\chapter{Al-Fatihah (The Opening)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[1][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bismi Allahi alrrahmani alrraheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[1][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alhamdu lillahi rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[1][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alrrahmani alrraheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Beneficent, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[1][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Maliki yawmi alddeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Master of the Day of Judgment,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[1][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Iyyaka naAAbudu waiyyaka nastaAAeenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[1][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ihdina alssirata almustaqeema}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Show us the straight path,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[1][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sirata allatheena anAAamta AAalayhim ghayri almaghdoobi AAalayhim wala alddalleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The path of those whom Thou hast favoured; Not the (path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Baqarah (The Cow)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aliflammeem}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Alif. Lam. Mim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika alkitabu la rayba feehi hudan lilmuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is the Scripture whereof there is no doubt, a guidance unto those who ward off (evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yuminoona bialghaybi wayuqeemoona alssalata wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who believe in the Unseen, and establish worship, and spend of that We have bestowed upon them;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena yuminoona bima onzila ilayka wama onzila min qablika wabialakhirati hum yooqinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And who believe in that which is revealed unto thee (Muhammad) and that which was revealed before thee, and are certain of the Hereafter.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika AAala hudan min rabbihim waolaika humu almuflihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} These depend on guidance from their Lord. These are the successful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena kafaroo sawaon AAalayhim aanthartahum am lam tunthirhum la yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for the Disbelievers, Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not it is all one for them; they believe not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khatama Allahu AAala quloobihim waAAala samAAihim waAAala absarihim ghishawatun walahum AAathabun AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah hath sealed their hearing and their hearts, and on their eyes there is a covering. Theirs will be an awful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamina alnnasi man yaqoolu amanna biAllahi wabialyawmi alakhiri wama hum bimumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of mankind are some who say: We believe in Allah and the Last Day, when they believe not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YukhadiAAoona Allaha waallatheena amanoo wama yakhdaAAoona illa anfusahum wama yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They think to beguile Allah and those who believe, and they beguile none save themselves; but they perceive not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee quloobihim maradun fazadahumu Allahu maradan walahum AAathabun aleemun bima kanoo yakthiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In their hearts is a disease, and Allah increaseth their disease. A painful doom is theirs because they lie.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha qeela lahum la tufsidoo fee alardi qaloo innama nahnu muslihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when it is said unto them: Make not mischief in the earth, they say: We are peacemakers only.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ala innahum humu almufsidoona walakin la yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Are not they indeed the mischief-makers? But they perceive not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha qeela lahum aminoo kama amana alnnasu qaloo anuminu kama amana alssufahao ala innahum humu alssufahao walakin la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when it is said unto them: believe as the people believe, they say: shall we believe as the foolish believe? are not they indeed the foolish? But they know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha laqoo allatheena amanoo qaloo amanna waitha khalaw ila shayateenihim qaloo inna maAAakum innama nahnu mustahzioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they fall in with those who believe, they say: We believe; but when they go apart to their devils they declare: Lo! we are with you; verily we did but mock.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu yastahzio bihim wayamudduhum fee tughyanihim yaAAmahoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah (Himself) doth mock them, leaving them to wander blindly on in their contumacy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika allatheena ishtarawoo alddalalata bialhuda fama rabihat tijaratuhum wama kanoo muhtadeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} These are they who purchase error at the price of guidance, so their commerce doth not prosper, neither are they guided.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Mathaluhum kamathali allathee istawqada naran falamma adaat ma hawlahu thahaba Allahu binoorihim watarakahum fee thulumatin la yubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Their likeness is as the likeness of one who kindleth fire, and when it sheddeth its light around him Allah taketh away their light and leaveth them in darkness, where they cannot see,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Summun bukmun AAumyun fahum la yarjiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Deaf, dumb and blind; and they return not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw kasayyibin mina alssamai feehi thulumatun waraAAdun wabarqun yajAAaloona asabiAAahum fee athanihim mina alssawaAAiqi hathara almawti waAllahu muheetun bialkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or like a rainstorm from the sky, wherein is darkness, thunder and the flash of lightning. They thrust their fingers in their ears by reason of the thunder-claps, for fear of death, Allah encompasseth the disbelievers (in His guidance, His omniscience and His omnipotence).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yakadu albarqu yakhtafu absarahum kullama adaa lahum mashaw feehi waitha athlama AAalayhim qamoo walaw shaa Allahu lathahaba bisamAAihim waabsarihim inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The lightning almost snatcheth away their sight from them. As often as it flasheth forth for them they walk therein, and when it darkeneth against them they stand still. If Allah willed, He could destroy their hearing and their sight. Lo! Allah is able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnasu oAAbudoo rabbakumu allathee khalaqakum waallatheena min qablikum laAAallakum tattaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O mankind! worship your Lord, Who hath created you and those before you, so that ye may ward off (evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda firashan waalssamaa binaan waanzala mina alssamai maan faakhraja bihi mina alththamarati rizqan lakum fala tajAAaloo lillahi andadan waantum taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who hath appointed the earth a resting-place for you, and the sky a canopy; and causeth water to pour down from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you. And do not set up rivals to Allah when ye know (better).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain kuntum fee raybin mimma nazzalna AAala AAabdina fatoo bisooratin min mithlihi waodAAoo shuhadaakum min dooni Allahi in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if ye are in doubt concerning that which We reveal unto Our slave (Muhammad), then produce a surah of the like thereof, and call your witness beside Allah if ye are truthful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain lam tafAAaloo walan tafAAaloo faittaqoo alnnara allatee waqooduha alnnasu waalhijaratu oAAiddat lilkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if ye do it not - and ye can never do it - then guard yourselves against the Fire prepared for disbelievers, whose fuel is of men and stones.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wabashshiri allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati anna lahum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu kullama ruziqoo minha min thamaratin rizqan qaloo hatha allathee ruziqna min qablu waotoo bihi mutashabihan walahum feeha azwajun mutahharatun wahum feeha khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And give glad tidings (O Muhammad) unto those who believe and do good works; that theirs are Gardens underneath which rivers flow; as often as they are regaled with food of the fruit thereof, they say: this is what was given us aforetime; and it is given to them in resemblance. There for them are pure companions; there for ever they abide.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha la yastahyee an yadriba mathalan ma baAAoodatan fama fawqaha faamma allatheena amanoo fayaAAlamoona annahu alhaqqu min rabbihim waamma allatheena kafaroo fayaqooloona matha arada Allahu bihatha mathalan yudillu bihi katheeran wayahdee bihi katheeran wama yudillu bihi illa alfasiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah disdaineth not to coin the similitude even of a gnat. Those who believe know that it is the truth from their Lord; but those who disbelieve say: What doth Allah wish (to teach) by such a similitude? He misleadeth many thereby, and He guideth many thereby; and He misleadeth thereby only miscreants;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yanqudoona AAahda Allahi min baAAdi meethaqihi wayaqtaAAoona ma amara Allahu bihi an yoosala wayufsidoona fee alardi olaika humu alkhasiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who break the covenant of Allah after ratifying it, and sever that which Allah ordered to be joined, and (who) make mischief in the earth: Those are they who are the losers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kayfa takfuroona biAllahi wakuntum amwatan faahyakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum thumma ilayhi turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How disbelieve ye in Allah when ye were dead and He gave life to you! Then He will give you death, then life again, and then unto Him ye will return.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa allathee khalaqa lakum ma fee alardi jameeAAan thumma istawa ila alssamai fasawwahunna sabAAa samawatin wahuwa bikulli shayin AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who created for you all that is in the earth. Then turned He to the heaven, and fashioned it as seven heavens. And He is knower of all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee jaAAilun fee alardi khaleefatan qaloo atajAAalu feeha man yufsidu feeha wayasfiku alddimaa wanahnu nusabbihu bihamdika wanuqaddisu laka qala innee aAAlamu ma la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to place a viceroy in the earth, they said: Wilt thou place therein one who will do harm therein and will shed blood, while we, we hymn Thy praise and sanctify Thee? He said: Surely I know that which ye know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAallama adama alasmaa kullaha thumma AAaradahum AAala almalaikati faqala anbioonee biasmai haolai in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He taught Adam all the names, then showed them to the angels, saying: Inform Me of the names of these, if ye are truthful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo subhanaka la AAilma lana illa ma AAallamtana innaka anta alAAaleemu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Be glorified! We have no knowledge saving that which Thou hast taught us. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Knower, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya adamu anbihum biasmaihim falamma anbaahum biasmaihim qala alam aqul lakum innee aAAlamu ghayba alssamawati waalardi waaAAlamu ma tubdoona wama kuntum taktumoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O Adam! Inform them of their names, and when he had informed them of their names, He said: Did I not tell you that I know the secret of the heavens and the earth? And I know that which ye disclose and which ye hide.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa aba waistakbara wakana mina alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We said unto the angels: Prostrate yourselves before Adam, they fell prostrate, all save Iblis. He demurred through pride, and so became a disbeliever.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqulna ya adamu oskun anta wazawjuka aljannata wakula minha raghadan haythu shituma wala taqraba hathihi alshshajarata fatakoona mina alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We said: O Adam! Dwell thou and thy wife in the Garden, and eat ye freely (of the fruits) thereof where ye will; but come not nigh this tree lest ye become wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faazallahuma alshshaytanu AAanha faakhrajahuma mimma kana feehi waqulna ihbitoo baAAdukum libaAAdin AAaduwwun walakum fee alardi mustaqarrun wamataAAun ila heenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But Satan caused them to deflect therefrom and expelled them from the (happy) state in which they were; and We said: Fall down, one of you a foe unto the other! There shall be for you on earth a habitation and provision for a time.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatalaqqa adamu min rabbihi kalimatin fataba AAalayhi innahu huwa alttawwabu alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then Adam received from his Lord words (of revelation), and He relented toward him. Lo! He is the relenting, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qulna ihbitoo minha jameeAAan faimma yatiyannakum minnee hudan faman tabiAAa hudaya fala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We said: Go down, all of you, from hence; but verily there cometh unto you from Me a guidance; and whoso followeth My guidance, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But they who disbelieve, and deny Our revelations, such are rightful Peoples of the Fire. They will abide therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya banee israeela othkuroo niAAmatiya allatee anAAamtu AAalaykum waawfoo biAAahdee oofi biAAahdikum waiyyaya fairhabooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Children of Israel! Remember My favour wherewith I favoured you, and fulfil your (part of the) covenant, I shall fulfil My (part of the) covenant, and fear Me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaminoo bima anzaltu musaddiqan lima maAAakum wala takoonoo awwala kafirin bihi wala tashtaroo biayatee thamanan qaleelan waiyyaya faittaqooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And believe in that which I reveal, confirming that which ye possess already (of the Scripture), and be not first to disbelieve therein, and part not with My revelations for a trifling price, and keep your duty unto Me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala talbisoo alhaqqa bialbatili wataktumoo alhaqqa waantum taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Confound not truth with falsehood, nor knowingly conceal the truth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata wairkaAAoo maAAa alrrakiAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Establish worship, pay the poor-due, and bow your heads with those who bow (in worship).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Atamuroona alnnasa bialbirri watansawna anfusakum waantum tatloona alkitaba afala taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Enjoin ye righteousness upon mankind while ye yourselves forget (to practise it)? And ye are readers of the Scripture! Have ye then no sense?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaistaAAeenoo bialssabri waalssalati wainnaha lakabeeratun illa AAala alkhashiAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Seek help in patience and prayer; and truly it is hard save for the humble-minded,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yathunnoona annahum mulaqoo rabbihim waannahum ilayhi rajiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who know that they will have to meet their Lord, and that unto Him they are returning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya banee israeela othkuroo niAAmatiya allatee anAAamtu AAalaykum waannee faddaltukum AAala alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Children of Israel! Remember My favour wherewith I favoured you and how I preferred you to (all) creatures.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waittaqoo yawman la tajzee nafsun AAan nafsin shayan wala yuqbalu minha shafaAAatun wala yukhathu minha AAadlun wala hum yunsaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And guard yourselves against a day when no soul will in aught avail another, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be received from it, nor will they be helped.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith najjaynakum min ali firAAawna yasoomoonakum sooa alAAathabi yuthabbihoona abnaakum wayastahyoona nisaakum wafee thalikum balaon min rabbikum AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (remember) when We did deliver you from Pharaoh's folk, who were afflicting you with dreadful torment, slaying your sons and sparing your women: that was a tremendous trial from your Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith faraqna bikumu albahra faanjaynakum waaghraqna ala firAAawna waantum tanthuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We brought you through the sea and rescued you, and drowned the folk of Pharaoh in your sight.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith waAAadna moosa arbaAAeena laylatan thumma ittakhathtumu alAAijla min baAAdihi waantum thalimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We did appoint for Moses forty nights (of solitude), and then ye chose the calf, when he had gone from you, and were wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma AAafawna AAankum min baAAdi thalika laAAallakum tashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, even after that, We pardoned you in order that ye might give thanks.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith atayna moosa alkitaba waalfurqana laAAallakum tahtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We gave unto Moses the Scripture and the criterion (of right and wrong), that ye might be led aright.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qala moosa liqawmihi ya qawmi innakum thalamtum anfusakum biittikhathikumu alAAijla fatooboo ila bariikum faoqtuloo anfusakum thalikum khayrun lakum AAinda bariikum fataba AAalaykum innahu huwa alttawwabu alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Moses said unto his people: O my people! Ye have wronged yourselves by your choosing of the calf (for worship) so turn in penitence to your Creator, and kill (the guilty) yourselves. That will be best for you with your Creator and He will relent toward you. Lo! He is the Relenting, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qultum ya moosa lan numina laka hatta nara Allaha jahratan faakhathatkumu alssaAAiqatu waantum tanthuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when ye said: O Moses! We will not believe in thee till we see Allah plainly; and even while ye gazed the lightning seized you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma baAAathnakum min baAAdi mawtikum laAAallakum tashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We revived you after your extinction, that ye might give thanks.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wathallalna AAalaykumu alghamama waanzalna AAalaykumu almanna waalssalwa kuloo min tayyibati ma razaqnakum wama thalamoona walakin kanoo anfusahum yathlimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We caused the white cloud to overshadow you and sent down on you the manna and the quails, (saying): Eat of the good things wherewith We have provided you - they wronged Us not, but they did wrong themselves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qulna odkhuloo hathihi alqaryata fakuloo minha haythu shitum raghadan waodkhuloo albaba sujjadan waqooloo hittatun naghfir lakum khatayakum wasanazeedu almuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We said: Go into this township and eat freely of that which is therein, and enter the gate prostrate, and say: "Repentance." We will forgive you your sins and will increase (reward) for the right-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fabaddala allatheena thalamoo qawlan ghayra allathee qeela lahum faanzalna AAala allatheena thalamoo rijzan mina alssamai bima kanoo yafsuqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But those who did wrong changed the word which had been told them for another saying, and We sent down upon the evil-doers wrath from heaven for their evil-doing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waithi istasqa moosa liqawmihi faqulna idrib biAAasaka alhajara fainfajarat minhu ithnata AAashrata AAaynan qad AAalima kullu onasin mashrabahum kuloo waishraboo min rizqi Allahi wala taAAthaw fee alardi mufsideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Moses asked for water for his people, We said: Smite with thy staff the rock. And there gushed out therefrom twelve springs (so that) each tribe knew their drinking-place. Eat and drink of that which Allah hath provided, and do not act corruptly, making mischief in the earth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qultum ya moosa lan nasbira AAala taAAamin wahidin faodAAu lana rabbaka yukhrij lana mimma tunbitu alardu min baqliha waqiththaiha wafoomiha waAAadasiha wabasaliha qala atastabdiloona allathee huwa adna biallathee huwa khayrun ihbitoo misran fainna lakum ma saaltum waduribat AAalayhimu alththillatu waalmaskanatu wabaoo bighadabin mina Allahi thalika biannahum kanoo yakfuroona biayati Allahi wayaqtuloona alnnabiyyeena bighayri alhaqqi thalika bima AAasaw wakanoo yaAAtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when ye said: O Moses! We are weary of one kind of food; so call upon thy Lord for us that He bring forth for us of that which the earth groweth - of its herbs and its cucumbers and its corn and its lentils and its onions. He said: Would ye exchange that which is higher for that which is lower? Go down to settled country, thus ye shall get that which ye demand. And humiliation and wretchedness were stamped upon them and they were visited with wrath from Allah. That was because they disbelieved in Allah's revelations and slew the prophets wrongfully. That was for their disobedience and transgression.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena amanoo waallatheena hadoo waalnnasara waalssabieena man amana biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri waAAamila salihan falahum ajruhum AAinda rabbihim wala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Those who believe (in that which is revealed unto thee, Muhammad), and those who are Jews, and Christians, and Sabaeans - whoever believeth in Allah and the Last Day and doeth right - surely their reward is with their Lord, and there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith akhathna meethaqakum warafaAAna fawqakumu alttoora khuthoo ma ataynakum biquwwatin waothkuroo ma feehi laAAallakum tattaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (remember, O Children of Israel) when We made a covenant with you and caused the mount to tower above you, (saying): Hold fast that which We have given you, and remember that which is therein, that ye may ward off (evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma tawallaytum min baAAdi thalika falawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu lakuntum mina alkhasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, even after that, ye turned away, and if it had not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy ye had been among the losers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad AAalimtumu allatheena iAAtadaw minkum fee alssabti faqulna lahum koonoo qiradatan khasieena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And ye know of those of you who broke the Sabbath, how We said unto them: Be ye apes, despised and hated!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FajaAAalnaha nakalan lima bayna yadayha wama khalfaha wamawAAithatan lilmuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We made it an example to their own and to succeeding generations, and an admonition to the Allah-fearing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qala moosa liqawmihi inna Allaha yamurukum an tathbahoo baqaratan qaloo atattakhithuna huzuwan qala aAAoothu biAllahi an akoona mina aljahileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Moses said unto his people: Lo! Allah commandeth you that ye sacrifice a cow, they said: Dost thou make game of us? He answered: Allah forbid that I should be among the foolish!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo odAAu lana rabbaka yubayyin lana ma hiya qala innahu yaqoolu innaha baqaratun la faridun wala bikrun AAawanun bayna thalika faifAAaloo ma tumaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Pray for us unto thy Lord that He make clear to us what (cow) she is. (Moses) answered: Lo! He saith, Verily she is a cow neither with calf nor immature; (she is) between the two conditions; so do that which ye are commanded.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo odAAu lana rabbaka yubayyin lana ma lawnuha qala innahu yaqoolu innaha baqaratun safrao faqiAAun lawnuha tasurru alnnathireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Pray for us unto thy Lord that He make clear to us of what colour she is. (Moses) answered: Lo! He saith: Verily she is a yellow cow. Bright is her colour, gladdening beholders.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo odAAu lana rabbaka yubayyin lana ma hiya inna albaqara tashabaha AAalayna wainna in shaa Allahu lamuhtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Pray for us unto thy Lord that He make clear to us what (cow) she is. Lo! cows are much alike to us; and Lo! if Allah wills, we may be led aright.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala innahu yaqoolu innaha baqaratun la thaloolun tutheeru alarda wala tasqee alhartha musallamatun la shiyata feeha qaloo alana jita bialhaqqi fathabahooha wama kadoo yafAAaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Moses) answered: Lo! He saith: Verily she is a cow unyoked; she plougheth not the soil nor watereth the tilth; whole and without mark. They said: Now thou bringest the truth. So they sacrificed her, though almost they did not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qataltum nafsan faiddaratum feeha waAllahu mukhrijun ma kuntum taktumoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (remember) when ye slew a man and disagreed concerning it and Allah brought forth that which ye were hiding.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqulna idriboohu bibaAAdiha kathalika yuhyee Allahu almawta wayureekum ayatihi laAAallakum taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We said: Smite him with some of it. Thus Allah bringeth the dead to life and showeth you His portents so that ye may understand.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma qasat quloobukum min baAAdi thalika fahiya kaalhijarati aw ashaddu qaswatan wainna mina alhijarati lama yatafajjaru minhu alanharu wainna minha lama yashshaqqaqu fayakhruju minhu almao wainna minha lama yahbitu min khashyati Allahi wama Allahu bighafilin AAamma taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, even after that, your hearts were hardened and became as rocks, or worse than rocks, for hardness. For indeed there are rocks from out which rivers gush, and indeed there are rocks which split asunder so that water floweth from them. And indeed there are rocks which fall down for the fear of Allah. Allah is not unaware of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AfatatmaAAoona an yuminoo lakum waqad kana fareequn minhum yasmaAAoona kalama Allahi thumma yuharrifoonahu min baAAdi ma AAaqaloohu wahum yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have ye any hope that they will be true to you when a party of them used to listen to the word of Allah, then used to change it, after they had understood it, knowingly?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha laqoo allatheena amanoo qaloo amanna waitha khala baAAduhum ila baAAdin qaloo atuhaddithoonahum bima fataha Allahu AAalaykum liyuhajjookum bihi AAinda rabbikum afala taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they fall in with those who believe, they say: We believe. But when they go apart one with another they say: Prate ye to them of that which Allah hath disclosed to you that they may contend with you before your Lord concerning it? Have ye then no sense?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awala yaAAlamoona anna Allaha yaAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Are they then unaware that Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden and that which they proclaim?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waminhum ommiyyoona la yaAAlamoona alkitaba illa amaniyya wain hum illa yathunnoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Among them are unlettered folk who know the Scripture not except from hearsay. They but guess.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fawaylun lillatheena yaktuboona alkitaba biaydeehim thumma yaqooloona hatha min AAindi Allahi liyashtaroo bihi thamanan qaleelan fawaylun lahum mimma katabat aydeehim wawaylun lahum mimma yaksiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefore woe be unto those who write the Scripture with their hands and then say, "This is from Allah," that they may purchase a small gain therewith. Woe unto them for that their hands have written, and woe unto them for that they earn thereby.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo lan tamassana alnnaru illa ayyaman maAAdoodatan qul attakhathtum AAinda Allahi AAahdan falan yukhlifa Allahu AAahdahu am taqooloona AAala Allahi ma la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: The Fire (of punishment) will not touch us save for a certain number of days. Say: Have ye received a covenant from Allah - truly Allah will not break His covenant - or tell ye concerning Allah that which ye know not?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bala man kasaba sayyiatan waahatat bihi khateeatuhu faolaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but whosoever hath done evil and his sin surroundeth him; such are rightful owners of the Fire; they will abide therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati olaika ashabu aljannati hum feeha khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who believe and do good works: such are rightful owners of the Garden. They will abide therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith akhathna meethaqa banee israeela la taAAbudoona illa Allaha wabialwalidayni ihsanan wathee alqurba waalyatama waalmasakeeni waqooloo lilnnasi husnan waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata thumma tawallaytum illa qaleelan minkum waantum muAAridoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (remember) when We made a covenant with the Children of Israel, (saying): Worship none save Allah (only), and be good to parents and to kindred and to orphans and the needy, and speak kindly to mankind; and establish worship and pay the poor-due. Then, after that, ye slid back, save a few of you, being averse.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith akhathna meethaqakum la tasfikoona dimaakum wala tukhrijoona anfusakum min diyarikum thumma aqrartum waantum tashhadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We made with you a covenant (saying): Shed not the blood of your people nor turn (a party of) your people out of your dwellings. Then ye ratified (Our covenant) and ye were witnesses (thereto).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma antum haolai taqtuloona anfusakum watukhrijoona fareeqan minkum min diyarihim tathaharoona AAalayhim bialithmi waalAAudwani wain yatookum osara tufadoohum wahuwa muharramun AAalaykum ikhrajuhum afatuminoona bibaAAdi alkitabi watakfuroona bibaAAdin fama jazao man yafAAalu thalika minkum illa khizyun fee alhayati alddunya wayawma alqiyamati yuraddoona ila ashaddi alAAathabi wama Allahu bighafilin AAamma taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Yet ye it is who slay each other and drive out a party of your people from their homes, supporting one another against them by sin and transgression? - and if they came to you as captives ye would ransom them, whereas their expulsion was itself unlawful for you - Believe ye in part of the Scripture and disbelieve ye in part thereof? And what is the reward of those who do so save ignominy in the life of the world, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be consigned to the most grievous doom. For Allah is not unaware of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika allatheena ishtarawoo alhayata alddunya bialakhirati fala yukhaffafu AAanhumu alAAathabu wala hum yunsaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such are those who buy the life of the world at the price of the Hereafter. Their punishment will not be lightened, neither will they have support.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba waqaffayna min baAAdihi bialrrusuli waatayna AAeesa ibna maryama albayyinati waayyadnahu biroohi alqudusi afakullama jaakum rasoolun bima la tahwa anfusukumu istakbartum fafareeqan kaththabtum wafareeqan taqtuloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We gave unto Moses the Scripture and We caused a train of messengers to follow after him, and We gave unto Jesus, son of Mary, clear proofs (of Allah's sovereignty), and We supported him with the Holy spirit. Is it ever so, that, when there cometh unto you a messenger (from Allah) with that which ye yourselves desire not, ye grow arrogant, and some ye disbelieve and some ye slay?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo quloobuna ghulfun bal laAAanahumu Allahu bikufrihim faqaleelan ma yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: Our hearts are hardened. Nay, but Allah hath cursed them for their unbelief. Little is that which they believe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma jaahum kitabun min AAindi Allahi musaddiqun lima maAAahum wakanoo min qablu yastaftihoona AAala allatheena kafaroo falamma jaahum ma AAarafoo kafaroo bihi falaAAnatu Allahi AAala alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when there cometh unto them a scripture from Allah, confirming that in their possession - though before that they were asking for a signal triumph over those who disbelieved - and when there cometh unto them that which they know (to be the truth) they disbelieve therein. The curse of Allah is on disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bisama ishtaraw bihi anfusahum an yakfuroo bima anzala Allahu baghyan an yunazzila Allahu min fadlihi AAala man yashao min AAibadihi fabaoo bighadabin AAala ghadabin walilkafireena AAathabun muheenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Evil is that for which they sell their souls: that they should disbelieve in that which Allah hath revealed, grudging that Allah should reveal of His bounty unto whom He will of His slaves. They have incurred anger upon anger. For disbelievers is a shameful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha qeela lahum aminoo bima anzala Allahu qaloo numinu bima onzila AAalayna wayakfuroona bima waraahu wahuwa alhaqqu musaddiqan lima maAAahum qul falima taqtuloona anbiyaa Allahi min qablu in kuntum mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when it is said unto them: Believe in that which Allah hath revealed, they say: We believe in that which was revealed unto us. And they disbelieve in that which cometh after it, though it is the truth confirming that which they possess. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Why then slew ye the prophets of Allah aforetime, if ye are (indeed) believers?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad jaakum moosa bialbayyinati thumma ittakhathtumu alAAijla min baAAdihi waantum thalimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Moses came unto you with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), yet, while he was away, ye chose the calf (for worship) and ye were wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith akhathna meethaqakum warafaAAna fawqakumu alttoora khuthoo ma ataynakum biquwwatin waismaAAoo qaloo samiAAna waAAasayna waoshriboo fee quloobihimu alAAijla bikufrihim qul bisama yamurukum bihi eemanukum in kuntum mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We made with you a covenant and caused the Mount to tower above you, (saying): Hold fast by that which We have given you, and hear (Our Word), they said: We hear and we rebel. And (worship of) the calf was made to sink into their hearts because of their rejection (of the covenant). Say (unto them): Evil is that which your belief enjoineth on you, if ye are believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul in kanat lakumu alddaru alakhiratu AAinda Allahi khalisatan min dooni alnnasi fatamannawoo almawta in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them): If the abode of the Hereafter in the providence of Allah is indeed for you alone and not for others of mankind (as ye pretend), then long for death (for ye must long for death) if ye are truthful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walan yatamannawhu abadan bima qaddamat aydeehim waAllahu AAaleemun bialththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But they will never long for it, because of that which their own hands have sent before them. Allah is aware of evil-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walatajidannahum ahrasa alnnasi AAala hayatin wamina allatheena ashrakoo yawaddu ahaduhum law yuAAammaru alfa sanatin wama huwa bimuzahzihihi mina alAAathabi an yuAAammara waAllahu baseerun bima yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thou wilt find them greediest of mankind for life and (greedier) than the idolaters. (Each) one of them would like to be allowed to live a thousand years. And to live (a thousand years) would be no means remove him from the doom. Allah is Seer of what they do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul man kana AAaduwwan lijibreela fainnahu nazzalahu AAala qalbika biithni Allahi musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi wahudan wabushra lilmumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad, to mankind): Who is an enemy to Gabriel! For he it is who hath revealed (this Scripture) to thy heart by Allah's leave, confirming that which was (revealed) before it, and a guidance and glad tidings to believers;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man kana AAaduwwan lillahi wamalaikatihi warusulihi wajibreela wameekala fainna Allaha AAaduwwun lilkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who is an enemy to Allah, and His angels and His messengers, and Gabriel and Michael! Then, lo! Allah (Himself) is an enemy to the disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad anzalna ilayka ayatin bayyinatin wama yakfuru biha illa alfasiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Verily We have revealed unto thee clear tokens, and only miscreants will disbelieve in them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awakullama AAahadoo AAahdan nabathahu fareequn minhum bal aktharuhum la yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is it ever so that when they make a covenant a party of them set it aside? The truth is, most of them believe not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma jaahum rasoolun min AAindi Allahi musaddiqun lima maAAahum nabatha fareequn mina allatheena ootoo alkitaba kitaba Allahi waraa thuhoorihim kaannahum la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when there cometh unto them a messenger from Allah, confirming that which they possess, a party of those who have received the Scripture fling the Scripture of Allah behind their backs as if they knew not,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaittabaAAoo ma tatloo alshshayateenu AAala mulki sulaymana wama kafara sulaymanu walakinna alshshayateena kafaroo yuAAallimoona alnnasa alssihra wama onzila AAala almalakayni bibabila haroota wamaroota wama yuAAallimani min ahadin hatta yaqoola innama nahnu fitnatun fala takfur fayataAAallamoona minhuma ma yufarriqoona bihi bayna almari wazawjihi wama hum bidarreena bihi min ahadin illa biithni Allahi wayataAAallamoona ma yadurruhum wala yanfaAAuhum walaqad AAalimoo lamani ishtarahu ma lahu fee alakhirati min khalaqin walabisa ma sharaw bihi anfusahum law kanoo yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And follow that which the devils falsely related against the kingdom of Solomon. Solomon disbelieved not; but the devils disbelieved, teaching mankind magic and that which was revealed to the two angels in Babel, Harut and Marut. Nor did they (the two angels) teach it to anyone till they had said: We are only a temptation, therefore disbelieve not (in the guidance of Allah). And from these two (angles) people learn that by which they cause division between man and wife; but they injure thereby no-one save by Allah's leave. And they learn that which harmeth them and profiteth them not. And surely they do know that he who trafficketh therein will have no (happy) portion in the Hereafter; and surely evil is the price for which they sell their souls, if they but knew.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw annahum amanoo waittaqaw lamathoobatun min AAindi Allahi khayrun law kanoo yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if they had believed and kept from evil, a recompense from Allah would be better, if they only knew.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la taqooloo raAAina waqooloo onthurna waismaAAoo walilkafireena AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe, say not (unto the Prophet): "Listen to us" but say "Look upon us," and be ye listeners. For disbelievers is a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma yawaddu allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi wala almushrikeena an yunazzala AAalaykum min khayrin min rabbikum waAllahu yakhtassu birahmatihi man yashao waAllahu thoo alfadli alAAatheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Neither those who disbelieve among the people of the Scripture nor the idolaters love that there should be sent down unto you any good thing from your Lord. But Allah chooseth for His mercy whom He will, and Allah is of Infinite Bounty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma nansakh min ayatin aw nunsiha nati bikhayrin minha aw mithliha alam taAAlam anna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nothing of our revelation (even a single verse) do we abrogate or cause be forgotten, but we bring (in place) one better or the like thereof. Knowest thou not that Allah is Able to do all things?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam taAAlam anna Allaha lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi wama lakum min dooni Allahi min waliyyin wala naseerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Knowest thou not that it is Allah unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and ye have not, beside Allah, any guardian or helper?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am tureedoona an tasaloo rasoolakum kama suila moosa min qablu waman yatabaddali alkufra bialeemani faqad dalla sawaa alssabeeli}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or would ye question your messenger as Moses was questioned aforetime? He who chooseth disbelief instead of faith, verily he hath gone astray from a plain road.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wadda katheerun min ahli alkitabi law yaruddoonakum min baAAdi eemanikum kuffaran hasadan min AAindi anfusihim min baAAdi ma tabayyana lahumu alhaqqu faoAAfoo waisfahoo hatta yatiya Allahu biamrihi inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Many of the people of the Scripture long to make you disbelievers after your belief, through envy on their own account, after the truth hath become manifest unto them. Forgive and be indulgent (toward them) until Allah give command. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata wama tuqaddimoo lianfusikum min khayrin tajidoohu AAinda Allahi inna Allaha bima taAAmaloona baseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Establish worship, and pay the poor-due; and whatever of good ye send before (you) for your souls, ye will find it with Allah. Lo! Allah is Seer of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo lan yadkhula aljannata illa man kana hoodan aw nasara tilka amaniyyuhum qul hatoo burhanakum in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: None entereth paradise unless he be a Jew or a Christian. These are their own desires. Say: Bring your proof (of what ye state) if ye are truthful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][112]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bala man aslama wajhahu lillahi wahuwa muhsinun falahu ajruhu AAinda rabbihi wala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but whosoever surrendereth his purpose to Allah while doing good, his reward is with his Lord; and there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][113]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqalati alyahoodu laysati alnnasara AAala shayin waqalati alnnasara laysati alyahoodu AAala shayin wahum yatloona alkitaba kathalika qala allatheena la yaAAlamoona mithla qawlihim faAllahu yahkumu baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the Jews say the Christians follow nothing (true), and the Christians say the Jews follow nothing (true); yet both are readers of the Scripture. Even thus speak those who know not. Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they differ.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][114]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman athlamu mimman manaAAa masajida Allahi an yuthkara feeha ismuhu wasaAAa fee kharabiha olaika ma kana lahum an yadkhulooha illa khaifeena lahum fee alddunya khizyun walahum fee alakhirati AAathabun AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And who doth greater wrong than he who forbiddeth the approach to the sanctuaries of Allah lest His name should be mentioned therein, and striveth for their ruin. As for such, it was never meant that they should enter them except in fear. Theirs in the world is ignominy and theirs in the Hereafter is an awful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][115]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walillahi almashriqu waalmaghribu faaynama tuwalloo fathamma wajhu Allahi inna Allaha wasiAAun AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Allah belong the East and the West, and whithersoever ye turn, there is Allah's Countenance. Lo! Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][116]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo itakhatha Allahu waladan subhanahu bal lahu ma fee alssamawati waalardi kullun lahu qanitoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: Allah hath taken unto Himself a son. Be He glorified! Nay, but whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth is His. All are subservient unto Him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][117]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{BadeeAAu alssamawati waalardi waitha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoonu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Originator of the heavens and the earth! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][118]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena la yaAAlamoona lawla yukallimuna Allahu aw tateena ayatun kathalika qala allatheena min qablihim mithla qawlihim tashabahat quloobuhum qad bayyanna alayati liqawmin yooqinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who have no knowledge say: Why doth not Allah speak unto us, or some sign come unto us? Even thus, as they now speak, spake those (who were) before them. Their hearts are all alike. We have made clear the revelations for people who are sure.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][119]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna arsalnaka bialhaqqi basheeran wanatheeran wala tusalu Aaan ashabi aljaheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have sent thee (O Muhammad) with the truth, a bringer of glad tidings and a warner. And thou wilt not be asked about the owners of hell-fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][120]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walan tarda AAanka alyahoodu wala alnnasara hatta tattabiAAa millatahum qul inna huda Allahi huwa alhuda walaini ittabaAAta ahwaahum baAAda allathee jaaka mina alAAilmi ma laka mina Allahi min waliyyin wala naseerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the Jews will not be pleased with thee, nor will the Christians, till thou follow their creed. Say: Lo! the guidance of Allah (Himself) is Guidance. And if thou shouldst follow their desires after the knowledge which hath come unto thee, then wouldst thou have from Allah no protecting guardian nor helper.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][121]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena ataynahumu alkitaba yatloonahu haqqa tilawatihi olaika yuminoona bihi waman yakfur bihi faolaika humu alkhasiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those unto whom We have given the Scripture, who read it with the right reading, those believe in it. And whoso disbelieveth in it, those are they who are the losers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][122]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya banee israeela othkuroo niAAmatiya allatee anAAamtu AAalaykum waannee faddaltukum AAala alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Children of Israel! Remember My favour wherewith I favoured you and how I preferred you to (all) creatures.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][123]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waittaqoo yawman la tajzee nafsun AAan nafsin shayan wala yuqbalu minha AAadlun wala tanfaAAuha shafaAAatun wala hum yunsaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And guard (yourselves) against a day when no soul will in aught avail another, nor will compensation be accepted from it, nor will intercession be of use to it; nor will they be helped.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][124]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waithi ibtala ibraheema rabbuhu bikalimatin faatammahunna qala innee jaAAiluka lilnnasi imaman qala wamin thurriyyatee qala la yanalu AAahdee alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (remember) when his Lord tried Abraham with (His) commands, and he fulfilled them, He said: Lo! I have appointed thee a leader for mankind. (Abraham) said: And of my offspring (will there be leaders)? He said: My covenant includeth not wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][125]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith jaAAalna albayta mathabatan lilnnasi waamnan waittakhithoo min maqami ibraheema musallan waAAahidna ila ibraheema waismaAAeela an tahhira baytiya lilttaifeena waalAAakifeena waalrrukkaAAi alssujoodi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We made the House (at Makka) a resort for mankind and sanctuary, (saying): Take as your place of worship the place where Abraham stood (to pray). And We imposed a duty upon Abraham and Ishmael, (saying): Purify My house for those who go around and those who meditate therein and those who bow down and prostrate themselves (in worship).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][126]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qala ibraheemu rabbi ijAAal hatha baladan aminan waorzuq ahlahu mina alththamarati man amana minhum biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri qala waman kafara faomattiAAuhu qaleelan thumma adtarruhu ila AAathabi alnnari wabisa almaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Abraham prayed: My Lord! Make this a region of security and bestow upon its people fruits, such of them as believe in Allah and the Last Day, He answered: As for him who disbelieveth, I shall leave him in contentment for a while, then I shall compel him to the doom of Fire - a hapless journey's end!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][127]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith yarfaAAu ibraheemu alqawaAAida mina albayti waismaAAeelu rabbana taqabbal minna innaka anta alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Abraham and Ishmael were raising the foundations of the House, (Abraham prayed): Our Lord! Accept from us (this duty). Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Hearer, the Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][128]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbana waijAAalna muslimayni laka wamin thurriyyatina ommatan muslimatan laka waarina manasikana watub AAalayna innaka anta alttawwabu alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Our Lord! And make us submissive unto Thee and of our seed a nation submissive unto Thee, and show us our ways of worship, and relent toward us. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Relenting, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][129]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbana waibAAath feehim rasoolan minhum yatloo AAalayhim ayatika wayuAAallimuhumu alkitaba waalhikmata wayuzakkeehim innaka anta alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Our Lord! And raise up in their midst a messenger from among them who shall recite unto them Thy revelations, and shall instruct them in the Scripture and in wisdom and shall make them grow. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Mighty, Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][130]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman yarghabu AAan millati ibraheema illa man safiha nafsahu walaqadi istafaynahu fee alddunya wainnahu fee alakhirati lamina alssaliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And who forsaketh the religion of Abraham save him who befooleth himself? Verily We chose him in the world, and lo! in the Hereafter he is among the righteous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][131]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith qala lahu rabbuhu aslim qala aslamtu lirabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When his Lord said unto him: Surrender! he said: I have surrendered to the Lord of the Worlds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][132]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wawassa biha ibraheemu baneehi wayaAAqoobu ya baniyya inna Allaha istafa lakumu alddeena fala tamootunna illa waantum muslimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The same did Abraham enjoin upon his sons, and also Jacob, (saying): O my sons! Lo! Allah hath chosen for you the (true) religion; therefore die not save as men who have surrendered (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][133]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am kuntum shuhadaa ith hadara yaAAqooba almawtu ith qala libaneehi ma taAAbudoona min baAAdee qaloo naAAbudu ilahaka wailaha abaika ibraheema waismaAAeela waishaqa ilahan wahidan wanahnu lahu muslimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or were ye present when death came to Jacob, when he said unto his sons: What will ye worship after me? They said: We shall worship thy god, the god of thy fathers, Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac, One Allah, and unto Him we have surrendered.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][134]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tilka ommatun qad khalat laha ma kasabat walakum ma kasabtum wala tusaloona AAamma kano yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those are a people who have passed away. Theirs is that which they earned, and yours is that which ye earn. And ye will not be asked of what they used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][135]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo koonoo hoodan aw nasara tahtadoo qul bal millata ibraheema haneefan wama kana mina almushrikeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: Be Jews or Christians, then ye will be rightly guided. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Nay, but (we follow) the religion of Abraham, the upright, and he was not of the idolaters.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][136]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qooloo amanna biAllahi wama onzila ilayna wama onzila ila ibraheema waismaAAeela waishaqa wayaAAqooba waalasbati wama ootiya moosa waAAeesa wama ootiya alnnabiyyoona min rabbihim la nufarriqu bayna ahadin minhum wanahnu lahu muslimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muslims): We believe in Allah and that which is revealed unto us and that which was revealed unto Abraham, and Ishmael, and Isaac, and Jacob, and the tribes, and that which Moses and Jesus received, and that which the prophets received from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and unto Him we have surrendered.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][137]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain amanoo bimithli ma amantum bihi faqadi ihtadaw wain tawallaw fainnama hum fee shiqaqin fasayakfeekahumu Allahu wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if they believe in the like of that which ye believe, then are they rightly guided. But if they turn away, then are they in schism, and Allah will suffice thee (for defence) against them. He is the Hearer, the Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][138]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sibghata Allahi waman ahsanu mina Allahi sibghatan wanahnu lahu AAabidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (We take our) colour from Allah, and who is better than Allah at colouring. We are His worshippers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][139]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul atuhajjoonana fee Allahi wahuwa rabbuna warabbukum walana aAAmaluna walakum aAAmalukum wanahnu lahu mukhlisoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto the People of the Scripture): Dispute ye with us concerning Allah when He is our Lord and your Lord? Ours are our works and yours your works. We look to Him alone.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][140]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am taqooloona inna ibraheema waismaAAeela waishaqa wayaAAqooba waalasbata kanoo hoodan aw nasara qul aantum aAAlamu ami Allahu waman athlamu mimman katama shahadatan AAindahu mina Allahi wama Allahu bighafilin AAamma taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or say ye that Abraham, and Ishmael, and Isaac, and Jacob, and the tribes were Jews or Christians? Say: Do ye know best, or doth Allah? And who is more unjust than he who hideth a testimony which he hath received from Allah? Allah is not unaware of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][141]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tilka ommatun qad khalat laha ma kasabat walakum ma kasabtum wala tusaloona AAamma kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those are a people who have passed away; theirs is that which they earned and yours that which ye earn. And ye will not be asked of what they used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][142]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sayaqoolu alssufahao mina alnnasi ma wallahum AAan qiblatihimu allatee kanoo AAalayha qul lillahi almashriqu waalmaghribu yahdee man yashao ila siratin mustaqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The foolish of the people will say: What hath turned them from the qiblah which they formerly observed? Say: Unto Allah belong the East and the West. He guideth whom He will unto a straight path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][143]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakathalika jaAAalnakum ommatan wasatan litakoonoo shuhadaa AAala alnnasi wayakoona alrrasoolu AAalaykum shaheedan wama jaAAalna alqiblata allatee kunta AAalayha illa linaAAlama man yattabiAAu alrrasoola mimman yanqalibu AAala AAaqibayhi wain kanat lakabeeratan illa AAala allatheena hada Allahu wama kana Allahu liyudeeAAa eemanakum inna Allaha bialnnasi laraoofun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus We have appointed you a middle nation, that ye may be witnesses against mankind, and that the messenger may be a witness against you. And We appointed the qiblah which ye formerly observed only that We might know him who followeth the messenger, from him who turneth on his heels. In truth it was a hard (test) save for those whom Allah guided. But it was not Allah's purpose that your faith should be in vain, for Allah is Full of Pity, Merciful toward mankind.}
