\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][264]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tubtiloo sadaqatikum bialmanni waalatha kaallathee yunfiqu malahu riaa alnnasi wala yuminu biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri famathaluhu kamathali safwanin AAalayhi turabun faasabahu wabilun fatarakahu saldan la yaqdiroona AAala shayin mimma kasaboo waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Render not vain your almsgiving by reproach and injury, like him who spendeth his wealth only to be seen of men and believeth not in Allah and the Last Day. His likeness is as the likeness of a rock whereon is dust of earth; a rainstorm smiteth it, leaving it smooth and bare. They have no control of aught of that which they have gained. Allah guideth not the disbelieving folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][265]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamathalu allatheena yunfiqoona amwalahumu ibtighaa mardati Allahi watathbeetan min anfusihim kamathali jannatin birabwatin asabaha wabilun faatat okulaha diAAfayni fain lam yusibha wabilun fatallun waAllahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the likeness of those who spend their wealth in search of Allah's pleasure, and for the strengthening of their souls, is as the likeness of a garden on a height. The rainstorm smiteth it and it bringeth forth its fruit twofold. And if the rainstorm smite it not, then the shower. Allah is Seer of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][266]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ayawaddu ahadukum an takoona lahu jannatun min nakheelin waaAAnabin tajree min tahtiha alanharu lahu feeha min kulli alththamarati waasabahu alkibaru walahu thurriyyatun duAAafao faasabaha iAAsarun feehi narun faihtaraqat kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati laAAallakum tatafakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Would any of you like to have a garden of palm-trees and vines, with rivers flowing underneath it, with all kinds of fruit for him therein; and old age hath stricken him and he hath feeble offspring; and a fiery whirlwind striketh it and it is (all) consumed by fire. Thus Allah maketh plain His revelations unto you, in order that ye may give thought.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][267]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo anfiqoo min tayyibati ma kasabtum wamimma akhrajna lakum mina alardi wala tayammamoo alkhabeetha minhu tunfiqoona walastum biakhitheehi illa an tughmidoo feehi waiAAlamoo anna Allaha ghaniyyun hameedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Spend of the good things which ye have earned, and of that which We bring forth from the earth for you, and seek not the bad (with intent) to spend thereof (in charity) when ye would not take it for yourselves save with disdain; and know that Allah is Absolute, Owner of Praise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][268]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alshshaytanu yaAAidukumu alfaqra wayamurukum bialfahshai waAllahu yaAAidukum maghfiratan minhu wafadlan waAllahu wasiAAun AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The devil promiseth you destitution and enjoineth on you lewdness. But Allah promiseth you forgiveness from Himself with bounty. Allah is All-Embracing, All-knowing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][269]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yutee alhikmata man yashao waman yuta alhikmata faqad ootiya khayran katheeran wama yaththakkaru illa oloo alalbabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He giveth wisdom unto whom He will, and he unto whom wisdom is given, he truly hath received abundant good. But none remember except men of understanding.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][270]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama anfaqtum min nafaqatin aw nathartum min nathrin fainna Allaha yaAAlamuhu wama lilththalimeena min ansarin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whatever alms ye spend or vow ye vow, lo! Allah knoweth it. Wrong-doers have no helpers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][271]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In tubdoo alssadaqati faniAAimma hiya wain tukhfooha watutooha alfuqaraa fahuwa khayrun lakum wayukaffiru AAankum min sayyiatikum waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If ye publish your almsgiving, it is well, but if ye hide it and give it to the poor, it will be better for you, and will atone for some of your ill-deeds. Allah is Informed of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][272]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laysa AAalayka hudahum walakinna Allaha yahdee man yashao wama tunfiqoo min khayrin falianfusikum wama tunfiqoona illa ibtighaa wajhi Allahi wama tunfiqoo min khayrin yuwaffa ilaykum waantum la tuthlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The guiding of them is not thy duty (O Muhammad), but Allah guideth whom He will. And whatsoever good thing ye spend, it is for yourselves, when ye spend not save in search of Allah's Countenance; and whatsoever good thing ye spend, it will be repaid to you in full, and ye will not be wronged.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][273]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lilfuqarai allatheena ohsiroo fee sabeeli Allahi la yastateeAAoona darban fee alardi yahsabuhumu aljahilu aghniyaa mina alttaAAaffufi taAArifuhum biseemahum la yasaloona alnnasa ilhafan wama tunfiqoo min khayrin fainna Allaha bihi AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Alms are) for the poor who are straitened for the cause of Allah, who cannot travel in the land (for trade). The unthinking man accounteth them wealthy because of their restraint. Thou shalt know them by their mark: They do not beg of men with importunity. And whatsoever good thing ye spend, lo! Allah knoweth it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][274]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yunfiqoona amwalahum biallayli waalnnahari sirran waAAalaniyatan falahum ajruhum AAinda rabbihim wala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who spend their wealth by night and day, by stealth and openly, verily their reward is with their Lord, and their shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][275]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yakuloona alrriba la yaqoomoona illa kama yaqoomu allathee yatakhabbatuhu alshshaytanu mina almassi thalika biannahum qaloo innama albayAAu mithlu alrriba waahalla Allahu albayAAa waharrama alrriba faman jaahu mawAAithatun min rabbihi faintaha falahu ma salafa waamruhu ila Allahi waman AAada faolaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who swallow usury cannot rise up save as he ariseth whom the devil hath prostrated by (his) touch. That is because they say: Trade is just like usury; whereas Allah permitteth trading and forbiddeth usury. He unto whom an admonition from his Lord cometh, and (he) refraineth (in obedience thereto), he shall keep (the profits of) that which is past, and his affair (henceforth) is with Allah. As for him who returneth (to usury) - Such are rightful owners of the Fire. They will abide therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][276]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yamhaqu Allahu alrriba wayurbee alssadaqati waAllahu la yuhibbu kulla kaffarin atheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah hath blighted usury and made almsgiving fruitful. Allah loveth not the impious and guilty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][277]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati waaqamoo alssalata waatawoo alzzakata lahum ajruhum AAinda rabbihim wala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who believe and do good works and establish worship and pay the poor-due, their reward is with their Lord and there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][278]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha watharoo ma baqiya mina alrriba in kuntum mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah, and give up what remaineth (due to you) from usury, if ye are (in truth) believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][279]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain lam tafAAaloo fathanoo biharbin mina Allahi warasoolihi wain tubtum falakum ruoosu amwalikum la tathlimoona wala tuthlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if ye do not, then be warned of war (against you) from Allah and His messenger. And if ye repent, then ye have your principal (without interest). Wrong not, and ye shall not be wronged.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][280]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain kana thoo AAusratin fanathiratun ila maysaratin waan tasaddaqoo khayrun lakum in kuntum taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if the debtor is in straitened circumstances, then (let there be) postponement to (the time of) ease; and that ye remit the debt as almsgiving would be better for you if ye did but know.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][281]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waittaqoo yawman turjaAAoona feehi ila Allahi thumma tuwaffa kullu nafsin ma kasabat wahum la yuthlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And guard yourselves against a day in which ye will be brought back to Allah. Then every soul will be paid in full that which it hath earned, and they will not be wronged.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][282]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha tadayantum bidaynin ila ajalin musamman faoktuboohu walyaktub baynakum katibun bialAAadli wala yaba katibun an yaktuba kama AAallamahu Allahu falyaktub walyumlili allathee AAalayhi alhaqqu walyattaqi Allaha rabbahu wala yabkhas minhu shayan fain kana allathee AAalayhi alhaqqu safeehan aw daAAeefan aw la yastateeAAu an yumilla huwa falyumlil waliyyuhu bialAAadli waistashhidoo shaheedayni min rijalikum fain lam yakoona rajulayni farajulun waimraatani mimman tardawna mina alshshuhadai an tadilla ihdahuma fatuthakkira ihdahuma alokhra wala yaba alshshuhadao itha ma duAAoo wala tasamoo an taktuboohu sagheeran aw kabeeran ila ajalihi thalikum aqsatu AAinda Allahi waaqwamu lilshshahadati waadna alla tartaboo illa an takoona tijaratan hadiratan tudeeroonaha baynakum falaysa AAalaykum junahun alla taktubooha waashhidoo itha tabayaAAtum wala yudarra katibun wala shaheedun wain tafAAaloo fainnahu fusooqun bikum waittaqoo Allaha wayuAAallimukumu Allahu waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! When ye contract a debt for a fixed term, record it in writing. Let a scribe record it in writing between you in (terms of) equity. No scribe should refuse to write as Allah hath taught him, so let him write, and let him who incurreth the debt dictate, and let him observe his duty to Allah his Lord, and diminish naught thereof. But if he who oweth the debt is of low understanding, or weak, or unable himself to dictate, then let the guardian of his interests dictate in (terms of) equity. And call to witness, from among your men, two witnesses. And if two men be not (at hand) then a man and two women, of such as ye approve as witnesses, so that if the one erreth (through forgetfulness) the other will remember. And the witnesses must not refuse when they are summoned. Be not averse to writing down (the contract) whether it be small or great, with (record of) the term thereof. That is more equitable in the sight of Allah and more sure for testimony, and the best way of avoiding doubt between you; save only in the case when it is actual merchandise which ye transfer among yourselves from hand to hand. In that case it is no sin for you if ye write it not. And have witnesses when ye sell one to another, and let no harm be done to scribe or witness. If ye do (harm to them) lo! it is a sin in you. Observe your duty to Allah. Allah is teaching you. And Allah is knower of all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][283]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain kuntum AAala safarin walam tajidoo katiban farihanun maqboodatun fain amina baAAdukum baAAdan falyuaddi allathee itumina amanatahu walyattaqi Allaha rabbahu wala taktumoo alshshahadata waman yaktumha fainnahu athimun qalbuhu waAllahu bima taAAmaloona AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If ye be on a journey and cannot find a scribe, then a pledge in hand (shall suffice). And if one of you entrusteth to another let him who is trusted deliver up that which is entrusted to him (according to the pact between them) and let him observe his duty to Allah his Lord. Hide not testimony. He who hideth it, verily his heart is sinful. Allah is Aware of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][284]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wain tubdoo ma fee anfusikum aw tukhfoohu yuhasibkum bihi Allahu fayaghfiru liman yashao wayuAAaththibu man yashao waAllahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Allah (belongeth) whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; and whether ye make known what is in your minds or hide it, Allah will bring you to account for it. He will forgive whom He will and He will punish whom He will. Allah is Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][285]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Amana alrrasoolu bima onzila ilayhi min rabbihi waalmuminoona kullun amana biAllahi wamalaikatihi wakutubihi warusulihi la nufarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulihi waqaloo samiAAna waataAAna ghufranaka rabbana wailayka almaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The messenger believeth in that which hath been revealed unto him from his Lord and (so do) believers. Each one believeth in Allah and His angels and His scriptures and His messengers - We make no distinction between any of His messengers - and they say: We hear, and we obey. (Grant us) Thy forgiveness, our Lord. Unto Thee is the journeying.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[2][286]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yukallifu Allahu nafsan illa wusAAaha laha ma kasabat waAAalayha ma iktasabat rabbana la tuakhithna in naseena aw akhtana rabbana wala tahmil AAalayna isran kama hamaltahu AAala allatheena min qablina rabbana wala tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bihi waoAAfu AAanna waighfir lana wairhamna anta mawlana faonsurna AAala alqawmi alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah tasketh not a soul beyond its scope. For it (is only) that which it hath earned, and against it (only) that which it hath deserved. Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget, or miss the mark! Our Lord! Lay not on us such a burden as thou didst lay on those before us! Our Lord! Impose not on us that which we have not the strength to bear! Pardon us, absolve us and have mercy on us, Thou, our Protector, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-'Imran (The Family of Amran)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aliflammeem}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Alim. Lam. Mim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu la ilaha illa huwa alhayyu alqayyoomu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah! There is no god save Him, the Alive, the Eternal.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Nazzala AAalayka alkitaba bialhaqqi musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi waanzala alttawrata waalinjeela}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He hath revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture with truth, confirming that which was (revealed) before it, even as He revealed the Torah and the Gospel.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Min qablu hudan lilnnasi waanzala alfurqana inna allatheena kafaroo biayati Allahi lahum AAathabun shadeedun waAllahu AAazeezun thoo intiqamin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Aforetime, for a guidance to mankind; and hath revealed the Criterion (of right and wrong). Lo! those who disbelieve the revelations of Allah, theirs will be a heavy doom. Allah is Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha la yakhfa AAalayhi shayon fee alardi wala fee alssamai}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! nothing in the earth or in the heavens is hidden from Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa allathee yusawwirukum fee alarhami kayfa yashao la ilaha illa huwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who fashioneth you in the wombs as pleaseth Him. There is no Allah save Him, the Almighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa allathee anzala AAalayka alkitaba minhu ayatun muhkamatun hunna ommu alkitabi waokharu mutashabihatun faamma allatheena fee quloobihim zayghun fayattabiAAoona ma tashabaha minhu ibtighaa alfitnati waibtighaa taweelihi wama yaAAlamu taweelahu illa Allahu waalrrasikhoona fee alAAilmi yaqooloona amanna bihi kullun min AAindi rabbina wama yaththakkaru illa oloo alalbabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who hath revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture wherein are clear revelations - they are the substance of the Book - and others (which are) allegorical. But those in whose hearts is doubt pursue, forsooth, that which is allegorical seeking (to cause) dissension by seeking to explain it. None knoweth its explanation save Allah. And those who are of sound instruction say: We believe therein; the whole is from our Lord; but only men of understanding really heed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbana la tuzigh quloobana baAAda ith hadaytana wahab lana min ladunka rahmatan innaka anta alwahhabu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Our Lord! Cause not our hearts to stray after Thou hast guided us, and bestow upon us mercy from Thy Presence. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Bestower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbana innaka jamiAAu alnnasi liyawmin la rayba feehi inna Allaha la yukhlifu almeeAAada}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Our Lord! Lo! it is Thou Who gatherest mankind together to a Day of which there is no doubt. Lo! Allah faileth not to keep the tryst.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena kafaroo lan tughniya AAanhum amwaluhum wala awladuhum mina Allahi shayan waolaika hum waqoodu alnnari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (On that Day) neither the riches nor the progeny of those who disbelieve will aught avail them with Allah. They will be fuel for Fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kadabi ali firAAawna waallatheena min qablihim kaththaboo biayatina faakhathahumu Allahu bithunoobihim waAllahu shadeedu alAAiqabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Like Pharaoh's folk and those who were before them, they disbelieved Our revelations and so Allah seized them for their sins. And Allah is severe in punishment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul lillatheena kafaroo satughlaboona watuhsharoona ila jahannama wabisa almihadu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad) unto those who disbelieve: Ye shall be overcome and gathered unto Hell, an evil resting-place.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qad kana lakum ayatun fee fiatayni iltaqata fiatun tuqatilu fee sabeeli Allahi waokhra kafiratun yarawnahum mithlayhim raya alAAayni waAllahu yuayyidu binasrihi man yashao inna fee thalika laAAibratan liolee alabsari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There was a token for you in two hosts which met: one army fighting in the way of Allah, and another disbelieving, whom they saw as twice their number, clearly, with their very eyes. Thus Allah strengtheneth with His succour whom He will. Lo! herein verily is a lesson for those who have eyes.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Zuyyina lilnnasi hubbu alshshahawati mina alnnisai waalbaneena waalqanateeri almuqantarati mina alththahabi waalfiddati waalkhayli almusawwamati waalanAAami waalharthi thalika mataAAu alhayati alddunya waAllahu AAindahu husnu almaabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Beautified for mankind is love of the joys (that come) from women and offspring; and stored-up heaps of gold and silver, and horses branded (with their mark), and cattle and land. That is comfort of the life of the world. Allah! With Him is a more excellent abode.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul aonabbiokum bikhayrin min thalikum lillatheena ittaqaw AAinda rabbihim jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha waazwajun mutahharatun waridwanun mina Allahi waAllahu baseerun bialAAibadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Shall I inform you of something better than that? For those who keep from evil, with their Lord, are Gardens underneath which rivers flow wherein they will abide, and pure companions, and contentment from Allah. Allah is Seer of His bondmen,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yaqooloona rabbana innana amanna faighfir lana thunoobana waqina AAathaba alnnari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who say: Our Lord! Lo! we believe. So forgive us our sins and guard us from the punishment of Fire;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alssabireena waalssadiqeena waalqaniteena waalmunfiqeena waalmustaghfireena bialashari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The steadfast, and the truthful, and the obedient, those who spend (and hoard not), those who pray for pardon in the watches of the night.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Shahida Allahu annahu la ilaha illa huwa waalmalaikatu waoloo alAAilmi qaiman bialqisti la ilaha illa huwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah (Himself) is Witness that there is no Allah save Him. And the angels and the men of learning (too are witness). Maintaining His creation in justice, there is no Allah save Him the Almighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna alddeena AAinda Allahi alislamu wama ikhtalafa allatheena ootoo alkitaba illa min baAAdi ma jaahumu alAAilmu baghyan baynahum waman yakfur biayati Allahi fainna Allaha sareeAAu alhisabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! religion with Allah (is) the Surrender (to His Will and Guidance). Those who (formerly) received the Scripture differed only after knowledge came unto them, through transgression among themselves. Whoso disbelieveth the revelations of Allah (will find that) lo! Allah is swift at reckoning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain hajjooka faqul aslamtu wajhiya lillahi wamani ittabaAAani waqul lillatheena ootoo alkitaba waalommiyyeena aaslamtum fain aslamoo faqadi ihtadaw wain tawallaw fainnama AAalayka albalaghu waAllahu baseerun bialAAibadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if they argue with thee, (O Muhammad), say: I have surrendered my purpose to Allah and (so have) those who follow me. And say unto those who have received the Scripture and those who read not: Have ye (too) surrendered? If they surrender, then truly they are rightly guided, and if they turn away, then it is thy duty only to convey the message (unto them). Allah is Seer of (His) bondmen.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena yakfuroona biayati Allahi wayaqtuloona alnnabiyyeena bighayri haqqin wayaqtuloona allatheena yamuroona bialqisti mina alnnasi fabashshirhum biAAathabin aleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who disbelieve the revelations of Allah, and slay the prophets wrongfully, and slay those of mankind who enjoin equity: promise them a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika allatheena habitat aAAmaluhum fee alddunya waalakhirati wama lahum min nasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those are they whose works have failed in the world and the Hereafter; and they have no helpers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara ila allatheena ootoo naseeban mina alkitabi yudAAawna ila kitabi Allahi liyahkuma baynahum thumma yatawalla fareequn minhum wahum muAAridoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou not seen how those who have received a portion of the Scripture invoke the Scripture of Allah (in their disputes) that it may judge between them; then a faction of them turn away, being opposed (to it)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika biannahum qaloo lan tamassana alnnaru illa ayyaman maAAdoodatin wagharrahum fee deenihim ma kanoo yaftaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That is because they say: The Fire will not touch us save for a certain number of days. That which they used to invent hath deceived them regarding their religion.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakayfa itha jamaAAnahum liyawmin la rayba feehi wawuffiyat kullu nafsin ma kasabat wahum la yuthlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How (will it be with them) when We have brought them all together to a Day of which there is no doubt, when every soul will be paid in full what it hath earned, and they will not be wronged.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Quli allahumma malika almulki tutee almulka man tashao watanziAAu almulka mimman tashao watuAAizzu man tashao watuthillu man tashao biyadika alkhayru innaka AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: O Allah! Owner of Sovereignty! Thou givest sovereignty unto whom Thou wilt, and Thou withdrawest sovereignty from whom Thou wilt. Thou exaltest whom Thou wilt, and Thou abasest whom Thou wilt. In Thy hand is the good. Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tooliju allayla fee alnnahari watooliju alnnahara fee allayli watukhriju alhayya mina almayyiti watukhriju almayyita mina alhayyi watarzuqu man tashao bighayri hisabin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thou causest the night to pass into the day, and Thou causest the day to pass into the night. And Thou bringest forth the living from the dead, and Thou bringest forth the dead from the living. And Thou givest sustenance to whom Thou choosest, without stint.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yattakhithi almuminoona alkafireena awliyaa min dooni almumineena waman yafAAal thalika falaysa mina Allahi fee shayin illa an tattaqoo minhum tuqatan wayuhaththirukumu Allahu nafsahu waila Allahi almaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Let not the believers take disbelievers for their friends in preference to believers. Whoso doeth that hath no connection with Allah unless (it be) that ye but guard yourselves against them, taking (as it were) security. Allah biddeth you beware (only) of Himself. Unto Allah is the journeying.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul in tukhfoo ma fee sudoorikum aw tubdoohu yaAAlamhu Allahu wayaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi waAllahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say, (O Muhammad): Whether ye hide that which is in your breasts or reveal it, Allah knoweth it. He knoweth that which is in the heavens and that which is in the earth, and Allah is Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma tajidu kullu nafsin ma AAamilat min khayrin muhdaran wama AAamilat min sooin tawaddu law anna baynaha wabaynahu amadan baAAeedan wayuhaththirukumu Allahu nafsahu waAllahu raoofun bialAAibadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the Day when every soul will find itself confronted with all that it hath done of good and all that it hath done of evil (every soul) will long that there might be a mighty space of distance between it and that (evil). Allah biddeth you beware of Him. And Allah is Full of Pity for (His) bondmen.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul in kuntum tuhibboona Allaha faittabiAAoonee yuhbibkumu Allahu wayaghfir lakum thunoobakum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say, (O Muhammad, to mankind): If ye love Allah, follow me; Allah will love you and forgive you your sins. Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ateeAAoo Allaha waalrrasoola fain tawallaw fainna Allaha la yuhibbu alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Obey Allah and the messenger. But if they turn away, lo! Allah loveth not the disbelievers (in His guidance).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha istafa adama wanoohan waala ibraheema waala AAimrana AAala alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah preferred Adam and Noah and the Family of Abraham and the Family of 'Imran above (all His) creatures.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thurriyyatan baAAduha min baAAdin waAllahu sameeAAun AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They were descendants one of another. Allah is Hearer, Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith qalati imraatu AAimrana rabbi innee nathartu laka ma fee batnee muharraran fataqabbal minnee innaka anta alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Remember) when the wife of 'Imran said: My Lord! I have vowed unto Thee that which is in my belly as a consecrated (offering). Accept it from me. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Hearer, the Knower!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma wadaAAatha qalat rabbi innee wadaAAtuha ontha waAllahu aAAlamu bima wadaAAat walaysa alththakaru kaalontha wainnee sammaytuha maryama wainnee oAAeethuha bika wathurriyyataha mina alshshaytani alrrajeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when she was delivered she said: My Lord! Lo! I am delivered of a female - Allah knew best of what she was delivered - the male is not as the female; and lo! I have named her Mary, and lo! I crave Thy protection for her and for her offspring from Satan the outcast.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fataqabbalaha rabbuha biqaboolin hasanin waanbataha nabatan hasanan wakaffalaha zakariyya kullama dakhala AAalayha zakariyya almihraba wajada AAindaha rizqan qala ya maryamu anna laki hatha qalat huwa min AAindi Allahi inna Allaha yarzuqu man yashao bighayri hisabin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And her Lord accepted her with full acceptance and vouchsafed to her a goodly growth; and made Zachariah her guardian. Whenever Zachariah went into the sanctuary where she was, he found that she had food. He said: O Mary! Whence cometh unto thee this (food)? She answered: It is from Allah. Allah giveth without stint to whom He will.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hunalika daAAa zakariyya rabbahu qala rabbi hab lee min ladunka thurriyyatan tayyibatan innaka sameeAAu aldduAAai}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then Zachariah prayed unto his Lord and said: My Lord! Bestow upon me of Thy bounty goodly offspring. Lo! Thou art the Hearer of Prayer.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fanadathu almalaikatu wahuwa qaimun yusallee fee almihrabi anna Allaha yubashshiruka biyahya musaddiqan bikalimatin mina Allahi wasayyidan wahasooran wanabiyyan mina alssaliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the angels called to him as he stood praying in the sanctuary: Allah giveth thee glad tidings of (a son whose name is) John, (who cometh) to confirm a word from Allah lordly, chaste, a prophet of the righteous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi anna yakoonu lee ghulamun waqad balaghaniya alkibaru waimraatee AAaqirun qala kathalika Allahu yafAAalu ma yashao}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when age hath overtaken me already and my wife is barren? (The angel) answered: So (it will be). Allah doeth what He will.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi ijAAal lee ayatan qala ayatuka alla tukallima alnnasa thalathata ayyamin illa ramzan waothkur rabbaka katheeran wasabbih bialAAashiyyi waalibkari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! Appoint a token for me. (The angel) said: The token unto thee (shall be) that thou shalt not speak unto mankind three days except by signs. Remember thy Lord much, and praise (Him) in the early hours of night and morning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qalati almalaikatu ya maryamu inna Allaha istafaki watahharaki waistafaki AAala nisai alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the angels said: O Mary! Lo! Allah hath chosen thee and made thee pure, and hath preferred thee above (all) the women of creation.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya maryamu oqnutee lirabbiki waosjudee wairkaAAee maAAa alrrakiAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Mary! Be obedient to thy Lord, prostrate thyself and bow with those who bow (in worship).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika min anbai alghaybi nooheehi ilayka wama kunta ladayhim ith yulqoona aqlamahum ayyuhum yakfulu maryama wama kunta ladayhim ith yakhtasimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is of the tidings of things hidden. We reveal it unto thee (Muhammad). Thou wast not present with them when they threw their pens (to know) which of them should be the guardian of Mary, nor wast thou present with them when they quarrelled (thereupon).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith qalati almalaikatu ya maryamu inna Allaha yubashshiruki bikalimatin minhu ismuhu almaseehu AAeesa ibnu maryama wajeehan fee alddunya waalakhirati wamina almuqarrabeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And remember) when the angels said: O Mary! Lo! Allah giveth thee glad tidings of a word from him, whose name is the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, illustrious in the world and the Hereafter, and one of those brought near (unto Allah).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayukallimu alnnasa fee almahdi wakahlan wamina alssaliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He will speak unto mankind in his cradle and in his manhood, and he is of the righteous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qalat rabbi anna yakoonu lee waladun walam yamsasnee basharun qala kathaliki Allahu yakhluqu ma yashao itha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoonu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} She said: My Lord! How can I have a child when no mortal hath touched me? He said: So (it will be). Allah createth what He will. If He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WayuAAallimuhu alkitaba waalhikmata waalttawrata waalinjeela}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He will teach him the Scripture and wisdom, and the Torah and the Gospel,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Warasoolan ila banee israeela annee qad jitukum biayatin min rabbikum annee akhluqu lakum mina altteeni kahayati alttayri faanfukhu feehi fayakoonu tayran biithni Allahi waobrio alakmaha waalabrasa waohyee almawta biithni Allahi waonabbiokum bima takuloona wama taddakhiroona fee buyootikum inna fee thalika laayatan lakum in kuntum mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And will make him a messenger unto the Children of Israel, (saying): Lo! I come unto you with a sign from your Lord. Lo! I fashion for you out of clay the likeness of a bird, and I breathe into it and it is a bird, by Allah's leave. I heal him who was born blind, and the leper, and I raise the dead, by Allah's leave. And I announce unto you what ye eat and what ye store up in your houses. Lo! herein verily is a portent for you, if ye are to be believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamusaddiqan lima bayna yadayya mina alttawrati waliohilla lakum baAAda allathee hurrima AAalaykum wajitukum biayatin min rabbikum faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (I come) confirming that which was before me of the Torah, and to make lawful some of that which was forbidden unto you. I come unto you with a sign from your Lord, so keep your duty to Allah and obey me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma ahassa AAeesa minhumu alkufra qala man ansaree ila Allahi qala alhawariyyoona nahnu ansaru Allahi amanna biAllahi waishhad bianna muslimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But when Jesus became conscious of their disbelief, he cried: Who will be my helpers in the cause of Allah? The disciples said: We will be Allah's helpers. We believe in Allah, and bear thou witness that we have surrendered (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbana amanna bima anzalta waittabaAAna alrrasoola faoktubna maAAa alshshahideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Our Lord! We believe in that which Thou hast revealed and we follow him whom Thou hast sent. Enrol us among those who witness (to the truth).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamakaroo wamakara Allahu waAllahu khayru almakireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they (the disbelievers) schemed, and Allah schemed (against them): and Allah is the best of schemers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith qala Allahu ya AAeesa innee mutawaffeeka warafiAAuka ilayya wamutahhiruka mina allatheena kafaroo wajaAAilu allatheena ittabaAAooka fawqa allatheena kafaroo ila yawmi alqiyamati thumma ilayya marjiAAukum faahkumu baynakum feema kuntum feehi takhtalifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And remember) when Allah said: O Jesus! Lo! I am gathering thee and causing thee to ascend unto Me, and am cleansing thee of those who disbelieve and am setting those who follow thee above those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection. Then unto Me ye will (all) return, and I shall judge between you as to that wherein ye used to differ.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faamma allatheena kafaroo faoAAaththibuhum AAathaban shadeedan fee alddunya waalakhirati wama lahum min nasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for those who disbelieve I shall chastise them with a heavy chastisement in the world and the Hereafter; and they will have no helpers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fayuwaffeehim ojoorahum waAllahu la yuhibbu alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And as for those who believe and do good works, He will pay them their wages in full. Allah loveth not wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika natloohu AAalayka mina alayati waalththikri alhakeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This (which) We recite unto thee is a revelation and a wise reminder.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna mathala AAeesa AAinda Allahi kamathali adama khalaqahu min turabin thumma qala lahu kun fayakoonu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the likeness of Jesus with Allah is as the likeness of Adam. He created him of dust, then He said unto him: Be! and he is.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alhaqqu min rabbika fala takun mina almumtareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (This is) the truth from thy Lord (O Muhammad), so be not thou of those who waver.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faman hajjaka feehi min baAAdi ma jaaka mina alAAilmi faqul taAAalaw nadAAu abnaana waabnaakum wanisaana wanisaakum waanfusana waanfusakum thumma nabtahil fanajAAal laAAnata Allahi AAala alkathibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whoso disputeth with thee concerning him, after the knowledge which hath come unto thee, say (unto him): Come! We will summon our sons and your sons, and our women and your women, and ourselves and yourselves, then we will pray humbly (to our Lord) and (solemnly) invoke the curse of Allah upon those who lie.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna hatha lahuwa alqasasu alhaqqu wama min ilahin illa Allahu wainna Allaha lahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! This verily is the true narrative. There is no Allah save Allah, and lo! Allah, He verily is, is the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain tawallaw fainna Allaha AAaleemun bialmufsideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if they turn away, then lo! Allah is Aware of (who are) the corrupters.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ya ahla alkitabi taAAalaw ila kalimatin sawain baynana wabaynakum alla naAAbuda illa Allaha wala nushrika bihi shayan wala yattakhitha baAAduna baAAdan arbaban min dooni Allahi fain tawallaw faqooloo ishhadoo bianna muslimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: O People of the Scripture! Come to an agreement between us and you: that we shall worship none but Allah, and that we shall ascribe no partner unto Him, and that none of us shall take others for lords beside Allah. And if they turn away, then say: Bear witness that we are they who have surrendered (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ahla alkitabi lima tuhajjoona fee ibraheema wama onzilati alttawratu waalinjeelu illa min baAAdihi afala taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O People of the Scripture! Why will ye argue about Abraham, when the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed till after him? Have ye then no sense?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Haantum haolai hajajtum feema lakum bihi AAilmun falima tuhajjoona feema laysa lakum bihi AAilmun waAllahu yaAAlamu waantum la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! ye are those who argue about that whereof ye have some knowledge: Why then argue ye concerning that whereof ye have no knowledge? Allah knoweth. Ye know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma kana ibraheemu yahoodiyyan wala nasraniyyan walakin kana haneefan musliman wama kana mina almushrikeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Abraham was not a Jew, nor yet a Christian; but he was an upright man who had surrendered (to Allah), and he was not of the idolaters.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna awla alnnasi biibraheema lallatheena ittabaAAoohu wahatha alnnabiyyu waallatheena amanoo waAllahu waliyyu almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those of mankind who have the best claim to Abraham are those who followed him, and this Prophet and those who believe (with him); and Allah is the Protecting Guardian of the believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waddat taifatun min ahli alkitabi law yudilloonakum wama yudilloona illa anfusahum wama yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A party of the People of the Scripture long to make you go astray; and they make none to go astray except themselves, but they perceive not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ahla alkitabi lima takfuroona biayati Allahi waantum tashhadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O People of the Scripture! Why disbelieve ye in the revelations of Allah, when ye (yourselves) bear witness (to their truth)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ahla alkitabi lima talbisoona alhaqqa bialbatili wataktumoona alhaqqa waantum taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O People of the Scripture! Why confound ye truth with falsehood and knowingly conceal the truth?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqalat taifatun min ahli alkitabi aminoo biallathee onzila AAala allatheena amanoo wajha alnnahari waokfuroo akhirahu laAAallahum yarjiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And a party of the People of the Scripture say: Believe in that which hath been revealed unto those who believe at the opening of the day, and disbelieve at the end thereof, in order that they may return;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tuminoo illa liman tabiAAa deenakum qul inna alhuda huda Allahi an yuta ahadun mithla ma ooteetum aw yuhajjookum AAinda rabbikum qul inna alfadla biyadi Allahi yuteehi man yashao waAllahu wasiAAun AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And believe not save in one who followeth your religion - Say (O Muhammad): Lo! the guidance is Allah's Guidance - that anyone is given the like of that which was given unto you or that they may argue with you in the presence of their Lord. Say (O Muhammad): Lo! the bounty is in Allah's hand. He bestoweth it on whom He will. Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yakhtassu birahmatihi man yashao waAllahu thoo alfadli alAAatheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He selecteth for His mercy whom He will. Allah is of Infinite Bounty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamin ahli alkitabi man in tamanhu biqintarin yuaddihi ilayka waminhum man in tamanhu bideenarin la yuaddihi ilayka illa ma dumta AAalayhi qaiman thalika biannahum qaloo laysa AAalayna fee alommiyyeena sabeelun wayaqooloona AAala Allahi alkathiba wahum yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Among the People of the Scripture there is he who, if thou trust him with a weight of treasure, will return it to thee. And among them there is he who, if thou trust him with a piece of gold, will not return it to thee unless thou keep standing over him. That is because they say: We have no duty to the Gentiles. They speak a lie concerning Allah knowingly.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bala man awfa biAAahdihi waittaqa fainna Allaha yuhibbu almuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but (the chosen of Allah is) he who fulfilleth his pledge and wardeth off (evil); for lo! Allah loveth those who ward off (evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena yashtaroona biAAahdi Allahi waaymanihim thamanan qaleelan olaika la khalaqa lahum fee alakhirati wala yukallimuhumu Allahu wala yanthuru ilayhim yawma alqiyamati wala yuzakkeehim walahum AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's covenant and their oaths, they have no portion in the Hereafter. Allah will neither speak to them nor look upon them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He make them grow. Theirs will be a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna minhum lafareeqan yalwoona alsinatahum bialkitabi litahsaboohu mina alkitabi wama huwa mina alkitabi wayaqooloona huwa min AAindi Allahi wama huwa min AAindi Allahi wayaqooloona AAala Allahi alkathiba wahum yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! there is a party of them who distort the Scripture with their tongues, that ye may think that what they say is from the Scripture, when it is not from the Scripture. And they say: It is from Allah, when it is not from Allah; and they speak a lie concerning Allah knowingly.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma kana libasharin an yutiyahu Allahu alkitaba waalhukma waalnnubuwwata thumma yaqoola lilnnasi koonoo AAibadan lee min dooni Allahi walakin koonoo rabbaniyyeena bima kuntum tuAAallimoona alkitaba wabima kuntum tadrusoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is not (possible) for any human being unto whom Allah had given the Scripture and wisdom and the prophethood that he should afterwards have said unto mankind: Be slaves of me instead of Allah; but (what he said was): Be ye faithful servants of the Lord by virtue of your constant teaching of the Scripture and of your constant study thereof.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala yamurakum an tattakhithoo almalaikata waalnnabiyyeena arbaban ayamurukum bialkufri baAAda ith antum muslimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he commanded you not that ye should take the angels and the prophets for lords. Would he command you to disbelieve after ye had surrendered (to Allah)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith akhatha Allahu meethaqa alnnabiyyeena lama ataytukum min kitabin wahikmatin thumma jaakum rasoolun musaddiqun lima maAAakum latuminunna bihi walatansurunnahu qala aaqrartum waakhathtum AAala thalikum isree qaloo aqrarna qala faishhadoo waana maAAakum mina alshshahideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When Allah made (His) covenant with the prophets, (He said): Behold that which I have given you of the Scripture and knowledge. And afterward there will come unto you a messenger, confirming that which ye possess. Ye shall believe in him and ye shall help him. He said: Do ye agree, and will ye take up My burden (which I lay upon you) in this (matter)? They answered: We agree. He said: Then bear ye witness. I will be a witness with you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faman tawalla baAAda thalika faolaika humu alfasiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then whosoever after this shall turn away: they will be miscreants.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaghayra deeni Allahi yabghoona walahu aslama man fee alssamawati waalardi tawAAan wakarhan wailayhi yurjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Seek they other than the religion of Allah, when unto Him submitteth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, and unto Him they will be returned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul amanna biAllahi wama onzila AAalayna wama onzila AAala ibraheema waismaAAeela waishaqa wayaAAqooba waalasbati wama ootiya moosa waAAeesa waalnnabiyyoona min rabbihim la nufarriqu bayna ahadin minhum wanahnu lahu muslimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad): We believe in Allah and that which is revealed unto us and that which was revealed unto Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the tribes, and that which was vouchsafed unto Moses and Jesus and the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and unto Him we have surrendered.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman yabtaghi ghayra alislami deenan falan yuqbala minhu wahuwa fee alakhirati mina alkhasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whoso seeketh as religion other than the Surrender (to Allah) it will not be accepted from him, and he will be a loser in the Hereafter.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kayfa yahdee Allahu qawman kafaroo baAAda eemanihim washahidoo anna alrrasoola haqqun wajaahumu albayyinatu waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How shall Allah guide a people who disbelieved after their belief and (after) they bore witness that the messenger is true and after clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty) had come unto them. And Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika jazaohum anna AAalayhim laAAnata Allahi waalmalaikati waalnnasi ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for such, their guerdon is that on them rests the curse of Allah and of angels and of men combined.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khalideena feeha la yukhaffafu AAanhumu alAAathabu wala hum yuntharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will abide therein. Their doom will not be lightened, neither will they be reprieved;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa allatheena taboo min baAAdi thalika waaslahoo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save those who afterward repent and do right. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena kafaroo baAAda eemanihim thumma izdadoo kufran lan tuqbala tawbatuhum waolaika humu alddalloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who disbelieve after their (profession of) belief, and afterward grow violent in disbelief: their repentance will not be accepted. And such are those who are astray.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena kafaroo wamatoo wahum kuffarun falan yuqbala min ahadihim milo alardi thahaban walawi iftada bihi olaika lahum AAathabun aleemun wama lahum min nasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who disbelieve, and die in disbelief, the (whole) earth full of gold would not be accepted from such an one if it were offered as a ransom (for his soul). Theirs will be a painful doom and they will have no helpers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lan tanaloo albirra hatta tunfiqoo mimma tuhibboona wama tunfiqoo min shayin fainna Allaha bihi AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ye will not attain unto piety until ye spend of that which ye love. And whatsoever ye spend, Allah is Aware thereof.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kullu alttaAAami kana hillan libanee israeela illa ma harrama israeelu AAala nafsihi min qabli an tunazzala alttawratu qul fatoo bialttawrati faotlooha in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} All food was lawful unto the Children of Israel, save that which Israel forbade himself, (in days) before the Torah was revealed. Say: Produce the Torah and read it (unto us) if ye are truthful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Famani iftara AAala Allahi alkathiba min baAAdi thalika faolaika humu althalimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whoever shall invent a falsehood after that concerning Allah, such will be wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul sadaqa Allahu faittabiAAoo millata ibraheema haneefan wama kana mina almushrikeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Allah speaketh truth. So follow the religion of Abraham, the upright. He was not of the idolaters.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna awwala baytin wudiAAa lilnnasi lallathee bibakkata mubarakan wahudan lilAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the first Sanctuary appointed for mankind was that at Becca, a blessed place, a guidance to the peoples;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Feehi ayatun bayyinatun maqamu ibraheema waman dakhalahu kana aminan walillahi AAala alnnasi hijju albayti mani istataAAa ilayhi sabeelan waman kafara fainna Allaha ghaniyyun AAani alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Wherein are plain memorials (of Allah's guidance); the place where Abraham stood up to pray; and whosoever entereth it is safe. And pilgrimage to the House is a duty unto Allah for mankind, for him who can find a way thither. As for him who disbelieveth, (let him know that) lo! Allah is Independent of (all) creatures.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ya ahla alkitabi lima takfuroona biayati Allahi waAllahu shaheedun AAala ma taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: O People of the Scripture! Why disbelieve ye in the revelations of Allah, when Allah (Himself) is Witness of what ye do?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ya ahla alkitabi lima tasuddoona AAan sabeeli Allahi man amana tabghoonaha AAiwajan waantum shuhadao wama Allahu bighafilin AAamma taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: O People of the Scripture! Why drive ye back believers from the way of Allah, seeking to make it crooked, when ye are witnesses (to Allah's guidance)? Allah is not unaware of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in tuteeAAoo fareeqan mina allatheena ootoo alkitaba yaruddookum baAAda eemanikum kafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! If ye obey a party of those who have received the Scripture they will make you disbelievers after your belief.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakayfa takfuroona waantum tutla AAalaykum ayatu Allahi wafeekum rasooluhu waman yaAAtasim biAllahi faqad hudiya ila siratin mustaqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How can ye disbelieve, when it is ye unto whom Allah's revelations are recited, and His messenger is in your midst? He who holdeth fast to Allah, he indeed is guided unto a right path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha haqqa tuqatihi wala tamootunna illa waantum muslimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah with right observance, and die not save as those who have surrendered (unto Him)}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaiAAtasimoo bihabli Allahi jameeAAan wala tafarraqoo waothkuroo niAAmata Allahi AAalaykum ith kuntum aAAdaan faallafa bayna quloobikum faasbahtum biniAAmatihi ikhwanan wakuntum AAala shafa hufratin mina alnnari faanqathakum minha kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum ayatihi laAAallakum tahtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And hold fast, all of you together, to the cable of Allah, and do not separate. And remember Allah's favour unto you: How ye were enemies and He made friendship between your hearts so that ye became as brothers by His grace; and (how) ye were upon the brink of an abyss of fire, and He did save you from it. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations unto you, that haply ye may be guided,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waltakun minkum ommatun yadAAoona ila alkhayri wayamuroona bialmaAAroofi wayanhawna AAani almunkari waolaika humu almuflihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And there may spring from you a nation who invite to goodness, and enjoin right conduct and forbid indecency. Such are they who are successful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala takoonoo kaallatheena tafarraqoo waikhtalafoo min baAAdi ma jaahumu albayyinatu waolaika lahum AAathabun AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And be ye not as those who separated and disputed after the clear proofs had come unto them. For such there is an awful doom,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma tabyaddu wujoohun wataswaddu wujoohun faamma allatheena iswaddat wujoohuhum akafartum baAAda eemanikum fathooqoo alAAathaba bima kuntum takfuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the Day when (some) faces will be whitened and (some) faces will be blackened; and as for those whose faces have been blackened, it will be said unto them: Disbelieved ye after your (profession of) belief? Then taste the punishment for that ye disbelieved.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma allatheena ibyaddat wujoohuhum fafee rahmati Allahi hum feeha khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And as for those whose faces have been whitened, in the mercy of Allah they dwell for ever.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tilka ayatu Allahi natlooha AAalayka bialhaqqi wama Allahu yureedu thulman lilAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} These are revelations of Allah. We recite them unto thee in truth. Allah willeth no injustice to (His) creatures.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi waila Allahi turjaAAu alomooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; and unto Allah all things are returned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kuntum khayra ommatin okhrijat lilnnasi tamuroona bialmaAAroofi watanhawna AAani almunkari watuminoona biAllahi walaw amana ahlu alkitabi lakana khayran lahum minhumu almuminoona waaktharuhumu alfasiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ye are the best community that hath been raised up for mankind. Ye enjoin right conduct and forbid indecency; and ye believe in Allah. And if the People of the Scripture had believed it had been better for them. Some of them are believers; but most of them are evil-livers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lan yadurrookum illa athan wain yuqatilookum yuwallookumu aladbara thumma la yunsaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will not harm you save a trifling hurt, and if they fight against you they will turn and flee. And afterward they will not be helped.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][112]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Duribat AAalayhimu alththillatu ayna ma thuqifoo illa bihablin mina Allahi wahablin mina alnnasi wabaoo bighadabin mina Allahi waduribat AAalayhimu almaskanatu thalika biannahum kanoo yakfuroona biayati Allahi wayaqtuloona alanbiyaa bighayri haqqin thalika bima AAasaw wakanoo yaAAtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ignominy shall be their portion wheresoever they are found save (where they grasp) a rope from Allah and a rope from men. They have incurred anger from their Lord, and wretchedness is laid upon them. That is because they used to disbelieve the revelations of Allah, and slew the prophets wrongfully. That is because they were rebellious and used to transgress.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][113]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laysoo sawaan min ahli alkitabi ommatun qaimatun yatloona ayati Allahi anaa allayli wahum yasjudoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They are not all alike. Of the People of the Scripture there is a staunch community who recite the revelations of Allah in the night season, falling prostrate (before Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][114]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yuminoona biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri wayamuroona bialmaAAroofi wayanhawna AAani almunkari wayusariAAoona fee alkhayrati waolaika mina alssaliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They believe in Allah and the Last Day, and enjoin right conduct and forbid indecency, and vie one with another in good works. These are of the righteous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][115]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yafAAaloo min khayrin falan yukfaroohu waAllahu AAaleemun bialmuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whatever good they do, they will not be denied the meed thereof. Allah is Aware of those who ward off (evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][116]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena kafaroo lan tughniya AAanhum amwaluhum wala awladuhum mina Allahi shayan waolaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the riches and the progeny of those who disbelieve will not avail them aught against Allah; and such are rightful owners of the Fire. They will abide therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][117]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Mathalu ma yunfiqoona fee hathihi alhayati alddunya kamathali reehin feeha sirrun asabat hartha qawmin thalamoo anfusahum faahlakathu wama thalamahumu Allahu walakin anfusahum yathlimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The likeness of that which they spend in this life of the world is as the likeness of a biting, icy wind which smiteth the harvest of a people who have wronged themselves, and devastateth it. Allah wronged them not, but they do wrong themselves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[3][118]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo bitanatan min doonikum la yaloonakum khabalan waddoo ma AAanittum qad badati albaghdao min afwahihim wama tukhfee sudooruhum akbaru qad bayyanna lakumu alayati in kuntum taAAqiloona}}
