\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Shall I seek another than Allah for Lord, when He is Lord of all things? Each soul earneth only on its own account, nor doth any laden bear another's load. Then unto your Lord is your return and He will tell you that wherein ye differed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[6][165]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee jaAAalakum khalaifa alardi warafaAAa baAAdakum fawqa baAAdin darajatin liyabluwakum fee ma atakum inna rabbaka sareeAAu alAAiqabi wainnahu laghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who hath placed you as viceroys of the earth and hath exalted some of you in rank above others, that He may try you by (the test of) that which He hath given you. Lo! Thy Lord is swift in prosecution, and Lo! He verily is Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-A'raf (The Elevated Places)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aliflammeemsad}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Alif. Lam. Mim. Sad.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kitabun onzila ilayka fala yakun fee sadrika harajun minhu litunthira bihi wathikra lilmumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (It is) a Scripture that is revealed unto thee (Muhammad) - so let there be no heaviness in thy heart therefrom - that thou mayst warn thereby, and (it is) a Reminder unto believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{IttabiAAoo ma onzila ilaykum min rabbikum wala tattabiAAoo min doonihi awliyaa qaleelan ma tathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Saying): Follow that which is sent down unto you from your Lord, and follow no protecting friends beside Him. Little do ye recollect!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakam min qaryatin ahlaknaha fajaaha basuna bayatan aw hum qailoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How many a township have We destroyed! As a raid by night, or while they slept at noon, Our terror came unto them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama kana daAAwahum ith jaahum basuna illa an qaloo inna kunna thalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} No plea had they, when Our terror came unto them, save that they said: Lo! We were wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falanasalanna allatheena orsila ilayhim walanasalanna almursaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then verily We shall question those unto whom (Our message) hath been sent, and verily We shall question the messengers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falanaqussanna AAalayhim biAAilmin wama kunna ghaibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then verily We shall narrate unto them (the event) with knowledge, for We were not absent (when it came to pass).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalwaznu yawmaithini alhaqqu faman thaqulat mawazeenuhu faolaika humu almuflihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The weighing on that day is the true (weighing). As for those whose scale is heavy, they are the successful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman khaffat mawazeenuhu faolaika allatheena khasiroo anfusahum bima kanoo biayatina yathlimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And as for those whose scale is light: those are they who lose their souls because they used to wrong Our revelations.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad makkannakum fee alardi wajaAAalna lakum feeha maAAayisha qaleelan ma tashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We have given you (mankind) power in the earth, and appointed for you therein livelihoods. Little give ye thanks!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad khalaqnakum thumma sawwarnakum thumma qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa lam yakun mina alssajideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We created you, then fashioned you, then told the angels: Fall ye prostrate before Adam! And they fell prostrate, all save Iblis, who was not of those who make prostration.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ma manaAAaka alla tasjuda ith amartuka qala ana khayrun minhu khalaqtanee min narin wakhalaqtahu min teenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: What hindered thee that thou didst not fall prostrate when I bade thee? (Iblis) said: I am better than him. Thou createdst me of fire while him Thou didst create of mud.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala faihbit minha fama yakoonu laka an tatakabbara feeha faokhruj innaka mina alssaghireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Then go down hence! It is not for thee to show pride here, so go forth! Lo! thou art of those degraded.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala anthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Reprieve me till the day when they are raised (from the dead).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala innaka mina almunthareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Lo! thou art of those reprieved.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala fabima aghwaytanee laaqAAudanna lahum sirataka almustaqeema}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Now, because Thou hast sent me astray, verily I shall lurk in ambush for them on Thy Right Path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma laatiyannahum min bayni aydeehim wamin khalfihim waAAan aymanihim waAAan shamailihim wala tajidu aktharahum shakireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then I shall come upon them from before them and from behind them and from their right hands and from their left hands, and Thou wilt not find most of them beholden (unto Thee).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala okhruj minha mathooman madhooran laman tabiAAaka minhum laamlaanna jahannama minkum ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Go forth from hence, degraded, banished. As for such of them as follow thee, surely I will fill hell with all of you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waya adamu oskun anta wazawjuka aljannata fakula min haythu shituma wala taqraba hathihi alshshajarata fatakoona mina alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (unto man): O Adam! Dwell thou and thy wife in the Garden and eat from whence ye will, but come not nigh this tree lest ye become wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fawaswasa lahuma alshshaytanu liyubdiya lahuma ma wooriya AAanhuma min sawatihima waqala ma nahakuma rabbukuma AAan hathihi alshshajarati illa an takoona malakayni aw takoona mina alkhalideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then Satan whispered to them that he might manifest unto them that which was hidden from them of their shame, and he said: Your Lord forbade you from this tree only lest ye should become angels or become of the immortals.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqasamahuma innee lakuma lamina alnnasiheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he swore unto them (saying): Lo! I am a sincere adviser unto you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fadallahuma bighuroorin falamma thaqa alshshajarata badat lahuma sawatuhuma watafiqa yakhsifani AAalayhima min waraqi aljannati wanadahuma rabbuhuma alam anhakuma AAan tilkuma alshshajarati waaqul lakuma inna alshshaytana lakuma AAaduwwun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus did he lead them on with guile. And when they tasted of the tree their shame was manifest to them and they began to hide (by heaping) on themselves some of the leaves of the Garden. And their Lord called them, (saying): Did I not forbid you from that tree and tell you: Lo! Satan is an open enemy to you?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbana thalamna anfusana wain lam taghfir lana watarhamna lanakoonanna mina alkhasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Our Lord! We have wronged ourselves. If thou forgive us not and have not mercy on us, surely we are of the lost!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ihbitoo baAAdukum libaAAdin AAaduwwun walakum fee alardi mustaqarrun wamataAAun ila heenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Go down (from hence), one of you a foe unto the other. There will be for you on earth a habitation and provision for a while.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala feeha tahyawna wafeeha tamootoona waminha tukhrajoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: There shall ye live, and there shall ye die, and thence shall ye be brought forth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya banee adama qad anzalna AAalaykum libasan yuwaree sawatikum wareeshan walibasu alttaqwa thalika khayrun thalika min ayati Allahi laAAallahum yaththakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Children of Adam! We have revealed unto you raiment to conceal your shame, and splendid vesture, but the raiment of restraint from evil, that is best. This is of the revelations of Allah, that they may remember.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya banee adama la yaftinannakumu alshshaytanu kama akhraja abawaykum mina aljannati yanziAAu AAanhuma libasahuma liyuriyahuma sawatihima innahu yarakum huwa waqabeeluhu min haythu la tarawnahum inna jaAAalna alshshayateena awliyaa lillatheena la yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Children of Adam! Let not Satan seduce you as he caused your (first) parents to go forth from the Garden and tore off from them their robe (of innocence) that he might manifest their shame to them. Lo! he seeth you, he and his tribe, from whence ye see him not. Lo! We have made the devils protecting friends for those who believe not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha faAAaloo fahishatan qaloo wajadna AAalayha abaana waAllahu amarana biha qul inna Allaha la yamuru bialfahshai ataqooloona AAala Allahi ma la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they do some lewdness they say: We found our fathers doing it and Allah hath enjoined it on us. Say: Allah, verily, enjoineth not lewdness. Tell ye concerning Allah that which ye know not?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul amara rabbee bialqisti waaqeemoo wujoohakum AAinda kulli masjidin waodAAoohu mukhliseena lahu alddeena kama badaakum taAAoodoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: My Lord enjoineth justice. And set your faces upright (toward Him) at every place of worship and call upon Him, making religion pure for Him (only). As He brought you into being, so return ye (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fareeqan hada wafareeqan haqqa AAalayhimu alddalalatu innahumu ittakhathoo alshshayateena awliyaa min dooni Allahi wayahsaboona annahum muhtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A party hath He led aright, while error hath just hold over (another) party, for lo! they choose the devils for protecting supporters instead of Allah and deem that they are rightly guided.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya banee adama khuthoo zeenatakum AAinda kulli masjidin wakuloo waishraboo wala tusrifoo innahu la yuhibbu almusrifeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Children of Adam! Look to your adornment at every place of worship, and eat and drink, but be not prodigal. Lo! He loveth not the prodigals.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul man harrama zeenata Allahi allatee akhraja liAAibadihi waalttayyibati mina alrrizqi qul hiya lillatheena amanoo fee alhayati alddunya khalisatan yawma alqiyamati kathalika nufassilu alayati liqawmin yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Who hath forbidden the adornment of Allah which He hath brought forth for His bondmen, and the good things of His providing? Say: Such, on the Day of Resurrection, will be only for those who believed during the life of the world. Thus do we detail Our revelations for people who have knowledge.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul innama harrama rabbiya alfawahisha ma thahara minha wama batana waalithma waalbaghya bighayri alhaqqi waan tushrikoo biAllahi ma lam yunazzil bihi sultanan waan taqooloo AAala Allahi ma la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: My Lord forbiddeth only indecencies, such of them as are apparent and such as are within, and sin and wrongful oppression, and that ye associate with Allah that for which no warrant hath been revealed, and that ye tell concerning Allah that which ye know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walikulli ommatin ajalun faitha jaa ajaluhum la yastakhiroona saAAatan wala yastaqdimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And every nation hath its term, and when its term cometh, they cannot put it off an hour nor yet advance (it).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya banee adama imma yatiyannakum rusulun minkum yaqussoona AAalaykum ayatee famani ittaqa waaslaha fala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Children of Adam! When messengers of your own come unto you who narrate unto you My revelations, then whosoever refraineth from evil and amendeth - there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena kaththaboo biayatina waistakbaroo AAanha olaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But they who deny Our revelations and scorn them - each are rightful owners of the Fire; they will abide therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faman athlamu mimmani iftara AAala Allahi kathiban aw kaththaba biayatihi olaika yanaluhum naseebuhum mina alkitabi hatta itha jaathum rusuluna yatawaffawnahum qaloo ayna ma kuntum tadAAoona min dooni Allahi qaloo dalloo AAanna washahidoo AAala anfusihim annahum kanoo kafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who doeth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie concerning Allah or denieth Our tokens. (For such) their appointed portion of the Book (of destiny) reacheth them till, when Our messengers come to gather them, they say: Where (now) is that to which ye cried beside Allah? They say: They have departed from us. And they testify against themselves that they were disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala odkhuloo fee omamin qad khalat min qablikum mina aljinni waalinsi fee alnnari kullama dakhalat ommatun laAAanat okhtaha hatta itha iddarakoo feeha jameeAAan qalat okhrahum lioolahum rabbana haolai adalloona faatihim AAathaban diAAfan mina alnnari qala likullin diAAfun walakin la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He saith: Enter into the Fire among nations of the jinn and humankind who passed away before you. Every time a nation entereth, it curseth its sister (nation) till, when they have all been made to follow one another thither, the last of them saith unto the first of them: Our Lord! These led us astray, so give them double torment of the Fire. He saith: For each one there is double (torment), but ye know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqalat oolahum liokhrahum fama kana lakum AAalayna min fadlin fathooqoo alAAathaba bima kuntum taksiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the first of them saith unto the last of them: Ye were no whit better than us, so taste the doom for what ye used to earn.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena kaththaboo biayatina waistakbaroo AAanha la tufattahu lahum abwabu alssamai wala yadkhuloona aljannata hatta yalija aljamalu fee sammi alkhiyati wakathalika najzee almujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! they who deny Our revelations and scorn them, for them the gates of heaven will nor be opened not will they enter the Garden until the camel goeth through the needle's eye. Thus do We requite the guilty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahum min jahannama mihadun wamin fawqihim ghawashin wakathalika najzee alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Theirs will be a bed of hell, and over them coverings (of hell). Thus do We requite wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati la nukallifu nafsan illa wusAAaha olaika ashabu aljannati hum feeha khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But (as for) those who believe and do good works - We tax not any soul beyond its scope - Such are rightful owners of the Garden. They abide therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WanazaAAna ma fee sudoorihim min ghillin tajree min tahtihimu alanharu waqaloo alhamdu lillahi allathee hadana lihatha wama kunna linahtadiya lawla an hadana Allahu laqad jaat rusulu rabbina bialhaqqi wanoodoo an tilkumu aljannatu oorithtumooha bima kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We remove whatever rancour may be in their hearts. Rivers flow beneath them. And they say: The praise to Allah, Who hath guided us to this. We could not truly have been led aright if Allah had not guided us. Verily the messengers of our Lord did bring the Truth. And it is cried unto them: This is the Garden. Ye inherit it for what ye used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanada ashabu aljannati ashaba alnnari an qad wajadna ma waAAadana rabbuna haqqan fahal wajadtum ma waAAada rabbukum haqqan qaloo naAAam faaththana muaththinun baynahum an laAAnatu Allahi AAala alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the dwellers of the Garden cry unto the dwellers of the Fire: We have found that which our Lord promised us (to be) the Truth. Have ye (too) found that which your Lord promised the Truth? They say: Yea, verily. And a crier in between them crieth: The curse of Allah is on evil-doers,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yasuddoona AAan sabeeli Allahi wayabghoonaha AAiwajan wahum bialakhirati kafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who debar (men) from the path of Allah and would have it crooked, and who are disbelievers in the Last Day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wabaynahuma hijabun waAAala alaAArafi rijalun yaAArifoona kullan biseemahum wanadaw ashaba aljannati an salamun AAalaykum lam yadkhulooha wahum yatmaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Between them is a veil. And on the Heights are men who know them all by their marks. And they call unto the dwellers of the Garden: Peace be unto you! They enter it not although they hope (to enter).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha surifat absaruhum tilqaa ashabi alnnari qaloo rabbana la tajAAalna maAAa alqawmi alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when their eyes are turned toward the dwellers of the Fire, they say: Our Lord! Place us not with the wrong-doing folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanada ashabu alaAArafi rijalan yaAArifoonahum biseemahum qaloo ma aghna AAankum jamAAukum wama kuntum tastakbiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the dwellers on the Heights call unto men whom they know by their marks, (saying): What did your multitude and that in which ye took your pride avail you?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ahaolai allatheena aqsamtum la yanaluhumu Allahu birahmatin odkhuloo aljannata la khawfun AAalaykum wala antum tahzanoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Are these they of whom ye swore that Allah would not show them mercy? (Unto them it hath been said): Enter the Garden. No fear shall come upon you nor is it ye who will grieve.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanada ashabu alnari ashaba aljannati an afeedoo AAalayna mina almai aw mimma razaqakumu Allahu qaloo inna Allaha harramahuma AAala alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the dwellers of the Fire cry out unto the dwellers of the Garden: Pour on us some water or some wherewith Allah hath provided you. They say: Lo! Allah hath forbidden both to disbelievers (in His guidance),}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena ittakhathoo deenahum lahwan walaAAiban wagharrathumu alhayatu alddunya faalyawma nansahum kama nasoo liqaa yawmihim hatha wama kanoo biayatina yajhadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who took their religion for a sport and pastime, and whom the life of the world beguiled. So this day We have forgotten them even as they forgot the meeting of this their Day and as they used to deny Our tokens.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad jinahum bikitabin fassalnahu AAala AAilmin hudan warahmatan liqawmin yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Verily We have brought them a Scripture which We expounded with knowledge, a guidance and a mercy for a people who believe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hal yanthuroona illa taweelahu yawma yatee taweeluhu yaqoolu allatheena nasoohu min qablu qad jaat rusulu rabbina bialhaqqi fahal lana min shufaAAaa fayashfaAAoo lana aw nuraddu fanaAAmala ghayra allathee kunna naAAmalu qad khasiroo anfusahum wadalla AAanhum ma kanoo yaftaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Await they aught save the fulfilment thereof? On the day when the fulfilment thereof cometh, those who were before forgetful thereof will say: The messengers of our Lord did bring the Truth! Have we any intercessors, that they may intercede for us? Or can we be returned (to life on earth), that we may act otherwise than we used to act? They have lost their souls, and that which they devised hath failed them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna rabbakumu Allahu allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi yughshee allayla alnnahara yatlubuhu hatheethan waalshshamsa waalqamara waalnnujooma musakhkharatin biamrihi ala lahu alkhalqu waalamru tabaraka Allahu rabbu alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! your Lord is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days, then mounted He the Throne. He covereth the night with the day, which is in haste to follow it, and hath made the sun and the moon and the stars subservient by His command. His verily is all creation and commandment. Blessed be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{OdAAoo rabbakum tadarruAAan wakhufyatan innahu la yuhibbu almuAAtadeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (O mankind!) Call upon your Lord humbly and in secret. Lo! He loveth not aggressors.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tufsidoo fee alardi baAAda islahiha waodAAoohu khawfan watamaAAan inna rahmata Allahi qareebun mina almuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Work not confusion in the earth after the fair ordering (thereof). and call on Him in fear and hope. Lo! the mercy of Allah is nigh unto the good.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee yursilu alrriyaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatihi hatta itha aqallat sahaban thiqalan suqnahu libaladin mayyitin faanzalna bihi almaa faakhrajna bihi min kulli alththamarati kathalika nukhriju almawta laAAallakum tathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who sendeth the winds as tidings heralding His mercy, till, when they bear a cloud heavy (with rain), We lead it to a dead land, and then cause water to descend thereon and thereby bring forth fruits of every kind. Thus bring We forth the dead. Haply ye may remember.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalbaladu alttayyibu yakhruju nabatuhu biithni rabbihi waallathee khabutha la yakhruju illa nakidan kathalika nusarrifu alayati liqawmin yashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for the good land, its vegetation cometh forth by permission of its Lord; while as for that which is bad, only the useless cometh forth (from it). Thus do We recount the tokens for people who give thanks.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad arsalna noohan ila qawmihi faqala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We sent Noah (of old) unto his people, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an Awful Day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala almalao min qawmihi inna lanaraka fee dalalin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The chieftains of his people said: Lo! we see thee surely in plain error.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya qawmi laysa bee dalalatun walakinnee rasoolun min rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O my people! There is no error in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the Worlds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Oballighukum risalati rabbee waansahu lakum waaAAlamu mina Allahi ma la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} I convey unto you the messages of my Lord and give good counsel unto you, and know from Allah that which ye know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AwaAAajibtum an jaakum thikrun min rabbikum AAala rajulin minkum liyunthirakum walitattaqoo walaAAallakum turhamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Marvel ye that there should come unto you a Reminder from your Lord by means of a man among you, that he may warn you, and that ye may keep from evil, and that haply ye may find mercy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakaththaboohu faanjaynahu waallatheena maAAahu fee alfulki waaghraqna allatheena kaththaboo biayatina innahum kanoo qawman AAameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship, and We drowned those who denied Our tokens. Lo! they were blind folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waila AAadin akhahum hoodan qala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto (the tribe of) A'ad (We sent) their brother, Hud. He said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala almalao allatheena kafaroo min qawmihi inna lanaraka fee safahatin wainna lanathunnuka mina alkathibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The chieftains of his people, who were disbelieving, said: Lo! we surely see thee in foolishness, and lo! we deem thee of the liars.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya qawmi laysa bee safahatun walakinnee rasoolun min rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O my people! There is no foolishness in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the Worlds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Oballighukum risalati rabbee waana lakum nasihun ameenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} I convey unto you the messages of my Lord and am for you a true adviser.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AwaAAajibtum an jaakum thikrun min rabbikum AAala rajulin minkum liyunthirakum waothkuroo ith jaAAalakum khulafaa min baAAdi qawmi noohin wazadakum fee alkhalqi bastatan faothkuroo alaa Allahi laAAallakum tuflihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Marvel ye that there should come unto you a Reminder from your Lord by means of a man among you, that he may warn you? Remember how He made you viceroys after Noah's folk, and gave you growth of stature. Remember (all) the bounties of your Lord, that haply ye may be successful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ajitana linaAAbuda Allaha wahdahu wanathara ma kana yaAAbudu abaona fatina bima taAAiduna in kunta mina alssadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Hast come unto us that we should serve Allah alone, and forsake what our fathers worshipped? Then bring upon us that wherewith thou threatenest us if thou art of the truthful!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala qad waqaAAa AAalaykum min rabbikum rijsun waghadabun atujadiloonanee fee asmain sammaytumooha antum waabaokum ma nazzala Allahu biha min sultanin faintathiroo innee maAAakum mina almuntathireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Terror and wrath from your Lord have already fallen on you. Would ye wrangle with me over names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which no warrant from Allah hath been revealed? Then await (the consequence), lo! I (also) am of those awaiting (it).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faanjaynahu waallatheena maAAahu birahmatin minna waqataAAna dabira allatheena kaththaboo biayatina wama kanoo mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We saved him and those with him by a mercy from Us, and We cut the root of those who denied Our revelations and were not believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waila thamooda akhahum salihan qala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu qad jaatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum hathihi naqatu Allahi lakum ayatan fatharooha takul fee ardi Allahi wala tamassooha bisooin fayakhuthakum AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And to (the tribe of) Thamud (We sent) their brother Salih. He said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. A wonder from your Lord hath come unto you. Lo! this is the camel of Allah, a token unto you; so let her feed in Allah's earth, and touch her not with hurt lest painful torment seize you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waothkuroo ith jaAAalakum khulafaa min baAAdi AAadin wabawwaakum fee alardi tattakhithoona min suhooliha qusooran watanhitoona aljibala buyootan faothkuroo alaa Allahi wala taAAthaw fee alardi mufsideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And remember how He made you viceroys after A'ad and gave you station in the earth. Ye choose castles in the plains and hew the mountains into dwellings. So remember (all) the bounties of Allah and do not evil, making mischief in the earth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala almalao allatheena istakbaroo min qawmihi lillatheena istudAAifoo liman amana minhum ataAAlamoona anna salihan mursalun min rabbihi qaloo inna bima orsila bihi muminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The chieftains of his people, who were scornful, said unto those whom they despised, unto such of them as believed: Know ye that Salih is one sent from his Lord? They said: Lo! In that wherewith he hath been sent we are believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala allatheena istakbaroo inna biallathee amantum bihi kafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who were scornful said: Lo! in that which ye believe we are disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaAAaqaroo alnnaqata waAAataw AAan amri rabbihim waqaloo ya salihu itina bima taAAiduna in kunta mina almursaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So they hamstrung the she-camel, and they flouted the commandment of their Lord, and they said: O Salih! Bring upon us that thou threatenest if thou art indeed of those sent (from Allah).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faakhathathumu alrrajfatu faasbahoo fee darihim jathimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So the earthquake seized them, and morning found them prostrate in their dwelling-place.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatawalla AAanhum waqala ya qawmi laqad ablaghtukum risalata rabbee wanasahtu lakum walakin la tuhibboona alnnasiheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (Salih) turned from them and said: O my people! I delivered my Lord's message unto you and gave you good advice, but ye love not good advisers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walootan ith qala liqawmihi atatoona alfahishata ma sabaqakum biha min ahadin mina alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Lot! (Remember) when he said unto his folk: Will ye commit abomination such as no creature ever did before you?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innakum latatoona alrrijala shahwatan min dooni alnnisai bal antum qawmun musrifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! ye come with lust unto men instead of women. Nay, but ye are wanton folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama kana jawaba qawmihi illa an qaloo akhrijoohum min qaryatikum innahum onasun yatatahharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the answer of his people was only that they said (one to another): Turn them out of your township. They are folk, forsooth, who keep pure.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faanjaynahu waahlahu illa imraatahu kanat mina alghabireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We rescued him and his household, save his wife, who was of those who stayed behind.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamtarna AAalayhim mataran faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We rained a rain upon them. See now the nature of the consequence of evil-doers!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waila madyana akhahum shuAAayban qala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu qad jaatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum faawfoo alkayla waalmeezana wala tabkhasoo alnnasa ashyaahum wala tufsidoo fee alardi baAAda islahiha thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto Midian (We sent) their brother, Shu'eyb. He said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Lo! a clear proof hath come unto you from your Lord; so give full measure and full weight and wrong not mankind in their goods, and work not confusion in the earth after the fair ordering thereof. That will be better for you, if ye are believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala taqAAudoo bikulli siratin tooAAidoona watasuddoona AAan sabeeli Allahi man amana bihi watabghoonaha AAiwajan waothkuroo ith kuntum qaleelan fakaththarakum waonthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu almufsideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lurk not on every road to threaten (wayfarers), and to turn away from Allah's path him who believeth in Him, and to seek to make it crooked. And remember, when ye were but few, how He did multiply you. And see the nature of the consequence for the corrupters!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain kana taifatun minkum amanoo biallathee orsiltu bihi wataifatun lam yuminoo faisbiroo hatta yahkuma Allahu baynana wahuwa khayru alhakimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if there is a party of you which believeth in that wherewith I have been sent, and there is a party which believeth not, then have patience until Allah judge between us. He is the Best of all who deal in judgment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala almalao allatheena istakbaroo min qawmihi lanukhrijannaka ya shuAAaybu waallatheena amanoo maAAaka min qaryatina aw lataAAoodunna fee millatina qala awalaw kunna kariheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The chieftains of his people, who were scornful, said: Surely we will drive thee out, O Shu'eyb, and those who believe with thee, from our township, unless ye return to our religion. He said: Even though we hate it?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qadi iftarayna AAala Allahi kathiban in AAudna fee millatikum baAAda ith najjana Allahu minha wama yakoonu lana an naAAooda feeha illa an yashaa Allahu rabbuna wasiAAa rabbuna kulla shayin AAilman AAala Allahi tawakkalna rabbana iftah baynana wabayna qawmina bialhaqqi waanta khayru alfatiheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We should have invented a lie against Allah if we returned to your religion after Allah hath rescued us from it. It is not for us to return to it unless Allah our Lord should (so) will. Our Lord comprehendeth all things in knowledge. In Allah do we put our trust. Our Lord! Decide with truth between us and our folk, for Thou art the best of those who make decision.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala almalao allatheena kafaroo min qawmihi laini ittabaAAtum shuAAayban innakum ithan lakhasiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But the chieftains of his people, who were disbelieving, said: If ye follow Shu'eyb, then truly ye shall be the losers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faakhathathumu alrrajfatu faasbahoo fee darihim jathimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So the earthquake seized them and morning found them prostrate in their dwelling-place.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena kaththaboo shuAAayban kaan lam yaghnaw feeha allatheena kaththaboo shuAAayban kanoo humu alkhasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who denied Shu'eyb became as though they had not dwelt there. Those who denied Shu'eyb, they were the losers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatawalla AAanhum waqala ya qawmi laqad ablaghtukum risalati rabbee wanasahtu lakum fakayfa asa AAala qawmin kafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So he turned from them and said: O my people! I delivered my Lord's messages unto you and gave you good advice; then how can I sorrow for a people that rejected (truth)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama arsalna fee qaryatin min nabiyyin illa akhathna ahlaha bialbasai waalddarrai laAAallahum yaddarraAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We sent no prophet unto any township but We did afflict its folk with tribulation and adversity that haply they might grow humble.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma baddalna makana alssayyiati alhasanata hatta AAafaw waqaloo qad massa abaana alddarrao waalssarrao faakhathnahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then changed We the evil plight for good till they grew affluent and said: Tribulation and distress did touch our fathers. Then We seized them unawares, when they perceived not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw anna ahla alqura amanoo waittaqaw lafatahna AAalayhim barakatin mina alssamai waalardi walakin kaththaboo faakhathnahum bima kanoo yaksiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if the people of the townships had believed and kept from evil, surely We should have opened for them blessings from the sky and from the earth. But (unto every messenger) they gave the lie, and so We seized them on account of what they used to earn.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaamina ahlu alqura an yatiyahum basuna bayatan wahum naimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Are the people of the townships then secure from the coming of Our wrath upon them as a night-raid while they sleep?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awa amina ahlu alqura an yatiyahum basuna duhan wahum yalAAaboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or are the people of the townships then secure from the coming of Our wrath upon them in the daytime while they play?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaaminoo makra Allahi fala yamanu makra Allahi illa alqawmu alkhasiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Are they then secure from Allah's scheme? None deemeth himself secure from Allah's scheme save folk that perish.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yahdi lillatheena yarithoona alarda min baAAdi ahliha an law nashao asabnahum bithunoobihim wanatbaAAu AAala quloobihim fahum la yasmaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is it not an indication to those who inherit the land after its people (who thus reaped the consequence of evil-doing) that, if We will, We can smite them for their sins and print upon their hearts so that they hear not?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tilka alqura naqussu AAalayka min anbaiha walaqad jaathum rusuluhum bialbayyinati fama kanoo liyuminoo bima kaththaboo min qablu kathalika yatbaAAu Allahu AAala quloobi alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such were the townships. We relate some tidings of them unto thee (Muhammad). Their messengers verily came unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), but they could not believe because they had before denied. Thus doth Allah print upon the hearts of disbelievers (that they hear not).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama wajadna liaktharihim min AAahdin wain wajadna aktharahum lafasiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We found no (loyalty to any) covenant in most of them. Nay, most of them We found wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma baAAathna min baAAdihim moosa biayatina ila firAAawna wamalaihi fathalamoo biha faonuthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almufsideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, after them, We sent Moses with our tokens unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they repelled them. Now, see the nature of the consequence for the corrupters!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala moosa ya firAAawnu innee rasoolun min rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Moses said: O Pharaoh! Lo! I am a messenger from the Lord of the Worlds,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Haqeequn AAala an la aqoola AAala Allahi illa alhaqqa qad jitukum bibayyinatin min rabbikum faarsil maAAiya banee israeela}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Approved upon condition that I speak concerning Allah nothing but the truth. I come unto you (lords of Egypt) with a clear proof from your Lord. So let the Children of Israel go with me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala in kunta jita biayatin fati biha in kunta mina alssadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Pharaoh) said: If thou comest with a token, then produce it, if thou art of those who speak the truth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalqa AAasahu faitha hiya thuAAbanun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then he flung down his staff and lo! it was a serpent manifest;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WanazaAAa yadahu faitha hiya baydao lilnnathireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he drew forth his hand (from his bosom), and lo! it was white for the beholders.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala almalao min qawmi firAAawna inna hatha lasahirun AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The chiefs of Pharaoh's people said: Lo! this is some knowing wizard,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum famatha tamuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who would expel you from your land. Now what do ye advise?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo arjih waakhahu waarsil fee almadaini hashireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said (unto Pharaoh): Put him off (a while) - him and his brother - and send into the cities summoners,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][112]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yatooka bikulli sahirin AAaleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} To bring each knowing wizard unto thee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][113]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajaa alssaharatu firAAawna qaloo inna lana laajran in kunna nahnu alghalibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the wizards came to Pharaoh, saying: Surely there will be a reward for us if we are victors.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][114]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala naAAam wainnakum lamina almuqarrabeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He answered: Yes, and surely ye shall be of those brought near (to me).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][115]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya moosa imma an tulqiya waimma an nakoona nahnu almulqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: O Moses! Either throw (first) or let us be the first throwers?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][116]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala alqoo falamma alqaw saharoo aAAyuna alnnasi waistarhaboohum wajaoo bisihrin AAatheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Throw! And when they threw they cast a spell upon the people's eyes, and overawed them, and produced a mighty spell.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][117]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waawhayna ila moosa an alqi AAasaka faitha hiya talqafu ma yafikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We inspired Moses (saying): Throw thy staff! And lo! it swallowed up their lying show.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][118]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FawaqaAAa alhaqqu wabatala ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus was the Truth vindicated and that which they were doing was made vain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][119]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faghuliboo hunalika wainqalaboo saghireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus were they there defeated and brought low.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][120]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waolqiya alssaharatu sajideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the wizards fell down prostrate,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][121]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo amanna birabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][122]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbi moosa waharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Lord of Moses and Aaron.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][123]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala firAAawnu amantum bihi qabla an athana lakum inna hatha lamakrun makartumoohu fee almadeenati litukhrijoo minha ahlaha fasawfa taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Pharaoh said: Ye believe in Him before I give you leave! Lo! this is the plot that ye have plotted in the city that ye may drive its people hence. But ye shall come to know!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][124]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{LaoqatiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin thumma laosallibannakum ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Surely I shall have your hands and feet cut off upon alternate sides. Then I shall crucify you every one.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][125]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo inna ila rabbina munqaliboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Lo! We are about to return unto our Lord!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][126]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama tanqimu minna illa an amanna biayati rabbina lamma jaatna rabbana afrigh AAalayna sabran watawaffana muslimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thou takest vengeance on us only forasmuch as we believed the tokens of our Lord when they came unto us. Our Lord! Vouchsafe unto us steadfastness and make us die as men who have surrendered (unto Thee).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][127]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala almalao min qawmi firAAawna atatharu moosa waqawmahu liyufsidoo fee alardi wayatharaka waalihataka qala sanuqattilu abnaahum wanastahyee nisaahum wainna fawqahum qahiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The chiefs of Pharaoh's people said: (O King), wilt thou suffer Moses and his people to make mischief in the land, and flout thee and thy gods? He said: We will slay their sons and spare their women, for lo! we are in power over them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][128]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala moosa liqawmihi istaAAeenoo biAllahi waisbiroo inna alarda lillahi yoorithuha man yashao min AAibadihi waalAAaqibatu lilmuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Moses said unto his people: Seek help in Allah and endure. Lo! the earth is Allah's. He giveth it for an inheritance to whom He will. And lo! the sequel is for those who keep their duty (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][129]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ootheena min qabli an tatiyana wamin baAAdi ma jitana qala AAasa rabbukum an yuhlika AAaduwwakum wayastakhlifakum fee alardi fayanthura kayfa taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: We suffered hurt before thou camest unto us, and since thou hast come unto us. He said: It may be that your Lord is going to destroy your adversary and make you viceroys in the earth, that He may see how ye behave.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][130]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad akhathna ala firAAawna bialssineena wanaqsin mina alththamarati laAAallahum yaththakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And we straitened Pharaoh's folk with famine and dearth of fruits, that peradventure they might heed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][131]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha jaathumu alhasanatu qaloo lana hathihi wain tusibhum sayyiatun yattayyaroo bimoosa waman maAAahu ala innama tairuhum AAinda Allahi walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But whenever good befell them, they said: This is ours; and whenever evil smote them they ascribed it to the evil auspices of Moses and those with him. Surely their evil auspice was only with Allah. But most of them knew not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][132]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo mahma tatina bihi min ayatin litasharana biha fama nahnu laka bimumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they said: Whatever portent thou bringest wherewith to bewitch us, we shall not put faith in thee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][133]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faarsalna AAalayhimu alttoofana waaljarada waalqummala waalddafadiAAa waalddama ayatin mufassalatin faistakbaroo wakanoo qawman mujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So We sent against them the flood and the locusts and the vermin and the frogs and the blood - a succession of clear signs. But they were arrogant and became a guilty folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][134]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma waqaAAa AAalayhimu alrrijzu qaloo ya moosa odAAu lana rabbaka bima AAahida AAindaka lain kashafta AAanna alrrijza lanuminanna laka walanursilanna maAAaka banee israeela}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the terror fell on them they cried: O Moses! Pray for us unto thy Lord, because He hath a covenant with thee. If thou removest the terror from us we verily will trust thee and will let the Children of Israel go with thee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][135]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma kashafna AAanhumu alrrijza ila ajalin hum balighoohu itha hum yankuthoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But when We did remove from them the terror for a term which they must reach, behold! they broke their covenant.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][136]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faintaqamna minhum faaghraqnahum fee alyammi biannahum kaththaboo biayatina wakanoo AAanha ghafileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefore We took retribution from them; therefore We drowned them in the sea: because they denied Our revelations and were heedless of them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][137]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waawrathna alqawma allatheena kanoo yustadAAafoona mashariqa alardi wamagharibaha allatee barakna feeha watammat kalimatu rabbika alhusna AAala banee israeela bima sabaroo wadammarna ma kana yasnaAAu firAAawnu waqawmuhu wama kanoo yaAArishoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We caused the folk who were despised to inherit the eastern parts of the land and the western parts thereof which We had blessed. And the fair word of thy Lord was fulfilled for the Children of Israel because of their endurance; and We annihilated (all) that Pharaoh and his folk had done and that they had contrived.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][138]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajawazna bibanee israeela albahra faataw AAala qawmin yaAAkufoona AAala asnamin lahum qaloo ya moosa ijAAal lana ilahan kama lahum alihatun qala innakum qawmun tajhaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We brought the Children of Israel across the sea, and they came unto a people who were given up to idols which they had. They said: O Moses! Make for us a god even as they have gods. He said: Lo! ye are a folk who know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][139]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna haolai mutabbarun ma hum feehi wabatilun ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! as for these, their way will be destroyed and all that they are doing is in vain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][140]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala aghayra Allahi abgheekum ilahan wahuwa faddalakum AAala alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Shall I seek for you a god other than Allah when He hath favoured you above (all) creatures?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][141]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith anjaynakum min ali firAAawna yasoomoonakum sooa alAAathabi yuqattiloona abnaakum wayastahyoona nisaakum wafee thalikum balaon min rabbikum AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (remember) when We did deliver you from Pharaoh's folk who were afflicting you with dreadful torment, slaughtering your sons and sparing your women. That was a tremendous trial from your Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][142]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WawaAAadna moosa thalatheena laylatan waatmamnaha biAAashrin fatamma meeqatu rabbihi arbaAAeena laylatan waqala moosa liakheehi haroona okhlufnee fee qawmee waaslih wala tattabiAA sabeela almufsideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We did appoint for Moses thirty nights (of solitude), and added to them ten, and he completed the whole time appointed by his Lord of forty nights; and Moses said unto his brother, Aaron: Take my place among the people. Do right, and follow not the way of mischief-makers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][143]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma jaa moosa limeeqatina wakallamahu rabbuhu qala rabbi arinee anthur ilayka qala lan taranee walakini onthur ila aljabali faini istaqarra makanahu fasawfa taranee falamma tajalla rabbuhu liljabali jaAAalahu dakkan wakharra moosa saAAiqan falamma afaqa qala subhanaka tubtu ilayka waana awwalu almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Moses came to Our appointed tryst and his Lord had spoken unto him, he said: My Lord! Show me (Thy Self), that I may gaze upon Thee. He said: Thou wilt not see Me, but gaze upon the mountain! If it stand still in its place, then thou wilt see Me. And when his Lord revealed (His) glory to the mountain He sent it crashing down. And Moses fell down senseless. And when he woke he said: Glory unto Thee! I turn unto Thee repentant, and I am the first of (true) believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][144]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya moosa innee istafaytuka AAala alnnasi birisalatee wabikalamee fakhuth ma ataytuka wakun mina alshshakireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O Moses! I have preferred thee above mankind by My messages and by My speaking (unto thee). So hold that which I have given thee, and be among the thankful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][145]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakatabna lahu fee alalwahi min kulli shayin mawAAithatan watafseelan likulli shayin fakhuthha biquwwatin wamur qawmaka yakhuthoo biahsaniha saoreekum dara alfasiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We wrote for him, upon the tablets, the lesson to be drawn from all things and the explanation of all things, then (bade him): Hold it fast; and command thy people (saying): Take the better (course made clear) therein. I shall show thee the abode of evil-livers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][146]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Saasrifu AAan ayatiya allatheena yatakabbaroona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi wain yaraw kulla ayatin la yuminoo biha wain yaraw sabeela alrrushdi la yattakhithoohu sabeelan wain yaraw sabeela alghayyi yattakhithoohu sabeelan thalika biannahum kaththaboo biayatina wakanoo AAanha ghafileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} I shall turn away from My revelations those who magnify themselves wrongfully in the earth, and if they see each token believe it not, and if they see the way of righteousness choose it nor for (their) way, and if they see the way of error choose if for (their) way. That is because they deny Our revelations and are used to disregard them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][147]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena kaththaboo biayatina waliqai alakhirati habitat aAAmaluhum hal yujzawna illa ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who deny Our revelations and the meeting of the Hereafter, their works are fruitless. Are they requited aught save what they used to do?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][148]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waittakhatha qawmu moosa min baAAdihi min huliyyihim AAijlan jasadan lahu khuwarun alam yaraw annahu la yukallimuhum wala yahdeehim sabeelan ittakhathoohu wakanoo thalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the folk of Moses, after (he left them), chose a calf (for worship), (made) out of their ornaments, of saffron hue, which gave a lowing sound. Saw they not that it spake not unto them nor guided them to any way? They chose it, and became wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][149]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma suqita fee aydeehim waraaw annahum qad dalloo qaloo lain lam yarhamna rabbuna wayaghfir lana lanakoonanna mina alkhasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they feared the consequences thereof and saw that they had gone astray, they said: Unless our Lord have mercy on us and forgive us, we verily are of the lost.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][150]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma rajaAAa moosa ila qawmihi ghadbana asifan qala bisama khalaftumoonee min baAAdee aAAajiltum amra rabbikum waalqa alalwaha waakhatha birasi akheehi yajurruhu ilayhi qala ibna omma inna alqawma istadAAafoonee wakadoo yaqtuloonanee fala tushmit biya alaAAdaa wala tajAAalnee maAAa alqawmi alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Moses returned unto his people, angry and grieved, he said: Evil is that (course) which ye took after I had left you. Would ye hasten on the judgment of your Lord? And he cast down the tablets, and he seized his brother by the head, dragging him toward him. He said: Son of my mother! Lo! the folk did judge me weak and almost killed me. Oh, make not mine enemies to triumph over me and place me not among the evil-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][151]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi ighfir lee waliakhee waadkhilna fee rahmatika waanta arhamu alrrahimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! Have mercy on me and on my brother; bring us into Thy mercy, Thou the Most Merciful of all who show mercy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][152]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena ittakhathoo alAAijla sayanaluhum ghadabun min rabbihim wathillatun fee alhayati alddunya wakathalika najzee almuftareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Those who chose the calf (for worship), terror from their Lord and humiliation will come upon them in the life of the world. Thus do We requite those who invent a lie.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][153]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena AAamiloo alssayyiati thumma taboo min baAAdiha waamanoo inna rabbaka min baAAdiha laghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But those who do ill-deeds and afterward repent and believe - lo! for them, afterward, Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][154]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma sakata AAan moosa alghadabu akhatha alalwaha wafee nuskhatiha hudan warahmatun lillatheena hum lirabbihim yarhaboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, when the anger of Moses abated, he took up the tablets, and in their inscription there was guidance and mercy for all those who fear their Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][155]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waikhtara moosa qawmahu sabAAeena rajulan limeeqatina falamma akhathathumu alrrajfatu qala rabbi law shita ahlaktahum min qablu waiyyaya atuhlikuna bima faAAala alssufahao minna in hiya illa fitnatuka tudillu biha man tashao watahdee man tashao anta waliyyuna faighfir lana wairhamna waanta khayru alghafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Moses chose of his people seventy men for Our appointed tryst and, when the trembling came on them, he said: My Lord! If Thou hadst willed Thou hadst destroyed them long before, and me with them. Wilt thou destroy us for that which the ignorant among us did? It is but Thy trial (of us). Thou sendest whom Thou wilt astray and guidest whom Thou wilt: Thou art our Protecting Friend, therefore forgive us and have mercy on us, Thou, the Best of all who show forgiveness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[7][156]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waoktub lana fee hathihi alddunya hasanatan wafee alakhirati inna hudna ilayka qala AAathabee oseebu bihi man ashao warahmatee wasiAAat kulla shayin fasaaktubuha lillatheena yattaqoona wayutoona alzzakata waallatheena hum biayatina yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And ordain for us in this world that which is good, and in the Hereafter (that which is good), Lo! We have turned unto Thee. He said: I smite with My punishment whom I will, and My mercy embraceth all things, therefore I shall ordain it for those who ward off (evil) and pay the poor-due, and those who believe Our revelations;}
