They will say: Allah. Then say: Will ye not then keep your duty (unto Him)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fathalikumu Allahu rabbukumu alhaqqu famatha baAAda alhaqqi illa alddalalu faanna tusrafoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such then is Allah, your rightful Lord. After the Truth what is there saving error? How then are ye turned away!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kathalika haqqat kalimatu rabbika AAala allatheena fasaqoo annahum la yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus is the Word of thy Lord justified concerning those who do wrong: that they believe not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul hal min shurakaikum man yabdao alkhalqa thumma yuAAeeduhu quli Allahu yabdao alkhalqa thumma yuAAeeduhu faanna tufakoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Is there of your partners (whom ye ascribe unto Allah) one that produceth Creation and then reproduceth it? Say: Allah produceth Creation, then reproduceth it. How then, are ye misled!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul hal min shurakaikum man yahdee ila alhaqqi quli Allahu yahdee lilhaqqi afaman yahdee ila alhaqqi ahaqqu an yuttabaAAa amman la yahiddee illa an yuhda fama lakum kayfa tahkumoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Is there of your partners (whom ye ascribe unto Allah) one that leadeth to the Truth? Say: Allah leadeth to the Truth. Is He Who leadeth to the Truth more deserving that He should be followed, or he who findeth not the way unless he (himself) be guided. What aileth you? How judge ye?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yattabiAAu aktharuhum illa thannan inna alththanna la yughnee mina alhaqqi shayan inna Allaha AAaleemun bima yafAAaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Most of them follow not but conjecture. Assuredly conjecture can by no means take the place of truth. Lo! Allah is Aware of what they do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama kana hatha alquranu an yuftara min dooni Allahi walakin tasdeeqa allathee bayna yadayhi watafseela alkitabi la rayba feehi min rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And this Qur'an is not such as could ever be invented in despite of Allah; but it is a confirmation of that which was before it and an exposition of that which is decreed for mankind - Therein is no doubt - from the Lord of the Worlds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am yaqooloona iftarahu qul fatoo bisooratin mithlihi waodAAoo mani istataAAtum min dooni Allahi in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or say they: He hath invented it? Say: Then bring a surah like unto it, and call (for help) on all ye can besides Allah, if ye are truthful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal kaththaboo bima lam yuheetoo biAAilmihi walamma yatihim taweeluhu kathalika kaththaba allatheena min qablihim faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but they denied that, the knowledge whereof they could not compass, and whereof the interpretation (in events) hath not yet come unto them. Even so did those before them deny. Then see what was the consequence for the wrong-doers!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waminhum man yuminu bihi waminhum man la yuminu bihi warabbuka aAAlamu bialmufsideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of them is he who believeth therein, and of them is he who believeth not therein, and thy Lord is Best Aware of the corrupters.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain kaththabooka faqul lee AAamalee walakum AAamalukum antum bareeoona mimma aAAmalu waana bareeon mimma taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if they deny thee, say: Unto me my work, and unto you your work. Ye are innocent of what I do, and I am innocent of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waminhum man yastamiAAoona ilayka afaanta tusmiAAu alssumma walaw kanoo la yaAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of them are some who listen unto thee. But canst thou make the deaf to hear even though they apprehend not?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waminhum man yanthuru ilayka afaanta tahdee alAAumya walaw kanoo la yubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of them is he who looketh toward thee. But canst thou guide the blind even though they see not?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha la yathlimu alnnasa shayan walakinna alnnasa anfusahum yathlimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah wrongeth not mankind in aught; but mankind wrong themselves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma yahshuruhum kaan lam yalbathoo illa saAAatan mina alnnahari yataAAarafoona baynahum qad khasira allatheena kaththaboo biliqai Allahi wama kanoo muhtadeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And on the day when He shall gather them together, (when it will seem) as though they had tarried but an hour of the day, recognising one another, those will verily have perished who denied the meeting with Allah and were not guided.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waimma nuriyannaka baAAda allathee naAAiduhum aw natawaffayannaka failayna marjiAAuhum thumma Allahu shaheedun AAala ma yafAAaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whether We let thee (O Muhammad) behold something of that which We promise them or (whether We) cause thee to die, still unto Us is their return, and Allah, moreover, is Witness over what they do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walikulli ommatin rasoolun faitha jaa rasooluhum qudiya baynahum bialqisti wahum la yuthlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And for every nation there is a messenger. And when their messenger cometh (on the Day of Judgment) it will be judged between them fairly, and they will not be wronged.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul la amliku linafsee darran wala nafAAan illa ma shaa Allahu likulli ommatin ajalun itha jaa ajaluhum fala yastakhiroona saAAatan wala yastaqdimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: I have no power to hurt or benefit myself, save that which Allah willeth. For every nation there is an appointed time. When their time cometh, then they cannot put it off an hour, nor hasten (it).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul araaytum in atakum AAathabuhu bayatan aw naharan matha yastaAAjilu minhu almujrimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Have ye thought: When His doom cometh unto you as a raid by night, or in the (busy) day; what is there of it that the guilty ones desire to hasten?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Athumma itha ma waqaAAa amantum bihi alana waqad kuntum bihi tastaAAjiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is it (only) then, when it hath befallen you, that ye will believe? What! (Believe) now, when (until now) ye have been hastening it on (through disbelief)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma qeela lillatheena thalamoo thooqoo AAathaba alkhuldi hal tujzawna illa bima kuntum taksiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then will it be said unto those who dealt unjustly Taste the torment of eternity. Are ye requited aught save what ye used to earn?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayastanbioonaka ahaqqun huwa qul ee warabbee innahu lahaqqun wama antum bimuAAjizeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they ask thee to inform them (saying): Is it true? Say: Yea, by my Lord, verily it is true, and ye cannot escape.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw anna likulli nafsin thalamat ma fee alardi laiftadat bihi waasarroo alnnadamata lamma raawoo alAAathaba waqudiya baynahum bialqisti wahum la yuthlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if each soul that doeth wrong had all that is in the earth it would seek to ransom itself therewith; and they will feel remorse within them, when they see the doom. But it hath been judged between them fairly and they are not wronged.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ala inna lillahi ma fee alssamawati waalardi ala inna waAAda Allahi haqqun walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! verily all that is in the heavens and the earth is Allah's. Lo! verily Allah's promise is true. But most of them know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa yuhyee wayumeetu wailayhi turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He quickeneth and giveth death, and unto Him ye will be returned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnasu qad jaatkum mawAAithatun min rabbikum washifaon lima fee alssudoori wahudan warahmatun lilmumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O mankind! There hath come unto you an exhortation from your Lord, a balm for that which is in the breasts, a guidance and a mercy for believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul bifadli Allahi wabirahmatihi fabithalika falyafrahoo huwa khayrun mimma yajmaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy: therein let them rejoice. It is better than what they hoard.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul araaytum ma anzala Allahu lakum min rizqin fajaAAaltum minhu haraman wahalalan qul allahu athina lakum am AAala Allahi taftaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Have ye considered what provision Allah hath sent down for you, how ye have made of it lawful and unlawful? Hath Allah permitted you, or do ye invent a lie concerning Allah?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama thannu allatheena yaftaroona AAala Allahi alkathiba yawma alqiyamati inna Allaha lathoo fadlin AAala alnnasi walakinna aktharahum la yashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And what think those who invent a lie concerning Allah (will be their plight) upon the Day of Resurrection? Lo! Allah truly is Bountiful toward mankind, but most of them give not thanks.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama takoonu fee shanin wama tatloo minhu min quranin wala taAAmaloona min AAamalin illa kunna AAalaykum shuhoodan ith tufeedoona feehi wama yaAAzubu AAan rabbika min mithqali tharratin fee alardi wala fee alssamai wala asghara min thalika wala akbara illa fee kitabin mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thou (Muhammad) art not occupied with any business and thou recitest not a Lecture from this (Scripture), and ye (mankind) perform no act, but We are Witness of you when ye are engaged therein. And not an atom's weight in the earth or in the sky escapeth your Lord, nor what is less than that or greater than that, but it is (written) in a clear Book.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ala inna awliyaa Allahi la khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! verily the friends of Allah are (those) on whom fear (cometh) not, nor do they grieve?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena amanoo wakanoo yattaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who believe and keep their duty (to Allah).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahumu albushra fee alhayati alddunya wafee alakhirati la tabdeela likalimati Allahi thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Theirs are good tidings in the life of the world and in the Hereafter - There is no changing the Words of Allah - that is the Supreme Triumph.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala yahzunka qawluhum inna alAAizzata lillahi jameeAAan huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! power belongeth wholly to Allah. He is the Hearer, the Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ala inna lillahi man fee alssamawati waman fee alardi wama yattabiAAu allatheena yadAAoona min dooni Allahi shurakaa in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wain hum illa yakhrusoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! is it not unto Allah that belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and whosoever is in the earth? Those who follow aught instead of Allah follow not (His) partners. They follow only a conjecture, and they do but guess.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa allathee jaAAala lakumu allayla litaskunoo feehi waalnnahara mubsiran inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yasmaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who hath appointed for you the night that ye should rest therein and the day giving sight. Lo! herein verily are portents for a folk that heed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ittakhatha Allahu waladan subhanahu huwa alghaniyyu lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi in AAindakum min sultanin bihatha ataqooloona AAala Allahi ma la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They say: Allah hath taken (unto Him) a son - Glorified be He! He hath no needs! His is all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Ye have no warrant for this. Tell ye concerning Allah that which ye know not?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul inna allatheena yaftaroona AAala Allahi alkathiba la yuflihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Verily those who invent a lie concerning Allah will not succeed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{MataAAun fee alddunya thumma ilayna marjiAAuhum thumma nutheequhumu alAAathaba alshshadeeda bima kanoo yakfuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This world's portion (will be theirs), then unto Us is their return. Then We make them taste a dreadful doom because they used to disbelieve.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waotlu AAalayhim nabaa noohin ith qala liqawmihi ya qawmi in kana kabura AAalaykum maqamee watathkeeree biayati Allahi faAAala Allahi tawakkaltu faajmiAAoo amrakum washurakaakum thumma la yakun amrukum AAalaykum ghummatan thumma iqdoo ilayya wala tunthirooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Recite unto them the story of Noah, when he told his people: O my people! If my sojourn (here) and my reminding you by Allah's revelations are an offence unto you, in Allah have I put my trust, so decide upon your course of action you and your partners. Let not your course of action be in doubt for you. Then have at me, give me no respite.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain tawallaytum fama saaltukum min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala Allahi waomirtu an akoona mina almuslimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But if ye are averse I have asked of you no wage. My wage is the concern of Allah only, and I am commanded to be of those who surrender (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakaththaboohu fanajjaynahu waman maAAahu fee alfulki wajaAAalnahum khalaifa waaghraqna allatheena kaththaboo biayatina faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almunthareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship, and made them viceroys (in the earth), while We drowned those who denied Our revelations. See then the nature of the consequence for those who had been warned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma baAAathna min baAAdihi rusulan ila qawmihim fajaoohum bialbayyinati fama kanoo liyuminoo bima kaththaboo bihi min qablu kathalika natbaAAu AAala quloobi almuAAtadeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, after him, We sent messengers unto their folk, and they brought them clear proofs. But they were not ready to believe in that which they before denied. Thus print We on the hearts of the transgressors.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma baAAathna min baAAdihim moosa waharoona ila firAAawna wamalaihi biayatina faistakbaroo wakanoo qawman mujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, after them, We sent Moses and Aaron unto Pharaoh and his chiefs with Our revelations, but they were arrogant and were a guilty folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jaahumu alhaqqu min AAindina qaloo inna hatha lasihrun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the Truth from Our presence came unto them, they said: Lo! this is mere magic.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala moosa ataqooloona lilhaqqi lamma jaakum asihrun hatha wala yuflihu alssahiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Moses said: Speak ye (so) of the Truth when it hath come unto you? Is this magic? Now magicians thrive not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ajitana litalfitana AAamma wajadna AAalayhi abaana watakoona lakuma alkibriyao fee alardi wama nahnu lakuma bimumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Hast thou come unto us to pervert us from that (faith) in which we found our fathers, and that you two may own the place of greatness in the land? We will not believe you two.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala firAAawnu itoonee bikulli sahirin AAaleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Pharaoh said: Bring every cunning wizard unto me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jaa alssaharatu qala lahum moosa alqoo ma antum mulqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the wizards came, Moses said unto them: Cast your cast!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma alqaw qala moosa ma jitum bihi alssihru inna Allaha sayubtiluhu inna Allaha la yuslihu AAamala almufsideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they had cast, Moses said: That which ye have brought is magic. Lo! Allah will make it vain. Lo! Allah upholdeth not the work of mischief-makers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayuhiqqu Allahu alhaqqa bikalimatihi walaw kariha almujrimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah will vindicate the Truth by His words, however much the guilty be averse.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama amana limoosa illa thurriyyatun min qawmihi AAala khawfin min firAAawna wamalaihim an yaftinahum wainna firAAawna laAAalin fee alardi wainnahu lamina almusrifeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But none trusted Moses, save some scions of his people, (and they were) in fear of Pharaoh and their chiefs, that he would persecute them. Lo! Pharaoh was verily a tyrant in the land, and lo! he verily was of the wanton.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala moosa ya qawmi in kuntum amantum biAllahi faAAalayhi tawakkaloo in kuntum muslimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Moses said: O my people! If ye have believed in Allah then put trust in Him, if ye have indeed surrendered (unto Him)!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqaloo AAala Allahi tawakkalna rabbana la tajAAalna fitnatan lilqawmi alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: In Allah we put trust. Our Lord! Oh, make us not a lure for the wrongdoing folk;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanajjina birahmatika mina alqawmi alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And, of Thy mercy, save us from the folk that disbelieve.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waawhayna ila moosa waakheehi an tabawwaa liqawmikuma bimisra buyootan waijAAaloo buyootakum qiblatan waaqeemoo alssalata wabashshiri almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We inspired Moses and his brother, (saying): Appoint houses for your people in Egypt and make your houses oratories, and establish worship. And give good news to the believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala moosa rabbana innaka atayta firAAawna wamalaahu zeenatan waamwalan fee alhayati alddunya rabbana liyudilloo AAan sabeelika rabbana itmis AAala amwalihim waoshdud AAala quloobihim fala yuminoo hatta yarawoo alAAathaba alaleema}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Moses said: Our Lord! Lo! Thou hast given Pharaoh and his chiefs splendour and riches in the life of the world, Our Lord! that they may lead men astray from Thy way. Our Lord! Destroy their riches and harden their hearts so that they believe not till they see the painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala qad ojeebat daAAwatukuma faistaqeema wala tattabiAAanni sabeela allatheena la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Your prayer is heard. Do ye twain keep to the straight path, and follow not the road of those who have no knowledge.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajawazna bibanee israeela albahra faatbaAAahum firAAawnu wajunooduhu baghyan waAAadwan hatta itha adrakahu algharaqu qala amantu annahu la ilaha illa allathee amanat bihi banoo israeela waana mina almuslimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We brought the Children of Israel across the sea, and Pharaoh with his hosts pursued them in rebellion and transgression, till, when the (fate of) drowning overtook him, he exclaimed: I believe that there is no Allah save Him in Whom the Children of Israel believe, and I am of those who surrender (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alana waqad AAasayta qablu wakunta mina almufsideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} What! Now! When hitherto thou hast rebelled and been of the wrong-doers?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalyawma nunajjeeka bibadanika litakoona liman khalfaka ayatan wainna katheeran mina alnnasi AAan ayatina laghafiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But this day We save thee in thy body that thou mayst be a portent for those after thee. Lo! most of mankind are heedless of Our portents.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad bawwana banee israeela mubawwaa sidqin warazaqnahum mina alttayyibati fama ikhtalafoo hatta jaahumu alAAilmu inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We verily did allot unto the Children of Israel a fixed abode, and did provide them with good things; and they differed not until the knowledge came unto them. Lo! thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain kunta fee shakkin mimma anzalnna ilayka faisali allatheena yaqraoona alkitaba min qablika laqad jaaka alhaqqu min rabbika fala takoonanna mina almumtareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if thou (Muhammad) art in doubt concerning that which We reveal unto thee, then question those who read the Scripture (that was) before thee. Verily the Truth from thy Lord hath come unto thee. So be not thou of the waverers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala takoonanna mina allatheena kaththaboo biayati Allahi fatakoona mina alkhasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And be not thou of those who deny the revelations of Allah, for then wert thou of the losers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena haqqat AAalayhim kalimatu rabbika la yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those for whom the word of thy Lord (concerning sinners) hath effect will not believe,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw jaathum kullu ayatin hatta yarawoo alAAathaba alaleema}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Though every token come unto them, till they see the painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falawla kanat qaryatun amanat fanafaAAaha eemanuha illa qawma yoonusa lamma amanoo kashafna AAanhum AAathaba alkhizyi fee alhayati alddunya wamattaAAnahum ila heenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If only there had been a community (of all those that were destroyed of old) that believed and profited by its belief as did the folk of Jonah! When they believed We drew off from them the torment of disgrace in the life of the world and gave them comfort for a while.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw shaa rabbuka laamana man fee alardi kulluhum jameeAAan afaanta tukrihu alnnasa hatta yakoonoo mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if thy Lord willed, all who are in the earth would have believed together. Wouldst thou (Muhammad) compel men until they are believers?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama kana linafsin an tumina illa biithni Allahi wayajAAalu alrrijsa AAala allatheena la yaAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is not for any soul to believe save by the permission of Allah. He hath set uncleanness upon those who have no sense.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Quli onthuroo matha fee alssamawati waalardi wama tughnee alayatu waalnnuthuru AAan qawmin la yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Behold what is in the heavens and the earth! But revelations and warnings avail not folk who will not believe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fahal yantathiroona illa mithla ayyami allatheena khalaw min qablihim qul faintathiroo innee maAAakum mina almuntathireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} What expect they save the like of the days of those who passed away before them? Say: Expect then! I am with you among the expectant.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma nunajjee rusulana waallatheena amanoo kathalika haqqan AAalayna nunjee almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then shall We save Our messengers and the believers, in like manner (as of old). It is incumbent upon Us to save believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ya ayyuha alnnasu in kuntum fee shakkin min deenee fala aAAbudu allatheena taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi walakin aAAbudu Allaha allathee yatawaffakum waomirtu an akoona mina almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad): O mankind! If ye are in doubt of my religion, then (know that) I worship not those whom ye worship instead of Allah, but I worship Allah Who causeth you to die, and I have been commanded to be of the believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waan aqim wajhaka lilddeeni haneefan wala takoonanna mina almushrikeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And, (O Muhammad) set thy purpose resolutely for religion, as a man by nature upright, and be not of those who ascribe partners (to Allah).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tadAAu min dooni Allahi ma la yanfaAAuka wala yadurruka fain faAAalta fainnaka ithan mina alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And cry not, beside Allah, unto that which cannot profit thee nor hurt thee, for if thou didst so then wert thou of the wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain yamsaska Allahu bidurrin fala kashifa lahu illa huwa wain yuridka bikhayrin fala radda lifadlihi yuseebu bihi man yashao min AAibadihi wahuwa alghafooru alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If Allah afflicteth thee with some hurt, there is none who can remove it save Him; and if He desireth good for thee, there is none who can repel His bounty. He striketh with it whom He will of his bondmen. He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ya ayyuha alnnasu qad jaakumu alhaqqu min rabbikum famani ihtada fainnama yahtadee linafsihi waman dalla fainnama yadillu AAalayha wama ana AAalaykum biwakeelin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: O mankind! Now hath the Truth from your Lord come unto you. So whosoever is guided, is guided only for (the good of) his soul, and whosoever erreth erreth only against it. And I am not a warder over you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[10][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaittabiAA ma yooha ilayka waisbir hatta yahkuma Allahu wahuwa khayru alhakimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (O Muhammad) follow that which is inspired in thee, and forbear until Allah give judgment. And He is the Best of Judges.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Hud (Hud)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aliflamra kitabun ohkimat ayatuhu thumma fussilat min ladun hakeemin khabeerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Alif. Lam. Ra. (This is) a Scripture the revelations whereof are perfected and then expounded. (It cometh) from One Wise, Informed,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alla taAAbudoo illa Allaha innanee lakum minhu natheerun wabasheerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Saying): Serve none but Allah. Lo! I am unto you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waani istaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi yumattiAAkum mataAAan hasanan ila ajalin musamman wayuti kulla thee fadlin fadlahu wain tawallaw fainee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin kabeerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (bidding you): Ask pardon of your Lord and turn to Him repentant. He will cause you to enjoy a fair estate until a time appointed. He giveth His bounty unto every bountiful one. But if ye turn away, lo! (then) I fear for you the retribution of an awful Day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ila Allahi marjiAAukum wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Allah is your return, and He is Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ala innahum yathnoona sudoorahum liyastakhfoo minhu ala heena yastaghshoona thiyabahum yaAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! now they fold up their breasts that they may hide (their thoughts) from Him. At the very moment when they cover themselves with their clothing, Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden and that which they proclaim. Lo! He is Aware of what is in the breasts (of men).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama min dabbatin fee alardi illa AAala Allahi rizquha wayaAAlamu mustaqarraha wamustawdaAAaha kullun fee kitabin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And there is not a beast in the earth but the sustenance thereof dependeth on Allah. He knoweth its habitation and its repository. All is in a clear Record.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda fee sittati ayyamin wakana AAarshuhu AAala almai liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu AAamalan walain qulta innakum mabAAoothoona min baAAdi almawti layaqoolanna allatheena kafaroo in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days - and His Throne was upon the water - that He might try you, which of you is best in conduct. Yet if thou (O Muhammad) sayest: Lo! ye will be raised again after death! those who disbelieve will surely say: This is naught but mere magic.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walain akhkharna AAanhumu alAAathaba ila ommatin maAAdoodatin layaqoolunna ma yahbisuhu ala yawma yateehim laysa masroofan AAanhum wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if We delay for them the doom until a reckoned time, they will surely say: What withholdeth it? Verily on the day when it cometh unto them, it cannot be averted from them, and that which they derided will surround them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walain athaqna alinsana minna rahmatan thumma nazaAAnaha minhu innahu layaoosun kafoorun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if we cause man to taste some mercy from Us and afterward withdraw it from him, lo! he is despairing, thankless.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walain athaqnahu naAAmaa baAAda darraa massathu layaqoolanna thahaba alssayyiatu AAannee innahu lafarihun fakhoorun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if We cause him to taste grace after some misfortune that had befallen him, he saith: The ills have gone from me. Lo! he is exultant, boastful;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa allatheena sabaroo waAAamiloo alssalihati olaika lahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save those who persevere and do good works. Theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FalaAAallaka tarikun baAAda ma yooha ilayka wadaiqun bihi sadruka an yaqooloo lawla onzila AAalayhi kanzun aw jaa maAAahu malakun innama anta natheerun waAllahu AAala kulli shayin wakeelun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A likely thing, that thou wouldst forsake aught of that which hath been revealed unto thee, and that thy breast should be straitened for it, because they say: Why hath not a treasure been sent down for him, or an angel come with him? Thou art but a warner, and Allah is in charge of all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am yaqooloona iftarahu qul fatoo biAAashri suwarin mithlihi muftarayatin waodAAoo mani istataAAtum min dooni Allahi in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or they say: He hath invented it. Say: Then bring ten surahs, the like thereof, invented, and call on everyone ye can beside Allah, if ye are truthful!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fai llam yastajeeboo lakum faiAAlamoo annama onzila biAAilmi Allahi waan la ilaha illa huwa fahal antum muslimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if they answer not your prayer, then know that it is revealed only in the knowledge of Allah; and that there is no Allah save Him. Will ye then be (of) those who surrender?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man kana yureedu alhayata alddunya wazeenataha nuwaffi ilayhim aAAmalahum feeha wahum feeha la yubkhasoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whoso desireth the life of the world and its pomp, We shall repay them their deeds herein, and therein they will not be wronged.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika allatheena laysa lahum fee alakhirati illa alnnaru wahabita ma sanaAAoo feeha wabatilun ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those are they for whom is naught in the Hereafter save the Fire. (All) that they contrive here is vain and (all) that they are wont to do is fruitless.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaman kana AAala bayyinatin min rabbihi wayatloohu shahidun minhu wamin qablihi kitabu moosa imaman warahmatan olaika yuminoona bihi waman yakfur bihi mina alahzabi faalnnaru mawAAiduhu fala taku fee miryatin minhu innahu alhaqqu min rabbika walakinna akthara alnnasi la yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is he (to be counted equal with them) who relieth on a clear proof from his Lord, and a witness from Him reciteth it, and before it was the Book of Moses, an example and a mercy? Such believe therein, and whoso disbelieveth therein of the clans, the Fire is his appointed place. So be not thou in doubt concerning it. Lo! it is the Truth from thy Lord; but most of mankind believe not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman athlamu mimmani iftara AAala Allahi kathiban olaika yuAAradoona AAala rabbihim wayaqoolu alashhadu haolai allatheena kathaboo AAala rabbihim ala laAAnatu Allahi AAala alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who doeth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie concerning Allah? Such will be brought before their Lord, and the witnesses will say: These are they who lied concerning their Lord. Now the curse of Allah is upon wrong-doers,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yasuddoona AAan sabeeli Allahi wayabghoonaha AAiwajan wahum bialakhirati hum kafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who debar (men) from the way of Allah and would have it crooked, and who are disbelievers in the Hereafter.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika lam yakoonoo muAAjizeena fee alardi wama kana lahum min dooni Allahi min awliyaa yudaAAafu lahumu alAAathabu ma kanoo yastateeAAoona alssamAAa wama kanoo yubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such will not escape in the earth, nor have they any protecting friends beside Allah. For them the torment will be double. They could not bear to hear, and they used not to see.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika allatheena khasiroo anfusahum wadalla AAanhum ma kanoo yaftaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such are they who have lost their souls, and that which they used to invent hath failed them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La jarama annahum fee alakhirati humu alakhsaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Assuredly in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alsalihati waakhbatoo ila rabbihim olaika ashabu aljannati hum feeha khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who believe and do good works and humble themselves before their Lord: such are rightful owners of the Garden; they will abide therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Mathalu alfareeqayni kaalaAAma waalasammi waalbaseeri waalssameeAAi hal yastawiyani mathalan afala tathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The similitude of the two parties is as the blind and the deaf and the seer and the hearer. Are they equal in similitude? Will ye not then be admonished?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad arsalna noohan ila qawmihi innee lakum natheerun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We sent Noah unto his folk (and he said): Lo! I am a plain warner unto you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{An la taAAbudoo illa Allaha innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin aleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That ye serve none, save Allah. Lo! I fear for you the retribution of a painful Day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqala almalao allatheena kafaroo min qawmihi ma naraka illa basharan mithlana wama naraka ittabaAAaka illa allatheena hum arathiluna badiya alrrayi wama nara lakum AAalayna min fadlin bal nathunnukum kathibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved, said: We see thee but a mortal like us, and we see not that any follow thee save the most abject among us, without reflection. We behold in you no merit above us - nay, we deem you liars.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya qawmi araaytum in kuntu AAala bayyinatin min rabbee waatanee rahmatan min AAindihi faAAummiyat AAalaykum anulzimukumooha waantum laha karihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O my people! Bethink you, if I rely on a clear proof from my Lord and there hath come unto me a mercy from His presence, and it hath been made obscure to you, can we compel you to accept it when ye are averse thereto?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waya qawmi la asalukum AAalayhi malan in ajriya illa AAala Allahi wama ana bitaridi allatheena amanoo innahum mulaqoo rabbihim walakinnee arakum qawman tajhaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And O my people! I ask of you no wealth therefor. My reward is the concern only of Allah, and I am not going to thrust away those who believe - Lo! they have to meet their Lord! - but I see you a folk that are ignorant.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waya qawmi man yansurunee mina Allahi in taradtuhum afala tathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And, O my people! who would deliver me from Allah if I thrust them away? Will ye not then reflect?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala aqoolu lakum AAindee khazainu Allahi wala aAAlamu alghayba wala aqoolu innee malakun wala aqoolu lillatheena tazdaree aAAyunukum lan yutiyahumu Allahu khayran Allahu aAAlamu bima fee anfusihim innee ithan lamina alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} I say not unto you: "I have the treasures of Allah" nor "I have knowledge of the Unseen," nor say I: "Lo! I am an angel!" Nor say I unto those whom your eyes scorn that Allah will not give them good - Allah knoweth best what is in their hearts - Lo! then indeed I should be of the wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya noohu qad jadaltana faaktharta jidalana fatina bima taAAiduna in kunta mina alssadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: O Noah! Thou hast disputed with us and multiplied disputation with us; now bring upon us that wherewith thou threatenest us, if thou art of the truthful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala innama yateekum bihi Allahu in shaa wama antum bimuAAjizeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Only Allah will bring it upon you if He will, and ye can by no means escape.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala yanfaAAukum nushee in aradtu an ansaha lakum in kana Allahu yureedu an yughwiyakum huwa rabbukum wailayhi turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} My counsel will not profit you if I were minded to advise you, if Allah's will is to keep you astray. He is your Lord and unto Him ye will be brought back.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am yaqooloona iftarahu qul ini iftaraytuhu faAAalayya ijramee waana bareeon mimma tujrimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or say they (again): He hath invented it? Say: If I have invented it, upon me be my crimes, but I am innocent of (all) that ye commit.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waoohiya ila noohin annahu lan yumina min qawmika illa man qad amana fala tabtais bima kanoo yafAAaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And it was inspired in Noah, (saying): No-one of thy folk will believe save him who hath believed already. Be not distressed because of what they do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaisnaAAi alfulka biaAAyunina wawahyina wala tukhatibnee fee allatheena thalamoo innahum mughraqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Build the ship under Our eyes and by Our inspiration, and speak not unto Me on behalf of those who do wrong. Lo! they will be drowned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WayasnaAAu alfulka wakullama marra AAalayhi malaon min qawmihi sakhiroo minhu qala in taskharoo minna fainna naskharu minkum kama taskharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he was building the ship, and every time that chieftains of his people passed him, they made mock of him. He said: Though ye make mock of Us, yet We mock at you even as ye mock;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasawfa taAAlamoona man yateehi AAathabun yukhzeehi wayahillu AAalayhi AAathabun muqeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And ye shall know to whom a punishment that will confound him cometh, and upon whom a lasting doom will fall.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatta itha jaa amruna wafara alttannooru qulna ihmil feeha min kullin zawjayni ithnayni waahlaka illa man sabaqa AAalayhi alqawlu waman amana wama amana maAAahu illa qaleelun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Thus it was) till, when Our commandment came to pass and the oven gushed forth water, We said: Load therein two of every kind, a pair (the male and female), and thy household, save him against whom the word hath gone forth already, and those who believe. And but a few were they who believed with him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala irkaboo feeha bismi Allahi majraha wamursaha inna rabbee laghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he said: Embark therein! In the name of Allah be its course and its mooring. Lo! my Lord is Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahiya tajree bihim fee mawjin kaaljibali wanada noohunu ibnahu wakana fee maAAzilin ya bunayya irkab maAAana wala takun maAAa alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And it sailed with them amid waves like mountains, and Noah cried unto his son - and he was standing aloof - O my son! Come ride with us, and be not with the disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala saawee ila jabalin yaAAsimunee mina almai qala la AAasima alyawma min amri Allahi illa man rahima wahala baynahuma almawju fakana mina almughraqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: I shall betake me to some mountain that will save me from the water. (Noah) said: This day there is none that saveth from the commandment of Allah save him on whom He hath had mercy. And the wave came in between them, so he was among the drowned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqeela ya ardu iblaAAee maaki waya samao aqliAAee wagheeda almao waqudiya alamru waistawat AAala aljoodiyyi waqeela buAAdan lilqawmi alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And it was said: O earth! Swallow thy water and, O sky! be cleared of clouds! And the water was made to subside. And the commandment was fulfilled. And it (the ship) came to rest upon (the mount) Al-Judi and it was said: A far removal for wrongdoing folk!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanada noohun rabbahu faqala rabbi inna ibnee min ahlee wainna waAAdaka alhaqqu waanta ahkamu alhakimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Noah cried unto his Lord and said: My Lord! Lo! my son is of my household! Surely Thy promise is the truth and Thou are the Most Just of Judges.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya noohu innahu laysa min ahlika innahu AAamalun ghayru salihin fala tasalni ma laysa laka bihi AAilmun innee aAAithuka an takoona mina aljahileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O Noah! Lo! he is not of thy household; lo! he is of evil conduct, so ask not of Me that whereof thou hast no knowledge. I admonish thee lest thou be among the ignorant.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi innee aAAoothu bika an asalaka ma laysa lee bihi AAilmun wailla taghfir lee watarhamnee akun mina alkhasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! Lo! in Thee do I seek refuge (from the sin) that I should ask of Thee that whereof I have no knowledge. Unless Thou forgive me and have mercy on me I shall be among the lost.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qeela ya noohu ihbit bisalamin minna wabarakatin AAalayka waAAala omamin mimman maAAaka waomamun sanumattiAAuhum thumma yamassuhum minna AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It was said (unto him): O Noah! Go thou down (from the mountain) with peace from Us and blessings upon thee and some nations (that will spring) from those with thee. (There will be other) nations unto whom We shall give enjoyment a long while and then a painful doom from Us will overtake them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tilka min anbai alghaybi nooheeha ilayka ma kunta taAAlamuha anta wala qawmuka min qabli hatha faisbir inna alAAaqibata lilmuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is of the tidings of the Unseen which We inspire in thee (Muhammad). Thou thyself knewest it not, nor did thy folk (know it) before this. Then have patience. Lo! the sequel is for those who ward off (evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waila AAadin akhahum hoodan qala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu in antum illa muftaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto (the tribe of) A'ad (We sent) their brother, Hud. He said: O my people! Serve Allah! Ye have no other Allah save Him. Lo! ye do but invent.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya qawmi la asalukum AAalayhi ajran in ajriya illa AAala allathee fataranee afala taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O my people! I ask of you no reward for it. Lo! my reward is the concern only of Him Who made me. Have ye then no sense?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waya qawmi istaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi yursili alssamaa AAalaykum midraran wayazidkum quwwatan ila quwwatikum wala tatawallaw mujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And, O my people! Ask forgiveness of your Lord, then turn unto Him repentant; He will cause the sky to rain abundance on you and will add unto you strength to your strength. Turn not away, guilty!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya hoodu ma jitana bibayyinatin wama nahnu bitarikee alihatina AAan qawlika wama nahnu laka bimumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: O Hud! Thou hast brought us no clear proof and we are not going to forsake our gods on thy (mere) saying, and we are not believers in thee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In naqoolu illa iAAtaraka baAAdu alihatina bisooin qala innee oshhidu Allaha waishhadoo annee bareeon mimma tushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We say naught save that one of our gods hath possessed thee in an evil way. He said: I call Allah to witness, and do ye (too) bear witness, that I am innocent of (all) that ye ascribe as partners (to Allah)}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Min doonihi fakeedoonee jameeAAan thumma la tunthirooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Beside Him. So (try to) circumvent me, all of you, give me no respite.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innee tawakkaltu AAala Allahi rabbee warabbikum ma min dabbatin illa huwa akhithun binasiyatiha inna rabbee AAala siratin mustaqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! I have put my trust in Allah, my Lord and your Lord. Not an animal but He doth grasp it by the forelock! Lo! my Lord is on a straight path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain tawallaw faqad ablaghtukum ma orsiltu bihi ilaykum wayastakhlifu rabbee qawman ghayrakum wala tadurroonahu shayan inna rabbee AAala kulli shayin hafeethun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if ye turn away, still I have conveyed unto you that wherewith I was sent unto you, and my Lord will set in place of you a folk other than you. Ye cannot injure Him at all. Lo! my Lord is Guardian over all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma jaa amruna najjayna hoodan waallatheena amanoo maAAahu birahmatin minna wanajjaynahum min AAathabin ghaleethin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Our commandment came to pass We saved Hud and those who believed with him by a mercy from Us; We saved them from a harsh doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watilka AAadun jahadoo biayati rabbihim waAAasaw rusulahu waittabaAAoo amra kulli jabbarin AAaneedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And such were A'ad. They denied the revelations of their Lord and flouted His messengers and followed the command of every froward potentate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaotbiAAoo fee hathihi alddunya laAAnatan wayawma alqiyamati ala inna AAadan kafaroo rabbahum ala buAAdan liAAadin qawmi hoodin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And a curse was made to follow them in the world and on the Day of Resurrection. Lo! A'ad disbelieved in their Lord. A far removal for A'ad, the folk of Hud!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waila thamooda akhahum salihan qala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu huwa anshaakum mina alardi waistaAAmarakum feeha faistaghfiroohu thumma tooboo ilayhi inna rabbee qareebun mujeebun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto (the tribe of) Thamud (We sent) their brother Salih. He said: O my people! Serve Allah, Ye have no other Allah save Him. He brought you forth from the earth and hath made you husband it. So ask forgiveness of Him and turn unto Him repentant. Lo! my Lord is Nigh, Responsive.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya salihu qad kunta feena marjuwwan qabla hatha atanhana an naAAbuda ma yaAAbudu abaona wainnana lafee shakkin mimma tadAAoona ilayhi mureebun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: O Salih! Thou hast been among us hitherto as that wherein our hope was placed. Dost thou ask us not to worship what our fathers worshipped? Lo! we verily are in grave doubt concerning that to which thou callest us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya qawmi araaytum in kuntu AAala bayyinatin min rabbee waatanee minhu rahmatan faman yansurunee mina Allahi in AAasaytuhu fama tazeedoonanee ghayra takhseerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O my people! Bethink you: if I am (acting) on clear proof from my Lord and there hath come unto me a mercy from Him, who will save me from Allah if I disobey Him? Ye would add to me naught save perdition.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waya qawmi hathihi naqatu Allahi lakum ayatan fatharooha takul fee ardi Allahi wala tamassooha bisooin fayakhuthakum AAathabun qareebun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O my people! This is the camel of Allah, a token unto you, so suffer her to feed in Allah's earth, and touch her not with harm lest a near torment seize you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaAAaqarooha faqala tamattaAAoo fee darikum thalathata ayyamin thalika waAAdun ghayru makthoobin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But they hamstrung her, and then he said: Enjoy life in your dwelling-place three days! This is a threat that will not be belied.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jaa amruna najjayna salihan waallatheena amanoo maAAahu birahmatin minna wamin khizyi yawmiithin inna rabbaka huwa alqawiyyu alAAazeezu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So, when Our commandment came to pass, We saved Salih, and those who believed with him, by a mercy from Us, from the ignominy of that day. Lo, thy Lord! He is the Strong, the Mighty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waakhatha allatheena thalamoo alssayhatu faasbahoo fee diyarihim jathimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the (awful) Cry overtook those who did wrong, so that morning found them prostrate in their dwellings,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaan lam yaghnaw feeha ala inna thamooda kafaroo rabbahum ala buAAdan lithamooda}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As though they had not dwelt there. Lo! Thamud disbelieved in their Lord. A far removal for Thamud!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad jaat rusuluna ibraheema bialbushra qaloo salaman qala salamun fama labitha an jaa biAAijlin haneethin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Our messengers cam unto Abraham with good news. They said: Peace! He answered: Peace! and delayed not to bring a roasted calf.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma raa aydiyahum la tasilu ilayhi nakirahum waawjasa minhum kheefatan qaloo la takhaf inna orsilna ila qawmi lootin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when he saw their hands reached not to it, he mistrusted them and conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! Lo! we are sent unto the folk of Lot.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waimraatuhu qaimatun fadahikat fabashsharnaha biishaqa wamin warai ishaqa yaAAqooba}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And his wife, standing by laughed when We gave her good tidings (of the birth) of Isaac, and, after Isaac, of Jacob.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qalat ya waylata aalidu waana AAajoozun wahatha baAAlee shaykhan inna hatha lashayon AAajeebun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} She said: Oh woe is me! Shall I bear a child when I am an old woman, and this my husband is an old man? Lo! this is a strange thing!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ataAAjabeena min amri Allahi rahmatu Allahi wabarakatuhu AAalaykum ahla albayti innahu hameedun majeedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Wonderest thou at the commandment of Allah? The mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, O people of the house! Lo! He is Owner of Praise, Owner of Glory!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma thahaba AAan ibraheema alrrawAAu wajaathu albushra yujadiluna fee qawmi lootin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the awe departed from Abraham, and the glad news reached him, he pleaded with Us on behalf of the folk of Lot.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna ibraheema lahaleemun awwahun muneebun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Abraham was mild, imploring, penitent.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ibraheemu aAArid AAan hatha innahu qad jaa amru rabbika wainnahum ateehim AAathabun ghayru mardoodin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (It was said) O Abraham! Forsake this! Lo! thy Lord's commandment hath gone forth, and lo! there cometh unto them a doom which cannot be repelled.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma jaat rusuluna lootan seea bihim wadaqa bihim tharAAan waqala hatha yawmun AAaseebun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Our messengers came unto Lot, he was distressed and knew not how to protect them. He said: This is a distressful day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajaahu qawmuhu yuhraAAoona ilayhi wamin qablu kanoo yaAAmaloona alssayyiati qala ya qawmi haolai banatee hunna atharu lakum faittaqoo Allaha wala tukhzooni fee dayfee alaysa minkum rajulun rasheedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And his people came unto him, running towards him - and before then they used to commit abominations - He said: O my people! Here are my daughters! They are purer for you. Beware of Allah, and degrade me not in (the person of) my guests. Is there not among you any upright man?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo laqad AAalimta ma lana fee banatika min haqqin wainnaka lataAAlamu ma nureedu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Well thou knowest that we have no right to thy daughters, and well thou knowest what we want.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala law anna lee bikum quwwatan aw awee ila ruknin shadeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Would that I had strength to resist you or had some strong support (among you)!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya lootu inna rusulu rabbika lan yasiloo ilayka faasri biahlika biqitAAin mina allayli wala yaltafit minkum ahadun illa imraataka innahu museebuha ma asabahum inna mawAAidahumu alssubhu alaysa alssubhu biqareebin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (The messengers) said: O Lot! Lo! we are messengers of thy Lord; they shall not reach thee. So travel with thy people in a part of the night, and let not one of you turn round - (all) save thy wife. Lo! that which smiteth them will smite her (also). Lo! their tryst is (for) the morning. Is not the morning nigh?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jaa amruna jaAAalna AAaliyaha safilaha waamtarna AAalayha hijaratan min sijjeelin mandoodin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So when Our commandment came to pass We overthrew (that township) and rained upon it stones of clay, one after another,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Musawwamatan AAinda rabbika wama hiya mina alththalimeena bibaAAeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Marked with fire in the providence of thy Lord (for the destruction of the wicked). And they are never far from the wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waila madyana akhahum shuAAayban qala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu wala tanqusoo almikyala waalmeezana innee arakum bikhayrin wainnee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin muheetin}}
