\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto Midian (We sent) their brother Shu'eyb. He said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him! And give not short measure and short weight. Lo! I see you well-to-do, and lo! I fear for you the doom of a besetting Day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waya qawmi awfoo almikyala waalmeezana bialqisti wala tabkhasoo alnnasa ashyaahum wala taAAthaw fee alardi mufsideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O my people! Give full measure and full weight in justice, and wrong not people in respect of their goods. And do not evil in the earth, causing corruption.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Baqiyyatu Allahi khayrun lakum in kuntum mumineena wama ana AAalaykum bihafeethin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That which Allah leaveth with you is better for you if ye are believers; and I am not a keeper over you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya shuAAaybu asalatuka tamuruka an natruka ma yaAAbudu abaona aw an nafAAala fee amwalina ma nashao innaka laanta alhaleemu alrrasheedu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: O Shu'eyb! Doth thy way of prayer command thee that we should forsake that which our fathers (used to) worship, or that we (should leave off) doing what we will with our own property. Lo! thou art the mild, the guide to right behaviour.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya qawmi araaytum in kuntu AAala bayyinatin min rabbee warazaqanee minhu rizqan hasanan wama oreedu an okhalifakum ila ma anhakum AAanhu in oreedu illa alislaha ma istataAAtu wama tawfeeqee illa biAllahi AAalayhi tawakkaltu wailayhi oneebu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O my people! Bethink you: if I am (acting) on a clear proof from my Lord and He sustaineth me with fair sustenance from Him (how can I concede aught to you)? I desire not to do behind your backs that which I ask you not to do. I desire naught save reform so far as I am able. My welfare is only in Allah. In Him I trust and unto Him I turn (repentant).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waya qawmi la yajrimannakum shiqaqee an yuseebakum mithlu ma asaba qawma noohin aw qawma hoodin aw qawma salihin wama qawmu lootin minkum bibaAAeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And, O my people! Let not the schism with me cause you to sin so that there befall you that which befell the folk of Noah and the folk of Hud, and the folk of Salih; and the folk of Lot are not far off from you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waistaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi inna rabbee raheemun wadoodun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ask pardon of your Lord and then turn unto Him (repentant). Lo! my Lord is Merciful, Loving.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya shuAAaybu ma nafqahu katheeran mimma taqoolu wainna lanaraka feena daAAeefan walawla rahtuka larajamnaka wama anta AAalayna biAAazeezin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: O Shu'eyb! We understand not much of that thou tellest, and lo! we do behold thee weak among us. But for thy family, we should have stoned thee, for thou art not strong against us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya qawmi arahtee aAAazzu AAalaykum mina Allahi waittakhathtumoohu waraakum thihriyyan inna rabbee bima taAAmaloona muheetun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O my people! Is my family more to be honoured by you than Allah? and ye put Him behind you, neglected! Lo! my Lord surroundeth what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waya qawmi iAAmaloo AAala makanatikum innee AAamilun sawfa taAAlamoona man yateehi AAathabun yukhzeehi waman huwa kathibun wairtaqiboo inne maAAakum raqeebun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And, O my people! Act according to your power, lo! I (too) am acting. Ye will soon know on whom there cometh a doom that will abase him, and who it is that lieth. And watch! Lo! I am a watcher with you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma jaa amruna najjayna shuAAayban waallatheena amanoo maAAahu birahmatin minna waakhathati allatheena thalamoo alssayhatu faasbahoo fee diyarihim jathimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Our commandment came to pass We saved Shu'eyb and those who believed with him by a mercy from Us; and the (Awful) Cry seized those who did injustice, and morning found them prostrate in their dwellings,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaan lam yaghnaw feeha ala buAAdan limadyana kama baAAidat thamoodu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As though they had not dwelt there. A far removal for Midian, even as Thamud had been removed afar!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad arsalna moosa biayatina wasultanin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations and a clear warrant}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ila firAAawna wamalaihi faittabaAAoo amra firAAawna wama amru firAAawna birasheedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they did follow the command of Pharaoh, and the command of Pharaoh was no right guide.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yaqdumu qawmahu yawma alqiyamati faawradahumu alnnara wabisa alwirdu almawroodu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He will go before his people on the Day of Resurrection and will lead them to the Fire for watering-place. Ah, hapless is the watering-place (whither they are) led.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaotbiAAoo fee hathihi laAAnatan wayawma alqiyamati bisa alrrifdu almarfoodu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A curse is made to follow them in the world and on the Day of Resurrection. Hapless is the gift (that will be) given (them).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika min anbai alqura naqussuhu AAalayka minha qaimun wahaseedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That is (something) of the tidings of the townships (which were destroyed of old). We relate it unto thee (Muhammad). Some of them are standing and some (already) reaped.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama thalamnahum walakin thalamoo anfusahum fama aghnat AAanhum alihatuhumu allatee yadAAoona min dooni Allahi min shayin lamma jaa amru rabbika wama zadoohum ghayra tatbeebin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We wronged them not, but they did wrong themselves; and their gods on whom they call beside Allah availed them naught when came thy Lord's command; they added to them naught save ruin.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakathalika akhthu rabbika itha akhatha alqura wahiya thalimatun inna akhthahu aleemun shadeedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Even thus is the grasp of thy Lord when He graspeth the townships while they are doing wrong. Lo! His grasp is painful, very strong.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna fee thalika laayatan liman khafa AAathaba alakhirati thalika yawmun majmooAAun lahu alnnasu wathalika yawmun mashhoodun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! herein verily there is a portent for those who fear the doom of the Hereafter. That is a day unto which mankind will be gathered, and that is a day that will be witnessed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama nuakhkhiruhu illa liajalin maAAdoodin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We defer it only to a term already reckoned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma yati la takallamu nafsun illa biithnihi faminhum shaqiyyun wasaAAeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when it cometh no soul will speak except by His permission; some among them will be wretched, (others) glad.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faamma allatheena shaqoo fafee alnnari lahum feeha zafeerun washaheequn}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for those who will be wretched (on that day) they will be in the Fire; sighing and wailing will be their portion therein,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khalideena feeha ma damati alssamawatu waalardu illa ma shaa rabbuka inna rabbaka faAAAAalun lima yureedu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Abiding there so long as the heavens and the earth endure save for that which thy Lord willeth. Lo! thy Lord is Doer of what He will.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma allatheena suAAidoo fafee aljannati khalideena feeha ma damati alssamawatu waalardu illa ma shaa rabbuka AAataan ghayra majthoothin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And as for those who will be glad (that day) they will be in the Garden, abiding there so long as the heavens and the earth endure save for that which thy Lord willeth: a gift unfailing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala taku fee miryatin mimma yaAAbudu haolai ma yaAAbudoona illa kama yaAAbudu abaohum min qablu wainna lamuwaffoohum naseebahum ghayra manqoosin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So be not thou in doubt concerning that which these (folk) worship. They worship only as their fathers worshipped aforetime. Lo! we shall pay them their whole due unabated.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba faikhtulifa feehi walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laqudiya baynahum wainnahum lafee shakkin minhu mureebun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And we verily gave unto Moses the Scripture, and there was strife thereupon; and had it not been for a Word that had already gone forth from thy Lord, the case would have been judged between them, and lo! they are in grave doubt concerning it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna kullan lamma layuwaffiyannahum rabbuka aAAmalahum innahu bima yaAAmaloona khabeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! unto each thy Lord will verily repay his works in full. Lo! He is Informed of what they do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][112]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faistaqim kama omirta waman taba maAAaka wala tatghaw innahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So tread thou the straight path as thou art commanded, and those who turn (unto Allah) with thee, and transgress not. Lo! He is Seer of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][113]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tarkanoo ila allatheena thalamoo fatamassakumu alnnaru wama lakum min dooni Allahi min awliyaa thumma la tunsaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And incline not toward those who do wrong lest the Fire touch you, and ye have no protecting friends against Allah, and afterward ye would not be helped.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][114]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaqimi alssalata tarafayi alnnahari wazulafan mina allayli inna alhasanati yuthhibna alssayyiati thalika thikra lilththakireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Establish worship at the two ends of the day and in some watches of the night. Lo! good deeds annul ill-deeds. This is reminder for the mindful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][115]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waisbir fainna Allaha la yudeeAAu ajra almuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And have patience, (O Muhammad), for lo! Allah loseth not the wages of the good.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][116]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falawla kana mina alqurooni min qablikum oloo baqiyyatin yanhawna AAani alfasadi fee alardi illa qaleelan mimman anjayna minhum waittabaAAa allatheena thalamoo ma otrifoo feehi wakanoo mujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If only there had been among the generations before you men possessing a remnant (of good sense) to warn (their people) from corruption in the earth, as did a few of those whom We saved from them! The wrong-doers followed that by which they were made sapless, and were guilty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][117]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama kana rabbuka liyuhlika alqura bithulmin waahluha muslihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In truth thy Lord destroyed not the townships tyrannously while their folk were doing right.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][118]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw shaa rabbuka lajaAAala alnnasa ommatan wahidatan wala yazaloona mukhtalifeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if thy Lord had willed, He verily would have made mankind one nation, yet they cease not differing,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][119]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa man rahima rabbuka walithalika khalaqahum watammat kalimatu rabbika laamlaanna jahannama mina aljinnati waalnnasi ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save him on whom thy Lord hath mercy; and for that He did create them. And the Word of thy Lord hath been fulfilled: Verily I shall fill hell with the jinn and mankind together.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][120]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakullan naqussu AAalayka min anbai alrrusuli ma nuthabbitu bihi fuadaka wajaaka fee hathihi alhaqqu wamawAAithatun wathikra lilmumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And all that We relate unto thee of the story of the messengers is in order that thereby We may make firm thy heart. And herein hath come unto thee the Truth and an exhortation and a reminder for believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][121]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqul lillatheena la yuminoona iAAmaloo AAala makanatikum inna AAamiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And say unto those who believe not: Act according to your power. Lo! We (too) are acting.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][122]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waintathiroo inna muntathiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And wait! Lo! We (too) are waiting.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[11][123]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walillahi ghaybu alssamawati waalardi wailayhi yurjaAAu alamru kulluhu faoAAbudhu watawakkal AAalayhi wama rabbuka bighafilin AAamma taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah's is the Invisible of the heavens and the earth, and unto Him the whole matter will be returned. So worship Him and put thy trust in Him. Lo! thy Lord is not unaware of what ye (mortals) do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Yusuf (Joseph)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aliflamra tilka ayatu alkitabi almubeenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verse of the Scripture that maketh plain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna anzalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan laAAallakum taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have revealed it, a Lecture in Arabic, that ye may understand.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Nahnu naqussu AAalayka ahsana alqasasi bima awhayna ilayka hatha alqurana wain kunta min qablihi lamina alghafileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We narrate unto thee (Muhammad) the best of narratives in that We have inspired in thee this Qur'an, though aforetime thou wast of the heedless.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith qala yoosufu liabeehi ya abati innee raaytu ahada AAashara kawkaban waalshshamsa waalqamara raaytuhum lee sajideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When Joseph said unto his father: O my father! Lo! I saw in a dream eleven planets and the sun and the moon, I saw them prostrating themselves unto me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya bunayya la taqsus ruyaka AAala ikhwatika fayakeedoo laka kaydan inna alshshaytana lilinsani AAaduwwun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O my dear son! Tell not thy brethren of thy vision, lest they plot a plot against thee. Lo! Satan is for man an open foe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakathalika yajtabeeka rabbuka wayuAAallimuka min taweeli alahadeethi wayutimmu niAAmatahu AAalayka waAAala ali yaAAqooba kama atammaha AAala abawayka min qablu ibraheema waishaqa inna rabbaka AAaleemun hakeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus thy Lord will prefer thee and will teach thee the interpretation of events, and will perfect His grace upon thee and upon the family of Jacob as He perfected it upon thy forefathers, Abraham and Isaac. Lo! thy Lord is Knower, Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad kana fee yoosufa waikhwatihi ayatun lilssaileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Verily in Joseph and his brethren are signs (of Allah's Sovereignty) for the inquiring.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith qaloo layoosufu waakhoohu ahabbu ila abeena minna wanahnu AAusbatun inna abana lafee dalalin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When they said: Verily Joseph and his brother are dearer to our father than we are, many though we be. Lo! our father is in plain aberration.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Oqtuloo yoosufa awi itrahoohu ardan yakhlu lakum wajhu abeekum watakoonoo min baAAdihi qawman saliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (One said): Kill Joseph or cast him to some (other) land, so that your father's favour may be all for you, and (that) ye may afterward be righteous folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala qailun minhum la taqtuloo yoosufa waalqoohu fee ghayabati aljubbi yaltaqithu baAAdu alssayyarati in kuntum faAAileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} One among them said: Kill not Joseph but, if ye must be doing, fling him into the depth of the pit; some caravan will find him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya abana ma laka la tamanna AAala yoosufa wainna lahu lanasihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: O our father! Why wilt thou not trust us with Joseph, when lo! we are good friends to him?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Arsilhu maAAana ghadan yartaAA wayalAAab wainna lahu lahafithoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Send him with us to-morrow that he may enjoy himself and play. And lo! we shall take good care of him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala innee layahzununee an thathhaboo bihi waakhafu an yakulahu alththibu waantum AAanhu ghafiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Lo! in truth it saddens me that ye should take him with you, and I fear less the wolf devour him while ye are heedless of him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo lain akalahu alththibu wanahnu AAusbatun inna ithan lakhasiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: If the wolf should devour him when we are (so strong) a band, then surely we should have already perished.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma thahaboo bihi waajmaAAoo an yajAAaloohu fee ghayabati aljubbi waawhayna ilayhi latunabiannahum biamrihim hatha wahum la yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, when they led him off, and were of one mind that they should place him in the depth of the pit, We inspired in him: Thou wilt tell them of this deed of theirs when they know (thee) not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajaoo abahum AAishaan yabkoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they came weeping to their father in the evening.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya abana inna thahabna nastabiqu watarakna yoosufa AAinda mataAAina faakalahu alththibu wama anta bimuminin lana walaw kunna sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Saying: O our father! We went racing one with another, and left Joseph by our things, and the wolf devoured him, and thou believest not our saying even when we speak the truth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajaoo AAala qameesihi bidamin kathibin qala bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran fasabrun jameelun waAllahu almustaAAanu AAala ma tasifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they came with false blood on his shirt. He said: Nay, but your minds have beguiled you into something. (My course is) comely patience. And Allah it is Whose help is to be sought in that (predicament) which ye describe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajaat sayyaratun faarsaloo waridahum faadla dalwahu qala ya bushra hatha ghulamun waasarroohu bidaAAatan waAllahu AAaleemun bima yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And there came a caravan, and they sent their waterdrawer. He let down his pail (into the pit). He said: Good luck! Here is a youth. And they hid him as a treasure, and Allah was Aware of what they did.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Washarawhu bithamanin bakhsin darahima maAAdoodatin wakanoo feehi mina alzzahideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they sold him for a low price, a number of silver coins; and they attached no value to him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allathee ishtarahu min misra liimraatihi akrimee mathwahu AAasa an yanfaAAana aw nattakhithahu waladan wakathalika makkanna liyoosufa fee alardi walinuAAallimahu min taweeli alahadeethi waAllahu ghalibun AAala amrihi walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he of Egypt who purchased him said unto his wife: Receive him honourably. Perchance he may prove useful to us or we may adopt him as a son. Thus we established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events. And Allah was predominant in His career, but most of mankind know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma balagha ashuddahu ataynahu hukman waAAilman wakathalika najzee almuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And And when he reached his prime We gave him wisdom and knowledge. Thus We reward the good.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Warawadathu allatee huwa fee baytiha AAan nafsihi waghallaqati alabwaba waqalat hayta laka qala maAAatha Allahi innahu rabbee ahsana mathwaya innahu la yuflihu alththalimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And she, in whose house he was, asked of him an evil act. She bolted the doors and said: Come! He said: I seek refuge in Allah! Lo! he is my lord, who hath treated me honourably. Lo! wrong-doers never prosper.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad hammat bihi wahamma biha lawla an raa burhana rabbihi kathalika linasrifa AAanhu alssooa waalfahshaa innahu min AAibadina almukhlaseena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} She verily desired him, and he would have desired her if it had not been that he saw the argument of his Lord. Thus it was, that We might ward off from him evil and lewdness. Lo! he was of Our chosen slaves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waistabaqa albaba waqaddat qameesahu min duburin waalfaya sayyidaha lada albabi qalat ma jazao man arada biahlika sooan illa an yusjana aw AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they raced with one another to the door, and she tore his shirt from behind, and they met her lord and master at the door. She said: What shall be his reward, who wisheth evil to thy folk, save prison or a painful doom?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala hiya rawadatnee AAan nafsee washahida shahidun min ahliha in kana qameesuhu qudda min qubulin fasadaqat wahuwa mina alkathibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Joseph) said: She it was who asked of me an evil act. And a witness of her own folk testified: If his shirt is torn from before, then she speaketh truth and he is of the liars.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain kana qameesuhu qudda min duburin fakathabat wahuwa mina alssadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if his shirt is torn from behind, then she hath lied and he is of the truthful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma raa qameesahu qudda min duburin qala innahu min kaydikunna inna kaydakunna AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So when he saw his shirt torn from behind, he said: Lo! this is of the guile of you women. Lo! the guile of you is very great.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yoosufu aAArid AAan hatha waistaghfiree lithanbiki innaki kunti mina alkhatieena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Joseph! Turn away from this, and thou, (O woman), ask forgiveness for thy sin. Lo! thou art of the faulty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala niswatun fee almadeenati imraatu alAAazeezi turawidu fataha AAan nafsihi qad shaghafaha hubban inna lanaraha fee dalalin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And women in the city said: The ruler's wife is asking of her slave-boy an ill-deed. Indeed he has smitten her to the heart with love. We behold her in plain aberration.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma samiAAat bimakrihinna arsalat ilayhinna waaAAtadat lahunna muttakaan waatat kulla wahidatin minhunna sikkeenan waqalati okhruj AAalayhinna falamma raaynahu akbarnahu waqattaAAna aydiyahunna waqulna hasha lillahi ma hatha basharan in hatha illa malakun kareemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when she heard of their sly talk, she sent to them and prepared for them a cushioned couch (to lie on at the feast) and gave to every one of them a knife and said (to Joseph): Come out unto them! And when they saw him they exalted him and cut their hands, exclaiming: Allah Blameless! This is no a human being. This is not other than some gracious angel.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qalat fathalikunna allathee lumtunnanee feehi walaqad rawadtuhu AAan nafsihi faistAAsama walain lam yafAAal ma amuruhu layusjananna walayakoonan mina alssaghireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} She said: This is he on whose account ye blamed me. I asked of him an evil act, but he proved continent, but if he do not my behest he verily shall be imprisoned, and verily shall be of those brought low.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi alssijnu ahabbu ilayya mimma yadAAoonanee ilayhi wailla tasrif AAannee kaydahunna asbu ilayhinna waakun mina aljahileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O my Lord! Prison is more dear than that unto which they urge me, and if Thou fend not off their wiles from me I shall incline unto them and become of the foolish.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faistajaba lahu rabbuhu fasarafa AAanhu kaydahunna innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So his Lord heard his prayer and fended off their wiles from him. Lo! He is Hearer, Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma bada lahum min baAAdi ma raawoo alayati layasjununnahu hatta heenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And it seemed good to them (the men-folk) after they had seen the signs (of his innocence) to imprison him for a time.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wadakhala maAAahu alssijna fatayani qala ahaduhuma innee aranee aAAsiru khamran waqala alakharu innee aranee ahmilu fawqa rasee khubzan takulu alttayru minhu nabbina bitaweelihi inna naraka mina almuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And two young men went to prison with him. One of them said: I dreamed that I was pressing wine. The other said: I dreamed that I was carrying upon my head bread whereof the birds were eating. Announce unto us the interpretation, for we see thee of those good (at interpretation).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala la yateekuma taAAamun turzaqanihi illa nabbatukuma bitaweelihi qabla an yatiyakuma thalikuma mimma AAallamanee rabbee innee taraktu millata qawmin la yuminoona biAllahi wahum bialakhirati hum kafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: The food which ye are given (daily) shall not come unto you but I shall tell you the interpretation ere it cometh unto you. This is of that which my Lord hath taught me. Lo! I have forsaken the religion of folk who believe not in Allah and are disbelievers in the Hereafter.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaittabaAAtu millata abaee ibraheema waishaqa wayaAAqooba ma kana lana an nushrika biAllahi min shayin thalika min fadli Allahi AAalayna waAAala alnnasi walakinna akthara alnnasi la yashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And I have followed the religion of my fathers, Abraham and Isaac and Jacob. It never was for us to attribute aught as partner to Allah. This is of the bounty of Allah unto us (the seed of Abraham) and unto mankind; but most men give not thanks.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya sahibayi alssijni aarbabun mutafarriqoona khayrun ami Allahu alwahidu alqahharu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O my fellow-prisoners! Are divers lords better, or Allah the One, Almighty?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma taAAbudoona min doonihi illa asmaan sammaytumooha antum waabaokum ma anzala Allahu biha min sultanin ini alhukmu illa lillahi amara alla taAAbudoo illa iyyahu thalika alddeenu alqayyimu walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those whom ye worship beside Him are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers. Allah hath revealed no sanction for them. The decision rests with Allah only, Who hath commanded you that ye worship none save Him. This is the right religion, but most men know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya sahibayi alssijni amma ahadukuma fayasqee rabbahu khamran waamma alakharu fayuslabu fatakulu alttayru min rasihi qudiya alamru allathee feehi tastaftiyani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O my two fellow-prisoners! As for one of you, he will pour out wine for his lord to drink; and as for the other, he will be crucified so that the birds will eat from his head. Thus is the case judged concerning which ye did inquire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala lillathee thanna annahu najin minhuma othkurnee AAinda rabbika faansahu alshshaytanu thikra rabbihi falabitha fee alssijni bidAAa sineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he said unto him of the twain who he knew would be released: Mention me in the presence of thy lord. But Satan caused him to forget to mention it to his lord, so he (Joseph) stayed in prison for some years.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala almaliku innee ara sabAAa baqaratin simanin yakuluhunna sabAAun AAijafun wasabAAa sunbulatin khudrin waokhara yabisatin ya ayyuha almalao aftoonee fee ruyaya in kuntum lilrruya taAAburoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the king said: Lo! I saw in a dream seven fat kine which seven lean were eating, and seven green ears of corn and other (seven) dry. O notables! Expound for me my vision, if ye can interpret dreams.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo adghathu ahlamin wama nahnu bitaweeli alahlami biAAalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They answered: Jumbled dreams! And we are not knowing in the interpretation of dreams.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allathee naja minhuma waiddakara baAAda ommatin ana onabbiokum bitaweelihi faarsilooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he of the two who was released, and (now) at length remembered, said: I am going to announce unto you the interpretation, therefore send me forth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yoosufu ayyuha alssiddeequ aftina fee sabAAi baqaratin simanin yakuluhunna sabAAun AAijafun wasabAAi sunbulatin khudrin waokhara yabisatin laAAallee arjiAAu ila alnnasi laAAallahum yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And when he came to Joseph in the prison, he exclaimed): Joseph! O thou truthful one! Expound for us the seven fat kine which seven lean were eating and the seven green ears of corn and other (seven) dry, that I may return unto the people, so that they may know.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala tazraAAoona sabAAa sineena daaban fama hasadtum fatharoohu fee sunbulihi illa qaleelan mimma takuloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Ye shall sow seven years as usual, but that which ye reap, leave it in the ear, all save a little which ye eat.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma yatee min baAAdi thalika sabAAun shidadun yakulna ma qaddamtum lahunna illa qaleelan mimma tuhsinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then after that will come seven hard years which will devour all that ye have prepared for them, save a little of that which ye have stored.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma yatee min baAAdi thalika AAamun feehi yughathu alnnasu wafeehi yaAAsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, after that, will come a year when the people will have plenteous crops and when they will press (wine and oil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala almaliku itoonee bihi falamma jaahu alrrasoolu qala irjiAA ila rabbika faisalhu ma balu alnniswati allatee qattaAAna aydiyahunna inna rabbee bikaydihinna AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the king said: Bring him unto me. And when the messenger came unto him, he (Joseph) said: Return unto thy lord and ask him what was the case of the women who cut their hands. Lo! my Lord knoweth their guile.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ma khatbukunna ith rawadtunna yoosufa AAan nafsihi qulna hasha lillahi ma AAalimna AAalayhi min sooin qalati imraatu alAAazeezi alana hashasa alhaqqu ana rawadtuhu AAan nafsihi wainnahu lamina alssadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He (the king) (then sent for those women and) said: What happened when ye asked an evil act of Joseph? They answered: Allah Blameless! We know no evil of him. Said the wife of the ruler: Now the truth is out. I asked of him an evil act, and he is surely of the truthful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika liyaAAlama annee lam akhunhu bialghaybi waanna Allaha la yahdee kayda alkhaineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Then Joseph said: I asked for) this, that he (my lord) may know that I betrayed him not in secret, and that surely Allah guideth not the snare of the betrayers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama obarrio nafsee inna alnnafsa laammaratun bialssooi illa ma rahima rabbee inna rabbee ghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} I do not exculpate myself. Lo! the (human) soul enjoineth unto evil, save that whereon my Lord hath mercy. Lo! my Lord is Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala almaliku itoonee bihi astakhlishu linafsee falamma kallamahu qala innaka alyawma ladayna makeenun ameenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the king said: Bring him unto me that I may attach him to my person. And when he had talked with him he said: Lo! thou art to-day in our presence established and trusted.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ijAAalnee AAala khazaini alardi innee hafeethun AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Set me over the storehouses of the land. Lo! I am a skilled custodian.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakathalika makanna liyoosufa fee alardi yatabawwao minha haythu yashao nuseebu birahmatina man nashao wala nudeeAAu ajra almuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus gave We power to Joseph in the land. He was the owner of it where he pleased. We reach with Our mercy whom We will. We lose not the reward of the good.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaajru alakhirati khayrun lillatheena amanoo wakanoo yattaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the reward of the Hereafter is better, for those who believe and ward off (evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajaa ikhwatu yoosufa fadakhaloo AAalayhi faAAarafahum wahum lahu munkiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Joseph's brethren came and presented themselves before him, and he knew them but they knew him not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma jahhazahum bijahazihim qala itoonee biakhin lakum min abeekum ala tarawna annee oofee alkayla waana khayru almunzileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when he provided them with their provision he said: Bring unto me a brother of yours from your father. See ye not that I fill up the measure and I am the best of hosts?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain lam tatoonee bihi fala kayla lakum AAindee wala taqrabooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if ye bring him not unto me, then there shall be no measure for you with me, nor shall ye draw near.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo sanurawidu AAanhu abahu wainna lafaAAiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: We will try to win him from his father: that we will surely do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala lifityanihi ijAAaloo bidaAAatahum fee rihalihim laAAallahum yaAArifoonaha itha inqalaboo ila ahlihim laAAallahum yarjiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said unto his young men: Place their merchandise in their saddlebags, so that they may know it when they go back to their folk, and so will come again.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma rajaAAoo ila abeehim qaloo ya abana muniAAa minna alkaylu faarsil maAAana akhana naktal wainna lahu lahafithoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So when they went back to their father they said: O our father! The measure is denied us, so send with us our brother that we may obtain the measure, surely we will guard him well.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala hal amanukum AAalayhi illa kama amintukum AAala akheehi min qablu faAllahu khayrun hafithan wahuwa arhamu alrrahimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Can I entrust him to you save as I entrusted his brother to you aforetime? Allah is better at guarding, and He is the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma fatahoo mataAAahum wajadoo bidaAAatahum ruddat ilayhim qaloo ya abana ma nabghee hathihi bidaAAatuna ruddat ilayna wanameeru ahlana wanahfathu akhana wanazdadu kayla baAAeerin thalika kaylun yaseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they opened their belongings they discovered that their merchandise had been returned to them. They said: O our father! What (more) can we ask? Here is our merchandise returned to us. We shall get provision for our folk and guard our brother, and we shall have the extra measure of a camel (load). This (that we bring now) is a light measure.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala lan orsilahu maAAakum hatta tutooni mawthiqan mina Allahi latatunnanee bihi illa an yuhata bikum falamma atawhu mawthiqahum qala Allahu AAala ma naqoolu wakeelun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: I will not send him with you till ye give me an undertaking in the name of Allah that ye will bring him back to me, unless ye are surrounded. And when they gave him their undertaking he said: Allah is the Warden over what we say.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala ya baniyya la tadkhuloo min babin wahidin waodkhuloo min abwabin mutafarriqatin wama oghnee AAankum mina Allahi min shayin ini alhukmu illa lillahi AAalayhi tawakkaltu waAAalayhi falyatawakkali almutawakkiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he said: O my sons! Go not in by one gate; go in by different gates. I can naught avail you as against Allah. Lo! the decision rests with Allah only. In Him do I put my trust, and in Him let all the trusting put their trust.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma dakhaloo min haythu amarahum aboohum ma kana yughnee AAanhum mina Allahi min shayin illa hajatan fee nafsi yaAAqooba qadaha wainnahu lathoo AAilmin lima AAallamnahu walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they entered in the manner which their father had enjoined, it would have naught availed them as against Allah; it was but a need of Jacob's soul which he thus satisfied; and lo! he was a lord of knowledge because We had taught him; but most of mankind know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma dakhaloo AAala yoosufa awa ilayhi akhahu qala innee ana akhooka fala tabtais bima kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they went in before Joseph, he took his brother unto him, saying: Lo! I, even I, am thy brother, therefore sorrow not for what they did.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jahhazahum bijahazihim jaAAala alssiqayata fee rahli akheehi thumma aththana muaththinun ayyatuha alAAeeru innakum lasariqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when he provided them with their provision, he put the drinking-cup in his brother's saddlebag, and then a crier cried: O camel-riders! Lo! ye are surely thieves!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo waaqbaloo AAalayhim matha tafqidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They cried, coming toward them: What is it ye have lost?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo nafqidu suwaAAa almaliki waliman jaa bihi himlu baAAeerin waana bihi zaAAeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: We have lost the king's cup, and he who bringeth it shall have a camel-load, and I (said Joseph) am answerable for it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo taAllahi laqad AAalimtum ma jina linufsida fee alardi wama kunna sariqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: By Allah, well ye know we came not to do evil in the land, and are no thieves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo fama jazaohu in kuntum kathibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: And what shall be the penalty for it, if ye prove liars?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo jazaohu man wujida fee rahlihi fahuwa jazaohu kathalika najzee alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: The penalty for it! He in whose bag (the cup) is found, he is the penalty for it. Thus we requite wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fabadaa biawAAiyatihim qabla wiAAai akheehi thumma istakhrajaha min wiAAai akheehi kathalika kidna liyoosufa ma kana liyakhutha akhahu fee deeni almaliki illa an yashaa Allahu narfaAAu darajatin man nashao wafawqa kulli thee AAilmin AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then he (Joseph) began the search with their bags before his brother's bag, then he produced it from his brother's bag. Thus did We contrive for Joseph. He could not have taken his brother according to the king's law unless Allah willed. We raise by grades (of mercy) whom We will, and over every lord of knowledge there is one more knowing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo in yasriq faqad saraqa akhun lahu min qablu faasarraha yoosufu fee nafsihi walam yubdiha lahum qala antum sharrun makanan waAllahu aAAlamu bima tasifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: If he stealeth, a brother of his stole before. But Joseph kept it secret in his soul and revealed it not unto them. He said (within himself): Ye are in worse case, and Allah knoweth best (the truth of) that which ye allege.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya ayyuha alAAazeezu inna lahu aban shaykhan kabeeran fakhuth ahadana makanahu inna naraka mina almuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: O ruler of the land! Lo! he hath a very aged father, so take one of us instead of him. Lo! we behold thee of those who do kindness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala maAAatha Allahi an nakhutha illa man wajadna mataAAana AAindahu inna ithan lathalimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Allah forbid that we should seize save him with whom we found our property; then truly we should be wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma istayasoo minhu khalasoo najiyyan qala kabeeruhum alam taAAlamoo anna abakum qad akhatha AAalaykum mawthiqan mina Allahi wamin qablu ma farrattum fee yoosufa falan abraha alarda hatta yathana lee abee aw yahkuma Allahu lee wahuwa khayru alhakimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So, When they despaired of (moving) him, they conferred together apart. The eldest of them said: Know ye not how your father took an undertaking from you in Allah's name and how ye failed in the case of Joseph aforetime? Therefore I shall not go forth from the land until my father giveth leave or Allah judgeth for me. He is the Best of Judges.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{IrjiAAoo ila abeekum faqooloo ya abana inna ibnaka saraqa wama shahidna illa bima AAalimna wama kunna lilghaybi hafitheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Return unto your father and say: O our father! Lo! thy son hath stolen. We testify only to that which we know; we are not guardians of the Unseen.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waisali alqaryata allatee kunna feeha waalAAeera allatee aqbalna feeha wainna lasadiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ask the township where we were, and the caravan with which we travelled hither. Lo! we speak the truth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran fasabrun jameelun AAasa Allahu an yatiyanee bihim jameeAAan innahu huwa alAAaleemu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And when they came unto their father and had spoken thus to him) he said: Nay, but your minds have beguiled you into something. (My course is) comely patience! It may be that Allah will bring them all unto me. Lo! He, only He, is the Knower, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watawalla AAanhum waqala ya asafa AAala yoosufa waibyaddat AAaynahu mina alhuzni fahuwa katheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he turned away from them and said: Alas, my grief for Joseph! And his eyes were whitened with the sorrow that he was suppressing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo taAllahi taftao tathkuru yoosufa hatta takoona haradan aw takoona mina alhalikeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: By Allah, thou wilt never cease remembering Joseph till thy health is ruined or thou art of those who perish!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala innama ashkoo baththee wahuznee ila Allahi waaAAlamu mina Allahi ma la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: I expose my distress and anguish only unto Allah, and I know from Allah that which ye know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya baniyya ithhaboo fatahassasoo min yoosufa waakheehi wala tayasoo min rawhi Allahi innahu la yayasu min rawhi Allahi illa alqawmu alkafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Go, O my sons, and ascertain concerning Joseph and his brother, and despair not of the Spirit of Allah. Lo! none despaireth of the Spirit of Allah save disbelieving folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma dakhaloo AAalayhi qaloo ya ayyuha alAAazeezu massana waahlana alddurru wajina bibidaAAatin muzjatin faawfi lana alkayla watasaddaq AAalayna inna Allaha yajzee almutasaddiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they came (again) before him (Joseph) they said: O ruler! Misfortune hath touched us and our folk, and we bring but poor merchandise, so fill for us the measure and be charitable unto us. Lo! Allah will requite the charitable,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala hal AAalimtum ma faAAaltum biyoosufa waakheehi ith antum jahiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Know ye what ye did unto Joseph and his brother in your ignorance?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ainnaka laanta yoosufa qala ana yoosufu wahatha akhee qad manna Allahu AAalayna innahu man yattaqi wayasbir fainna Allaha la yudeeAAu ajra almuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Is it indeed thou who art Joseph? He said: I am Joseph and this is my brother. Allah hath shown us favour. Lo! he who wardeth off (evil) and endureth (findeth favour); for lo! Allah loseth not the wages of the kindly.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo taAllahi laqad atharaka Allahu AAalayna wain kunna lakhatieena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: By Allah, verily Allah hath preferred thee above us, and we were indeed sinful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala la tathreeba AAalaykumu alyawma yaghfiru Allahu lakum wahuwa arhamu alrrahimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Have no fear this day! May Allah forgive you, and He is the Most Merciful of those who show mercy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ithhaboo biqameesee hatha faalqoohu AAala wajhi abee yati baseeran watoonee biahlikum ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Go with this shirt of mine and lay it on my father's face, he will become (again) a seer; and come to me with all your folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma fasalati alAAeeru qala aboohum innee laajidu reeha yoosufa lawla an tufannidooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When the caravan departed their father had said: Truly I am conscious of the breath of Joseph, though ye call me dotard.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo taAllahi innaka lafee dalalika alqadeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Those around him) said: By Allah, lo! thou art in thine old aberration.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma an jaa albasheeru alqahu AAala wajhihi fairtadda baseeran qala alam aqul lakum innee aAAlamu mina Allahi ma la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, when the bearer of glad tidings came, he laid it on his face and he became a seer once more. He said: Said I not unto you that I know from Allah that which ye know not?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya abana istaghfir lana thunoobana inna kunna khatieena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: O our father! Ask forgiveness of our sins for us, for lo! we were sinful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala sawfa astaghfiru lakum rabbee innahu huwa alghafooru alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: I shall ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Lo! He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma dakhaloo AAala yoosufa awa ilayhi abawayhi waqala odkhuloo misra in shaa Allahu amineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they came in before Joseph, he took his parents unto him, and said: Come into Egypt safe, if Allah will!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WarafaAAa abawayhi AAala alAAarshi wakharroo lahu sujjadan waqala ya abati hatha taweelu ruyaya min qablu qad jaAAalaha rabbee haqqan waqad ahsana bee ith akhrajanee mina alssijni wajaa bikum mina albadwi min baAAdi an nazagha alshshaytanu baynee wabayna ikhwatee inna rabbee lateefun lima yashao innahu huwa alAAaleemu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he placed his parents on the dais and they fell down before him prostrate, and he said: O my father! This is the interpretation of my dream of old. My Lord hath made it true, and He hath shown me kindness, since He took me out of the prison and hath brought you from the desert after Satan had made strife between me and my brethren. Lo! my Lord is tender unto whom He will. He is the Knower, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbi qad ataytanee mina almulki waAAallamtanee min taweeli alahadeethi fatira alssamawati waalardi anta waliyyee fee alddunya waalakhirati tawaffanee musliman waalhiqnee bialssaliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O my Lord! Thou hast given me (something) of sovereignty and hast taught me (something) of the interpretation of events - Creator of the heavens and the earth! Thou art my Protecting Guardian in the world and the Hereafter. Make me to die muslim (unto Thee), and join me to the righteous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika min anbai alghaybi nooheehi ilayka wama kunta ladayhim ith ajmaAAoo amrahum wahum yamkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is of the tidings of the Unseen which We inspire in thee (Muhammad). Thou wast not present with them when they fixed their plan and they were scheming.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama aktharu alnnasi walaw harasta bimumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And though thou try much, most men will not believe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama tasaluhum AAalayhi min ajrin in huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thou askest them no fee for it. It is naught else than a reminder unto the peoples.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakaayyin min ayatin fee alssamawati waalardi yamurroona AAalayha wahum AAanha muAAridoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How many a portent is there in the heavens and the earth which they pass by with face averted!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yuminu aktharuhum biAllahi illa wahum mushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And most of them believe not in Allah except that they attribute partners (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaaminoo an tatiyahum ghashiyatun min AAathabi Allahi aw tatiyahumu alssaAAatu baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Deem they themselves secure from the coming on them of a pall of Allah's punishment, or the coming of the Hour suddenly while they are unaware?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul hathihi sabeelee adAAoo ila Allahi AAala baseeratin ana wamani ittabaAAanee wasubhana Allahi wama ana mina almushrikeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: This is my Way: I call on Allah with sure knowledge. I and whosoever followeth me - Glory be to Allah! - and I am not of the idolaters.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama arsalna min qablika illa rijalan noohee ilayhim min ahli alqura afalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim waladaru alakhirati khayrun lillatheena ittaqaw afala taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We sent not before thee (any messengers) save men whom We inspired from among the folk of the townships - Have they not travelled in the land and seen the nature of the consequence for those who were before them? And verily the abode of the Hereafter, for those who ward off (evil), is best. Have ye then no sense? -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatta itha istayasa alrrusulu wathannoo annahum qad kuthiboo jaahum nasruna fanujjiya man nashao wala yuraddu basuna AAani alqawmi almujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Till, when the messengers despaired and thought that they were denied, then came unto them Our help, and whom We would was saved. And Our wrath cannot be warded from the guilty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[12][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad kana fee qasasihim AAibratun liolee alalbabi ma kana hadeethan yuftara walakin tasdeeqa allathee bayna yadayhi watafseela kulli shayin wahudan warahmatan liqawmin yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In their history verily there is a lesson for men of understanding. It is no invented story but a confirmation of the existing (Scripture) and a detailed explanation of everything, and a guidance and a mercy for folk who believe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Ar-Ra'd (The Thunder)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aliflammeemra tilka ayatu alkitabi waallathee onzila ilayka min rabbika alhaqqu walakinna akthara alnnasi la yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Alif. Lam. Mim. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture. That which is revealed unto thee from thy Lord is the Truth, but most of mankind believe not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu allathee rafaAAa alssamawati bighayri AAamadin tarawnaha thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara kullun yajree liajalin musamman yudabbiru alamra yufassilu alayati laAAallakum biliqai rabbikum tooqinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah it is Who raised up the heavens without visible supports, then mounted the Throne, and compelled the sun and the moon to be of service, each runneth unto an appointed term; He ordereth the course; He detaileth the revelations, that haply ye may be certain of the meeting with your Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee madda alarda wajaAAala feeha rawasiya waanharan wamin kulli alththamarati jaAAala feeha zawjayni ithnayni yughshee allayla alnnahara inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who spread out the earth and placed therein firm hills and flowing streams, and of all fruits He placed therein two spouses (male and female). He covereth the night with the day. Lo! herein verily are portents for people who take thought.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wafee alardi qitaAAun mutajawiratun wajannatun min aAAnabin wazarAAun wanakheelun sinwanun waghayru sinwanin yusqa bimain wahidin wanufaddilu baAAdaha AAala baAAdin fee alokuli inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yaAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in the Earth are neighbouring tracts, vineyards and ploughed lands, and date-palms, like and unlike, which are watered with one water. And we have made some of them to excel others in fruit. Lo! herein verily are portents for people who have sense.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain taAAjab faAAajabun qawluhum aitha kunna turaban ainna lafee khalqin jadeedin olaika allatheena kafaroo birabbihim waolaika alaghlalu fee aAAnaqihim waolaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if thou wonderest, then wondrous is their saying: When we are dust, are we then forsooth (to be raised) in a new creation? Such are they who disbelieve in their Lord; such have carcans on their necks; such are rightful owners of the Fire, they will abide therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WayastaAAjiloonaka bialssayyiati qabla alhasanati waqad khalat min qablihimu almathulatu wainna rabbaka lathoo maghfiratin lilnnasi AAala thulmihim wainna rabbaka lashadeedu alAAiqabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they bid thee hasten on the evil rather than the good, when exemplary punishments have indeed occurred before them. But lo! thy Lord is rich in pardon for mankind despite their wrong, and lo! thy Lord is strong in punishment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayaqoolu allatheena kafaroo lawla onzila AAalayhi ayatun min rabbihi innama anta munthirun walikulli qawmin hadin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who disbelieve say: If only some portent were sent down upon him from his Lord! Thou art a warner only, and for every folk a guide.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu yaAAlamu ma tahmilu kullu ontha wama tagheedu alarhamu wama tazdadu wakullu shayin AAindahu bimiqdarin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah knoweth that which every female beareth and that which the wombs absorb and that which they grow. And everything with Him is measured.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAalimu alghaybi waalshshahadati alkabeeru almutaAAali}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He is the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, the Great, the High Exalted.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sawaon minkum man asarra alqawla waman jahara bihi waman huwa mustakhfin biallayli wasaribun bialnnahari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Alike of you is he who hideth the saying and he who noiseth it abroad, he who lurketh in the night and he who goeth freely in the daytime.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][11]
\end{Arabic}}
