\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahu muAAaqqibatun min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi yahfathoonahu min amri Allahi inna Allaha la yughayyiru ma biqawmin hatta yughayyiroo ma bianfusihim waitha arada Allahu biqawmin sooan fala maradda lahu wama lahum min doonihi min walin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For him are angels ranged before him and behind him, who guard him by Allah's command. Lo! Allah changeth not the condition of a folk until they (first) change that which is in their hearts; and if Allah willeth misfortune for a folk there is none that can repel it, nor have they a defender beside Him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa allathee yureekumu albarqa khawfan watamaAAan wayunshio alssahaba alththiqala}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who showeth you the lightning, a fear and a hope, and raiseth the heavy clouds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayusabbihu alrraAAdu bihamdihi waalmalaikatu min kheefatihi wayursilu alssawaAAiqa fayuseebu biha man yashao wahum yujadiloona fee Allahi wahuwa shadeedu almihali}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The thunder hymneth His praise and (so do) the angels for awe of Him. He launcheth the thunderbolts and smiteth with them whom He will while they dispute (in doubt) concerning Allah, and He is mighty in wrath.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahu daAAwatu alhaqqi waallatheena yadAAoona min doonihi la yastajeeboona lahum bishayin illa kabasiti kaffayhi ila almai liyablugha fahu wama huwa bibalighihi wama duAAao alkafireena illa fee dalalin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Him is the real prayer. Those unto whom they pray beside Allah respond to them not at all, save as (is the response to) one who stretcheth forth his hands toward water (asking) that it may come unto his mouth, and it will never reach it. The prayer of disbelievers goeth (far) astray.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walillahi yasjudu man fee alssamawati waalardi tawAAan wakarhan wathilaluhum bialghuduwwi waalasali}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto Allah falleth prostrate whosoever is in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, as do their shadows in the morning and the evening hours.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul man rabbu alssamawati waalardi quli Allahu qul afaittakhathtum min doonihi awliyaa la yamlikoona lianfusihim nafAAan wala darran qul hal yastawee alaAAma waalbaseeru am hal tastawee alththulumatu waalnnooru am jaAAaloo lillahi shurakaa khalaqoo kakhalqihi fatashabaha alkhalqu AAalayhim quli Allahu khaliqu kulli shayin wahuwa alwahidu alqahharu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad): Who is Lord of the heavens and the earth? Say: Allah. Say: Take ye then (others) beside Him for protectors, which, even for themselves, have neither benefit nor hurt? Say: Is the blind man equal to the seer, or is darkness equal to light? Or assign they unto Allah partners who created the like of His creation so that the creation (which they made and His creation) seemed alike to them? Say: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the Almighty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Anzala mina alssamai maan fasalat awdiyatun biqadariha faihtamala alssaylu zabadan rabiyan wamimma yooqidoona AAalayhi fee alnnari ibtighaa hilyatin aw mataAAin zabadun mithluhu kathalika yadribu Allahu alhaqqa waalbatila faamma alzzabadu fayathhabu jufaan waamma ma yanfaAAu alnnasa fayamkuthu fee alardi kathalika yadribu Allahu alamthala}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He sendeth down water from the sky, so that valleys flow according to their measure, and the flood beareth (on its surface) swelling foam - from that which they smelt in the fire in order to make ornaments and tools riseth a foam like unto it - thus Allah coineth (the similitude of) the true and the false. Then, as for the foam, it passeth away as scum upon the banks, while, as for that which is of use to mankind, it remaineth in the earth. Thus Allah coineth the similitudes.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lillatheena istajaboo lirabbihimu alhusna waallatheena lam yastajeeboo lahu law anna lahum ma fee alardi jameeAAan wamithlahu maAAahu laiftadaw bihi olaika lahum sooo alhisabi wamawahum jahannamu wabisa almihadu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For those who answered Allah's call is bliss; and for those who answered not His call, if they had all that is in the earth, and therewith the like thereof, they would proffer it as ransom. Such will have a woeful reckoning, and their habitation will be hell, a dire abode.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaman yaAAlamu annama onzila ilayka min rabbika alhaqqu kaman huwa aAAma innama yatathakkaru oloo alalbabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is he who knoweth that what is revealed unto thee from thy Lord is the truth like him who is blind? But only men of understanding heed;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yoofoona biAAahdi Allahi wala yanqudoona almeethaqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such as keep the pact of Allah, and break not the covenant;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena yasiloona ma amara Allahu bihi an yoosala wayakhshawna rabbahum wayakhafoona sooa alhisabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such as unite that which Allah hath commandeth should be joined, and fear their Lord, and dread a woeful reckoning;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena sabaroo ibtighaa wajhi rabbihim waaqamoo alssalata waanfaqoo mimma razaqnahum sirran waAAalaniyatan wayadraoona bialhasanati alssayyiata olaika lahum AAuqba alddari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such as persevere in seeking their Lord's Countenance and are regular in prayer and spend of that which We bestow upon them secretly and openly, and overcome evil with good. Theirs will be the sequel of the (heavenly) Home,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Jannatu AAadnin yadkhuloonaha waman salaha min abaihim waazwajihim wathurriyyatihim waalmalaikatu yadkhuloona AAalayhim min kulli babin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Gardens of Eden which they enter, along with all who do right of their fathers and their helpmeets and their seed. The angels enter unto them from every gate,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Salamun AAalaykum bima sabartum faniAAma AAuqba alddari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Saying): Peace be unto you because ye persevered. Ah, passing sweet will be the sequel of the (heavenly) Home.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena yanqudoona AAahda Allahi min baAAdi meethaqihi wayaqtaAAoona ma amara Allahu bihi an yoosala wayufsidoona fee alardi olaika lahumu allaAAnatu walahum sooo alddari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who break the covenant of Allah after ratifying it, and sever that which Allah hath commanded should be joined, and make mischief in the earth: theirs is the curse and theirs the ill abode.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru wafarihoo bialhayati alddunya wama alhayatu alddunya fee alakhirati illa mataAAun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah enlargeth livelihood for whom He will, and straiteneth (it for whom He will); and they rejoice in the life of the world, whereas the life of the world is but brief comfort as compared with the Hereafter.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayaqoolu allatheena kafaroo lawla onzila AAalayhi ayatun min rabbihi qul inna Allaha yudillu man yashao wayahdee ilayhi man anaba}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who disbelieve say: If only a portent were sent down upon him from his Lord! Say: Lo! Allah sendeth whom He will astray, and guideth unto Himself all who turn (unto Him),}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena amanoo watatmainnu quloobuhum bithikri Allahi ala bithikri Allahi tatmainnu alquloobu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who have believed and whose hearts have rest in the remembrance of Allah. Verily in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati tooba lahum wahusnu maabin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who believe and do right: Joy is for them, and bliss (their) journey's end.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kathalika arsalnaka fee ommatin qad khalat min qabliha omamun litatluwa AAalayhimu allathee awhayna ilayka wahum yakfuroona bialrrahmani qul huwa rabbee la ilaha illa huwa AAalayhi tawakkaltu wailayhi matabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus We send thee (O Muhammad) unto a nation, before whom other nations have passed away, that thou mayst recite unto them that which We have inspired in thee, while they are disbelievers in the Beneficent. Say: He is my Lord; there is no Allah save Him. In Him do I put my trust and unto Him is my recourse.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw anna quranan suyyirat bihi aljibalu aw quttiAAat bihi alardu aw kullima bihi almawta bal lillahi alamru jameeAAan afalam yayasi allatheena amanoo an law yashao Allahu lahada alnnasa jameeAAan wala yazalu allatheena kafaroo tuseebuhum bima sanaAAoo qariAAatun aw tahullu qareeban min darihim hatta yatiya waAAdu Allahi inna Allaha la yukhlifu almeeAAada}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Had it been possible for a Lecture to cause the mountains to move, or the earth to be torn asunder, or the dead to speak, (this Qur'an would have done so). Nay, but Allah's is the whole command. Do not those who believe know that, had Allah willed, He could have guided all mankind? As for those who disbelieve, disaster ceaseth not to strike them because of what they do, or it dwelleth near their home until the threat of Allah come to pass. Lo! Allah faileth not to keep the tryst.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqadi istuhzia birusulin min qablika faamlaytu lillatheena kafaroo thumma akhathtuhum fakayfa kana AAiqabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily messengers (of Allah) were mocked before thee, but long I bore with those who disbelieved. At length I seized them, and how (awful) was My punishment!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaman huwa qaimun AAala kulli nafsin bima kasabat wajaAAaloo lillahi shurakaa qul sammoohum am tunabbioonahu bima la yaAAlamu fee alardi am bithahirin mina alqawli bal zuyyina lillatheena kafaroo makruhum wasuddoo AAani alssabeeli waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is He Who is aware of the deserts of every soul (as he who is aware of nothing)? Yet they ascribe unto Allah partners. Say: Name them. Is it that ye would inform Him of something which He knoweth not in the earth? Or is it but a way of speaking? Nay but their contrivance is made seeming fair for those who disbelieve and they are kept from the right road. He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahum AAathabun fee alhayati alddunya walaAAathabu alakhirati ashaqqu wama lahum mina Allahi min waqin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For them is torment in the life of the world, and verily the doom of the Hereafter is more painful, and they have no defender from Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Mathalu aljannati allatee wuAAida almuttaqoona tajree min tahtiha alanharu okuluha daimun wathilluha tilka AAuqba allatheena ittaqaw waAAuqba alkafireena alnnaru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A similitude of the Garden which is promised unto those who keep their duty (to Allah): Underneath it rivers flow; its food is everlasting, and its shade; this is the reward of those who keep their duty, while the reward of disbelievers is the Fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena ataynahumu alkitaba yafrahoona bima onzila ilayka wamina alahzabi man yunkiru baAAdahu qul innama omirtu an aAAbuda Allaha wala oshrika bihi ilayhi adAAoo wailayhi maabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those unto whom We gave the Scripture rejoice in that which is revealed unto thee. And of the clans there are who deny some of it. Say: I am commanded only that I serve Allah and ascribe unto Him no partner. Unto Him I cry, and unto Him is my return.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakathalika anzalnahu hukman AAarabiyyan walaini ittabaAAta ahwaahum baAAda ma jaaka mina alAAilmi ma laka mina Allahi min waliyyin wala waqin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus have We revealed it, a decisive utterance in Arabic; and if thou shouldst follow their desires after that which hath come unto thee of knowledge, then truly wouldst thou have from Allah no protecting friend nor defender.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad arsalna rusulan min qablika wajaAAalna lahum azwajan wathurriyyatan wama kana lirasoolin an yatiya biayatin illa biithni Allahi likulli ajalin kitabun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We sent messengers (to mankind) before thee, and We appointed for them wives and offspring, and it was not (given) to any messenger that he should bring a portent save by Allah's leave. For everything there is a time prescribed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yamhoo Allahu ma yashao wayuthbitu waAAindahu ommu alkitabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah effaceth what He will, and establisheth (what He will), and with Him is the source of ordinance.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain ma nuriyannaka baAAda allathee naAAiduhum aw natawaffayannaka fainnama AAalayka albalaghu waAAalayna alhisabu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whether We let thee see something of that which We have promised them, or make thee die (before its happening), thine is but conveyance (of the message). Ours the reckoning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yaraw anna natee alarda nanqusuha min atrafiha waAllahu yahkumu la muAAaqqiba lihukmihi wahuwa sareeAAu alhisabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} See they not how we aim to the land, reducing it of its outlying parts? (When) Allah doometh there is none that can postpone His doom, and He is swift at reckoning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqad makara allatheena min qablihim falillahi almakru jameeAAan yaAAlamu ma taksibu kullu nafsin wasayaAAlamu alkuffaru liman AAuqba alddari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who were before them plotted; but all plotting is Allah's. He knoweth that which each soul earneth. The disbelievers will come to know for whom will be the sequel of the (heavenly) Home.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[13][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayaqoolu allatheena kafaroo lasta mursalan qul kafa biAllahi shaheedan baynee wabaynakum waman AAindahu AAilmu alkitabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Ibrahim (Abraham)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aliflamra kitabun anzalnahu ilayka litukhrija alnnasa mina alththulumati ila alnnoori biithni rabbihim ila sirati alAAazeezi alhameedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Alif. Lam. Ra. (This is) a Scripture which We have revealed unto thee (Muhammad) that thereby thou mayst bring forth mankind from darkness unto light, by the permission of their Lord, unto the path of the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahi allathee lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wawaylun lilkafireena min AAathabin shadeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah, unto Whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. and woe unto the disbelievers from an awful doom;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yastahibboona alhayata alddunya AAala alakhirati wayasuddoona AAan sabeeli Allahi wayabghoonaha AAiwajan olaika fee dalalin baAAeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who love the life of the world more than the Hereafter, and debar (men) from the way of Allah and would have it crooked: such are far astray.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama arsalna min rasoolin illa bilisani qawmihi liyubayyina lahum fayudillu Allahu man yashao wayahdee man yashao wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We never sent a messenger save with the language of his folk, that he might make (the message) clear for them. Then Allah sendeth whom He will astray, and guideth whom He will. He is the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad arsalna moosa biayatina an akhrij qawmaka mina alththulumati ila alnnoori wathakkirhum biayyami Allahi inna fee thalika laayatin likulli sabbarin shakoorin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We verily sent Moses with Our revelations, saying: Bring thy people forth from darkness unto light. And remind them of the days of Allah. Lo! therein are revelations for each steadfast, thankful (heart).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qala moosa liqawmihi othkuroo niAAmata Allahi AAalaykum ith anjakum min ali firAAawna yasoomoonakum sooa alAAathabi wayuthabbihoona abnaakum wayastahyoona nisaakum wafee thalikum balaon min rabbikum AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (remind them) how Moses said unto his people: Remember Allah's favour unto you when He delivered you from Pharaoh's folk who were afflicting you with dreadful torment, and were slaying your sons and sparing your women; that was a tremendous trial from your Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith taaththana rabbukum lain shakartum laazeedannakum walain kafartum inna AAathabee lashadeedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when your Lord proclaimed: If ye give thanks, I will give you more; but if ye are thankless, lo! My punishment is dire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala moosa in takfuroo antum waman fee alardi jameeAAan fainna Allaha laghaniyyun hameedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Moses said: Though ye and all who are in the earth prove thankless, lo! Allah verily is Absolute, Owner of Praise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam yatikum nabao allatheena min qablikum qawmi noohin waAAadin wathamooda waallatheena min baAAdihim la yaAAlamuhum illa Allahu jaathum rusuluhum bialbayyinati faraddoo aydiyahum fee afwahihim waqaloo inna kafarna bima orsiltum bihi wainna lafee shakkin mimma tadAAoonana ilayhi mureebun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hath not the history of those before you reached you: the folk of Noah, and (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud, and those after them? None save Allah knoweth them. Their messengers came unto them with clear proofs, but they thrust their hands into their mouths, and said: Lo! we disbelieve in that wherewith ye have been sent, and lo! we are in grave doubt concerning that to which ye call us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qalat rusuluhum afee Allahi shakkun fatiri alssamawati waalardi yadAAookum liyaghfira lakum min thunoobikum wayuakhkhirakum ila ajalin musamman qaloo in antum illa basharun mithluna tureedoona an tasuddoona AAamma kana yaAAbudu abaona fatoona bisultanin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Their messengers said: Can there be doubt concerning Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth? He calleth you that He may forgive you your sins and reprieve you unto an appointed term. They said: Ye are but mortals like us, who would fain turn us away from what our fathers used to worship. Then bring some clear warrant.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qalat lahum rusuluhum in nahnu illa basharun mithlukum walakinna Allaha yamunnu AAala man yashao min AAibadihi wama kana lana an natiyakum bisultanin illa biithni Allahi waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Their messengers said unto them: We are but mortals like you, but Allah giveth grace unto whom He will of His slaves. It is not ours to bring you a warrant unless by the permission of Allah. In Allah let believers put their trust!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama lana alla natawakkala AAala Allahi waqad hadana subulana walanasbiranna AAala ma athaytumoona waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almutawakkiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How should we not put our trust in Allah when He hath shown us our ways? We surely will endure the hurt ye do us. In Allah let the trusting put their trust.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena kafaroo lirusulihim lanukhrijannakum min ardina aw lataAAoodunna fee millatina faawha ilayhim rabbuhum lanuhlikanna alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who disbelieved said unto their messengers: Verily we will drive you out from our land, unless ye return to our religion. Then their Lord inspired them, (saying): Verily we shall destroy the wrong-doers,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walanuskinannakumu alarda min baAAdihim thalika liman khafa maqamee wakhafa waAAeedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We shall make you to dwell in the land after them. This is for him who feareth My Majesty and feareth My threats.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waistaftahoo wakhaba kullu jabbarin AAaneedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they sought help (from their Lord) and every froward potentate was bought to naught;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Min waraihi jahannamu wayusqa min main sadeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hell is before him, and he is made to drink a festering water,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YatajarraAAuhu wala yakadu yuseeghuhu wayateehi almawtu min kulli makanin wama huwa bimayyitin wamin waraihi AAathabun ghaleethun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which he sippeth but can hardly swallow, and death cometh unto him from every side while yet he cannot die, and before him is a harsh doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Mathalu allatheena kafaroo birabbihim aAAmaluhum karamadin ishtaddat bihi alrreehu fee yawmin AAasifin la yaqdiroona mimma kasaboo AAala shayin thalika huwa alddalalu albaAAeedu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A similitude of those who disbelieve in their Lord: Their works are as ashes which the wind bloweth hard upon a stormy day. They have no control of aught that they have earned. That is the extreme failure.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara anna Allaha khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi in yasha yuthhibkum wayati bikhalqin jadeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou not seen that Allah hath created the heavens and the earth with truth? If He will, He can remove you and bring (in) some new creation;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama thalika AAala Allahi biAAazeezin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that is no great matter for Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wabarazoo lillahi jameeAAan faqala aldduAAafao lillatheena istakbaroo inna kunna lakum tabaAAan fahal antum mughnoona AAanna min AAathabi Allahi min shayin qaloo law hadana Allahu lahadaynakum sawaon AAalayna ajaziAAna am sabarna ma lana min maheesin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They all come forth unto their Lord. Then those who were despised say unto those who were scornful: We were unto you a following, can ye then avert from us aught of Allah's doom? They say: Had Allah guided us, we should have guided you. Whether we rage or patiently endure is (now) all one for us; we have no place of refuge.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala alshshaytanu lamma qudiya alamru inna Allaha waAAadakum waAAda alhaqqi wawaAAadtukum faakhlaftukum wama kana liya AAalaykum min sultanin illa an daAAawtukum faistajabtum lee fala taloomoonee waloomoo anfusakum ma ana bimusrikhikum wama antum bimusrikhiyya innee kafartu bima ashraktumooni min qablu inna alththalimeena lahum AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Satan saith, when the matter hath been decided: Lo! Allah promised you a promise of truth; and I promised you, then failed you. And I had no power over you save that I called unto you and ye obeyed me. So blame not, but blame yourselves. I cannot help you, nor can ye help me, Lo! I disbelieved in that which ye before ascribed to me. Lo! for wrong-doers is a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waodkhila allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha biithni rabbihim tahiyyatuhum feeha salamun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who believed and did good works are made to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein abiding by permission of their Lord, their greeting therein: Peace!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara kayfa daraba Allahu mathalan kalimatan tayyibatan kashajaratin tayyibatin asluha thabitun wafarAAuha fee alssamai}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Seest thou not how Allah coineth a similitude: A goodly saying, as a goodly tree, its root set firm, its branches reaching into heaven,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tutee okulaha kulla heenin biithni rabbiha wayadribu Allahu alamthala lilnnasi laAAallahum yatathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Giving its fruit at every season by permission of its Lord? Allah coineth the similitudes for mankind in order that they may reflect.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamathalu kalimatin khabeethatin kashajaratin khabeethatin ijtuththat min fawqi alardi ma laha min qararin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the similitude of a bad saying is as a bad tree, uprooted from upon the earth, possessing no stability.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yuthabbitu Allahu allatheena amanoo bialqawli alththabiti fee alhayati alddunya wafee alakhirati wayudillu Allahu alththalimeena wayafAAalu Allahu ma yashao}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah confirmeth those who believe by a firm saying in the life of the world and in the Hereafter, and Allah sendeth wrong-doers astray. And Allah doeth what He will.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara ila allatheena baddaloo niAAmata Allahi kufran waahalloo qawmahum dara albawari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou not seen those who gave the grace of Allah in exchange for thanklessness and led their people down to the Abode of Loss,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Jahannama yaslawnaha wabisa alqararu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Even to) hell? They are exposed thereto. A hapless end!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAaloo lillahi andadan liyudilloo AAan sabeelihi qul tamattaAAoo fainna maseerakum ila alnnari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they set up rivals to Allah that they may mislead (men) from His way. Say: Enjoy life (while ye may) for lo! your journey's end will be the Fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul liAAibadiya allatheena amanoo yuqeemoo alssalata wayunfiqoo mimma razaqnahum sirran waAAalaniyatan min qabli an yatiya yawmun la bayAAun feehi wala khilalun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Tell My bondmen who believe to establish worship and spend of that which We have given them, secretly and publicly, before a day cometh wherein there will be neither traffick nor befriending.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda waanzala mina alssamai maan faakhraja bihi mina alththamarati rizqan lakum wasakhkhara lakumu alfulka litajriya fee albahri biamrihi wasakhkhara lakumu alanhara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah is He Who created the heavens and the earth, and causeth water to descend from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you, and maketh the ships to be of service unto you, that they may run upon the sea at His command, and hath made of service unto you the rivers;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wasakhkhara lakumu alshshamsa waalqamara daibayni wasakhkhara lakumu allayla waalnnahara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And maketh the sun and the moon, constant in their courses, to be of service unto you, and hath made of service unto you the night and the day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waatakum min kulli ma saaltumoohu wain taAAuddoo niAAmata Allahi la tuhsooha inna alinsana lathaloomun kaffarun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He giveth you of all ye ask of Him, and if ye would count the bounty of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! man is verily a wrong-doer, an ingrate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qala ibraheemu rabbi ijAAal hatha albalada aminan waojnubnee wabaniyya an naAAbuda alasnama}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Abraham said: My Lord! Make safe this territory, and preserve me and my sons from serving idols.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbi innahunna adlalna katheeran mina alnnasi faman tabiAAanee fainnahu minnee waman AAasanee fainnaka ghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} My Lord! Lo! they have led many of mankind astray. But whoso followeth me, he verily is of me. And whoso disobeyeth me - Still Thou art Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbana innee askantu min thurriyyatee biwadin ghayri thee zarAAin AAinda baytika almuharrami rabbana liyuqeemoo alssalata faijAAal afidatan mina alnnasi tahwee ilayhim waorzuqhum mina alththamarati laAAallahum yashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Our Lord! Lo! I have settled some of my posterity in an uncultivable valley near unto Thy holy House, our Lord! that they may establish proper worship; so incline some hearts of men that they may yearn toward them, and provide Thou them with fruits in order that they may be thankful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbana innaka taAAlamu ma nukhfee wama nuAAlinu wama yakhfa AAala Allahi min shayin fee alardi wala fee alssamai}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Our Lord! Lo! Thou knowest that which we hide and that which we proclaim. Nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alhamdu lillahi allathee wahaba lee AAala alkibari ismaAAeela waishaqa inna rabbee lasameeAAu aldduAAai}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Praise be to Allah Who hath given me, in my old age, Ishmael and Isaac! Lo! my Lord is indeed the Hearer of Prayer.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbi ijAAalnee muqeema alssalati wamin thurriyyatee rabbana wtaqabbal duAAai}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} My Lord! Make me to establish proper worship, and some of my posterity (also); our Lord! and accept my prayer.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbana ighfir lee waliwalidayya walilmumineena yawma yaqoomu alhisabu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and believers on the day when the account is cast.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tahsabanna Allaha ghafilan AAamma yaAAmalu alththalimoona innama yuakhkhiruhum liyawmin tashkhasu feehi alabsaru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Deem not that Allah is unaware of what the wicked do. He but giveth them a respite till a day when eyes will stare (in terror),}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{MuhtiAAeena muqniAAee ruoosihim la yartaddu ilayhim tarfuhum waafidatuhum hawaon}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As they come hurrying on in fear, their heads upraised, their gaze returning not to them, and their hearts as air.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanthiri alnnasa yawma yateehimu alAAathabu fayaqoolu allatheena thalamoo rabbana akhkhirna ila ajalin qareebin nujib daAAwataka wanattabiAAi alrrusula awalam takoonoo aqsamtum min qablu ma lakum min zawalin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And warn mankind of a day when the doom will come upon them, and those who did wrong will say: Our Lord! Reprieve us for a little while. We will obey Thy call and will follow the messengers. (It will be answered): Did ye not swear before that there would be no end for you?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wasakantum fee masakini allatheena thalamoo anfusahum watabayyana lakum kayfa faAAalna bihim wadarabna lakumu alamthala}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (have ye not) dwelt in the dwellings of those who wronged themselves (of old) and (hath it not) become plain to you how We dealt with them and made examples for you?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqad makaroo makrahum waAAinda Allahi makruhum wain kana makruhum litazoola minhu aljibalu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Verily they have plotted their plot, and their plot is with Allah, though their plot were one whereby the mountains should be moved.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala tahsabanna Allaha mukhlifa waAAdihi rusulahu inna Allaha AAazeezun thoo intiqamin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So think not that Allah will fail to keep His promise to His messengers. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma tubaddalu alardu ghayra alardi waalssamawatu wabarazoo lillahi alwahidi alqahhari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when the earth will be changed to other than the earth, and the heavens (also will be changed) and they will come forth unto Allah, the One, the Almighty,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watara almujrimeena yawmaithin muqarraneena fee alasfadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thou wilt see the guilty on that day linked together in chains,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sarabeeluhum min qatranin wataghsha wujoohahumu alnnaru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Their raiment of pitch, and the Fire covering their faces,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyajziya Allahu kulla nafsin ma kasabat inna Allaha sareeAAu alhisabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That Allah may repay each soul what it hath earned. Lo! Allah is swift at reckoning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[14][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha balaghun lilnnasi waliyuntharoo bihi waliyaAAlamoo annama huwa ilahun wahidun waliyaththakkara oloo alalbabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is a clear message for mankind in order that they may be warned thereby, and that they may know that He is only One Allah, and that men of understanding may take heed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Hijr (The Rock)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aliflamra tilka ayatu alkitabi waquranin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture and a plain Reading.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rubama yawaddu allatheena kafaroo law kanoo muslimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tharhum yakuloo wayatamattaAAoo wayulhihimu alamalu fasawfa yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa walaha kitabun maAAloomun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We destroyed no township but there was a known decree for it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha wama yastakhiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} No nation can outstrip its term nor can they lag behind.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo ya ayyuha allathee nuzzila AAalayhi alththikru innaka lamajnoonun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed, lo! thou art indeed a madman!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Law ma tateena bialmalaikati in kunta mina alssadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Why bringest thou not angels unto us, if thou art of the truthful?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma nunazzilu almalaikata illa bialhaqqi wama kanoo ithan munthareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We send not down the angels save with the Fact, and in that case (the disbelievers) would not be tolerated.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna nahnu nazzalna alththikra wainna lahu lahafithoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad arsalna min qablika fee shiyaAAi alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We verily sent (messengers) before thee among the factions of the men of old.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kathalika naslukuhu fee quloobi almujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yuminoona bihi waqad khalat sunnatu alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They believe not therein, though the example of the men of old hath gone before.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw fatahna AAalayhim baban mina alssamai fathalloo feehi yaAArujoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqaloo innama sukkirat absaruna bal nahnu qawmun mashooroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They would say: Our sight is wrong - nay, but we are folk bewitched.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad jaAAalna fee alssamai buroojan wazayyannaha lilnnathireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily in the heaven we have set mansions of the stars, and We have beautified it for beholders.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahafithnaha min kulli shaytanin rajeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We have guarded it from every outcast devil,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa mani istaraqa alssamAAa faatbaAAahu shihabun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli shayin mawzoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the earth have We spread out, and placed therein firm hills, and caused each seemly thing to grow therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalna lakum feeha maAAayisha waman lastum lahu biraziqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And we have given unto you livelihoods therein, and unto those for whom ye provide not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain min shayin illa AAindana khazainuhu wama nunazziluhu illa biqadarin maAAloomin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And there is not a thing but with Us are the stores thereof. And we send it not down save in appointed measure.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waarsalna alrriyaha lawaqiha faanzalna mina alssamai maan faasqaynakumoohu wama antum lahu bikhazineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna lanahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wanahnu alwarithoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! and it is We, even We, Who quicken and give death, and We are the Inheritor.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad AAalimna almustaqdimeena minkum walaqad AAalimna almustakhireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We know the eager among you and verily We know the laggards.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna rabbaka huwa yahshuruhum innahu hakeemun AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thy Lord will gather them together. Lo! He is Wise, Aware.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min salsalin min hamain masnoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Verily We created man of potter's clay of black mud altered,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaljanna khalaqnahu min qablu min nari alssamoomi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min salsalin min hamain masnoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So the angels fell prostrate, all of them together}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa ibleesa aba an yakoona maAAa alssajideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save Iblis. He refused to be among the prostrate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya ibleesu ma laka alla takoona maAAa alssajideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O Iblis! What aileth thee that thou art not among the prostrate?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala lam akun liasjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min salsalin min hamain masnoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: I am not one to prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter's clay of black mud altered!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Then go thou forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna AAalayka allaAAnata ila yawmi alddeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! the curse shall be upon thee till the Day of Judgment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Then lo! thou art of those reprieved}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Till the Day of appointed time.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi bima aghwaytanee laozayyinanna lahum fee alardi walaoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! Because Thou hast sent me astray, I verily shall adorn the path of error for them in the earth, and shall mislead them every one,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save such of them as are Thy perfectly devoted slaves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala hatha siratun AAalayya mustaqeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: This is a right course incumbent upon Me:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna AAibadee laysa laka AAalayhim sultanun illa mani ittabaAAaka mina alghaweena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! as for My slaves, thou hast no power over any of them save such of the froward as follow thee,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna jahannama lamawAAiduhum ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! for all such, hell will be the promised place.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laha sabAAatu abwabin likulli babin minhum juzon maqsoomun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It hath seven gates, and each gate hath an appointed portion.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who ward off (evil) are among gardens and watersprings.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Odkhulooha bisalamin amineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And it is said unto them): Enter them in peace, secure.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WanazaAAna ma fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwanan AAala sururin mutaqabileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yamassuhum feeha nasabun wama hum minha bimukhrajeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Nabbi AAibadee annee ana alghafooru alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wa anna AAathabee huwa alAAathabu alaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that My doom is the dolorous doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanabbihum AAan dayfi ibraheema}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And tell them of Abraham's guests,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala inna minkum wajiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (How) when they came in unto him, and said: Peace. He said: Lo! we are afraid of you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo la tawjal inna nubashshiruka bighulamin AAaleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala abashshartumoonee AAala an massaniya alkibaru fabima tubashshirooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Bring ye me good tidings (of a son) when old age hath overtaken me? Of what then can ye bring good tidings?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo bashsharnaka bialhaqqi fala takun mina alqaniteena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: We bring thee good tidings in truth. So be not thou of the despairing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala waman yaqnatu min rahmati rabbihi illa alddalloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: And who despaireth of the mercy of his Lord save those who are astray?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: And afterward what is your business, O ye messengers (of Allah)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: We have been sent unto a guilty folk,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa ala lootin inna lamunajjoohum ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (All) save the family of Lot. Them we shall deliver every one,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa imraatahu qaddarna innaha lamina alghabireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Except his wife, of whom We had decreed that she should be of those who stay behind.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jaa ala lootin almursaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala innakum qawmun munkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Lo! ye are folk unknown (to me).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo bal jinaka bima kanoo feehi yamtaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Nay, but we bring thee that concerning which they keep disputing,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waataynaka bialhaqqi wainna lasadiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And bring thee the Truth, and lo! we are truth-tellers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faasri biahlika biqitAAin mina allayli waittabiAA adbarahum wala yaltafit minkum ahadun waimdoo haythu tumaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So travel with thy household in a portion of the night, and follow thou their backs. Let none of you turn round, but go whither ye are commanded.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqadayna ilayhi thalika alamra anna dabira haolai maqtooAAun musbiheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We made plain the case to him, that the root of them (who did wrong) was to be cut at early morn.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajaa ahlu almadeenati yastabshiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the people of the city came, rejoicing at the news (of new arrivals).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala inna haolai dayfee fala tafdahooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waittaqoo Allaha wala tukhzooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And keep your duty to Allah, and shame me not!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo awalam nanhaka AAani alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said; Have we not forbidden you from (entertaining) anyone?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala haolai banatee in kuntum faAAileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Here are my daughters, if ye must be doing (so).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{LaAAamruka innahum lafee sakratihim yaAAmahoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By thy life (O Muhammad) they moved blindly in the frenzy of approaching death.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faakhathathumu alssayhatu mushriqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FajaAAalna AAaliyaha safilaha waamtarna AAalayhim hijaratan min sijjeelin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We utterly confounded them, and We rained upon them stones of heated clay.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna fee thalika laayatin lilmutawassimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! therein verily are portents for those who read the signs.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnaha labisabeelin muqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! it is upon a road still uneffaced.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna fee thalika laayatan lilmumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! therein is indeed a portent for believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain kana ashabu alaykati lathalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the dwellers in the wood indeed were evil-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faintaqamna minhum wainnahuma labiimamin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So we took vengeance on them; and lo! they both are on a high-road plain to see.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad kaththaba ashabu alhijri almursaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the dwellers in Al-Hijr denied (Our) messengers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waataynahum ayatina fakanoo AAanha muAArideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And we gave them Our revelations, but they were averse to them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakanoo yanhitoona mina aljibali buyootan amineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills, (wherein they dwelt) secure.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faakhathathumu alssayhatu musbiheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the morning hour,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yaksiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that which they were wont to count as gain availed them not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi wainna alssaAAata laatiyatun faisfahi alssafha aljameela}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna rabbaka huwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad ataynaka sabAAan mina almathanee waalqurana alAAatheema}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum wala tahzan AAalayhim waikhfid janahaka lilmumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoin, and be not grieved on their account, and lower thy wing (in tenderness) for the believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqul innee ana alnnatheeru almubeenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kama anzalna AAala almuqtasimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such as We send down for those who make division,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena jaAAaloo alqurana AAideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who break the Qur'an into parts.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fawarabbika lanasalannahum ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Them, by thy Lord, We shall question, every one,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAamma kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Of what they used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaisdaAA bima tumaru waaAArid AAani almushrikeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So proclaim that which thou art commanded, and withdraw from the idolaters.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna kafaynaka almustahzieena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We defend thee from the scoffers,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yajAAaloona maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fasawfa yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who set some other god along with Allah. But they will come to know.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad naAAlamu annaka yadeequ sadruka bima yaqooloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Well know We that thy bosom is oppressed by what they say,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wakun mina alssajideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But hymn the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who make prostration (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[15][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaoAAbud rabbaka hatta yatiyaka alyaqeenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{An-Nahl (The Bee)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ata amru Allahi fala tastaAAjiloohu subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The commandment of Allah will come to pass, so seek not ye to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted be He above all that they associate (with Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yunazzilu almalaikata bialrroohi min amrihi AAala man yashao min AAibadihi an anthiroo annahu la ilaha illa ana faittaqooni}}
