\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He sendeth down the angels with the Spirit of His command unto whom He will of His bondmen, (saying): Warn mankind that there is no Allah save Me, so keep your duty unto Me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi taAAala AAamma yushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. High be He Exalted above all that they associate (with Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khalaqa alinsana min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He hath created man from a drop of fluid, yet behold! he is an open opponent.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaalanAAama khalaqaha lakum feeha difon wamanafiAAu waminha takuloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the cattle hath He created, whence ye have warm clothing and uses, and whereof ye eat;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walakum feeha jamalun heena tureehoona waheena tasrahoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And wherein is beauty for you, when ye bring them home, and when ye take them out to pasture.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watahmilu athqalakum ila baladin lam takoonoo baligheehi illa bishiqqi alanfusi inna rabbakum laraoofun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they bear your loads for you unto a land ye could not reach save with great trouble to yourselves. Lo! your Lord is Full of Pity, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalkhayla waalbighala waalhameera litarkabooha wazeenatan wayakhluqu ma la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And horses and mules and asses (hath He created) that ye may ride them, and for ornament. And He createth that which ye know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAala Allahi qasdu alssabeeli waminha jairun walaw shaa lahadakum ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah's is the direction of the way, and some (roads) go not straight. And had He willed He would have led you all aright.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa allathee anzala mina alssamai maan lakum minhu sharabun waminhu shajarun feehi tuseemoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who sendeth down water from the sky, whence ye have drink, and whence are trees on which ye send your beasts to pasture.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yunbitu lakum bihi alzzarAAa waalzzaytoona waalnnakheela waalaAAnaba wamin kulli alththamarati inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yatafakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therewith He causeth crops to grow for you, and the olive and the date-palm and grapes and all kinds of fruit. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for people who reflect.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wasakhkhara lakumu allayla waalnnahara waalshshamsa waalqamara waalnnujoomu musakhkharatun biamrihi inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yaAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He hath constrained the night and the day and the sun and the moon to be of service unto you, and the stars are made subservient by His command. Lo! herein indeed are portents for people who have sense.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama tharaa lakum fee alardi mukhtalifan alwanuhu inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yaththakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whatsoever He hath created for you in the earth of divers hues, lo! therein is indeed a portent for people who take heed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee sakhkhara albahra litakuloo minhu lahman tariyyan watastakhrijoo minhu hilyatan talbasoonaha watara alfulka mawakhira feehi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who hath constrained the sea to be of service that ye eat fresh meat from thence, and bring forth from thence ornaments which ye wear. And thou seest the ships ploughing it that ye (mankind) may seek of His bounty and that haply ye may give thanks.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalqa fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bikum waanharan wasubulan laAAallakum tahtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He hath cast into the earth firm hills that it quake not with you, and streams and roads that ye may find a way.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAalamatin wabialnnajmi hum yahtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And landmarks (too), and by the star they find a way.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaman yakhluqu kaman la yakhluqu afala tathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is He then Who createth as him who createth not? Will ye not then remember?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain taAAuddoo niAAmata Allahi la tuhsooha inna Allaha laghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if ye would count the favour of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! Allah is indeed Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAllahu yaAAlamu ma tusirroona wama tuAAlinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah knoweth that which ye keep hidden and that which ye proclaim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena yadAAoona min dooni Allahi la yakhluqoona shayan wahum yukhlaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those unto whom they cry beside Allah created naught, but are themselves created.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Amwatun ghayru ahyain wama yashAAuroona ayyana yubAAathoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (They are) dead, not living. And they know not when they will be raised.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ilahukum ilahun wahidun faallatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati quloobuhum munkiratun wahum mustakbiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Your Allah is One Allah. But as for those who believe not in the Hereafter their hearts refuse to know, for they are proud.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La jarama anna Allaha yaAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona innahu la yuhibbu almustakbireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Assuredly Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden and that which they proclaim. Lo! He loveth not the proud.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha qeela lahum matha anzala rabbukum qaloo asateeru alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when it is said unto them: What hath your Lord revealed? they say: (Mere) fables of the men of old,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyahmiloo awzarahum kamilatan yawma alqiyamati wamin awzari allatheena yudilloonahum bighayri AAilmin ala saa ma yaziroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That they may bear their burdens undiminished on the Day of Resurrection, with somewhat of the burdens of those whom they mislead without knowledge. Ah! evil is that which they bear!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qad makara allatheena min qablihim faata Allahu bunyanahum mina alqawaAAidi fakharra AAalayhimu alssaqfu min fawqihim waatahumu alAAathabu min haythu la yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those before them plotted, so Allah struck at the foundations of their building, and then the roof fell down upon them from above them, and the doom came on them whence they knew not;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma yawma alqiyamati yukhzeehim wayaqoolu ayna shurakaiya allatheena kuntum tushaqqoona feehim qala allatheena ootoo alAAilma inna alkhizya alyawma waalssooa AAala alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and will say: Where are My partners, for whose sake ye opposed (My guidance)? Those who have been given knowledge will say: Disgrace this day and evil are upon the disbelievers,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena tatawaffahumu almalaikatu thalimee anfusihim faalqawoo alssalama ma kunna naAAmalu min sooin bala inna Allaha AAaleemun bima kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whom the angels cause to die while they are wronging themselves. Then will they make full submission (saying): We used not to do any wrong. Nay! Surely Allah is Knower of what ye used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faodkhuloo abwaba jahannama khalideena feeha falabisa mathwa almutakabbireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So enter the gates of hell, to dwell therein for ever. Woeful indeed will be the lodging of the arrogant.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqeela lillatheena ittaqaw matha anzala rabbukum qaloo khayran lillatheena ahsanoo fee hathihi alddunya hasanatun waladaru alakhirati khayrun walaniAAma daru almuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And it is said unto those who ward off (evil): What hath your Lord revealed? They say: Good. For those who do good in this world there is a good (reward) and the home of the Hereafter will be better. Pleasant indeed will be the home of those who ward off (evil) -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Jannatu AAadnin yadkhuloonaha tajree min tahtiha alanharu lahum feeha ma yashaoona kathalika yajzee Allahu almuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Gardens of Eden which they enter, underneath which rivers flow, wherein they have what they will. Thus Allah repayeth those who ward off (evil),}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena tatawaffahumu almalaikatu tayyibeena yaqooloona salamun AAalaykumu odkhuloo aljannata bima kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those whom the angels cause to die (when they are) good. They say: Peace be unto you! Enter the Garden because of what ye used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hal yanthuroona illa an tatiyahumu almalaikatu aw yatiya amru rabbika kathalika faAAala allatheena min qablihim wama thalamahumu Allahu walakin kanoo anfusahum yathlimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Await they aught say that the angels should come unto them or thy Lord's command should come to pass? Even so did those before them. Allah wronged them not, but they did wrong themselves,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faasabahum sayyiatu ma AAamiloo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So that the evils of what they did smote them, and that which they used to mock surrounded them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena ashrakoo law shaa Allahu ma AAabadna min doonihi min shayin nahnu wala abaona wala harramna min doonihi min shayin kathalika faAAala allatheena min qablihim fahal AAala alrrusuli illa albalaghu almubeenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the idolaters say: Had Allah willed, we had not worshipped aught beside Him, we and our fathers, nor had we forbidden aught without (command from) Him. Even so did those before them. Are the messengers charged with aught save plain conveyance (of the message)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad baAAathna fee kulli ommatin rasoolan ani oAAbudoo Allaha waijtaniboo alttaghoota faminhum man hada Allahu waminhum man haqqat AAalayhi alddalalatu faseeroo fee alardi faonthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu almukaththibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We have raised in every nation a messenger, (proclaiming): Serve Allah and shun false gods. Then some of them (there were) whom Allah guided, and some of them (there were) upon whom error had just hold. Do but travel in the land and see the nature of the consequence for the deniers!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In tahris AAala hudahum fainna Allaha la yahdee man yudillu wama lahum min nasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Even if thou (O Muhammad) desirest their right guidance, still Allah assuredly will not guide him who misleadeth. Such have no helpers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaqsamoo biAllahi jahda aymanihim la yabAAathu Allahu man yamootu bala waAAdan AAalayhi haqqan walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they swear by Allah their most binding oaths (that) Allah will not raise up him who dieth. Nay, but it is a promise (binding) upon Him in truth, but most of mankind know not,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyubayyina lahumu allathee yakhtalifoona feehi waliyaAAlama allatheena kafaroo annahum kanoo kathibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That He may explain unto them that wherein they differ, and that those who disbelieved may know that they were liars.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama qawluna lishayin itha aradnahu an naqoola lahu kun fayakoonu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Our word unto a thing, when We intend it, is only that We say unto it: Be! and it is.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena hajaroo fee Allahi min baAAdi ma thulimoo lanubawwiannahum fee alddunya hasanatan walaajru alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who became fugitives for the cause of Allah after they had been oppressed, We verily shall give them goodly lodging in the world, and surely the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if they but knew;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena sabaroo waAAala rabbihim yatawakkaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such as are steadfast and put their trust in Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama arsalna min qablika illa rijalan noohee ilayhim faisaloo ahla alththikri in kuntum la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men whom We inspired - Ask the followers of the Remembrance if ye know not! -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bialbayyinati waalzzuburi waanzalna ilayka alththikra litubayyina lilnnasi ma nuzzila ilayhim walaAAallahum yatafakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} With clear proofs and writings; and We have revealed unto thee the Remembrance that thou mayst explain to mankind that which hath been revealed for them, and that haply they may reflect.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaamina allatheena makaroo alssayyiati an yakhsifa Allahu bihimu alarda aw yatiyahumu alAAathabu min haythu la yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Are they who plan ill-deeds then secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them, or that the doom will not come on them whence they know not?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw yakhuthahum fee taqallubihim fama hum bimuAAjizeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or that He will not seize them in their going to and fro so that there be no escape for them?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw yakhuthahum AAala takhawwufin fainna rabbakum laraoofun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or that He will not seize them with a gradual wasting? Lo! thy Lord is indeed Full of Pity, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awa lam yaraw ila ma khalaqa Allahu min shayin yatafayyao thilaluhu AAani alyameeni waalshshamaili sujjadan lillahi wahum dakhiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not observed all things that Allah hath created, how their shadows incline to the right and to the left, making prostration unto Allah, and they are lowly?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walillahi yasjudu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi min dabbatin waalmalaikatu wahum la yastakbiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto Allah maketh prostration whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth of living creatures, and the angels (also) and they are not proud.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yakhafoona rabbahum min fawqihim wayafAAaloona ma yumaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They fear their Lord above them, and do what they are bidden.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala Allahu la tattakhithoo ilahayni ithnayni innama huwa ilahun wahidun faiyyaya fairhabooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah hath said: Choose not two gods. There is only One Allah. So of Me, Me only, be in awe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walahu ma fee alssamawati waalardi walahu alddeenu wasiban afaghayra Allahi tattaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth, and religion is His for ever. Will ye then fear any other than Allah?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama bikum min niAAmatin famina Allahi thumma itha massakumu alddurru failayhi tajaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whatever of comfort ye enjoy, it is from Allah. Then, when misfortune reacheth you, unto Him ye cry for help.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma itha kashafa alddurra AAankum itha fareequn minkum birabbihim yushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And afterward, when He hath rid you of the misfortune, behold! a set of you attribute partners to their Lord,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyakfuroo bima ataynahum fatamattaAAoo fasawfa taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So as to deny that which We have given them. Then enjoy life (while ye may), for ye will come to know.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WayajAAaloona lima la yaAAlamoona naseeban mimma razaqnahum taAllahi latusalunna AAamma kuntum taftaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they assign a portion of that which We have given them unto what they know not. By Allah! but ye will indeed be asked concerning (all) that ye used to invent.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WayajAAaloona lillahi albanati subhanahu walahum ma yashtahoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they assign unto Allah daughters - Be He Glorified! - and unto themselves what they desire;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha bushshira ahaduhum bialontha thalla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa katheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When if one of them receiveth tidings of the birth of a female, his face remaineth darkened, and he is wroth inwardly.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yatawara mina alqawmi min sooi ma bushshira bihi ayumsikuhu AAala hoonin am yadussuhu fee altturabi ala saa ma yahkumoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He hideth himself from the folk because of the evil of that whereof he hath had tidings, (asking himself): Shall he keep it in contempt, or bury it beneath the dust. Verily evil is their judgment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lillatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati mathalu alssawi walillahi almathalu alaAAla wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For those who believe not in the Hereafter is an evil similitude, and Allah's is the Sublime Similitude. He is the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw yuakhithu Allahu alnnasa bithulmihim ma taraka AAalayha min dabbatin walakin yuakhkhiruhum ila ajalin musamman faitha jaa ajaluhum la yastakhiroona saAAatan wala yastaqdimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If Allah were to take mankind to task for their wrong-doing, he would not leave hereon a living creature, but He reprieveth them to an appointed term, and when their term cometh they cannot put (it) off an hour nor (yet) advance (it).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WayajAAaloona lillahi ma yakrahoona watasifu alsinatuhumu alkathiba anna lahumu alhusna la jarama anna lahumu alnnara waannahum mufratoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they assign unto Allah that which they (themselves) dislike, and their tongues expound the lie that the better portion will be theirs. Assuredly theirs will be the Fire, and they will be abandoned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{TaAllahi laqad arsalna ila omamin min qablika fazayyana lahumu alshshaytanu aAAmalahum fahuwa waliyyuhumu alyawma walahum AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By Allah, We verily sent messengers unto the nations before thee, but the devil made their deeds fairseeming unto them. So he is their patron this day, and theirs will be a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama anzalna AAalayka alkitaba illa litubayyina lahumu allathee ikhtalafoo feehi wahudan warahmatan liqawmin yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We have revealed the Scripture unto thee only that thou mayst explain unto them that wherein they differ, and (as) a guidance and a mercy for a people who believe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAllahu anzala mina alssamai maan faahya bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yasmaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah sendeth down water from the sky and therewith reviveth the earth after her death. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for a folk who hear.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna lakum fee alanAAami laAAibratan nusqeekum mimma fee butoonihi min bayni farthin wadamin labanan khalisan saighan lilshsharibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! in the cattle there is a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, from betwixt the refuse and the blood, pure milk palatable to the drinkers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamin thamarati alnnakheeli waalaAAnabi tattakhithoona minhu sakaran warizqan hasanan inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yaAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of the fruits of the date-palm, and grapes, whence ye derive strong drink and (also) good nourishment. Lo! therein is indeed a portent for people who have sense.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waawha rabbuka ila alnnahli ani ittakhithee mina aljibali buyootan wamina alshshajari wamimma yaAArishoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thy Lord inspired the bee, saying: Choose thou habitations in the hills and in the trees and in that which they thatch;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma kulee min kulli alththamarati faoslukee subula rabbiki thululan yakhruju min butooniha sharabun mukhtalifun alwanuhu feehi shifaon lilnnasi inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yatafakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then eat of all fruits, and follow the ways of thy Lord, made smooth (for thee). There cometh forth from their bellies a drink divers of hues, wherein is healing for mankind. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for people who reflect.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAllahu khalaqakum thumma yatawaffakum waminkum man yuraddu ila arthali alAAumuri likay la yaAAlama baAAda AAilmin shayan inna Allaha AAaleemun qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah createth you, then causeth you to die, and among you is he who is brought back to the most abject stage of life, so that he knoweth nothing after (having had) knowledge. Lo! Allah is Knower, Powerful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAllahu faddala baAAdakum AAala baAAdin fee alrrizqi fama allatheena fuddiloo biraddee rizqihim AAala ma malakat aymanuhum fahum feehi sawaon afabiniAAmati Allahi yajhadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah hath favoured some of you above others in provision. Now those who are more favoured will by no means hand over their provision to those (slaves) whom their right hands possess, so that they may be equal with them in respect thereof. Is it then the grace of Allah that they deny?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAllahu jaAAala lakum min anfusikum azwajan wajaAAala lakum min azwajikum baneena wahafadatan warazaqakum mina alttayyibati afabialbatili yuminoona wabiniAAmati Allahi hum yakfuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah hath given you wives of your own kind, and hath given you, from your wives, sons and grandsons, and hath made provision of good things for you. Is it then in vanity that they believe and in the grace of Allah that they disbelieve?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WayaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yamliku lahum rizqan mina alssamawati waalardi shayan wala yastateeAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they worship beside Allah that which owneth no provision whatsoever for them from the heavens or the earth, nor have they (whom they worship) any power.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala tadriboo lillahi alamthala inna Allaha yaAAlamu waantum la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So coin not similitudes for Allah. Lo! Allah knoweth; ye know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Daraba Allahu mathalan AAabdan mamlookan la yaqdiru AAala shayin waman razaqnahu minna rizqan hasanan fahuwa yunfiqu minhu sirran wajahran hal yastawoona alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah coineth a similitude: (on the one hand) a (mere) chattel slave, who hath control of nothing, and (on the other hand) one on whom we have bestowed a fair provision from Us, and he spendeth thereof secretly and openly. Are they equal? Praise be to Allah! But most of them know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wadaraba Allahu mathalan rajulayni ahaduhuma abkamu la yaqdiru AAala shayin wahuwa kallun AAala mawlahu aynama yuwajjihhu la yati bikhayrin hal yastawee huwa waman yamuru bialAAadli wahuwa AAala siratin mustaqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah coineth a similitude: Two men, one of them dumb, having control of nothing, and he is a burden on his owner; whithersoever he directeth him to go, he bringeth no good. Is he equal with one who enjoineth justice and followeth a straight path (of conduct)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walillahi ghaybu alssamawati waalardi wama amru alssaAAati illa kalamhi albasari aw huwa aqrabu inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto Allah belongeth the Unseen of the heavens and the earth, and the matter of the Hour (of Doom) is but as a twinkling of the eye, or it is nearer still. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAllahu akhrajakum min butooni ommahatikum la taAAlamoona shayan wajaAAala lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata laAAallakum tashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers knowing nothing, and gave you hearing and sight and hearts that haply ye might give thanks.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam yaraw ila alttayri musakhkharatin fee jawwi alssamai ma yumsikuhunna illa Allahu inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not seen the birds obedient in mid-air? None holdeth them save Allah. Lo! herein, verily, are portents for a people who believe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAllahu jaAAala lakum min buyootikum sakanan wajaAAala lakum min juloodi alanAAami buyootan tastakhiffoonaha yawma thaAAnikum wayawma iqamatikum wamin aswafiha waawbariha waashAAariha athathan wamataAAan ila heenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah hath given you in your houses an abode, and hath given you (also), of the hides of cattle, houses which ye find light (to carry) on the day of migration and on the day of pitching camp; and of their wool and their fur and their hair, caparison and comfort for a while.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAllahu jaAAala lakum mimma khalaqa thilalan wajaAAala lakum mina aljibali aknanan wajaAAala lakum sarabeela taqeekumu alharra wasarabeela taqeekum basakum kathalika yutimmu niAAmatahu AAalaykum laAAallakum tuslimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah hath given you, of that which He hath created, shelter from the sun; and hath given you places of refuge in the mountains, and hath given you coats to ward off the heat from you, and coats (of armour) to save you from your own foolhardiness. Thus doth He perfect His favour unto you, in order that ye may surrender (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain tawallaw fainnama AAalayka albalaghu almubeenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, if they turn away, thy duty (O Muhammad) is but plain conveyance (of the message).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YaAArifoona niAAmata Allahi thumma yunkiroonaha waaktharuhumu alkafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They know the favour of Allah and then deny it. Most of them are ingrates.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma nabAAathu min kulli ommatin shaheedan thumma la yuthanu lillatheena kafaroo wala hum yustaAAtaboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (bethink you of) the day when we raise up of every nation a witness, then there is no leave for disbelievers, nor are they allowed to make amends.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha raa allatheena thalamoo alAAathaba fala yukhaffafu AAanhum wala hum yuntharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when those who did wrong behold the doom, it will not be made light for them, nor will they be reprieved.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha raa allatheena ashrakoo shurakaahum qaloo rabbana haolai shurakaona allatheena kunna nadAAoo min doonika faalqaw ilayhimu alqawla innakum lakathiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when those who ascribed partners to Allah behold those partners of theirs, they will say: Our Lord! these are our partners unto whom we used to cry instead of Thee. But they will fling to them the saying: Lo! ye verily are liars!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalqaw ila Allahi yawmaithin alssalama wadalla AAanhum ma kanoo yaftaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they proffer unto Allah submission on that day, and all that they used to invent hath failed them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi zidnahum AAathaban fawqa alAAathabi bima kanoo yufsidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For those who disbelieve and debar (men) from the way of Allah, We add doom to doom because they wrought corruption,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma nabAAathu fee kulli ommatin shaheedan AAalayhim min anfusihim wajina bika shaheedan AAala haolai wanazzalna AAalayka alkitaba tibyanan likulli shayin wahudan warahmatan wabushra lilmuslimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (bethink you of) the day when We raise in every nation a witness against them of their own folk, and We bring thee (Muhammad) as a witness against these. And We reveal the Scripture unto thee as an exposition of all things, and a guidance and a mercy and good tidings for those who have surrendered (to Allah).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha yamuru bialAAadli waalihsani waeetai thee alqurba wayanha AAani alfahshai waalmunkari waalbaghyi yaAAithukum laAAallakum tathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah enjoineth justice and kindness, and giving to kinsfolk, and forbiddeth lewdness and abomination and wickedness. He exhorteth you in order that ye may take heed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waawfoo biAAahdi Allahi itha AAahadtum wala tanqudoo alaymana baAAda tawkeediha waqad jaAAaltumu Allaha AAalaykum kafeelan inna Allaha yaAAlamu ma tafAAaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Fulfil the covenant of Allah when ye have covenanted, and break not your oaths after the asseveration of them, and after ye have made Allah surety over you. Lo! Allah knoweth what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala takoonoo kaallatee naqadat ghazlaha min baAAdi quwwatin ankathan tattakhithoona aymanakum dakhalan baynakum an takoona ommatun hiya arba min ommatin innama yablookumu Allahu bihi walayubayyinanna lakum yawma alqiyamati ma kuntum feehi takhtalifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And be not like unto her who unravelleth the thread, after she hath made it strong, to thin filaments, making your oaths a deceit between you because of a nation being more numerous than (another) nation. Allah only trieth you thereby, and He verily will explain to you on the Day of Resurrection that wherein ye differed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw shaa Allahu lajaAAalakum ommatan wahidatan walakin yudillu man yashao wayahdee man yashao walatusalunna AAamma kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Had Allah willed He could have made you (all) one nation, but He sendeth whom He will astray and guideth whom He will, and ye will indeed be asked of what ye used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tattakhithoo aymanakum dakhalan baynakum fatazilla qadamun baAAda thubootiha watathooqoo alssooa bima sadadtum AAan sabeeli Allahi walakum AAathabun AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Make not your oaths a deceit between you, lest a foot should slip after being firmly planted and ye should taste evil forasmuch as ye debarred (men) from the way of Allah, and yours should be an awful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tashtaroo biAAahdi Allahi thamanan qaleelan innama AAinda Allahi huwa khayrun lakum in kuntum taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And purchase not a small gain at the price of Allah's covenant. Lo! that which Allah hath is better for you, if ye did but know.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma AAindakum yanfadu wama AAinda Allahi baqin walanajziyanna allatheena sabaroo ajrahum biahsani ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That which ye have wasteth away, and that which Allah hath remaineth. And verily We shall pay those who are steadfast a recompense in proportion to the best of what they used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man AAamila salihan min thakarin aw ontha wahuwa muminun falanuhyiyannahu hayatan tayyibatan walanajziyannahum ajrahum biahsani ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whosoever doeth right, whether male or female, and is a believer, him verily we shall quicken with good life, and We shall pay them a recompense in proportion to the best of what they used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha qarata alqurana faistaAAith biAllahi mina alshshaytani alrrajeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when thou recitest the Qur'an, seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu laysa lahu sultanun AAala allatheena amanoo waAAala rabbihim yatawakkaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! he hath no power over those who believe and put trust in their Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama sultanuhu AAala allatheena yatawallawnahu waallatheena hum bihi mushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} His power is only over those who make a friend of him, and those who ascribe partners unto Him (Allah).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha baddalna ayatan makana ayatin waAllahu aAAlamu bima yunazzilu qaloo innama anta muftarin bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We put a revelation in place of (another) revelation, - and Allah knoweth best what He revealeth - they say: Lo! thou art but inventing. Most of them know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul nazzalahu roohu alqudusi min rabbika bialhaqqi liyuthabbita allatheena amanoo wahudan wabushra lilmuslimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: The holy Spirit hath delivered it from thy Lord with truth, that it may confirm (the faith of) those who believe, and as guidance and good tidings for those who have surrendered (to Allah).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad naAAlamu annahum yaqooloona innama yuAAallimuhu basharun lisanu allathee yulhidoona ilayhi aAAjamiyyun wahatha lisanun AAarabiyyun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We know well that they say: Only a man teacheth him. The speech of him at whom they falsely hint is outlandish, and this is clear Arabic speech.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena la yuminoona biayati Allahi la yahdeehimu Allahu walahum AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who disbelieve the revelations of Allah, Allah guideth them not and theirs will be a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama yaftaree alkathiba allatheena la yuminoona biayati Allahi waolaika humu alkathiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Only they invent falsehood who believe not Allah's revelations, and (only) they are the liars.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man kafara biAllahi min baAAdi eemanihi illa man okriha waqalbuhu mutmainnun bialeemani walakin man sharaha bialkufri sadran faAAalayhim ghadabun mina Allahi walahum AAathabun AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whoso disbelieveth in Allah after his belief - save him who is forced thereto and whose heart is still content with the Faith - but whoso findeth ease in disbelief: On them is wrath from Allah. Theirs will be an awful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika biannahumu istahabboo alhayata alddunya AAala alakhirati waanna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That is because they have chosen the life of the world rather than the Hereafter, and because Allah guideth not the disbelieving folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika allatheena tabaAAa Allahu AAala quloobihim wasamAAihim waabsarihim waolaika humu alghafiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such are they whose hearts and ears and eyes Allah hath sealed. And such are the heedless.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La jarama annahum fee alakhirati humu alkhasiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Assuredly in the Hereafter they are the losers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma inna rabbaka lillatheena hajaroo min baAAdi ma futinoo thumma jahadoo wasabaroo inna rabbaka min baAAdiha laghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then lo! thy Lord - for those who became fugitives after they had been persecuted, and then fought and were steadfast - lo! thy Lord afterward is (for them) indeed Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma tatee kullu nafsin tujadilu AAan nafsiha watuwaffa kullu nafsin ma AAamilat wahum la yuthlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the Day when every soul will come pleading for itself, and every soul will be repaid what it did, and they will not be wronged.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][112]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wadaraba Allahu mathalan qaryatan kanat aminatan mutmainnatan yateeha rizquha raghadan min kulli makanin fakafarat bianAAumi Allahi faathaqaha Allahu libasa aljooAAi waalkhawfi bima kanoo yasnaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah coineth a similitude: a township that dwelt secure and well content, its provision coming to it in abundance from every side, but it disbelieved in Allah's favours, so Allah made it experience the garb of dearth and fear because of what they used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][113]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad jaahum rasoolun minhum fakaththaboohu faakhathahumu alAAathabu wahum thalimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily there had come unto them a messenger from among them, but they had denied him, and so the torment seized them while they were wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][114]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakuloo mimma razaqakumu Allahu halalan tayyiban waoshkuroo niAAmata Allahi in kuntum iyyahu taAAbudoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So eat of the lawful and good food which Allah hath provided for you, and thank the bounty of your Lord if it is Him ye serve.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][115]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama harrama AAalaykumu almaytata waalddama walahma alkhinzeeri wama ohilla lighayri Allahi bihi famani idturra ghayra baghin wala AAadin fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He hath forbidden for you only carrion and blood and swineflesh and that which hath been immolated in the name of any other than Allah; but he who is driven thereto, neither craving nor transgressing, lo! then Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][116]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala taqooloo lima tasifu alsinatukumu alkathiba hatha halalun wahatha haramun litaftaroo AAala Allahi alkathiba inna allatheena yaftaroona AAala Allahi alkathiba la yuflihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And speak not, concerning that which your own tongues qualify (as clean or unclean), the falsehood: "This is lawful, and this is forbidden," so that ye invent a lie against Allah. Lo! those who invent a lie against Allah will not succeed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][117]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{MataAAun qaleelun walahum AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A brief enjoyment (will be theirs); and theirs a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][118]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAala allatheena hadoo harramna ma qasasna AAalayka min qablu wama thalamnahum walakin kanoo anfusahum yathlimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto those who are Jews We have forbidden that which We have already related unto thee. And We wronged them not, but they were wont to wrong themselves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][119]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma inna rabbaka lillatheena AAamiloo alssooa bijahalatin thumma taboo min baAAdi thalika waaslahoo inna rabbaka min baAAdiha laghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then lo! thy Lord - for those who do evil in ignorance and afterward repent and amend - lo! (for them) thy Lord is afterward indeed Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][120]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna ibraheema kana ommatan qanitan lillahi haneefan walam yaku mina almushrikeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Abraham was a nation obedient to Allah, by nature upright, and he was not of the idolaters;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][121]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Shakiran lianAAumihi ijtabahu wahadahu ila siratin mustaqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thankful for His bounties; He chose him and He guided him unto a straight path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][122]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waataynahu fee alddunya hasanatan wainnahu fee alakhirati lamina alssaliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We gave him good in the world, and in the Hereafter he is among the righteous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][123]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma awhayna ilayka ani ittabiAA millata ibraheema haneefan wama kana mina almushrikeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And afterward We inspired thee (Muhammad, saying): Follow the religion of Abraham, as one by nature upright. He was not of the idolaters.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][124]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama juAAila alssabtu AAala allatheena ikhtalafoo feehi wainna rabbaka layahkumu baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Sabbath was appointed only for those who differed concerning it, and lo! thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][125]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{OdAAu ila sabeeli rabbika bialhikmati waalmawAAithati alhasanati wajadilhum biallatee hiya ahsanu inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bialmuhtadeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Call unto the way of thy Lord with wisdom and fair exhortation, and reason with them in the better way. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who go aright.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][126]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain AAaqabtum faAAaqiboo bimithli ma AAooqibtum bihi walain sabartum lahuwa khayrun lilssabireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If ye punish, then punish with the like of that wherewith ye were afflicted. But if ye endure patiently, verily it is better for the patient.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][127]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waisbir wama sabruka illa biAllahi wala tahzan AAalayhim wala taku fee dayqin mimma yamkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Endure thou patiently (O Muhammad). Thine endurance is only by (the help of) Allah. Grieve not for them, and be not in distress because of that which they devise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[16][128]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha maAAa allatheena ittaqaw waallatheena hum muhsinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah is with those who keep their duty unto Him and those who are doers of good.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Bani Isra'il (The Israelites)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Subhana allathee asra biAAabdihi laylan mina almasjidi alharami ila almasjidi alaqsa allathee barakna hawlahu linuriyahu min ayatina innahu huwa alssameeAAu albaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Glorified be He Who carried His servant by night from the Inviolable Place of Worship to the Far distant place of worship the neighbourhood whereof We have blessed, that We might show him of Our tokens! Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Seer.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waatayna moosa alkitaba wajaAAalnahu hudan libanee israeela alla tattakhithoo min doonee wakeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We gave unto Moses the Scripture, and We appointed it a guidance for the children of Israel, saying: Choose no guardian beside Me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thurriyyata man hamalna maAAa noohin innahu kana AAabdan shakooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (They were) the seed of those whom We carried (in the ship) along with Noah. Lo! he was a grateful slave.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqadayna ila banee israeela fee alkitabi latufsidunna fee alardi marratayni walataAAlunna AAuluwwan kabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We decreed for the Children of Israel in the Scripture: Ye verily will work corruption in the earth twice, and ye will become great tyrants.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha jaa waAAdu oolahuma baAAathna AAalaykum AAibadan lana olee basin shadeedin fajasoo khilala alddiyari wakana waAAdan mafAAoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So when the time for the first of the two came, We roused against you slaves of Ours of great might who ravaged (your) country, and it was a threat performed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma radadna lakumu alkarrata AAalayhim waamdadnakum biamwalin wabaneena wajaAAalnakum akthara nafeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then we gave you once again your turn against them, and We aided you with wealth and children and made you more in soldiery.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In ahsantum ahsantum lianfusikum wain asatum falaha faitha jaa waAAdu alakhirati liyasoooo wujoohakum waliyadkhuloo almasjida kama dakhaloohu awwala marratin waliyutabbiroo ma AAalaw tatbeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Saying): If ye do good, ye do good for your own souls, and if ye do evil, it is for them (in like manner). So, when the time for the second (of the judgments) came (We roused against you others of Our slaves) to ravage you, and to enter the Temple even as they entered it the first time, and to lay waste all that they conquered with an utter wasting.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAasa rabbukum an yarhamakum wain AAudtum AAudna wajaAAalna jahannama lilkafireena haseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It may be that your Lord will have mercy on you, but if ye repeat (the crime) We shall repeat (the punishment), and We have appointed hell a dungeon for the disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna hatha alqurana yahdee lillatee hiya aqwamu wayubashshiru almumineena allatheena yaAAmaloona alssalihati anna lahum ajran kabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! this Qur'an guideth unto that which is straightest, and giveth tidings unto the believers who do good works that theirs will be a great reward.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati aAAtadna lahum AAathaban aleeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that those who believe not in the Hereafter, for them We have prepared a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WayadAAu alinsanu bialshsharri duAAaahu bialkhayri wakana alinsanu AAajoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Man prayeth for evil as he prayeth for good; for man was ever hasty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalna allayla waalnnahara ayatayni famahawna ayata allayli wajaAAalna ayata alnnahari mubsiratan litabtaghoo fadlan min rabbikum walitaAAlamoo AAadada alssineena waalhisaba wakulla shayin fassalnahu tafseelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We appoint the night and the day two portents. Then We make dark the portent of the night, and We make the portent of the day sight-giving, that ye may seek bounty from your Lord, and that ye may know the computation of the years, and the reckoning; and everything have We expounded with a clear expounding.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakulla insanin alzamnahu tairahu fee AAunuqihi wanukhriju lahu yawma alqiyamati kitaban yalqahu manshooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And every man's augury have We fastened to his own neck, and We shall bring forth for him on the Day of Resurrection a book which he will find wide open.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Iqra kitabaka kafa binafsika alyawma AAalayka haseeban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And it will be said unto him): Read thy Book. Thy soul sufficeth as reckoner against thee this day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Mani ihtada fainnama yahtadee linafsihi waman dalla fainnama yadillu AAalayha wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra wama kunna muAAaththibeena hatta nabAAatha rasoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whosoever goeth right, it is only for (the good of) his own soul that he goeth right, and whosoever erreth, erreth only to its hurt. No laden soul can bear another's load, We never punish until we have sent a messenger.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha aradna an nuhlika qaryatan amarna mutrafeeha fafasaqoo feeha fahaqqa AAalayha alqawlu fadammarnaha tadmeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We would destroy a township We send commandment to its folk who live at ease, and afterward they commit abomination therein, and so the Word (of doom) hath effect for it, and we annihilate it with complete annihilation.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakam ahlakna mina alqurooni min baAAdi noohin wakafa birabbika bithunoobi AAibadihi khabeeran baseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How many generations have We destroyed since Noah! And Allah sufficeth as Knower and Beholder of the sins of His slaves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man kana yureedu alAAajilata AAajjalna lahu feeha ma nashao liman nureedu thumma jaAAalna lahu jahannama yaslaha mathmooman madhooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whoso desireth that (life) which hasteneth away, We hasten for him therein what We will for whom We please. And afterward We have appointed for him hell; he will endure the heat thereof, condemned, rejected.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman arada alakhirata wasaAAa laha saAAyaha wahuwa muminun faolaika kana saAAyuhum mashkooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whoso desireth the Hereafter and striveth for it with the effort necessary, being a believer; for such, their effort findeth favour (with their Lord).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kullan numiddu haolai wahaolai min AAatai rabbika wama kana AAatao rabbika mahthooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Each do We supply, both these and those, from the bounty of thy Lord. And the bounty of thy Lord can never be walled up.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Onthur kayfa faddalna baAAdahum AAala baAAdin walalakhiratu akbaru darajatin waakbaru tafdeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} See how We prefer one of them above another, and verily the Hereafter will be greater in degrees and greater in preferment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La tajAAal maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fataqAAuda mathmooman makhthoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Set not up with Allah any other god (O man) lest thou sit down reproved, forsaken.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqada rabbuka alla taAAbudoo illa iyyahu wabialwalidayni ihsanan imma yablughanna AAindaka alkibara ahaduhuma aw kilahuma fala taqul lahuma offin wala tanharhuma waqul lahuma qawlan kareeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thy Lord hath decreed, that ye worship none save Him, and (that ye show) kindness to parents. If one of them or both of them attain old age with thee, say not "Fie" unto them nor repulse them, but speak unto them a gracious word.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waikhfid lahuma janaha alththulli mina alrrahmati waqul rabbi irhamhuma kama rabbayanee sagheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lower unto them the wing of submission through mercy, and say: My Lord! Have mercy on them both as they did care for me when I was little.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbukum aAAlamu bima fee nufoosikum in takoonoo saliheena fainnahu kana lilawwabeena ghafooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Your Lord is Best Aware of what is in your minds. If ye are righteous, then lo! He was ever Forgiving unto those who turn (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waati tha alqurba haqqahu waalmiskeena waibna alssabeeli wala tubaththir tabtheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Give the kinsman his due, and the needy, and the wayfarer, and squander not (thy wealth) in wantonness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna almubaththireena kanoo ikhwana alshshayateeni wakana alshshaytanu lirabbihi kafooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the squanderers were ever brothers of the devils, and the devil was ever an ingrate to his Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waimma tuAAridanna AAanhumu ibtighaa rahmatin min rabbika tarjooha faqul lahum qawlan maysooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But if thou turn away from them, seeking mercy from thy Lord, for which thou hopest, then speak unto them a reasonable word.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tajAAal yadaka maghloolatan ila AAunuqika wala tabsutha kulla albasti fataqAAuda malooman mahsooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And let not thy hand be chained to thy neck nor open it with a complete opening, lest thou sit down rebuked, denuded.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna rabbaka yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru innahu kana biAAibadihi khabeeran baseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thy Lord enlargeth the provision for whom He will, and straiteneth (it for whom He will). Lo, He was ever Knower, Seer of His slaves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala taqtuloo awladakum khashyata imlaqin nahnu narzuquhum waiyyakum inna qatlahum kana khitan kabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Slay not your children, fearing a fall to poverty, We shall provide for them and for you. Lo! the slaying of them is great sin.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala taqraboo alzzina innahu kana fahishatan wasaa sabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And come not near unto adultery. Lo! it is an abomination and an evil way.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala taqtuloo alnnafsa allatee harrama Allahu illa bialhaqqi waman qutila mathlooman faqad jaAAalna liwaliyyihi sultanan fala yusrif fee alqatli innahu kana mansooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And slay not the life which Allah hath forbidden save with right. Whoso is slain wrongfully, We have given power unto his heir, but let him not commit excess in slaying. Lo! he will be helped.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala taqraboo mala alyateemi illa biallatee hiya ahsanu hatta yablugha ashuddahu waawfoo bialAAahdi inna alAAahda kana masoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Come not near the wealth of the orphan save with that which is better till he come to strength; and keep the covenant. Lo! of the covenant it will be asked.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waawfoo alkayla itha kiltum wazinoo bialqistasi almustaqeemi thalika khayrun waahsanu taweelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Fill the measure when ye measure, and weigh with a right balance; that is meet, and better in the end.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala taqfu ma laysa laka bihi AAilmun inna alssamAAa waalbasara waalfuada kullu olaika kana AAanhu masoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (O man), follow not that whereof thou hast no knowledge. Lo! the hearing and the sight and the heart - of each of these it will be asked.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tamshi fee alardi marahan innaka lan takhriqa alarda walan tablugha aljibala toolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And walk not in the earth exultant. Lo! thou canst not rend the earth, nor canst thou stretch to the height of the hills.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kullu thalika kana sayyiohu AAinda rabbika makroohan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The evil of all that is hateful in the sight of thy Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika mimma awha ilayka rabbuka mina alhikmati wala tajAAal maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fatulqa fee jahannama malooman madhooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is (part) of that wisdom wherewith thy Lord hath inspired thee (O Muhammad). And set not up with Allah any other god, lest thou be cast into hell, reproved, abandoned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaasfakum rabbukum bialbaneena waittakhatha mina almalaikati inathan innakum lataqooloona qawlan AAatheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hath your Lord then distinguished you (O men of Makka) by giving you sons, and hath chosen for Himself females from among the angels? Lo! verily ye speak an awful word!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][41]
\end{Arabic}}
