\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad sarrafna fee hatha alqurani liyaththakkaroo wama yazeeduhum illa nufooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We verily have displayed (Our warnings) in this Qur'an that they may take heed, but it increaseth them in naught save aversion.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul law kana maAAahu alihatun kama yaqooloona ithan laibtaghaw ila thee alAAarshi sabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad, to the disbelievers): If there were other gods along with Him, as they say, then had they sought a way against the Lord of the Throne.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yaqooloona AAuluwwan kabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Glorified is He, and High Exalted above what they say!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tusabbihu lahu alssamawatu alssabAAu waalardu waman feehinna wain min shayin illa yusabbihu bihamdihi walakin la tafqahoona tasbeehahum innahu kana haleeman ghafooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The seven heavens and the earth and all that is therein praise Him, and there is not a thing but hymneth His praise; but ye understand not their praise. Lo! He is ever Clement, Forgiving.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha qarata alqurana jaAAalna baynaka wabayna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati hijaban mastooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when thou recitest the Qur'an we place between thee and those who believe not in the Hereafter a hidden barrier;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalna AAala quloobihim akinnatan an yafqahoohu wafee athanihim waqran waitha thakarta rabbaka fee alqurani wahdahu wallaw AAala adbarihim nufooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We place upon their hearts veils lest they should understand it, and in their ears a deafness; and when thou makest mention of thy Lord alone in the Qur'an, they turn their backs in aversion.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Nahnu aAAlamu bima yastamiAAoona bihi ith yastamiAAoona ilayka waith hum najwa ith yaqoolu alththalimoona in tattabiAAoona illa rajulan mashooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We are Best Aware of what they wish to hear when they give ear to thee and when they take secret counsel, when the evil-doers say: Ye follow but a man bewitched.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Onthur kayfa daraboo laka alamthala fadalloo fala yastateeAAoona sabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} See what similitudes they coin for thee, and thus are all astray, and cannot find a road!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo aitha kunna AAithaman warufatan ainna lamabAAoothoona khalqan jadeedan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: When we are bones and fragments, shall we forsooth, be raised up as a new creation?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul koonoo hijaratan aw hadeedan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Be ye stones or iron}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw khalqan mimma yakburu fee sudoorikum fasayaqooloona man yuAAeeduna quli allathee fatarakum awwala marratin fasayunghidoona ilayka ruoosahum wayaqooloona mata huwa qul AAasa an yakoona qareeban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or some created thing that is yet greater in your thoughts! Then they will say: Who shall bring us back (to life). Say: He Who created you at the first. Then will they shake their heads at thee, and say: When will it be? Say: It will perhaps be soon;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma yadAAookum fatastajeeboona bihamdihi watathunnoona in labithtum illa qaleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A day when He will call you and ye will answer with His praise, and ye will think that ye have tarried but a little while.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqul liAAibadee yaqooloo allatee hiya ahsanu inna alshshaytana yanzaghu baynahum inna alshshaytana kana lilinsani AAaduwwan mubeenan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Tell My bondmen to speak that which is kindlier. Lo! the devil soweth discord among them. Lo! the devil is for man an open foe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbukum aAAlamu bikum in yasha yarhamkum aw in yasha yuAAaththibkum wama arsalnaka AAalayhim wakeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Your Lord is Best Aware of you. If He will, He will have mercy on you, or if He will, He will punish you. We have not sent thee (O Muhammad) as a warden over them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Warabbuka aAAlamu biman fee alssamawati waalardi walaqad faddalna baAAda alnnabiyyeena AAala baAAdin waatayna dawooda zabooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thy Lord is Best Aware of all who are in the heavens and the earth. And we preferred some of the prophets above others, and unto David We gave the Psalms.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Quli odAAu allatheena zaAAamtum min doonihi fala yamlikoona kashfa alddurri AAankum wala tahweelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Cry unto those (saints and angels) whom ye assume (to be gods) beside Him, yet they have no power to rid you of misfortune nor to change.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika allatheena yadAAoona yabtaghoona ila rabbihimu alwaseelata ayyuhum aqrabu wayarjoona rahmatahu wayakhafoona AAathabahu inna AAathaba rabbika kana mahthooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those unto whom they cry seek the way of approach to their Lord, which of them shall be the nearest; they hope for His mercy and they fear His doom. Lo! the doom of thy Lord is to be shunned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain min qaryatin illa nahnu muhlikooha qabla yawmi alqiyamati aw muAAaththibooha AAathaban shadeedan kana thalika fee alkitabi mastooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There is not a township but We shall destroy it ere the Day of Resurrection, or punish it with dire punishment. That is set forth in the Book (of Our decrees).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama manaAAana an nursila bialayati illa an kaththaba biha alawwaloona waatayna thamooda alnnaqata mubsiratan fathalamoo biha wama nursilu bialayati illa takhweefan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Naught hindereth Us from sending portents save that the folk of old denied them. And We gave Thamud the she-camel - a clear portent save to warn.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qulna laka inna rabbaka ahata bialnnasi wama jaAAalna alrruya allatee araynaka illa fitnatan lilnnasi waalshshajarata almalAAoonata fee alqurani wanukhawwifuhum fama yazeeduhum illa tughyanan kabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (it was a warning) when we told thee: Lo! thy Lord encompasseth mankind, and We appointed the sight which We showed thee as an ordeal for mankind, and (likewise) the Accursed Tree in the Qur'an. We warn them, but it increaseth them in naught save gross impiety.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa qala aasjudu liman khalaqta teenan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We said unto the angels: Fall down prostrate before Adam and they fell prostrate all save Iblis, he said: Shall I fall prostrate before that which Thou hast created of clay?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala araaytaka hatha allathee karramta AAalayya lain akhkhartani ila yawmi alqiyamati laahtanikanna thurriyyatahu illa qaleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Seest Thou this (creature) whom Thou hast honoured above me, if Thou give me grace until the Day of Resurrection I verily will seize his seed, save but a few.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ithhab faman tabiAAaka minhum fainna jahannama jazaokum jazaan mawfooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Go, and whosoever of them followeth thee - lo! hell will be your payment, ample payment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waistafziz mani istataAAta minhum bisawtika waajlib AAalayhim bikhaylika warajlika washarikhum fee alamwali waalawladi waAAidhum wama yaAAiduhumu alshshaytanu illa ghurooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And excite any of them whom thou canst with thy voice, and urge thy horse and foot against them, and be a partner in their wealth and children, and promise them. Satan promiseth them only to deceive.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna AAibadee laysa laka AAalayhim sultanun wakafa birabbika wakeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! My (faithful) bondmen - over them thou hast no power, and thy Lord sufficeth as (their) guardian.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbukumu allathee yuzjee lakumu alfulka fee albahri litabtaghoo min fadlihi innahu kana bikum raheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (O mankind), your Lord is He Who driveth for you the ship upon the sea that ye may seek of His bounty. Lo! He was ever Merciful toward you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha massakumu alddurru fee albahri dalla man tadAAoona illa iyyahu falamma najjakum ila albarri aAAradtum wakana alinsanu kafooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when harm toucheth you upon the sea, all unto whom ye cry (for succour) fail save Him (alone), but when He bringeth you safe to land, ye turn away, for man was ever thankless.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaamintum an yakhsifa bikum janiba albarri aw yursila AAalaykum hasiban thumma la tajidoo lakum wakeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Feel ye then secure that He will not cause a slope of the land to engulf you, or send a sand-storm upon you, and then ye will find that ye have no protector?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am amintum an yuAAeedakum feehi taratan okhra fayursila AAalaykum qasifan mina alrreehi fayughriqakum bima kafartum thumma la tajidoo lakum AAalayna bihi tabeeAAan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or feel ye secure that He will not return you to that (plight) a second time, and send against you a hurricane of wind and drown you for your thanklessness, and then ye will not find therein that ye have any avenger against Us?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad karramna banee adama wahamalnahum fee albarri waalbahri warazaqnahum mina alttayyibati wafaddalnahum AAala katheerin mimman khalaqna tafdeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Verily we have honoured the Children of Adam. We carry them on the land and the sea, and have made provision of good things for them, and have preferred them above many of those whom We created with a marked preferment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma nadAAoo kulla onasin biimamihim faman ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi faolaika yaqraoona kitabahum wala yuthlamoona fateelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when We shall summon all men with their record, whoso is given his book in his right hand - such will read their book and they will not be wronged a shred.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman kana fee hathihi aAAma fahuwa fee alakhirati aAAma waadallu sabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whoso is blind here will be blind in the Hereafter, and yet further from the road.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain kadoo layaftinoonaka AAani allathee awhayna ilayka litaftariya AAalayna ghayrahu waithan laittakhathooka khaleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they indeed strove hard to beguile thee (Muhammad) away from that wherewith We have inspired thee, that thou shouldst invent other than it against Us; and then would they have accepted thee as a friend.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walawla an thabbatnaka laqad kidta tarkanu ilayhim shayan qaleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if We had not made thee wholly firm thou mightest almost have inclined unto them a little.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ithan laathaqnaka diAAfa alhayati wadiAAfa almamati thumma la tajidu laka AAalayna naseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then had we made thee taste a double (punishment) of living and a double (punishment) of dying, then hadst thou found no helper against Us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain kadoo layastafizzoonaka mina alardi liyukhrijooka minha waithan la yalbathoona khilafaka illa qaleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they indeed wished to scare thee from the land that they might drive thee forth from thence, and then they would have stayed (there) but a little after thee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sunnata man qad arsalna qablaka min rusulina wala tajidu lisunnatina tahweelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Such was Our) method in the case of those whom We sent before thee (to mankind), and thou wilt not find for Our method aught of power to change.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aqimi alssalata lidulooki alshshamsi ila ghasaqi allayli waqurana alfajri inna qurana alfajri kana mashhoodan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Establish worship at the going down of the sun until the dark of night, and (the recital of) the Qur'an at dawn. Lo! (the recital of) the Qur'an at dawn is ever witnessed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamina allayli fatahajjad bihi nafilatan laka AAasa an yabAAathaka rabbuka maqaman mahmoodan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And some part of the night awake for it, a largess for thee. It may be that thy Lord will raise thee to a praised estate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqul rabbi adkhilnee mudkhala sidqin waakhrijnee mukhraja sidqin waijAAal lee min ladunka sultanan naseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And say: My Lord! Cause me to come in with a firm incoming and to go out with a firm outgoing. And give me from Thy presence a sustaining Power.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqul jaa alhaqqu wazahaqa albatilu inna albatila kana zahooqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And say: Truth hath come and falsehood hath vanished away. Lo! falsehood is ever bound to vanish.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanunazzilu mina alqurani ma huwa shifaon warahmatun lilmumineena wala yazeedu alththalimeena illa khasaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We reveal of the Qur'an that which is a healing and a mercy for believers though it increase the evil-doers in naught save ruin.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha anAAamna AAala alinsani aAArada wanaa bijanibihi waitha massahu alshsharru kana yaoosan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We make life pleasant unto man, he turneth away and is averse; and when ill toucheth him he is in despair.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul kullun yaAAmalu AAala shakilatihi farabbukum aAAlamu biman huwa ahda sabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Each one doth according to his rule of conduct, and thy Lord is Best Aware of him whose way is right.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayasaloonaka AAani alrroohi quli alrroohu min amri rabbee wama ooteetum mina alAAilmi illa qaleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They are asking thee concerning the Spirit. Say: The Spirit is by command of my Lord, and of knowledge ye have been vouchsafed but little.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walain shina lanathhabanna biallathee awhayna ilayka thumma la tajidu laka bihi AAalayna wakeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if We willed We could withdraw that which We have revealed unto thee, then wouldst thou find no guardian for thee against Us in respect thereof.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa rahmatan min rabbika inna fadlahu kana AAalayka kabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (It is naught) save mercy from thy Lord. Lo! His kindness unto thee was ever great.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul laini ijtamaAAati alinsu waaljinnu AAala an yatoo bimithli hatha alqurani la yatoona bimithlihi walaw kana baAAduhum libaAAdin thaheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Verily, though mankind and the jinn should assemble to produce the like of this Qur'an, they could not produce the like thereof though they were helpers one of another.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad sarrafna lilnnasi fee hatha alqurani min kulli mathalin faaba aktharu alnnasi illa kufooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We have displayed for mankind in this Qur'an all kind of similitudes, but most of mankind refuse aught save disbelief.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo lan numina laka hatta tafjura lana mina alardi yanbooAAan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: We will not put faith in thee till thou cause a spring to gush forth from the earth for us;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw takoona laka jannatun min nakheelin waAAinabin fatufajjira alanhara khilalaha tafjeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or thou have a garden of date-palms and grapes, and cause rivers to gush forth therein abundantly;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw tusqita alssamaa kama zaAAamta AAalayna kisafan aw tatiya biAllahi waalmalaikati qabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or thou cause the heaven to fall upon us piecemeal, as thou hast pretended, or bring Allah and the angels as a warrant;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw yakoona laka baytun min zukhrufin aw tarqa fee alssamai walan numina liruqiyyika hatta tunazzila AAalayna kitaban naqraohu qul subhana rabbee hal kuntu illa basharan rasoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or thou have a house of gold; or thou ascend up into heaven, and even then we will put no faith in thine ascension till thou bring down for us a book that we can read. Say (O Muhammad): My Lord be Glorified! Am I aught save a mortal messenger?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama manaAAa alnnasa an yuminoo ith jaahumu alhuda illa an qaloo abaAAatha Allahu basharan rasoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And naught prevented mankind from believing when the guidance came unto them save that they said: Hath Allah sent a mortal as (His) messenger?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul law kana fee alardi malaikatun yamshoona mutmainneena lanazzalna AAalayhim mina alssamai malakan rasoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: If there were in the earth angels walking secure, We had sent down for them from heaven an angel as messenger.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul kafa biAllahi shaheedan baynee wabaynakum innahu kana biAAibadihi khabeeran baseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Allah sufficeth for a witness between me and you. Lo! He is Knower, Seer of His slaves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman yahdi Allahu fahuwa almuhtadi waman yudlil falan tajida lahum awliyaa min doonihi wanahshuruhum yawma alqiyamati AAala wujoohihim AAumyan wabukman wasumman mawahum jahannamu kullama khabat zidnahum saAAeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he whom Allah guideth, he is led aright; while, as for him whom He sendeth astray, for them thou wilt find no protecting friends beside Him, and We shall assemble them on the Day of Resurrection on their faces, blind, dumb and deaf; their habitation will be hell; whenever it abateth, We increase the flame for them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika jazaohum biannahum kafaroo biayatina waqaloo aitha kunna AAithaman warufatan ainna lamabAAoothoona khalqan jadeedan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That is their reward because they disbelieved Our revelations and said: When we are bones and fragments shall we, forsooth, be raised up as a new creation?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yaraw anna Allaha allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda qadirun AAala an yakhluqa mithlahum wajaAAala lahum ajalan la rayba feehi faaba alththalimoona illa kufooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not seen that Allah Who created the heavens and the earth is Able to create the like of them, and hath appointed for them an end whereof there is no doubt? But the wrong-doers refuse aught save disbelief.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul law antum tamlikoona khazaina rahmati rabbee ithan laamsaktum khashyata alinfaqi wakana alinsanu qatooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them): If ye possessed the treasures of the mercy of my Lord, ye would surely hold them back for fear of spending, for man was ever grudging.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad atayna moosa tisAAa ayatin bayyinatin faisal banee israeela ith jaahum faqala lahu firAAawnu innee laathunnuka ya moosa mashooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We gave unto Moses nine tokens, clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty). Do but ask the Children of Israel how he came unto them, then Pharaoh said unto him: Lo! I deem thee one bewitched, O Moses.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala laqad AAalimta ma anzala haolai illa rabbu alssamawati waalardi basaira wainnee laathunnuka ya firAAawnu mathbooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: In truth thou knowest that none sent down these (portents) save the Lord of the heavens and the earth as proofs, and lo! (for my part) I deem thee lost, O Pharaoh.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faarada an yastafizzahum mina alardi faaghraqnahu waman maAAahu jameeAAan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he wished to scare them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him, all together.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqulna min baAAdihi libanee israeela oskunoo alarda faitha jaa waAAdu alakhirati jina bikum lafeefan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We said unto the Children of Israel after him: Dwell in the land; but when the promise of the Hereafter cometh to pass We shall bring you as a crowd gathered out of various nations.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wabialhaqqi anzalnahu wabialhaqqi nazala wama arsalnaka illa mubashshiran wanatheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} With truth have We sent it down, and with truth hath it descended. And We have sent thee as naught else save a bearer of good tidings and a warner.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waquranan faraqnahu litaqraahu AAala alnnasi AAala mukthin wanazzalnahu tanzeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (it is) a Qur'an that We have divided, that thou mayst recite it unto mankind at intervals, and We have revealed it by (successive) revelation.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul aminoo bihi aw la tuminoo inna allatheena ootoo alAAilma min qablihi itha yutla AAalayhim yakhirroona lilathqani sujjadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Believe therein or believe not, lo! those who were given knowledge before it, when it is read unto them, fall down prostrate on their faces, adoring,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayaqooloona subhana rabbina in kana waAAdu rabbina lamafAAoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Saying: Glory to our Lord! Verily the promise of our Lord must be fulfilled.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayakhirroona lilathqani yabkoona wayazeeduhum khushooAAan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They fall down on their faces, weeping, and it increaseth humility in them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Quli odAAoo Allaha awi odAAoo alrrahmana ayyan ma tadAAoo falahu alasmao alhusna wala tajhar bisalatika wala tukhafit biha waibtaghi bayna thalika sabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto mankind): Cry unto Allah, or cry unto the Beneficent, unto whichsoever ye cry (it is the same). His are the most beautiful names. And thou (Muhammad), be not loud-voiced in thy worship nor yet silent therein, but follow a way between.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[17][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waquli alhamdu lillahi allathee lam yattakhith waladan walam yakun lahu shareekun fee almulki walam yakun lahu waliyyun mina alththulli wakabbirhu takbeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And say: Praise be to Allah, Who hath not taken unto Himself a son, and Who hath no partner in the Sovereignty, nor hath He any protecting friend through dependence. And magnify Him with all magnificence.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Kahf (The Cave)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alhamdu lillahi allathee anzala AAala AAabdihi alkitaba walam yajAAal lahu AAiwajan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Praise be to Allah Who hath revealed the Scripture unto His slave, and hath not placed therein any crookedness,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qayyiman liyunthira basan shadeedan min ladunhu wayubashshira almumineena allatheena yaAAmaloona alssalihati anna lahum ajran hasanan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (But hath made it) straight, to give warning of stern punishment from Him, and to bring unto the believers who do good works the news that theirs will be a fair reward,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Makitheena feehi abadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Wherein they will abide for ever;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayunthira allatheena qaloo ittakhatha Allahu waladan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And to warn those who say: Allah hath chosen a son,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma lahum bihi min AAilmin wala liabaihim kaburat kalimatan takhruju min afwahihim in yaqooloona illa kathiban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (A thing) whereof they have no knowledge, nor (had) their fathers, Dreadful is the word that cometh out of their mouths. They speak naught but a lie.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FalaAAallaka bakhiAAun nafsaka AAala atharihim in lam yuminoo bihatha alhadeethi asafan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Yet it may be, if they believe not in this statement, that thou (Muhammad) wilt torment thy soul with grief over their footsteps.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna jaAAalna ma AAala alardi zeenatan laha linabluwahum ayyuhum ahsanu AAamalan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have placed all that is on the earth as an ornament thereof that We may try them: which of them is best in conduct.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna lajaAAiloona ma AAalayha saAAeedan juruzan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! We shall make all that is thereon a barren mound.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am hasibta anna ashaba alkahfi waalrraqeemi kanoo min ayatina AAajaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or deemest thou that the People of the Cave and the Inscription are a wonder among Our portents?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith awa alfityatu ila alkahfi faqaloo rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wahayyi lana min amrina rashadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When the young men fled for refuge to the Cave and said: Our Lord! Give us mercy from Thy presence, and shape for us right conduct in our plight.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fadarabna AAala athanihim fee alkahfi sineena AAadadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We sealed up their hearing in the Cave for a number of years.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma baAAathnahum linaAAlama ayyu alhizbayni ahsa lima labithoo amadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And afterward We raised them up that We might know which of the two parties would best calculate the time that they had tarried.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Nahnu naqussu AAalayka nabaahum bialhaqqi innahum fityatun amanoo birabbihim wazidnahum hudan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We narrate unto thee their story with truth. Lo! they were young men who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Warabatna AAala quloobihim ith qamoo faqaloo rabbuna rabbu alssamawati waalardi lan nadAAuwa min doonihi ilahan laqad qulna ithan shatatan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We made firm their hearts when they stood forth and said: Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. We cry unto no Allah beside Him, for then should we utter an enormity.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Haolai qawmuna ittakhathoo min doonihi alihatan lawla yatoona AAalayhim bisultanin bayyinin faman athlamu mimmani iftara AAala Allahi kathiban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} These, our people, have chosen (other) gods beside Him though they bring no clear warrant (vouchsafed) to them. And who doth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie concerning Allah?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waithi iAAtazaltumoohum wama yaAAbudoona illa Allaha fawoo ila alkahfi yanshur lakum rabbukum min rahmatihi wayuhayyi lakum min amrikum mirfaqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when ye withdraw from them and that which they worship except Allah, then seek refuge in the Cave; your Lord will spread for you of His mercy and will prepare for you a pillow in your plight.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watara alshshamsa itha talaAAat tazawaru AAan kahfihim thata alyameeni waitha gharabat taqriduhum thata alshshimali wahum fee fajwatin minhu thalika min ayati Allahi man yahdi Allahu fahuwa almuhtadi waman yudlil falan tajida lahu waliyyan murshidan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thou mightest have seen the sun when it rose move away from their cave to the right, and when it set go past them on the left, and they were in the cleft thereof. That was (one) of the portents of Allah. He whom Allah guideth, he indeed is led aright, and he whom He sendeth astray, for him thou wilt not find a guiding friend.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watahsabuhum ayqathan wahum ruqoodun wanuqallibuhum thata alyameeni wathata alshshimali wakalbuhum basitun thiraAAayhi bialwaseedi lawi ittalaAAta AAalayhim lawallayta minhum firaran walamulita minhum ruAAban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thou wouldst have deemed them waking though they were asleep, and We caused them to turn over to the right and the left, and their dog stretching out his paws on the threshold. If thou hadst observed them closely thou hadst assuredly turned away from them in flight, and hadst been filled with awe of them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakathalika baAAathnahum liyatasaaloo baynahum qala qailun minhum kam labithtum qaloo labithna yawman aw baAAda yawmin qaloo rabbukum aAAlamu bima labithtum faibAAathoo ahadakum biwariqikum hathihi ila almadeenati falyanthur ayyuha azka taAAaman falyatikum birizqin minhu walyatalattaf wala yushAAiranna bikum ahadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in like manner We awakened them that they might question one another. A speaker from among them said: How long have ye tarried? They said: We have tarried a day or some part of a day, (Others) said: Your Lord best knoweth what ye have tarried. Now send one of you with this your silver coin unto the city, and let him see what food is purest there and bring you a supply thereof. Let him be courteous and let no man know of you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahum in yathharoo AAalaykum yarjumookum aw yuAAeedookum fee millatihim walan tuflihoo ithan abadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For they, if they should come to know of you, will stone you or turn you back to their religion; then ye will never prosper.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakathalika aAAtharna AAalayhim liyaAAlamoo anna waAAda Allahi haqqun waanna alsaAAata la rayba feeha ith yatanazaAAoona baynahum amrahum faqaloo ibnoo AAalayhim bunyanan rabbuhum aAAlamu bihim qala allatheena ghalaboo AAala amrihim lanattakhithanna AAalayhim masjidan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in like manner We disclosed them (to the people of the city) that they might know that the promise of Allah is true, and that, as for the Hour, there is no doubt concerning it. When (the people of the city) disputed of their case among themselves, they said: Build over them a building; their Lord knoweth best concerning them. Those who won their point said: We verily shall build a place of worship over them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sayaqooloona thalathatun rabiAAuhum kalbuhum wayaqooloona khamsatun sadisuhum kalbuhum rajman bialghaybi wayaqooloona sabAAatun wathaminuhum kalbuhum qul rabbee aAAlamu biAAiddatihim ma yaAAlamuhum illa qaleelun fala tumari feehim illa miraan thahiran wala tastafti feehim minhum ahadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Some) will say: They were three, their dog the fourth, and (some) say: Five, their dog the sixth, guessing at random; and (some) say: Seven, and their dog the eighth. Say (O Muhammad): My Lord is Best Aware of their number. None knoweth them save a few. So contend not concerning them except with an outward contending, and ask not any of them to pronounce concerning them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala taqoolanna lishayin innee faAAilun thalika ghadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And say not of anything: Lo! I shall do that tomorrow,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa an yashaa Allahu waothkur rabbaka itha naseeta waqul AAasa an yahdiyani rabbee liaqraba min hatha rashadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Except if Allah will. And remember thy Lord when thou forgettest, and say: It may be that my Lord guideth me unto a nearer way of truth than this.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walabithoo fee kahfihim thalatha miatin sineena waizdadoo tisAAan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (it is said) they tarried in their Cave three hundred years and add nine.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Quli Allahu aAAlamu bima labithoo lahu ghaybu alssamawati waalardi absir bihi waasmiAA ma lahum min doonihi min waliyyin wala yushriku fee hukmihi ahadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Allah is Best Aware how long they tarried. His is the Invisible of the heavens and the earth. How clear of sight is He and keen of hearing! They have no protecting friend beside Him, and He maketh none to share in His government.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waotlu ma oohiya ilayka min kitabi rabbika la mubaddila likalimatihi walan tajida min doonihi multahadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And recite that which hath been revealed unto thee of the Scripture of thy Lord. There is none who can change His words, and thou wilt find no refuge beside Him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waisbir nafsaka maAAa allatheena yadAAoona rabbahum bialghadati waalAAashiyyi yureedoona wajhahu wala taAAdu AAaynaka AAanhum tureedu zeenata alhayati alddunya wala tutiAA man aghfalna qalbahu AAan thikrina waittabaAAa hawahu wakana amruhu furutan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Restrain thyself along with those who cry unto their Lord at morn and evening, seeking His Countenance; and let not thine eyes overlook them, desiring the pomp of the life of the world; and obey not him whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance, who followeth his own lust and whose case hath been abandoned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waquli alhaqqu min rabbikum faman shaa falyumin waman shaa falyakfur inna aAAtadna lilththalimeena naran ahata bihim suradiquha wain yastagheethoo yughathoo bimain kaalmuhli yashwee alwujooha bisa alshsharabu wasaat murtafaqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: (It is) the truth from the Lord of you (all). Then whosoever will, let him believe, and whosoever will, let him disbelieve. Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers Fire. Its tent encloseth them. If they ask for showers, they will be showered with water like to molten lead which burneth the faces. Calamitous the drink and ill the resting-place!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati inna la nudeeAAu ajra man ahsana AAamalan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! as for those who believe and do good works - Lo! We suffer not the reward of one whose work is goodly to be lost.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika lahum jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtihimu alanharu yuhallawna feeha min asawira min thahabin wayalbasoona thiyaban khudran min sundusin waistabraqin muttakieena feeha AAala alaraiki niAAma alththawabu wahasunat murtafaqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for such, theirs will be Gardens of Eden, wherein rivers flow beneath them; therein they will be given armlets of gold and will wear green robes of finest silk and gold embroidery, reclining upon throne therein. Blest the reward, and fair the resting-place!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waidrib lahum mathalan rajulayni jaAAalna liahadihima jannatayni min aAAnabin wahafafnahuma binakhlin wajaAAalna baynahuma zarAAan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Coin for them a similitude: Two men, unto one of whom We had assigned two gardens of grapes, and We had surrounded both with date-palms and had put between them tillage.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kilta aljannatayni atat okulaha walam tathlim minhu shayan wafajjarna khilalahuma naharan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Each of the gardens gave its fruit and withheld naught thereof. And We caused a river to gush forth therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakana lahu thamarun faqala lisahibihi wahuwa yuhawiruhu ana aktharu minka malan waaAAazzu nafaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he had fruit. And he said unto his comrade, when he spake with him: I am more than thee in wealth, and stronger in respect of men.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wadakhala jannatahu wahuwa thalimun linafsihi qala ma athunnu an tabeeda hathihi abadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he went into his garden, while he (thus) wronged himself. He said: I think not that all this will ever perish.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama athunnu alssaAAata qaimatan walain rudidtu ila rabbee laajidanna khayran minha munqalaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} I think not that the Hour will ever come, and if indeed I am brought back unto my Lord I surely shall find better than this as a resort.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala lahu sahibuhu wahuwa yuhawiruhu akafarta biallathee khalaqaka min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma sawwaka rajulan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} His comrade, when he (thus) spake with him, exclaimed: Disbelievest thou in Him Who created thee of dust, then of a drop (of seed), and then fashioned thee a man?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lakinna huwa Allahu rabbee wala oshriku birabbee ahadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But He is Allah, my Lord, and I ascribe unto my Lord no partner.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walawla ith dakhalta jannataka qulta ma shaa Allahu la quwwata illa biAllahi in tarani ana aqalla minka malan wawaladan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If only, when thou enteredst thy garden, thou hadst said: That which Allah willeth (will come to pass)! There is no strength save in Allah! Though thou seest me as less than thee in wealth and children,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaAAasa rabbee an yutiyani khayran min jannatika wayursila AAalayha husbanan mina alssamai fatusbiha saAAeedan zalaqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Yet it may be that my Lord will give me better than thy garden, and will send on it a bolt from heaven, and some morning it will be a smooth hillside,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw yusbiha maoha ghawran falan tastateeAAa lahu talaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or some morning the water thereof will be lost in the earth so that thou canst not make search for it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waoheeta bithamarihi faasbaha yuqallibu kaffayhi AAala ma anfaqa feeha wahiya khawiyatun AAala AAurooshiha wayaqoolu ya laytanee lam oshrik birabbee ahadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And his fruit was beset (with destruction). Then began he to wring his hands for all that he had spent upon it, when (now) it was all ruined on its trellises, and to say: Would that I had ascribed no partner to my Lord!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walam takun lahu fiatun yansuroonahu min dooni Allahi wama kana muntasiran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he had no troop of men to help him as against Allah, nor could he save himself.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hunalika alwalayatu lillahi alhaqqi huwa khayrun thawaban wakhayrun AAuqban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In this case is protection only from Allah, the True, He is Best for reward, and best for consequence.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waidrib lahum mathala alhayati alddunya kamain anzalnahu mina alssamai faikhtalata bihi nabatu alardi faasbaha hasheeman tathroohu alrriyahu wakana Allahu AAala kulli shayin muqtadiran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And coin for them the similitude of the life of the world as water which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingleth with it and then becometh dry twigs that the winds scatter. Allah is able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Almalu waalbanoona zeenatu alhayati alddunya waalbaqiyatu alssalihatu khayrun AAinda rabbika thawaban wakhayrun amalan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Wealth and children are an ornament of the life of the world. But the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better in respect of hope.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma nusayyiru aljibala watara alarda barizatan wahasharnahum falam nughadir minhum ahadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (bethink you of) the Day when we remove the hills and ye see the earth emerging, and We gather them together so as to leave not one of them behind.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAuridoo AAala rabbika saffan laqad jitumoona kama khalaqnakum awwala marratin bal zaAAamtum allan najAAala lakum mawAAidan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they are set before thy Lord in ranks (and it is said unto them): Now verily have ye come unto Us as We created you at the first. But ye thought that We had set no tryst for you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WawudiAAa alkitabu fatara almujrimeena mushfiqeena mimma feehi wayaqooloona ya waylatana ma lihatha alkitabi la yughadiru sagheeratan wala kabeeratan illa ahsaha wawajadoo ma AAamiloo hadiran wala yathlimu rabbuka ahadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the Book is placed, and thou seest the guilty fearful of that which is therein, and they say: What kind of a Book is this that leaveth not a small thing nor a great thing but hath counted it! And they find all that they did confronting them, and thy Lord wrongeth no-one.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa kana mina aljinni fafasaqa AAan amri rabbihi afatattakhithoonahu wathurriyyatahu awliyaa min doonee wahum lakum AAaduwwun bisa lilththalimeena badalan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (remember) when We said unto the angels: Fall prostrate before Adam, and they fell prostrate, all save Iblis. He was of the jinn, so he rebelled against his Lord's command. Will ye choose him and his seed for your protecting friends instead of Me, when they are an enemy unto you? Calamitous is the exchange for evil-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma ashhadtuhum khalqa alssamawati waalardi wala khalqa anfusihim wama kuntu muttakhitha almudilleena AAadudan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} I made them not to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor their own creation; nor choose I misleaders for (My) helpers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma yaqoolu nadoo shurakaiya allatheena zaAAamtum fadaAAawhum falam yastajeeboo lahum wajaAAalna baynahum mawbiqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (be mindful of) the Day when He will say: Call those partners of Mine whom ye pretended. Then they will cry unto them, but they will not hear their prayer, and We shall set a gulf of doom between them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waraa almujrimoona alnnara fathannoo annahum muwaqiAAooha walam yajidoo AAanha masrifan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the guilty behold the Fire and know that they are about to fall therein, and they find no way of escape thence.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad sarrafna fee hatha alqurani lilnnasi min kulli mathalin wakana alinsanu akthara shayin jadalan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We have displayed for mankind in this Qur'an all manner of similitudes, but man is more than anything contentious.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama manaAAa alnnasa an yuminoo ith jaahumu alhuda wayastaghfiroo rabbahum illa an tatiyahum sunnatu alawwaleena aw yatiyahumu alAAathabu qubulan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And naught hindereth mankind from believing when the guidance cometh unto them, and from asking forgiveness of their Lord unless (it be that they wish) that the judgment of the men of old should come upon them or (that) they should be confronted with the Doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama nursilu almursaleena illa mubashshireena wamunthireena wayujadilu allatheena kafaroo bialbatili liyudhidoo bihi alhaqqa waittakhathoo ayatee wama onthiroo huzuwan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We send not the messengers save as bearers of good news and warners. Those who disbelieve contend with falsehood in order to refute the Truth thereby. And they take Our revelations and that wherewith they are threatened as a jest.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman athlamu mimman thukkira biayati rabbihi faaAArada AAanha wanasiya ma qaddamat yadahu inna jaAAalna AAala quloobihim akinnatan an yafqahoohu wafee athanihim waqran wain tadAAuhum ila alhuda falan yahtadoo ithan abadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And who doth greater wrong than he who hath been reminded of the revelations of his Lord, yet turneth away from them and forgetteth what his hands send forward (to the Judgment)? Lo! on their hearts We have placed coverings so that they understand not, and in their ears a deafness. And though thou call them to the guidance, in that case they can never be led aright.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Warabbuka alghafooru thoo alrrahmati law yuakhithuhum bima kasaboo laAAajjala lahumu alAAathaba bal lahum mawAAidun lan yajidoo min doonihi mawilan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thy Lord is the Forgiver, Full of Mercy. If He took them to task (now) for what they earn, He would hasten on the doom for them; but theirs is an appointed term from which they will find no escape.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watilka alqura ahlaknahum lamma thalamoo wajaAAalna limahlikihim mawAAidan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (all) those townships! We destroyed them when they did wrong, and We appointed a fixed time for their destruction.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qala moosa lifatahu la abrahu hatta ablugha majmaAAa albahrayni aw amdiya huquban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Moses said unto his servant: I will not give up until I reach the point where the two rivers meet, though I march on for ages.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma balagha majmaAAa baynihima nasiya hootahuma faittakhatha sabeelahu fee albahri saraban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they reached the point where the two met, they forgot their fish, and it took its way into the waters, being free.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jawaza qala lifatahu atina ghadaana laqad laqeena min safarina hatha nasaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they had gone further, he said unto his servant: Bring us our breakfast. Verily we have found fatigue in this our journey.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala araayta ith awayna ila alssakhrati fainnee naseetu alhoota wama ansaneehu illa alshshaytanu an athkurahu waittakhatha sabeelahu fee albahri AAajaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Didst thou see, when we took refuge on the rock, and I forgot the fish - and none but Satan caused me to forget to mention it - it took its way into the waters by a marvel.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala thalika ma kunna nabghi fairtadda AAala atharihima qasasan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: This is that which we have been seeking. So they retraced their steps again.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fawajada AAabdan min AAibadina ataynahu rahmatan min AAindina waAAallamnahu min ladunna AAilman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then found they one of Our slaves, unto whom We had given mercy from Us, and had taught him knowledge from Our presence.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala lahu moosa hal attabiAAuka AAala an tuAAallimani mimma AAullimta rushdan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Moses said unto him: May I follow thee, to the end that thou mayst teach me right conduct of that which thou hast been taught?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala innaka lan tastateeAAa maAAiya sabran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Lo! thou canst not bear with me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakayfa tasbiru AAala ma lam tuhit bihi khubran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How canst thou bear with that whereof thou canst not compass any knowledge?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala satajidunee in shaa Allahu sabiran wala aAAsee laka amran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Allah willing, thou shalt find me patient and I shall not in aught gainsay thee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala faini ittabaAAtanee fala tasalnee AAan shayin hatta ohditha laka minhu thikran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Well, if thou go with me, ask me not concerning aught till I myself make mention of it unto thee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faintalaqa hatta itha rakiba fee alssafeenati kharaqaha qala akharaqtaha litughriqa ahlaha laqad jita shayan imran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So they twain set out till, when they were in the ship, he made a hole therein. (Moses) said: Hast thou made a hole therein to drown the folk thereof? Thou verily hast done a dreadful thing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala alam aqul innaka lan tastateeAAa maAAiya sabran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not bear with me?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala la tuakhithnee bima naseetu wala turhiqnee min amree AAusran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Moses) said: Be not wroth with me that I forgot, and be not hard upon me for my fault.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faintalaqa hatta itha laqiya ghulaman faqatalahu qala aqatalta nafsan zakiyyatan bighayri nafsin laqad jita shayan nukran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So they twain journeyed on till, when they met a lad, he slew him. (Moses) said: What! Hast thou slain an innocent soul who hath slain no man? Verily thou hast done a horrid thing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala alam aqul laka innaka lan tastateeAAa maAAiya sabran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not bear with me?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala in saaltuka AAan shayin baAAdaha fala tusahibnee qad balaghta min ladunnee AAuthran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Moses) said: If I ask thee after this concerning aught, keep not company with me. Thou hast received an excuse from me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faintalaqa hatta itha ataya ahla qaryatin istatAAama ahlaha faabaw an yudayyifoohuma fawajada feeha jidaran yureedu an yanqadda faaqamahu qala law shita laittakhathta AAalayhi ajran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So they twain journeyed on till, when they came unto the folk of a certain township, they asked its folk for food, but they refused to make them guests. And they found therein a wall upon the point of falling into ruin, and he repaired it. (Moses) said: If thou hadst wished, thou couldst have taken payment for it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala hatha firaqu baynee wabaynika saonabbioka bitaweeli ma lam tastatiAA AAalayhi sabran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: This is the parting between thee and me! I will announce unto thee the interpretation of that thou couldst not bear with patience.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Amma alssafeenatu fakanat limasakeena yaAAmaloona fee albahri faaradtu an aAAeebaha wakana waraahum malikun yakhuthu kulla safeenatin ghasban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working on the river, and I wished to mar it, for there was a king behind them who is taking every ship by force.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma alghulamu fakana abawahu muminayni fakhasheena an yurhiqahuma tughyanan wakufran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And as for the lad, his parents were believers and we feared lest he should oppress them by rebellion and disbelief.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faaradna an yubdilahuma rabbuhuma khayran minhu zakatan waaqraba ruhman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And we intended that their Lord should change him for them for one better in purity and nearer to mercy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma aljidaru fakana lighulamayni yateemayni fee almadeenati wakana tahtahu kanzun lahuma wakana aboohuma salihan faarada rabbuka an yablugha ashuddahuma wayastakhrija kanzahuma rahmatan min rabbika wama faAAaltuhu AAan amree thalika taweelu ma lam tastiAA AAalayhi sabran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure belonging to them, and their father had been righteous, and thy Lord intended that they should come to their full strength and should bring forth their treasure as a mercy from their Lord; and I did it not upon my own command. Such is the interpretation of that wherewith thou couldst not bear.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayasaloonaka AAan thee alqarnayni qul saatloo AAalaykum minhu thikran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will ask thee of Dhu'l-Qarneyn. Say: I shall recite unto you a remembrance of him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna makkanna lahu fee alardi waataynahu min kulli shayin sababan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We made him strong in the land and gave him unto every thing a road.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaatbaAAa sababan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he followed a road}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatta itha balagha maghriba alshshamsi wajadaha taghrubu fee AAaynin hamiatin wawajada AAindaha qawman qulna ya tha alqarnayni imma an tuAAaththiba waimma an tattakhitha feehim husnan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Till, when he reached the setting-place of the sun, he found it setting in a muddy spring, and found a people thereabout. We said: O Dhu'l-Qarneyn! Either punish or show them kindness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala amma man thalama fasawfa nuAAaththibuhu thumma yuraddu ila rabbihi fayuAAaththibuhu AAathaban nukran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: As for him who doeth wrong, we shall punish him, and then he will be brought back unto his Lord, Who will punish him with awful punishment!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma man amana waAAamila salihan falahu jazaan alhusna wasanaqoolu lahu min amrina yusran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But as for him who believeth and doeth right, good will be his reward, and We shall speak unto him a mild command.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma atbaAAa sababan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then he followed a road}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatta itha balagha matliAAa alshshamsi wajadaha tatluAAu AAala qawmin lam najAAal lahum min dooniha sitran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Till, when he reached the rising-place of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had appointed no shelter therefrom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kathalika waqad ahatna bima ladayhi khubran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So (it was). And We knew all concerning him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma atbaAAa sababan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then he followed a road}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatta itha balagha bayna alssaddayni wajada min doonihima qawman la yakadoona yafqahoona qawlan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Till, when he came between the two mountains, he found upon their hither side a folk that scarce could understand a saying.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya tha alqarnayni inna yajooja wamajooja mufsidoona fee alardi fahal najAAalu laka kharjan AAala an tajAAala baynana wabaynahum saddan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: O Dhu'l-Qarneyn! Lo! Gog and Magog are spoiling the land. So may we pay thee tribute on condition that thou set a barrier between us and them?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ma makkannee feehi rabbee khayrun faaAAeenoonee biquwwatin ajAAal baynakum wabaynahum radman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: That wherein my Lord hath established me is better (than your tribute). Do but help me with strength (of men), I will set between you and them a bank.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Atoonee zubara alhadeedi hatta itha sawa bayna alsadafayni qala onfukhoo hatta itha jaAAalahu naran qala atoonee ofrigh AAalayhi qitran}}
