\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Give me pieces of iron - till, when he had levelled up (the gap) between the cliffs, he said: Blow! - till, when he had made it a fire, he said: Bring me molten copper to pour thereon.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama istaAAoo an yathharoohu wama istataAAoo lahu naqban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (Gog and Magog) were not able to surmount, nor could they pierce (it).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala hatha rahmatun min rabbee faitha jaa waAAdu rabbee jaAAalahu dakkaa wakana waAAdu rabbee haqqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord cometh to pass, He will lay it low, for the promise of my Lord is true.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watarakna baAAdahum yawmaithin yamooju fee baAAdin wanufikha fee alssoori fajamaAAnahum jamAAan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And on that day we shall let some of them surge against others, and the Trumpet will be blown. Then We shall gather them together in one gathering.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAaradna jahannama yawmaithin lilkafireena AAardan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On that day we shall present hell to the disbelievers, plain to view,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena kanat aAAyunuhum fee ghitain AAan thikree wakanoo la yastateeAAoona samAAan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those whose eyes were hoodwinked from My reminder, and who could not bear to hear.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afahasiba allatheena kafaroo an yattakhithoo AAibadee min doonee awliyaa inna aAAtadna jahannama lilkafireena nuzulan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Do the disbelievers reckon that they can choose My bondmen as protecting friends beside Me? Lo! We have prepared hell as a welcome for the disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul hal nunabbiokum bialakhsareena aAAmalan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Shall We inform you who will be the greatest losers by their works?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena dalla saAAyuhum fee alhayati alddunya wahum yahsaboona annahum yuhsinoona sunAAan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those whose effort goeth astray in the life of the world, and yet they reckon that they do good work.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika allatheena kafaroo biayati rabbihim waliqaihi fahabitat aAAmaluhum fala nuqeemu lahum yawma alqiyamati waznan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those are they who disbelieve in the revelations of their Lord and in the meeting with Him. Therefor their works are vain, and on the Day of Resurrection We assign no weight to them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika jazaohum jahannamu bima kafaroo waittakhathoo ayatee warusulee huzuwan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That is their reward: hell, because they disbelieved, and made a jest of Our revelations and Our messengers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati kanat lahum jannatu alfirdawsi nuzulan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs are the Gardens of Paradise for welcome,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khalideena feeha la yabghoona AAanha hiwalan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Wherein they will abide, with no desire to be removed from thence.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul law kana albahru midadan likalimati rabbee lanafida albahru qabla an tanfada kalimatu rabbee walaw jina bimithlihi madadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Though the sea became ink for the Words of my Lord, verily the sea would be used up before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even though We brought the like thereof to help.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[18][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul innama ana basharun mithlukum yooha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun faman kana yarjoo liqaa rabbihi falyaAAmal AAamalan salihan wala yushrik biAAibadati rabbihi ahadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: I am only a mortal like you. My Lord inspireth in me that your Allah is only One Allah. And whoever hopeth for the meeting with his Lord, let him do righteous work, and make none sharer of the worship due unto his Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Maryam (Mary)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{KafhayaAAaynsad}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Kaf. Ha. Ya. A'in. Sad.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thikru rahmati rabbika AAabdahu zakariyya}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A mention of the mercy of thy Lord unto His servant Zachariah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith nada rabbahu nidaan khafiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When he cried unto his Lord a cry in secret,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi innee wahana alAAathmu minnee waishtaAAala alrrasu shayban walam akun biduAAaika rabbi shaqiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Saying: My Lord! Lo! the bones of me wax feeble and my head is shining with grey hair, and I have never been unblest in prayer to Thee, my Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnee khiftu almawaliya min waraee wakanati imraatee AAaqiran fahab lee min ladunka waliyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! I fear my kinsfolk after me, since my wife is barren. Oh, give me from Thy presence a successor}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yarithunee wayarithu min ali yaAAqooba waijAAalhu rabbi radiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who shall inherit of me and inherit (also) of the house of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, acceptable (unto Thee).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya zakariyya inna nubashshiruka bighulamin ismuhu yahya lam najAAal lahu min qablu samiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (It was said unto him): O Zachariah! Lo! We bring thee tidings of a son whose name is John; we have given the same name to none before (him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi anna yakoonu lee ghulamun wakanati imraatee AAaqiran waqad balaghtu mina alkibari AAitiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren and I have reached infirm old age?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala kathalika qala rabbuka huwa AAalayya hayyinun waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shayan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me, even as I created thee before, when thou wast naught.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi ijAAal lee ayatan qala ayatuka alla tukallima alnnasa thalatha layalin sawiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! Appoint for me some token. He said: Thy token is that thou, with no bodily defect, shalt not speak unto mankind three nights.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakharaja AAala qawmihi mina almihrabi faawha ilayhim an sabbihoo bukratan waAAashiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then he came forth unto his people from the sanctuary, and signified to them: Glorify your Lord at break of day and fall of night.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya yahya khuthi alkitaba biquwwatin waataynahu alhukma sabiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And it was said unto his son): O John! Hold fast the Scripture. And we gave him wisdom when a child,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahananan min ladunna wazakatan wakana taqiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And compassion from Our presence, and purity; and he was devout,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wabarran biwalidayhi walam yakun jabbaran AAasiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And dutiful toward his parents. And he was not arrogant, rebellious.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wasalamun AAalayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamootu wayawma yubAAathu hayyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Peace on him the day he was born, and the day he dieth and the day he shall be raised alive!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waothkur fee alkitabi maryama ithi intabathat min ahliha makanan sharqiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And make mention of Mary in the Scripture, when she had withdrawn from her people to a chamber looking East,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faittakhathat min doonihim hijaban faarsalna ilayha roohana fatamaththala laha basharan sawiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And had chosen seclusion from them. Then We sent unto her Our Spirit and it assumed for her the likeness of a perfect man.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qalat innee aAAoothu bialrrahmani minka in kunta taqiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} She said: Lo! I seek refuge in the Beneficent One from thee, if thou art Allah-fearing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala innama ana rasoolu rabbiki liahaba laki ghulaman zakiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: I am only a messenger of thy Lord, that I may bestow on thee a faultless son.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qalat anna yakoonu lee ghulamun walam yamsasnee basharun walam aku baghiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} She said: How can I have a son when no mortal hath touched me, neither have I been unchaste?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala kathaliki qala rabbuki huwa AAalayya hayyinun walinajAAalahu ayatan lilnnasi warahmatan minna wakana amran maqdiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me. And (it will be) that We may make of him a revelation for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a thing ordained.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fahamalathu faintabathat bihi makanan qasiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a far place.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faajaaha almakhadu ila jithAAi alnnakhlati qalat ya laytanee mittu qabla hatha wakuntu nasyan mansiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the pangs of childbirth drove her unto the trunk of the palm-tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died ere this and had become a thing of naught, forgotten!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fanadaha min tahtiha alla tahzanee qad jaAAala rabbuki tahtaki sariyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then (one) cried unto her from below her, saying: Grieve not! Thy Lord hath placed a rivulet beneath thee,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuzzee ilayki bijithAAi alnnakhlati tusaqit AAalayki rutaban janiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And shake the trunk of the palm-tree toward thee, thou wilt cause ripe dates to fall upon thee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakulee waishrabee waqarree AAaynan faimma tarayinna mina albashari ahadan faqoolee innee nathartu lilrrahmani sawman falan okallima alyawma insiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So eat and drink and be consoled. And if thou meetest any mortal, say: Lo! I have vowed a fast unto the Beneficent, and may not speak this day to any mortal.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faatat bihi qawmaha tahmiluhu qaloo ya maryamu laqad jiti shayan fariyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then she brought him to her own folk, carrying him. They said: O Mary! Thou hast come with an amazing thing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya okhta haroona ma kana abooki imraa sawin wama kanat ommuki baghiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a wicked man nor was thy mother a harlot.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faasharat ilayhi qaloo kayfa nukallimu man kana fee almahdi sabiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then she pointed to him. They said: How can we talk to one who is in the cradle, a young boy?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala innee AAabdu Allahi ataniya alkitaba wajaAAalanee nabiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He spake: Lo! I am the slave of Allah. He hath given me the Scripture and hath appointed me a Prophet,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalanee mubarakan ayna ma kuntu waawsanee bialssalati waalzzakati ma dumtu hayyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And hath made me blessed wheresoever I may be, and hath enjoined upon me prayer and almsgiving so long as I remain alive,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wabarran biwalidatee walam yajAAalnee jabbaran shaqiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (hath made me) dutiful toward her who bore me, and hath not made me arrogant, unblest.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalssalamu AAalayya yawma wulidtu wayawma amootu wayawma obAAathu hayyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Peace on me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika AAeesa ibnu maryama qawla alhaqqi allathee feehi yamtaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such was Jesus, son of Mary: (this is) a statement of the truth concerning which they doubt.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma kana lillahi an yattakhitha min waladin subhanahu itha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoonu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It befitteth not (the Majesty of) Allah that He should take unto Himself a son. Glory be to Him! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna Allaha rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So serve Him. That is the right path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min mashhadi yawmin AAatheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The sects among them differ: but woe unto the disbelievers from the meeting of an awful Day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AsmiAA bihim waabsir yawma yatoonana lakini alththalimoona alyawma fee dalalin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} See and hear them on the Day they come unto Us! yet the evil-doers are to-day in error manifest.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanthirhum yawma alhasrati ith qudiya alamru wahum fee ghaflatin wahum la yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And warn them of the Day of anguish when the case hath been decided. Now they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna nahnu narithu alarda waman AAalayha wailayna yurjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We, only We, inherit the earth and all who are thereon, and unto Us they are returned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waothkur fee alkitabi ibraheema innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And make mention (O Muhammad) in the Scripture of Abraham. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith qala liabeehi ya abati lima taAAbudu ma la yasmaAAu wala yubsiru wala yughnee AAanka shayan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When he said unto his father: O my father! Why worshippest thou that which heareth not nor seeth, nor can in aught avail thee?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya abati innee qad jaanee mina alAAilmi ma lam yatika faittabiAAnee ahdika siratan sawiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O my father! Lo! there hath come unto me of knowledge that which came not unto thee. So follow me, and I will lead thee on a right path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya abati la taAAbudi alshshaytana inna alshshaytana kana lilrrahmani AAasiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O my father! Serve not the devil. Lo! the devil is a rebel unto the Beneficent.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya abati innee akhafu an yamassaka AAathabun mina alrrahmani fatakoona lilshshyatani waliyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O my father! Lo! I fear lest a punishment from the Beneficent overtake thee so that thou become a comrade of the devil.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala araghibun anta AAan alihatee ya ibraheemu lain lam tantahi laarjumannaka waohjurnee maliyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Rejectest thou my gods, O Abraham? If thou cease not, I shall surely stone thee. Depart from me a long while!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala salamun AAalayka saastaghfiru laka rabbee innahu kana bee hafiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Peace be unto thee! I shall ask forgiveness of my Lord for thee. Lo! He was ever gracious unto me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaaAAtazilukum wama tadAAoona min dooni Allahi waadAAoo rabbee AAasa alla akoona biduAAai rabbee shaqiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} I shall withdraw from you and that unto which ye pray beside Allah, and I shall pray unto my Lord. It may be that, in prayer unto my Lord, I shall not be unblest.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma iAAtazalahum wama yaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi wahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba wakullan jaAAalna nabiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So, when he had withdrawn from them and that which they were worshipping beside Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob. Each of them We made a prophet.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wawahabna lahum min rahmatina wajaAAalna lahum lisana sidqin AAaliyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And we gave them of Our mercy, and assigned to them a high and true renown.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waothkur fee alkitabi moosa innahu kana mukhlasan wakana rasoolan nabiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And make mention in the Scripture of Moses. Lo! he was chosen, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanadaynahu min janibi alttoori alaymani waqarrabnahu najiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We called him from the right slope of the Mount, and brought him nigh in communion.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wawahabna lahu min rahmatina akhahu haroona nabiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We bestowed upon him of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet (likewise).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waothkur fee alkitabi ismaAAeela innahu kana sadiqa alwaAAdi wakana rasoolan nabiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And make mention in the Scripture of Ishmael. Lo! he was a keeper of his promise, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakana yamuru ahlahu bialssalati waalzzakati wakana AAinda rabbihi mardiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He enjoined upon his people worship and almsgiving, and was acceptable in the sight of his Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waothkur fee alkitabi idreesa innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And make mention in the Scripture of Idris. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WarafaAAnahu makanan AAaliyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We raised him to high station.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika allatheena anAAama Allahu AAalayhim mina alnnabiyyeena min thurriyyati adama wamimman hamalna maAAa noohin wamin thurriyyati ibraheema waisraeela wamimman hadayna waijtabayna itha tutla AAalayhim ayatu alrrahmani kharroo sujjadan wabukiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} These are they unto whom Allah showed favour from among the prophets, of the seed of Adam and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Noah, and of the seed of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Beneficent were recited unto them, they fell down, adoring and weeping.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakhalafa min baAAdihim khalfun adaAAoo alssalata waittabaAAoo alshshahawati fasawfa yalqawna ghayyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts. But they will meet deception.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa man taba waamana waAAamila salihan faolaika yadkhuloona aljannata wala yuthlamoona shayan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save him who shall repent and believe and do right. Such will enter the Garden, and they will not be wronged in aught -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Jannati AAadnin allatee waAAada alrrahmanu AAibadahu bialghaybi innahu kana waAAduhu matiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Gardens of Eden, which the Beneficent hath promised to His slaves in the unseen. Lo! His promise is ever sure of fulfilment -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan illa salaman walahum rizquhum feeha bukratan waAAashiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They hear therein no idle talk, but only Peace; and therein they have food for morn and evening.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tilka aljannatu allatee noorithu min AAibadina man kana taqiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such is the Garden which We cause the devout among Our bondmen to inherit.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama natanazzalu illa biamri rabbika lahu ma bayna aydeena wama khalfana wama bayna thalika wama kana rabbuka nasiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We (angels) come not down save by commandment of thy Lord. Unto Him belongeth all that is before us and all that is behind us and all that is between those two, and thy Lord was never forgetful -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma faoAAbudhu waistabir liAAibadatihi hal taAAlamu lahu samiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them! Therefor, worship thou Him and be thou steadfast in His service. Knowest thou one that can be named along with Him?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayaqoolu alinsanu aitha ma mittu lasawfa okhraju hayyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And man saith: When I am dead, shall I forsooth be brought forth alive?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awala yathkuru alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min qablu walam yaku shayan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Doth not man remember that We created him before, when he was naught?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fawarabbika lanahshurannahum waalshshayateena thumma lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jithiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And, by thy Lord, verily We shall assemble them and the devils, then We shall bring them, crouching, around hell.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma lananziAAanna min kulli sheeAAatin ayyuhum ashaddu AAala alrrahmani AAitiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We shall pluck out from every sect whichever of them was most stubborn in rebellion to the Beneficent.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma lanahnu aAAlamu biallatheena hum awla biha siliyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And surely We are Best Aware of those most worthy to be burned therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain minkum illa wariduha kana AAala rabbika hatman maqdiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There is not one of you but shall approach it. That is a fixed ordinance of thy Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma nunajjee allatheena ittaqaw wanatharu alththalimeena feeha jithiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We shall rescue those who kept from evil, and leave the evil-doers crouching there.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo ayyu alfareeqayni khayrun maqaman waahsanu nadiyyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Which of the two parties (yours or ours) is better in position, and more imposing as an army?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu athathan wariyan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were more imposing in respect of gear and outward seeming!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul man kana fee alddalalati falyamdud lahu alrrahmanu maddan hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona imma alAAathaba waimma alssaAAata fasayaAAlamoona man huwa sharrun makanan waadAAafu jundan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: As for him who is in error, the Beneficent will verily prolong his span of life until, when they behold that which they were promised, whether it be punishment (in the world), or the Hour (of doom), they will know who is worse in position and who is weaker as an army.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayazeedu Allahu allatheena ihtadaw hudan waalbaqiyatu alssalihatu khayrun AAinda rabbika thawaban wakhayrun maraddan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah increaseth in right guidance those who walk aright, and the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better for resort.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaraayta allathee kafara biayatina waqala laootayanna malan wawaladan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou seen him who disbelieveth in Our revelations and saith: Assuredly I shall be given wealth and children?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AttalaAAa alghayba ami ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hath he perused the Unseen, or hath he made a pact with the Beneficent?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla sanaktubu ma yaqoolu wanamuddu lahu mina alAAathabi maddan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but We shall record that which he saith and prolong for him a span of torment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanarithuhu ma yaqoolu wayateena fardan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We shall inherit from him that whereof he spake, and he will come unto Us, alone (without his wealth and children).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan liyakoonoo lahum AAizzan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they have chosen (other) gods beside Allah that they may be a power for them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla sayakfuroona biAAibadatihim wayakoonoona AAalayhim diddan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but they will deny their worship of them, and become opponents unto them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara anna arsalna alshshayateena AAala alkafireena taozzuhum azzan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Seest thou not that We have set the devils on the disbelievers to confound them with confusion?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala taAAjal AAalayhim innama naAAuddu lahum AAaddan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So make no haste against them (O Muhammad). We do but number unto them a sum (of days).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma nahshuru almuttaqeena ila alrrahmani wafdan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when We shall gather the righteous unto the Beneficent, a goodly company.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanasooqu almujrimeena ila jahannama wirdan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And drive the guilty unto hell, a weary herd,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yamlikoona alshshafaAAata illa mani ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will have no power of intercession, save him who hath made a covenant with his Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad jitum shayan iddan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Assuredly ye utter a disastrous thing}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Takadu alssamawatu yatafattarna minhu watanshaqqu alardu watakhirru aljibalu haddan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whereby almost the heavens are torn, and the earth is split asunder and the mountains fall in ruins,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{An daAAaw lilrrahmani waladan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That ye ascribe unto the Beneficent a son,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yanbaghee lilrrahmani an yattakhitha waladan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When it is not meet for (the Majesty of) the Beneficent that He should choose a son.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In kullu man fee alssamawati waalardi illa atee alrrahmani AAabdan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There is none in the heavens and the earth but cometh unto the Beneficent as a slave.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad ahsahum waAAaddahum AAaddan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Verily He knoweth them and numbereth them with (right) numbering.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakulluhum ateehi yawma alqiyamati fardan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And each one of them will come unto Him on the Day of Resurrection, alone.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sayajAAalu lahumu alrrahmanu wuddan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who believe and do good works, the Beneficent will appoint for them love.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika litubashshira bihi almuttaqeena watunthira bihi qawman luddan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We make (this Scripture) easy in thy tongue, (O Muhammad) only that thou mayst bear good tidings therewith unto those who ward off (evil), and warn therewith the froward folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[19][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasmaAAu lahum rikzan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Canst thou (Muhammad) see a single man of them, or hear from them the slightest sound?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Ta Ha (Ta Ha)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Taha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ta. Ha.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma anzalna AAalayka alqurana litashqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We have not revealed unto thee (Muhammad) this Qur'an that thou shouldst be distressed,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa tathkiratan liman yakhsha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But as a reminder unto him who feareth,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tanzeelan mimman khalaqa alarda waalssamawati alAAula}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the high heavens,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alrrahmanu AAala alAAarshi istawa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Beneficent One, Who is established on the Throne.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wama baynahuma wama tahta alththara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and whatsoever is between them, and whatsoever is beneath the sod.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain tajhar bialqawli fainnahu yaAAlamu alssirra waakhfa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if thou speakest aloud, then lo! He knoweth the secret (thought) and (that which is yet) more hidden.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu la ilaha illa huwa lahu alasmao alhusna}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah! There is no Allah save Him. His are the most beautiful names.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahal ataka hadeethu moosa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hath there come unto thee the story of Moses?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith raa naran faqala liahlihi omkuthoo innee anastu naran laAAallee ateekum minha biqabasin aw ajidu AAala alnnari hudan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When he saw a fire and said unto his folk: Lo! Wait! I see a fire afar off. Peradventure I may bring you a brand therefrom or may find guidance at the fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma ataha noodiya ya moosa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when he reached it, he was called by name: O Moses!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innee ana rabbuka faikhlaAA naAAlayka innaka bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! I, even I, am thy Lord, So take off thy shoes, for lo! thou art in the holy valley of Tuwa.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waana ikhtartuka faistamiAA lima yooha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And I have chosen thee, so hearken unto that which is inspired.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innanee ana Allahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudnee waaqimi alssalata lithikree}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! I, even I, am Allah, There is no Allah save Me. So serve Me and establish worship for My remembrance.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna alssaAAata atiyatun akadu okhfeeha litujza kullu nafsin bima tasAAa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the Hour is surely coming. But I will to keep it hidden, that every soul may be rewarded for that which it striveth (to achieve).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala yasuddannaka AAanha man la yuminu biha waittabaAAa hawahu fatarda}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor, let not him turn thee aside from (the thought of) it who believeth not therein but followeth his own desire, lest thou perish.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama tilka biyameenika ya moosa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And what is that in thy right hand, O Moses?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala hiya AAasaya atawakkao AAalayha waahushshu biha AAala ghanamee waliya feeha maaribu okhra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: This is my staff whereon I lean, and wherewith I bear down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala alqiha ya moosa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Cast it down, O Moses!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalqaha faitha hiya hayyatun tasAAa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So he cast it down, and lo! it was a serpent, gliding.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala khuthha wala takhaf sanuAAeeduha seerataha aloola}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Grasp it and fear not. We shall return it to its former state.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waodmum yadaka ila janahika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin ayatan okhra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thrust thy hand within thine armpit, it will come forth white without hurt. (That will be) another token.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Linuriyaka min ayatina alkubra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That We may show thee (some) of Our greater portents,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ithhab ila firAAawna innahu tagha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Go thou unto Pharaoh! Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi ishrah lee sadree}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Moses) said: My Lord! relieve my mind}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayassir lee amree}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And ease my task for me;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waohlul AAuqdatan min lisanee}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And loose a knot from my tongue,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yafqahoo qawlee}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That they may understand my saying.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaijAAal lee wazeeran min ahlee}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Appoint for me a henchman from my folk,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Haroona akhee}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Aaron, my brother.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Oshdud bihi azree}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Confirm my strength with him}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waashrikhu fee amree}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And let him share my task,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kay nusabbihaka katheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That we may glorify Thee much}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanathkuraka katheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And much remember Thee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innaka kunta bina baseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Thou art ever Seeing us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala qad ooteeta sulaka ya moosa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Thou art granted thy request, O Moses.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad mananna AAalayka marratan okhra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And indeed, another time, already We have shown thee favour,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith awhayna ila ommika ma yooha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When we inspired in thy mother that which is inspired,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ani iqthifeehi fee alttabooti faiqthifeehi fee alyammi falyulqihi alyammu bialssahili yakhuthhu AAaduwwun lee waAAaduwwun lahu waalqaytu AAalayka mahabbatan minnee walitusnaAAa AAala AAaynee}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Saying: Throw him into the ark, and throw it into the river, then the river shall throw it on to the bank, and there an enemy to Me and an enemy to him shall take him. And I endued thee with love from Me that thou mightest be trained according to My will,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith tamshee okhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum AAala man yakfuluhu farajaAAnaka ila ommika kay taqarra AAaynuha wala tahzana waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynaka mina alghammi wafatannaka futoonan falabithta sineena fee ahli madyana thumma jita AAala qadarin ya moosa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When thy sister went and said: Shall I show you one who will nurse him? and we restored thee to thy mother that her eyes might be refreshed and might not sorrow. And thou didst kill a man and We delivered thee from great distress, and tried thee with a heavy trial. And thou didst tarry years among the folk of Midian. Then camest thou (hither) by (My) providence, O Moses,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaistanaAAtuka linafsee}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And I have attached thee to Myself.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ithhab anta waakhooka biayatee wala taniya fee thikree}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Go, thou and thy brother, with My tokens, and be not faint in remembrance of Me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ithhaba ila firAAawna innahu tagha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Go, both of you, unto Pharaoh. Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqoola lahu qawlan layyinan laAAallahu yatathakkaru aw yakhsha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And speak unto him a gentle word, that peradventure he may heed or fear.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbana innana nakhafu an yafruta AAalayna aw an yatgha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Our Lord! Lo! we fear that he may be beforehand with us or that he may play the tyrant.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala la takhafa innanee maAAakuma asmaAAu waara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Fear not. Lo! I am with you twain, Hearing and Seeing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatiyahu faqoola inna rasoola rabbika faarsil maAAana banee israeela wala tuAAaththibhum qad jinaka biayatin min rabbika waalssalamu AAala mani ittabaAAa alhuda}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So go ye unto him and say: Lo! we are two messengers of thy Lord. So let the children of Israel go with us, and torment them not. We bring thee a token from thy Lord. And peace will be for him who followeth right guidance.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna qad oohiya ilayna anna alAAathaba AAala man kaththaba watawalla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! it hath been revealed unto us that the doom will be for him who denieth and turneth away.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala faman rabbukuma ya moosa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Pharaoh) said: Who then is the Lord of you twain, O Moses?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbuna allathee aAAta kulla shayin khalqahu thumma hada}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Our Lord is He Who gave unto everything its nature, then guided it aright.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala fama balu alqurooni aloola}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: What then is the state of the generations of old?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala AAilmuha AAinda rabbee fee kitabin la yadillu rabbee wala yansa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a Record. My Lord neither erreth nor forgetteth,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wasalaka lakum feeha subulan waanzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi azwajan min nabatin shatta}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who hath appointed the earth as a bed and hath threaded roads for you therein and hath sent down water from the sky and thereby We have brought forth divers kinds of vegetation,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kuloo wairAAaw anAAamakum inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Saying): Eat ye and feed your cattle. Lo! herein verily are portents for men of thought.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Minha khalaqnakum wafeeha nuAAeedukum waminha nukhrijukum taratan okhra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thereof We created you, and thereunto We return you, and thence We bring you forth a second time.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad araynahu ayatina kullaha fakaththaba waaba}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We verily did show him all Our tokens, but he denied them and refused.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ajitana litukhrijana min ardina bisihrika ya moosa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Hast come to drive us out from our land by thy magic, O Moses?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falanatiyannaka bisihrin mithlihi faijAAal baynana wabaynaka mawAAidan la nukhlifuhu nahnu wala anta makanan suwan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But we surely can produce for thee magic the like thereof; so appoint a tryst between us and you, which neither we nor thou shall fail to keep, at a place convenient (to us both).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala mawAAidukum yawmu alzzeenati waan yuhshara alnnasu duhan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Moses) said: Your tryst shall be the day of the feast, and let the people assemble when the sun hath risen high.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatawalla firAAawnu fajamaAAa kaydahu thumma ata}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then Pharaoh went and gathered his strength, then came (to the appointed tryst).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala lahum moosa waylakum la taftaroo AAala Allahi kathiban fayushitakum biAAathabin waqad khaba mani iftara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Moses said unto them: Woe unto you! Invent not a lie against Allah, lest He extirpate you by some punishment. He who lieth faileth miserably.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FatanazaAAoo amrahum baynahum waasarroo alnnajwa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then they debated one with another what they must do, and they kept their counsel secret.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo in hathani lasahirani yureedani an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihima wayathhaba bitareeqatikumu almuthla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Lo! these are two wizards who would drive you out from your country by their magic, and destroy your best traditions;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaajmiAAoo kaydakum thumma itoo saffan waqad aflaha alyawma mani istaAAla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So arrange your plan, and come in battle line. Whoso is uppermost this day will be indeed successful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya moosa imma an tulqiya waimma an nakoona awwala man alqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: O Moses! Either throw first, or let us be the first to throw?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala bal alqoo faitha hibaluhum waAAisiyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min sihrihim annaha tasAAa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Nay, do ye throw! Then lo! their cords and their staves, by their magic, appeared to him as though they ran.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faawjasa fee nafsihi kheefatan moosa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Moses conceived a fear in his mind.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qulna la takhaf innaka anta alaAAla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We said: Fear not! Lo! thou art the higher.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalqi ma fee yameenika talqaf ma sanaAAoo innama sanaAAoo kaydu sahirin wala yuflihu alssahiru haythu ata}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Throw that which is in thy right hand! It will eat up that which they have made. Lo! that which they have made is but a wizard's artifice, and a wizard shall not be successful to whatever point (of skill) he may attain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faolqiya alssaharatu sujjadan qaloo amanna birabbi haroona wamoosa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then the wizards were (all) flung down prostrate, crying: We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falaoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum fee juthooAAi alnnakhli walataAAlamunna ayyuna ashaddu AAathaban waabqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Pharaoh) said: Ye put faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he is your chief who taught you magic. Now surely I shall cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and I shall crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and ye shall know for certain which of us hath sterner and more lasting punishment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo lan nuthiraka AAala ma jaana mina albayyinati waallathee fatarana faiqdi ma anta qadin innama taqdee hathihi alhayata alddunya}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: We choose thee not above the clear proofs that have come unto us, and above Him Who created us. So decree what thou wilt decree. Thou wilt end for us only this life of the world.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna amanna birabbina liyaghfira lana khatayana wama akrahtana AAalayhi mina alssihri waAllahu khayrun waabqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! we believe in our Lord, that He may forgive us our sins and the magic unto which thou didst force us. Allah is better and more lasting.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu man yati rabbahu mujriman fainna lahu jahannama la yamootu feeha wala yahya}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! whoso cometh guilty unto his Lord, verily for him is hell. There he will neither die nor live.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman yatihi muminan qad AAamila alssalihati faolaika lahumu alddarajatu alAAula}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But whoso cometh unto Him a believer, having done good works, for such are the high stations;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wathalika jazao man tazakka}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever. That is the reward of him who groweth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad awhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee faidrib lahum tareeqan fee albahri yabasan la takhafu darakan wala takhsha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night and strike for them a dry path in the sea, fearing not to be overtaken, neither being afraid (of the sea).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaatbaAAahum firAAawnu bijunoodihi faghashiyahum mina alyammi ma ghashiyahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then Pharaoh followed them with his hosts and there covered them that which did cover them of the sea.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waadalla firAAawnu qawmahu wama hada}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Pharaoh led his folk astray, he did not guide them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya banee israeela qad anjaynakum min AAaduwwikum wawaAAadnakum janiba alttoori alaymana wanazzalna AAalaykumu almanna waalssalwa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Children of Israel! We delivered you from your enemy, and we made a covenant with you on the holy mountain's side, and sent down on you the manna and the quails,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kuloo min tayyibati ma razaqnakum wala tatghaw feehi fayahilla AAalaykum ghadabee waman yahlil AAalayhi ghadabee faqad hawa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Saying): Eat of the good things wherewith We have provided you, and transgress not in respect thereof lest My wrath come upon you: and he on whom My wrath cometh, he is lost indeed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnee laghaffarun liman taba waamana waAAamila salihan thumma ihtada}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! verily I am Forgiving toward him who repenteth and believeth and doeth good, and afterward walketh aright.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama aAAjalaka AAan qawmika ya moosa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (it was said): What hath made thee hasten from thy folk, O Moses?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala hum olai AAala atharee waAAajiltu ilayka rabbi litarda}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: They are close upon my track. I hastened unto Thee, my Lord, that Thou mightest be well pleased.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala fainna qad fatanna qawmaka min baAAdika waadallahumu alssamiriyyu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Lo! We have tried thy folk in thine absence, and As-Samiri hath misled them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FarajaAAa moosa ila qawmihi ghadbana asifan qala ya qawmi alam yaAAidkum rabbukum waAAdan hasanan afatala AAalaykumu alAAahdu am aradtum an yahilla AAalaykum ghadabun min rabbikum faakhlaftum mawAAidee}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then Moses went back unto his folk, angry and sad. He said: O my people! Hath not your Lord promised you a fair promise? Did the time appointed then appear too long for you, or did ye wish that wrath from your Lord should come upon you, that ye broke tryst with me?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ma akhlafna mawAAidaka bimalkina walakinna hummilna awzaran min zeenati alqawmi faqathafnaha fakathalika alqa alssamiriyyu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: We broke not tryst with thee of our own will, but we were laden with burdens of ornaments of the folk, then cast them (in the fire), for thus As-Samiri proposed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faakhraja lahum AAijlan jasadan lahu khuwarun faqaloo hatha ilahukum wailahu moosa fanasiya}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then he produced for them a calf, of saffron hue, which gave forth a lowing sound. And they cried: This is your god and the god of Moses, but he hath forgotten.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afala yarawna alla yarjiAAu ilayhim qawlan wala yamliku lahum darran wala nafAAan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} See they not, then, that it returneth no saying unto them and possesseth for them neither hurt nor use?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad qala lahum haroonu min qablu ya qawmi innama futintum bihi wainna rabbakumu alrrahmanu faittabiAAoonee waateeAAoo amree}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Aaron indeed had told them beforehand: O my people! Ye are but being seduced therewith, for lo! your Lord is the Beneficent, so follow me and obey my order.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo lan nabraha AAalayhi AAakifeena hatta yarjiAAa ilayna moosa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: We shall by no means cease to be its votaries till Moses return unto us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya haroonu ma manaAAaka ith raaytahum dalloo}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He (Moses) said: O Aaron! What held thee back when thou didst see them gone astray,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][93]
\end{Arabic}}
