\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alla tattabiAAani afaAAasayta amree}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That thou followedst me not? Hast thou then disobeyed my order?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya bna omma la takhuth bilihyatee wala birasee innee khasheetu an taqoola farraqta bayna banee israeela walam tarqub qawlee}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O son of my mother! Clutch not my beard nor my head! I feared lest thou shouldst say: Thou hast caused division among the Children of Israel, and hast not waited for my word.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala fama khatbuka ya samiriyyu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Moses) said: And what hast thou to say, O Samiri?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala basurtu bima lam yabsuroo bihi faqabadtu qabdatan min athari alrrasooli fanabathtuha wakathalika sawwalat lee nafsee}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: I perceived what they perceive not, so I seized a handful from the footsteps of the messenger, and then threw it in. Thus my soul commended to me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala faithhab fainna laka fee alhayati an taqoola la misasa wainna laka mawAAidan lan tukhlafahu waonthur ila ilahika allathee thalta AAalayhi AAakifan lanuharriqannahu thumma lanansifannahu fee alyammi nasfan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Moses) said: Then go! and lo! in this life it is for thee to say: Touch me not! and lo! there is for thee a tryst thou canst not break. Now look upon thy god of which thou hast remained a votary. Verily we will burn it and will scatter its dust over the sea.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama ilahukumu Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa wasiAAa kulla shayin AAilman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Your Allah is only Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah. He embraceth all things in His knowledge.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kathalika naqussu AAalayka min anbai ma qad sabaqa waqad ataynaka min ladunna thikran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus relate We unto thee (Muhammad) some tidings of that which happened of old, and We have given thee from Our presence a reminder.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man aAArada AAanhu fainnahu yahmilu yawma alqiyamati wizran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whoso turneth away from it, he verily will bear a burden on the Day of Resurrection,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khalideena feehi wasaa lahum yawma alqiyamati himlan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Abiding under it - an evil burden for them on the Day of Resurrection,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori wanahshuru almujrimeena yawmaithin zurqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The day when the Trumpet is blown. On that day we assemble the guilty white-eyed (with terror),}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yatakhafatoona baynahum in labithtum illa AAashran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Murmuring among themselves: Ye have tarried but ten (days).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona ith yaqoolu amthaluhum tareeqatan in labithtum illa yawman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We are Best Aware of what they utter when their best in conduct say: Ye have tarried but a day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayasaloonaka AAani aljibali faqul yansifuha rabbee nasfan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will ask thee of the mountains (on that day). Say: My Lord will break them into scattered dust.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fayatharuha qaAAan safsafan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And leave it as an empty plain,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La tara feeha AAiwajan wala amtan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Wherein thou seest neither curve nor ruggedness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawmaithin yattabiAAoona alddaAAiya la AAiwaja lahu wakhashaAAati alaswatu lilrrahmani fala tasmaAAu illa hamsan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On that day they follow the summoner who deceiveth not, and voices are hushed for the Beneficent, and thou hearest but a faint murmur.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawmaithin la tanfaAAu alshshafaAAatu illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waradiya lahu qawlan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On that day no intercession availeth save (that of) him unto whom the Beneficent hath given leave and whose word He accepteth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yuheetoona bihi AAilman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He knoweth (all) that is before them and (all) that is behind them, while they cannot compass it in knowledge.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAanati alwujoohu lilhayyi alqayyoomi waqad khaba man hamala thulman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And faces humble themselves before the Living, the Eternal. And he who beareth (a burden of) wrongdoing is indeed a failure (on that day).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][112]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa muminun fala yakhafu thulman wala hadman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he who hath done some good works, being a believer, he feareth not injustice nor begrudging (of his wage).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][113]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakathalika anzalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan wasarrafna feehi mina alwaAAeedi laAAallahum yattaqoona aw yuhdithu lahum thikran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus we have revealed it as a Lecture in Arabic, and have displayed therein certain threats, that peradventure they may keep from evil or that it may cause them to take heed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][114]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu wala taAAjal bialqurani min qabli an yuqda ilayka wahyuhu waqul rabbi zidnee AAilman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then exalted be Allah, the True King! And hasten not (O Muhammad) with the Qur'an ere its revelation hath been perfected unto thee, and say: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][115]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad AAahidna ila adama min qablu fanasiya walam najid lahu AAazman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We made a covenant of old with Adam, but he forgot, and We found no constancy in him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][116]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa aba}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We said unto the angels: Fall prostrate before Adam, they fell prostrate (all) save Iblis; he refused.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][117]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqulna ya adamu inna hatha AAaduwwun laka walizawjika fala yukhrijannakuma mina aljannati fatashqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor we said: O Adam! This is an enemy unto thee and unto thy wife, so let him not drive you both out of the Garden so that thou come to toil.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][118]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna laka alla tajooAAa feeha wala taAAra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is (vouchsafed) unto thee that thou hungerest not therein nor art naked,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][119]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waannaka la tathmao feeha wala tadha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that thou thirstest not therein nor art exposed to the sun's heat.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][120]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fawaswasa ilayhi alshshaytanu qala ya adamu hal adulluka AAala shajarati alkhuldi wamulkin la yabla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But the devil whispered to him, saying: O Adam! Shall I show thee the tree of immortality and power that wasteth not away?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][121]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faakala minha fabadat lahuma sawatuhuma watafiqa yakhsifani AAalayhima min waraqi aljannati waAAasa adamu rabbahu faghawa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then they twain ate thereof, so that their shame became apparent unto them, and they began to hide by heaping on themselves some of the leaves of the Garden. And Adam disobeyed his Lord, so went astray.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][122]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma ijtabahu rabbuhu fataba AAalayhi wahada}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then his Lord chose him, and relented toward him, and guided him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][123]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ihbita minha jameeAAan baAAdukum libaAAdin AAaduwwun faimma yatiyannakum minnee hudan famani ittabaAAa hudaya fala yadillu wala yashqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Go down hence, both of you, one of you a foe unto the other. But when there come unto you from Me a guidance, then whoso followeth My guidance, he will not go astray nor come to grief.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][124]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman aAArada AAan thikree fainna lahu maAAeeshatan dankan wanahshuruhu yawma alqiyamati aAAman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But he who turneth away from remembrance of Me, his will be a narrow life, and I shall bring him blind to the assembly on the Day of Resurrection.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][125]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi lima hashartanee aAAma waqad kuntu baseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He will say: My Lord! Wherefor hast Thou gathered me (hither) blind, when I was wont to see?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][126]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala kathalika atatka ayatuna fanaseetaha wakathalika alyawma tunsa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He will say: So (it must be). Our revelations came unto thee but thou didst forget them. In like manner thou art forgotten this Day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][127]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakathalika najzee man asrafa walam yumin biayati rabbihi walaAAathabu alakhirati ashaddu waabqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus do We reward him who is prodigal and believeth not the revelations of his Lord; and verily the doom of the Hereafter will be sterner and more lasting.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][128]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni yamshoona fee masakinihim inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is it not a guidance for them (to know) how many a generation We destroyed before them, amid whose dwellings they walk? Lo! therein verily are signs for men of thought.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][129]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika lakana lizaman waajalun musamman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And but for a decree that had already gone forth from thy Lord, and a term already fixed, the judgment would have been inevitable (in this world).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][130]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla ghuroobiha wamin anai allayli fasabbih waatrafa alnnahari laAAallaka tarda}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor (O Muhammad), bear with what they say, and celebrate the praise of thy Lord ere the rising of the sun and ere the going down thereof. And glorify Him some hours of the night and at the two ends of the day, that thou mayst find acceptance.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][131]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum zahrata alhayati alddunya linaftinahum feehi warizqu rabbika khayrun waabqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoy, the flower of the life of the world, that We may try them thereby. The provision of thy Lord is better and more lasting.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][132]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamur ahlaka bialssalati waistabir AAalayha la nasaluka rizqan nahnu narzuquka waalAAaqibatu lilttaqwa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And enjoin upon thy people worship, and be constant therein. We ask not of thee a provision: We provided for thee. And the sequel is for righteousness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][133]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo lawla yateena biayatin min rabbihi awalam tatihim bayyinatu ma fee alssuhufi aloola}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: If only he would bring us a miracle from his Lord! Hath there not come unto them the proof of what is in the former scriptures?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][134]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw anna ahlaknahum biAAathabin min qablihi laqaloo rabbana lawla arsalta ilayna rasoolan fanattabiAAa ayatika min qabli an nathilla wanakhza}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if we had destroyed them with some punishment before it, they would assuredly have said: Our Lord! If only Thou hadst sent unto us a messenger, so that we might have followed Thy revelations before we were (thus) humbled and disgraced!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[20][135]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul kullun mutarabbisun fatarabbasoo fasataAAlamoona man ashabu alssirati alssawiyyi wamani ihtada}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Each is awaiting; so await ye! Ye will come to know who are the owners of the path of equity, and who is right.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Anbiya' (The Prophets)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Iqtaraba lilnnasi hisabuhum wahum fee ghaflatin muAAridoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Their reckoning draweth nigh for mankind, while they turn away in heedlessness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma yateehim min thikrin min rabbihim muhdathin illa istamaAAoohu wahum yalAAaboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Never cometh there unto them a new reminder from their Lord but they listen to it while they play,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahiyatan quloobuhum waasarroo alnnajwa allatheena thalamoo hal hatha illa basharun mithlukum afatatoona alssihra waantum tubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} With hearts preoccupied. And they confer in secret. The wrong-doers say: Is this other than a mortal like you? Will ye then succumb to magic when ye see (it)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbee yaAAlamu alqawla fee alssamai waalardi wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He saith: My Lord knoweth what is spoken in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal qaloo adghathu ahlamin bali iftarahu bal huwa shaAAirun falyatina biayatin kama orsila alawwaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, say they, (these are but) muddled dreams; nay, he hath but invented it; nay, he is but a poet. Let him bring us a portent even as those of old (who were Allah's messengers) were sent (with portents).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma amanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaha afahum yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Not a township believed of those which We destroyed before them (though We sent them portents): would they then believe?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama arsalna qablaka illa rijalan noohee ilayhim faisaloo ahla alththikri in kuntum la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men, whom We inspired. Ask the followers of the Reminder if ye know not?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama jaAAalnahum jasadan la yakuloona alttaAAama wama kanoo khalideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We gave them not bodies that would not eat food, nor were they immortals.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma sadaqnahumu alwaAAda faanjaynahum waman nashao waahlakna almusrifeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then we fulfilled the promise unto them. So we delivered them and whom We would, and We destroyed the prodigals.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad anzalna ilaykum kitaban feehi thikrukum afala taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Now We have revealed unto you a Scripture wherein is your Reminder. Have ye then no sense?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakam qasamna min qaryatin kanat thalimatan waanshana baAAdaha qawman akhareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How many a community that dealt unjustly have We shattered, and raised up after them another folk!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma ahassoo basana itha hum minha yarkudoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And, when they felt Our might, behold them fleeing from it!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La tarkudoo wairjiAAoo ila ma otriftum feehi wamasakinikum laAAallakum tusaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (But it was said unto them): Flee not, but return to that (existence) which emasculated you and to your dwellings, that ye may be questioned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They cried: Alas for us! we were wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama zalat tilka daAAwahum hatta jaAAalnahum haseedan khamideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And this their crying ceased not till We made them as reaped corn, extinct.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in play.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Law aradna an nattakhitha lahwan laittakhathnahu min ladunna in kunna faAAileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If We had wished to find a pastime, We could have found it in Our presence - if We ever did.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal naqthifu bialhaqqi AAala albatili fayadmaghuhu faitha huwa zahiqun walakumu alwaylu mimma tasifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but We hurl the true against the false, and it doth break its head and lo! it vanisheth. And yours will be woe for that which ye ascribe (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walahu man fee alssamawati waalardi waman AAindahu la yastakbiroona AAan AAibadatihi wala yastahsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Him belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those who dwell in His presence are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they weary;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yusabbihoona allayla waalnnahara la yafturoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They glorify (Him) night and day; they flag not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ami ittakhathoo alihatan mina alardi hum yunshiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or have they chosen gods from the earth who raise the dead?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Law kana feehima alihatun illa Allahu lafasadata fasubhana Allahi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If there were therein gods beside Allah, then verily both (the heavens and the earth) had been disordered. Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Throne, from all that they ascribe (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yusalu AAamma yafAAalu wahum yusaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He will not be questioned as to that which He doeth, but they will be questioned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ami ittakhathoo min doonihi alihatan qul hatoo burhanakum hatha thikru man maAAiya wathikru man qablee bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona alhaqqa fahum muAAridoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or have they chosen other gods beside Him? say: Bring your proof (of their godhead). This is the Reminder of those with me and those before me, but most of them know not the Truth and so they are averse.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama arsalna min qablika min rasoolin illa noohee ilayhi annahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We sent no messenger before thee but We inspired him, (saying): There is no Allah save Me (Allah), so worship Me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan subhanahu bal AAibadun mukramoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son. Be He Glorified! Nay, but (those whom they call sons) are honoured slaves;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yasbiqoonahu bialqawli wahum biamrihi yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They speak not until He hath spoken, and they act by His command.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yashfaAAoona illa limani irtada wahum min khashyatihi mushfiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He knoweth what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him whom He accepteth, and they quake for awe of Him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman yaqul minhum innee ilahun min doonihi fathalika najzeehi jahannama kathalika najzee alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And one of them who should say: Lo! I am a god beside Him, that one We should repay with hell. Thus We Repay wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yara allatheena kafaroo anna alssamawati waalarda kanata ratqan fafataqnahuma wajaAAalna mina almai kulla shayin hayyin afala yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were of one piece, then We parted them, and we made every living thing of water? Will they not then believe?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalna fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bihim wajaAAalna feeha fijajan subulan laAAallahum yahtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We have placed in the earth firm hills lest it quake with them, and We have placed therein ravines as roads that haply they may find their way.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalna alssamaa saqfan mahfoothan wahum AAan ayatiha muAAridoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And we have made the sky a roof withheld (from them). Yet they turn away from its portents.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee khalaqa allayla waalnnahara waalshshamsa waalqamara kullun fee falakin yasbahoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. They float, each in an orbit.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama jaAAalna libasharin min qablika alkhulda afain mitta fahumu alkhalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We appointed immortality for no mortal before thee. What! if thou diest, can they be immortal!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kullu nafsin thaiqatu almawti wanablookum bialshsharri waalkhayri fitnatan wailayna turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Every soul must taste of death, and We try you with evil and with good, for ordeal. And unto Us ye will be returned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha raaka allatheena kafaroo in yattakhithoonaka illa huzuwan ahatha allathee yathkuru alihatakum wahum bithikri alrrahmani hum kafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when those who disbelieve behold thee, they but choose thee out for mockery, (saying): Is this he who maketh mention of your gods? And they would deny all mention of the Beneficent.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khuliqa alinsanu min AAajalin saoreekum ayatee fala tastaAAjiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Man is made of haste. I shall show you My portents, but ask Me not to hasten.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: When will this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Law yaAAlamu allatheena kafaroo heena la yakuffoona AAan wujoohihimu alnnara wala AAan thuhoorihim wala hum yunsaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not be able to drive off the fire from their faces and from their backs, and they will not be helped!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal tateehim baghtatan fatabhatuhum fala yastateeAAoona raddaha wala hum yuntharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but it will come upon them unawares so that it will stupefy them, and they will be unable to repel it, neither will they be reprieved.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqadi istuhzia birusulin min qablika fahaqa biallatheena sakhiroo minhum ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Messengers before thee, indeed, were mocked, but that whereat they mocked surrounded those who scoffed at them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul man yaklaokum biallayli waalnnahari mina alrrahmani bal hum AAan thikri rabbihim muAAridoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Who guardeth you in the night or in the day from the Beneficent? Nay, but they turn away from mention of their Lord!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am lahum alihatun tamnaAAuhum min doonina la yastateeAAoona nasra anfusihim wala hum minna yushaboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or have they gods who can shield them from Us? They cannot help themselves nor can they be defended from Us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal mattaAAna haolai waabaahum hatta tala AAalayhimu alAAumuru afala yarawna anna natee alarda nanqusuha min atrafiha afahumu alghaliboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but We gave these and their fathers ease until life grew long for them. See they not how we aim to the land, reducing it of its outlying parts? Can they then be the victors?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul innama onthirukum bialwahyi wala yasmaAAu alssummu aldduAAaa itha ma yuntharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I warn you only by the Inspiration. But the deaf hear not the call when they are warned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walain massathum nafhatun min AAathabi rabbika layaqoolunna ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if a breath of thy Lord's punishment were to touch them, they assuredly would say: Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WanadaAAu almawazeena alqista liyawmi alqiyamati fala tuthlamu nafsun shayan wain kana mithqala habbatin min khardalin atayna biha wakafa bina hasibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection so that no soul is wronged in aught. Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it. And We suffice for reckoners.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad atayna moosa waharoona alfurqana wadiyaan wathikran lilmuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi wahum mina alssaAAati mushfiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who fear their Lord in secret and who dread the Hour (of doom).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahatha thikrun mubarakun anzalnahu afaantum lahu munkiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is a blessed Reminder that we have revealed: Will ye then reject it?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad atayna ibraheema rushdahu min qablu wakunna bihi AAalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We verily gave Abraham of old his proper course, and We were Aware of him,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma hathihi alttamatheelu allatee antum laha AAakifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When he said unto his father and his folk: What are these images unto which ye pay devotion?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo wajadna abaana laha AAabideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: We found our fathers worshippers of them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala laqad kuntum antum waabaokum fee dalalin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Verily ye and your fathers were in plain error.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ajitana bialhaqqi am anta mina allaAAibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Bringest thou unto us the truth, or art thou some jester?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala bal rabbukum rabbu alssamawati waalardi allathee fatarahunna waana AAala thalikum mina alshshahideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them; and I am of those who testify unto that.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WataAllahi laakeedanna asnamakum baAAda an tuwalloo mudbireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols after ye have gone away and turned your backs.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FajaAAalahum juthathan illa kabeeran lahum laAAallahum ilayhi yarjiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then he reduced them to fragments, all save the chief of them, that haply they might have recourse to it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo man faAAala hatha bialihatina innahu lamina alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Who hath done this to our gods? Surely it must be some evil-doer.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo samiAAna fatan yathkuruhum yuqalu lahu ibraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: We heard a youth make mention of them, who is called Abraham.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo fatoo bihi AAala aAAyuni alnnasi laAAallahum yashhadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Then bring him (hither) before the people's eyes that they may testify.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo aanta faAAalta hatha bialihatina ya ibraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Is it thou who hast done this to our gods, O Abraham?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala bal faAAalahu kabeeruhum hatha faisaloohum in kanoo yantiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: But this, their chief hath done it. So question them, if they can speak.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FarajaAAoo ila anfusihim faqaloo innakum antumu alththalimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then gathered they apart and said: Lo! ye yourselves are the wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma nukisoo AAala ruoosihim laqad AAalimta ma haolai yantiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they were utterly confounded, and they said: Well thou knowest that these speak not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala afataAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yanfaAAukum shayan wala yadurrukum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Worship ye then instead of Allah that which cannot profit you at all, nor harm you?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Offin lakum walima taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi afala taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Fie on you and all that ye worship instead of Allah! Have ye then no sense?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo harriqoohu waonsuroo alihatakum in kuntum faAAileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They cried: Burn him and stand by your gods, if ye will be doing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qulna ya naru koonee bardan wasalaman AAala ibraheema}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We said: O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaradoo bihi kaydan fajaAAalnahumu alakhsareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they wished to set a snare for him, but We made them the greater losers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanajjaynahu walootan ila alardi allatee barakna feeha lilAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We rescued him and Lot (and brought them) to the land which We have blessed for (all) peoples.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wawahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba nafilatan wakullan jaAAalna saliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We bestowed upon him Isaac, and Jacob as a grandson. Each of them We made righteous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalnahum aimmatan yahdoona biamrina waawhayna ilayhim fiAAla alkhayrati waiqama alssalati waeetaa alzzakati wakanoo lana AAabideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We made them chiefs who guide by Our command, and We inspired in them the doing of good deeds and the right establishment of worship and the giving of alms, and they were worshippers of Us (alone).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walootan ataynahu hukman waAAilman wanajjaynahu mina alqaryati allatee kanat taAAmalu alkhabaitha innahum kanoo qawma sawin fasiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto Lot we gave judgment and knowledge, and We delivered him from the community that did abominations. Lo! they were folk of evil, lewd.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waadkhalnahu fee rahmatina innahu mina alssaliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We brought him in unto Our mercy. Lo! he was of the righteous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanoohan ith nada min qablu faistajabna lahu fanajjaynahu waahlahu mina alkarbi alAAatheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Noah, when he cried of old, We heard his prayer and saved him and his household from the great affliction.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanasarnahu mina alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayatina innahum kanoo qawma sawin faaghraqnahum ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And delivered him from the people who denied Our revelations. Lo! they were folk of evil, therefor did We drown them all.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wadawooda wasulaymana ith yahkumani fee alharthi ith nafashat feehi ghanamu alqawmi wakunna lihukmihim shahideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment concerning the field, when people's sheep had strayed and browsed therein by night; and We were witnesses to their judgment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fafahhamnaha sulaymana wakullan atayna hukman waAAilman wasakhkharna maAAa dawooda aljibala yusabbihna waalttayra wakunna faAAileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We made Solomon to understand (the case); and unto each of them We gave judgment and knowledge. And we subdued the hills and the birds to hymn (His) praise along with David. We were the doers (thereof).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAallamnahu sanAAata laboosin lakum lituhsinakum min basikum fahal antum shakiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We taught him the art of making garments (of mail) to protect you in your daring. Are ye then thankful?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walisulaymana alrreeha AAasifatan tajree biamrihi ila alardi allatee barakna feeha wakunna bikulli shayin AAalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto Solomon (We subdued) the wind in its raging. It set by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And of everything We are Aware.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamina alshshayateeni man yaghoosoona lahu wayaAAmaloona AAamalan doona thalika wakunna lahum hafitheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of the evil ones (subdued We unto him) some who dived (for pearls) for him and did other work, and We were warders unto them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alddurru waanta arhamu alrrahimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Job, when he cried unto his Lord, (saying): Lo! adversity afflicteth me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faistajabna lahu fakashafna ma bihi min durrin waataynahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan min AAindina wathikra lilAAabideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We heard his prayer and removed that adversity from which he suffered, and We gave him his household (that he had lost) and the like thereof along with them, a mercy from Our store, and a remembrance for the worshippers;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaismaAAeela waidreesa watha alkifli kullun mina alssabireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (mention) Ishmael, and Idris, and Dhu'l-Kifl. All were of the steadfast.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waadkhalnahum fee rahmatina innahum mina alssaliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We brought them in unto Our mercy. Lo! they are among the righteous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watha alnnooni ith thahaba mughadiban fathanna an lan naqdira AAalayhi fanada fee alththulumati an la ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu mina alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (mention) Dhu'n-Nun, when he went off in anger and deemed that We had no power over him, but he cried out in the darkness, saying: There is no Allah save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faistajabna lahu wanajjaynahu mina alghammi wakathalika nunjee almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then we heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish. Thus we save believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wazakariyya ith nada rabbahu rabbi la tatharnee fardan waanta khayru alwaritheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Zachariah, when he cried unto his Lord: My Lord! Leave me not childless, though Thou art the Best of inheritors.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faistajabna lahu wawahabna lahu yahya waaslahna lahu zawjahu innahum kanoo yusariAAoona fee alkhayrati wayadAAoonana raghaban warahaban wakanoo lana khashiAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We heard his prayer, and bestowed upon him John, and adjusted his wife (to bear a child) for him. Lo! they used to vie one with the other in good deeds, and they cried unto Us in longing and in fear, and were submissive unto Us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatee ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna feeha min roohina wajaAAalnaha waibnaha ayatan lilAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And she who was chaste, therefor We breathed into her (something) of Our Spirit and made her and her son a token for (all) peoples.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna hathihi ommatukum ommatan wahidatan waana rabbukum faoAAbudooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WataqattaAAoo amrahum baynahum kullun ilayna rajiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they have broken their religion (into fragments) among them, (yet) all are returning unto Us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa muminun fala kufrana lisaAAyihi wainna lahu katiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then whoso doeth some good works and is a believer, there will be no rejection of his effort. Lo! We record (it) for him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waharamun AAala qaryatin ahlaknaha annahum la yarjiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And there is a ban upon any community which We have destroyed: that they shall not return.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatta itha futihat yajooju wamajooju wahum min kulli hadabin yansiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Until, when Gog and Magog are let loose, and they hasten out of every mound,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waiqtaraba alwaAAdu alhaqqu faitha hiya shakhisatun absaru allatheena kafaroo ya waylana qad kunna fee ghaflatin min hatha bal kunna thalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the True Promise draweth nigh; then behold them, staring wide (in terror), the eyes of those who disbelieve! (They say): Alas for us! We (lived) in forgetfulness of this. Ah, but we were wrong-doers!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innakum wama taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! ye (idolaters) and that which ye worship beside Allah are fuel of hell. Thereunto ye will come.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Law kana haolai alihatan ma waradooha wakullun feeha khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If these had been gods they would not have come thither, but all will abide therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahum feeha zafeerun wahum feeha la yasmaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therein wailing is their portion, and therein they hear not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena sabaqat lahum minna alhusna olaika AAanha mubAAadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those unto whom kindness hath gone forth before from Us, they will be far removed from thence.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yasmaAAoona haseesaha wahum fee ma ishtahat anfusuhum khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will not hear the slightest sound thereof, while they abide in that which their souls desire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yahzunuhumu alfazaAAu alakbaru watatalaqqahumu almalaikatu hatha yawmukumu allathee kuntum tooAAadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Supreme Horror will not grieve them, and the angels will welcome them, (saying): This is your Day which ye were promised;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma natwee alssamaa katayyi alssijlli lilkutubi kama badana awwala khalqin nuAAeeduhu waAAdan AAalayna inna kunna faAAileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Day when We shall roll up the heavens as a recorder rolleth up a written scroll. As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise (binding) upon Us. Lo! We are to perform it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad katabna fee alzzaboori min baAAdi alththikri anna alarda yarithuha AAibadiya alssalihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily we have written in the Scripture, after the Reminder: My righteous slaves will inherit the earth:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna fee hatha labalaghan liqawmin AAabideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! there is a plain statement for folk who are devout.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama arsalnaka illa rahmatan lilAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We sent thee not save as a mercy for the peoples.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul innama yooha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun fahal antum muslimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: It is only inspired in me that your Allah is One Allah. Will ye then surrender (unto Him)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain tawallaw faqul athantukum AAala sawain wain adree aqareebun am baAAeedun ma tooAAadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But if they are averse, then say: I have warned you all alike, although I know not whether nigh or far is that which ye are promised.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu yaAAlamu aljahra mina alqawli wayaAAlamu ma taktumoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! He knoweth that which is said openly, and that which ye conceal.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain adree laAAallahu fitnatun lakum wamataAAun ila heenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And I know not but that this may be a trial for you, and enjoyment for a while.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[21][112]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi ohkum bialhaqqi warabbuna alrrahmanu almustaAAanu AAala ma tasifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He saith: My Lord! Judge Thou with truth. Our Lord is the Beneficent, Whose help is to be implored against that which ye ascribe (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Hajj (The Pilgrimage)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnasu ittaqoo rabbakum inna zalzalata alssaAAati shayon AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O mankind! Fear your Lord. Lo! the earthquake of the Hour (of Doom) is a tremendous thing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma tarawnaha tathhalu kullu murdiAAatin AAamma ardaAAat watadaAAu kullu thati hamlin hamlaha watara alnnasa sukara wama hum bisukara walakinna AAathaba Allahi shadeedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when ye behold it, every nursing mother will forget her nursling and every pregnant one will be delivered of her burden, and thou (Muhammad) wilt see mankind as drunken, yet they will not be drunken, but the Doom of Allah will be strong (upon them).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamina alnnasi man yujadilu fee Allahi bighayri AAilmin wayattabiAAu kulla shaytanin mareedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Among mankind is he who disputeth concerning Allah without knowledge, and followeth each froward devil;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kutiba AAalayhi annahu man tawallahu faannahu yudilluhu wayahdeehi ila AAathabi alssaAAeeri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For him it is decreed that whoso taketh him for friend, he verily will mislead him and will guide him to the punishment of the Flame.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnasu in kuntum fee raybin mina albaAAthi fainna khalaqnakum min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma min AAalaqatin thumma min mudghatin mukhallaqatin waghayri mukhallaqatin linubayyina lakum wanuqirru fee alarhami ma nashao ila ajalin musamman thumma nukhrijukum tiflan thumma litablughoo ashuddakum waminkum man yutawaffa waminkum man yuraddu ila arthali alAAumuri likayla yaAAlama min baAAdi AAilmin shayan watara alarda hamidatan faitha anzalna AAalayha almaa ihtazzat warabat waanbatat min kulli zawjin baheejin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O mankind! if ye are in doubt concerning the Resurrection, then lo! We have created you from dust, then from a drop of seed, then from a clot, then from a little lump of flesh shapely and shapeless, that We may make (it) clear for you. And We cause what We will to remain in the wombs for an appointed time, and afterward We bring you forth as infants, then (give you growth) that ye attain your full strength. And among you there is he who dieth (young), and among you there is he who is brought back to the most abject time of life, so that, after knowledge, he knoweth naught. And thou (Muhammad) seest the earth barren, but when We send down water thereon, it doth thrill and swell and put forth every lovely kind (of growth).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika bianna Allaha huwa alhaqqu waannahu yuhyee almawta waannahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That is because Allah, He is the Truth and because He quickeneth the dead, and because He is Able to do all things;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanna alssaAAata atiyatun la rayba feeha waanna Allaha yabAAathu man fee alquboori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And because the Hour will come, there is no doubt thereof; and because Allah will raise those who are in the graves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamina alnnasi man yujadilu fee Allahi bighayri AAilmin wala hudan wala kitabin muneerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And among mankind is he who disputeth concerning Allah without knowledge or guidance or a scripture giving light,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thaniya AAitfihi liyudilla AAan sabeeli Allahi lahu fee alddunya khizyun wanutheequhu yawma alqiyamati AAathaba alhareeqi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Turning away in pride to beguile (men) from the way of Allah. For him in this world is ignominy, and on the Day of Resurrection We make him taste the doom of burning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika bima qaddamat yadaka waanna Allaha laysa bithallamin lilAAabeedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And unto him it will be said): This is for that which thy two hands have sent before, and because Allah is no oppressor of His slaves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamina alnnasi man yaAAbudu Allaha AAala harfin fain asabahu khayrun itmaanna bihi wain asabathu fitnatun inqalaba AAala wajhihi khasira alddunya waalakhirata thalika huwa alkhusranu almubeenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And among mankind is he who worshippeth Allah upon a narrow marge so that if good befalleth him he is content therewith, but if a trial befalleth him, he falleth away utterly. He loseth both the world and the Hereafter. That is the sheer loss.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YadAAoo min dooni Allahi ma la yadurruhu wama la yanfaAAuhu thalika huwa alddalalu albaAAeedu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He calleth, beside Allah, unto that which hurteth him not nor benefiteth him. That is the far error.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YadAAoo laman darruhu aqrabu min nafAAihi labisa almawla walabisa alAAasheeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He calleth unto him whose harm is nearer than his benefit; verily an evil patron and verily an evil friend!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha yudkhilu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu inna Allaha yafAAalu ma yureedu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah causeth those who believe and do good works to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow. Lo! Allah doth what He intendeth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man kana yathunnu an lan yansurahu Allahu fee alddunya waalakhirati falyamdud bisababin ila alssamai thumma liyaqtaAA falyanthur hal yuthhibanna kayduhu ma yagheethu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whoso is wont to think (through envy) that Allah will not give him (Muhammad) victory in the world and the Hereafter (and is enraged at the thought of his victory), let him stretch a rope up to the roof (of his dwelling), and let him hang himself. Then let him see whether his strategy dispelleth that whereat he rageth!.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakathalika anzalnahu ayatin bayyinatin waanna Allaha yahdee man yureedu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus We reveal it as plain revelations, and verily Allah guideth whom He will.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena amanoo waallatheena hadoo waalssabieena waalnnasara waalmajoosa waallatheena ashrakoo inna Allaha yafsilu baynahum yawma alqiyamati inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin shaheedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who believe (this revelation), and those who are Jews, and the Sabaeans and the Christians and the Magians and the idolaters - Lo! Allah will decide between them on the Day of Resurrection. Lo! Allah is Witness over all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara anna Allaha yasjudu lahu man fee alssamawati waman fee alardi waalshshamsu waalqamaru waalnnujoomu waaljibalu waalshshajaru waalddawabbu wakatheerun mina alnnasi wakatheerun haqqa AAalayhi alAAathabu waman yuhini Allahu fama lahu min mukrimin inna Allaha yafAAalu ma yashao}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou not seen that unto Allah payeth adoration whosoever is in the heavens and whosoever is in the earth, and the sun, and the moon, and the stars, and the hills, and the trees, and the beasts, and many of mankind, while there are many unto whom the doom is justly due. He whom Allah scorneth, there is none to give him honour. Lo! Allah doeth what He will.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hathani khasmani ikhtasamoo fee rabbihim faallatheena kafaroo quttiAAat lahum thiyabun min narin yusabbu min fawqi ruoosihimu alhameemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} These twain (the believers and the disbelievers) are two opponents who contend concerning their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, garments of fire will be cut out for them; boiling fluid will be poured down on their heads,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yusharu bihi ma fee butoonihim waaljuloodu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whereby that which is in their bellies, and their skins too, will be melted;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walahum maqamiAAu min hadeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And for them are hooked rods of iron.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kullama aradoo an yakhrujoo minha min ghammin oAAeedoo feeha wathooqoo AAathaba alhareeqi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whenever, in their anguish, they would go forth from thence they are driven back therein and (it is said unto them): Taste the doom of burning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha yudkhilu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu yuhallawna feeha min asawira min thahabin waluluan walibasuhum feeha hareerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah will cause those who believe and do good works to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will be allowed armlets of gold, and pearls, and their raiment therein will be silk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahudoo ila alttayyibi mina alqawli wahudoo ila sirati alhameedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They are guided unto gentle speech; they are guided unto the path of the Glorious One.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena kafaroo wayasuddoona AAan sabeeli Allahi waalmasjidi alharami allathee jaAAalnahu lilnnasi sawaan alAAakifu feehi waalbadi waman yurid feehi biilhadin bithulmin nuthiqhu min AAathabin aleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who disbelieve and bar (men) from the way of Allah and from the Inviolable Place of Worship, which We have appointed for mankind together, the dweller therein and the nomad: whosoever seeketh wrongful partiality therein, him We shall cause to taste a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith bawwana liibraheema makana albayti an la tushrik bee shayan watahhir baytiya lilttaifeena waalqaimeena waalrrukkaAAi alssujoodi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (remember) when We prepared for Abraham the place of the (holy) House, saying: Ascribe thou no thing as partner unto Me, and purify My House for those who make the round (thereof) and those who stand and those who bow and make prostration.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaththin fee alnnasi bialhajji yatooka rijalan waAAala kulli damirin yateena min kulli fajjin AAameeqin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And proclaim unto mankind the pilgrimage. They will come unto thee on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every deep ravine,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyashhadoo manafiAAa lahum wayathkuroo isma Allahi fee ayyamin maAAloomatin AAala ma razaqahum min baheemati alanAAami fakuloo minha waatAAimoo albaisa alfaqeera}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That they may witness things that are of benefit to them, and mention the name of Allah on appointed days over the beast of cattle that He hath bestowed upon them. Then eat thereof and feed therewith the poor unfortunate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma lyaqdoo tafathahum walyoofoo nuthoorahum walyattawwafoo bialbayti alAAateeqi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then let them make an end of their unkemptness and pay their vows and go around the ancient House.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika waman yuAAaththim hurumati Allahi fahuwa khayrun lahu AAinda rabbihi waohillat lakumu alanAAamu illa ma yutla AAalaykum faijtaniboo alrrijsa mina alawthani waijtaniboo qawla alzzoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That (is the command). And whoso magnifieth the sacred things of Allah, it will be well for him in the sight of his Lord. The cattle are lawful unto you save that which hath been told you. So shun the filth of idols, and shun lying speech,}
