\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hunafaa lillahi ghayra mushrikeena bihi waman yushrik biAllahi fakaannama kharra mina alssamai fatakhtafuhu alttayru aw tahwee bihi alrreehu fee makanin saheeqin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Turning unto Allah (only), not ascribing partners unto Him; for whoso ascribeth partners unto Allah, it is as if he had fallen from the sky and the birds had snatched him or the wind had blown him to a far-off place.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika waman yuAAaththim shaAAaira Allahi fainnaha min taqwa alquloobi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That (is the command). And whoso magnifieth the offerings consecrated to Allah, it surely is from devotion of the hearts,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lakum feeha manafiAAu ila ajalin musamman thumma mahilluha ila albayti alAAateeqi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therein are benefits for you for an appointed term; and afterward they are brought for sacrifice unto the ancient House.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walikulli ommatin jaAAalna mansakan liyathkuroo isma Allahi AAala ma razaqahum min baheemati alanAAami failahukum ilahun wahidun falahu aslimoo wabashshiri almukhbiteena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And for every nation have We appointed a ritual, that they may mention the name of Allah over the beast of cattle that He hath given them for food; and your god is One God, therefor surrender unto Him. And give good tidings (O Muhammad) to the humble,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena itha thukira Allahu wajilat quloobuhum waalssabireena AAala ma asabahum waalmuqeemee alssalati wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whose hearts fear when Allah is mentioned, and the patient of whatever may befall them, and those who establish worship and who spend of that We have bestowed on them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalbudna jaAAalnaha lakum min shaAAairi Allahi lakum feeha khayrun faothkuroo isma Allahi AAalayha sawaffa faitha wajabat junoobuha fakuloo minha waatAAimoo alqaniAAa waalmuAAtarra kathalika sakhkharnaha lakum laAAallakum tashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the camels! We have appointed them among the ceremonies of Allah. Therein ye have much good. So mention the name of Allah over them when they are drawn up in lines. Then when their flanks fall (dead), eat thereof and feed the beggar and the suppliant. Thus have We made them subject unto you, that haply ye may give thanks.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lan yanala Allaha luhoomuha wala dimaoha walakin yanaluhu alttaqwa minkum kathalika sakhkharaha lakum litukabbiroo Allaha AAala ma hadakum wabashshiri almuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Their flesh and their food reach not Allah, but the devotion from you reacheth Him. Thus have We made them subject unto you that ye may magnify Allah that He hath guided you. And give good tidings (O Muhammad) to the good.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha yudafiAAu AAani allatheena amanoo inna Allaha la yuhibbu kulla khawwanin kafoorin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah defendeth those who are true. Lo! Allah loveth not each treacherous ingrate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Othina lillatheena yuqataloona biannahum thulimoo wainna Allaha AAala nasrihim laqadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Sanction is given unto those who fight because they have been wronged; and Allah is indeed Able to give them victory;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena okhrijoo min diyarihim bighayri haqqin illa an yaqooloo rabbuna Allahu walawla dafAAu Allahi alnnasa baAAdahum bibaAAdin lahuddimat sawamiAAu wabiyaAAun wasalawatun wamasajidu yuthkaru feeha ismu Allahi katheeran walayansuranna Allahu man yansuruhu inna Allaha laqawiyyun AAazeezun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who have been driven from their homes unjustly only because they said: Our Lord is Allah - For had it not been for Allah's repelling some men by means of others, cloisters and churches and oratories and mosques, wherein the name of Allah is oft mentioned, would assuredly have been pulled down. Verily Allah helpeth one who helpeth Him. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena in makkannahum fee alardi aqamoo alssalata waatawoo alzzakata waamaroo bialmaAAroofi wanahaw AAani almunkari walillahi AAaqibatu alomoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who, if We give them power in the land, establish worship and pay the poor-due and enjoin kindness and forbid iniquity. And Allah's is the sequel of events.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain yukaththibooka faqad kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waAAadun wathamoodu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If they deny thee (Muhammad), even so the folk of Noah, and (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud, before thee, denied (Our messengers);}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqawmu ibraheema waqawmu lootin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the folk of Abraham and the folk of Lot;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waashabu madyana wakuththiba moosa faamlaytu lilkafireena thumma akhathtuhum fakayfa kana nakeeri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And) the dwellers in Midian. And Moses was denied; but I indulged the disbelievers a long while, then I seized them, and how (terrible) was My abhorrence!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakaayyin min qaryatin ahlaknaha wahiya thalimatun fahiya khawiyatun AAala AAurooshiha wabirin muAAattalatin waqasrin masheedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How many a township have We destroyed while it was sinful, so that it lieth (to this day) in ruins, and (how many) a deserted well and lofty tower!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afalam yaseeroo fee alardi fatakoona lahum quloobun yaAAqiloona biha aw athanun yasmaAAoona biha fainnaha la taAAma alabsaru walakin taAAma alquloobu allatee fee alssudoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not travelled in the land, and have they hearts wherewith to feel and ears wherewith to hear? For indeed it is not the eyes that grow blind, but it is the hearts, which are within the bosoms, that grow blind.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WayastaAAjiloonaka bialAAathabi walan yukhlifa Allahu waAAdahu wainna yawman AAinda rabbika kaalfi sanatin mimma taAAuddoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they will bid thee hasten on the Doom, and Allah faileth not His promise, but lo! a Day with Allah is as a thousand years of what ye reckon.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakaayyin min qaryatin amlaytu laha wahiya thalimatun thumma akhathtuha wailayya almaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And how many a township did I suffer long though it was sinful! Then I grasped it. Unto Me is the return.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ya ayyuha alnnasu innama ana lakum natheerun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: O mankind! I am only a plain warner unto you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who believe and do good works, for them is pardon and a rich provision;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena saAAaw fee ayatina muAAajizeena olaika ashabu aljaheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} While those who strive to thwart Our revelations, such are rightful owners of the Fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama arsalna min qablika min rasoolin wala nabiyyin illa itha tamanna alqa alshshaytanu fee omniyyatihi fayansakhu Allahu ma yulqee alshshaytanu thumma yuhkimu Allahu ayatihi waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Never sent We a messenger or a prophet before thee but when He recited (the message) Satan proposed (opposition) in respect of that which he recited thereof. But Allah abolisheth that which Satan proposeth. Then Allah establisheth His revelations. Allah is Knower, Wise;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{LiyajAAala ma yulqee alshshaytanu fitnatan lillatheena fee quloobihim maradun waalqasiyati quloobuhum wainna alththalimeena lafee shiqaqin baAAeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That He may make that which the devil proposeth a temptation for those in whose hearts is a disease, and those whose hearts are hardened - Lo! the evil-doers are in open schism -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaliyaAAlama allatheena ootoo alAAilma annahu alhaqqu min rabbika fayuminoo bihi fatukhbita lahu quloobuhum wainna Allaha lahadi allatheena amanoo ila siratin mustaqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that those who have been given knowledge may know that it is the truth from thy Lord, so that they may believe therein and their hearts may submit humbly unto Him. Lo! Allah verily is guiding those who believe unto a right path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala yazalu allatheena kafaroo fee miryatin minhu hatta tatiyahumu alssaAAatu baghtatan aw yatiyahum AAathabu yawmin AAaqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt thereof until the Hour come upon them unawares, or there come unto them the doom of a disastrous day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Almulku yawmaithin lillahi yahkumu baynahum faallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fee jannati alnnaAAeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Sovereignty on that day will be Allah's, He will judge between them. Then those who believed and did good works will be in Gardens of Delight,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina faolaika lahum AAathabun muheenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} While those who disbelieved and denied Our revelations, for them will be a shameful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena hajaroo fee sabeeli Allahi thumma qutiloo aw matoo layarzuqannahumu Allahu rizqan hasanan wainna Allaha lahuwa khayru alrraziqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who fled their homes for the cause of Allah and then were slain or died, Allah verily will provide for them a good provision. Lo! Allah, He verily is Best of all who make provision.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Layudkhilannahum mudkhalan yardawnahu wainna Allaha laAAaleemun haleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Assuredly He will cause them to enter by an entry that they will love. Lo! Allah verily is Knower, Indulgent.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika waman AAaqaba bimithli ma AAooqiba bihi thumma bughiya AAalayhi layansurannahu Allahu inna Allaha laAAafuwwun ghafoorun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That (is so). And whoso hath retaliated with the like of that which he was made to suffer and then hath (again) been wronged, Allah will succour him. Lo! Allah verily is Mild, Forgiving.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika bianna Allaha yooliju allayla fee alnnahari wayooliju alnnahara fee allayli waanna Allaha sameeAAun baseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That is because Allah maketh the night to pass into the day and maketh the day to pass into the night, and because Allah is Hearer, Seer.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika bianna Allaha huwa alhaqqu waanna ma yadAAoona min doonihi huwa albatilu waanna Allaha huwa alAAaliyyu alkabeeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That is because Allah, He is the True, and that whereon they call instead of Him, it is the false, and because Allah, He is the High, the Great.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina alssamai maan fatusbihu alardu mukhdarratan inna Allaha lateefun khabeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Seest thou not how Allah sendeth down water from the sky and then the earth becometh green upon the morrow? Lo! Allah is Subtile, Aware.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wainna Allaha lahuwa alghaniyyu alhameedu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Him belongeth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Lo! Allah, He verily is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara anna Allaha sakhkhara lakum ma fee alardi waalfulka tajree fee albahri biamrihi wayumsiku alssamaa an taqaAAa AAala alardi illa biithnihi inna Allaha bialnnasi laraoofun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou not seen how Allah hath made all that is in the earth subservient unto you? And the ship runneth upon the sea by His command, and He holdeth back the heaven from falling on the earth unless by His leave. Lo! Allah is, for mankind, Full of Pity, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee ahyakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum inna alinsana lakafoorun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who gave you life, then He will cause you to die, and then will give you life (again). Lo! man is verily an ingrate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Likulli ommatin jaAAalna mansakan hum nasikoohu fala yunaziAAunnaka fee alamri waodAAu ila rabbika innaka laAAala hudan mustaqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto each nation have We given sacred rites which they are to perform; so let them not dispute with thee of the matter, but summon thou unto thy Lord. Lo! thou indeed followest right guidance.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain jadalooka faquli Allahu aAAlamu bima taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if they wrangle with thee, say: Allah is Best Aware of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu yahkumu baynakum yawma alqiyamati feema kuntum feehi takhtalifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein ye used to differ.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam taAAlam anna Allaha yaAAlamu ma fee alssamai waalardi inna thalika fee kitabin inna thalika AAala Allahi yaseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou not known that Allah knoweth all that is in the heaven and the earth? Lo! it is in a record. Lo! that is easy for Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WayaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma lam yunazzil bihi sultanan wama laysa lahum bihi AAilmun wama lilththalimeena min naseerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they worship instead of Allah that for which He hath sent down no warrant, and that whereof they have no knowledge. For evil-doers there is no helper.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin taAArifu fee wujoohi allatheena kafaroo almunkara yakadoona yastoona biallatheena yatloona AAalayhim ayatina qul afaonabbiokum bisharrin min thalikum alnnaru waAAadaha Allahu allatheena kafaroo wabisa almaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Our revelations are recited unto them, thou knowest the denial in the faces of those who disbelieve; they all but attack those who recite Our revelations unto them. Say: Shall I proclaim unto you worse than that? The Fire! Allah hath promised it for those who disbelieve. A hapless journey's end!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnasu duriba mathalun faistamiAAoo lahu inna allatheena tadAAoona min dooni Allahi lan yakhluqoo thubaban walawi ijtamaAAoo lahu wain yaslubuhumu alththubabu shayan la yastanqithoohu minhu daAAufa alttalibu waalmatloobu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O mankind! A similitude is coined, so pay ye heed to it: Lo! those on whom ye call beside Allah will never create a fly though they combine together for the purpose. And if the fly took something from them, they could not rescue it from it. So weak are (both) the seeker and the sought!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi inna Allaha laqawiyyun AAazeezun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They measure not Allah His rightful measure. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu yastafee mina almalaikati rusulan wamina alnnasi inna Allaha sameeAAun baseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah chooseth from the angels messengers, and (also) from mankind. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Seer.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum waila Allahi turjaAAu alomooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He knoweth all that is before them and all that is behind them, and unto Allah all things are returned. $$A}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo irkaAAoo waosjudoo waoAAbudoo rabbakum waifAAaloo alkhayra laAAallakum tuflihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Bow down and prostrate yourselves, and worship your Lord, and do good, that haply ye may prosper.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[22][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajahidoo fee Allahi haqqa jihadihi huwa ijtabakum wama jaAAala AAalaykum fee alddeeni min harajin millata abeekum ibraheema huwa sammakumu almuslimeena min qablu wafee hatha liyakoona alrrasoolu shaheedan AAalaykum watakoonoo shuhadaa AAala alnnasi faaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waiAAtasimoo biAllahi huwa mawlakum faniAAma almawla waniAAma alnnaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And strive for Allah with the endeavour which is His right. He hath chosen you and hath not laid upon you in religion any hardship; the faith of your father Abraham (is yours). He hath named you Muslims of old time and in this (Scripture), that the messenger may be a witness against you, and that ye may be witnesses against mankind. So establish worship, pay the poor-due, and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protecting friend. A blessed Patron and a blessed Helper!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Mu'minun (The Believers)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qad aflaha almuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Successful indeed are the believers}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena hum fee salatihim khashiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who are humble in their prayers,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena hum AAani allaghwi muAAridoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And who shun vain conversation,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena hum lilzzakati faAAiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And who are payers of the poor-due;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena hum lifuroojihim hafithoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And who guard their modesty -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save from their wives or the (slaves) that their right hands possess, for then they are not blameworthy,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But whoso craveth beyond that, such are transgressors -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena hum liamanatihim waAAahdihim raAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And who are shepherds of their pledge and their covenant,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena hum AAala salawatihim yuhafithoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And who pay heed to their prayers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika humu alwarithoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} These are the heirs}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yarithoona alfirdawsa hum feeha khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who will inherit paradise. There they will abide.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min sulalatin min teenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Verily We created man from a product of wet earth;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma jaAAalnahu nutfatan fee qararin makeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then placed him as a drop (of seed) in a safe lodging;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma khalaqna alnnutfata AAalaqatan fakhalaqna alAAalaqata mudghatan fakhalaqna almudghata AAithaman fakasawna alAAithama lahman thumma anshanahu khalqan akhara fatabaraka Allahu ahsanu alkhaliqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then fashioned We the drop a clot, then fashioned We the clot a little lump, then fashioned We the little lump bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, and then produced it as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma innakum baAAda thalika lamayyitoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then lo! after that ye surely die.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma innakum yawma alqiyamati tubAAathoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection ye are raised (again).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad khalaqna fawqakum sabAAa taraiqa wama kunna AAani alkhalqi ghafileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We have created above you seven paths, and We are never unmindful of creation.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanzalna mina alssamai maan biqadarin faaskannahu fee alardi wainna AAala thahabin bihi laqadiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And we send down from the sky water in measure, and We give it lodging in the earth, and lo! We are Able to withdraw it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faanshana lakum bihi jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin lakum feeha fawakihu katheeratun waminha takuloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We produce for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you and whereof ye eat;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Washajaratan takhruju min toori saynaa tanbutu bialdduhni wasibghin lilakileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And a tree that springeth forth from Mount Sinai that groweth oil and relish for the eaters.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna lakum fee alanAAami laAAibratan nusqeekum mimma fee butooniha walakum feeha manafiAAu katheeratun waminha takuloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! in the cattle there is verily a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, and many uses have ye in them, and of them do ye eat;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAalayha waAAala alfulki tuhmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And on them and on the ship ye are carried.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad arsalna noohan ila qawmihi faqala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We verily sent Noah unto his folk, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqala almalao allatheena kafaroo min qawmihi ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yureedu an yatafaddala AAalaykum walaw shaa Allahu laanzala malaikatan ma samiAAna bihatha fee abaina alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved, said: This is only a mortal like you who would make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. We heard not of this in the case of our fathers of old.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In huwa illa rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihi hatta heenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He is only a man in whom is a madness, so watch him for a while.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththabooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faawhayna ilayhi ani isnaAAi alfulka biaAAyunina wawahyina faitha jaa amruna wafara alttannooru faosluk feeha min kullin zawjayni ithnayni waahlaka illa man sabaqa AAalayhi alqawlu minhum wala tukhatibnee fee allatheena thalamoo innahum mughraqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We inspired in him, saying: Make the ship under Our eyes and Our inspiration. Then, when Our command cometh and the oven gusheth water, introduce therein of every (kind) two spouses, and thy household save him thereof against whom the Word hath already gone forth. And plead not with Me on behalf of those who have done wrong. Lo! they will be drowned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha istawayta anta waman maAAaka AAala alfulki faquli alhamdu lillahi allathee najjana mina alqawmi alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when thou art on board the ship, thou and whoso is with thee, then say: Praise be to Allah Who hath saved us from the wrongdoing folk!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqul rabbi anzilnee munzalan mubarakan waanta khayru almunzileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And say: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna fee thalika laayatin wain kunna lamubtaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! herein verily are portents, for lo! We are ever putting (mankind) to the test.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma anshana min baAAdihim qarnan akhareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, after them, We brought forth another generation;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faarsalna feehim rasoolan minhum ani oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And we sent among them a messenger of their own, saying: Serve Allah, Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala almalao min qawmihi allatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biliqai alakhirati waatrafnahum fee alhayati alddunya ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yakulu mimma takuloona minhu wayashrabu mimma tashraboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made soft in the life of the world, said: This is only a mortal like you, who eateth of that whereof ye eat and drinketh of that ye drink.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walain ataAAtum basharan mithlakum innakum ithan lakhasiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If ye were to obey a mortal like yourselves, then, lo! ye surely would be losers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AyaAAidukum annakum itha mittum wakuntum turaban waAAithaman annakum mukhrajoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Doth he promise you that you, when ye are dead and have become dust and bones, will (again) be brought forth?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hayhata hayhata lima tooAAadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Begone, begone, with that which ye are promised!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In hiya illa hayatuna alddunya namootu wanahya wama nahnu bimabAAootheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and we shall not be raised (again).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In huwa illa rajulun iftara AAala Allahi kathiban wama nahnu lahu bimumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He is only a man who hath invented a lie about Allah. We are not going to put faith in him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththabooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala AAamma qaleelin layusbihunna nadimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: In a little while they surely will become repentant.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faakhathathumu alssayhatu bialhaqqi fajaAAalnahum ghuthaan fabuAAdan lilqawmi alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So the (Awful) Cry overtook them rightfully, and We made them like as wreckage (that a torrent hurleth). A far removal for wrongdoing folk!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma anshana min baAAdihim quroonan akhareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then after them We brought forth other generations.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha wama yastakhiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} No nation can outstrip its term, nor yet postpone it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma arsalna rusulana tatra kulla ma jaa ommatan rasooluha kaththaboohu faatbaAAna baAAdahum baAAdan wajaAAalnahum ahadeetha fabuAAdan liqawmin la yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We sent our messengers one after another. Whenever its messenger came unto a nation they denied him; so We caused them to follow one another (to disaster) and We made them bywords. A far removal for folk who believe not!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma arsalna moosa waakhahu haroona biayatina wasultanin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our tokens and a clear warrant}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ila firAAawna wamalaihi faistakbaroo wakanoo qawman AAaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they scorned (them) and they were despotic folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqaloo anuminu libasharayni mithlina waqawmuhuma lana AAabidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they said: Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves, and whose folk are servile unto us?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakaththaboohuma fakanoo mina almuhlakeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So they denied them, and became of those who were destroyed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba laAAallahum yahtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We verily gave Moses the Scripture, that haply they might go aright.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalna ibna maryama waommahu ayatan waawaynahuma ila rabwatin thati qararin wamaAAeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent, and We gave them refuge on a height, a place of flocks and watersprings.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alrrusulu kuloo mina alttayyibati waiAAmaloo salihan innee bima taAAmaloona AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye messengers! Eat of the good things, and do right. Lo! I am Aware of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna hathihi ommatukum ommatan wahidatan waana rabbukum faittaqooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! this your religion is one religion and I am your Lord, so keep your duty unto Me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FataqattaAAoo amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu hizbin bima ladayhim farihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But they (mankind) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in its tenets.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatharhum fee ghamratihim hatta heenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So leave them in their error till a time.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ayahsaboona annama numidduhum bihi min malin wabaneena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Think they that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{NusariAAu lahum fee alkhayrati bal la yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We hasten unto them with good things? Nay, but they perceive not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena hum min khashyati rabbihim mushfiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who go in awe for fear of their Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena hum biayati rabbihim yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who believe in the revelations of their Lord,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena hum birabbihim la yushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who ascribe not partners unto their Lord,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena yutoona ma ataw waquloobuhum wajilatun annahum ila rabbihim rajiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who give that which they give with hearts afraid because they are about to return unto their Lord,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika yusariAAoona fee alkhayrati wahum laha sabiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} These race for the good things, and they shall win them in the race.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala nukallifu nafsan illa wusAAaha waladayna kitabun yantiqu bialhaqqi wahum la yuthlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And we task not any soul beyond its scope, and with Us is a Record which speaketh the truth, and they will not be wronged.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal quloobuhum fee ghamratin min hatha walahum aAAmalun min dooni thalika hum laha AAamiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but their hearts are in ignorance of this (Qur'an), and they have other works, besides, which they are doing;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatta itha akhathna mutrafeehim bialAAathabi itha hum yajaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Till when We grasp their luxurious ones with the punishment, behold! they supplicate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La tajaroo alyawma innakum minna la tunsaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Supplicate not this day! Assuredly ye will not be helped by Us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qad kanat ayatee tutla AAalaykum fakuntum AAala aAAqabikum tankisoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} My revelations were recited unto you, but ye used to turn back on your heels,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Mustakbireena bihi samiran tahjuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In scorn thereof. Nightly did ye rave together.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afalam yaddabbaroo alqawla am jaahum ma lam yati abaahumu alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not pondered the Word, or hath that come unto them which came not unto their fathers of old?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am lam yaAArifoo rasoolahum fahum lahu munkiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or know they not their messenger, and so reject him?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am yaqooloona bihi jinnatun bal jaahum bialhaqqi waaktharuhum lilhaqqi karihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or say they: There is a madness in him? Nay, but he bringeth them the Truth; and most of them are haters of the Truth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walawi ittabaAAa alhaqqu ahwaahum lafasadati alssamawatu waalardu waman feehinna bal ataynahum bithikrihim fahum AAan thikrihim muAAridoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if the Truth had followed their desires, verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein had been corrupted. Nay, We have brought them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they now turn away.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am tasaluhum kharjan fakharaju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru alrraziqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or dost thou ask of them (O Muhammad) any tribute? But the bounty of thy Lord is better, for He is Best of all who make provision.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnaka latadAAoohum ila siratin mustaqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! thou summonest them indeed unto a straight path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati AAani alssirati lanakiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed astray from the path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw rahimnahum wakashafna ma bihim min durrin lalajjoo fee tughyanihim yaAAmahoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Though We had mercy on them and relieved them of the harm afflicting them, they still would wander blindly on in their contumacy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad akhathnahum bialAAathabi fama istakanoo lirabbihim wama yatadarraAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Already have We grasped them with punishment, but they humble not themselves unto their Lord, nor do they pray,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatta itha fatahna AAalayhim baban tha AAathabin shadeedin itha hum feehi mublisoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Until, when We open for them the gate of extreme punishment, behold! they are aghast thereat.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee anshaa lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who hath created for you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who hath sown you broadcast in the earth, and unto Him ye will be gathered.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee yuhyee wayumeetu walahu ikhtilafu allayli waalnnahari afala taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and His is the difference of night and day. Have ye then no sense?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal qaloo mithla ma qala alawwaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but they say the like of that which said the men of old;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad wuAAidna nahnu waabaona hatha min qablu in hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We were already promised this, we and our forefathers. Lo! this is naught but fables of the men of old.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul limani alardu waman feeha in kuntum taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Unto Whom (belongeth) the earth and whosoever is therein, if ye have knowledge?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sayaqooloona lillahi qul afala tathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will say: Unto Allah. Say: Will ye not then remember?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul man rabbu alssamawati alssabAAi warabbu alAAarshi alAAatheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Who is Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Tremendous Throne?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sayaqooloona lillahi qul afala tattaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: Will ye not then keep duty (unto Him)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul man biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wahuwa yujeeru wala yujaru AAalayhi in kuntum taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: In Whose hand is the dominion over all things and He protecteth, while against Him there is no protection, if ye have knowledge?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sayaqooloona lillahi qul faanna tusharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: How then are ye bewitched?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal ataynahum bialhaqqi wainnahum lakathiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but We have brought them the Truth, and lo! they are liars.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma ittakhatha Allahu min waladin wama kana maAAahu min ilahin ithan lathahaba kullu ilahin bima khalaqa walaAAala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin subhana Allahi AAamma yasifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah hath not chosen any son, nor is there any god along with Him; else would each god have assuredly championed that which he created, and some of them would assuredly have overcome others. Glorified be Allah above all that they allege.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAalimi alghaybi waalshshahadati fataAAala AAamma yushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! and Exalted be He over all that they ascribe as partners (unto Him)!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul rabbi imma turiyannee ma yooAAadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: My Lord! If Thou shouldst show me that which they are promised.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbi fala tajAAalnee fee alqawmi alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} My Lord! then set me not among the wrongdoing folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna AAala an nuriyaka ma naAAiduhum laqadiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We are Able to show thee that which We have promised them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{IdfaAA biallatee hiya ahsanu alssayyiata nahnu aAAlamu bima yasifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best Aware of that which they allege.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqul rabbi aAAoothu bika min hamazati alshshayateeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And say: My Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from suggestions of the evil ones,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaaAAoothu bika rabbi an yahdurooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And I seek refuge in Thee, my Lord, lest they be present with me,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatta itha jaa ahadahumu almawtu qala rabbi irjiAAooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Until, when death cometh unto one of them, he saith: My Lord! Send me back,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{LaAAallee aAAmalu salihan feema taraktu kalla innaha kalimatun huwa qailuha wamin waraihim barzakhun ila yawmi yubAAathoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That I may do right in that which I have left behind! But nay! It is but a word that he speaketh; and behind them is a barrier until the day when they are raised.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha nufikha fee alssoori fala ansaba baynahum yawmaithin wala yatasaaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the trumpet is blown there will be no kinship among them that day, nor will they ask of one another.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faman thaqulat mawazeenuhu faolaika humu almuflihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then those whose scales are heavy, they are the successful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman khaffat mawazeenuhu faolaika allatheena khasiroo anfusahum fee jahannama khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those whose scales are light are those who lose their souls, in hell abiding.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Talfahu wujoohahumu alnnaru wahum feeha kalihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The fire burneth their faces, and they are glum therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam takun ayatee tutla AAalaykum fakuntum biha tukaththiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (It will be said): Were not My revelations recited unto you, and then ye used to deny them?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo rabbana ghalabat AAalayna shiqwatuna wakunna qawman dalleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will say: Our Lord! Our evil fortune conquered us, and we were erring folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbana akhrijna minha fain AAudna fainna thalimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Our Lord! Oh, bring us forth from hence! If we return (to evil) then indeed we shall be wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ikhsaoo feeha wala tukallimooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He saith: Begone therein, and speak not unto Me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu kana fareequn min AAibadee yaqooloona rabbana amanna faighfir lana wairhamna waanta khayru alrrahimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! there was a party of My slaves who said: Our Lord! We believe, therefor forgive us and have mercy on us for Thou art Best of all who show mercy;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faittakhathtumoohum sikhriyyan hatta ansawkum thikree wakuntum minhum tadhakoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But ye chose them for a laughing-stock until they caused you to forget remembrance of Me, while ye laughed at them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innee jazaytuhumu alyawma bima sabaroo annahum humu alfaizoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! I have rewarded them this day forasmuch as they were steadfast in that they, even they, are the triumphant.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][112]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala kam labithtum fee alardi AAadada sineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He will say: How long tarried ye in the earth, counting by years?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][113]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo labithna yawman aw baAAda yawmin faisali alAAaddeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will say: We tarried by a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep count!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][114]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala in labithtum illa qaleelan law annakum kuntum taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He will say: Ye tarried but a little if ye only knew.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][115]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afahasibtum annama khalaqnakum AAabathan waannakum ilayna la turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Deemed ye then that We had created you for naught, and that ye would not be returned unto Us?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][116]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu la ilaha illa huwa rabbu alAAarshi alkareemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Now Allah be Exalted, the True King! There is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Throne of Grace.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][117]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman yadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara la burhana lahu bihi fainnama hisabuhu AAinda rabbihi innahu la yuflihu alkafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He who crieth unto any other god along with Allah hath no proof thereof. His reckoning is only with his Lord. Lo! disbelievers will not be successful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[23][118]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqul rabbi ighfir wairham waanta khayru alrrahimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (O Muhammad) say: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for Thou art Best of all who show mercy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{An-Nur (The Light)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sooratun anzalnaha wafaradnaha waanzalna feeha ayatin bayyinatin laAAallakum tathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Here is) a surah which We have revealed and enjoined, and wherein We have revealed plain tokens, that haply ye may take heed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alzzaniyatu waalzzanee faijlidoo kulla wahidin minhuma miata jaldatin wala takhuthkum bihima rafatun fee deeni Allahi in kuntum tuminoona biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri walyashhad AAathabahuma taifatun mina almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The adulterer and the adulteress, scourge ye each one of them (with) a hundred stripes. And let not pity for the twain withhold you from obedience to Allah, if ye believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a party of believers witness their punishment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alzzanee la yankihu illa zaniyatan aw mushrikatan waalzzaniyatu la yankihuha illa zanin aw mushrikun wahurrima thalika AAala almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The adulterer shall not marry save an adulteress or an idolatress, and the adulteress none shall marry save an adulterer or an idolater. All that is forbidden unto believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena yarmoona almuhsanati thumma lam yatoo biarbaAAati shuhadaa faijlidoohum thamaneena jaldatan wala taqbaloo lahum shahadatan abadan waolaika humu alfasiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who accuse honourable women but bring not four witnesses, scourge them (with) eighty stripes and never (afterward) accept their testimony - They indeed are evil-doers -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa allatheena taboo min baAAdi thalika waaslahoo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save those who afterward repent and make amends. (For such) lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena yarmoona azwajahum walam yakun lahum shuhadao illa anfusuhum fashahadatu ahadihim arbaAAu shahadatin biAllahi innahu lamina alssadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for those who accuse their wives but have no witnesses except themselves; let the testimony of one of them be four testimonies, (swearing) by Allah that he is of those who speak the truth;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalkhamisatu anna laAAnata Allahi AAalayhi in kana mina alkathibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And yet a fifth, invoking the curse of Allah on him if he is of those who lie.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayadrao AAanha alAAathaba an tashhada arbaAAa shahadatin biAllahi innahu lamina alkathibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And it shall avert the punishment from her if she bear witness before Allah four times that the thing he saith is indeed false,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalkhamisata anna ghadaba Allahi AAalayha in kana mina alssadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And a fifth (time) that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he speaketh truth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu waanna Allaha tawwabun hakeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Wise, (ye had been undone).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena jaoo bialifki AAusbatun minkum la tahsaboohu sharran lakum bal huwa khayrun lakum likulli imriin minhum ma iktasaba mina alithmi waallathee tawalla kibrahu minhum lahu AAathabun AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! they who spread the slander are a gang among you. Deem it not a bad thing for you; nay, it is good for you. Unto every man of them (will be paid) that which he hath earned of the sin; and as for him among them who had the greater share therein, his will be an awful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lawla ith samiAAtumoohu thanna almuminoona waalmuminatu bianfusihim khayran waqaloo hatha ifkun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Why did not the believers, men and women, when ye heard it, think good of their own own folk, and say: It is a manifest untruth?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lawla jaoo AAalayhi biarbaAAati shuhadaa faith lam yatoo bialshshuhadai faolaika AAinda Allahi humu alkathiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Why did they not produce four witnesses? Since they produce not witnesses, they verily are liars in the sight of Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu fee alddunya waalakhirati lamassakum fee ma afadtum feehi AAathabun AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you in the world and the Hereafter an awful doom had overtaken you for that whereof ye murmured.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith talaqqawnahu bialsinatikum wataqooloona biafwahikum ma laysa lakum bihi AAilmun watahsaboonahu hayyinan wahuwa AAinda Allahi AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When ye welcomed it with your tongues, and uttered with your mouths that whereof ye had no knowledge, ye counted it a trifle. In the sight of Allah it is very great.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walawla ith samiAAtumoohu qultum ma yakoonu lana an natakallama bihatha subhanaka hatha buhtanun AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Wherefor, when ye heard it, said ye not: It is not for us to speak of this. Glory be to Thee (O Allah)! This is awful calumny.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YaAAithukumu Allahu an taAAoodoo limithlihi abadan in kuntum mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah admonisheth you that ye repeat not the like thereof ever, if ye are (in truth) believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He expoundeth unto you the revelations. Allah is Knower, Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena yuhibboona an tasheeAAa alfahishatu fee allatheena amanoo lahum AAathabun aleemun fee alddunya waalakhirati waAllahu yaAAlamu waantum la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who love that slander should be spread concerning those who believe, theirs will be a painful punishment in the world and the Hereafter. Allah knoweth. Ye know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu waanna Allaha raoofun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Merciful, (ye had been undone).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattabiAAoo khutuwati alshshaytani waman yattabiAA khutuwati alshshaytani fainnahu yamuru bialfahshai waalmunkari walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu ma zaka minkum min ahadin abadan walakinna Allaha yuzakkee man yashao waAllahu sameeAAun AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Follow not the footsteps of the devil. Unto whomsoever followeth the footsteps of the devil, lo! he commandeth filthiness and wrong. Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, not one of you would ever have grown pure. But Allah causeth whom He will to grow. And Allah is Hearer, Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala yatali oloo alfadli minkum waalssaAAati an yutoo olee alqurba waalmasakeena waalmuhajireena fee sabeeli Allahi walyaAAfoo walyasfahoo ala tuhibboona an yaghfira Allahu lakum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And let not those who possess dignity and ease among you swear not to give to the near of kin and to the needy, and to fugitives for the cause of Allah. Let them forgive and show indulgence. Yearn ye not that Allah may forgive you? Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena yarmoona almuhsanati alghafilati almuminati luAAinoo fee alddunya waalakhirati walahum AAathabun AAatheemun}}
