\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! as for those who traduce virtuous, believing women (who are) careless, cursed are they in the world and the Hereafter. Theirs will be an awful doom}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma tashhadu AAalayhim alsinatuhum waaydeehim waarjuluhum bima kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when their tongues and their hands and their feet testify against them as to what they used to do,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawmaithin yuwaffeehimu Allahu deenahumu alhaqqa wayaAAlamoona anna Allaha huwa alhaqqu almubeenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On that day Allah will pay them their just due, and they will know that Allah, He is the Manifest Truth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alkhabeethatu lilkhabeetheena waalkhabeethoona lilkhabeethati waalttayyibatu lilttayyibeena waalttayyiboona lilttayyibati olaika mubarraoona mimma yaqooloona lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Vile women are for vile men, and vile men for vile women. Good women are for good men, and good men for good women; such are innocent of that which people say: For them is pardon and a bountiful provision.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tadkhuloo buyootan ghayra buyootikum hatta tastanisoo watusallimoo AAala ahliha thalikum khayrun lakum laAAallakum tathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Enter not houses other than your own without first announcing your presence and invoking peace upon the folk thereof. That is better for you, that ye may be heedful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain lam tajidoo feeha ahadan fala tadkhulooha hatta yuthana lakum wain qeela lakumu irjiAAoo fairjiAAoo huwa azka lakum waAllahu bima taAAmaloona AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if ye find no-one therein, still enter not until permission hath been given. And if it be said unto you: Go away again, then go away, for it is purer for you. Allah knoweth what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laysa AAalaykum junahun an tadkhuloo buyootan ghayra maskoonatin feeha mataAAun lakum waAllahu yaAAlamu ma tubdoona wama taktumoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (It is) no sin for you to enter uninhabited houses wherein is comfort for you. Allah knoweth what ye proclaim and what ye hide.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul lilmumineena yaghuddoo min absarihum wayahfathoo furoojahum thalika azka lahum inna Allaha khabeerun bima yasnaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and be modest. That is purer for them. Lo! Allah is aware of what they do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqul lilmuminati yaghdudna min absarihinna wayahfathna furoojahunna wala yubdeena zeenatahunna illa ma thahara minha walyadribna bikhumurihinna AAala juyoobihinna wala yubdeena zeenatahunna illa libuAAoolatihinna aw abaihinna aw abai buAAoolatihinna aw abnaihinna aw abnai buAAoolatihinna aw ikhwanihinna aw banee ikhwanihinna aw banee akhawatihinna aw nisaihinna aw ma malakat aymanuhunna awi alttabiAAeena ghayri olee alirbati mina alrrijali awi alttifli allatheena lam yathharoo AAala AAawrati alnnisai wala yadribna biarjulihinna liyuAAlama ma yukhfeena min zeenatihinna watooboo ila Allahi jameeAAan ayyuha almuminoona laAAallakum tuflihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And tell the believing women to lower their gaze and be modest, and to display of their adornment only that which is apparent, and to draw their veils over their bosoms, and not to reveal their adornment save to their own husbands or fathers or husbands' fathers, or their sons or their husbands' sons, or their brothers or their brothers' sons or sisters' sons, or their women, or their slaves, or male attendants who lack vigour, or children who know naught of women's nakedness. And let them not stamp their feet so as to reveal what they hide of their adornment. And turn unto Allah together, O believers, in order that ye may succeed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waankihoo alayama minkum waalssaliheena min AAibadikum waimaikum in yakoonoo fuqaraa yughnihimu Allahu min fadlihi waAllahu wasiAAun AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And marry such of you as are solitary and the pious of your slaves and maid-servants. If they be poor, Allah will enrich them of His bounty. Allah is of ample means, Aware.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WalyastaAAfifi allatheena la yajidoona nikahan hatta yughniyahumu Allahu min fadlihi waallatheena yabtaghoona alkitaba mimma malakat aymanukum fakatiboohum in AAalimtum feehim khayran waatoohum min mali Allahi allathee atakum wala tukrihoo fatayatikum AAala albighai in aradna tahassunan litabtaghoo AAarada alhayati alddunya waman yukrihhunna fainna Allaha min baAAdi ikrahihinna ghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And let those who cannot find a match keep chaste till Allah give them independence by His grace. And such of your slaves as seek a writing (of emancipation), write it for them if ye are aware of aught of good in them, and bestow upon them of the wealth of Allah which He hath bestowed upon you. Force not your slave-girls to whoredom that ye may seek enjoyment of the life of the world, if they would preserve their chastity. And if one force them, then (unto them), after their compulsion, lo! Allah will be Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad anzalna ilaykum ayatin mubayyinatin wamathalan mina allatheena khalaw min qablikum wamawAAithatan lilmuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We have sent down for you revelations that make plain, and the example of those who passed away before you. An admonition unto those who ward off (evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu nooru alssamawati waalardi mathalu noorihi kamishkatin feeha misbahun almisbahu fee zujajatin alzzujajatu kaannaha kawkabun durriyyun yooqadu min shajaratin mubarakatin zaytoonatin la sharqiyyatin wala gharbiyyatin yakadu zaytuha yudeeo walaw lam tamsashu narun noorun AAala noorin yahdee Allahu linoorihi man yashao wayadribu Allahu alamthala lilnnasi waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The similitude of His light is as a niche wherein is a lamp. The lamp is in a glass. The glass is as it were a shining star. (This lamp is) kindled from a blessed tree, an olive neither of the East nor of the West, whose oil would almost glow forth (of itself) though no fire touched it. Light upon light. Allah guideth unto His light whom He will. And Allah speaketh to mankind in allegories, for Allah is Knower of all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee buyootin athina Allahu an turfaAAa wayuthkara feeha ismuhu yusabbihu lahu feeha bialghuduwwi waalasali}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (This lamp is found) in houses which Allah hath allowed to be exalted and that His name shall be remembered therein. Therein do offer praise to Him at morn and evening.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rijalun la tulheehim tijaratun wala bayAAun AAan thikri Allahi waiqami alssalati waeetai alzzakati yakhafoona yawman tataqallabu feehi alquloobu waalabsaru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Men whom neither merchandise nor sale beguileth from remembrance of Allah and constancy in prayer and paying to the poor their due; who fear a day when hearts and eyeballs will be overturned;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyajziyahumu Allahu ahsana ma AAamiloo wayazeedahum min fadlihi waAllahu yarzuqu man yashao bighayri hisabin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That Allah may reward them with the best of what they did, and increase reward for them of His bounty. Allah giveth blessings without stint to whom He will.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena kafaroo aAAmaluhum kasarabin biqeeAAatin yahsabuhu alththamanu maan hatta itha jaahu lam yajidhu shayan wawajada Allaha AAindahu fawaffahu hisabahu waAllahu sareeAAu alhisabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for those who disbelieve, their deeds are as a mirage in a desert. The thirsty one supposeth it to be water till he cometh unto it and findeth it naught, and findeth, in the place thereof, Allah Who payeth him his due; and Allah is swift at reckoning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw kathulumatin fee bahrin lujjiyyin yaghshahu mawjun min fawqihi mawjun min fawqihi sahabun thulumatun baAAduha fawqa baAAdin itha akhraja yadahu lam yakad yaraha waman lam yajAAali Allahu lahu nooran fama lahu min noorin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or as darkness on a vast, abysmal sea. There covereth him a wave, above which is a wave, above which is a cloud. Layer upon layer of darkness. When he holdeth out his hand he scarce can see it. And he for whom Allah hath not appointed light, for him there is no light.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara anna Allaha yusabbihu lahu man fee alssamawati waalardi waalttayru saffatin kullun qad AAalima salatahu watasbeehahu waAllahu AAaleemun bima yafAAaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou not seen that Allah, He it is Whom all who are in the heavens and the earth praise, and the birds in their flight? Of each He knoweth verily the worship and the praise; and Allah is Aware of what they do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi waila Allahi almaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah is the journeying.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara anna Allaha yuzjee sahaban thumma yuallifu baynahu thumma yajAAaluhu rukaman fatara alwadqa yakhruju min khilalihi wayunazzilu mina alssamai min jibalin feeha min baradin fayuseebu bihi man yashao wayasrifuhu AAan man yashao yakadu sana barqihi yathhabu bialabsari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou not seen how Allah wafteth the clouds, then gathereth them, then maketh them layers, and thou seest the rain come forth from between them; He sendeth down from the heaven mountains wherein is hail, and smiteth therewith whom He will, and averteth it from whom He will. The flashing of His lightning all but snatcheth away the sight.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yuqallibu Allahu allayla waalnnahara inna fee thalika laAAibratan liolee alabsari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah causeth the revolution of the day and the night. Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for those who see.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAllahu khalaqa kulla dabbatin min main faminhum man yamshee AAala batnihi waminhum man yamshee AAala rijlayni waminhum man yamshee AAala arbaAAin yakhluqu Allahu ma yashao inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah hath created every animal of water. Of them is (a kind) that goeth upon its belly and (a kind) that goeth upon two legs and (a kind) that goeth upon four. Allah createth what He will. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad anzalna ayatin mubayyinatin waAllahu yahdee man yashao ila siratin mustaqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Verily We have sent down revelations and explained them. Allah guideth whom He will unto a straight path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayaqooloona amanna biAllahi wabialrrasooli waataAAna thumma yatawalla fareequn minhum min baAAdi thalika wama olaika bialmumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: We believe in Allah and the messenger, and we obey; then after that a faction of them turn away. Such are not believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha duAAoo ila Allahi warasoolihi liyahkuma baynahum itha fareequn minhum muAAridoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they appeal unto Allah and His messenger to judge between them, lo! a faction of them are averse;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain yakun lahumu alhaqqu yatoo ilayhi muthAAineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But if right had been with them they would have come unto him willingly.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afee quloobihim maradun ami irtaboo am yakhafoona an yaheefa Allahu AAalayhim warasooluhu bal olaika humu alththalimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is there in their hearts a disease, or have they doubts, or fear they lest Allah and His messenger should wrong them in judgment? Nay, but such are evil-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama kana qawla almumineena itha duAAoo ila Allahi warasoolihi liyahkuma baynahum an yaqooloo samiAAna waataAAna waolaika humu almuflihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The saying of (all true) believers when they appeal unto Allah and His messenger to judge between them is only that they say: We hear and we obey. And such are the successful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman yutiAAi Allaha warasoolahu wayakhsha Allaha wayattaqhi faolaika humu alfaizoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He who obeyeth Allah and His messenger, and feareth Allah, and keepeth duty (unto Him): such indeed are the victorious.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaqsamoo biAllahi jahda aymanihim lain amartahum layakhrujunna qul la tuqsimoo taAAatun maAAroofatun inna Allaha khabeerun bima taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They swear by Allah solemnly that, if thou order them, they will go forth. Say: Swear not; known obedience (is better). Lo! Allah is Informed of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ateeAAoo Allaha waateeAAoo alrrasoola fain tawallaw fainnama AAalayhi ma hummila waAAalaykum ma hummiltum wain tuteeAAoohu tahtadoo wama AAala alrrasooli illa albalaghu almubeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Obey Allah and obey the messenger. But if ye turn away, then (it is) for him (to do) only that wherewith he hath been charged, and for you (to do) only that wherewith ye have been charged. If ye obey him, ye will go aright. But the messenger hath no other charge than to convey (the message) plainly.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAada Allahu allatheena amanoo minkum waAAamiloo alssalihati layastakhlifannahum fee alardi kama istakhlafa allatheena min qablihim walayumakkinanna lahum deenahumu allathee irtada lahum walayubaddilannahum min baAAdi khawfihim amnan yaAAbudoonanee la yushrikoona bee shayan waman kafara baAAda thalika faolaika humu alfasiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah hath promised such of you as believe and do good work that He will surely make them to succeed (the present rulers) in the earth even as He caused those who were before them to succeed (others); and that He will surely establish for them their religion which He hath approved for them, and will give them in exchange safety after their fear. They serve Me. They ascribe no thing as partner unto Me. Those who disbelieve henceforth, they are the miscreants.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waateeAAoo alrrasoola laAAallakum turhamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Establish worship and pay the poor-due and obey the messenger, that haply ye may find mercy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La tahsabanna allatheena kafaroo muAAjizeena fee alardi wamawahumu alnnaru walabisa almaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Think not that the disbelievers can escape in the land. Fire will be their home - a hapless journey's end!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo liyastathinkumu allatheena malakat aymanukum waallatheena lam yablughoo alhuluma minkum thalatha marratin min qabli salati alfajri waheena tadaAAoona thiyabakum mina alththaheerati wamin baAAdi salati alAAishai thalathu AAawratin lakum laysa AAalaykum wala AAalayhim junahun baAAdahunna tawwafoona AAalaykum baAAdukum AAala baAAdin kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Let your slaves, and those of you who have not come to puberty, ask leave of you at three times (before they come into your presence): Before the prayer of dawn, and when ye lay aside your raiment for the heat of noon, and after the prayer of night. Three times of privacy for you. It is no sin for them or for you at other times, when some of you go round attendant upon others (if they come into your presence without leave). Thus Allah maketh clear the revelations for you. Allah is Knower, Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha balagha alatfalu minkumu alhuluma falyastathinoo kama istathana allatheena min qablihim kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum ayatihi waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the children among you come to puberty then let them ask leave even as those before them used to ask it. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations for you. Allah is Knower, Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaalqawaAAidu mina alnnisai allatee la yarjoona nikahan falaysa AAalayhinna junahun an yadaAAna thiyabahunna ghayra mutabarrijatin bizeenatin waan yastaAAfifna khayrun lahunna waAllahu sameeAAun AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for women past child-bearing, who have no hope of marriage, it is no sin for them if they discard their (outer) clothing in such a way as not to show adornment. But to refrain is better for them. Allah is Hearer, Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laysa AAala alaAAma harajun wala AAala alaAAraji harajun wala AAala almareedi harajun wala AAala anfusikum an takuloo min buyootikum aw buyooti abaikum aw buyooti ommahatikum aw buyooti ikhwanikum aw buyooti akhawatikum aw buyooti aAAmamikum aw buyooti AAammatikum aw buyooti akhwalikum aw buyooti khalatikum aw ma malaktum mafatihahu aw sadeeqikum laysa AAalaykum junahun an takuloo jameeAAan aw ashtatan faitha dakhaltum buyootan fasallimoo AAala anfusikum tahiyyatan min AAindi Allahi mubarakatan tayyibatan kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati laAAallakum taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} No blame is there upon the blind nor any blame upon the lame nor any blame upon the sick nor on yourselves if ye eat from your houses, or the houses of your fathers, or the houses of your mothers, or the houses of your brothers, or the houses of your sisters, or the houses of your fathers' brothers, or the houses of your fathers' sisters, or the houses of your mothers' brothers, or the houses of your mothers' sisters, or (from that) whereof ye hold the keys, or (from the house) of a friend. No sin shall it be for you whether ye eat together or apart. But when ye enter houses, salute one another with a greeting from Allah, blessed and sweet. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations for you, that haply ye may understand.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama almuminoona allatheena amanoo biAllahi warasoolihi waitha kanoo maAAahu AAala amrin jamiAAin lam yathhaboo hatta yastathinoohu inna allatheena yastathinoonaka olaika allatheena yuminoona biAllahi warasoolihi faitha istathanooka libaAAdi shanihim fathan liman shita minhum waistaghfir lahumu Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They only are the true believers who believe in Allah and His messenger and, when they are with him on some common errand, go not away until they have asked leave of him. Lo! those who ask leave of thee, those are they who believe in Allah and His messenger. So, if they ask thy leave for some affair of theirs, give leave to whom thou wilt of them, and ask for them forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La tajAAaloo duAAaa alrrasooli baynakum kaduAAai baAAdikum baAAdan qad yaAAlamu Allahu allatheena yatasallaloona minkum liwathan falyahthari allatheena yukhalifoona AAan amrihi an tuseebahum fitnatun aw yuseebahum AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Make not the calling of the messenger among you as your calling one of another. Allah knoweth those of you who steal away, hiding themselves. And let those who conspire to evade orders beware lest grief or painful punishment befall them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[24][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ala inna lillahi ma fee alssamawati waalardi qad yaAAlamu ma antum AAalayhi wayawma yurjaAAoona ilayhi fayunabbiohum bima AAamiloo waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! verily unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth. He knoweth your condition. And (He knoweth) the Day when they are returned unto Him so that He may inform them of what they did. Allah is Knower of all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Furqan (The Discrimination)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tabaraka allathee nazzala alfurqana AAala AAabdihi liyakoona lilAAalameena natheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Blessed is He Who hath revealed unto His slave the Criterion (of right and wrong), that he may be a warner to the peoples.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi walam yattakhith waladan walam yakun lahu shareekun fee almulki wakhalaqa kulla shayin faqaddarahu taqdeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, He hath chosen no son nor hath He any partner in the Sovereignty. He hath created everything and hath meted out for it a measure.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waittakhathoo min doonihi alihatan la yakhluqoona shayan wahum yukhlaqoona wala yamlikoona lianfusihim darran wala nafAAan wala yamlikoona mawtan wala hayatan wala nushooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Yet they choose beside Him other gods who create naught but are themselves created, and possess not hurt nor profit for themselves, and possess not death nor life, nor power to raise the dead.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena kafaroo in hatha illa ifkun iftarahu waaAAanahu AAalayhi qawmun akharoona faqad jaoo thulman wazooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who disbelieve say: This is naught but a lie that he hath invented, and other folk have helped him with it, so that they have produced a slander and a lie.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo asateeru alawwaleena iktatabaha fahiya tumla AAalayhi bukratan waaseelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: Fables of the men of old which he hath had written down so that they are dictated to him morn and evening.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul anzalahu allathee yaAAlamu alssirra fee alssamawati waalardi innahu kana ghafooran raheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He who knoweth the secret of the heavens and the earth hath revealed it. Lo! He ever is Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo mali hatha alrrasooli yakulu alttaAAama wayamshee fee alaswaqi lawla onzila ilayhi malakun fayakoona maAAahu natheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: What aileth this messenger (of Allah) that he eateth food and walketh in the markets? Why is not an angel sent down unto him, to be a warner with him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw yulqa ilayhi kanzun aw takoonu lahu jannatun yakulu minha waqala alththalimoona in tattabiAAoona illa rajulan mashooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or (why is not) treasure thrown down unto him, or why hath he not a paradise from whence to eat? And the evil-doers say: Ye are but following a man bewitched.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Onthur kayfa daraboo laka alamthala fadalloo fala yastateeAAoona sabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} See how they coin similitudes for thee, so that they are all astray and cannot find a road!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tabaraka allathee in shaa jaAAala laka khayran min thalika jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu wayajAAal laka qusooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Blessed is He Who, if He will, will assign thee better than (all) that - Gardens underneath which rivers flow - and will assign thee mansions.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal kaththaboo bialssaAAati waaAAtadna liman kaththaba bialssaAAati saAAeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but they deny (the coming of) the Hour, and for those who deny (the coming of) the Hour We have prepared a flame.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Itha raathum min makanin baAAeedin samiAAoo laha taghayyuthan wazafeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When it seeth them from afar, they hear the crackling and the roar thereof.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha olqoo minha makanan dayyiqan muqarraneena daAAaw hunalika thubooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they are flung into a narrow place thereof, chained together, they pray for destruction there.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La tadAAoo alyawma thubooran wahidan waodAAoo thubooran katheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Pray not that day for one destruction, but pray for many destructions!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul athalika khayrun am jannatu alkhuldi allatee wuAAida almuttaqoona kanat lahum jazaan wamaseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Is that (doom) better or the Garden of Immortality which is promised unto those who ward off (evil)? It will be their reward and journey's end.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahum feeha ma yashaoona khalideena kana AAala rabbika waAAdan masoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therein abiding, they have all that they desire. It is for thy Lord a promise that must be fulfilled.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma yahshuruhum wama yaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi fayaqoolu aantum adlaltum AAibadee haolai am hum dalloo alssabeela}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And on the day when He will assemble them and that which they worship instead of Allah and will say: Was it ye who misled these my slaves or did they (themselves) wander from the way?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo subhanaka ma kana yanbaghee lana an nattakhitha min doonika min awliyaa walakin mattaAAtahum waabaahum hatta nasoo alththikra wakanoo qawman booran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will say: Be Thou Glorified! it was not for us to choose any protecting friends beside thee; but Thou didst give them and their fathers ease till they forgot the warning and became lost folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqad kaththabookum bima taqooloona fama tastateeAAoona sarfan wala nasran waman yathlim minkum nuthiqhu AAathaban kabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus they will give you the lie regarding what ye say, then ye can neither avert (the doom) nor obtain help. And whoso among you doeth wrong, We shall make him taste great torment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama arsalna qablaka mina almursaleena illa innahum layakuloona alttaAAama wayamshoona fee alaswaqi wajaAAalna baAAdakum libaAAdin fitnatan atasbiroona wakana rabbuka baseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We never sent before thee any messengers but lo! they verily ate food and walked in the markets. And We have appointed some of you a test for others: Will ye be steadfast? And thy Lord is ever Seer.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena la yarjoona liqaana lawla onzila AAalayna almalaikatu aw nara rabbana laqadi istakbaroo fee anfusihim waAAataw AAutuwwan kabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who look not for a meeting with Us say: Why are angels not sent down unto us and (Why) do we not see our Lord! Assuredly they think too highly of themselves and are scornful with great pride.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma yarawna almalaikata la bushra yawmaithin lilmujrimeena wayaqooloona hijran mahjooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when they behold the angels, on that day there will be no good tidings for the guilty; and they will cry: A forbidding ban!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqadimna ila ma AAamiloo min AAamalin fajaAAalnahu habaan manthooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We shall turn unto the work they did and make it scattered motes.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ashabu aljannati yawmaithin khayrun mustaqarran waahsanu maqeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who have earned the Garden on that day will be better in their home and happier in their place of noonday rest;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma tashaqqaqu alssamao bialghamami wanuzzila almalaikatu tanzeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A day when the heaven with the clouds will be rent asunder and the angels will be sent down, a grand descent.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Almulku yawmaithin alhaqqu lilrrahmani wakana yawman AAala alkafireena AAaseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Sovereignty on that day will be the True (Sovereignty) belonging to the Beneficent One, and it will be a hard day for disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma yaAAaddu alththalimu AAala yadayhi yaqoolu ya laytanee ittakhathtu maAAa alrrasooli sabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when the wrong-doer gnaweth his hands, he will say: Ah, would that I had chosen a way together with the messenger (of Allah)!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya waylata laytanee lam attakhith fulanan khaleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Alas for me! Ah, would that I had never taken such an one for friend!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad adallanee AAani alththikri baAAda ith jaanee wakana alshshaytanu lilinsani khathoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He verily led me astray from the Reminder after it had reached me. Satan was ever man's deserter in the hour of need.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala alrrasoolu ya rabbi inna qawmee ittakhathoo hatha alqurana mahjooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the messenger saith: O my Lord! Lo! mine own folk make this Qur'an of no account.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakathalika jaAAalna likulli nabiyyin AAaduwwan mina almujrimeena wakafa birabbika hadiyan wanaseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Even so have We appointed unto every prophet an opponent from among the guilty; but Allah sufficeth for a Guide and Helper.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena kafaroo lawla nuzzila AAalayhi alquranu jumlatan wahidatan kathalika linuthabbita bihi fuadaka warattalnahu tarteelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who disbelieve say: Why is the Qur'an not revealed unto him all at once? (It is revealed) thus that We may strengthen thy heart therewith; and We have arranged it in right order.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala yatoonaka bimathalin illa jinaka bialhaqqi waahsana tafseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they bring thee no similitude but We bring thee the Truth (as against it), and better (than their similitude) as argument.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yuhsharoona AAala wujoohihim ila jahannama olaika sharrun makanan waadallu sabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who will be gathered on their faces unto hell: such are worse in plight and further from the right road.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba wajaAAalna maAAahu akhahu haroona wazeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We verily gave Moses the Scripture and placed with him his brother Aaron as henchman.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqulna ithhaba ila alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayatina fadammarnahum tadmeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We said: Go together unto the folk who have denied Our revelations. Then We destroyed them, a complete destruction.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqawma noohin lamma kaththaboo alrrusula aghraqnahum wajaAAalnahum lilnnasi ayatan waaAAtadna lilththalimeena AAathaban aleeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Noah's folk, when they denied the messengers, We drowned them and made of them a portent for mankind. We have prepared a painful doom for evil-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAadan wathamooda waashaba alrrassi waquroonan bayna thalika katheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud, and the dwellers in Ar-Rass, and many generations in between.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakullan darabna lahu alamthala wakullan tabbarna tatbeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Each (of them) We warned by examples, and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad ataw AAala alqaryati allatee omtirat matara alssawi afalam yakoonoo yarawnaha bal kanoo la yarjoona nushooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And indeed they have passed by the township whereon was rained the fatal rain. Can it be that they have not seen it? Nay, but they hope for no resurrection.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha raawka in yattakhithoonaka illa huzuwan ahatha allathee baAAatha Allahu rasoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they see thee (O Muhammad) they treat thee only as a jest (saying): Is this he whom Allah sendeth as a messenger?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In kada layudilluna AAan alihatina lawla an sabarna AAalayha wasawfa yaAAlamoona heena yarawna alAAathaba man adallu sabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He would have led us far away from our gods if we had not been staunch to them. They will know, when they behold the doom, who is more astray as to the road.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Araayta mani ittakhatha ilahahu hawahu afaanta takoonu AAalayhi wakeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou seen him who chooseth for his god his own lust? Wouldst thou then be guardian over him?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am tahsabu anna aktharahum yasmaAAoona aw yaAAqiloona in hum illa kaalanAAami bal hum adallu sabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or deemest thou that most of them hear or understand? They are but as the cattle - nay, but they are farther astray?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara ila rabbika kayfa madda alththilla walaw shaa lajaAAalahu sakinan thumma jaAAalna alshshamsa AAalayhi daleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou not seen how thy Lord hath spread the shade - And if He willed He could have made it still - then We have made the sun its pilot;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma qabadnahu ilayna qabdan yaseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We withdraw it unto Us, a gradual withdrawal?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee jaAAala lakumu allayla libasan waalnnawma subatan wajaAAala alnnahara nushooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who maketh night a covering for you, and sleep repose, and maketh day a resurrection.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee arsala alrriyaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatihi waanzalna mina alssamai maan tahooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who sendeth the winds, glad tidings heralding His mercy, and We send down purifying water from the sky,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Linuhyiya bihi baldatan maytan wanusqiyahu mimma khalaqna anAAaman waanasiyya katheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That We may give life thereby to a dead land, and We give many beasts and men that We have created to drink thereof.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad sarrafnahu baynahum liyaththakkaroo faaba aktharu alnnasi illa kufooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We have repeated it among them that they may remember, but most of mankind begrudge aught save ingratitude.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw shina labaAAathna fee kulli qaryatin natheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If We willed, We could raise up a warner in every village.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala tutiAAi alkafireena wajahidhum bihi jihadan kabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So obey not the disbelievers, but strive against them herewith with a great endeavour.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee maraja albahrayni hatha AAathbun furatun wahatha milhun ojajun wajaAAala baynahuma barzakhan wahijran mahjooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who hath given independence to the two seas (though they meet); one palatable, sweet, and the other saltish, bitter; and hath set a bar and a forbidding ban between them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee khalaqa mina almai basharan fajaAAalahu nasaban wasihran wakana rabbuka qadeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who hath created man from water, and hath appointed for him kindred by blood and kindred by marriage; for thy Lord is ever Powerful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WayaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yanfaAAuhum wala yadurruhum wakana alkafiru AAala rabbihi thaheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Yet they worship instead of Allah that which can neither benefit them nor hurt them. The disbeliever was ever a partisan against his Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama arsalnaka illa mubashshiran wanatheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We have sent thee (O Muhammad) only as a bearer of good tidings and a warner.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ma asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin illa man shaa an yattakhitha ila rabbihi sabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: I ask of you no reward for this, save that whoso will may choose a way unto his Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watawakkal AAala alhayyi allathee la yamootu wasabbih bihamdihi wakafa bihi bithunoobi AAibadihi khabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And trust thou in the Living One Who dieth not, and hymn His praise. He sufficeth as the Knower of His bondmen's sins,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi alrrahmanu faisal bihi khabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six Days, then He mounted the Throne. The Beneficent! Ask anyone informed concerning Him!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha qeela lahumu osjudoo lilrrahmani qaloo wama alrrahmanu anasjudu lima tamuruna wazadahum nufooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when it is said unto them: Prostrate to the Beneficent! they say: And what is the Beneficent? Are we to prostrate to whatever thou (Muhammad) biddest us? And it increaseth aversion in them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tabaraka allathee jaAAala fee alssamai buroojan wajaAAala feeha sirajan waqamaran muneeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Blessed be He Who hath placed in the heaven mansions of the stars, and hath placed therein a great lamp and a moon giving light!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee jaAAala allayla waalnnahara khilfatan liman arada an yaththakkara aw arada shukooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who hath appointed night and day in succession, for him who desireth to remember, or desireth thankfulness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAibadu alrrahmani allatheena yamshoona AAala alardi hawnan waitha khatabahumu aljahiloona qaloo salaman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The (faithful) slaves of the Beneficent are they who walk upon the earth modestly, and when the foolish ones address them answer: Peace;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena yabeetoona lirabbihim sujjadan waqiyaman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And who spend the night before their Lord, prostrate and standing,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena yaqooloona rabbana isrif AAanna AAathaba jahannama inna AAathabaha kana gharaman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And who say: Our Lord! Avert from us the doom of hell; lo! the doom thereof is anguish;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innaha saat mustaqarran wamuqaman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! it is wretched as abode and station;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena itha anfaqoo lam yusrifoo walam yaqturoo wakana bayna thalika qawaman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal nor grudging; and there is ever a firm station between the two;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena la yadAAoona maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara wala yaqtuloona alnnafsa allatee harrama Allahu illa bialhaqqi wala yaznoona waman yafAAal thalika yalqa athaman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who cry not unto any other god along with Allah, nor take the life which Allah hath forbidden save in (course of) justice, nor commit adultery - and whoso doeth this shall pay the penalty;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YudaAAaf lahu alAAathabu yawma alqiyamati wayakhlud feehi muhanan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The doom will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein disdained for ever;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa man taba waamana waAAamila AAamalan salihan faolaika yubaddilu Allahu sayyiatihim hasanatin wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save him who repenteth and believeth and doth righteous work; as for such, Allah will change their evil deeds to good deeds. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman taba waAAamila salihan fainnahu yatoobu ila Allahi mataban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whosoever repenteth and doeth good, he verily repenteth toward Allah with true repentance -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena la yashhadoona alzzoora waitha marroo biallaghwi marroo kiraman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who will not witness vanity, but when they pass near senseless play, pass by with dignity.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena itha thukkiroo biayati rabbihim lam yakhirroo AAalayha summan waAAumyanan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who, when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena yaqooloona rabbana hab lana min azwajina wathurriyyatina qurrata aAAyunin waijAAalna lilmuttaqeena imaman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And who say: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika yujzawna alghurfata bima sabaroo wayulaqqawna feeha tahiyyatan wasalaman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will be awarded the high place forasmuch as they were steadfast, and they will meet therein with welcome and the ward of peace,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khalideena feeha hasunat mustaqarran wamuqaman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Abiding there for ever. Happy is it as abode and station!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[25][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ma yaAAbao bikum rabbee lawla duAAaokum faqad kaththabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): My Lord would not concern Himself with you but for your prayer. But now ye have denied (the Truth), therefor there will be judgment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Ash-Shu'ara' (The Poets)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Taseenmeem}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ta. Sin. Mim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tilka ayatu alkitabi almubeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{LaAAallaka bakhiAAun nafsaka alla yakoonoo mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It may be that thou tormentest thyself (O Muhammad) because they believe not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In nasha nunazzil AAalayhim mina alssamai ayatan fathallat aAAnaquhum laha khadiAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yateehim min thikrin mina alrrahmani muhdathin illa kanoo AAanhu muAArideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Never cometh there unto them a fresh reminder from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqad kaththaboo fasayateehim anbao ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Now they have denied (the Truth); but there will come unto them tidings of that whereat they used to scoff.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yaraw ila alardi kam anbatna feeha min kulli zawjin kareemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith nada rabbuka moosa ani iti alqawma alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when thy Lord called Moses, saying: Go unto the wrongdoing folk,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qawma firAAawna ala yattaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi innee akhafu an yukaththibooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayadeequ sadree wala yantaliqu lisanee faarsil ila haroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And I shall be embarrassed, and my tongue will not speak plainly, therefor send for Aaron (to help me).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walahum AAalayya thanbun faakhafu an yaqtulooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they have a crime against me, so I fear that they will kill me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala kalla faithhaba biayatina inna maAAakum mustamiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Nay, verily. So go ye twain with Our tokens. Lo! We shall be with you, Hearing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatiya firAAawna faqoola inna rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{An arsil maAAana banee israeela}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Saying): Let the Children of Israel go with us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala alam nurabbika feena waleedan walabithta feena min AAumurika sineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Pharaoh) said (unto Moses): Did we not rear thee among us as a child? And thou didst dwell many years of thy life among us,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WafaAAalta faAAlataka allatee faAAalta waanta mina alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst, and thou wast one of the ingrates.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala faAAaltuha ithan waana mina alddalleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fafarartu minkum lamma khiftukum fawahaba lee rabbee hukman wajaAAalanee mina almursaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then I fled from you when I feared you, and my Lord vouchsafed me a command and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watilka niAAmatun tamunnuha AAalayya an AAabbadta banee israeela}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And this is the past favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala firAAawnu wama rabbu alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Pharaoh said: And what is the Lord of the Worlds?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye had but sure belief.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala liman hawlahu ala tastamiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Pharaoh) said unto those around him: Hear ye not?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbukum warabbu abaikumu alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala inna rasoolakumu allathee orsila ilaykum lamajnoonun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Pharaoh) said: Lo! your messenger who hath been sent unto you is indeed a madman!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi wama baynahuma in kuntum taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Lord of the East and the West and all that is between them, if ye did but understand.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala laini ittakhathta ilahan ghayree laajAAalannaka mina almasjooneena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Pharaoh) said: If thou choosest a god other than me, I assuredly shall place thee among the prisoners.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala awalaw jituka bishayin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Even though I show thee something plain?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala fati bihi in kunta mina alssadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Pharaoh) said: Produce it then, if thou art of the truthful!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalqa AAasahu faitha hiya thuAAbanun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then he flung down his staff and it became a serpent manifest,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WanazaAAa yadahu faitha hiya baydao lilnnathireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he drew forth his hand and lo! it was white to the beholders.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala lilmalai hawlahu inna hatha lasahirun AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo! this is verily a knowing wizard,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihi famatha tamuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who would drive you out of your land by his magic. Now what counsel ye?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo arjih waakhahu waibAAath fee almadaini hashireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Put him off, (him) and his brother, and send into the cities summoners}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yatooka bikulli sahharin AAaleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who shall bring unto thee every knowing wizard.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FajumiAAa alssaharatu limeeqati yawmin maAAloomin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So the wizards were gathered together at a set time on a day appointed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqeela lilnnasi hal antum mujtamiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{LaAAallana nattabiAAu alssaharata in kanoo humu alghalibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards if they are the winners.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jaa alssaharatu qaloo lifirAAawna ainna lana laajran in kunna nahnu alghalibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala naAAam wainnakum ithan lamina almuqarrabeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Aye, and ye will then surely be of those brought near (to me).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala lahum moosa alqoo ma antum mulqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Moses said unto them: Throw what ye are going to throw!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalqaw hibalahum waAAisiyyahum waqaloo biAAizzati firAAawna inna lanahnu alghaliboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then they threw down their cords and their staves and said: By Pharaoh's might, lo! we verily are the winners.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalqa moosa AAasahu faitha hiya talqafu ma yafikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then Moses threw his staff and lo! it swallowed that which they did falsely show.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faolqiya alssaharatu sajideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the wizards were flung prostrate,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo amanna birabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbi moosa waharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Lord of Moses and Aaron.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falasawfa taAAlamoona laoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Pharaoh) said: Ye put your faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he doubtless is your chief who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know. Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and verily I will crucify you every one.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo la dayra inna ila rabbina munqaliboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: It is no hurt, for lo! unto our Lord we shall return.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna natmaAAu an yaghfira lana rabbuna khatayana an kunna awwala almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! we ardently hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we are the first of the believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waawhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee innakum muttabaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night, for ye will be pursued.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faarsala firAAawnu fee almadaini hashireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then Pharaoh sent into the cities summoners,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna haolai lashirthimatun qaleeloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Who said): Lo! these indeed are but a little troop,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnahum lana laghaithoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! they are offenders against us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna lajameeAAun hathiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! we are a ready host.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faakhrajnahum min jannatin waAAuyoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus did We take them away from gardens and watersprings,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakunoozin wamaqamin kareemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And treasures and a fair estate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kathalika waawrathnaha banee israeela}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus (were those things taken from them) and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaatbaAAoohum mushriqeena}}
