\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they overtook them at sunrise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma taraa aljamAAani qala ashabu moosa inna lamudrakoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the two hosts saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala kalla inna maAAiya rabbee sayahdeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faawhayna ila moosa ani idrib biAAasaka albahra fainfalaqa fakana kullu firqin kaalttawdi alAAatheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And it parted, and each part was as a mountain vast.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waazlafna thamma alakhareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then brought We near the others to that place.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanjayna moosa waman maAAahu ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We saved Moses and those with him, every one;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma aghraqna alakhareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We drowned the others.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waotlu AAalayhim nabaa ibraheema}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Recite unto them the story of Abraham:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma taAAbudoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When he said unto his father and his folk: What worship ye?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo naAAbudu asnaman fanathallu laha AAakifeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala hal yasmaAAoonakum ith tadAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Do they hear you when ye cry?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw yanfaAAoonakum aw yadurroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or do they benefit or harm you?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo bal wajadna abaana kathalika yafAAaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala afaraaytum ma kuntum taAAbudoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: See now that which ye worship,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Antum waabaokumu alaqdamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ye and your forefathers!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fainnahum AAaduwwun lee illa rabba alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me, save the Lord of the Worlds,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee khalaqanee fahuwa yahdeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who created me, and He doth guide me,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallathee huwa yutAAimunee wayasqeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Who feedeth me and watereth me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha maridtu fahuwa yashfeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when I sicken, then He healeth me,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallathee yumeetunee thumma yuhyeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Who causeth me to die, then giveth me life (again),}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallathee atmaAAu an yaghfira lee khateeatee yawma alddeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbi hab lee hukman waalhiqnee bialssaliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaijAAal lee lisana sidqin fee alakhireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And give unto me a good report in later generations.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaijAAalnee min warathati jannati alnnaAAeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waighfir liabee innahu kana mina alddalleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And forgive my father. Lo! he is of those who err.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tukhzinee yawma yubAAathoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And abase me not on the day when they are raised,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma la yanfaAAu malun wala banoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The day when wealth and sons avail not (any man)}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa man ata Allaha biqalbin saleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waozlifati aljannatu lilmuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waburrizati aljaheemu lilghaweena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And hell will appear plainly to the erring.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqeela lahum ayna ma kuntum taAAbudoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And it will be said unto them: Where is (all) that ye used to worship}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Min dooni Allahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Instead of Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakubkiboo feeha hum waalghawoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then will they be hurled therein, they and the seducers}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajunoodu ibleesa ajmaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the hosts of Iblis, together.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo wahum feeha yakhtasimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they will say, when they are quarrelling therein:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][97]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{TaAllahi in kunna lafee dalalin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][98]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith nusawweekum birabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][99]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama adallana illa almujrimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It was but the guilty who misled us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][100]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama lana min shafiAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Now we have no intercessors}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][101]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala sadeeqin hameemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nor any loving friend.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][102]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falaw anna lana karratan fanakoona mina almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][103]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][104]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][105]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaththabat qawmu noohin almursaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah),}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][106]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith qala lahum akhoohum noohun ala tattaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When their brother Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][107]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][108]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][109]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo anuminu laka waittabaAAaka alarthaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Shall we put faith in thee, when the lowest (of the people) follow thee?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][112]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala wama AAilmee bima kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][113]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In hisabuhum illa AAala rabbee law tashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! their reckoning is my Lord's concern, if ye but knew;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][114]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama ana bitaridi almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And I am not (here) to repulse believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][181]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awfoo alkayla wala takoonoo mina almukhsireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Give full measure, and be not of those who give less (than the due).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][182]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wazinoo bialqistasi almustaqeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And weigh with the true balance.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][183]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tabkhasoo alnnasa ashyaahum wala taAAthaw fee alardi mufsideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Wrong not mankind in their goods, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][184]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waittaqoo allathee khalaqakum waaljibillata alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And keep your duty unto Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][185]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo innama anta mina almusahhareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][186]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama anta illa basharun mithluna wain nathunnuka lamina alkathibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thou art but a mortal like us, and lo! we deem thee of the liars.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][187]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faasqit AAalayna kisafan mina alssamai in kunta mina alssadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us, if thou art of the truthful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][188]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbee aAAlamu bima taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord is Best Aware of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][189]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakaththaboohu faakhathahum AAathabu yawmi alththullati innahu kana AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But they denied him, so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom. Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][190]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][191]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][192]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnahu latanzeelu rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! it is a revelation of the Lord of the Worlds,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][193]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Nazala bihi alrroohu alameenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which the True Spirit hath brought down}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][194]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAala qalbika litakoona mina almunthireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][195]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bilisanin AAarabiyyin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In plain Arabic speech.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][196]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnahu lafee zuburi alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! it is in the Scriptures of the men of old.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][197]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yakun lahum ayatan an yaAAlamahu AAulamao banee israeela}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is it not a token for them that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][198]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw nazzalnahu AAala baAAdi alaAAjameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if We had revealed it unto one of any other nation than the Arabs,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][199]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqaraahu AAalayhim ma kanoo bihi mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he had read it unto them, they would not have believed in it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][200]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kathalika salaknahu fee quloobi almujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][201]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yuminoona bihi hatta yarawoo alAAathaba alaleema}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][202]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fayatiyahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][203]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fayaqooloo hal nahnu muntharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][204]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AfabiAAathabina yastaAAjiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Would they (now) hasten on Our doom?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][205]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaraayta in mattaAAnahum sineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou then seen, if We content them for (long) years,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][206]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma jaahum ma kanoo yooAAadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And then cometh that which they were promised,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][207]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yumattaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (How) that wherewith they were contented naught availeth them?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][208]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa laha munthiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We destroyed no township but it had its warners}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][209]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thikra wama kunna thalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For reminder, for We never were oppressors.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][210]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama tanazzalat bihi alshshayateenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The devils did not bring it down.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][211]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yanbaghee lahum wama yastateeAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][212]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahum AAani alssamAAi lamaAAzooloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][213]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala tadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fatakoona mina almuAAaththabeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor invoke not with Allah another god, lest thou be one of the doomed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][214]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanthir AAasheerataka alaqrabeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And warn thy tribe of near kindred,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][215]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waikhfid janahaka limani ittabaAAaka mina almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][216]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain AAasawka faqul innee bareeon mimma taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][217]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watawakkal AAala alAAazeezi alrraheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][218]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee yaraka heena taqoomu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][219]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wataqallubaka fee alssajideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][220]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][221]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hal onabbiokum AAala man tanazzalu alshshayateenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][222]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tanazzalu AAala kulli affakin atheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They descend on every sinful, false one.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][223]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yulqoona alssamAAa waaktharuhum kathiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They listen eagerly, but most of them are liars.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][224]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaalshshuAAarao yattabiAAuhumu alghawoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for poets, the erring follow them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][225]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara annahum fee kulli wadin yaheemoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou not seen how they stray in every valley,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][226]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waannahum yaqooloona ma la yafAAaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And how they say that which they do not?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[26][227]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati wathakaroo Allaha katheeran waintasaroo min baAAdi ma thulimoo wasayaAAlamu allatheena thalamoo ayya munqalabin yanqaliboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save those who believe and do good works, and remember Allah much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. Those who do wrong will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{An-Naml (The Naml)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Taseen tilka ayatu alqurani wakitabin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ta. Sin. These are revelations of the Qur'an and a Scripture that maketh plain;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hudan wabushra lilmumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A guidance and good tidings for believers}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yuqeemoona alssalata wayutoona alzzakata wahum bialakhirati hum yooqinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who establish worship and pay the poor-due and are sure of the Hereafter.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati zayyanna lahum aAAmalahum fahum yaAAmahoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! as for those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their works fairseeming unto them so that they are all astray.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika allatheena lahum sooo alAAathabi wahum fee alakhirati humu alakhsaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those are they for whom is the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnaka latulaqqa alqurana min ladun hakeemin AAaleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! as for thee (Muhammad), thou verily receivest the Qur'an from the presence of One Wise, Aware.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith qala moosa liahlihi innee anastu naran saateekum minha bikhabarin aw ateekum bishihabin qabasin laAAallakum tastaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Remember) when Moses said unto his household: Lo! I spy afar off a fire; I will bring you tidings thence, or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jaaha noodiya an boorika man fee alnnari waman hawlaha wasubhana Allahi rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But when he reached it, he was called, saying: Blessed is Whosoever is in the fire and Whosoever is round about it! And Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya moosa innahu ana Allahu alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Moses! Lo! it is I, Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalqi AAasaka falamma raaha tahtazzu kaannaha jannun walla mudbiran walam yuAAaqqib ya moosa la takhaf innee la yakhafu ladayya almursaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And throw down thy staff! But when he saw it writhing as it were a demon, he turned to flee headlong; (but it was said unto him): O Moses! Fear not! the emissaries fear not in My presence,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa man thalama thumma baddala husnan baAAda sooin fainnee ghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save him who hath done wrong and afterward hath changed evil for good. And lo! I am Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waadkhil yadaka fee jaybika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin fee tisAAi ayatin ila firAAawna waqawmihi innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And put thy hand into the bosom of thy robe, it will come forth white but unhurt. (This will be one) among nine tokens unto Pharaoh and his people Lo! they were ever evil-living folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jaathum ayatuna mubsiratan qaloo hatha sihrun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But when Our tokens came unto them, plain to see, they said: This is mere magic,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajahadoo biha waistayqanatha anfusuhum thulman waAAuluwwan faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almufsideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they denied them, though their souls acknowledged them, for spite and arrogance. Then see the nature of the consequence for the wrong-doers!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad atayna dawooda wasulaymana AAilman waqala alhamdu lillahi allathee faddalana AAala katheerin min AAibadihi almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We verily gave knowledge unto David and Solomon, and they said: Praise be to Allah, Who hath preferred us above many of His believing slaves!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wawaritha sulaymanu dawooda waqala ya ayyuha alnnasu AAullimna mantiqa alttayri waooteena min kulli shayin inna hatha lahuwa alfadlu almubeenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Solomon was David's heir. And he said: O mankind! Lo! we have been taught the language of birds, and have been given (abundance) of all things. This surely is evident favour.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahushira lisulaymana junooduhu mina aljinni waalinsi waalttayri fahum yoozaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And there were gathered together unto Solomon his armies of the jinn and humankind, and of the birds, and they were set in battle order;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatta itha ataw AAala wadi alnnamli qalat namlatun ya ayyuha alnnamlu odkhuloo masakinakum la yahtimannakum sulaymanu wajunooduhu wahum la yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Till, when they reached the Valley of the Ants, an ant exclaimed: O ants! Enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his armies crush you, unperceiving.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatabassama dahikan min qawliha waqala rabbi awziAAnee an ashkura niAAmataka allatee anAAamta AAalayya waAAala walidayya waan aAAmala salihan tardahu waadkhilnee birahmatika fee AAibadika alssaliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (Solomon) smiled, laughing at her speech, and said: My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and to do good that shall be pleasing unto Thee, and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watafaqqada alttayra faqala ma liya la ara alhudhuda am kana mina alghaibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he sought among the birds and said: How is it that I see not the hoopoe, or is he among the absent?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{LaoAAaththibannahu AAathaban shadeedan aw laathbahannahu aw layatiyannee bisultanin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} I verily will punish him with hard punishment or I verily will slay him, or he verily shall bring me a plain excuse.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Famakatha ghayra baAAeedin faqala ahattu bima lam tuhit bihi wajituka min sabain binabain yaqeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But he was not long in coming, and he said: I have found out (a thing) that thou apprehendest not, and I come unto thee from Sheba with sure tidings.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innee wajadtu imraatan tamlikuhum waootiyat min kulli shayin walaha AAarshun AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! I found a woman ruling over them, and she hath been given (abundance) of all things, and hers is a mighty throne.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajadtuha waqawmaha yasjudoona lilshshamsi min dooni Allahi wazayyana lahumu alshshaytanu aAAmalahum fasaddahum AAani alssabeeli fahum la yahtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allah; and Satan maketh their works fairseeming unto them, and debarreth them from the way (of Truth), so that they go not aright;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alla yasjudoo lillahi allathee yukhriju alkhabaa fee alssamawati waalardi wayaAAlamu ma tukhfoona wama tuAAlinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So that they worship not Allah, Who bringeth forth the hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knoweth what ye hide and what ye proclaim,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu la ilaha illa huwa rabbu alAAarshi alAAatheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah; there is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Tremendous Throne.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala sananthuru asadaqta am kunta mina alkathibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Solomon) said: We shall see whether thou speakest truth or whether thou art of the liars.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ithhab bikitabee hatha faalqih ilayhim thumma tawalla AAanhum faonthur matha yarjiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Go with this my letter and throw it down unto them; then turn away and see what (answer) they return,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qalat ya ayyuha almalao innee olqiya ilayya kitabun kareemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (The Queen of Sheba) said (when she received the letter): O chieftains! Lo! there hath been thrown unto me a noble letter.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu min sulaymana wainnahu bismi Allahi alrrahmani alrraheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! it is from Solomon, and lo! it is: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alla taAAloo AAalayya watoonee muslimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Exalt not yourselves against me, but come unto me as those who surrender.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qalat ya ayyuha almalao aftoonee fee amree ma kuntu qatiAAatan amran hatta tashhadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} She said: O chieftains! Pronounce for me in my case. I decide no case till ye are present with me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo nahnu oloo quwwatin waoloo basin shadeedin waalamru ilayki faonthuree matha tamureena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: We are lords of might and lords of great prowess, but it is for thee to command; so consider what thou wilt command.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qalat inna almulooka itha dakhaloo qaryatan afsadooha wajaAAaloo aAAizzata ahliha athillatan wakathalika yafAAaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} She said: Lo! kings, when they enter a township, ruin it and make the honour of its people shame. Thus will they do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnee mursilatun ilayhim bihadiyyatin fanathiratun bima yarjiAAu almursaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But lo! I am going to send a present unto them, and to see with what (answer) the messengers return.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jaa sulaymana qala atumiddoonani bimalin fama ataniya Allahu khayrun mimma atakum bal antum bihadiyyatikum tafrahoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So when (the envoy) came unto Solomon, (the King) said: What! Would ye help me with wealth? But that which Allah hath given me is better than that which He hath given you. Nay it is ye (and not I) who exult in your gift.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{IrjiAA ilayhim falanatiyannahum bijunoodin la qibala lahum biha walanukhrijannahum minha athillatan wahum saghiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Return unto them. We verily shall come unto them with hosts that they cannot resist, and we shall drive them out from thence with shame, and they will be abased.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya ayyuha almalao ayyukum yateenee biAAarshiha qabla an yatoonee muslimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O chiefs! Which of you will bring me her throne before they come unto me, surrendering?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala AAifreetun mina aljinni ana ateeka bihi qabla an taqooma min maqamika wainne AAalayhi laqawiyyun ameenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A stalwart of the jinn said: I will bring it thee before thou canst rise from thy place. Lo! I verily am strong and trusty for such work.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala allathee AAindahu AAilmun mina alkitabi ana ateeka bihi qabla an yartadda ilayka tarfuka falamma raahu mustaqirran AAindahu qala hatha min fadli rabbee liyabluwanee aashkuru am akfuru waman shakara fainnama yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fainna rabbee ghaniyyun kareemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} One with whom was knowledge of the Scripture said: I will bring it thee before thy gaze returneth unto thee. And when he saw it set in his presence, (Solomon) said: This is of the bounty of my Lord, that He may try me whether I give thanks or am ungrateful. Whosoever giveth thanks he only giveth thanks for (the good of) his own soul; and whosoever is ungrateful (is ungrateful only to his own soul's hurt). For lo! my Lord is Absolute in independence, Bountiful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala nakkiroo laha AAarshaha nanthur atahtadee am takoonu mina allatheena la yahtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Disguise her throne for her that we may see whether she will go aright or be of those not rightly guided.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jaat qeela ahakatha AAarshuki qalat kaannahu huwa waooteena alAAilma min qabliha wakunna muslimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So, when she came, it was said (unto her): Is thy throne like this? She said: (It is) as though it were the very one. And (Solomon said): We were given the knowledge before her and we had surrendered (to Allah).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wasaddaha ma kanat taAAbudu min dooni Allahi innaha kanat min qawmin kafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (all) that she was wont to worship instead of Allah hindered her, for she came of disbelieving folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qeela laha odkhulee alssarha falamma raathu hasibathu lujjatan wakashafat AAan saqayha qala innahu sarhun mumarradun min qawareera qalat rabbi innee thalamtu nafsee waaslamtu maAAa sulaymana lillahi rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It was said unto her: Enter the hall. And when she saw it she deemed it a pool and bared her legs. (Solomon) said: Lo! it is a hall, made smooth, of glass. She said: My Lord! Lo! I have wronged myself, and I surrender with Solomon unto Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad arsalna ila thamooda akhahum salihan ani oAAbudoo Allaha faitha hum fareeqani yakhtasimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We verily sent unto Thamud their brother Salih, saying: Worship Allah. And lo! they (then became two parties quarrelling.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya qawmi lima tastaAAjiloona bialssayyiati qabla alhasanati lawla tastaghfiroona Allaha laAAallakum turhamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O my people! Why will ye hasten on the evil rather than the good? Why will ye not ask pardon of Allah, that ye may receive mercy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ittayyarna bika wabiman maAAaka qala tairukum AAinda Allahi bal antum qawmun tuftanoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: We augur evil of thee and those with thee. He said: Your evil augury is with Allah. Nay, but ye are folk that are being tested.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakana fee almadeenati tisAAatu rahtin yufsidoona fee alardi wala yuslihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And there were in the city nine persons who made mischief in the land and reformed not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo taqasamoo biAllahi lanubayyitannahu waahlahu thumma lanaqoolanna liwaliyyihi ma shahidna mahlika ahlihi wainna lasadiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Swear one to another by Allah that we verily will attack him and his household by night, and afterward we will surely say unto his friend: We witnessed not the destruction of his household. And lo! we are truthtellers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamakaroo makran wamakarna makran wahum la yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So they plotted a plot: and We plotted a plot, while they perceived not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu makrihim anna dammarnahum waqawmahum ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then see the nature of the consequence of their plotting, for lo! We destroyed them and their people, every one.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatilka buyootuhum khawiyatan bima thalamoo inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} See, yonder are their dwellings empty and in ruins because they did wrong. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for a people who have knowledge.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanjayna allatheena amanoo wakanoo yattaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And we saved those who believed and used to ward off (evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walootan ith qala liqawmihi atatoona alfahishata waantum tubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Lot! when he said unto his folk: Will ye commit abomination knowingly?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ainnakum latatoona alrrijala shahwatan min dooni alnnisai bal antum qawmun tajhaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Must ye needs lust after men instead of women? Nay, but ye are folk who act senselessly.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama kana jawaba qawmihi illa an qaloo akhrijoo ala lootin min qaryatikum innahum onasun yatatahharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But the answer of his folk was naught save that they said: Expel the household of Lot from your township, for they (forsooth) are folk who would keep clean!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faanjaynahu waahlahu illa imraatahu qaddarnaha mina alghabireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We saved him and his household save his wife; We destined her to be of those who stayed behind.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamtarna AAalayhim mataran fasaa mataru almunthareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We rained a rain upon them. Dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Quli alhamdu lillahi wasalamun AAala AAibadihi allatheena istafa allahu khayrun amma yushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad): Praise be to Allah, and peace be on His slaves whom He hath chosen! Is Allah best, or (all) that ye ascribe as partners (unto Him)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Amman khalaqa alssamawati waalarda waanzala lakum mina alssamai maan faanbatna bihi hadaiqa thata bahjatin ma kana lakum an tunbitoo shajaraha ailahun maAAa Allahi bal hum qawmun yaAAdiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is not He (best) Who created the heavens and the earth, and sendeth down for you water from the sky wherewith We cause to spring forth joyous orchards, whose trees it never hath been yours to cause to grow. Is there any Allah beside Allah? Nay, but they are folk who ascribe equals (unto Him)!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Amman jaAAala alarda qararan wajaAAala khilalaha anharan wajaAAala laha rawasiya wajaAAala bayna albahrayni hajizan ailahun maAAa Allahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is not He (best) Who made the earth a fixed abode, and placed rivers in the folds thereof, and placed firm hills therein, and hath set a barrier between the two seas? Is there any Allah beside Allah? Nay, but most of them know not!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Amman yujeebu almudtarra itha daAAahu wayakshifu alssooa wayajAAalukum khulafaa alardi ailahun maAAa Allahi qaleelan ma tathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is not He (best) Who answereth the wronged one when he crieth unto Him and removeth the evil, and hath made you viceroys of the earth? Is there any Allah beside Allah? Little do they reflect!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Amman yahdeekum fee thulumati albarri waalbahri waman yursilu alrriyaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatihi ailahun maAAa Allahi taAAala Allahu AAamma yushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is not He (best) Who guideth you in the darkness of the land and the sea, He Who sendeth the winds as heralds of His mercy? Is there any Allah beside Allah? High Exalted be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Amman yabdao alkhalqa thumma yuAAeeduhu waman yarzuqukum mina alssamai waalardi ailahun maAAa Allahi qul hatoo burhanakum in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is not He (best) Who produceth creation, then reproduceth it, and Who provideth for you from the heaven and the earth? Is there any Allah beside Allah? Say: Bring your proof, if ye are truthful!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul la yaAAlamu man fee alssamawati waalardi alghayba illa Allahu wama yashAAuroona ayyana yubAAathoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad): None in the heavens and the earth knoweth the Unseen save Allah; and they know not when they will be raised (again).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bali iddaraka AAilmuhum fee alakhirati bal hum fee shakkin minha bal hum minha AAamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but doth their knowledge reach to the Hereafter? Nay, for they are in doubt concerning it. Nay, for they cannot see it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena kafaroo aitha kunna turaban waabaona ainna lamukhrajoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Yet those who disbelieve say: When we have become dust like our fathers, shall we verily be brought forth (again)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad wuAAidna hatha nahnu waabaona min qablu in hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We were promised this, forsooth, we and our fathers. (All) this is naught but fables of the men of old.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul seeroo fee alardi faonthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu almujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Travel in the land and see the nature of the sequel for the guilty!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tahzan AAalayhim wala takun fee dayqin mimma yamkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And grieve thou not for them, nor be in distress because of what they plot (against thee).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul AAasa an yakoona radifa lakum baAAdu allathee tastaAAjiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: It may be that a part of that which ye would hasten on is close behind you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna rabbaka lathoo fadlin AAala alnnasi walakinna aktharahum la yashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thy Lord is full of bounty for mankind, but most of them do not give thanks.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna rabbaka layaAAlamu ma tukinnu sudooruhum wama yuAAlinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thy Lord knoweth surely all that their bosoms hide, and all that they proclaim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama min ghaibatin fee alssamai waalardi illa fee kitabin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And there is nothing hidden in the heaven or the earth but it is in a clear Record.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna hatha alqurana yaqussu AAala banee israeela akthara allathee hum feehi yakhtalifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! this Qur'an narrateth unto the Children of Israel most of that concerning which they differ.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnahu lahudan warahmatun lilmumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! it is a guidance and a mercy for believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum bihukmihi wahuwa alAAazeezu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thy Lord will judge between them of His wisdom, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatawakkal AAala Allahi innaka AAala alhaqqi almubeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor (O Muhammad) put thy trust in Allah, for thou (standest) on the plain Truth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innaka la tusmiAAu almawta wala tusmiAAu alssumma aldduAAaa itha wallaw mudbireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thou canst not make the dead to hear, nor canst thou make the deaf to hear the call when they have turned to flee;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama anta bihadee alAAumyi AAan dalalatihim in tusmiAAu illa man yuminu biayatina fahum muslimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nor canst thou lead the blind out of their error. Thou canst make none to hear, save those who believe Our revelations and who have surrendered.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha waqaAAa alqawlu AAalayhim akhrajna lahum dabbatan mina alardi tukallimuhum anna alnnasa kanoo biayatina la yooqinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the word is fulfilled concerning them, We shall bring forth a beast of the earth to speak unto them because mankind had not faith in Our revelations.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma nahshuru min kulli ommatin fawjan mimman yukaththibu biayatina fahum yoozaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (remind them of) the Day when We shall gather out of every nation a host of those who denied Our revelations, and they will be set in array;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatta itha jaoo qala akaththabtum biayatee walam tuheetoo biha AAilman ammatha kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Till, when they come (before their Lord), He will say: Did ye deny My revelations when ye could not compass them in knowledge, or what was it that ye did?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WawaqaAAa alqawlu AAalayhim bima thalamoo fahum la yantiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the Word will be fulfilled concerning them because they have done wrong, and they will not speak.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam yaraw anna jaAAalna allayla liyaskunoo feehi waalnnahara mubsiran inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not seen how We have appointed the night that they may rest therein, and the day sight-giving? Lo! therein verily are portents for a people who believe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma yunfakhu fee alssoori fafaziAAa man fee alssamawati waman fee alardi illa man shaa Allahu wakullun atawhu dakhireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (remind them of) the Day when the Trumpet will be blown, and all who are in the heavens and the earth will start in fear, save him whom Allah willeth. And all come unto Him, humbled.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watara aljibala tahsabuha jamidatan wahiya tamurru marra alssahabi sunAAa Allahi allathee atqana kulla shayin innahu khabeerun bima tafAAaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thou seest the hills thou deemest solid flying with the flight of clouds: the doing of Allah Who perfecteth all things. Lo! He is Informed of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man jaa bialhasanati falahu khayrun minha wahum min fazaAAin yawmaithin aminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whoso bringeth a good deed will have better than its worth; and such are safe from fear that Day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman jaa bialssayyiati fakubbat wujoohuhum fee alnnari hal tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whoso bringeth an ill-deed, such will be flung down on their faces in the Fire. Are ye rewarded aught save what ye did?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama omirtu an aAAbuda rabba hathihi albaldati allathee harramaha walahu kullu shayin waomirtu an akoona mina almuslimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Say): I (Muhammad) am commanded only to serve the Lord of this land which He hath hallowed, and unto Whom all things belong. And I am commanded to be of those who surrender (unto Him),}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waan atluwa alqurana famani ihtada fainnama yahtadee linafsihi waman dalla faqul innama ana mina almunthireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And to recite the Qur'an. And whoso goeth right, goeth right only for (the good of) his own soul; and as for him who goeth astray - (Unto him) say: Lo! I am only a warner.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[27][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waquli alhamdu lillahi sayureekum ayatihi fataAArifoonaha wama rabbuka bighafilin AAamma taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And say: Praise be to Allah Who will show you His portents so that ye shall know them. And thy Lord is not unaware of what ye (mortals) do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Qasas (The Narrative)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Taseenmeem}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ta. Sin. Mim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tilka ayatu alkitabi almubeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Natloo AAalayka min nabai moosa wafirAAawna bialhaqqi liqawmin yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We narrate unto thee (somewhat) of the story of Moses and Pharaoh with truth, for folk who believe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna firAAawna AAala fee alardi wajaAAala ahlaha shiyaAAan yastadAAifu taifatan minhum yuthabbihu abnaahum wayastahyee nisaahum innahu kana mina almufsideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Pharaoh exalted himself in the earth and made its people castes. A tribe among them he oppressed, killing their sons and sparing their women. Lo! he was of those who work corruption.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanureedu an namunna AAala allatheena istudAAifoo fee alardi wanajAAalahum aimmatan wanajAAalahumu alwaritheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We desired to show favour unto those who were oppressed in the earth, and to make them examples and to make them the inheritors,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanumakkina lahum fee alardi wanuriya firAAawna wahamana wajunoodahuma minhum ma kanoo yahtharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And to establish them in the earth, and to show Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts that which they feared from them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waawhayna ila ommi moosa an ardiAAeehi faitha khifti AAalayhi faalqeehi fee alyammi wala takhafee wala tahzanee inna raddoohu ilayki wajaAAiloohu mina almursaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We inspired the mother of Moses, saying: Suckle him and, when thou fearest for him, then cast him into the river and fear not nor grieve. Lo! We shall bring him back unto thee and shall make him (one) of Our messengers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Failtaqatahu alu firAAawna liyakoona lahum AAaduwwan wahazanan inna firAAawna wahamana wajunoodahuma kanoo khatieena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the family of Pharaoh took him up, that he might become for them an enemy and a sorrow, Lo! Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts were ever sinning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqalati imraatu firAAawna qurratu AAaynin lee walaka la taqtuloohu AAasa an yanfaAAana aw nattakhithahu waladan wahum la yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the wife of Pharaoh said: (He will be) a consolation for me and for thee. Kill him not. Peradventure he may be of use to us, or we may choose him for a son. And they perceived not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waasbaha fuadu ommi moosa farighan in kadat latubdee bihi lawla an rabatna AAala qalbiha litakoona mina almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the heart of the mother of Moses became void, and she would have betrayed him if We had not fortified her heart, that she might be of the believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqalat liokhtihi qusseehi fabasurat bihi AAan junubin wahum la yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And she said unto his sister: Trace him. So she observed him from afar, and they perceived not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waharramna AAalayhi almaradiAAa min qablu faqalat hal adullukum AAala ahli baytin yakfuloonahu lakum wahum lahu nasihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We had before forbidden foster-mothers for him, so she said: Shall I show you a household who will rear him for you and take care of him?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faradadnahu ila ommihi kay taqarra AAaynuha wala tahzana walitaAAlama anna waAAda Allahi haqqun walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So We restored him to his mother that she might be comforted and not grieve, and that she might know that the promise of Allah is true. But most of them know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma balagha ashuddahu waistawa ataynahu hukman waAAilman wakathalika najzee almuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when he reached his full strength and was ripe, We gave him wisdom and knowledge. Thus do We reward the good.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wadakhala almadeenata AAala heeni ghaflatin min ahliha fawajada feeha rajulayni yaqtatilani hatha min sheeAAatihi wahatha min AAaduwwihi faistaghathahu allathee min sheeAAatihi AAala allathee min AAaduwwihi fawakazahu moosa faqada AAalayhi qala hatha min AAamali alshshaytani innahu AAaduwwun mudillun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he entered the city at a time of carelessness of its folk, and he found therein two men fighting, one of his own caste, and the other of his enemies; and he who was of his caste asked him for help against him who was of his enemies. So Moses struck him with his fist and killed him. He said: This is of the devil's doing. Lo! he is an enemy, a mere misleader.}
