\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi innee thalamtu nafsee faighfir lee faghafara lahu innahu huwa alghafooru alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! Lo! I have wronged my soul, so forgive me. Then He forgave him. Lo! He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi bima anAAamta AAalayya falan akoona thaheeran lilmujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! Forasmuch as Thou hast favoured me, I will nevermore be a supporter of the guilty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faasbaha fee almadeenati khaifan yataraqqabu faitha allathee istansarahu bialamsi yastasrikhuhu qala lahu moosa innaka laghawiyyun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And morning found him in the city, fearing, vigilant, when behold! he who had appealed to him the day before cried out to him for help. Moses said unto him: Lo! thou art indeed a mere hothead.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma an arada an yabtisha biallathee huwa AAaduwwun lahuma qala ya moosa atureedu an taqtulanee kama qatalta nafsan bialamsi in tureedu illa an takoona jabbaran fee alardi wama tureedu an takoona mina almusliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when he would have fallen upon the man who was an enemy unto them both, he said: O Moses! Wouldst thou kill me as thou didst kill a person yesterday. Thou wouldst be nothing but a tyrant in the land, thou wouldst not be of the reformers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajaa rajulun min aqsa almadeenati yasAAa qala ya moosa inna almalaa yatamiroona bika liyaqtulooka faokhruj innee laka mina alnnasiheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And a man came from the uttermost part of the city, running. He said: O Moses! Lo! the chiefs take counsel against thee to slay thee; therefor escape. Lo! I am of those who give thee good advice.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakharaja minha khaifan yataraqqabu qala rabbi najjinee mina alqawmi alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So he escaped from thence, fearing, vigilant. He said: My Lord! Deliver me from the wrongdoing folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma tawajjaha tilqaa madyana qala AAasa rabbee an yahdiyanee sawaa alssabeeli}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when he turned his face toward Midian, he said: Peradventure my Lord will guide me in the right road.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma warada maa madyana wajada AAalayhi ommatan mina alnnasi yasqoona wawajada min doonihimu imraatayni tathoodani qala ma khatbukuma qalata la nasqee hatta yusdira alrriAAao waaboona shaykhun kabeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when he came unto the water of Midian he found there a whole tribe of men, watering. And he found apart from them two women keeping back (their flocks). He said: What aileth you? The two said: We cannot give (our flocks) to drink till the shepherds return from the water; and our father is a very old man.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasaqa lahuma thumma tawalla ila alththilli faqala rabbi innee lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So he watered (their flock) for them. Then he turned aside into the shade, and said: My Lord! I am needy of whatever good Thou sendest down for me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fajaathu ihdahuma tamshee AAala istihyain qalat inna abee yadAAooka liyajziyaka ajra ma saqayta lana falamma jaahu waqassa AAalayhi alqasasa qala la takhaf najawta mina alqawmi alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then there came unto him one of the two women, walking shyly. She said: Lo! my father biddeth thee, that he may reward thee with a payment for that thou didst water (the flock) for us. Then, when he came unto him and told him the (whole) story, he said: Fear not! Thou hast escaped from the wrongdoing folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qalat ihdahuma ya abati istajirhu inna khayra mani istajarta alqawiyyu alameenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} One of the two women said: O my father! Hire him! For the best (man) that thou canst hire in the strong, the trustworthy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala innee oreedu an onkihaka ihda ibnatayya hatayni AAala an tajuranee thamaniya hijajin fain atmamta AAashran famin AAindika wama oreedu an ashuqqa AAalayka satajidunee in shaa Allahu mina alssaliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Lo! I fain would marry thee to one of these two daughters of mine on condition that thou hirest thyself to me for (the term of) eight pilgrimages. Then if thou completest ten it will be of thine own accord, for I would not make it hard for thee. Allah willing, thou wilt find me of the righteous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala thalika baynee wabaynaka ayyama alajalayni qadaytu fala AAudwana AAalayya waAllahu AAala ma naqoolu wakeelun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: That (is settled) between thee and me. Whichever of the two terms I fulfil, there will be no injustice to me, and Allah is Surety over what we say.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma qada moosaalajala wasara biahlihi anasa min janibi alttoori naran qala liahlihi omkuthoo innee anastu naran laAAallee ateekum minha bikhabarin aw jathwatin mina alnnari laAAallakum tastaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, when Moses had fulfilled the term, and was travelling with his housefolk, he saw in the distance a fire and said unto his housefolk: Bide ye (here). Lo! I see in the distance a fire; peradventure I shall bring you tidings thence, or a brand from the fire that ye may warm yourselves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma ataha noodiya min shatii alwadi alaymani fee albuqAAati almubarakati mina alshshajarati an ya moosa innee ana Allahu rabbu alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when he reached it, he was called from the right side of the valley in the blessed field, from the tree: O Moses! Lo! I, even I, am Allah, the Lord of the Worlds;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waan alqi AAasaka falamma raaha tahtazzu kaannaha jannun walla mudbiran walam yuAAaqqib ya moosa aqbil wala takhaf innaka mina alamineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Throw down thy staff. And when he saw it writhing as it had been a demon, he turned to flee headlong, (and it was said unto him): O Moses! Draw nigh and fear not. Lo! thou art of those who are secure.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Osluk yadaka fee jaybika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin waodmum ilayka janahaka mina alrrahbi fathanika burhanani min rabbika ila firAAawna wamalaihi innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thrust thy hand into the bosom of thy robe it will come forth white without hurt. And guard thy heart from fear. Then these shall be two proofs from your Lord unto Pharaoh and his chiefs. Lo! they are evil-living folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi innee qataltu minhum nafsan faakhafu an yaqtulooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! Lo! I killed a man among them and I fear that they will kill me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waakhee haroonu huwa afsahu minnee lisanan faarsilhu maAAiya ridan yusaddiqunee innee akhafu an yukaththibooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} My brother Aaron is more eloquent than me in speech. Therefor send him with me as a helper to confirm me. Lo! I fear that they will give the lie to me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala sanashuddu AAadudaka biakheeka wanajAAalu lakuma sultanan fala yasiloona ilaykuma biayatina antuma wamani ittabaAAakuma alghaliboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: We will strengthen thine arm with thy brother, and We will give unto you both power so that they cannot reach you for Our portents. Ye twain, and those who follow you, will be the winners.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jaahum moosa biayatina bayyinatin qaloo ma hatha illa sihrun muftaran wama samiAAna bihatha fee abaina alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But when Moses came unto them with Our clear tokens, they said: This is naught but invented magic. We never heard of this among our fathers of old.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala moosa rabbee aAAlamu biman jaa bialhuda min AAindihi waman takoonu lahu AAaqibatu alddari innahu la yuflihu alththalimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Moses said: My Lord is Best Aware of him who bringeth guidance from His presence, and whose will be the sequel of the Home (of bliss). Lo! wrong-doers will not be successful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala firAAawnu ya ayyuha almalao ma AAalimtu lakum min ilahin ghayree faawqid lee ya hamanu AAala altteeni faijAAal lee sarhan laAAallee attaliAAu ila ilahi moosa wainnee laathunnuhu mina alkathibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Pharaoh said: O chiefs! I know not that ye have a god other than me, so kindle for me (a fire), O Haman, to bake the mud; and set up for me a lofty tower in order that I may survey the god of Moses; and lo! I deem him of the liars.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waistakbara huwa wajunooduhu fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi wathannoo annahum ilayna la yurjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he and his hosts were haughty in the land without right, and deemed that they would never be brought back to Us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faakhathnahu wajunoodahu fanabathnahum fee alyammi faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor We seized him and his hosts, and abandoned them unto the sea. Behold the nature of the consequence for evil-doers!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalnahum aimmatan yadAAoona ila alnnari wayawma alqiyamati la yunsaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We made them patterns that invite unto the Fire, and on the Day of Resurrection they will not be helped.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaatbaAAnahum fee hathihi alddunya laAAnatan wayawma alqiyamati hum mina almaqbooheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We made a curse to follow them in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be among the hateful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba min baAAdi ma ahlakna alquroona aloola basaira lilnnasi wahudan warahmatan laAAallahum yatathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We verily gave the Scripture unto Moses after We had destroyed the generations of old: clear testimonies for mankind, and a guidance and a mercy, that haply they might reflect.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama kunta bijanibi algharbiyyi ith qadayna ila moosa alamra wama kunta mina alshshahideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thou (Muhammad) wast not on the western side (of the Mount) when We expounded unto Moses the commandment, and thou wast not among those present;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walakinna anshana quroonan fatatawala AAalayhimu alAAumuru wama kunta thawiyan fee ahli madyana tatloo AAalayhim ayatina walakinna kunna mursileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But We brought forth generations, and their lives dragged on for them. And thou wast not a dweller in Midian, reciting unto them Our revelations, but We kept sending (messengers to men).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama kunta bijanibi alttoori ith nadayna walakin rahmatan min rabbika litunthira qawman ma atahum min natheerin min qablika laAAallahum yatathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thou was not beside the Mount when We did call; but (the knowledge of it is) a mercy from thy Lord that thou mayst warn a folk unto whom no warner came before thee, that haply they may give heed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walawla an tuseebahum museebatun bima qaddamat aydeehim fayaqooloo rabbana lawla arsalta ilayna rasoolan fanattabiAAa ayatika wanakoona mina almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Otherwise, if disaster should afflict them because of that which their own hands have sent before (them), they might say: Our Lord! Why sentest Thou no messenger unto us, that we might have followed Thy revelations and been of the believers?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jaahumu alhaqqu min AAindina qaloo lawla ootiya mithla ma ootiya moosa awalam yakfuroo bima ootiya moosa min qablu qaloo sihrani tathahara waqaloo inna bikullin kafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But when there came unto them the Truth from Our presence, they said: Why is he not given the like of what was given unto Moses? Did they not disbelieve in that which was given unto Moses of old? They say: Two magics that support each other; and they say: Lo! in both we are disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul fatoo bikitabin min AAindi Allahi huwa ahda minhuma attabiAAhu in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Then bring a scripture from the presence of Allah that giveth clearer guidance than these two (that) I may follow it, if ye are truthful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain lam yastajeeboo laka faiAAlam annama yattabiAAoona ahwaahum waman adallu mimmani ittabaAAa hawahu bighayri hudan mina Allahi inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if they answer thee not, then know that what they follow is their lusts. And who goeth farther astray than he who followeth his lust without guidance from Allah. Lo! Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad wassalna lahumu alqawla laAAallahum yatathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And now verily We have caused the Word to reach them, that haply they may give heed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena ataynahumu alkitaba min qablihi hum bihi yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those unto whom We gave the Scripture before it, they believe in it,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha yutla AAalayhim qaloo amanna bihi innahu alhaqqu min rabbina inna kunna min qablihi muslimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when it is recited unto them, they say: We believe in it. Lo! it is the Truth from our Lord. Lo! even before it we were of those who surrender (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika yutawna ajrahum marratayni bima sabaroo wayadraoona bialhasanati alssayyiata wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} These will be given their reward twice over, because they are steadfast and repel evil with good, and spend of that wherewith We have provided them,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha samiAAoo allaghwa aAAradoo AAanhu waqaloo lana aAAmaluna walakum aAAmalukum salamun AAalaykum la nabtaghee aljahileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they hear vanity they withdraw from it and say: Unto us our works and unto you your works. Peace be unto you! We desire not the ignorant.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innaka la tahdee man ahbabta walakinna Allaha yahdee man yashao wahuwa aAAlamu bialmuhtadeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thou (O Muhammad) guidest not whom thou lovest, but Allah guideth whom He will. And He is Best Aware of those who walk aright.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo in nattabiAAi alhuda maAAaka nutakhattaf min ardina awalam numakkin lahum haraman aminan yujba ilayhi thamaratu kulli shayin rizqan min ladunna walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: If we were to follow the Guidance with thee we should be torn out of our land. Have We not established for them a sure sanctuary, whereunto the produce of all things is brought (in trade), a provision from Our presence? But most of them know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakam ahlakna min qaryatin batirat maAAeeshataha fatilka masakinuhum lam tuskan min baAAdihim illa qaleelan wakunna nahnu alwaritheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And how many a community have We destroyed that was thankless for its means of livelihood! And yonder are their dwellings, which have not been inhabited after them save a little. And We, even We, were the inheritors.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama kana rabbuka muhlika alqura hatta yabAAatha fee ommiha rasoolan yatloo AAalayhim ayatina wama kunna muhlikee alqura illa waahluha thalimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And never did thy Lord destroy the townships, till He had raised up in their mother(-town) a messenger reciting unto them Our revelations. And never did We destroy the townships unless the folk thereof were evil-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama ooteetum min shayin famataAAu alhayati alddunya wazeenatuha wama AAinda Allahi khayrun waabqa afala taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whatsoever ye have been given is a comfort of the life of the world and an ornament thereof; and that which Allah hath is better and more lasting. Have ye then no sense?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaman waAAadnahu waAAdan hasanan fahuwa laqeehi kaman mattaAAnahu mataAAa alhayati alddunya thumma huwa yawma alqiyamati mina almuhdareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is he whom We have promised a fair promise which he will find (true) like him whom We suffer to enjoy awhile the comfort of the life of the world, then on the Day of Resurrection he will be of those arraigned?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma yunadeehim fayaqoolu ayna shurakaiya allatheena kuntum tazAAumoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when He will call unto them and say: Where are My partners whom ye imagined?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala allatheena haqqa AAalayhimu alqawlu rabbana haolai allatheena aghwayna aghwaynahum kama ghawayna tabarrana ilayka ma kanoo iyyana yaAAbudoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those concerning whom the Word will have come true will say: Our Lord! These are they whom we led astray. We led them astray even as we ourselves were astray. We declare our innocence before Thee: us they never worshipped.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqeela odAAoo shurakaakum fadaAAawhum falam yastajeeboo lahum waraawoo alAAathaba law annahum kanoo yahtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And it will be said: Cry unto your (so-called) partners (of Allah). And they will cry unto them, and they will give no answer unto them, and they will see the Doom. Ah, if they had but been guided!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma yunadeehim fayaqoolu matha ajabtumu almursaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And on the Day when He will call unto them and say: What answer gave ye to the messengers?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaAAamiyat AAalayhimu alanbao yawmaithin fahum la yatasaaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On that day (all) tidings will be dimmed for them, nor will they ask one of another,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faamma man taba waamana waAAamila salihan faAAasa an yakoona mina almufliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But as for him who shall repent and believe and do right, he haply may be one of the successful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Warabbuka yakhluqu ma yashao wayakhtaru ma kana lahumu alkhiyaratu subhana Allahi wataAAala AAamma yushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thy Lord bringeth to pass what He willeth and chooseth. They have never any choice. Glorified be Allah and Exalted above all that they associate (with Him)!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Warabbuka yaAAlamu ma tukinnu sudooruhum wama yuAAlinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thy Lord knoweth what their breasts conceal, and what they publish.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa Allahu la ilaha illa huwa lahu alhamdu fee aloola waalakhirati walahu alhukmu wailayhi turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He is Allah; there is no Allah save Him. His is all praise in the former and the latter (state), and His is the command, and unto Him ye will be brought back.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul araaytum in jaAAala Allahu AAalaykumu allayla sarmadan ila yawmi alqiyamati man ilahun ghayru Allahi yateekum bidiyain afala tasmaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Have ye thought, if Allah made night everlasting for you till the Day of Resurrection, who is a god beside Allah who could bring you light? Will ye not then hear?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul araaytum in jaAAala Allahu AAalaykumu alnnahara sarmadan ila yawmi alqiyamati man ilahun ghayru Allahi yateekum bilaylin taskunoona feehi afala tubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Have ye thought, if Allah made day everlasting for you till the Day of Resurrection, who is a god beside Allah who could bring you night wherein ye rest? Will ye not then see?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamin rahmatihi jaAAala lakumu allayla waalnnahara litaskunoo feehi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Of His mercy hath He appointed for you night and day, that therein ye may rest, and that ye may seek His bounty, and that haply ye may be thankful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma yunadeehim fayaqoolu ayna shurakaiya allatheena kuntum tazAAumoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And on the Day when He shall call unto them and say: Where are My partners whom ye pretended?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WanazaAAna min kulli ommatin shaheedan faqulna hatoo burhanakum faAAalimoo anna alhaqqa lillahi wadalla AAanhum ma kanoo yaftaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We shall take out from every nation a witness and We shall say: Bring your proof. Then they will know that Allah hath the Truth, and all that they invented will have failed them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna qaroona kana min qawmi moosa fabagha AAalayhim waataynahu mina alkunoozi ma inna mafatihahu latanooo bialAAusbati olee alquwwati ith qala lahu qawmuhu la tafrah inna Allaha la yuhibbu alfariheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Now Korah was of Moses' folk, but he oppressed them; and We gave him so much treasure that the stores thereof would verily have been a burden for a troop of mighty men. When his own folk said unto him: Exult not; lo! Allah loveth not the exultant;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waibtaghi feema ataka Allahu alddara alakhirata wala tansa naseebaka mina alddunya waahsin kama ahsana Allahu ilayka wala tabghi alfasada fee alardi inna Allaha la yuhibbu almufsideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But seek the abode of the Hereafter in that which Allah hath given thee and neglect not thy portion of the world, and be thou kind even as Allah hath been kind to thee, and seek not corruption in the earth; lo! Allah loveth not corrupters,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala innama ooteetuhu AAala AAilmin AAindee awalam yaAAlam anna Allaha qad ahlaka min qablihi mina alqurooni man huwa ashaddu minhu quwwatan waaktharu jamAAan wala yusalu AAan thunoobihimu almujrimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: I have been given it only on account of knowledge I possess. Knew he not that Allah had destroyed already of the generations before him men who were mightier than him in strength and greater in respect of following? The guilty are not questioned of their sins.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakharaja AAala qawmihi fee zeenatihi qala allatheena yureedoona alhayata alddunya ya layta lana mithla ma ootiya qaroonu innahu lathoo haththin AAatheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then went he forth before his people in his pomp. Those who were desirous of the life of the world said: Ah, would that we had the like of what hath been given unto Korah! Lo! he is lord of rare good fortune.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena ootoo alAAilma waylakum thawabu Allahi khayrun liman amana waAAamila salihan wala yulaqqaha illa alssabiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But those who had been given knowledge said: Woe unto you! The reward of Allah for him who believeth and doeth right is better, and only the steadfast will obtain it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakhasafna bihi wabidarihi alarda fama kana lahu min fiatin yansuroonahu min dooni Allahi wama kana mina almuntasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So We caused the earth to swallow him and his dwelling-place. Then he had no host to help him against Allah, nor was he of those who can save themselves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waasbaha allatheena tamannaw makanahu bialamsi yaqooloona waykaanna Allaha yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao min AAibadihi wayaqdiru lawla an manna Allahu AAalayna lakhasafa bina waykaannahu la yuflihu alkafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And morning found those who had coveted his place but yesterday crying: Ah, welladay! Allah enlargeth the provision for whom He will of His slaves and straiteneth it (for whom He will). If Allah had not been gracious unto us He would have caused it to swallow us (also). Ah, welladay! the disbelievers never prosper.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tilka alddaru alakhiratu najAAaluha lillatheena la yureedoona AAuluwwan fee alardi wala fasadan waalAAaqibatu lilmuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for that Abode of the Hereafter We assign it unto those who seek not oppression in the earth, nor yet corruption. The sequel is for those who ward off (evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man jaa bialhasanati falahu khayrun minha waman jaa bialssayyiati fala yujza allatheena AAamiloo alssayyiati illa ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whoso bringeth a good deed, he will have better than the same; while as for him who bringeth an ill-deed, those who do ill-deeds will be requited only what they did.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allathee farada AAalayka alqurana laradduka ila maAAadin qul rabbee aAAlamu man jaa bialhuda waman huwa fee dalalin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! He Who hath given thee the Qur'an for a law will surely bring thee home again. Say: My Lord is Best Aware of him who bringeth guidance and him who is in error manifest.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama kunta tarjoo an yulqa ilayka alkitabu illa rahmatan min rabbika fala takoonanna thaheeran lilkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thou hadst no hope that the Scripture would be inspired in thee; but it is a mercy from thy Lord, so never be a helper to the disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala yasuddunnaka AAan ayati Allahi baAAda ith onzilat ilayka waodAAu ila rabbika wala takoonanna mina almushrikeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And let them not divert thee from the revelations of Allah after they have been sent down unto thee; but call (mankind) unto thy Lord, and be not of those who ascribe partners (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[28][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara la ilaha illa huwa kullu shayin halikun illa wajhahu lahu alhukmu wailayhi turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And cry not unto any other god along with Allah. There is no Allah save Him. Everything will perish save His countenance. His is the command, and unto Him ye will be brought back.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-'Ankabut (The Spider)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aliflammeem}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Alif. Lam. Mim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ahasiba alnnasu an yutrakoo an yaqooloo amanna wahum la yuftanoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Do men imagine that they will be left (at ease) because they say, We believe, and will not be tested with affliction?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad fatanna allatheena min qablihim falayaAAlamanna Allahu allatheena sadaqoo walayaAAlamanna alkathibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We tested those who were before you. Thus Allah knoweth those who are sincere, and knoweth those who feign.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am hasiba allatheena yaAAmaloona alssayyiati an yasbiqoona saa ma yahkumoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or do those who do ill-deeds imagine that they can outstrip Us? Evil (for them) is that which they decide.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man kana yarjoo liqaa Allahi fainna ajala Allahi laatin wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whoso looketh forward to the meeting with Allah (let him know that) Allah's reckoning is surely nigh, and He is the Hearer, the Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman jahada fainnama yujahidu linafsihi inna Allaha laghaniyyun AAani alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whosoever striveth, striveth only for himself, for lo! Allah is altogether Independent of (His) creatures.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lanukaffiranna AAanhum sayyiatihim walanajziyannahum ahsana allathee kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And as for those who believe and do good works, We shall remit from them their evil deeds and shall repay them the best that they did.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wawassayna alinsana biwalidayhi husnan wain jahadaka litushrika bee ma laysa laka bihi AAilmun fala tutiAAhuma ilayya marjiAAukum faonabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We have enjoined on man kindness to parents; but if they strive to make thee join with Me that of which thou hast no knowledge, then obey them not. Unto Me is your return and I shall tell you what ye used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lanudkhilannahum fee alssaliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And as for those who believe and do good works, We verily shall make them enter in among the righteous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamina alnnasi man yaqoolu amanna biAllahi faitha oothiya fee Allahi jaAAala fitnata alnnasi kaAAathabi Allahi walain jaa nasrun min rabbika layaqoolunna inna kunna maAAakum awalaysa Allahu biaAAlama bima fee sudoori alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Of mankind is he who saith: We believe in Allah, but, if he be made to suffer for the sake of Allah, he mistaketh the persecution of mankind for Allah's punishment; and then, if victory cometh from thy Lord, will say: Lo! we were with you (all the while). Is not Allah Best Aware of what is in the bosoms of (His) creatures?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WalayaAAlamanna Allahu allatheena amanoo walayaAAlamanna almunafiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Verily Allah knoweth those who believe, and verily He knoweth the hypocrites.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo ittabiAAoo sabeelana walnahmil khatayakum wama hum bihamileena min khatayahum min shayin innahum lakathiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Follow our way (of religion) and we verily will bear your sins (for you). They cannot bear aught of their sins. Lo! they verily are liars.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walayahmilunna athqalahum waathqalan maAAa athqalihim walayusalunna yawma alqiyamati AAamma kanoo yaftaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But they verily will bear their own loads and other loads beside their own, and they verily will be questioned on the Day of Resurrection concerning that which they invented.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad arsalna noohan ila qawmihi falabitha feehim alfa sanatin illa khamseena AAaman faakhathahumu alttoofanu wahum thalimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily we sent Noah (as Our messenger) unto his folk, and he continued with them for a thousand years save fifty years; and the flood engulfed them, for they were wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faanjaynahu waashaba alssafeenati wajaAAalnaha ayatan lilAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We rescued him and those with him in the ship, and made of it a portent for the peoples.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waibraheema ith qala liqawmihi oAAbudoo Allaha waittaqoohu thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Abraham! (Remember) when he said unto his folk: Serve Allah, and keep your duty unto Him; that is better for you if ye did but know.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi awthanan watakhluqoona ifkan inna allatheena taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi la yamlikoona lakum rizqan faibtaghoo AAinda Allahi alrrizqa waoAAbudoohu waoshkuroo lahu ilayhi turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ye serve instead of Allah only idols, and ye only invent a lie. Lo! those whom ye serve instead of Allah own no provision for you. So seek your provision from Allah, and serve Him, and give thanks unto Him, (for) unto Him ye will be brought back.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain tukaththiboo faqad kaththaba omamun min qablikum wama AAala alrrasooli illa albalaghu almubeenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But if ye deny, then nations have denied before you. The messenger is only to convey (the message) plainly.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yaraw kayfa yubdio Allahu alkhalqa thumma yuAAeeduhu inna thalika AAala Allahi yaseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} See they not how Allah produceth creation, then reproduceth it? Lo! for Allah that is easy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul seeroo fee alardi faonthuroo kayfa badaa alkhalqa thumma Allahu yunshio alnnashata alakhirata inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad): Travel in the land and see how He originated creation, then Allah bringeth forth the later growth. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YuAAaththibu man yashao wayarhamu man yashao wailayhi tuqlaboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He punisheth whom He will and showeth mercy unto whom He will, and unto Him ye will be turned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama antum bimuAAjizeena fee alardi wala fee alssamai wama lakum min dooni Allahi min waliyyin wala naseerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ye cannot escape (from Him) in the earth or in the sky, and beside Allah there is for you no friend or helper.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena kafaroo biayati Allahi waliqaihi olaika yaisoo min rahmatee waolaika lahum AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who disbelieve in the revelations of Allah and in (their) Meeting with Him, such have no hope of My mercy. For such there is a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama kana jawaba qawmihi illa an qaloo oqtuloohu aw harriqoohu faanjahu Allahu mina alnnari inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But the answer of his folk was only that they said: "Kill him" or "Burn him." Then Allah saved him from the Fire. Lo! herein verily are portents for folk who believe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala innama ittakhathtum min dooni Allahi awthanan mawaddata baynikum fee alhayati alddunya thumma yawma alqiyamati yakfuru baAAdukum bibaAAdin wayalAAanu baAAdukum baAAdan wamawakumu alnnaru wama lakum min nasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Ye have chosen only idols instead of Allah. The love between you is only in the life of the world. Then on the Day of Resurrection ye will deny each other and curse each other, and your abode will be the Fire, and ye will have no helpers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faamana lahu lootun waqala innee muhajirun ila rabbee innahu huwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Lot believed him, and said: Lo! I am a fugitive unto my Lord. Lo! He, only He, is the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wawahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba wajaAAalna fee thurriyyatihi alnnubuwwata waalkitaba waataynahu ajrahu fee alddunya wainnahu fee alakhirati lamina alssaliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob, and We established the prophethood and the Scripture among his seed, and We gave him his reward in the world, and lo! in the Hereafter he verily is among the righteous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walootan ith qala liqawmihi innakum latatoona alfahishata ma sabaqakum biha min ahadin mina alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Lot! (Remember) when he said unto his folk: Lo! ye commit lewdness such as no creature did before you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ainnakum latatoona alrrijala wataqtaAAoona alssabeela watatoona fee nadeekumu almunkara fama kana jawaba qawmihi illa an qaloo itina biAAathabi Allahi in kunta mina alssadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For come ye not in unto males, and cut ye not the road (for travellers), and commit ye not abomination in your meetings? But the answer of his folk was only that they said: Bring Allah's doom upon us if thou art a truthteller!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi onsurnee AAala alqawmi almufsideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! Give me victory over folk who work corruption.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma jaat rusuluna ibraheema bialbushra qaloo inna muhlikoo ahli hathihi alqaryati inna ahlaha kanoo thalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Our messengers brought Abraham the good news, they said: Lo! we are about to destroy the people of that township, for its people are wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala inna feeha lootan qaloo nahnu aAAlamu biman feeha lanunajjiyannahu waahlahu illa imraatahu kanat mina alghabireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Lo! Lot is there. They said: We are best aware of who is there. We are to deliver him and his household, all save his wife, who is of those who stay behind.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma an jaat rusuluna lootan seea bihim wadaqa bihim tharAAan waqaloo la takhaf wala tahzan inna munajjooka waahlaka illa imraataka kanat mina alghabireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Our messengers came unto Lot, he was troubled upon their account, for he could not protect them; but they said: Fear not, nor grieve! Lo! we are to deliver thee and thy household, (all) save thy wife, who is of those who stay behind.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna munziloona AAala ahli hathihi alqaryati rijzan mina alssamai bima kanoo yafsuqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We are about to bring down upon the folk of this township a fury from the sky because they are evil-livers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad tarakna minha ayatan bayyinatan liqawmin yaAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily of that We have left a clear sign for people who have sense.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waila madyana akhahum shuAAayban faqala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha waorjoo alyawma alakhira wala taAAthaw fee alardi mufsideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto Midian We sent Shu'eyb, their brother. He said: O my people! Serve Allah, and look forward to the Last Day, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakaththaboohu faakhathathumu alrrajfatu faasbahoo fee darihim jathimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But they denied him, and the dreadful earthquake took them, and morning found them prostrate in their dwelling place.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAadan wathamooda waqad tabayyana lakum min masakinihim wazayyana lahumu alshshaytanu aAAmalahum fasaddahum AAani alssabeeli wakanoo mustabsireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud! (Their fate) is manifest unto you from their (ruined and deserted) dwellings. Satan made their deeds seem fair unto them and so debarred them from the Way, though they were keen observers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaroona wafirAAawna wahamana walaqad jaahum moosa bialbayyinati faistakbaroo fee alardi wama kanoo sabiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Korah, Pharaoh and Haman! Moses came unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), but they were boastful in the land. And they were not winners (in the race).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakullan akhathna bithanbihi faminhum man arsalna AAalayhi hasiban waminhum man akhathathu alssayhatu waminhum man khasafna bihi alarda waminhum man aghraqna wama kana Allahu liyathlimahum walakin kanoo anfusahum yathlimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So We took each one in his sin; of them was he on whom We sent a hurricane, and of them was he who was overtaken by the (Awful) Cry, and of them was he whom We caused the earth to swallow, and of them was he whom We drowned. It was not for Allah to wrong them, but they wronged themselves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Mathalu allatheena ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi awliyaa kamathali alAAankabooti ittakhathat baytan wainna awhana albuyooti labaytu alAAankabooti law kanoo yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The likeness of those who choose other patrons than Allah is as the likeness of the spider when she taketh unto herself a house, and lo! the frailest of all houses is the spider's house, if they but knew.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha yaAAlamu ma yadAAoona min doonihi min shayin wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah knoweth what thing they invoke instead of Him. He is the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watilka alamthalu nadribuha lilnnasi wama yaAAqiluha illa alAAalimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for these similitudes, We coin them for mankind, but none will grasp their meaning save the wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khalaqa Allahu alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi inna fee thalika laayatan lilmumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah created the heavens and the earth with truth. Lo! therein is indeed a portent for believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Otlu ma oohiya ilayka mina alkitabi waaqimi alssalata inna alssalata tanha AAani alfahshai waalmunkari walathikru Allahi akbaru waAllahu yaAAlamu ma tasnaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Recite that which hath been inspired in thee of the Scripture, and establish worship. Lo! worship preserveth from lewdness and iniquity, but verily remembrance of Allah is more important. And Allah knoweth what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tujadiloo ahla alkitabi illa biallatee hiya ahsanu illa allatheena thalamoo minhum waqooloo amanna biallathee onzila ilayna waonzila ilaykum wailahuna wailahukum wahidun wanahnu lahu muslimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And argue not with the People of the Scripture unless it be in (a way) that is better, save with such of them as do wrong; and say: We believe in that which hath been revealed unto us and revealed unto you; our Allah and your Allah is One, and unto Him we surrender.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakathalika anzalna ilayka alkitaba faallatheena ataynahumu alkitaba yuminoona bihi wamin haolai man yuminu bihi wama yajhadu biayatina illa alkafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In like manner We have revealed unto thee the Scripture, and those unto whom We gave the Scripture aforetime will believe therein; and of these (also) there are some who believe therein. And none deny Our revelations save the disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama kunta tatloo min qablihi min kitabin wala takhuttuhu biyameenika ithan lairtaba almubtiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thou (O Muhammad) wast not a reader of any scripture before it, nor didst thou write it with thy right hand, for then might those have doubted, who follow falsehood.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal huwa ayatun bayyinatun fee sudoori allatheena ootoo alAAilma wama yajhadu biayatina illa alththalimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But it is clear revelations in the hearts of those who have been given knowledge, and none deny Our revelations save wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo lawla onzila AAalayhi ayatun min rabbihi qul innama alayatu AAinda Allahi wainnama ana natheerun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: Why are not portents sent down upon him from his Lord? Say: Portents are with Allah only, and I am but a plain warner.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yakfihim anna anzalna AAalayka alkitaba yutla AAalayhim inna fee thalika larahmatan wathikra liqawmin yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is it not enough for them that We have sent down unto thee the Scripture which is read unto them? Lo! herein verily is mercy, and a reminder for folk who believe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul kafa biAllahi baynee wabaynakum shaheedan yaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati waalardi waallatheena amanoo bialbatili wakafaroo biAllahi olaika humu alkhasiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Allah sufficeth for witness between me and you. He knoweth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those who believe in vanity and disbelieve in Allah, they it is who are the losers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WayastaAAjiloonaka bialAAathabi walawla ajalun musamman lajaahumu alAAathabu walayatiyannahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They bid thee hasten on the doom (of Allah). And if a term had not been appointed, the doom would assuredly have come unto them (ere now). And verily it will come upon them suddenly when they perceive not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YastaAAjiloonaka bialAAathabi wainna jahannama lamuheetatun bialkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They bid thee hasten on the doom, when lo! hell verily will encompass the disbelievers}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma yaghshahumu alAAathabu min fawqihim wamin tahti arjulihim wayaqoolu thooqoo ma kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when the doom will overwhelm them from above them and from underneath their feet, and He will say: Taste what ye used to do!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya AAibadiya allatheena amanoo inna ardee wasiAAatun faiyyaya faoAAbudooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O my bondmen who believe! Lo! My earth is spacious. Therefor serve Me only.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kullu nafsin thaiqatu almawti thumma ilayna turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Every soul will taste of death. Then unto Us ye will be returned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lanubawwiannahum mina aljannati ghurafan tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha niAAma ajru alAAamileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who believe and do good works, them verily We shall house in lofty dwellings of the Garden underneath which rivers flow. There they will dwell secure. How sweet the guerdon of the toilers,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena sabaroo waAAala rabbihim yatawakkaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who persevere, and put their trust in their Lord!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakaayyin min dabbatin la tahmilu rizqaha Allahu yarzuquha waiyyakum wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And how many an animal there is that beareth not its own provision! Allah provideth for it and for you. He is the Hearer, the Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara layaqoolunna Allahu faanna yufakoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if thou wert to ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth, and constrained the sun and the moon (to their appointed work)? they would say: Allah. How then are they turned away?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao min AAibadihi wayaqdiru lahu inna Allaha bikulli shayin AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah maketh the provision wide for whom He will of His bondmen, and straiteneth it for whom (He will). Lo! Allah is Aware of all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walain saaltahum man nazzala mina alssamai maan faahya bihi alarda min baAAdi mawtiha layaqoolunna Allahu quli alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if thou wert to ask them: Who causeth water to come down from the sky, and therewith reviveth the earth after its death? they verily would say: Allah. Say: Praise be to Allah! But most of them have no sense.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama hathihi alhayatu alddunya illa lahwun walaAAibun wainna alddara alakhirata lahiya alhayawanu law kanoo yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This life of the world is but a pastime and a game. Lo! the home of the Hereafter - that is Life, if they but knew.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha rakiboo fee alfulki daAAawoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu alddeena falamma najjahum ila albarri itha hum yushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they mount upon the ships they pray to Allah, making their faith pure for Him only, but when He bringeth them safe to land, behold! they ascribe partners (unto Him),}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyakfuroo bima ataynahum waliyatamattaAAoo fasawfa yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That they may disbelieve in that which We have given them, and that they may take their ease. But they will come to know.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yaraw anna jaAAalna haraman aminan wayutakhattafu alnnasu min hawlihim afabialbatili yuminoona wabiniAAmati Allahi yakfuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not seen that We have appointed a sanctuary immune (from violence), while mankind are ravaged all around them? Do they then believe in falsehood and disbelieve in the bounty of Allah?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman athlamu mimmani iftara AAala Allahi kathiban aw kaththaba bialhaqqi lamma jaahu alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who doeth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie concerning Allah, or denieth the truth when it cometh unto him? Is not there a home in hell for disbelievers?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[29][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena jahadoo feena lanahdiyannahum subulana wainna Allaha lamaAAa almuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for those who strive in Us, We surely guide them to Our paths, and lo! Allah is with the good.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Ar-Rum (The Romans)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aliflammeem}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Alif. Lam. Mim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ghulibati alrroomu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Romans have been defeated}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee adna alardi wahum min baAAdi ghalabihim sayaghliboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In the nearer land, and they, after their defeat will be victorious}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee bidAAi sineena lillahi alamru min qablu wamin baAAdu wayawmaithin yafrahu almuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Within ten years - Allah's is the command in the former case and in the latter - and in that day believers will rejoice}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Binasri Allahi yansuru man yashao wahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In Allah's help to victory. He helpeth to victory whom He will. He is the Mighty, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAda Allahi la yukhlifu Allahu waAAdahu walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is a promise of Allah. Allah faileth not His promise, but most of mankind know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YaAAlamoona thahiran mina alhayati alddunya wahum AAani alakhirati hum ghafiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They know only some appearance of the life of the world, and are heedless of the Hereafter.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yatafakkaroo fee anfusihim ma khalaqa Allahu alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi waajalin musamman wainna katheeran mina alnnasi biliqai rabbihim lakafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not pondered upon themselves? Allah created not the heavens and the earth, and that which is between them, save with truth and for a destined end. But truly many of mankind are disbelievers in the meeting with their Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim kanoo ashadda minhum quwwatan waatharoo alarda waAAamarooha akthara mimma AAamarooha wajaathum rusuluhum bialbayyinati fama kana Allahu liyathlimahum walakin kanoo anfusahum yathlimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not travelled in the land and seen the nature of the consequence for those who were before them? They were stronger than these in power, and they dug the earth and built upon it more than these have built. Messengers of their own came unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty). Surely Allah wronged them not, but they did wrong themselves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma kana AAaqibata allatheena asaoo alssooa an kaththaboo biayati Allahi wakanoo biha yastahzioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then evil was the consequence to those who dealt in evil, because they denied the revelations of Allah and made a mock of them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu yabdao alkhalqa thumma yuAAeeduhu thumma ilayhi turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah produceth creation, then He reproduceth it, then unto Him ye will be returned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma taqoomu alssaAAatu yublisu almujrimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in the day when the Hour riseth the unrighteous will despair.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walam yakun lahum min shurakaihim shufaAAao wakanoo bishurakaihim kafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There will be none to intercede for them of those whom they made equal with Allah. And they will reject their partners (whom they ascribed unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma taqoomu alssaAAatu yawmaithin yatafarraqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In the day when the Hour cometh, in that day they will be sundered.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faamma allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fahum fee rawdatin yuhbaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for those who believed and did good works, they will be made happy in a Garden.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma allatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina waliqai alakhirati faolaika fee alAAathabi muhdaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our revelations, and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, such will be brought to doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasubhana Allahi heena tumsoona waheena tusbihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So glory be to Allah when ye enter the night and when ye enter the morning -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walahu alhamdu fee alssamawati waalardi waAAashiyyan waheena tuthhiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Him be praise in the heavens and the earth! - and at the sun's decline and in the noonday.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yukhriju alhayya mina almayyiti wayukhriju almayyita mina alhayyi wayuhyee alarda baAAda mawtiha wakathalika tukhrajoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He bringeth forth the living from the dead, and He bringeth forth the dead from the living, and He reviveth the earth after her death. And even so will ye be brought forth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamin ayatihi an khalaqakum min turabin thumma itha antum basharun tantashiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of His signs is this: He created you of dust, and behold you human beings, ranging widely!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamin ayatihi an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwajan litaskunoo ilayha wajaAAala baynakum mawaddatan warahmatan inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of His signs is this: He created for you helpmeets from yourselves that ye might find rest in them, and He ordained between you love and mercy. Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who reflect.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamin ayatihi khalqu alssamawati waalardi waikhtilafu alsinatikum waalwanikum inna fee thalika laayatin lilAAalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the difference of your languages and colours. Lo! herein indeed are portents for men of knowledge.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][23]
\end{Arabic}}
