\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamin ayatihi manamukum biallayli waalnnahari waibtighaokum min fadlihi inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yasmaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of His signs is your slumber by night and by day, and your seeking of His bounty. Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who heed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamin ayatihi yureekumu albarqa khawfan watamaAAan wayunazzilu mina alssamai maan fayuhyee bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yaAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of His signs is this: He showeth you the lightning for a fear and for a hope, and sendeth down water from the sky, and thereby quickeneth the earth after her death. Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who understand.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamin ayatihi an taqooma alssamao waalardu biamrihi thumma itha daAAakum daAAwatan mina alardi itha antum takhrujoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of His signs is this: The heavens and the earth stand fast by His command, and afterward, when He calleth you, lo! from the earth ye will emerge.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walahu man fee alssamawati waalardi kullun lahu qanitoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Him belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth. All are obedient unto Him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee yabdao alkhalqa thumma yuAAeeduhu wahuwa ahwanu AAalayhi walahu almathalu alaAAla fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who produceth creation, then reproduceth it, and it is easier for Him. His is the Sublime Similitude in the heavens and the earth. He is the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Daraba lakum mathalan min anfusikum hal lakum mi mma malakat aymanukum min shurakaa fee ma razaqnakum faantum feehi sawaon takhafoonahum kakheefatikum anfusakum kathalika nufassilu alayati liqawmin yaAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He coineth for you a similitude of yourselves. Have ye, from among those whom your right hands possess, partners in the wealth We have bestowed upon you, equal with you in respect thereof, so that ye fear them as ye fear each other (that ye ascribe unto Us partners out of that which We created)? Thus We display the revelations for people who have sense.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bali ittabaAAa allatheena thalamoo ahwaahum bighayri AAilmin faman yahdee man adalla Allahu wama lahum min nasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but those who do wrong follow their own lusts without knowledge. Who is able to guide him whom Allah hath sent astray? For such there are no helpers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faaqim wajhaka lilddeeni haneefan fitrata Allahi allatee fatara alnnasa AAalayha la tabdeela likhalqi Allahi thalika alddeenu alqayyimu walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So set thy purpose (O Muhammad) for religion as a man by nature upright - the nature (framed) of Allah, in which He hath created man. There is no altering (the laws of) Allah's creation. That is the right religion, but most men know not -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Muneebeena ilayhi waittaqoohu waaqeemoo alssalata wala takoonoo mina almushrikeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Turning unto Him (only); and be careful of your duty unto Him and establish worship, and be not of those who ascribe partners (unto Him);}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Mina allatheena farraqoo deenahum wakanoo shiyaAAan kullu hizbin bima ladayhim farihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Of those who split up their religion and became schismatics, each sect exulting in its tenets.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha massa alnnasa durrun daAAaw rabbahum muneebeena ilayhi thumma itha athaqahum minhu rahmatan itha fareequn minhum birabbihim yushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when harm toucheth men they cry unto their Lord, turning to Him in repentance; then, when they have tasted of His mercy, behold! some of them attribute partners to their Lord}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyakfuroo bima ataynahum fatamattaAAoo fasawfa taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So as to disbelieve in that which We have given them. (Unto such it is said): Enjoy yourselves awhile, but ye will come to know.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am anzalna AAalayhim sultanan fahuwa yatakallamu bima kanoo bihi yushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or have We revealed unto them any warrant which speaketh of that which they associate with Him?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha athaqna alnnasa rahmatan farihoo biha wain tusibhum sayyiatun bima qaddamat aydeehim itha hum yaqnatoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We cause mankind to taste of mercy they rejoice therein; but if an evil thing befall them as the consequence of their own deeds, lo! they are in despair!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yaraw anna Allaha yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} See they not that Allah enlargeth the provision for whom He will, and straiteneth (it for whom He will). Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who believe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faati tha alqurba haqqahu waalmiskeena waibna alssabeeli thalika khayrun lillatheena yureedoona wajha Allahi waolaika humu almuflihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So give to the kinsman his due, and to the needy, and to the wayfarer. That is best for those who seek Allah's Countenance. And such are they who are successful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama ataytum min riban liyarbuwa fee amwali alnnasi fala yarboo AAinda Allahi wama ataytum min zakatin tureedoona wajha Allahi faolaika humu almudAAifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That which ye give in usury in order that it may increase on (other) people's property hath no increase with Allah; but that which ye give in charity, seeking Allah's Countenance, hath increase manifold.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu allathee khalaqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum hal min shurakaikum man yafAAalu min thalikum min shayin subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah is He Who created you and then sustained you, then causeth you to die, then giveth life to you again. Is there any of your (so-called) partners (of Allah) that doeth aught of that? Praised and Exalted be He above what they associate (with Him)!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thahara alfasadu fee albarri waalbahri bima kasabat aydee alnnasi liyutheeqahum baAAda allathee AAamiloo laAAallahum yarjiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Corruption doth appear on land and sea because of (the evil) which men's hands have done, that He may make them taste a part of that which they have done, in order that they may return.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul seeroo fee alardi faonthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablu kana aktharuhum mushrikeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad, to the disbelievers): Travel in the land, and see the nature of the consequence for those who were before you! Most of them were idolaters.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faaqim wajhaka lilddeeni alqayyimi min qabli an yatiya yawmun la maradda lahu mina Allahi yawmaithin yassaddaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So set thy purpose resolutely for the right religion, before the inevitable day cometh from Allah. On that day mankind will be sundered-}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man kafara faAAalayhi kufruhu waman AAamila salihan falianfusihim yamhadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whoso disbelieveth must (then) bear the consequences of his disbelief, while those who do right make provision for themselves -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyajziya allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati min fadlihi innahu la yuhibbu alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That He may reward out of His bounty those who believe and do good works. Lo! He loveth not the disbelievers (in His guidance).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamin ayatihi an yursila alrriyaha mubashshiratin waliyutheeqakum min rahmatihi walitajriya alfulku biamrihi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of His signs is this: He sendeth herald winds to make you taste His mercy, and that the ships may sail at His command, and that ye may seek his favour, and that haply ye may be thankful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad arsalna min qablika rusulan ila qawmihim fajaoohum bialbayyinati faintaqamna mina allatheena ajramoo wakana haqqan AAalayna nasru almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Verily We sent before thee (Muhammad) messengers to their own folk. Then we took vengeance upon those who were guilty (in regard to them). To help believers is ever incumbent upon Us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu allathee yursilu alrriyaha fatutheeru sahaban fayabsutuhu fee alssamai kayfa yashao wayajAAaluhu kisafan fatara alwadqa yakhruju min khilalihi faitha asaba bihi man yashao min AAibadihi itha hum yastabshiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah is He Who sendeth the winds so that they raise clouds, and spreadeth them along the sky as pleaseth Him, and causeth them to break and thou seest the rain downpouring from within them. And when He maketh it to fall on whom He will of His bondmen, lo! they rejoice;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain kanoo min qabli an yunazzala AAalayhim min qablihi lamubliseena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Though before that, even before it was sent down upon them, they were in despair.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faonthur ila athari rahmati Allahi kayfa yuhyee alarda baAAda mawtiha inna thalika lamuhyee almawta wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Look, therefore, at the prints of Allah's mercy (in creation): how He quickeneth the earth after her death. Lo! He verily is the Quickener of the Dead, and He is Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walain arsalna reehan faraawhu musfarran lathalloo min baAAdihi yakfuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if We sent a wind and they beheld it yellow, they verily would still continue in their disbelief.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fainnaka la tusmiAAu almawta wala tusmiAAu alssumma aldduAAaa itha wallaw mudbireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For verily thou (Muhammad) canst not make the dead to hear, nor canst thou make the deaf to hear the call when they have turned to flee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama anta bihadi alAAumyi AAan dalalatihim in tusmiAAu illa man yuminu biayatina fahum muslimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nor canst thou guide the blind out of their error. Thou canst make none to hear save those who believe in Our revelations so that they surrender (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu allathee khalaqakum min daAAfin thumma jaAAala min baAAdi daAAfin quwwatan thumma jaAAala min baAAdi quwwatin daAAfan washaybatan yakhluqu ma yashao wahuwa alAAaleemu alqadeeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah is He Who shaped you out of weakness, then appointed after weakness strength, then, after strength, appointed weakness and grey hair. He createth what He will. He is the Knower, the Mighty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma taqoomu alssaAAatu yuqsimu almujrimoona ma labithoo ghayra saAAatin kathalika kanoo yufakoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And on the day when the Hour riseth the guilty will vow that they did tarry but an hour - thus were they ever deceived.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena ootoo alAAilma waaleemana laqad labithtum fee kitabi Allahi ila yawmi albaAAthi fahatha yawmu albaAAthi walakinnakum kuntum la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But those to whom knowledge and faith are given will say: The truth is, ye have tarried, by Allah's decree, until the Day of Resurrection. This is the Day of Resurrection, but ye used not to know.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fayawmaithin la yanfaAAu allatheena thalamoo maAAthiratuhum wala hum yustaAAtaboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In that day their excuses will not profit those who did injustice, nor will they be allowed to make amends.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad darabna lilnnasi fee hatha alqurani min kulli mathalin walain jitahum biayatin layaqoolanna allatheena kafaroo in antum illa mubtiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Verily We have coined for mankind in this Qur'an all kinds of similitudes; and indeed if thou camest unto them with a miracle, those who disbelieve would verily exclaim: Ye are but tricksters!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kathalika yatbaAAu Allahu AAala quloobi allatheena la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus doth Allah seal the hearts of those who know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[30][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faisbir inna waAAda Allahi haqqun wala yastakhiffannaka allatheena la yooqinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So have patience (O Muhammad)! Allah's promise is the very truth, and let not those who have no certainty make thee impatient.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Luqman (Luqman)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aliflammeem}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Alif. Lam. Mim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tilka ayatu alkitabi alhakeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} These are revelations of the wise Scripture,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hudan warahmatan lilmuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A guidance and a mercy for the good,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yuqeemoona alssalata wayutoona alzzakata wahum bialakhirati hum yooqinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who establish worship and pay the poor-due and have sure faith in the Hereafter.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika AAala hudan min rabbihim waolaika humu almuflihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such have guidance from their Lord. Such are the successful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamina alnnasi man yashtaree lahwa alhadeethi liyudilla AAan sabeeli Allahi bighayri AAilmin wayattakhithaha huzuwan olaika lahum AAathabun muheenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of mankind is he who payeth for mere pastime of discourse, that he may mislead from Allah's way without knowledge, and maketh it the butt of mockery. For such there is a shameful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna walla mustakbiran kaan lam yasmaAAha kaanna fee othunayhi waqran fabashshirhu biAAathabin aleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Our revelations are recited unto him he turneth away in pride as if he heard them not, as if there were a deafness in his ears. So give him tidings of a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum jannatu alnnaAAeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who believe and do good works, for them are the gardens of delight,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khalideena feeha waAAda Allahi haqqan wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Wherein they will abide. It is a promise of Allah in truth. He is the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khalaqa alssamawati bighayri AAamadin tarawnaha waalqa fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bikum wabaththa feeha min kulli dabbatin waanzalna mina alssamai maan faanbatna feeha min kulli zawjin kareemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He hath created the heavens without supports that ye can see, and hath cast into the earth firm hills, so that it quake not with you; and He hath dispersed therein all kinds of beasts. And We send down water from the sky and We cause (plants) of every goodly kind to grow therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha khalqu Allahi faaroonee matha khalaqa allatheena min doonihi bali alththalimoona fee dalalin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is the Creation of Allah. Now show me that which those (ye worship) beside Him have created. Nay, but the wrong-doers are in error manifest!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad atayna luqmana alhikmata ani oshkur lillahi waman yashkur fainnama yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fainna Allaha ghaniyyun hameedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We gave Luqman wisdom, saying: Give thanks unto Allah; and whosoever giveth thanks, he giveth thanks for (the good of) his soul. And whosoever refuseth - Lo! Allah is Absolute, Owner of Praise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qala luqmanu liibnihi wahuwa yaAAithuhu ya bunayya la tushrik biAllahi inna alshshirka lathulmun AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (remember) when Luqman said unto his son, when he was exhorting him: O my dear son! Ascribe no partners unto Allah. Lo! to ascribe partners (unto Him) is a tremendous wrong -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wawassayna alinsana biwalidayhi hamalathu ommuhu wahnan AAala wahnin wafisaluhu fee AAamayni ani oshkur lee waliwalidayka ilayya almaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We have enjoined upon man concerning his partners - His mother beareth him in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years - Give thanks unto Me and unto thy parents. Unto Me is the journeying.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain jahadaka AAala an tushrika bee ma laysa laka bihi AAilmun fala tutiAAhuma wasahibhuma fee alddunya maAAroofan waittabiAA sabeela man anaba ilayya thumma ilayya marjiAAukum faonabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But if they strive with thee to make thee ascribe unto Me as partner that of which thou hast no knowledge, then obey them not. Consort with them in the world kindly, and follow the path of him who repenteth unto Me. Then unto Me will be your return, and I shall tell you what ye used to do -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya bunayya innaha in taku mithqala habbatin min khardalin fatakun fee sakhratin aw fee alssamawati aw fee alardi yati biha Allahu inna Allaha lateefun khabeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O my dear son! Lo! though it be but the weight of a grain of mustard-seed, and though it be in a rock, or in the heavens, or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Lo! Allah is Subtile, Aware.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya bunayya aqimi alssalata wamur bialmaAAroofi wainha AAani almunkari waisbir AAala ma asabaka inna thalika min AAazmi alomoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O my dear son! Establish worship and enjoin kindness and forbid iniquity, and persevere whatever may befall thee. Lo! that is of the steadfast heart of things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tusaAAAAir khaddaka lilnnasi wala tamshi fee alardi marahan inna Allaha la yuhibbu kulla mukhtalin fakhoorin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Turn not thy cheek in scorn toward folk, nor walk with pertness in the land. Lo! Allah loveth not each braggart boaster.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waiqsid fee mashyika waoghdud min sawtika inna ankara alaswati lasawtu alhameeri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Be modest in thy bearing and subdue thy voice. Lo! the harshest of all voices is the voice of the ass.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam taraw anna Allaha sakhkhara lakum ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi waasbagha AAalaykum niAAamahu thahiratan wabatinatan wamina alnnasi man yujadilu fee Allahi bighayri AAilmin wala hudan wala kitabin muneerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} See ye not how Allah hath made serviceable unto you whatsoever is in the skies and whatsoever is in the earth and hath loaded you with His favours both without and within? Yet of mankind is he who disputeth concerning Allah, without knowledge or guidance or a scripture giving light.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha qeela lahumu ittabiAAoo ma anzala Allahu qaloo bal nattabiAAu ma wajadna AAalayhi abaana awalaw kana alshshaytanu yadAAoohum ila AAathabi alssaAAeeri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if it be said unto them: Follow that which Allah hath revealed, they say: Nay, but we follow that wherein we found our fathers. What! Even though the devil were inviting them unto the doom of flame?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman yuslim wajhahu ila Allahi wahuwa muhsinun faqadi istamsaka bialAAurwati alwuthqa waila Allahi AAaqibatu alomoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whosoever surrendereth his purpose to Allah while doing good, he verily hath grasped the firm hand-hold. Unto Allah belongeth the sequel of all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman kafara fala yahzunka kufruhu ilayna marjiAAuhum fanunabbiohum bima AAamiloo inna Allaha AAaleemun bithati alssudoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whosoever disbelieveth, let not his disbelief afflict thee (O Muhammad). Unto Us is their return, and We shall tell them what they did. Lo! Allah is Aware of what is in the breasts (of men).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{NumattiAAuhum qaleelan thumma nadtarruhum ila AAathabin ghaleethin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We give them comfort for a little, and then We drive them to a heavy doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna Allahu quli alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If thou shouldst ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth? they would answer: Allah. Say: Praise be to Allah! But most of them know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lillahi ma fee alssamawati waalardi inna Allaha huwa alghaniyyu alhameedu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth. Lo! Allah, He is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw annama fee alardi min shajaratin aqlamun waalbahru yamudduhu min baAAdihi sabAAatu abhurin ma nafidat kalimatu Allahi inna Allaha AAazeezun hakeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if all the trees in the earth were pens, and the sea, with seven more seas to help it, (were ink), the words of Allah could not be exhausted. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma khalqukum wala baAAthukum illa kanafsin wahidatin inna Allaha sameeAAun baseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Your creation and your raising (from the dead) are only as (the creation and the raising of) a single soul. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara anna Allaha yooliju allayla fee alnnahari wayooliju alnnahara fee allayli wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara kullun yajree ila ajalin musamman waanna Allaha bima taAAmaloona khabeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou not seen how Allah causeth the night to pass into the day and causeth the day to pass into the night, and hath subdued the sun and the moon (to do their work), each running unto an appointed term; and that Allah is Informed of what ye do?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika bianna Allaha huwa alhaqqu waanna ma yadAAoona min doonihi albatilu waanna Allaha huwa alAAaliyyu alkabeeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That (is so) because Allah, He is the True, and that which they invoke beside Him is the False, and because Allah, He is the Sublime, the Great.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara anna alfulka tajree fee albahri biniAAmati Allahi liyuriyakum min ayatihi inna fee thalika laayatin likulli sabbarin shakoorin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou not seen how the ships glide on the sea by Allah's grace, that He may show you of His wonders? Lo! therein indeed are portents for every steadfast, grateful (heart).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha ghashiyahum mawjun kaalththulali daAAawoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu alddeena falamma najjahum ila albarri faminhum muqtasidun wama yajhadu biayatina illa kullu khattarin kafoorin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if a wave enshroudeth them like awnings, they cry unto Allah, making their faith pure for Him only. But when He bringeth them safe to land, some of them compromise. None denieth Our signs save every traitor ingrate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnasu ittaqoo rabbakum waikhshaw yawman la yajzee walidun AAan waladihi wala mawloodun huwa jazin AAan walidihi shayan inna waAAda Allahi haqqun fala taghurrannakumu alhayatu alddunya wala yaghurrannakum biAllahi algharooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O mankind! Keep your duty to your Lord and fear a Day when the parent will not be able to avail the child in aught, nor the child to avail the parent. Lo! Allah's promise is the very truth. Let not the life of the world beguile you, nor let the deceiver beguile you, in regard to Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[31][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha AAindahu AAilmu alssaAAati wayunazzilu alghaytha wayaAAlamu ma fee alarhami wama tadree nafsun matha taksibu ghadan wama tadree nafsun biayyi ardin tamootu inna Allaha AAaleemun khabeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah! With Him is knowledge of the Hour. He sendeth down the rain, and knoweth that which is in the wombs. No soul knoweth what it will earn to-morrow, and no soul knoweth in what land it will die. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{As-Sajdah (The Adoration)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aliflammeem}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Alif. Lam. Mim}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tanzeelu alkitabi la rayba feehi min rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The revelation of the Scripture whereof there is no doubt is from the Lord of the Worlds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am yaqooloona iftarahu bal huwa alhaqqu min rabbika litunthira qawman ma atahum min natheerin min qablika laAAallahum yahtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but it is the Truth from thy Lord, that thou mayst warn a folk to whom no warner came before thee, that haply they may walk aright.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi ma lakum min doonihi min waliyyin wala shafeeAAin afala tatathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah it is Who created the heavens and the earth, and that which is between them, in six Days. Then He mounted the Throne. Ye have not, beside Him, a protecting friend or mediator. Will ye not then remember?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yudabbiru alamra mina alssamai ila alardi thumma yaAAruju ilayhi fee yawmin kana miqdaruhu alfa sanatin mimma taAAuddoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He directeth the ordinance from the heaven unto the earth; then it ascendeth unto Him in a Day, whereof the measure is a thousand years of that ye reckon.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika AAalimu alghaybi waalshshahadati alAAazeezu alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such is the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, the Mighty, the Merciful,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee ahsana kulla shayin khalaqahu wabadaa khalqa alinsani min teenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who made all things good which He created, and He began the creation of man from clay;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma jaAAala naslahu min sulalatin min main maheenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then He made his seed from a draught of despised fluid;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma sawwahu wanafakha feehi min roohihi wajaAAala lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then He fashioned him and breathed into him of His Spirit; and appointed for you hearing and sight and hearts. Small thanks give ye!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo aitha dalalna fee alardi ainna lafee khalqin jadeedin bal hum biliqai rabbihim kafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: When we are lost in the earth, how can we then be re-created? Nay but they are disbelievers in the meeting with their Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul yatawaffakum malaku almawti allathee wukkila bikum thumma ila rabbikum turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: The angel of death, who hath charge concerning you, will gather you, and afterward unto your Lord ye will be returned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw tara ithi almujrimoona nakisoo ruoosihim AAinda rabbihim rabbana absarna wasamiAAna faarjiAAna naAAmal salihan inna mooqinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Couldst thou but see when the guilty hang their heads before their Lord, (and say): Our Lord! We have now seen and heard, so send us back; we will do right, now we are sure.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw shina laatayna kulla nafsin hudaha walakin haqqa alqawlu minnee laamlaanna jahannama mina aljinnati waalnnasi ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if We had so willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word from Me concerning evildoers took effect: that I will fill hell with the jinn and mankind together.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fathooqoo bima naseetum liqaa yawmikum hatha inna naseenakum wathooqoo AAathaba alkhuldi bima kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So taste (the evil of your deeds). Forasmuch as ye forgot the meeting of this your day, lo! We forget you. Taste the doom of immortality because of what ye used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama yuminu biayatina allatheena itha thukkiroo biha kharroo sujjadan wasabbahoo bihamdi rabbihim wahum la yastakbiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Only those believe in Our revelations who, when they are reminded of them, fall down prostrate and hymn the praise of their Lord, and they are not scornful,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tatajafa junoobuhum AAani almadajiAAi yadAAoona rabbahum khawfan watamaAAan wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who forsake their beds to cry unto their Lord in fear and hope, and spend of that We have bestowed on them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala taAAlamu nafsun ma okhfiya lahum min qurrati aAAyunin jazaan bima kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} No soul knoweth what is kept hid for them of joy, as a reward for what they used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaman kana muminan kaman kana fasiqan la yastawoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is he who is a believer like unto him who is an evil-liver? They are not alike.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Amma allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati falahum jannatu almawa nuzulan bima kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But as for those who believe and do good works, for them are the Gardens of Retreat - a welcome (in reward) for what they used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma allatheena fasaqoo famawahumu alnnaru kullama aradoo an yakhrujoo minha oAAeedoo feeha waqeela lahum thooqoo AAathaba alnnari allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And as for those who do evil, their retreat is the Fire. Whenever they desire to issue forth from thence, they are brought back thither. Unto them it is said: Taste the torment of the Fire which ye used to deny.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walanutheeqannahum mina alAAathabi aladna doona alAAathabi alakbari laAAallahum yarjiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We make them taste the lower punishment before the greater, that haply they may return.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman athlamu mimman thukkira biayati rabbihi thumma aAArada AAanha inna mina almujrimeena muntaqimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And who doth greater wrong than he who is reminded of the revelations of his Lord, then turneth from them. Lo! We shall requite the guilty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba fala takun fee miryatin min liqaihi wajaAAalnahu hudan libanee israeela}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We verily gave Moses the Scripture; so be not ye in doubt of his receiving it; and We appointed it a guidance for the Children of Israel.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalna minhum aimmatan yahdoona biamrina lamma sabaroo wakanoo biayatina yooqinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they became steadfast and believed firmly in Our revelations, We appointed from among them leaders who guided by Our command.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna rabbaka huwa yafsilu baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yahdi lahum kam ahlakna min qablihim mina alqurooni yamshoona fee masakinihim inna fee thalika laayatin afala yasmaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is it not a guidance for them (to observe) how many generations We destroyed before them, amid whose dwelling places they do walk? Lo! therein verily are portents! Will they not then heed?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yaraw anna nasooqu almaa ila alardi aljuruzi fanukhriju bihi zarAAan takulu minhu anAAamuhum waanfusuhum afala yubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not seen how We lead the water to the barren land and therewith bring forth crops whereof their cattle eat, and they themselves? Will they not then see?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayaqooloona mata hatha alfathu in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: When cometh this victory (of yours) if ye are truthful?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul yawma alfathi la yanfaAAu allatheena kafaroo eemanuhum wala hum yuntharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them): On the day of the victory the faith of those who disbelieve (and who then will believe) will not avail them, neither will they be reprieved.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[32][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaaAArid AAanhum waintathir innahum muntathiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), and await (the event). Lo! they (also) are awaiting (it).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Ahzab (The Allies)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu ittaqi Allaha wala tutiAAi alkafireena waalmunafiqeena inna Allaha kana AAaleeman hakeeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Prophet! Keep thy duty to Allah and obey not the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaittabiAA ma yooha ilayka min rabbika inna Allaha kana bima taAAmaloona khabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And follow that which is inspired in thee from thy Lord. Lo! Allah is Aware of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watawakkal AAala Allahi wakafa biAllahi wakeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And put thy trust in Allah, for Allah is sufficient as Trustee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma jaAAala Allahu lirajulin min qalbayni fee jawfihi wama jaAAala azwajakumu allaee tuthahiroona minhunna ommahatikum wama jaAAala adAAiyaakum abnaakum thalikum qawlukum biafwahikum waAllahu yaqoolu alhaqqa wahuwa yahdee alssabeela}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah hath not assigned unto any man two hearts within his body, nor hath He made your wives whom ye declare (to be your mothers) your mothers, nor hath He made those whom ye claim (to be your sons) your sons. This is but a saying of your mouths. But Allah saith the truth and He showeth the way.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{OdAAoohum liabaihim huwa aqsatu AAinda Allahi fain lam taAAlamoo abaahum faikhwanukum fee alddeeni wamawaleekum walaysa AAalaykum junahun feema akhtatum bihi walakin ma taAAammadat quloobukum wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Proclaim their real parentage. That will be more equitable in the sight of Allah. And if ye know not their fathers, then (they are) your brethren in the faith, and your clients. And there is no sin for you in the mistakes that ye make unintentionally, but what your hearts purpose (that will be a sin for you). Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alnnabiyyu awla bialmumineena min anfusihim waazwajuhu ommahatuhum waoloo alarhami baAAduhum awla bibaAAdin fee kitabi Allahi mina almumineena waalmuhajireena illa an tafAAaloo ila awliyaikum maAAroofan kana thalika fee alkitabi mastooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Prophet is closer to the believers than their selves, and his wives are (as) their mothers. And the owners of kinship are closer one to another in the ordinance of Allah than (other) believers and the fugitives (who fled from Mecca), except that ye should do kindness to your friends. This is written in the Book (of nature).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith akhathna mina alnnabiyyeena meethaqahum waminka wamin noohin waibraheema wamoosa waAAeesa ibni maryama waakhathna minhum meethaqan ghaleethan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We exacted a covenant from the prophets, and from thee (O Muhammad) and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus son of Mary. We took from them a solemn covenant;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyasala alssadiqeena AAan sidqihim waaAAadda lilkafireena AAathaban aleeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That He may ask the loyal of their loyalty. And He hath prepared a painful doom for the unfaithful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo othkuroo niAAmata Allahi AAalaykum ith jaatkum junoodun faarsalna AAalayhim reehan wajunoodan lam tarawha wakana Allahu bima taAAmaloona baseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Remember Allah's favour unto you when there came against you hosts, and We sent against them a great wind and hosts ye could not see. And Allah is ever Seer of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith jaookum min fawqikum wamin asfala minkum waith zaghati alabsaru wabalaghati alquloobu alhanajira watathunnoona biAllahi alththunoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When they came upon you from above you and from below you, and when eyes grew wild and hearts reached to the throats, and ye were imagining vain thoughts concerning Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hunalika ibtuliya almuminoona wazulziloo zilzalan shadeedan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There were the believers sorely tried, and shaken with a mighty shock.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith yaqoolu almunafiqoona waallatheena fee quloobihim maradun ma waAAadana Allahu warasooluhu illa ghurooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the hypocrites, and those in whose hearts is a disease, were saying: Allah and His messenger promised us naught but delusion.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qalat taifatun minhum ya ahla yathriba la muqama lakum fairjiAAoo wayastathinu fareequn minhumu alnnabiyya yaqooloona inna buyootana AAawratun wama hiya biAAawratin in yureedoona illa firaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when a party of them said: O folk of Yathrib! There is no stand (possible) for you, therefor turn back. And certain of them (even) sought permission of the Prophet, saying: Our homes lie open (to the enemy). And they lay not open. They but wished to flee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw dukhilat AAalayhim min aqtariha thumma suiloo alfitnata laatawha wama talabbathoo biha illa yaseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If the enemy had entered from all sides and they had been exhorted to treachery, they would have committed it, and would have hesitated thereupon but little.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad kanoo AAahadoo Allaha min qablu la yuwalloona aladbara wakana AAahdu Allahi masoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily they had already sworn unto Allah that they would not turn their backs (to the foe). An oath to Allah must be answered for.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul lan yanfaAAakumu alfiraru in farartum mina almawti awi alqatli waithan la tumattaAAoona illa qaleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Flight will not avail you if ye flee from death or killing, and then ye dwell in comfort but a little while.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul man tha allathee yaAAsimukum mina Allahi in arada bikum sooan aw arada bikum rahmatan wala yajidoona lahum min dooni Allahi waliyyan wala naseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Who is he who can preserve you from Allah if He intendeth harm for you, or intendeth mercy for you. They will not find that they have any friend or helper other than Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qad yaAAlamu Allahu almuAAawwiqeena minkum waalqaileena liikhwanihim halumma ilayna wala yatoona albasa illa qaleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah already knoweth those of you who hinder, and those who say unto their brethren: "Come ye hither unto us!" and they come not to the stress of battle save a little,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ashihhatan AAalaykum faitha jaa alkhawfu raaytahum yanthuroona ilayka tadooru aAAyunuhum kaallathee yughsha AAalayhi mina almawti faitha thahaba alkhawfu salaqookum bialsinatin hidadin ashihhatan AAala alkhayri olaika lam yuminoo faahbata Allahu aAAmalahum wakana thalika AAala Allahi yaseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Being sparing of their help to you (believers). But when the fear cometh, then thou (Muhammad) seest them regarding thee with rolling eyes like one who fainteth unto death. Then, when the fear departeth, they scald you with sharp tongues in their greed for wealth (from the spoil). Such have not believed. Therefor Allah maketh their deeds fruitless. And that is easy for Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yahsaboona alahzaba lam yathhaboo wain yati alahzabu yawaddoo law annahum badoona fee alaAArabi yasaloona AAan anbaikum walaw kanoo feekum ma qataloo illa qaleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They hold that the clans have not retired (for good); and if the clans should advance (again), they would fain be in the desert with the wandering Arabs, asking for the news of you; and if they were among you, they would not give battle, save a little.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad kana lakum fee rasooli Allahi oswatun hasanatun liman kana yarjoo Allaha waalyawma alakhira wathakara Allaha katheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Verily in the messenger of Allah ye have a good example for him who looketh unto Allah and the Last Day, and remembereth Allah much.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma raa almuminoona alahzaba qaloo hatha ma waAAadana Allahu warasooluhu wasadaqa Allahu warasooluhu wama zadahum illa eemanan watasleeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the true believers saw the clans, they said: This is that which Allah and His messenger promised us. Allah and His messenger are true. It did but confirm them in their faith and resignation.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Mina almumineena rijalun sadaqoo ma AAahadoo Allaha AAalayhi faminhum man qada nahbahu waminhum man yantathiru wama baddaloo tabdeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Of the believers are men who are true to that which they covenanted with Allah. Some of them have paid their vow by death (in battle), and some of them still are waiting; and they have not altered in the least;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyajziya Allahu alssadiqeena bisidqihim wayuAAaththiba almunafiqeena in shaa aw yatooba AAalayhim inna Allaha kana ghafooran raheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That Allah may reward the true men for their truth, and punish the hypocrites if He will, or relent toward them (if He will). Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waradda Allahu allatheena kafaroo bighaythihim lam yanaloo khayran wakafa Allahu almumineena alqitala wakana Allahu qawiyyan AAazeezan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah repulsed the disbelievers in their wrath; they gained no good. Allah averted their attack from the believers. Allah is ever Strong, Mighty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanzala allatheena thaharoohum min ahli alkitabi min sayaseehim waqathafa fee quloobihimu alrruAAba fareeqan taqtuloona watasiroona fareeqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He brought those of the People of the Scripture who supported them down from their strongholds, and cast panic into their hearts. Some ye slew, and ye made captive some.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waawrathakum ardahum wadiyarahum waamwalahum waardan lam tataooha wakana Allahu AAala kulli shayin qadeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He caused you to inherit their land and their houses and their wealth, and land ye have not trodden. Allah is ever Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu qul liazwajika in kuntunna turidna alhayata alddunya wazeenataha fataAAalayna omattiAAkunna waosarrihkunna sarahan jameelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Prophet! Say unto thy wives: If ye desire the world's life and its adornment, come! I will content you and will release you with a fair release.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain kuntunna turidna Allaha warasoolahu waalddara alakhirata fainna Allaha aAAadda lilmuhsinati minkunna ajran AAatheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But if ye desire Allah and His messenger and the abode of the Hereafter, then lo! Allah hath prepared for the good among you an immense reward.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya nisaa alnnabiyyi man yati minkunna bifahishatin mubayyinatin yudaAAaf laha alAAathabu diAAfayni wakana thalika AAala Allahi yaseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye wives of the Prophet! Whosoever of you committeth manifest lewdness, the punishment for her will be doubled, and that is easy for Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman yaqnut minkunna lillahi warasoolihi wataAAmal salihan nutiha ajraha marratayni waaAAtadna laha rizqan kareeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whosoever of you is submissive unto Allah and His messenger and doeth right, We shall give her her reward twice over, and We have prepared for her a rich provision.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya nisaa alnnabiyyi lastunna kaahadin mina alnnisai ini ittaqaytunna fala takhdaAAna bialqawli fayatmaAAa allathee fee qalbihi maradun waqulna qawlan maAAroofan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye wives of the Prophet! Ye are not like any other women. If ye keep your duty (to Allah), then be not soft of speech, lest he in whose heart is a disease aspire (to you), but utter customary speech.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqarna fee buyootikunna wala tabarrajna tabarruja aljahiliyyati aloola waaqimna alssalata waateena alzzakata waatiAAna Allaha warasoolahu innama yureedu Allahu liyuthhiba AAankumu alrrijsa ahla albayti wayutahhirakum tatheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And stay in your houses. Bedizen not yourselves with the bedizenment of the Time of Ignorance. Be regular in prayer, and pay the poor-due, and obey Allah and His messenger. Allah's wish is but to remove uncleanness far from you, O Folk of the Household, and cleanse you with a thorough cleansing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waothkurna ma yutla fee buyootikunna min ayati Allahi waalhikmati inna Allaha kana lateefan khabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And bear in mind that which is recited in your houses of the revelations of Allah and wisdom. Lo! Allah is Subtile, Aware.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna almuslimeena waalmuslimati waalmumineena waalmuminati waalqaniteena waalqanitati waalssadiqeena waalssadiqati waalssabireena waalssabirati waalkhashiAAeena waalkhashiAAati waalmutasaddiqeena waalmutasaddiqati waalssaimeena waalssaimati waalhafitheena furoojahum waalhafithati waalththakireena Allaha katheeran waalththakirati aAAadda Allahu lahum maghfiratan waajran AAatheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! men who surrender unto Allah, and women who surrender, and men who believe and women who believe, and men who obey and women who obey, and men who speak the truth and women who speak the truth, and men who persevere (in righteousness) and women who persevere, and men who are humble and women who are humble, and men who give alms and women who give alms, and men who fast and women who fast, and men who guard their modesty and women who guard (their modesty), and men who remember Allah much and women who remember - Allah hath prepared for them forgiveness and a vast reward.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama kana limuminin wala muminatin itha qada Allahu warasooluhu amran an yakoona lahumu alkhiyaratu min amrihim waman yaAAsi Allaha warasoolahu faqad dalla dalalan mubeenan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And it becometh not a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His messenger have decided an affair (for them), that they should (after that) claim any say in their affair; and whoso is rebellious to Allah and His messenger, he verily goeth astray in error manifest.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith taqoolu lillathee anAAama Allahu AAalayhi waanAAamta AAalayhi amsik AAalayka zawjaka waittaqi Allaha watukhfee fee nafsika ma Allahu mubdeehi watakhsha alnnasa waAllahu ahaqqu an takhshahu falamma qada zaydun minha wataran zawwajnakaha likay la yakoona AAala almumineena harajun fee azwaji adAAiyaihim itha qadaw minhunna wataran wakana amru Allahi mafAAoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when thou saidst unto him on whom Allah hath conferred favour and thou hast conferred favour: Keep thy wife to thyself, and fear Allah. And thou didst hide in thy mind that which Allah was to bring to light, and thou didst fear mankind whereas Allah hath a better right that thou shouldst fear Him. So when Zeyd had performed that necessary formality (of divorce) from her, We gave her unto thee in marriage, so that (henceforth) there may be no sin for believers in respect of wives of their adopted sons, when the latter have performed the necessary formality (of release) from them. The commandment of Allah must be fulfilled.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma kana AAala alnnabiyyi min harajin feema farada Allahu lahu sunnata Allahi fee allatheena khalaw min qablu wakana amru Allahi qadaran maqdooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There is no reproach for the Prophet in that which Allah maketh his due. That was Allah's way with those who passed away of old - and the commandment of Allah is certain destiny -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yuballighoona risalati Allahi wayakhshawnahu wala yakhshawna ahadan illa Allaha wakafa biAllahi haseeban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who delivered the messages of Allah and feared Him, and feared none save Allah. Allah keepeth good account.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma kana muhammadun aba ahadin min rijalikum walakin rasoola Allahi wakhatama alnnabiyyeena wakana Allahu bikulli shayin AAaleeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Muhammad is not the father of any man among you, but he is the messenger of Allah and the Seal of the Prophets; and Allah is ever Aware of all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo othkuroo Allaha thikran katheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Remember Allah with much remembrance.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wasabbihoohu bukratan waaseelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And glorify Him early and late.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa allathee yusallee AAalaykum wamalaikatuhu liyukhrijakum mina alththulumati ila alnnoori wakana bialmumineena raheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who blesseth you, and His angels (bless you), that He may bring you forth from darkness unto light; and He is ever Merciful to the believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tahiyyatuhum yawma yalqawnahu salamun waaAAadda lahum ajran kareeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Their salutation on the day when they shall meet Him will be: Peace. And He hath prepared for them a goodly recompense.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu inna arsalnaka shahidan wamubashshiran wanatheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Prophet! Lo! We have sent thee as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WadaAAiyan ila Allahi biithnihi wasirajan muneeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And as a summoner unto Allah by His permission, and as a lamp that giveth light.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wabashshiri almumineena bianna lahum mina Allahi fadlan kabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And announce unto the believers the good tidings that they will have great bounty from Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tutiAAi alkafireena waalmunafiqeena wadaAA athahum watawakkal AAala Allahi wakafa biAllahi wakeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And incline not to the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Disregard their noxious talk, and put thy trust in Allah. Allah is sufficient as Trustee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha nakahtumu almuminati thumma tallaqtumoohunna min qabli an tamassoohunna fama lakum AAalayhinna min AAiddatin taAAtaddoonaha famattiAAoohunna wasarrihoohunna sarahan jameelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! If ye wed believing women and divorce them before ye have touched them, then there is no period that ye should reckon. But content them and release them handsomely.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu inna ahlalna laka azwajaka allatee atayta ojoorahunna wama malakat yameenuka mimma afaa Allahu AAalayka wabanati AAammika wabanati AAammatika wabanati khalika wabanati khalatika allatee hajarna maAAaka waimraatan muminatan in wahabat nafsaha lilnnabiyyi in arada alnnabiyyu an yastankihaha khalisatan laka min dooni almumineena qad AAalimna ma faradna AAalayhim fee azwajihim wama malakat aymanuhum likayla yakoona AAalayka harajun wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Prophet! Lo! We have made lawful unto thee thy wives unto whom thou hast paid their dowries, and those whom thy right hand possesseth of those whom Allah hath given thee as spoils of war, and the daughters of thine uncle on the father's side and the daughters of thine aunts on the father's side, and the daughters of thine uncle on the mother's side and the daughters of thine aunts on the mother's side who emigrated with thee, and a believing woman if she give herself unto the Prophet and the Prophet desire to ask her in marriage - a privilege for thee only, not for the (rest of) believers - We are Aware of that which We enjoined upon them concerning their wives and those whom their right hands possess - that thou mayst be free from blame, for Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Turjee man tashao minhunna watuwee ilayka man tashao wamani ibtaghayta mimman AAazalta fala junaha AAalayka thalika adna an taqarra aAAyunuhunna wala yahzanna wayardayna bima ataytahunna kulluhunna waAllahu yaAAlamu ma fee quloobikum wakana Allahu AAaleeman haleeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thou canst defer whom thou wilt of them and receive unto thee whom thou wilt, and whomsoever thou desirest of those whom thou hast set aside (temporarily), it is no sin for thee (to receive her again); that is better; that they may be comforted and not grieve, and may all be pleased with what thou givest them. Allah knoweth what is in your hearts (O men), and Allah is ever Forgiving, Clement.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yahillu laka alnnisao min baAAdu wala an tabaddala bihinna min azwajin walaw aAAjabaka husnuhunna illa ma malakat yameenuka wakana Allahu AAala kulli shayin raqeeban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is not allowed thee to take (other) women henceforth, nor that thou shouldst change them for other wives even though their beauty pleased thee, save those whom thy right hand possesseth. And Allah is ever Watcher over all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tadkhuloo buyoota alnnabiyyi illa an yuthana lakum ila taAAamin ghayra nathireena inahu walakin itha duAAeetum faodkhuloo faitha taAAimtum faintashiroo wala mustaniseena lihadeethin inna thalikum kana yuthee alnnabiyya fayastahyee minkum waAllahu la yastahyee mina alhaqqi waitha saaltumoohunna mataAAan faisaloohunna min warai hijabin thalikum atharu liquloobikum waquloobihinna wama kana lakum an tuthoo rasoola Allahi wala an tankihoo azwajahu min baAAdihi abadan inna thalikum kana AAinda Allahi AAatheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Ye who believe! Enter not the dwellings of the Prophet for a meal without waiting for the proper time, unless permission be granted you. But if ye are invited, enter, and, when your meal is ended, then disperse. Linger not for conversation. Lo! that would cause annoyance to the Prophet, and he would be shy of (asking) you (to go); but Allah is not shy of the truth. And when ye ask of them (the wives of the Prophet) anything, ask it of them from behind a curtain. That is purer for your hearts and for their hearts. And it is not for you to cause annoyance to the messenger of Allah, nor that ye should ever marry his wives after him. Lo! that in Allah's sight would be an enormity.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In tubdoo shayan aw tukhfoohu fainna Allaha kana bikulli shayin AAaleeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whether ye divulge a thing or keep it hidden, lo! Allah is ever Knower of all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][55]
\end{Arabic}}
