\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La junaha AAalayhinna fee abaihinna wala abnaihinna wala ikhwanihinna wala abnai ikhwanihinna wala abnai akhawatihinna wala nisaihinna wala ma malakat aymanuhunna waittaqeena Allaha inna Allaha kana AAala kulli shayin shaheedan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is no sin for them (thy wives) to converse freely) with their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their brothers' sons, or the sons of their sisters or of their own women, or their slaves. O women! Keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is ever Witness over all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha wamalaikatahu yusalloona AAala alnnabiyyi ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo salloo AAalayhi wasallimoo tasleeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah and His angels shower blessings on the Prophet. O ye who believe! Ask blessings on him and salute him with a worthy salutation.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena yuthoona Allaha warasoolahu laAAanahumu Allahu fee alddunya waalakhirati waaAAadda lahum AAathaban muheenan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who malign Allah and His messenger, Allah hath cursed them in the world and the Hereafter, and hath prepared for them the doom of the disdained.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena yuthoona almumineena waalmuminati bighayri ma iktasaboo faqadi ihtamaloo buhtanan waithman mubeenan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who malign believing men and believing women undeservedly, they bear the guilt of slander and manifest sin.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu qul liazwajika wabanatika wanisai almumineena yudneena AAalayhinna min jalabeebihinna thalika adna an yuAArafna fala yuthayna wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Prophet! Tell thy wives and thy daughters and the women of the believers to draw their cloaks close round them (when they go abroad). That will be better, so that they may be recognised and not annoyed. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lain lam yantahi almunafiqoona waallatheena fee quloobihim maradun waalmurjifoona fee almadeenati lanughriyannaka bihim thumma la yujawiroonaka feeha illa qaleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If the hypocrites, and those in whose hearts is a disease, and the alarmists in the city do not cease, We verily shall urge thee on against them, then they will be your neighbours in it but a little while.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{MalAAooneena aynama thuqifoo okhithoo waquttiloo taqteelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Accursed, they will be seized wherever found and slain with a (fierce) slaughter.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sunnata Allahi fee allatheena khalaw min qablu walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That was the way of Allah in the case of those who passed away of old; thou wilt not find for the way of Allah aught of power to change.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yasaluka alnnasu AAani alssaAAati qul innama AAilmuha AAinda Allahi wama yudreeka laAAalla alssaAAata takoonu qareeban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Men ask thee of the Hour. Say: The knowledge of it is with Allah only. What can convey (the knowledge) unto thee? It may be that the Hour is nigh.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha laAAana alkafireena waaAAadda lahum saAAeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah hath cursed the disbelievers, and hath prepared for them a flaming fire,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khalideena feeha abadan la yajidoona waliyyan wala naseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Wherein they will abide for ever. They will find (then) no protecting friend nor helper.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma tuqallabu wujoohuhum fee alnnari yaqooloona ya laytana ataAAna Allaha waataAAna alrrasoola}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when their faces are turned over in the Fire, they say: Oh, would that we had obeyed Allah and had obeyed His messenger!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo rabbana inna ataAAna sadatana wakubaraana faadalloona alssabeela}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: Our Lord! Lo! we obeyed our princes and great men, and they misled us from the Way.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbana atihim diAAfayni mina alAAathabi wailAAanhum laAAnan kabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Our Lord! Oh, give them double torment and curse them with a mighty curse.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la takoonoo kaallatheena athaw moosa fabarraahu Allahu mimma qaloo wakana AAinda Allahi wajeehan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Be not as those who slandered Moses, but Allah proved his innocence of that which they alleged, and he was well esteemed in Allah's sight.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha waqooloo qawlan sadeedan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Guard your duty to Allah, and speak words straight to the point;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yuslih lakum aAAmalakum wayaghfir lakum thunoobakum waman yutiAAi Allaha warasoolahu faqad faza fawzan AAatheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He will adjust your works for you and will forgive you your sins. Whosoever obeyeth Allah and His messenger, he verily hath gained a signal victory.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna AAaradna alamanata AAala alssamawati waalardi waaljibali faabayna an yahmilnaha waashfaqna minha wahamalaha alinsanu innahu kana thalooman jahoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We offered the trust unto the heavens and the earth and the hills, but they shrank from bearing it and were afraid of it. And man assumed it. Lo! he hath proved a tyrant and a fool.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[33][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{LiyuAAaththiba Allahu almunafiqeena waalmunafiqati waalmushrikeena waalmushrikati wayatooba Allahu AAala almumineena waalmuminati wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So Allah punisheth hypocritical men and hypocritical women, and idolatrous men and idolatrous women. But Allah pardoneth believing men and believing women, and Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Saba' (The Saba')}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alhamdu lillahi allathee lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi walahu alhamdu fee alakhirati wahuwa alhakeemu alkhabeeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Praise be to Allah, unto Whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. His is the praise in the Hereafter, and He is the Wise, the Aware.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YaAAlamu ma yaliju fee alardi wama yakhruju minha wama yanzilu mina alssamai wama yaAAruju feeha wahuwa alrraheemu alghafooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He knoweth that which goeth into the earth and that which cometh forth from it, and that descendeth from the heaven and that which ascendeth into it. He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena kafaroo la tateena alssaAAatu qul bala warabbee latatiyannakum AAalimi alghaybi la yaAAzubu AAanhu mithqalu tharratin fee alssamawati wala fee alardi wala asgharu min thalika wala akbaru illa fee kitabin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who disbelieve say: The Hour will never come unto us. Say: Nay, by my Lord, but it is coming unto you surely. (He is) the Knower of the Unseen. Not an atom's weight, or less than that or greater, escapeth Him in the heavens or in the earth, but it is in a clear Record,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyajziya allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati olaika lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That He may reward those who believe and do good works. For them is pardon and a rich provision.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena saAAaw fee ayatina muAAajizeena olaika lahum AAathabun min rijzin aleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But those who strive against Our revelations, challenging (Us), theirs will be a painful doom of wrath.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayara allatheena ootoo alAAilma allathee onzila ilayka min rabbika huwa alhaqqa wayahdee ila sirati alAAazeezi alhameedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who have been given knowledge see that what is revealed unto thee from thy Lord is the truth and leadeth unto the path of the Mighty, the Owner of Praise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena kafaroo hal nadullukum AAala rajulin yunabbiokum itha muzziqtum kulla mumazzaqin innakum lafee khalqin jadeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who disbelieve say: Shall we show you a man who will tell you (that) when ye have become dispersed in dust with most complete dispersal still, even then, ye will be created anew?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aftara AAala Allahi kathiban am bihi jinnatun bali allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati fee alAAathabi waalddalali albaAAeedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hath he invented a lie concerning Allah, or is there in him a madness? Nay, but those who disbelieve in the Hereafter are in torment and far error.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afalam yaraw ila ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum mina alssamai waalardi in nasha nakhsif bihimu alarda aw nusqit AAalayhim kisafan mina alssamai inna fee thalika laayatan likulli AAabdin muneebin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not observed what is before them and what is behind them of the sky and the earth? If We will, We can make the earth swallow them, or cause obliteration from the sky to fall on them. Lo! herein surely is a portent for every slave who turneth (to Allah) repentant.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad atayna dawooda minna fadlan ya jibalu awwibee maAAahu waalttayra waalanna lahu alhadeeda}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And assuredly We gave David grace from Us, (saying): O ye hills and birds, echo his psalms of praise! And We made the iron supple unto him,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ani iAAmal sabighatin waqaddir fee alssardi waiAAmaloo salihan innee bima taAAmaloona baseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Saying: Make thou long coats of mail and measure the links (thereof). And do ye right. Lo! I am Seer of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walisulaymana alrreeha ghuduwwuha shahrun warawahuha shahrun waasalna lahu AAayna alqitri wamina aljinni man yaAAmalu bayna yadayhi biithni rabbihi waman yazigh minhum AAan amrina nuthiqhu min AAathabi alssaAAeeri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto Solomon (We gave) the wind, whereof the morning course was a month's journey and the evening course a month's journey, and We caused the fount of copper to gush forth for him, and (We gave him) certain of the jinn who worked before him by permission of his Lord. And such of them as deviated from Our command, them We caused to taste the punishment of flaming Fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YaAAmaloona lahu ma yashao min mahareeba watamatheela wajifanin kaaljawabi waqudoorin rasiyatin iAAmaloo ala dawooda shukran waqaleelun min AAibadiya alshshakooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They made for him what he willed: synagogues and statues, basins like wells and boilers built into the ground. Give thanks, O House of David! Few of My bondmen are thankful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma qadayna AAalayhi almawta ma dallahum AAala mawtihi illa dabbatu alardi takulu minsaatahu falamma kharra tabayyanati aljinnu an law kanoo yaAAlamoona alghayba ma labithoo fee alAAathabi almuheeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We decreed death for him, nothing showed his death to them save a creeping creature of the earth which gnawed away his staff. And when he fell the jinn saw clearly how, if they had known the Unseen, they would not have continued in despised toil.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad kana lisabain fee maskanihim ayatun jannatani AAan yameenin washimalin kuloo min rizqi rabbikum waoshkuroo lahu baldatun tayyibatun warabbun ghafoorun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There was indeed a sign for Sheba in their dwelling-place: Two gardens on the right hand and the left (as who should say): Eat of the provision of your Lord and render thanks to Him. A fair land and an indulgent Lord!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaaAAradoo faarsalna AAalayhim sayla alAAarimi wabaddalnahum bijannatayhim jannatayni thawatay okulin khamtin waathlin washayin min sidrin qaleelin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But they were froward, so We sent on them the flood of 'Iram, and in exchange for their two gardens gave them two gardens bearing bitter fruit, the tamarisk and here and there a lote-tree.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika jazaynahum bima kafaroo wahal nujazee illa alkafoora}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This We awarded them because of their ingratitude. Punish We ever any save the ingrates?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalna baynahum wabayna alqura allatee barakna feeha quran thahiratan waqaddarna feeha alssayra seeroo feeha layaliya waayyaman amineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We set, between them and the towns which We had blessed, towns easy to be seen, and We made the stage between them easy, (saying): Travel in them safely both by night and day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqaloo rabbana baAAid bayna asfarina wathalamoo anfusahum fajaAAalnahum ahadeetha wamazzaqnahum kulla mumazzaqin inna fee thalika laayatin likulli sabbarin shakoorin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But they said: Our Lord! Make the stage between our journeys longer. And they wronged themselves, therefore We made them bywords (in the land) and scattered them abroad, a total scattering. Lo! herein verily are portents for each steadfast, grateful (heart).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad saddaqa AAalayhim ibleesu thannahu faittabaAAoohu illa fareeqan mina almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Satan indeed found his calculation true concerning them, for they follow him, all save a group of true believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama kana lahu AAalayhim min sultanin illa linaAAlama man yuminu bialakhirati mimman huwa minha fee shakkin warabbuka AAala kulli shayin hafeethun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he had no warrant whatsoever against them, save that We would know him who believeth in the Hereafter from him who is in doubt thereof; and thy Lord (O Muhammad) taketh note of all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Quli odAAoo allatheena zaAAamtum min dooni Allahi la yamlikoona mithqala tharratin fee alssamawati wala fee alardi wama lahum feehima min shirkin wama lahu minhum min thaheerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad): Call upon those whom ye set up beside Allah! They possess not an atom's weight either in the heavens or in the earth, nor have they any share in either, nor hath He an auxiliary among them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tanfaAAu alshshafaAAatu AAindahu illa liman athina lahu hatta itha fuzziAAa AAan quloobihim qaloo matha qala rabbukum qaloo alhaqqa wahuwa alAAaliyyu alkabeeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} No intercession availeth with Him save for him whom He permitteth. Yet, when fear is banished from their hearts, they say: What was it that your Lord said? They say: The Truth. And He is the Sublime, the Great.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul man yarzuqukum mina alssamawati waalardi quli Allahu wainna aw iyyakum laAAala hudan aw fee dalalin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Who giveth you provision from the sky and the earth? Say: Allah, Lo! we or you assuredly are rightly guided or in error manifest.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul la tusaloona AAamma ajramna wala nusalu AAamma taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Ye will not be asked of what we committed, nor shall we be asked of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul yajmaAAu baynana rabbuna thumma yaftahu baynana bialhaqqi wahuwa alfattahu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Our Lord will bring us all together, then He will judge between us with truth. He is the All-knowing Judge.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul arooniya allatheena alhaqtum bihi shurakaa kalla bal huwa Allahu alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Show me those whom ye have joined unto Him as partners. Nay (ye dare not)! For He is Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama arsalnaka illa kaffatan lilnnasi basheeran wanatheeran walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We have not sent thee (O Muhammad) save as a bringer of good tidings and a warner unto all mankind; but most of mankind know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: When is this promise (to be fulfilled) if ye are truthful?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul lakum meeAAadu yawmin la tastakhiroona AAanhu saAAatan wala tastaqdimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad): Yours is the promise of a Day which ye cannot postpone nor hasten by an hour.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena kafaroo lan numina bihatha alqurani wala biallathee bayna yadayhi walaw tara ithi alththalimoona mawqoofoona AAinda rabbihim yarjiAAu baAAduhum ila baAAdin alqawla yaqoolu allatheena istudAAifoo lillatheena istakbaroo lawla antum lakunna mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who disbelieve say: We believe not in this Qur'an nor in that which was before it; but oh, if thou couldst see, when the wrong-doers are brought up before their Lord, how they cast the blame one to another; how those who were despised (in the earth) say unto those who were proud: But for you, we should have been believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala allatheena istakbaroo lillatheena istudAAifoo anahnu sadadnakum AAani alhuda baAAda ith jaakum bal kuntum mujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who were proud say unto those who were despised: Did we drive you away from the guidance after it had come unto you? Nay, but ye were guilty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena istudAAifoo lillatheena istakbaroo bal makru allayli waalnnahari ith tamuroonana an nakfura biAllahi wanajAAala lahu andadan waasarroo alnnadamata lamma raawoo alAAathaba wajaAAalna alaghlala fee aAAnaqi allatheena kafaroo hal yujzawna illa ma kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who were despised say unto those who were proud: Nay but (it was your) scheming night and day, when ye commanded us to disbelieve in Allah and set up rivals unto Him. And they are filled with remorse when they behold the doom; and We place carcans on the necks of those who disbelieved. Are they requited aught save what they used to do?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama arsalna fee qaryatin min natheerin illa qala mutrafooha inna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We sent not unto any township a warner, but its pampered ones declared: Lo! we are disbelievers in that wherewith ye have been sent.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo nahnu aktharu amwalan waawladan wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: We are more (than you) in wealth and children. We are not the punished!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul inna rabbee yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad): Lo! my Lord enlargeth the provision for whom He will and narroweth it (for whom He will). But most of mankind know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama amwalukum wala awladukum biallatee tuqarribukum AAindana zulfa illa man amana waAAamila salihan faolaika lahum jazao alddiAAfi bima AAamiloo wahum fee alghurufati aminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And it is not your wealth nor your children that will bring you near unto Us, but he who believeth and doeth good (he draweth near). As for such, theirs will be twofold reward for what they did and they will dwell secure in lofty halls.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena yasAAawna fee ayatina muAAajizeena olaika fee alAAathabi muhdaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And as for those who strive against Our revelations, challenging, they will be brought to the doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul inna rabbee yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao min AAibadihi wayaqdiru lahu wama anfaqtum min shayin fahuwa yukhlifuhu wahuwa khayru alrraziqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Lo! my Lord enlargeth the provision for whom He will of His bondmen, and narroweth (it) for him. And whatsoever ye spend (for good) He replaceth it. And He is the Best of Providers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma yahshuruhum jameeAAan thumma yaqoolu lilmalaikati ahaolai iyyakum kanoo yaAAbudoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And on the day when He will gather them all together, He will say unto the angels: Did these worship you?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo subhanaka anta waliyyuna min doonihim bal kanoo yaAAbudoona aljinna aktharuhum bihim muminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will say: Be Thou Glorified. Thou (alone) art our Guardian, not them! Nay, but they worshipped the jinn; most of them were believers in them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalyawma la yamliku baAAdukum libaAAdin nafAAan wala darran wanaqoolu lillatheena thalamoo thooqoo AAathaba alnnari allatee kuntum biha tukaththiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That day ye will possess no use nor hurt one for another. And We shall say unto those who did wrong: Taste the doom of the Fire which ye used to deny.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qaloo ma hatha illa rajulun yureedu an yasuddakum AAamma kana yaAAbudu abaokum waqaloo ma hatha illa ifkun muftaran waqala allatheena kafaroo lilhaqqi lamma jaahum in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if Our revelations are recited unto them in plain terms, they say: This is naught else than a man who would turn you away from what your fathers used to worship; and they say: This is naught else than an invented lie. Those who disbelieve say of the truth when it reacheth them: This is naught else than mere magic.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama ataynahum min kutubin yadrusoonaha wama arsalna ilayhim qablaka min natheerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We have given them no scriptures which they study, nor sent We unto them, before thee, any warner.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakaththaba allatheena min qablihim wama balaghoo miAAshara ma ataynahum fakaththaboo rusulee fakayfa kana nakeeri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those before them denied, and these have not attained a tithe of that which We bestowed on them (of old); yet they denied My messengers. How intense then was My abhorrence (of them)!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul innama aAAithukum biwahidatin an taqoomoo lillahi mathna wafurada thumma tatafakkaroo ma bisahibikum min jinnatin in huwa illa natheerun lakum bayna yaday AAathabin shadeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I exhort you unto one thing only: that ye awake, for Allah's sake, by twos and singly, and then reflect: There is no madness in your comrade. He is naught else than a warner unto you in face of a terrific doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ma saaltukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum in ajriya illa AAala Allahi wahuwa AAala kulli shayin shaheedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Whatever reward I might have asked of you is yours. My reward is the affair of Allah only. He is Witness over all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul inna rabbee yaqthifu bialhaqqi AAallamu alghuyoobi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Lo! my Lord hurleth the truth. (He is) the Knower of Things Hidden.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul jaa alhaqqu wama yubdio albatilu wama yuAAeedu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: The Truth hath come, and falsehood showeth not its face and will not return.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul in dalaltu fainnama adillu AAala nafsee waini ihtadaytu fabima yoohee ilayya rabbee innahu sameeAAun qareebun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: If I err, I err only to my own loss, and if I am rightly guided it is because of that which my Lord hath revealed unto me. Lo! He is Hearer, Nigh.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw tara ith faziAAoo fala fawta waokhithoo min makanin qareebin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Couldst thou but see when they are terrified with no escape, and are seized from near at hand,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo amanna bihi waanna lahumu alttanawushu min makanin baAAeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And say: We (now) believe therein. But how can they reach (faith) from afar off,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqad kafaroo bihi min qablu wayaqthifoona bialghaybi min makanin baAAeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When they disbelieved in it of yore. They aim at the unseen from afar off.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[34][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waheela baynahum wabayna ma yashtahoona kama fuAAila biashyaAAihim min qablu innahum kanoo fee shakkin mureebin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And a gulf is set between them and that which they desire, as was done for people of their kind of old. Lo! they were in hopeless doubt.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Fatir (The Originator)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alhamdu lillahi fatiri alssamawati waalardi jaAAili almalaikati rusulan olee ajnihatin mathna wathulatha warubaAAa yazeedu fee alkhalqi ma yashao inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Praise be to Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, Who appointeth the angels messengers having wings two, three and four. He multiplieth in creation what He will. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma yaftahi Allahu lilnnasi min rahmatin fala mumsika laha wama yumsik fala mursila lahu min baAAdihi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That which Allah openeth unto mankind of mercy none can withhold it; and that which He withholdeth none can release thereafter. He is the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnasu othkuroo niAAmata Allahi AAalaykum hal min khaliqin ghayru Allahi yarzuqukum mina alssamai waalardi la ilaha illa huwa faanna tufakoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O mankind! Remember Allah's grace toward you! Is there any creator other than Allah who provideth for you from the sky and the earth? There is no Allah save Him. Whither then are ye turned?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain yukaththibooka faqad kuththibat rusulun min qablika waila Allahi turjaAAu alomooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if they deny thee, (O Muhammad), messengers (of Allah) were denied before thee. Unto Allah all things are brought back.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnasu inna waAAda Allahi haqqun fala taghurrannakumu alhayatu alddunya wala yaghurrannakum biAllahi algharooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O mankind! Lo! the promise of Allah is true. So let not the life of the world beguile you, and let not the (avowed) beguiler beguile you with regard to Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna alshshaytana lakum AAaduwwun faittakhithoohu AAaduwwan innama yadAAoo hizbahu liyakoonoo min ashabi alssaAAeeri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the devil is an enemy for you, so treat him as an enemy. He only summoneth his faction to be owners of the flaming Fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena kafaroo lahum AAathabun shadeedun waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who disbelieve, theirs will be an awful doom; and those who believe and do good works, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaman zuyyina lahu sooo AAamalihi faraahu hasanan fainna Allaha yudillu man yashao wayahdee man yashao fala tathhab nafsuka AAalayhim hasaratin inna Allaha AAaleemun bima yasnaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is he, the evil of whose deeds is made fairseeming unto him so that he deemeth it good, (other than Satan's dupe)? Allah verily sendeth whom He will astray, and guideth whom He will; so let not thy soul expire in sighings for them. Lo! Allah is Aware of what they do!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAllahu allathee arsala alrriyaha fatutheeru sahaban fasuqnahu ila baladin mayyitin faahyayna bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha kathalika alnnushooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah it is Who sendeth the winds and they raise a cloud; then We lead it unto a dead land and revive therewith the earth after its death. Such is the Resurrection.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man kana yureedu alAAizzata falillahi alAAizzatu jameeAAan ilayhi yasAAadu alkalimu alttayyibu waalAAamalu alssalihu yarfaAAuhu waallatheena yamkuroona alssayyiati lahum AAathabun shadeedun wamakru olaika huwa yabooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whoso desireth power (should know that) all power belongeth to Allah. Unto Him good words ascend, and the pious deed doth He exalt; but those who plot iniquities, theirs will be an awful doom; and the plotting of such (folk) will come to naught.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAllahu khalaqakum min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma jaAAalakum azwajan wama tahmilu min ontha wala tadaAAu illa biAAilmihi wama yuAAammaru min muAAammarin wala yunqasu min AAumurihi illa fee kitabin inna thalika AAala Allahi yaseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah created you from dust, then from a little fluid, then He made you pairs (the male and female). No female beareth or bringeth forth save with His knowledge. And no-one groweth old who groweth old, nor is aught lessened of his life, but it is recorded in a Book, Lo! that is easy for Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yastawee albahrani hatha AAathbun furatun saighun sharabuhu wahatha milhun ojajun wamin kullin takuloona lahman tariyyan watastakhrijoona hilyatan talbasoonaha watara alfulka feehi mawakhira litabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the two seas are not alike: this, fresh, sweet, good to drink, this (other) bitter, salt. And from them both ye eat fresh meat and derive the ornament that ye wear. And thou seest the ship cleaving them with its prow that ye may seek of His bounty, and that haply ye may give thanks.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yooliju allayla fee alnnahari wayooliju alnnahara fee allayli wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara kullun yajree liajalin musamman thalikumu Allahu rabbukum lahu almulku waallatheena tadAAoona min doonihi ma yamlikoona min qitmeerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He maketh the night to pass into the day and He maketh the day to pass into the night. He hath subdued the sun and moon to service. Each runneth unto an appointed term. Such is Allah, your Lord; His is the Sovereignty; and those unto whom ye pray instead of Him own not so much as the white spot on a date-stone.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In tadAAoohum la yasmaAAoo duAAaakum walaw samiAAoo ma istajaboo lakum wayawma alqiyamati yakfuroona bishirkikum wala yunabbioka mithlu khabeerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If ye pray unto them they hear not your prayer, and if they heard they could not grant it you. On the Day of Resurrection they will disown association with you. None can inform you like Him Who is Aware.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnasu antumu alfuqarao ila Allahi waAllahu huwa alghaniyyu alhameedu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O mankind! Ye are the poor in your relation to Allah. And Allah! He is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In yasha yuthhibkum wayati bikhalqin jadeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If He will, He can be rid of you and bring (instead of you) some new creation.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama thalika AAala Allahi biAAazeezin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That is not a hard thing for Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra wain tadAAu muthqalatun ila himliha la yuhmal minhu shayon walaw kana tha qurba innama tunthiru allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi waaqamoo alssalata waman tazakka fainnama yatazakka linafsihi waila Allahi almaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And no burdened soul can bear another's burden, and if one heavy laden crieth for (help with) his load, naught of it will be lifted even though he (unto whom he crieth) be of kin. Thou warnest only those who fear their Lord in secret, and have established worship. He who groweth (in goodness), groweth only for himself, (he cannot by his merit redeem others). Unto Allah is the journeying.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yastawee alaAAma waalbaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The blind man is not equal with the seer;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala alththulumatu wala alnnooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nor is darkness (tantamount to) light;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala alththillu wala alharooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nor is the shadow equal with the sun's full heat;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yastawee alahyao wala alamwatu inna Allaha yusmiAAu man yashao wama anta bimusmiAAin man fee alquboori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nor are the living equal with the dead. Lo! Allah maketh whom He will to hear. Thou canst not reach those who are in the graves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In anta illa natheerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thou art but a warner.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna arsalnaka bialhaqqi basheeran wanatheeran wain min ommatin illa khala feeha natheerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have sent thee with the Truth, a bearer of glad tidings and a warner; and there is not a nation but a warner hath passed among them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain yukaththibooka faqad kaththaba allatheena min qablihim jaathum rusuluhum bialbayyinati wabialzzuburi wabialkitabi almuneeri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if they deny thee, those before them also denied. Their messengers came unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), and with the Psalms and the Scripture giving light.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma akhathtu allatheena kafaroo fakayfa kana nakeeri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then seized I those who disbelieved, and how intense was My abhorrence!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi thamaratin mukhtalifan alwanuha wamina aljibali judadun beedun wahumrun mukhtalifun alwanuha wagharabeebu soodun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou not seen that Allah causeth water to fall from the sky, and We produce therewith fruit of divers hues; and among the hills are streaks white and red, of divers hues, and (others) raven-black;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamina alnnasi waalddawabbi waalanAAami mukhtalifun alwanuhu kathalika innama yakhsha Allaha min AAibadihi alAAulamao inna Allaha AAazeezun ghafoorun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of men and beasts and cattle, in like manner, divers hues? The erudite among His bondmen fear Allah alone. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Forgiving.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena yatloona kitaba Allahi waaqamoo alssalata waanfaqoo mimma razaqnahum sirran waAAalaniyatan yarjoona tijaratan lan taboora}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who read the Scripture of Allah, and establish worship, and spend of that which We have bestowed on them secretly and openly, they look forward to imperishable gain,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyuwaffiyahum ojoorahum wayazeedahum min fadlihi innahu ghafoorun shakoorun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That He will pay them their wages and increase them of His grace. Lo! He is Forgiving, Responsive.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallathee awhayna ilayka mina alkitabi huwa alhaqqu musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi inna Allaha biAAibadihi lakhabeerun baseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for that which We inspire in thee of the Scripture, it is the Truth confirming that which was (revealed) before it. Lo! Allah is indeed Observer, Seer of His slaves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma awrathna alkitaba allatheena istafayna min AAibadina faminhum thalimun linafsihi waminhum muqtasidun waminhum sabiqun bialkhayrati biithni Allahi thalika huwa alfadlu alkabeeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We gave the Scripture as inheritance unto those whom We elected of Our bondmen. But of them are some who wrong themselves and of them are some who are lukewarm, and of them are some who outstrip (others) through good deeds, by Allah's leave. That is the great favour!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Jannatu AAadnin yadkhuloonaha yuhallawna feeha min asawira min thahabin waluluan walibasuhum feeha hareerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Gardens of Eden! They enter them wearing armlets of gold and pearl and their raiment therein is silk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo alhamdu lillahi allathee athhaba AAanna alhazana inna rabbana laghafoorun shakoorun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: Praise be to Allah Who hath put grief away from us. Lo! Our Lord is Forgiving, Bountiful,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee ahallana dara almuqamati min fadlihi la yamassuna feeha nasabun wala yamassuna feeha lughoobun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who, of His grace, hath installed us in the mansion of eternity, where toil toucheth us not nor can weariness affect us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena kafaroo lahum naru jahannama la yuqda AAalayhim fayamootoo wala yukhaffafu AAanhum min AAathabiha kathalika najzee kulla kafoorin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But as for those who disbelieve, for them is fire of hell; it taketh not complete effect upon them so that they can die, nor is its torment lightened for them. Thus We punish every ingrate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahum yastarikhoona feeha rabbana akhrijna naAAmal salihan ghayra allathee kunna naAAmalu awalam nuAAammirkum ma yatathakkaru feehi man tathakkara wajaakumu alnnatheeru fathooqoo fama lilththalimeena min naseerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they cry for help there, (saying): Our Lord! Release us; we will do right, not (the wrong) that we used to do. Did not We grant you a life long enough for him who reflected to reflect therein? And the warner came unto you. Now taste (the flavour of your deeds), for evil-doers have no helper.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha AAalimu ghaybi alssamawati waalardi innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah is the Knower of the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. Lo! He is Aware of the secret of (men's) breasts.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa allathee jaAAalakum khalaifa fee alardi faman kafara faAAalayhi kufruhu wala yazeedu alkafireena kufruhum AAinda rabbihim illa maqtan wala yazeedu alkafireena kufruhum illa khasaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who hath made you regents in the earth; so he who disbelieveth, his disbelief be on his own head. Their disbelief increaseth for the disbelievers, in their Lord's sight, naught save abhorrence. Their disbelief increaseth for the disbelievers naught save loss.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul araaytum shurakaakumu allatheena tadAAoona min dooni Allahi aroonee matha khalaqoo mina alardi am lahum shirkun fee alssamawati am ataynahum kitaban fahum AAala bayyinatin minhu bal in yaAAidu alththalimoona baAAduhum baAAdan illa ghurooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Have ye seen your partner-gods to whom ye pray beside Allah? Show me what they created of the earth! Or have they any portion in the heavens? Or have We given them a scripture so they act on clear proof therefrom? Nay, the evil-doers promise one another only to deceive.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha yumsiku alssamawati waalarda an tazoola walain zalata in amsakahuma min ahadin min baAAdihi innahu kana haleeman ghafooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah graspeth the heavens and the earth that they deviate not, and if they were to deviate there is not one that could grasp them after Him. Lo! He is ever Clement, Forgiving.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaqsamoo biAllahi jahda aymanihim lain jaahum natheerun layakoonunna ahda min ihda alomami falamma jaahum natheerun ma zadahum illa nufooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they swore by Allah, their most binding oath, that if a warner came unto them they would be more tractable than any of the nations; yet, when a warner came unto them it aroused in them naught save repugnance,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Istikbaran fee alardi wamakra alssayyii wala yaheequ almakru alssayyio illa biahlihi fahal yanthuroona illa sunnata alawwaleena falan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeelan walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tahweelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Shown in their) behaving arrogantly in the land and plotting evil; and the evil plot encloseth but the men who make it. Then, can they expect aught save the treatment of the folk of old? Thou wilt not find for Allah's way of treatment any substitute, nor wilt thou find for Allah's way of treatment aught of power to change.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim wakanoo ashadda minhum quwwatan wama kana Allahu liyuAAjizahu min shayin fee alssamawati wala fee alardi innahu kana AAaleeman qadeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not travelled in the land and seen the nature of the consequence for those who were before them, and they were mightier than these in power? Allah is not such that aught in the heavens or in the earth escapeth Him. Lo! He is the Wise, the Mighty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[35][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw yuakhithu Allahu alnnasa bima kasaboo ma taraka AAala thahriha min dabbatin walakin yuakhkhiruhum ila ajalin musamman faitha jaa ajaluhum fainna Allaha kana biAAibadihi baseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If Allah took mankind to task by that which they deserve, He would not leave a living creature on the surface of the earth; but He reprieveth them unto an appointed term, and when their term cometh - then verily (they will know that) Allah is ever Seer of His slaves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Ya Sin (Ya Sin)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yaseen}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ya Sin.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalqurani alhakeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By the wise Qur'an,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innaka lamina almursaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thou art of those sent}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAala siratin mustaqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On a straight path,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tanzeela alAAazeezi alrraheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Litunthira qawman ma onthira abaohum fahum ghafiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That thou mayst warn a folk whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad haqqa alqawlu AAala aktharihim fahum la yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Already hath the judgment, (for their infidelity) proved true of most of them, for they believe not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna jaAAalna fee aAAnaqihim aghlalan fahiya ila alathqani fahum muqmahoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have put on their necks carcans reaching unto the chins, so that they are made stiff-necked.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalna min bayni aydeehim saddan wamin khalfihim saddan faaghshaynahum fahum la yubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We have set a bar before them and a bar behind them, and (thus) have covered them so that they see not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wasawaon AAalayhim aanthartahum am lam tunthirhum la yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not, it is alike for them, for they believe not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama tunthiru mani ittabaAAa alththikra wakhashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi fabashshirhu bimaghfiratin waajrin kareemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thou warnest only him who followeth the Reminder and feareth the Beneficent in secret. To him bear tidings of forgiveness and a rich reward.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna nahnu nuhyee almawta wanaktubu ma qaddamoo waatharahum wakulla shayin ahsaynahu fee imamin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We it is Who bring the dead to life. We record that which they send before (them, and their footprints. And all things We have kept in a clear Register.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waidrib lahum mathalan ashaba alqaryati ith jaaha almursaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Coin for them a similitude: The people of the city when those sent (from Allah) came unto them;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith arsalna ilayhimu ithnayni fakaththaboohuma faAAazzazna bithalithin faqaloo inna ilaykum mursaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ma antum illa basharun mithluna wama anzala alrrahmanu min shayin in antum illa takthiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Ye are but mortals like unto us. The Beneficent hath naught revealed. Ye do but lie!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo rabbuna yaAAlamu inna ilaykum lamursaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama AAalayna illa albalaghu almubeenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And our duty is but plain conveyance (of the message).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo inna tatayyarna bikum lain lam tantahoo lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minna AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (The people of the city) said: We augur ill of you. If ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and grievous torture will befall you at our hands.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo tairukum maAAakum ain thukkirtum bal antum qawmun musrifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Your evil augury be with you! Is it because ye are reminded (of the truth)? Nay, but ye are froward folk!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajaa min aqsa almadeenati rajulun yasAAa qala ya qawmi ittabiAAoo almursaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{IttabiAAoo man la yasalukum ajran wahum muhtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama liya la aAAbudu allathee fataranee wailayhi turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aattakhithu min doonihi alihatan in yuridni alrrahmanu bidurrin la tughni AAannee shafaAAatuhum shayan wala yunqithooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Shall I take (other) gods in place of Him when, if the Beneficent should wish me any harm, their intercession will avail me naught, nor can they save?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innee ithan lafee dalalin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then truly I should be in error manifest.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innee amantu birabbikum faismaAAooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! I have believed in your Lord, so hear me!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qeela odkhuli aljannata qala ya layta qawmee yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It was said (unto him): Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bima ghafara lee rabbee wajaAAalanee mina almukrameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} With what (munificence) my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama anzalna AAala qawmihi min baAAdihi min jundin mina alssamai wama kunna munzileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We sent not down against his people after him a host from heaven, nor do We ever send.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum khamidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It was but one Shout, and lo! they were extinct.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya hasratan AAala alAAibadi ma yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ah, the anguish for the bondmen! Never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam yaraw kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni annahum ilayhim la yarjiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, which indeed returned not unto them;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain kullun lamma jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But all, without exception, will be brought before Us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waayatun lahumu alardu almaytatu ahyaynaha waakhrajna minha habban faminhu yakuloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A token unto them is the dead earth. We revive it, and We bring forth from it grain so that they eat thereof;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalna feeha jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin wafajjarna feeha mina alAAuyooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We have placed therein gardens of the date-palm and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyakuloo min thamarihi wama AAamilathu aydeehim afala yashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Subhana allathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha mimma tunbitu alardu wamin anfusihim wamimma la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Glory be to Him Who created all the sexual pairs, of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waayatun lahumu allaylu naslakhu minhu alnnahara faitha hum muthlimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A token unto them is night. We strip it of the day, and lo! they are in darkness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalshshamsu tajree limustaqarrin laha thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the sun runneth on unto a resting-place for him. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalqamara qaddarnahu manazila hatta AAada kaalAAurjooni alqadeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La alshshamsu yanbaghee laha an tudrika alqamara wala allaylu sabiqu alnnahari wakullun fee falakin yasbahoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waayatun lahum anna hamalna thurriyyatahum fee alfulki almashhooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakhalaqna lahum min mithlihi ma yarkaboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain nasha nughriqhum fala sareekha lahum wala hum yunqathoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa rahmatan minna wamataAAan ila heenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha qeela lahumu ittaqoo ma bayna aydeekum wama khalfakum laAAallakum turhamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama tateehim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanoo AAanha muAArideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Never came a token of the tokens of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha qeela lahum anfiqoo mimma razaqakumu Allahu qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo anutAAimu man law yashao Allahu atAAamahu in antum illa fee dalalin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma yanthuroona illa sayhatan wahidatan takhuthuhum wahum yakhissimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala yastateeAAoona tawsiyatan wala ila ahlihim yarjiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanufikha fee alssoori faitha hum mina alajdathi ila rabbihim yansiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya waylana man baAAathana min marqadina hatha ma waAAada alrrahmanu wasadaqa almursaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalyawma la tuthlamu nafsun shayan wala tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna ashaba aljannati alyawma fee shughulin fakihoona}}
