\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hum waazwajuhum fee thilalin AAala alaraiki muttakioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahum feeha fakihatun walahum ma yaddaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Salamun qawlan min rabbin raheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waimtazoo alyawma ayyuha almujrimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam aAAhad ilaykum ya banee adama an la taAAbudoo alshshaytana innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe! -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waani oAAbudoonee hatha siratun mustaqeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But that ye worship Me? That was the right path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad adalla minkum jibillan katheeran afalam takoonoo taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hathihi jahannamu allatee kuntum tooAAadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Islawha alyawma bima kuntum takfuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alyawma nakhtimu AAala afwahihim watukallimuna aydeehim watashhadu arjuluhum bima kanoo yaksiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw nashao latamasna AAala aAAyunihim faistabaqoo alssirata faanna yubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight so that they should struggle for the way. Then how could they have seen?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw nashao lamasakhnahum AAala makanatihim fama istataAAoo mudiyyan wala yarjiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place, making them powerless to go forward or turn back.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman nuAAammirhu nunakkishu fee alkhalqi afala yaAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama AAallamnahu alshshiAAra wama yanbaghee lahu in huwa illa thikrun waquranun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyunthira man kana hayyan wayahiqqa alqawlu AAala alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yaraw anna khalaqna lahum mimma AAamilat aydeena anAAaman fahum laha malikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wathallalnaha lahum faminha rakoobuhum waminha yakuloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walahum feeha manafiAAu wamasharibu afala yashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan laAAallahum yunsaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yastateeAAoona nasrahum wahum lahum jundun muhdaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala yahzunka qawluhum inna naAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yara alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wadaraba lana mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qala man yuhyee alAAithama wahiya rameemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul yuhyeeha allathee anshaaha awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee jaAAala lakum mina alshshajari alakhdari naran faitha antum minhu tooqidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalaysa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda biqadirin AAala an yakhluqa mithlahum bala wahuwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama amruhu itha arada shayan an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoonu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[36][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasubhana allathee biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wailayhi turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{As-Saffat (Those Ranging in Ranks)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalssaffati saffan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By those who set the ranks in battle order}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalzzajirati zajran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalttaliyati thikran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who read (the Word) for a reminder,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna ilahakum lawahidun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thy Lord is surely One;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma warabbu almashariqi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bizeenatin alkawakibi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahifthan min kulli shaytanin maridin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} With security from every froward devil.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yassammaAAoona ila almalai alaAAla wayuqthafoona min kulli janibin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Duhooran walahum AAathabun wasibun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa man khatifa alkhatfata faatbaAAahu shihabun thaqibun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faistaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqna inna khalaqnahum min teenin lazibin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal AAajibta wayaskharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha thukkiroo la yathkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And heed not when they are reminded,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha raaw ayatan yastaskhiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And seek to scoff when they behold a portent.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: Lo! this is mere magic;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awaabaona alawwaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And our forefathers?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul naAAam waantum dakhiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun faitha hum yanthuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo ya waylana hatha yawmu alddeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha yawmu alfasli allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ohshuroo allatheena thalamoo waazwajahum wama kanoo yaAAbudoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Min dooni Allahi faihdoohum ila sirati aljaheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqifoohum innahum masooloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And stop them, for they must be questioned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma lakum la tanasaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} What aileth you that ye help not one another?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal humu alyawma mustaslimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but this day they make full submission.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo innakum kuntum tatoonana AAani alyameeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo bal lam takoonoo mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama kana lana AAalaykum min sultanin bal kuntum qawman tagheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fahaqqa AAalayna qawlu rabbina inna lathaiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faaghwaynakum inna kunna ghaweena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fainnahum yawmaithin fee alAAathabi mushtarikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna kathalika nafAAalu bialmujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thus deal We with the guilty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahum kanoo itha qeela lahum la ilaha illa Allahu yastakbiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayaqooloona ainna latarikoo alihatina lishaAAirin majnoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal jaa bialhaqqi wasaddaqa almursaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innakum lathaiqoo alAAathabi alaleemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ye are requited naught save what ye did -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save single-minded slaves of Allah;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika lahum rizqun maAAloomun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For them there is a known provision,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fawakihu wahum mukramoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Fruits. And they will be honoured}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee jannati alnnaAAeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In the Gardens of delight,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAala sururin mutaqabileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On couches facing one another;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yutafu AAalayhim bikasin min maAAeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Baydaa laththatin lilshsharibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} White, delicious to the drinkers,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La feeha ghawlun wala hum AAanha yunzafoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAindahum qasiratu alttarfi AAeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaannahunna baydun maknoonun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala qailun minhum innee kana lee qareenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yaqoolu ainnaka lamina almusaddiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamadeenoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala hal antum muttaliAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He saith: Will ye look?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaittalaAAa faraahu fee sawai aljaheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala taAllahi in kidta laturdeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walawla niAAmatu rabbee lakuntu mina almuhdareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afama nahnu bimayyiteena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Are we then not to die}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa mawtatana aloola wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna hatha lahuwa alfawzu alAAatheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! this is the supreme triumph.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Limithli hatha falyaAAmali alAAamiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For the like of this, then, let the workers work.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Athalika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu alzzaqqoomi}}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna jaAAalnaha fitnatan lilththalimeena}}

\quranayah[37][64]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innaha shajaratun takhruju fee asli aljaheemi}}

\end{Arabic}}

\quranayah[37][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma inna marjiAAahum laila aljaheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell.}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahum alfaw abaahum dalleena}}

\quranayah[37][70]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fahum AAala atharihim yuhraAAoona}}

\quranayah[37][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad arsalna feehim munthireena}}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena}}

\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu min AAibadina almumineena}}

\quranayah[37][83]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faaradoo bihi kaydan fajaAAalnahumu alasfaleena}}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast.}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][109]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Salamun AAala ibraheema}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][110]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kathalika najzee almuhsineena}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][111]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu min AAibadina almumineena}}

\quranayah[37][114]

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watarakna AAalayhima fee alakhireena}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][120]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Salamun AAala moosa waharoona}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][121]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thus do We reward the good.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][122]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahuma min AAibadina almumineena}}

\quranayah[37][123]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna ilyasa lamina almursaleena}}

\quranayah[37][124]

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][125]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AtadAAoona baAAlan watatharoona ahsana alkhaliqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Will ye cry unto Baal and forsake the Best of creators,}

\quranayah[37][126]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allaha rabbakum warabba abaikumu alawwaleena}}

\quranayah[37][127]

\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][128]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save single-minded slaves of Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][129]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watarakna AAalayhi fee alakhireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation):}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][130]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Salamun AAala il yaseena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Peace be unto Elias!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][131]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thus do We reward the good.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][132]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu min AAibadina almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! he is one of our believing slaves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][133]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna lootan lamina almursaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][134]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith najjaynahu waahlahu ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When We saved him and his household, every one,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][135]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa AAajoozan fee alghabireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save an old woman among those who stayed behind;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][136]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma dammarna alakhareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We destroyed the others.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][137]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnakum latamurroona AAalayhim musbiheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! ye verily pass by (the ruin of) them in the morning}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][138]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wabiallayli afala taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And at night-time; have ye then no sense?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][139]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna yoonusa lamina almursaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][140]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith abaqa ila alfulki almashhooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When he fled unto the laden ship,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][141]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasahama fakana mina almudhadeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And then drew lots and was of those rejected;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][142]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Failtaqamahu alhootu wahuwa muleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][143]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falawla annahu kana mina almusabbiheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][144]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lalabitha fee batnihi ila yawmi yubAAathoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He would have tarried in its belly till the day when they are raised;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][145]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fanabathnahu bialAAarai wahuwa saqeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][146]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanbatna AAalayhi shajaratan min yaqteenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][147]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waarsalnahu ila miati alfin aw yazeedoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][148]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faamanoo famattaAAnahum ila heenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][149]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faistaftihim alirabbika albanatu walahumu albanoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Now ask them (O Muhammad): Hath thy Lord daughters whereas they have sons?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][150]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am khalaqna almalaikata inathan wahum shahidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or created We the angels females while they were present?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][151]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ala innahum min ifkihim layaqooloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! it is of their falsehood that they say:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][152]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walada Allahu wainnahum lakathiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah hath begotten. Allah! verily they tell a lie.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][153]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Astafa albanati AAala albaneena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][154]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma lakum kayfa tahkumoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} What aileth you? How judge ye?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][155]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afala tathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Will ye not then reflect?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][156]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am lakum sultanun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or have ye a clear warrant?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][157]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatoo bikitabikum in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][158]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAaloo baynahu wabayna aljinnati nasaban walaqad AAalimati aljinnatu innahum lamuhdaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][159]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Subhana Allahi AAamma yasifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Glorified be Allah from that which they attribute (unto Him),}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][160]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save single-minded slaves of Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][161]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fainnakum wama taAAbudoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! verily, ye and that which ye worship,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][162]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma antum AAalayhi bifatineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ye cannot excite (anyone) against Him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][163]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa man huwa sali aljaheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save him who is to burn in hell.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][164]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama minna illa lahu maqamun maAAloomun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There is not one of us but hath his known position.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][165]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna lanahnu alssaffoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][166]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna lanahnu almusabbihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! we, even we are they who hymn His praise}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][167]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain kanoo layaqooloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And indeed they used to say:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][168]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Law anna AAindana thikran mina alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If we had but a reminder from the men of old}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][169]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lakunna AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We would be single-minded slaves of Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][170]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakafaroo bihi fasawfa yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][171]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad sabaqat kalimatuna liAAibadina almursaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][172]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahum lahumu almansooroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That they verily would be helped,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][173]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna jundana lahumu alghaliboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that Our host, they verily would be the victors.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][174]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatawalla AAanhum hatta heenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][175]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waabsirhum fasawfa yubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And watch, for they will (soon) see.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][176]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AfabiAAathabina yastaAAjiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Would they hasten on Our doom?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][177]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha nazala bisahatihim fasaa sabahu almunthareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][178]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watawalla AAanhum hatta heenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Withdraw from them awhile}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][179]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waabsir fasawfa yubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And watch, for they will (soon) see.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][180]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Subhana rabbika rabbi alAAizzati AAamma yasifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][181]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wasalamun AAala almursaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And peace be unto those sent (to warn).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[37][182]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalhamdu lillahi rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Sad (Sad)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sad waalqurani thee alththikri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Sad. By the renowned Qur'an,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bali allatheena kafaroo fee AAizzatin washiqaqin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but those who disbelieve are in false pride and schism.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin fanadaw walata heena manasin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How many a generation We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum waqala alkafiroona hatha sahirun kaththabun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AjaAAala alalihata ilahan wahidan inna hatha lashayon AAujabun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Maketh he the gods One Allah? Lo! that is an astounding thing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waintalaqa almalao minhum ani imshoo waisbiroo AAala alihatikum inna hatha lashayon yuradu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The chiefs among them go about, exhorting: Go and be staunch to your gods! Lo! this is a thing designed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma samiAAna bihatha fee almillati alakhirati in hatha illa ikhtilaqun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We have not heard of this in later religion. This is naught but an invention.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aonzila AAalayhi alththikru min baynina bal hum fee shakkin min thikree bal lamma yathooqoo AAathabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hath the reminder been unto him (alone) among us? Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My reminder; nay but they have not yet tasted My doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am AAindahum khazainu rahmati rabbika alAAazeezi alwahhabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am lahum mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma falyartaqoo fee alasbabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs? Then let them ascend by ropes!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Jundun ma hunalika mahzoomun mina alahzabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A defeated host are (all) the factions that are there.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waAAadun wafirAAawnu thoo alawtadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The folk of Noah before them denied (their messenger) and (so did the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh firmly planted,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wathamoodu waqawmu lootin waashabu alaykati olaika alahzabu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (the tribe of) Thamud, and the folk of Lot, and the dwellers in the wood: these were the factions.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In kullun illa kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa AAiqabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Not one of them but did deny the messengers, therefor My doom was justified,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yanthuru haolai illa sayhatan wahidatan ma laha min fawaqin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} These wait for but one Shout, there will be no second thereto.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo rabbana AAajjil lana qittana qabla yawmi alhisabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They say: Our Lord! Hasten on for us our fate before the Day of Reckoning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Isbir AAala ma yaqooloona waothkur AAabdana dawooda tha alaydi innahu awwabun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Bear with what they say, and remember Our bondman David, lord of might, Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna sakhkharna aljibala maAAahu yusabbihna bialAAashiyyi waalishraqi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalttayra mahshooratan kullun lahu awwabun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Washadadna mulkahu waataynahu alhikmata wafasla alkhitabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We made his kingdom strong and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahal ataka nabao alkhasmi ith tasawwaroo almihraba}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And hath the story of the litigants come unto thee? How they climbed the wall into the royal chamber;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith dakhaloo AAala dawooda fafaziAAa minhum qaloo la takhaf khasmani bagha baAAduna AAala baAAdin faohkum baynana bialhaqqi wala tushtit waihdina ila sawai alssirati}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How they burst in upon David, and he was afraid of them. They said: Be not afraid! (We are) two litigants, one of whom hath wronged the other, therefor judge aright between us; be not unjust; and show us the fair way.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna hatha akhee lahu tisAAun watisAAoona naAAjatan waliya naAAjatun wahidatun faqala akfilneeha waAAazzanee fee alkhitabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! this my brother hath ninety and nine ewes while I had one ewe; and he said: Entrust it to me, and he conquered me in speech.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala laqad thalamaka bisuali naAAjatika ila niAAajihi wainna katheeran mina alkhulatai layabghee baAAduhum AAala baAAdin illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati waqaleelun ma hum wathanna dawoodu annama fatannahu faistaghfara rabbahu wakharra rakiAAan waanaba}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (David) said: He hath wronged thee in demanding thine ewe in addition to his ewes, and lo! many partners oppress one another, save such as believe and do good works, and they are few. And David guessed that We had tried him, and he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he bowed himself and fell down prostrate and repented.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faghafarna lahu thalika wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So We forgave him that; and lo! he had access to Our presence and a happy journey's end.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya dawoodu inna jaAAalnaka khaleefatan fee alardi faohkum bayna alnnasi bialhaqqi wala tattabiAAi alhawa fayudillaka AAan sabeeli Allahi inna allatheena yadilloona AAan sabeeli Allahi lahum AAathabun shadeedun bima nasoo yawma alhisabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And it was said unto him): O David! Lo! We have set thee as a viceroy in the earth; therefor judge aright between mankind, and follow not desire that it beguile thee from the way of Allah. Lo! those who wander from the way of Allah have an awful doom, forasmuch as they forgot the Day of Reckoning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma batilan thalika thannu allatheena kafaroo fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo mina alnnari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the opinion of those who disbelieve. And woe unto those who disbelieve, from the Fire!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am najAAalu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati kaalmufsideena fee alardi am najAAalu almuttaqeena kaalfujjari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Shall We treat those who believe and do good works as those who spread corruption in the earth; or shall We treat the pious as the wicked?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kitabun anzalnahu ilayka mubarakun liyaddabbaroo ayatihi waliyatathakkara oloo alalbabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (This is) a Scripture that We have revealed unto thee, full of blessing, that they may ponder its revelations, and that men of understanding may reflect.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wawahabna lidawooda sulaymana niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We bestowed on David, Solomon. How excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith AAurida AAalayhi bialAAashiyyi alssafinatu aljiyadu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When there were shown to him at eventide lightfooted coursers}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqala innee ahbabtu hubba alkhayri AAan thikri rabbee hatta tawarat bialhijabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he said: Lo! I have preferred the good things (of the world) to the remembrance of my Lord; till they were taken out of sight behind the curtain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ruddooha AAalayya fatafiqa mashan bialssooqi waalaAAnaqi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Then he said): Bring them back to me, and fell to slashing (with his sword their) legs and necks.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad fatanna sulaymana waalqayna AAala kursiyyihi jasadan thumma anaba}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We tried Solomon, and set upon his throne a (mere) body. Then did he repent.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi ighfir lee wahab lee mulkan la yanbaghee liahadin min baAAdee innaka anta alwahhabu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me sovereignty such as shall not belong to any after me. Lo! Thou art the Bestower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasakhkharna lahu alrreeha tajree biamrihi rukhaan haythu asaba}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So We made the wind subservient unto him, setting fair by his command whithersoever he intended.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalshshayateena kulla bannain waghawwasin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the unruly, every builder and diver (made We subservient),}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waakhareena muqarraneena fee alasfadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And others linked together in chains,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha AAataona faomnun aw amsik bighayri hisabin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Saying): This is Our gift, so bestow thou, or withhold, without reckoning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! he hath favour with Us, and a happy journey's end.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waothkur AAabdana ayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alshshaytanu binusbin waAAathabin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And make mention (O Muhammad) of Our bondman Job, when he cried unto his Lord (saying): Lo! the devil doth afflict me with distress and torment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Orkud birijlika hatha mughtasalun baridun washarabun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And it was said unto him): Strike the ground with thy foot. This (spring) is a cool bath and a refreshing drink.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wawahabna lahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan minna wathikra liolee alalbabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We bestowed on him (again) his household and therewith the like thereof, a mercy from Us, and a memorial for men of understanding.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakhuth biyadika dighthan faidrib bihi wala tahnath inna wajadnahu sabiran niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (it was said unto him): Take in thine hand a branch and smite therewith, and break not thine oath. Lo! We found him steadfast, how excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (to his Lord).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waothkur AAibadana ibraheema waishaqa wayaAAqooba olee alaydee waalabsari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And make mention of Our bondmen, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of parts and vision.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna akhlasnahum bikhalisatin thikra alddari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We purified them with a pure thought, remembrance of the Home (of the Hereafter).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnahum AAindana lamina almustafayna alakhyari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! in Our sight they are verily of the elect, the excellent.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waothkur ismaAAeela wailyasaAAa watha alkifli wakullun mina alakhyari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And make mention of Ishmael and Elisha and Dhu'l-Kifl. All are of the chosen.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha thikrun wainna lilmuttaqeena lahusna maabin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is a reminder. And lo! for those who ward off (evil) is a happy journey's end,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Jannati AAadnin mufattahatan lahumu alabwabu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Gardens of Eden, whereof the gates are opened for them,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Muttakieena feeha yadAAoona feeha bifakihatin katheeratin washarabin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Wherein, reclining, they call for plenteous fruit and cool drink (that is) therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAindahum qasiratu alttarfi atrabun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And with them are those of modest gaze, companions.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha ma tooAAadoona liyawmi alhisabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This it is that ye are promised for the Day of Reckoning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna hatha larizquna ma lahu min nafadin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! this in truth is Our provision, which will never waste away.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha wainna lilttagheena lasharra maabin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This (is for the righteous). And lo! for the transgressors there with be an evil journey's end,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Jahannama yaslawnaha fabisa almihadu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hell, where they will burn, an evil resting-place.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha falyathooqoohu hameemun waghassaqun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Here is a boiling and an ice-cold draught, so let them taste it,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waakharu min shaklihi azwajun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And other (torment) of the kind in pairs (the two extremes)!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha fawjun muqtahimun maAAakum la marhaban bihim innahum saloo alnnari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Here is an army rushing blindly with you. (Those who are already in the Fire say): No word of welcome for them. Lo! they will roast at the Fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo bal antum la marhaban bikum antum qaddamtumoohu lana fabisa alqararu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They say: Nay, but you (misleaders), for you there is no word of welcome. Ye prepared this for us (by your misleading). Now hapless is the plight.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo rabbana man qaddama lana hatha fazidhu AAathaban diAAfan fee alnnari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They say: Our Lord! Whoever did prepare this for us, oh, give him double portion of the Fire!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo ma lana la nara rijalan kunna naAAudduhum mina alashrari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: What aileth us that we behold not men whom we were wont to count among the wicked?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Attakhathnahum sikhriyyan am zaghat AAanhumu alabsaru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Did we take them (wrongly) for a laughing-stock, or have our eyes missed them?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna thalika lahaqqun takhasumu ahli alnnari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! that is very truth: the wrangling of the dwellers in the Fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul innama ana munthirun wama min ilahin illa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I am only a warner, and there is no Allah save Allah, the One, the Absolute,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alAAazeezu alghaffaru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Mighty, the Pardoning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul huwa nabaon AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: It is tremendous tidings}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Antum AAanhu muAAridoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whence ye turn away!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma kana liya min AAilmin bialmalai alaAAla ith yakhtasimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} I had no knowledge of the Highest Chiefs when they disputed;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In yooha ilayya illa annama ana natheerun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is revealed unto me only that I may be a plain warner.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min teenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to create a mortal out of mire,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when I have fashioned him and breathed into him of My Spirit, then fall down before him prostrate,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The angels fell down prostrate, every one,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa ibleesa istakbara wakana mina alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Saving Iblis; he was scornful and became one of the disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya ibleesu ma manaAAaka an tasjuda lima khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina alAAaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O Iblis! What hindereth thee from falling prostrate before that which I have created with both My hands? Art thou too proud or art thou of the high exalted?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ana khayrun minhu khalaqtanee min narin wakhalaqtahu min teenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: I am better than him. Thou createdst me of fire, whilst him Thou didst create of clay.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Go forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna AAalayka laAAnatee ila yawmi alddeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! My curse is on thee till the Day of Judgment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Lo! thou art of those reprieved}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Until the day of the time appointed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala fabiAAizzatika laoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: Then, by Thy might, I surely will beguile them every one,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena}}
