\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save Thy single-minded slaves among them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala faalhaqqu waalhaqqa aqoolu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: The Truth is, and the Truth I speak,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laamlaanna jahannama minka wamimman tabiAAaka minhum ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That I shall fill hell with thee and with such of them as follow thee, together.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ma asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin wama ana mina almutakallifeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee for this, and I am no simulating.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! it is naught else than a reminder for all peoples}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[38][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WalataAAlamunna nabaahu baAAda heenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And ye will come in time to know the truth thereof.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Az-Zumar (The Companies)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna anzalna ilayka alkitaba bialhaqqi faoAAbudi Allaha mukhlisan lahu alddeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have revealed the Scripture unto thee (Muhammad) with truth; so worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ala lillahi alddeenu alkhalisu waallatheena ittakhathoo min doonihi awliyaa ma naAAbuduhum illa liyuqarriboona ila Allahi zulfa inna Allaha yahkumu baynahum fee ma hum feehi yakhtalifoona inna Allaha la yahdee man huwa kathibun kaffarun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Surely pure religion is for Allah only. And those who choose protecting friends beside Him (say): We worship them only that they may bring us near unto Allah. Lo! Allah will judge between them concerning that wherein they differ. Lo! Allah guideth not him who is a liar, an ingrate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Law arada Allahu an yattakhitha waladan laistafa mimma yakhluqu ma yashao subhanahu huwa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If Allah had willed to choose a son, He could have chosen what He would of that which He hath created. Be He Glorified! He is Allah, the One, the Absolute.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi yukawwiru allayla AAala alnnahari wayukawwiru alnnahara AAala allayli wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara kullun yajree liajalin musamman ala huwa alAAazeezu alghaffaru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. He maketh night to succeed day, and He maketh day to succeed night, and He constraineth the sun and the moon to give service, each running on for an appointed term. Is not He the Mighty, the Forgiver?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin thumma jaAAala minha zawjaha waanzala lakum mina alanAAami thamaniyata azwajin yakhluqukum fee butooni ommahatikum khalqan min baAAdi khalqin fee thulumatin thalathin thalikumu Allahu rabbukum lahu almulku la ilaha illa huwa faanna tusrafoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He created you from one being, then from that (being) He made its mate; and He hath provided for you of cattle eight kinds. He created you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, in a threefold gloom. Such is Allah, your Lord. His is the Sovereignty. There is no Allah save Him. How then are ye turned away?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In takfuroo fainna Allaha ghaniyyun AAankum wala yarda liAAibadihi alkufra wain tashkuroo yardahu lakum wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra thumma ila rabbikum marjiAAukum fayunabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If ye are thankless, yet Allah is Independent of you, though He is not pleased with thanklessness for His bondmen; and if ye are thankful He is pleased therewith for you. No laden soul will bear another's load. Then unto your Lord is your return; and He will tell you what ye used to do. Lo! He knoweth what is in the breasts (of men).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha massa alinsana durrun daAAa rabbahu muneeban ilayhi thumma itha khawwalahu niAAmatan minhu nasiya ma kana yadAAoo ilayhi min qablu wajaAAala lillahi andadan liyudilla AAan sabeelihi qul tamattaAA bikufrika qaleelan innaka min ashabi alnnari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when some hurt toucheth man, he crieth unto his Lord, turning unto Him (repentant). Then, when He granteth him a boon from Him he forgetteth that for which he cried unto Him before, and setteth up rivals to Allah that he may beguile (men) from his way. Say (O Muhammad, unto such an one): Take pleasure in thy disbelief a while. Lo! thou art of the owners of the Fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Amman huwa qanitun anaa allayli sajidan waqaiman yahtharu alakhirata wayarjoo rahmata rabbihi qul hal yastawee allatheena yaAAlamoona waallatheena la yaAAlamoona innama yatathakkaru oloo alalbabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is he who payeth adoration in the watches of the night, prostrate and standing, bewaring of the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, (to be accounted equal with a disbeliever)? Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Are those who know equal with those who know not? But only men of understanding will pay heed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ya AAibadi allatheena amanoo ittaqoo rabbakum lillatheena ahsanoo fee hathihi alddunya hasanatun waardu Allahi wasiAAatun innama yuwaffa alssabiroona ajrahum bighayri hisabin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: O My bondmen who believe! Observe your duty to your Lord. For those who do good in this world there is good, and Allah's earth is spacious. Verily the steadfast will be paid their wages without stint.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul innee omirtu an aAAbuda Allaha mukhlisan lahu alddeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad): Lo! I am commanded to worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waomirtu lian akoona awwala almuslimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And I am commanded to be the first of those who are muslims (surrender unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul innee akhafu in AAasaytu rabbee AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Lo! if I should disobey my Lord, I fear the doom of a tremendous Day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Quli Allaha aAAbudu mukhlisan lahu deenee}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Allah I worship, making my religion pure for Him (only).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaoAAbudoo ma shitum min doonihi qul inna alkhasireena allatheena khasiroo anfusahum waahleehim yawma alqiyamati ala thalika huwa alkhusranu almubeenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then worship what ye will beside Him. Say: The losers will be those who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Ah, that will be the manifest loss!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahum min fawqihim thulalun mina alnnari wamin tahtihim thulalun thalika yukhawwifu Allahu bihi AAibadahu ya AAibadi faittaqooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They have an awning of fire above them and beneath them a dais (of fire). With this doth Allah appal His bondmen. O My bondmen, therefor fear Me!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena ijtanaboo alttaghoota an yaAAbudooha waanaboo ila Allahi lahumu albushra fabashshir AAibadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who put away false gods lest they should worship them and turn to Allah in repentance, for them there are glad tidings. Therefor give good tidings (O Muhammad) to My bondmen}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yastamiAAoona alqawla fayattabiAAoona ahsanahu olaika allatheena hadahumu Allahu waolaika hum oloo alalbabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who hear advice and follow the best thereof. Such are those whom Allah guideth, and such are men of understanding.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaman haqqa AAalayhi kalimatu alAAathabi afaanta tunqithu man fee alnnari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is he on whom the word of doom is fulfilled (to be helped), and canst thou (O Muhammad) rescue him who is in the Fire?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lakini allatheena ittaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafun min fawqiha ghurafun mabniyyatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu waAAda Allahi la yukhlifu Allahu almeeAAada}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But those who keep their duty to their Lord, for them are lofty halls with lofty halls above them, built (for them), beneath which rivers flow. (It is) a promise of Allah. Allah faileth not His promise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina alssamai maan fasalakahu yanabeeAAa fee alardi thumma yukhriju bihi zarAAan mukhtalifan alwanuhu thumma yaheeju fatarahu musfarran thumma yajAAaluhu hutaman inna fee thalika lathikra liolee alalbabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou not seen how Allah hath sent down water from the sky and hath caused it to penetrate the earth as watersprings, and afterward thereby produceth crops of divers hues; and afterward they wither and thou seest them turn yellow; then He maketh them chaff. Lo! herein verily is a reminder for men of understanding.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaman sharaha Allahu sadrahu lilislami fahuwa AAala noorin min rabbihi fawaylun lilqasiyati quloobuhum min thikri Allahi olaika fee dalalin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is he whose bosom Allah hath expanded for Al-Islam, so that he followeth a light from his Lord, (as he who disbelieveth)? Then woe unto those whose hearts are hardened against remembrance of Allah. Such are in plain error.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu nazzala ahsana alhadeethi kitaban mutashabihan mathaniya taqshaAAirru minhu juloodu allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum thumma taleenu julooduhum waquloobuhum ila thikri Allahi thalika huda Allahi yahdee bihi man yashao waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah hath (now) revealed the fairest of statements, a Scripture consistent, (wherein promises of reward are) paired (with threats of punishment), whereat doth creep the flesh of those who fear their Lord, so that their flesh and their hearts soften to Allah's reminder. Such is Allah's guidance, wherewith He guideth whom He will. And him whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaman yattaqee biwajhihi sooa alAAathabi yawma alqiyamati waqeela lilththalimeena thooqoo ma kuntum taksiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is he then, who will strike his face against the awful doom upon the Day of Resurrection (as he who doeth right)? And it will be said unto the wrong-doers: Taste what ye used to earn.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaththaba allatheena min qablihim faatahumu alAAathabu min haythu la yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those before them denied, and so the doom came on them whence they knew not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faathaqahumu Allahu alkhizya fee alhayati alddunya walaAAathabu alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus Allah made them taste humiliation in the life of the world, and verily the doom of the Hereafter will be greater if they did but know.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad darabna lilnnasi fee hatha alqurani min kulli mathalin laAAallahum yatathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We have coined for mankind in this Qur'an all kinds of similitudes, that haply they may reflect;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Quranan AAarabiyyan ghayra thee AAiwajin laAAallahum yattaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A Lecture in Arabic, containing no crookedness, that haply they may ward off (evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Daraba Allahu mathalan rajulan feehi shurakao mutashakisoona warajulan salaman lirajulin hal yastawiyani mathalan alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah coineth a similitude: A man in relation to whom are several part-owners, quarrelling, and a man belonging wholly to one man. Are the two equal in similitude? Praise be to Allah! But most of them know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innaka mayyitun wainnahum mayyitoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thou wilt die, and lo! they will die;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma innakum yawma alqiyamati AAinda rabbikum takhtasimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord ye will dispute.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faman athlamu mimman kathaba AAala Allahi wakaththaba bialssidqi ith jaahu alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And who doth greater wrong than he who telleth a lie against Allah, and denieth the truth when it reacheth him? Will not the home of disbelievers be in hell?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallathee jaa bialssidqi wasaddaqa bihi olaika humu almuttaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whoso bringeth the truth and believeth therein - Such are the dutiful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahum ma yashaoona AAinda rabbihim thalika jazao almuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They shall have what they will of their Lord's bounty. That is the reward of the good:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyukaffira Allahu AAanhum aswaa allathee AAamiloo wayajziyahum ajrahum biahsani allathee kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That Allah will remit from them the worst of what they did, and will pay them for reward the best they used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alaysa Allahu bikafin AAabdahu wayukhawwifoonaka biallatheena min doonihi waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Will not Allah defend His slave? Yet they would frighten thee with those beside Him. He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman yahdi Allahu fama lahu min mudillin alaysa Allahu biAAazeezin thee intiqamin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he whom Allah guideth, for him there can be no misleader. Is not Allah Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna Allahu qul afaraaytum ma tadAAoona min dooni Allahi in aradaniya Allahu bidurrin hal hunna kashifatu durrihi aw aradanee birahmatin hal hunna mumsikatu rahmatihi qul hasbiya Allahu AAalayhi yatawakkalu almutawakkiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily, if thou shouldst ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth? they will say: Allah. Say: Bethink you then of those ye worship beside Allah, if Allah willed some hurt for me, could they remove from me His hurt; or if He willed some mercy for me, could they restrain His mercy? Say: Allah is my all. In Him do (all) the trusting put their trust.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ya qawmi iAAmaloo AAala makanatikum innee AAamilun fasawfa taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: O my people! Act in your manner. Lo! I (too) am acting. Thus ye will come to know}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man yateehi AAathabun yukhzeehi wayahillu AAalayhi AAathabun muqeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who it is unto whom cometh a doom that will abase him, and on whom there falleth everlasting doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna anzalna AAalayka alkitaba lilnnasi bialhaqqi famani ihtada falinafsihi waman dalla fainnama yadillu AAalayha wama anta AAalayhim biwakeelin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture for mankind with truth. Then whosoever goeth right it is for his soul, and whosoever strayeth, strayeth only to its hurt. And thou art not a warder over them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu yatawaffa alanfusa heena mawtiha waallatee lam tamut fee manamiha fayumsiku allatee qada AAalayha almawta wayursilu alokhra ila ajalin musamman inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah receiveth (men's) souls at the time of their death, and that (soul) which dieth not (yet) in its sleep. He keepeth that (soul) for which He hath ordained death and dismisseth the rest till an appointed term. Lo! herein verily are portents for people who take thought.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ami ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi shufaAAaa qul awalaw kanoo la yamlikoona shayan wala yaAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or choose they intercessors other than Allah? Say: What! Even though they have power over nothing and have no intelligence?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul lillahi alshshafaAAatu jameeAAan lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi thumma ilayhi turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Unto Allah belongeth all intercession. His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. And afterward unto Him ye will be brought back.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha thukira Allahu wahdahu ishmaazzat quloobu allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati waitha thukira allatheena min doonihi itha hum yastabshiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Allah alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who believe not in the Hereafter are repelled, and when those (whom they worship) beside Him are mentioned, behold! they are glad.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Quli allahumma fatira alssamawati waalardi AAalima alghaybi waalshshahadati anta tahkumu bayna AAibadika fee ma kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: O Allah! Creator of the heavens and the earth! Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! Thou wilt judge between Thy slaves concerning that wherein they used to differ.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw anna lillatheena thalamoo ma fee alardi jameeAAan wamithlahu maAAahu laiftadaw bihi min sooi alAAathabi yawma alqiyamati wabada lahum mina Allahi ma lam yakoonoo yahtasiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And though those who do wrong possess all that is in the earth, and therewith as much again, they verily will seek to ransom themselves therewith on the Day of Resurrection from the awful doom; and there will appear unto them, from their Lord, that wherewith they never reckoned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wabada lahum sayyiatu ma kasaboo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the evils that they earned will appear unto them, and that whereat they used to scoff will surround them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha massa alinsana durrun daAAana thumma itha khawwalnahu niAAmatan minna qala innama ooteetuhu AAala AAilmin bal hiya fitnatun walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Now when hurt toucheth a man he crieth unto Us, and afterward when We have granted him a boon from Us, he saith: Only by force of knowledge I obtained it. Nay, but it is a test. But most of them know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qad qalaha allatheena min qablihim fama aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yaksiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those before them said it, yet (all) that they had earned availed them not;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faasabahum sayyiatu ma kasaboo waallatheena thalamoo min haolai sayuseebuhum sayyiatu ma kasaboo wama hum bimuAAjizeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But the evils that they earned smote them; and such of these as do wrong, the evils that they earn will smite them; they cannot escape.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yaAAlamoo anna Allaha yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Know they not that Allah enlargeth providence for whom He will, and straiteneth it (for whom He will). Lo! herein verily are portents for people who believe.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ya AAibadiya allatheena asrafoo AAala anfusihim la taqnatoo min rahmati Allahi inna Allaha yaghfiru alththunooba jameeAAan innahu huwa alghafooru alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: O My slaves who have been prodigal to their own hurt! Despair not of the mercy of Allah, Who forgiveth all sins. Lo! He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaneeboo ila rabbikum waaslimoo lahu min qabli an yatiyakumu alAAathabu thumma la tunsaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Turn unto your Lord repentant, and surrender unto Him, before there come unto you the doom, when ye cannot be helped.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaittabiAAoo ahsana ma onzila ilaykum min rabbikum min qabli an yatiyakumu alAAathabu baghtatan waantum la tashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And follow the better (guidance) of that which is revealed unto you from your Lord, before the doom cometh on you suddenly when ye know not,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{An taqoola nafsun ya hasrata AAala ma farrattu fee janbi Allahi wain kuntu lamina alssakhireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lest any soul should say: Alas, my grief that I was unmindful of Allah, and I was indeed among the scoffers!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw taqoola law anna Allaha hadanee lakuntu mina almuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or should say: If Allah had but guided me I should have been among the dutiful!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw taqoola heena tara alAAathaba law anna lee karratan faakoona mina almuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or should say, when it seeth the doom: Oh, that I had but a second chance that I might be among the righteous!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bala qad jaatka ayatee fakaththabta biha waistakbarta wakunta mina alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (But now the answer will be): Nay, for My revelations came unto thee, but thou didst deny them and wast scornful and wast among the disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma alqiyamati tara allatheena kathaboo AAala Allahi wujoohuhum muswaddatun alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilmutakabbireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And on the Day of Resurrection thou (Muhammad) seest those who lied concerning Allah with their faces blackened. Is not the home of the scorners in hell?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayunajjee Allahu allatheena ittaqaw bimafazatihim la yamassuhumu alssooo wala hum yahzanoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah delivereth those who ward off (evil) because of their deserts. Evil toucheth them not, nor do they grieve.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu khaliqu kulli shayin wahuwa AAala kulli shayin wakeelun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah is Creator of all things, and He is Guardian over all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahu maqaleedu alssamawati waalardi waallatheena kafaroo biayati Allahi olaika humu alkhasiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} His are the keys of the heavens and the earth, and they who disbelieve the revelations of Allah - such are they who are the losers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul afaghayra Allahi tamuroonnee aAAbudu ayyuha aljahiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad, to the disbelievers): Do ye bid me serve other than Allah? O ye fools!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad oohiya ilayka waila allatheena min qablika lain ashrakta layahbatanna AAamaluka walatakoonanna mina alkhasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily it hath been revealed unto thee as unto those before thee (saying): If thou ascribe a partner to Allah thy work will fail and thou indeed wilt be among the losers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bali Allaha faoAAbud wakun mina alshshakireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but Allah must thou serve, and be among the thankful!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi waalardu jameeAAan qabdatuhu yawma alqiyamati waalssamawatu matwiyyatun biyameenihi subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they esteem not Allah as He hath the right to be esteemed, when the whole earth is His handful on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens are rolled in His right hand. Glorified is He and High Exalted from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanufikha fee alssoori fasaAAiqa man fee alssamawati waman fee alardi illa man shaa Allahu thumma nufikha feehi okhra faitha hum qiyamun yanthuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the trumpet is blown, and all who are in the heavens and all who are in the earth swoon away, save him whom Allah willeth. Then it is blown a second time, and behold them standing waiting!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waashraqati alardu binoori rabbiha wawudiAAa alkitabu wajeea bialnnabiyyeena waalshshuhadai waqudiya baynahum bialhaqqi wahum la yuthlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the earth shineth with the light of her Lord, and the Book is set up, and the prophets and the witnesses are brought, and it is judged between them with truth, and they are not wronged.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wawuffiyat kullu nafsin ma AAamilat wahuwa aAAlamu bima yafAAaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And each soul is paid in full for what it did. And He is Best Aware of what they do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waseeqa allatheena kafaroo ila jahannama zumaran hatta itha jaooha futihat abwabuha waqala lahum khazanatuha alam yatikum rusulun minkum yatloona AAalaykum ayati rabbikum wayunthiroonakum liqaa yawmikum hatha qaloo bala walakin haqqat kalimatu alAAathabi AAala alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who disbelieve are driven unto hell in troops till, when they reach it and the gates thereof are opened, and the warders thereof say unto them: Came there not unto you messengers of your own, reciting unto you the revelations of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this your Day? they say: Yea, verily. But the word of doom of disbelievers is fulfilled.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qeela odkhuloo abwaba jahannama khalideena feeha fabisa mathwa almutakabbireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is said (unto them): Enter ye the gates of hell to dwell therein. Thus hapless is the journey's end of the scorners.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waseeqa allatheena ittaqaw rabbahum ila aljannati zumaran hatta itha jaooha wafutihat abwabuha waqala lahum khazanatuha salamun AAalaykum tibtum faodkhulooha khalideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who keep their duty to their Lord are driven unto the Garden in troops till, when they reach it, and the gates thereof are opened, and the warders thereof say unto them: Peace be unto you! Ye are good, so enter ye (the Garden of delight), to dwell therein;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo alhamdu lillahi allathee sadaqana waAAdahu waawrathana alarda natabawwao mina aljannati haythu nashao faniAAma ajru alAAamileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They say: Praise be to Allah, Who hath fulfilled His promise unto us and hath made us inherit the land, sojourning in the Garden where we will! So bounteous is the wage of workers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[39][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watara almalaikata haffeena min hawli alAAarshi yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim waqudiya baynahum bialhaqqi waqeela alhamdu lillahi rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thou (O Muhammad) seest the angels thronging round the Throne, hymning the praises of their Lord. And they are judged aright. And it is said: Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Mu'min (The Believer)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hameem}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ha. Mim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alAAaleemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Knower,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ghafiri alththanbi waqabili alttawbi shadeedi alAAiqabi thee alttawli la ilaha illa huwa ilayhi almaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Forgiver of sin, the Accepter of repentance, the Stern in punishment, the Bountiful. There is no Allah save Him. Unto Him is the journeying.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma yujadilu fee ayati Allahi illa allatheena kafaroo fala yaghrurka taqallubuhum fee albiladi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} None argue concerning the revelations of Allah save those who disbelieve, so let not their turn of fortune in the land deceive thee (O Muhammad).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waalahzabu min baAAdihim wahammat kullu ommatin birasoolihim liyakhuthoohu wajadaloo bialbatili liyudhidoo bihi alhaqqa faakhathtuhum fakayfa kana AAiqabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The folk of Noah and the factions after them denied (their messengers) before these, and every nation purposed to seize their messenger and argued falsely, (thinking) thereby to refute the Truth. Then I seized them, and how (awful) was My punishment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakathalika haqqat kalimatu rabbika AAala allatheena kafaroo annahum ashabu alnnari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus was the word of thy Lord concerning those who disbelieve fulfilled: That they are owners of the Fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yahmiloona alAAarsha waman hawlahu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayuminoona bihi wayastaghfiroona lillatheena amanoo rabbana wasiAAta kulla shayin rahmatan waAAilman faighfir lillatheena taboo waittabaAAoo sabeelaka waqihim AAathaba aljaheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who bear the Throne, and all who are round about it, hymn the praises of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who believe (saying): Our Lord! Thou comprehendest all things in mercy and knowledge, therefor forgive those who repent and follow Thy way. Ward off from them the punishment of hell.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbana waadkhilhum jannati AAadnin allatee waAAadtahum waman salaha min abaihim waazwajihim wathurriyyatihim innaka anta alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Our Lord! And make them enter the Gardens of Eden which thou hast promised them, with such of their fathers and their wives and their descendants as do right. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqihimu alssayyiati waman taqi alssayyiati yawmaithin faqad rahimtahu wathalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And ward off from them ill-deeds; and he from whom Thou wardest off ill-deeds that day, him verily hast Thou taken into mercy. That is the supreme triumph.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena kafaroo yunadawna lamaqtu Allahi akbaru min maqtikum anfusakum ith tudAAawna ila aleemani fatakfuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! (on that day) those who disbelieve are informed by proclamation: Verily Allah's abhorrence is more terrible than your abhorrence one of another, when ye were called unto the faith but did refuse.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo rabbana amattana ithnatayni waahyaytana ithnatayni faiAAtarafna bithunoobina fahal ila khuroojin min sabeelin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They say: Our Lord! Twice hast Thou made us die, and twice hast Thou made us live. Now we confess our sins. Is there any way to go out?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalikum biannahu itha duAAiya Allahu wahdahu kafartum wain yushrak bihi tuminoo faalhukmu lillahi alAAaliyyi alkabeeri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (It is said unto them): This is (your plight) because, when Allah only was invoked, ye disbelieved, but when some partner was ascribed to Him ye were believing. But the command belongeth only to Allah, the Sublime, the Majestic.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa allathee yureekum ayatihi wayunazzilu lakum mina alssamai rizqan wama yatathakkaru illa man yuneebu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who showeth you His portents, and sendeth down for you provision from the sky. None payeth heed save him who turneth (unto Him) repentant.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaodAAoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu alddeena walaw kariha alkafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor (O believers) pray unto Allah, making religion pure for Him (only), however much the disbelievers be averse -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{RafeeAAu alddarajati thoo alAAarshi yulqee alrrooha min amrihi AAala man yashao min AAibadihi liyunthira yawma alttalaqi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Exalter of Ranks, the Lord of the Throne. He causeth the Spirit of His command upon whom He will of His slaves, that He may warn of the Day of Meeting,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma hum barizoona la yakhfa AAala Allahi minhum shayon limani almulku alyawma lillahi alwahidi alqahhari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The day when they come forth, nothing of them being hidden from Allah. Whose is the Sovereignty this day? It is Allah's, the One, the Almighty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alyawma tujza kullu nafsin bima kasabat la thulma alyawma inna Allaha sareeAAu alhisabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This day is each soul requited that which it hath earned; no wrong (is done) this day. Lo! Allah is swift at reckoning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanthirhum yawma alazifati ithi alquloobu lada alhanajiri kathimeena ma lilththalimeena min hameemin wala shafeeAAin yutaAAu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Warn them (O Muhammad) of the Day of the approaching (doom), when the hearts will be choking the throats, (when) there will be no friend for the wrong-doers, nor any intercessor who will be heard.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YaAAlamu khainata alaAAyuni wama tukhfee alssudooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He knoweth the traitor of the eyes, and that which the bosoms hide.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAllahu yaqdee bialhaqqi waallatheena yadAAoona min doonihi la yaqdoona bishayin inna Allaha huwa alssameeAAu albaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah judgeth with truth, while those to whom they cry instead of Him judge not at all. Lo! Allah, He is the Hearer, the Seer.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awa lam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena kanoo min qablihim kanoo hum ashadda minhum quwwatan waatharan fee alardi faakhathahumu Allahu bithunoobihim wama kana lahum mina Allahi min waqin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not travelled in the land to see the nature of the consequence for those who disbelieved before them? They were mightier than these in power and (in the) traces (which they left behind them) in the earth. Yet Allah seized them for their sins, and they had no protector from Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika biannahum kanat tateehim rusuluhum bialbayyinati fakafaroo faakhathahumu Allahu innahu qawiyyun shadeedu alAAiqabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That was because their messengers kept bringing them clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty) but they disbelieved; so Allah seized them. Lo! He is Strong, severe in punishment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad arsalna moosa biayatina wasultanin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations and a clear warrant}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ila firAAawna wahamana waqaroona faqaloo sahirun kaththabun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Pharaoh and Haman and Korah, but they said: A lying sorcerer!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jaahum bialhaqqi min AAindina qaloo oqtuloo abnaa allatheena amanoo maAAahu waistahyoo nisaahum wama kaydu alkafireena illa fee dalalin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when he brought them the Truth from Our presence, they said: Slay the sons of those who believe with him, and spare their women. But the plot of disbelievers is in naught but error.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala firAAawnu tharoonee aqtul moosa walyadAAu rabbahu innee akhafu an yubaddila deenakum aw an yuthhira fee alardi alfasada}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Pharaoh said: Suffer me to kill Moses, and let him cry unto his Lord. Lo! I fear that he will alter your religion or that he will cause confusion in the land.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala moosa innee AAuthtu birabbee warabbikum min kulli mutakabbirin la yuminu biyawmi alhisabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Moses said: Lo! I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every scorner who believeth not in a Day of Reckoning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala rajulun muminun min ali firAAawna yaktumu eemanahu ataqtuloona rajulan an yaqoola rabbiyya Allahu waqad jaakum bialbayyinati min rabbikum wain yaku kathiban faAAalayhi kathibuhu wain yaku sadiqan yusibkum baAAdu allathee yaAAidukum inna Allaha la yahdee man huwa musrifun kaththabun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And a believing man of Pharaoh's family, who hid his faith, said: Would ye kill a man because he saith: My Lord is Allah, and hath brought you clear proofs from your Lord? If he is lying, then his lie is upon him; and if he is truthful, then some of that wherewith he threateneth you will strike you. Lo! Allah guideth not one who is a prodigal, a liar.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya qawmi lakumu almulku alyawma thahireena fee alardi faman yansuruna min basi Allahi in jaana qala firAAawnu ma oreekum illa ma ara wama ahdeekum illa sabeela alrrashadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O my people! Yours is the kingdom to-day, ye being uppermost in the land. But who would save us from the wrath of Allah should it reach us? Pharaoh said: I do but show you what I think, and I do but guide you to wise policy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allathee amana ya qawmi innee akhafu AAalaykum mithla yawmi alahzabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he who believed said: O my people! Lo! I fear for you a fate like that of the factions (of old);}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Mithla dabi qawmi noohin waAAadin wathamooda waallatheena min baAAdihim wama Allahu yureedu thulman lilAAibadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A plight like that of Noah's folk, and A'ad and Thamud, and those after them, and Allah willeth no injustice for (His) slaves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waya qawmi innee akhafu AAalaykum yawma alttanadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And, O my people! Lo! I fear for you a Day of Summoning,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma tuwalloona mudbireena ma lakum mina Allahi min AAasimin waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A day when ye will turn to flee, having no preserver from Allah: and he whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad jaakum yoosufu min qablu bialbayyinati fama ziltum fee shakkin mimma jaakum bihi hatta itha halaka qultum lan yabAAatha Allahu min baAAdihi rasoolan kathalika yudillu Allahu man huwa musrifun murtabun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily Joseph brought you of old clear proofs, yet ye ceased not to be in doubt concerning what he brought you till, when he died, ye said: Allah will not send any messenger after him. Thus Allah deceiveth him who is a prodigal, a doubter.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yujadiloona fee ayati Allahi bighayri sultanin atahum kabura maqtan AAinda Allahi waAAinda allatheena amanoo kathalika yatbaAAu Allahu AAala kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbarin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah without any warrant that hath come unto them, it is greatly hateful in the sight of Allah and in the sight of those who believe. Thus doth Allah print on every arrogant, disdainful heart.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala firAAawnu ya hamanu ibni lee sarhan laAAallee ablughu alasbaba}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Pharaoh said: O Haman! Build for me a tower that haply I may reach the roads,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Asbaba alssamawati faattaliAAa ila ilahi moosa wainnee laathunnuhu kathiban wakathalika zuyyina lifirAAawna sooo AAamalihi wasudda AAani alssabeeli wama kaydu firAAawna illa fee tababin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The roads of the heavens, and may look upon the god of Moses, though verily I think him a liar. Thus was the evil that he did made fairseeming unto Pharaoh, and he was debarred from the (right) way. The plot of Pharaoh ended but in ruin.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allathee amana ya qawmi ittabiAAooni ahdikum sabeela alrrashadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he who believed said: O my people! Follow me. I will show you the way of right conduct.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya qawmi innama hathihi alhayatu alddunya mataAAun wainna alakhirata hiya daru alqarari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O my people! Lo! this life of the world is but a passing comfort, and lo! the Hereafter, that is the enduring home.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man AAamila sayyiatan fala yujza illa mithlaha waman AAamila salihan min thakarin aw ontha wahuwa muminun faolaika yadkhuloona aljannata yurzaqoona feeha bighayri hisabin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whoso doeth an ill-deed, he will be repaid the like thereof, while whoso doeth right, whether male or female, and is a believer, (all) such will enter the Garden, where they will be nourished without stint.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waya qawmi ma lee adAAookum ila alnnajati watadAAoonanee ila alnnari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And, O my people! What aileth me that I call you unto deliverance when ye call me unto the Fire?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{TadAAoonanee liakfura biAllahi waoshrika bihi ma laysa lee bihi AAilmun waana adAAookum ila alAAazeezi alghaffari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ye call me to disbelieve in Allah and ascribe unto Him as partners that whereof I have no knowledge, while I call you unto the Mighty, the Forgiver.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La jarama annama tadAAoonanee ilayhi laysa lahu daAAwatun fee alddunya wala fee alakhirati waanna maraddana ila Allahi waanna almusrifeena hum ashabu alnnari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Assuredly that whereunto ye call me hath no claim in the world or in the Hereafter, and our return will be unto Allah, and the prodigals will be owners of the Fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasatathkuroona ma aqoolu lakum waofawwidu amree ila Allahi inna Allaha baseerun bialAAibadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And ye will remember what I say unto you. I confide my cause unto Allah. Lo! Allah is Seer of (His) slaves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fawaqahu Allahu sayyiati ma makaroo wahaqa biali firAAawna sooo alAAathabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So Allah warded off from him the evils which they plotted, while a dreadful doom encompassed Pharaoh's folk,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alnnaru yuAAradoona AAalayha ghuduwwan waAAashiyyan wayawma taqoomu alssaAAatu adkhiloo ala firAAawna ashadda alAAathabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening; and on the day when the Hour upriseth (it is said): Cause Pharaoh's folk to enter the most awful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith yatahajjoona fee alnnari fayaqoolu aldduAAafao lillatheena istakbaroo inna kunna lakum tabaAAan fahal antum mughnoona AAanna naseeban mina alnnari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they wrangle in the Fire, the weak say unto those who were proud: Lo! we were a following unto you; will ye therefor rid us of a portion of the Fire?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala allatheena istakbaroo inna kullun feeha inna Allaha qad hakama bayna alAAibadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who were proud say: Lo! we are all (together) herein. Lo! Allah hath judged between (His) slaves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena fee alnnari likhazanati jahannama odAAoo rabbakum yukhaffif AAanna yawman mina alAAathabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those in the Fire say unto the guards of hell: Entreat your Lord that He relieve us of a day of the torment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo awalam taku tateekum rusulukum bialbayyinati qaloo bala qaloo faodAAoo wama duAAao alkafireena illa fee dalalin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They say: Came not your messengers unto you with clear proofs? They say: Yea, verily. They say: Then do ye pray, although the prayer of disbelievers is in vain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna lanansuru rusulana waallatheena amanoo fee alhayati alddunya wayawma yaqoomu alashhadu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We verily do help Our messengers, and those who believe, in the life of the world and on the day when the witnesses arise,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma la yanfaAAu alththalimeena maAAthiratuhum walahumu allaAAnatu walahum sooo alddari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The day when their excuse availeth not the evil-doers, and theirs is the curse, and theirs the ill abode.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad atayna moosa alhuda waawrathna banee israeela alkitaba}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We verily gave Moses the guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hudan wathikra liolee alalbabi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A guide and a reminder for men of understanding.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faisbir inna waAAda Allahi haqqun waistaghfir lithanbika wasabbih bihamdi rabbika bialAAashiyyi waalibkari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then have patience (O Muhammad). Lo! the promise of Allah is true. And ask forgiveness of thy sin, and hymn the praise of thy Lord at fall of night and in the early hours.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena yujadiloona fee ayati Allahi bighayri sultanin atahum in fee sudoorihim illa kibrun ma hum bibaligheehi faistaAAith biAllahi innahu huwa alssameeAAu albaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah without a warrant having come unto them, there is naught else in their breasts save pride which they will never attain. So take thou refuge in Allah. Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Seer.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lakhalqu alssamawati waalardi akbaru min khalqi alnnasi walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Assuredly the creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of mankind; but most of mankind know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yastawee alaAAma waalbaseeru waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati wala almuseeo qaleelan ma tatathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the blind man and the seer are not equal, neither are those who believe and do good works (equal with) the evil-doer. Little do ye reflect!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna alssaAAata laatiyatun la rayba feeha walakinna akthara alnnasi la yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the Hour is surely coming, there is no doubt thereof; yet most of mankind believe not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala rabbukumu odAAoonee astajib lakum inna allatheena yastakbiroona AAan AAibadatee sayadkhuloona jahannama dakhireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And your Lord hath said: Pray unto Me and I will hear your prayer. Lo! those who scorn My service, they will enter hell, disgraced.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu allathee jaAAala lakumu allayla litaskunoo feehi waalnnahara mubsiran inna Allaha lathoo fadlin AAala alnnasi walakinna akthara alnnasi la yashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah it is Who hath appointed for you night that ye may rest therein, and day for seeing. Lo! Allah is a Lord of bounty for mankind, yet most of mankind give not thanks.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalikumu Allahu rabbukum khaliqu kulli shayin la ilaha illa huwa faanna tufakoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of all things, There is no Allah save Him. How then are ye perverted?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kathalika yufaku allatheena kanoo biayati Allahi yajhadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus are they perverted who deny the revelations of Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda qararan waalssamaa binaan wasawwarakum faahsana suwarakum warazaqakum mina alttayyibati thalikumu Allahu rabbukum fatabaraka Allahu rabbu alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah it is Who appointed for you the earth for a dwelling-place and the sky for a canopy, and fashioned you and perfected your shapes, and hath provided you with good things. Such is Allah, your Lord. Then blessed be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa alhayyu la ilaha illa huwa faodAAoohu mukhliseena lahu alddeena alhamdu lillahi rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He is the Living One. There is no Allah save Him. So pray unto Him, making religion pure for Him (only). Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul innee nuheetu an aAAbuda allatheena tadAAoona min dooni Allahi lamma jaaniya albayyinatu min rabbee waomirtu an oslima lirabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad): I am forbidden to worship those unto whom ye cry beside Allah since there have come unto me clear proofs from my Lord, and I am commanded to surrender to the Lord of the Worlds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa allathee khalaqakum min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma min AAalaqatin thumma yukhrijukum tiflan thumma litablughoo ashuddakum thumma litakoonoo shuyookhan waminkum man yutawaffa min qablu walitablughoo ajalan musamman walaAAallakum taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who created you from dust, then from a drop (of seed) then from a clot, then bringeth you forth as a child, then (ordaineth) that ye attain full strength and afterward that ye become old men - though some among you die before - and that ye reach an appointed term, that haply ye may understand.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa allathee yuhyee wayumeetu faitha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoonu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who quickeneth and giveth death. When He ordaineth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara ila allatheena yujadiloona fee ayati Allahi anna yusrafoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou not seen those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah, how they are turned away? -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena kaththaboo bialkitabi wabima arsalna bihi rusulana fasawfa yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who deny the Scripture and that wherewith We send Our messengers. But they will come to know,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ithi alaghlalu fee aAAnaqihim waalssalasilu yushaboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When carcans are about their necks and chains. They are dragged}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee alhameemi thumma fee alnnari yusjaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Through boiling waters; then they are thrust into the Fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma qeela lahum ayna ma kuntum tushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then it is said unto them: Where are (all) that ye used to make partners (in the Sovereignty)}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Min dooni Allahi qaloo dalloo AAanna bal lam nakun nadAAoo min qablu shayan kathalika yudillu Allahu alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Beside Allah? They say: They have failed us; but we used not to pray to anything before. Thus doth Allah send astray the disbelievers (in His guidance).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalikum bima kuntum tafrahoona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi wabima kuntum tamrahoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And it is said unto them): This is because ye exulted in the earth without right, and because ye were petulant.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Odkhuloo abwaba jahannama khalideena feeha fabisa mathwa almutakabbireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Enter ye the gates of hell, to dwell therein. Evil is the habitation of the scornful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faisbir inna waAAda Allahi haqqun faimma nuriyannaka baAAda allathee naAAiduhum aw natawaffayannaka failayna yurjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then have patience (O Muhammad). Lo! the promise of Allah is true. And whether we let thee see a part of that which We promise them, or (whether) We cause thee to die, still unto Us they will be brought back.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad arsalna rusulan min qablika minhum man qasasna AAalayka waminhum man lam naqsus AAalayka wama kana lirasoolin an yatiya biayatin illa biithni Allahi faitha jaa amru Allahi qudiya bialhaqqi wakhasira hunalika almubtiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Verily We sent messengers before thee, among them those of whom We have told thee, and some of whom We have not told thee; and it was not given to any messenger that he should bring a portent save by Allah's leave, but when Allah's commandment cometh (the cause) is judged aright, and the followers of vanity will then be lost.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu allathee jaAAala lakumu alanAAama litarkaboo minha waminha takuloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah it is Who hath appointed for you cattle, that ye may ride on some of them, and eat of some -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walakum feeha manafiAAu walitablughoo AAalayha hajatan fee sudoorikum waAAalayha waAAala alfulki tuhmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Many) benefits ye have from them - and that ye may satisfy by their means a need that is in your breasts, and may be borne upon them as upon the ship.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayureekum ayatihi faayya ayati Allahi tunkiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He showeth you His tokens. Which, then, of the tokens of Allah do ye deny?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim kanoo akthara minhum waashadda quwwatan waatharan fee alardi fama aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yaksiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not travelled in the land to see the nature of the consequence for those before them? They were more numerous than these, and mightier in power and (in the) traces (which they left behind them) in the earth. But all that they used to earn availed them not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jaathum rusuluhum bialbayyinati farihoo bima AAindahum mina alAAilmi wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when their messengers brought them clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty) they exulted in the knowledge they (themselves) possessed. And that which they were wont to mock befell them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma raaw basana qaloo amanna biAllahi wahdahu wakafarna bima kunna bihi mushrikeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, when they saw Our doom, they said: We believe in Allah only and reject (all) that we used to associate (with Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[40][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falam yaku yanfaAAuhum eemanuhum lamma raaw basana sunnata Allahi allatee qad khalat fee AAibadihi wakhasira hunalika alkafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But their faith could not avail them when they saw Our doom. This is Allah's law which hath ever taken course for His bondmen. And then the disbelievers will be ruined.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Ha Mim (Ha Mim)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hameem}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ha. Mim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][2]
\end{Arabic}}
