\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tanzeelun mina alrrahmani alrraheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A revelation from the Beneficent, the Merciful,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kitabun fussilat ayatuhu quranan AAarabiyyan liqawmin yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A Scripture whereof the verses are expounded, a Lecture in Arabic for people who have knowledge,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Basheeran wanatheeran faaAArada aktharuhum fahum la yasmaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Good tidings and a warning. But most of them turn away so that they hear not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo quloobuna fee akinnatin mimma tadAAoona ilayhi wafee athanina waqrun wamin baynina wabaynika hijabun faiAAmal innana AAamiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: Our hearts are protected from that unto which thou (O Muhammad) callest us, and in our ears there is a deafness, and between us and thee there is a veil. Act, then. Lo! we also shall be acting.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul innama ana basharun mithlukum yooha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun faistaqeemoo ilayhi waistaghfiroohu wawaylun lilmushrikeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them O Muhammad): I am only a mortal like you. It is inspired in me that your Allah is One Allah, therefor take the straight path unto Him and seek forgiveness of Him. And woe unto the idolaters,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena la yutoona alzzakata wahum bialakhirati hum kafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who give not the poor-due, and who are disbelievers in the Hereafter.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! as for those who believe and do good works, for them is a reward enduring.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ainnakum latakfuroona biallathee khalaqa alarda fee yawmayni watajAAaloona lahu andadan thalika rabbu alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad, unto the idolaters): Disbelieve ye verily in Him Who created the earth in two Days, and ascribe ye unto Him rivals? He (and none else) is the Lord of the Worlds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAala feeha rawasiya min fawqiha wabaraka feeha waqaddara feeha aqwataha fee arbaAAati ayyamin sawaan lilssaileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He placed therein firm hills rising above it, and blessed it and measured therein its sustenance in four Days, alike for (all) who ask;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma istawa ila alssamai wahiya dukhanun faqala laha walilardi itiya tawAAan aw karhan qalata atayna taiAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then turned He to the heaven when it was smoke, and said unto it and unto the earth: Come both of you, willingly or loth. They said: We come, obedient.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqadahunna sabAAa samawatin fee yawmayni waawha fee kulli samain amraha wazayyanna alssamaa alddunya bimasabeeha wahifthan thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then He ordained them seven heavens in two Days and inspired in each heaven its mandate; and We decked the nether heaven with lamps, and rendered it inviolable. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain aAAradoo fuqul anthartukum saAAiqatan mithla saAAiqati AAadin wathamooda}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But if they turn away, then say: I warn you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt (which fell of old upon the tribes) of A'ad and Thamud;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith jaathumu alrrusulu min bayni aydeehim wamin khalfihim alla taAAbudoo illa Allaha qaloo law shaa rabbuna laanzala malaikatan fainna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When their messengers came unto them from before them and behind them, saying: Worship none but Allah! they said: If our Lord had willed, He surely would have sent down angels (unto us), so lo! we are disbelievers in that wherewith ye have been sent.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faamma AAadun faistakbaroo fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi waqaloo man ashaddu minna quwwatan awalam yaraw anna Allaha allathee khalaqahum huwa ashaddu minhum quwwatan wakanoo biayatina yajhadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for A'ad, they were arrogant in the land without right, and they said: Who is mightier than us in power? Could they not see that Allah Who created them, He was mightier than them in power? And they denied Our revelations.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faarsalna AAalayhim reehan sarsaran fee ayyamin nahisatin linutheeqahum AAathaba alkhizyi fee alhayati alddunya walaAAathabu alakhirati akhza wahum la yunsaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor We let loose on them a raging wind in evil days, that We might make them taste the torment of disgrace in the life of the world. And verily the doom of the Hereafter will be more shameful, and they will not be helped.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma thamoodu fahadaynahum faistahabboo alAAama AAala alhuda faakhathathum saAAiqatu alAAathabi alhooni bima kanoo yaksiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And as for Thamud, We gave them guidance, but they preferred blindness to the guidance, so the bolt of the doom of humiliation overtook them because of what they used to earn.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanajjayna allatheena amanoo wakanoo yattaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We delivered those who believed and used to keep their duty to Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma yuhsharu aAAdao Allahi ila alnnari fahum yoozaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (make mention of) the day when the enemies of Allah are gathered unto the Fire, they are driven on}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatta itha ma jaooha shahida AAalayhim samAAuhum waabsaruhum wajulooduhum bima kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Till, when they reach it, their ears and their eyes and their skins testify against them as to what they used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo lijuloodihim lima shahidtum AAalayna qaloo antaqana Allahu allathee antaqa kulla shayin wahuwa khalaqakum awwala marratin wailayhi turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say unto their skins: Why testify ye against us? They say: Allah hath given us speech Who giveth speech to all things, and Who created you at the first, and unto Whom ye are returned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama kuntum tastatiroona an yashhada AAalaykum samAAukum wala absarukum wala juloodukum walakin thanantum anna Allaha la yaAAlamu katheeran mimma taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ye did not hide yourselves lest your ears and your eyes and your skins should testify against you, but ye deemed that Allah knew not much of what ye did.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wathalikum thannukumu allathee thanantum birabbikum ardakum faasbahtum mina alkhasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That, your thought which ye did think about your Lord, hath ruined you; and ye find yourselves (this day) among the lost.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain yasbiroo faalnnaru mathwan lahum wain yastaAAtiboo fama hum mina almuAAtabeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And though they are resigned, yet the Fire is still their home; and if they ask for favour, yet they are not of those unto whom favour can be shown.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqayyadna lahum quranaa fazayyanoo lahum ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wahaqqa AAalayhimu alqawlu fee omamin qad khalat min qablihim mina aljinni waalinsi innahum kanoo khasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We assigned them comrades (in the world), who made their present and their past fairseeming unto them. And the Word concerning nations of the jinn and humankind who passed away before them hath effect for them. Lo! they were ever losers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena kafaroo la tasmaAAoo lihatha alqurani wailghaw feehi laAAallakum taghliboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who disbelieve say: Heed not this Qur'an, and drown the hearing of it; haply ye may conquer.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falanutheeqanna allatheena kafaroo AAathaban shadeedan walanajziyannahum aswaa allathee kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But verily We shall cause those who disbelieve to taste an awful doom, and verily We shall requite them the worst of what they used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika jazao aAAdai Allahi alnnaru lahum feeha daru alkhuldi jazaan bima kanoo biayatina yajhadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That is the reward of Allah's enemies: the Fire. Therein is their immortal home, payment forasmuch as they denied Our revelations.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena kafaroo rabbana arina allathayni adallana mina aljinni waalinsi najAAalhuma tahta aqdamina liyakoona mina alasfaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who disbelieve will say: Our Lord! Show us those who beguiled us of the jinn and humankind. We will place them underneath our feet that they may be among the nethermost.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena qaloo rabbuna Allahu thumma istaqamoo tatanazzalu AAalayhimu almalaikatu alla takhafoo wala tahzanoo waabshiroo bialjannati allatee kuntum tooAAadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who say: Our Lord is Allah, and afterward are upright, the angels descend upon them, saying: Fear not nor grieve, but hear good tidings of the paradise which ye are promised.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Nahnu awliyaokum fee alhayati alddunya wafee alakhirati walakum feeha ma tashtahee anfusukum walakum feeha ma taddaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We are your protecting friends in the life of the world and in the Hereafter. There ye will have (all) that your souls desire, and there ye will have (all) for which ye pray.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Nuzulan min ghafoorin raheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A gift of welcome from One Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman ahsanu qawlan mimman daAAa ila Allahi waAAamila salihan waqala innanee mina almuslimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And who is better in speech than him who prayeth unto his Lord and doeth right, and saith: Lo! I am of those who are muslims (surrender unto Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tastawee alhasanatu wala alssayyiatu idfaAA biallatee hiya ahsanu faitha allathee baynaka wabaynahu AAadawatun kaannahu waliyyun hameemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The good deed and the evil deed are not alike. Repel the evil deed with one which is better, then lo! he, between whom and thee there was enmity (will become) as though he was a bosom friend.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yulaqqaha illa allatheena sabaroo wama yulaqqaha illa thoo haththin AAatheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But none is granted it save those who are steadfast, and none is granted it save the owner of great happiness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waimma yanzaghannaka mina alshshaytani nazghun faistaAAith biAllahi innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if a whisper from the devil reach thee (O Muhammad) then seek refuge in Allah. Lo! He is the Hearer, the Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamin ayatihi allaylu waalnnaharu waalshshamsu waalqamaru la tasjudoo lilshshamsi wala lilqamari waosjudoo lillahi alathee khalaqahunna in kuntum iyyahu taAAbudoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of His portents are the night and the day and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or the moon; but prostrate to Allah Who created them, if it is in truth Him Whom ye worship.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faini istakbaroo faallatheena AAinda rabbika yusabbihoona lahu biallayli waalnnahari wahum la yasamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But if they are too proud - still those who are with thy Lord glorify Him night and day, and tire not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamin ayatihi annaka tara alarda khashiAAatan faitha anzalna AAalayha almaa ihtazzat warabat inna allathee ahyaha lamuhyee almawta innahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of His portents (is this): that thou seest the earth lowly, but when We send down water thereon it thrilleth and groweth. Lo! He Who quickeneth it is verily the Quickener of the Dead. Lo! He is Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena yulhidoona fee ayatina la yakhfawna AAalayna afaman yulqa fee alnnari khayrun am man yatee aminan yawma alqiyamati iAAmaloo ma shitum innahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who distort Our revelations are not hid from Us. Is he who is hurled into the Fire better, or he who cometh secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do what ye will. Lo! He is Seer of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena kafaroo bialththikri lamma jaahum wainnahu lakitabun AAazeezun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who disbelieve in the Reminder when it cometh unto them (are guilty), for lo! it is an unassailable Scripture.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yateehi albatilu min bayni yadayhi wala min khalfihi tanzeelun min hakeemin hameedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Falsehood cannot come at it from before it or from behind it. (It is) a revelation from the Wise, the Owner of Praise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma yuqalu laka illa ma qad qeela lilrrusuli min qablika inna rabbaka lathoo maghfiratin wathoo AAiqabin aleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Naught is said unto thee (Muhammad) save what was said unto the messengers before thee. Lo! thy Lord is owner of forgiveness, and owner (also) of dire punishment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw jaAAalnahu quranan aAAjamiyyan laqaloo lawla fussilat ayatuhu aaAAjamiyyun waAAarabiyyun qul huwa lillatheena amanoo hudan washifaon waallatheena la yuminoona fee athanihim waqrun wahuwa AAalayhim AAaman olaika yunadawna min makanin baAAeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if We had appointed it a Lecture in a foreign tongue they would assuredly have said: If only its verses were expounded (so that we might understand)? What! A foreign tongue and an Arab? - Say unto them (O Muhammad): For those who believe it is a guidance and a healing; and as for those who disbelieve, there is a deafness in their ears, and it is blindness for them. Such are called to from afar.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba faikhtulifa feehi walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laqudiya baynahum wainnahum lafee shakkin minhu mureebin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We verily gave Moses the Scripture, but there hath been dispute concerning it; and but for a Word that had already gone forth from thy Lord, it would ere now have been judged between them; but lo! they are in hopeless doubt concerning it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man AAamila salihan falinafsihi waman asaa faAAalayha wama rabbuka bithallamin lilAAabeedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whoso doeth right it is for his soul, and whoso doeth wrong it is against it. And thy Lord is not at all a tyrant to His slaves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ilayhi yuraddu AAilmu alssaAAati wama takhruju min thamaratin min akmamiha wama tahmilu min ontha wala tadaAAu illa biAAilmihi wayawma yunadeehim ayna shurakaee qaloo athannaka ma minna min shaheedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Him is referred (all) knowledge of the Hour. And no fruits burst forth from their sheaths, and no female carrieth or bringeth forth but with His knowledge. And on the day when He calleth unto them: Where are now My partners? they will say: We confess unto Thee, not one of us is a witness (for them).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wadalla AAanhum ma kanoo yadAAoona min qablu wathannoo ma lahum min maheesin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those to whom they used to cry of old have failed them, and they perceive they have no place of refuge.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yasamu alinsanu min duAAai alkhayri wain massahu alshsharru fayaoosun qanootun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Man tireth not of praying for good, and if ill toucheth him, then he is disheartened, desperate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walain athaqnahu rahmatan minna min baAAdi darraa massathu layaqoolanna hatha lee wama athunnu alssaAAata qaimatan walain rujiAAtu ila rabbee inna lee AAindahu lalhusna falanunabbianna allatheena kafaroo bima AAamiloo walanutheeqannahum min AAathabin ghaleethin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily, if We cause him to taste mercy after some hurt that hath touched him, he will say: This is my own; and I deem not that the Hour will ever rise, and if I am brought back to my Lord, I surely shall be better off with Him - But We verily shall tell those who disbelieve (all) that they did, and We verily shall make them taste hard punishment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha anAAamna AAala alinsani aAArada wanaa bijanibihi waitha massahu alshsharru fathoo duAAain AAareedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When We show favour unto man, he withdraweth and turneth aside, but when ill toucheth him then he aboundeth in prayer.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul araaytum in kana min AAindi Allahi thumma kafartum bihi man adallu mimman huwa fee shiqaqin baAAeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Bethink you: If it is from Allah and ye reject it - Who is further astray than one who is at open feud (with Allah)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sanureehim ayatina fee alafaqi wafee anfusihim hatta yatabayyana lahum annahu alhaqqu awalam yakfi birabbika annahu AAala kulli shayin shaheedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We shall show them Our portents on the horizons and within themselves until it will be manifest unto them that it is the Truth. Doth not thy Lord suffice, since He is Witness over all things?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[41][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ala innahum fee miryatin min liqai rabbihim ala innahu bikulli shayin muheetun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How! Are they still in doubt about the meeting with their Lord? Lo! Is not He surrounding all things?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Ash-Shura (Counsel)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hameem}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ha. Mim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAaynseenqaf}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A'in. Sin. Qaf.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kathalika yoohee ilayka waila allatheena min qablika Allahu alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus Allah the Mighty, the Knower inspireth thee (Muhammad) as (He inspired) those before thee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wahuwa alAAaliyyu alAAatheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Him belongeth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and He is the Sublime, the Tremendous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Takadu alssamawatu yatafattarna min fawqihinna waalmalaikatu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayastaghfiroona liman fee alardi ala inna Allaha huwa alghafooru alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Almost might the heavens above be rent asunder while the angels hymn the praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on the earth. Lo! Allah, He is the Forgiver, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena ittakhathoo min doonihi awliyaa Allahu hafeethun AAalayhim wama anta AAalayhim biwakeelin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And as for those who choose protecting friends beside Him, Allah is Warden over them, and thou art in no wise a guardian over them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakathalika awhayna ilayka quranan AAarabiyyan litunthira omma alqura waman hawlaha watunthira yawma aljamAAi la rayba feehi fareequn fee aljannati wafareequn fee alssaAAeeri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thus We have inspired in thee a Lecture in Arabic, that thou mayst warn the mother-town and those around it, and mayst warn of a day of assembling whereof there is no doubt. A host will be in the Garden, and a host of them in the Flame.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw shaa Allahu lajaAAalahum ommatan wahidatan walakin yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihi waalththalimoona ma lahum min waliyyin wala naseerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Had Allah willed, He could have made them one community, but Allah bringeth whom He will into His mercy. And the wrong-doers have no friend nor helper.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ami ittakhathoo min doonihi awliyaa faAllahu huwa alwaliyyu wahuwa yuhyee almawta wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or have they chosen protecting friends besides Him? But Allah, He (alone) is the Protecting Friend. He quickeneth the dead, and He is Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama ikhtalaftum feehi min shayin fahukmuhu ila Allahi thalikumu Allahu rabbee AAalayhi tawakkaltu wailayhi oneebu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in whatsoever ye differ, the verdict therein belongeth to Allah. Such is my Lord, in Whom I put my trust, and unto Whom I turn.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatiru alssamawati waalardi jaAAala lakum min anfusikum azwajan wamina alanAAami azwajan yathraokum feehi laysa kamithlihi shayon wahuwa alssameeAAu albaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Creator of the heavens and the earth. He hath made for you pairs of yourselves, and of the cattle also pairs, whereby He multiplieth you. Naught is as His likeness; and He is the Hearer, the Seer.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahu maqaleedu alssamawati waalardi yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru innahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} His are the keys of the heavens and the earth. He enlargeth providence for whom He will and straiteneth (it for whom He will). Lo! He is Knower of all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{SharaAAa lakum mina alddeeni ma wassa bihi noohan waallathee awhayna ilayka wama wassayna bihi ibraheema wamoosa waAAeesa an aqeemoo alddeena wala tatafarraqoo feehi kabura AAala almushrikeena ma tadAAoohum ilayhi Allahu yajtabee ilayhi man yashao wayahdee ilayhi man yuneebu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He hath ordained for you that religion which He commended unto Noah, and that which We inspire in thee (Muhammad), and that which We commended unto Abraham and Moses and Jesus, saying: Establish the religion, and be not divided therein. Dreadful for the idolaters is that unto which thou callest them. Allah chooseth for Himself whom He will, and guideth unto Himself him who turneth (toward Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama tafarraqoo illa min baAAdi ma jaahumu alAAilmu baghyan baynahum walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika ila ajalin musamman laqudiya baynahum wainna allatheena oorithoo alkitaba min baAAdihim lafee shakkin minhu mureebin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they were not divided until after the knowledge came unto them, through rivalry among themselves; and had it not been for a Word that had already gone forth from thy Lord for an appointed term, it surely had been judged between them. And those who were made to inherit the Scripture after them are verily in hopeless doubt concerning it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falithalika faodAAu waistaqim kama omirta wala tattabiAA ahwaahum waqul amantu bima anzala Allahu min kitabin waomirtu liaAAdila baynakum Allahu rabbuna warabbukum lana aAAmaluna walakum aAAmalukum la hujjata baynana wabaynakumu Allahu yajmaAAu baynana wailayhi almaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto this, then, summon (O Muhammad). And be thou upright as thou art commanded, and follow not their lusts, but say: I believe in whatever scripture Allah hath sent down, and I am commanded to be just among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. Unto us our works and unto you your works; no argument between us and you. Allah will bring us together, and unto Him is the journeying.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena yuhajjoona fee Allahi min baAAdi ma istujeeba lahu hujjatuhum dahidatun AAinda rabbihim waAAalayhim ghadabun walahum AAathabun shadeedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who argue concerning Allah after He hath been acknowledged, their argument hath no weight with their Lord, and wrath is upon them and theirs will be an awful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu allathee anzala alkitaba bialhaqqi waalmeezani wama yudreeka laAAalla alssaAAata qareebun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah it is Who hath revealed the Scripture with truth, and the Balance. How canst thou know? It may be that the Hour is nigh.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YastaAAjilu biha allatheena la yuminoona biha waallatheena amanoo mushfiqoona minha wayaAAlamoona annaha alhaqqu ala inna allatheena yumaroona fee alssaAAati lafee dalalin baAAeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who believe not therein seek to hasten it, while those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the Truth. Are not they who dispute, in doubt concerning the Hour, far astray?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu lateefun biAAibadihi yarzuqu man yashao wahuwa alqawiyyu alAAazeezu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah is gracious unto His slaves. He provideth for whom He will. And He is the Strong, the Mighty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man kana yureedu hartha alakhirati nazid lahu fee harthihi waman kana yureedu hartha alddunya nutihi minha wama lahu fee alakhirati min naseebin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whoso desireth the harvest of the Hereafter, We give him increase in its harvest. And whoso desireth the harvest of the world, We give him thereof, and he hath no portion in the Hereafter.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am lahum shurakao sharaAAoo lahum mina alddeeni ma lam yathan bihi Allahu walawla kalimatu alfasli laqudiya baynahum wainna alththalimeena lahum AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or have they partners (of Allah) who have made lawful for them in religion that which Allah allowed not? And but for a decisive word (gone forth already), it would have been judged between them. Lo! for wrong-doers is a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tara alththalimeena mushfiqeena mimma kasaboo wahuwa waqiAAun bihim waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fee rawdati aljannati lahum ma yashaoona AAinda rabbihim thalika huwa alfadlu alkabeeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thou seest the wrong-doers fearful of that which they have earned, and it will surely befall them, while those who believe and do good works (will be) in flowering meadows of the Gardens, having what they wish from their Lord. This is the great preferment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika allathee yubashshiru Allahu AAibadahu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati qul la asalukum AAalayhi ajran illa almawaddata fee alqurba waman yaqtarif hasanatan nazid lahu feeha husnan inna Allaha ghafoorun shakoorun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This it is which Allah announceth unto His bondmen who believe and do good works. Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee therefor, save lovingkindness among kinsfolk. And whoso scoreth a good deed We add unto its good for him. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Responsive.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am yaqooloona iftara AAala Allahi kathiban fain yashai Allahu yakhtim AAala qalbika wayamhu Allahu albatila wayuhiqqu alhaqqa bikalimatihi innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or say they: He hath invented a lie concerning Allah? If Allah willed, He could have sealed thy heart (against them). And Allah will wipe out the lie and will vindicate the truth by His words. Lo! He is Aware of what is hidden in the breasts (of men).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee yaqbalu alttawbata AAan AAibadihi wayaAAfoo AAani alssayyiati wayaAAlamu ma tafAAaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who accepteth repentance from His bondmen, and pardoneth the evil deeds, and knoweth what ye do,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayastajeebu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati wayazeeduhum min fadlihi waalkafiroona lahum AAathabun shadeedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And accepteth those who do good works, and giveth increase unto them of His bounty. And as for disbelievers, theirs will be an awful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw basata Allahu alrrizqa liAAibadihi labaghaw fee alardi walakin yunazzilu biqadarin ma yashao innahu biAAibadihi khabeerun baseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if Allah were to enlarge the provision for His slaves they would surely rebel in the earth, but He sendeth down by measure as He willeth. Lo! He is Informed, a Seer of His bondmen.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee yunazzilu alghaytha min baAAdi ma qanatoo wayanshuru rahmatahu wahuwa alwaliyyu alhameedu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who sendeth down the saving rain after they have despaired, and spreadeth out His mercy. He is the Protecting Friend, the Praiseworthy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamin ayatihi khalqu alssamawati waalardi wama baththa feehima min dabbatin wahuwa AAala jamAAihim itha yashao qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of His portents is the creation of the heaven and the earth, and of whatever beasts He hath dispersed therein. And He is Able to gather them when He will.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama asabakum min museebatin fabima kasabat aydeekum wayaAAfoo AAan katheerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whatever of misfortune striketh you, it is what your right hands have earned. And He forgiveth much.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama antum bimuAAjizeena fee alardi wama lakum min dooni Allahi min waliyyin wala naseerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ye cannot escape in the earth, for beside Allah ye have no protecting friend nor any helper.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamin ayatihi aljawari fee albahri kaalaAAlami}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And of His portents are the ships, like banners on the sea;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In yasha yuskini alrreeha fayathlalna rawakida AAala thahrihi inna fee thalika laayatin likulli sabbarin shakoorin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If He will He calmeth the wind so that they keep still upon its surface - Lo! herein verily are signs for every steadfast grateful (heart). -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw yoobiqhunna bima kasaboo wayaAAfu AAan katheerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or He causeth them to perish on account of that which they have earned - And He forgiveth much -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WayaAAlama allatheena yujadiloona fee ayatina ma lahum min maheesin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that those who argue concerning Our revelations may know they have no refuge.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama ooteetum min shayin famataAAu alhayati alddunya wama AAinda Allahi khayrun waabqa lillatheena amanoo waAAala rabbihim yatawakkaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Now whatever ye have been given is but a passing comfort for the life of the world, and that which Allah hath is better and more lasting for those who believe and put their trust in their Lord,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena yajtaniboona kabaira alithmi waalfawahisha waitha ma ghadiboo hum yaghfiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who shun the worst of sins and indecencies and, when they are wroth, forgive,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena istajaboo lirabbihim waaqamoo alssalata waamruhum shoora baynahum wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who answer the call of their Lord and establish worship, and whose affairs are a matter of counsel, and who spend of what We have bestowed on them,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena itha asabahumu albaghyu hum yantasiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who, when great wrong is done to them, defend themselves,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajazao sayyiatin sayyiatun mithluha faman AAafa waaslaha faajruhu AAala Allahi innahu la yuhibbu alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The guerdon of an ill-deed is an ill the like thereof. But whosoever pardoneth and amendeth, his wage is the affair of Allah. Lo! He loveth not wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamani intasara baAAda thulmihi faolaika ma AAalayhim min sabeelin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whoso defendeth himself after he hath suffered wrong - for such, there is no way (of blame) against them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama alssabeelu AAala allatheena yathlimoona alnnasa wayabghoona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi olaika lahum AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The way (of blame) is only against those who oppress mankind, and wrongfully rebel in the earth. For such there is a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaman sabara waghafara inna thalika lamin AAazmi alomoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily whoso is patient and forgiveth - lo! that, verily, is (of) the steadfast heart of things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min waliyyin min baAAdihi watara alththalimeena lamma raawoo alAAathaba yaqooloona hal ila maraddin min sabeelin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no protecting friend after Him. And thou (Muhammad) wilt see the evil-doers when they see the doom, (how) they say: Is there any way of return?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watarahum yuAAradoona AAalayha khashiAAeena mina alththulli yanthuroona min tarfin khafiyyin waqala allatheena amanoo inna alkhasireena allatheena khasiroo anfusahum waahleehim yawma alqiyamati ala inna alththalimeena fee AAathabin muqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thou wilt see them exposed to (the Fire), made humble by disgrace, and looking with veiled eyes. And those who believe will say: Lo! the (eternal) losers are they who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Lo! are not the wrong-doers in perpetual torment?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama kana lahum min awliyaa yansuroonahum min dooni Allahi waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min sabeelin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they will have no protecting friends to help them instead of Allah. He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no road.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Istajeeboo lirabbikum min qabli an yatiya yawmun la maradda lahu mina Allahi ma lakum min maljain yawmaithin wama lakum min nakeerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Answer the call of your Lord before there cometh unto you from Allah a Day which there is no averting. Ye have no refuge on that Day, nor have a ye any (power of) refusal.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain aAAradoo fama arsalnaka AAalayhim hafeethan in AAalayka illa albalaghu wainna itha athaqna alinsana minna rahmatan fariha biha wain tusibhum sayyiatun bima qaddamat aydeehim fainna alinsana kafoorun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But if they are averse, We have not sent thee as a warder over them. Thine is only to convey (the message). And lo! when We cause man to taste of mercy from Us he exulteth therefor. And if some evil striketh them because of that which their own hands have sent before, then lo! man is an ingrate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi yakhluqu ma yashao yahabu liman yashao inathan wayahabu liman yashao alththukoora}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He createth what He will. He bestoweth female (offspring) upon whom He will, and bestoweth male (offspring) upon whom He will;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw yuzawwijuhum thukranan wainathan wayajAAalu man yashao AAaqeeman innahu AAaleemun qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or He mingleth them, males and females, and He maketh barren whom He will. Lo! He is Knower, Powerful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama kana libasharin an yukallimahu Allahu illa wahyan aw min warai hijabin aw yursila rasoolan fayoohiya biithnihi ma yashao innahu AAaliyyun hakeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And it was not (vouchsafed) to any mortal that Allah should speak to him unless (it be) by revelation or from behind a veil, or (that) He sendeth a messenger to reveal what He will by His leave. Lo! He is Exalted, Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakathalika awhayna ilayka roohan min amrina ma kunta tadree ma alkitabu wala aleemanu walakin jaAAalnahu nooran nahdee bihi man nashao min AAibadina wainnaka latahdee ila siratin mustaqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thus have We inspired in thee (Muhammad) a Spirit of Our command. Thou knewest not what the Scripture was, nor what the Faith. But We have made it a light whereby We guide whom We will of Our bondmen. And lo! thou verily dost guide unto a right path,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[42][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sirati Allahi allathee lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi ala ila Allahi taseeru alomooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The path of Allah, unto Whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Do not all things reach Allah at last?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Az-Zukhruf (Gold)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hameem}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ha. Mim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalkitabi almubeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By the Scripture which maketh plain,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna jaAAalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan laAAallakum taAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have appointed it a Lecture, in Arabic that haply ye may understand.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnahu fee ommi alkitabi ladayna laAAaliyyun hakeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Lo! in the Source of Decrees, which We possess, it is indeed sublime, decisive.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afanadribu AAankumu alththikra safhan an kuntum qawman musrifeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Shall We utterly ignore you because ye are a wanton folk?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakam arsalna min nabiyyin fee alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How many a prophet did We send among the men of old!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yateehim min nabiyyin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And never came there unto them a prophet but they used to mock him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faahlakna ashadda minhum batshan wamada mathalu alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then We destroyed men mightier than these in prowess; and the example of the men of old hath gone (before them).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna khalaqahunna alAAazeezu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if thou (Muhammad) ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth, they will surely answer: The Mighty, the Knower created them;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wajaAAala lakum feeha subulan laAAallakum tahtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who made the earth a resting-place for you, and placed roads for you therein, that haply ye may find your way;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallathee nazzala mina alssamai maan biqadarin faansharna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika tukhrajoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Who sendeth down water from the sky in (due) measure, and We revive a dead land therewith. Even so will ye be brought forth;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha wajaAAala lakum mina alfulki waalanAAami ma tarkaboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He Who created all the pairs, and appointed for you ships and cattle whereupon ye ride.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Litastawoo AAala thuhoorihi thumma tathkuroo niAAmata rabbikum itha istawaytum AAalayhi wataqooloo subhana allathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That ye may mount upon their backs, and may remember your Lord's favour when ye mount thereon, and may say: Glorified be He Who hath subdued these unto us, and we were not capable (of subduing them);}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna ila rabbina lamunqaliboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! unto our Lord we surely are returning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAaloo lahu min AAibadihi juzan inna alinsana lakafoorun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they allot to Him a portion of His bondmen! Lo! man is verily a mere ingrate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ami ittakhatha mimma yakhluqu banatin waasfakum bialbaneena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or chooseth He daughters of all that He hath created, and honoureth He you with sons?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha bushshira ahaduhum bima daraba lilrrahmani mathalan thalla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa katheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if one of them hath tidings of that which he likeneth to the Beneficent One, his countenance becometh black and he is full of inward rage.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awaman yunashshao fee alhilyati wahuwa fee alkhisami ghayru mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Liken they then to Allah) that which is bred up in outward show, and in dispute cannot make itself plain?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAaloo almalaikata allatheena hum AAibadu alrrahmani inathan ashahidoo khalqahum satuktabu shahadatuhum wayusaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they make the angels, who are the slaves of the Beneficent, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded and they will be questioned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo law shaa alrrahmanu ma AAabadnahum ma lahum bithalika min AAilmin in hum illa yakhrusoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: If the Beneficent One had (so) willed, we should not have worshipped them. They have no knowledge whatsoever of that. They do but guess.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am ataynahum kitaban min qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or have We given them any scripture before (this Qur'an) so that they are holding fast thereto?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal qaloo inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muhtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, for they say only: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are guided by their footprints.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakathalika ma arsalna min qablika fee qaryatin min natheerin illa qala mutrafooha inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muqtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And even so We sent not a warner before thee (Muhammad) into any township but its luxurious ones said: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are following their footprints.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala awalaw jitukum biahda mimma wajadtum AAalayhi abaakum qaloo inna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And the warner) said: What! Even though I bring you better guidance than that ye found your fathers following? They answered: Lo! in what ye bring we are disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faintaqamna minhum faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almukaththibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So We requited them. Then see the nature of the consequence for the rejecters!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith qala ibraheemu liabeehi waqawmihi innanee baraon mimma taAAbudoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Abraham said unto his father and his folk: Lo! I am innocent of what ye worship}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa allathee fataranee fainnahu sayahdeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save Him Who did create me, for He will surely guide me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalaha kalimatan baqiyatan fee AAaqibihi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he made it a word enduring among his seed, that haply they might return.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal mattaAAtu haolai waabaahum hatta jaahumu alhaqqu warasoolun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but I let these and their fathers enjoy life (only) till there should come unto them the Truth and a messenger making plain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma jaahumu alhaqqu qaloo hatha sihrun wainna bihi kafiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And now that the Truth hath come unto them they say: This is mere magic, and lo! we are disbelievers therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo lawla nuzzila hatha alquranu AAala rajulin mina alqaryatayni AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: If only this Qur'an had been revealed to some great man of the two towns?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbika nahnu qasamna baynahum maAAeeshatahum fee alhayati alddunya warafaAAna baAAdahum fawqa baAAdin darajatin liyattakhitha baAAduhum baAAdan sukhriyyan warahmatu rabbika khayrun mimma yajmaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is it they who apportion thy Lord's mercy? We have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of the world, and raised some of them above others in rank that some of them may take labour from others; and the mercy of thy Lord is better than (the wealth) that they amass.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walawla an yakoona alnnasu ommatan wahidatan lajaAAalna liman yakfuru bialrrahmani libuyootihim suqufan min fiddatin wamaAAarija AAalayha yathharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And were it not that mankind would have become one community, We might well have appointed, for those who disbelieve in the Beneficent, roofs of silver for their houses and stairs (of silver) whereby to mount,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walibuyootihim abwaban wasururan AAalayha yattakioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And for their houses doors (of silver) and couches of silver whereon to recline,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wazukhrufan wain kullu thalika lamma mataAAu alhayati alddunya waalakhiratu AAinda rabbika lilmuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And ornaments of gold. Yet all that would have been but a provision of the life of the world. And the Hereafter with your Lord would have been for those who keep from evil.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman yaAAshu AAan thikri alrrahmani nuqayyid lahu shaytanan fahuwa lahu qareenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he whose sight is dim to the remembrance of the Beneficent, We assign unto him a devil who becometh his comrade;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnahum layasuddoonahum AAani alssabeeli wayahsaboona annahum muhtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! they surely turn them from the way of Allah, and yet they deem that they are rightly guided;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatta itha jaana qala ya layta baynee wabaynaka buAAda almashriqayni fabisa alqareenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Till, when he cometh unto Us, he saith (unto his comrade): Ah, would that between me and thee there were the distance of the two horizons - an evil comrade!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walan yanfaAAakumu alyawma ith thalamtum annakum fee alAAathabi mushtarikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And it profiteth you not this day, because ye did wrong, that ye will be sharers in the doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaanta tusmiAAu alssumma aw tahdee alAAumya waman kana fee dalalin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Canst thou (Muhammad) make the deaf to hear, or canst thou guide the blind or him who is in error manifest?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faimma nathhabanna bika fainna minhum muntaqimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if We take thee away, We surely shall take vengeance on them,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw nuriyannaka allathee waAAadnahum fainna AAalayhim muqtadiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or (if) We show thee that wherewith We threaten them; for lo! We have complete command of them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faistamsik biallathee oohiya ilayka innaka AAala siratin mustaqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So hold thou fast to that which is inspired in thee. Lo! thou art on a right path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnahu lathikrun laka waliqawmika wasawfa tusaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! it is in truth a Reminder for thee and for thy folk; and ye will be questioned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waisal man arsalna min qablika min rusulina ajaAAalna min dooni alrrahmani alihatan yuAAbadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And ask those of Our messengers whom We sent before thee: Did We ever appoint gods to be worshipped beside the Beneficent?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad arsalna moosa biayatina ila firAAawna wamalaihi faqala innee rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma jaahum biayatina itha hum minha yadhakoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But when he brought them Our tokens, behold! they laughed at them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama nureehim min ayatin illa hiya akbaru min okhtiha waakhathnahum bialAAathabi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And every token that We showed them was greater than its sister (token), and We grasped them with the torment, that haply they might turn again.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo ya ayyuha alsahiru odAAu lana rabbaka bima AAahida AAindaka innana lamuhtadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they said: O wizard! Entreat thy Lord for us by the pact that He hath made with thee. Lo! we verily will walk aright.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma kashafna AAanhumu alAAathaba itha hum yankuthoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But when We eased them of the torment, behold! they broke their word.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanada firAAawnu fee qawmihi qala ya qawmi alaysa lee mulku misra wahathihi alanharu tajree min tahtee afala tubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Pharaoh caused a proclamation to be made among his people saying: O my people! Is not mine the sovereignty of Egypt and these rivers flowing under me? Can ye not then discern?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am ana khayrun min hatha allathee huwa maheenun wala yakadu yubeenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} I am surely better than this fellow, who is despicable and can hardly make (his meaning) plain!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falawla olqiya AAalayhi aswiratun min thahabin aw jaa maAAahu almalaikatu muqtarineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Why, then, have armlets of gold not been set upon him, or angels sent along with him?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faistakhaffa qawmahu faataAAoohu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus he persuaded his people to make light (of Moses), and they obeyed him. Lo! they were a wanton folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma asafoona intaqamna minhum faaghraqnahum ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So, when they angered Us, We punished them and drowned them every one.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FajaAAalnahum salafan wamathalan lilakhireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We made them a thing past, and an example for those after (them).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma duriba ibnu maryama mathalan itha qawmuka minhu yasiddoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the son of Mary is quoted as an example, behold! the folk laugh out,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo aalihatuna khayrun am huwa ma daraboohu laka illa jadalan bal hum qawmun khasimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And say: Are our gods better, or is he? They raise not the objection save for argument. Nay! but they are a contentious folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In huwa illa AAabdun anAAamna AAalayhi wajaAAalnahu mathalan libanee israeela}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He is nothing but a slave on whom We bestowed favour, and We made him a pattern for the Children of Israel.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw nashao lajaAAalna minkum malaikatan fee alardi yakhlufoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And had We willed We could have set among you angels to be viceroys in the earth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnahu laAAilmun lilssaAAati fala tamtarunna biha waittabiAAooni hatha siratun mustaqeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! verily there is knowledge of the Hour. So doubt ye not concerning it, but follow Me. This is the right path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala yasuddannakumu alshshaytanu innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And let not Satan turn you aside. Lo! he is an open enemy for you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walamma jaa AAeesa bialbayyinati qala qad jitukum bialhikmati waliobayyina lakum baAAda allathee takhtalifoona feehi faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When Jesus came with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), he said: I have come unto you with wisdom, and to make plain some of that concerning which ye differ. So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha huwa rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a right path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena thalamoo min AAathabi yawmin aleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But the factions among them differed. Then woe unto those who do wrong from the doom of a painful day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hal yanthuroona illa alssaAAata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Await they aught save the Hour, that it shall come upon them suddenly, when they know not?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alakhillao yawmaithin baAAduhum libaAAdin AAaduwwun illa almuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Friends on that day will be foes one to another, save those who kept their duty (to Allah).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya AAibadi la khawfun AAalaykumu alyawma wala antum tahzanoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O My slaves! For you there is no fear this day, nor is it ye who grieve;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena amanoo biayatina wakanoo muslimeena}}
