\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Ye) who believed Our revelations and were self-surrendered,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Odkhuloo aljannata antum waazwajukum tuhbaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Enter the Garden, ye and your wives, to be made glad.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yutafu AAalayhim bisihafin min thahabin waakwabin wafeeha ma tashtaheehi alanfusu watalaththu alaAAyunu waantum feeha khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therein are brought round for them trays of gold and goblets, and therein is all that souls desire and eyes find sweet. And ye are immortal therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watilka aljannatu allatee oorithtumooha bima kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is the Garden which ye are made to inherit because of what ye used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lakum feeha fakihatun katheeratun minha takuloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therein for you is fruit in plenty whence to eat.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna almujrimeena fee AAathabi jahannama khalidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the guilty are immortal in hell's torment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yufattaru AAanhum wahum feehi mublisoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is not relaxed for them, and they despair therein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama thalamnahum walakin kanoo humu alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We wronged them not, but they it was who did the wrong.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanadaw ya maliku liyaqdi AAalayna rabbuka qala innakum makithoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they cry: O master! Let thy Lord make an end of us. He saith: Lo! here ye must remain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad jinakum bialhaqqi walakinna aktharakum lilhaqqi karihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We verily brought the Truth unto you, but ye were, most of you, averse to the Truth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am abramoo amran fainna mubrimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or do they determine any thing (against the Prophet)? Lo! We (also) are determining.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am yahsaboona anna la nasmaAAu sirrahum wanajwahum bala warusuluna ladayhim yaktuboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or deem they that We cannot hear their secret thoughts and private confidences? Nay, but Our envoys, present with them, do record.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul in kana lilrrahmani waladun faana awwalu alAAabideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad): If the Beneficent One hath a son, then, I shall be first among the worshippers. (But there is no son).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Subhana rabbi alssamawati waalardi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So let them flounder (in their talk) and play until they meet the Day which they are promised.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee fee alssamai ilahun wafee alardi ilahun wahuwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who in the heaven is Allah, and in the earth Allah. He is the Wise, the Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watabaraka allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma waAAindahu AAilmu alssaAAati wailayhi turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And blessed be He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, and with Whom is knowledge of the Hour, and unto Whom ye will be returned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala yamliku allatheena yadAAoona min doonihi alshshafaAAata illa man shahida bialhaqqi wahum yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those unto whom they cry instead of Him possess no power of intercession, saving him who beareth witness unto the Truth knowingly.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walain saaltahum man khalaqahum layaqoolunna Allahu faanna yufakoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if thou ask them who created them, they will surely say: Allah. How then are they turned away?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqeelihi yarabbi inna haolai qawmun la yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he saith: O my Lord! Lo! these are a folk who believe not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[43][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faisfah AAanhum waqul salamun fasawfa yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then bear with them (O Muhammad) and say: Peace. But they will come to know.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Ad-Dukhan (The Drought)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hameem}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ha. Mim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalkitabi almubeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By the Scripture that maketh plain}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna anzalnahu fee laylatin mubarakatin inna kunna munthireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Feeha yufraqu kullu amrin hakeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whereon every wise command is made clear}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Amran min AAindina inna kunna mursileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rahmatan min rabbika innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La ilaha illa huwa yuhyee wayumeetu rabbukum warabbu abaikumu alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal hum fee shakkin yalAAaboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but they play in doubt.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fairtaqib yawma tatee alssamao bidukhanin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yaghsha alnnasa hatha AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbana ikshif AAanna alAAathaba inna muminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Anna lahumu alththikra waqad jaahum rasoolun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma tawallaw AAanhu waqaloo muAAallamun majnoonun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna kashifoo alAAathabi qaleelan innakum AAaidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma nabtishu albatshata alkubra inna muntaqimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad fatanna qablahum qawma firAAawna wajaahum rasoolun kareemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{An addoo ilayya AAibada Allahi innee lakum rasoolun ameenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waan la taAAloo AAala Allahi innee ateekum bisultanin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnee AAuthtu birabbee warabbikum an tarjumooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain lam tuminoo lee faiAAtazilooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FadaAAa rabbahu anna haolai qawmun mujrimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faasri biAAibadee laylan innakum muttabaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waotruki albahra rahwan innahum jundun mughraqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kam tarakoo min jannatin waAAuyoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WazurooAAin wamaqamin kareemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the cornlands and the goodly sites}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WanaAAmatin kanoo feeha fakiheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And pleasant things wherein they took delight!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kathalika waawrathnaha qawman akhareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama bakat AAalayhimu alssamao waalardu wama kanoo munthareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad najjayna banee israeela mina alAAathabi almuheeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Min firAAawna innahu kana AAaliyan mina almusrifeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqadi ikhtarnahum AAala AAilmin AAala alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waataynahum mina alayati ma feehi balaon mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna haolai layaqooloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! these, forsooth, are saying:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In hiya illa mawtatuna aloola wama nahnu bimunshareena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaAAin waallatheena min qablihim ahlaknahum innahum kanoo mujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma khalaqnahuma illa bialhaqqi walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna yawma alfasli meeqatuhum ajmaAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma la yughnee mawlan AAan mawlan shayan wala hum yunsaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa man rahima Allahu innahu huwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna shajarata alzzaqqoomi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the tree of Zaqqum,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{TaAAamu alatheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The food of the sinner!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaalmuhli yaghlee fee albutooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaghalyi alhameemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As the seething of boiling water.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khuthoohu faiAAtiloohu ila sawai aljaheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma subboo fawqa rasihi min AAathabi alhameemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thuq innaka anta alAAazeezu alkareemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna hatha ma kuntum bihi tamtaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna almuttaqeena fee maqamin ameenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee jannatin waAAuyoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Amid gardens and watersprings,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yalbasoona min sundusin waistabraqin mutaqabileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kathalika wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YadAAoona feeha bikulli fakihatin amineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They call therein for every fruit in safety.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yathooqoona feeha almawta illa almawtata aloola wawaqahum AAathaba aljaheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fadlan min rabbika thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika laAAallahum yatathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[44][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fairtaqib innahum murtaqiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Jathiyah (The Kneeling)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hameem}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ha. Mim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna fee alssamawati waalardi laayatin lilmumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! in the heavens and the earth are portents for believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wafee khalqikum wama yabuththu min dabbatin ayatun liqawmin yooqinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in your creation, and all the beasts that He scattereth in the earth, are portents for a folk whose faith is sure.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waikhtilafi allayli waalnnahari wama anzala Allahu mina alssamai min rizqin faahya bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha watasreefi alrriyahi ayatun liqawmin yaAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the difference of night and day and the provision that Allah sendeth down from the sky and thereby quickeneth the earth after her death, and the ordering of the winds, are portents for a people who have sense.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tilka ayatu Allahi natlooha AAalayka bialhaqqi fabiayyi hadeethin baAAda Allahi waayatihi yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} These are the portents of Allah which We recite unto thee (Muhammad) with truth. Then in what fact, after Allah and His portents, will they believe?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waylun likulli affakin atheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Woe unto each sinful liar,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YasmaAAu ayati Allahi tutla AAalayhi thumma yusirru mustakbiran kaan lam yasmaAAha fabashshirhu biAAathabin aleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who heareth the revelations of Allah recited unto him, and then continueth in pride as though he heard them not. Give him tidings of a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha AAalima min ayatina shayan ittakhathaha huzuwan olaika lahum AAathabun muheenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when he knoweth aught of Our revelations he maketh it a jest. For such there is a shameful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Min waraihim jahannamu wala yughnee AAanhum ma kasaboo shayan wala ma ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi awliyaa walahum AAathabun AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Beyond them there is hell, and that which they have earned will naught avail them, nor those whom they have chosen for protecting friends beside Allah. Theirs will be an awful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha hudan waallatheena kafaroo biayati rabbihim lahum AAathabun min rijzin aleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is guidance. And those who disbelieve the revelations of their Lord, for them there is a painful doom of wrath.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu allathee sakhkhara lakumu albahra litajriya alfulku feehi biamrihi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah it is Who hath made the sea of service unto you that the ships may run thereon by His command, and that ye may seek of His bounty, and that haply ye may be thankful;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wasakhkhara lakum ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi jameeAAan minhu inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And hath made of service unto you whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; it is all from Him. Lo! herein verily are portents for a people who reflect.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul lillatheena amanoo yaghfiroo lillatheena la yarjoona ayyama Allahi liyajziya qawman bima kanoo yaksiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Tell those who believe to forgive those who hope not for the days of Allah; in order that He may requite folk what they used to earn.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man AAamila salihan falinafsihi waman asaa faAAalayha thumma ila rabbikum turjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whoso doeth right, it is for his soul, and whoso doeth wrong, it is against it. And afterward unto your Lord ye will be brought back.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad atayna banee israeela alkitaba waalhukma waalnnubuwwata warazaqnahum mina alttayyibati wafaddalnahum AAala alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily we gave the Children of Israel the Scripture and the Command and the Prophethood, and provided them with good things and favoured them above (all) peoples;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waataynahum bayyinatin mina alamri fama ikhtalafoo illa min baAAdi ma jaahumu alAAilmu baghyan baynahum inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And gave them plain commandments. And they differed not until after the knowledge came unto them, through rivalry among themselves. Lo! thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma jaAAalnaka AAala shareeAAatin mina alamri faittabiAAha wala tattabiAA ahwaa allatheena la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And now have We set thee (O Muhammad) on a clear road of (Our) commandment; so follow it, and follow not the whims of those who know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahum lan yughnoo AAanka mina Allahi shayan wainna alththalimeena baAAduhum awliyao baAAdin waAllahu waliyyu almuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! they can avail thee naught against Allah. And lo! as for the wrong-doers, some of them are friends of others; and Allah is the Friend of those who ward off (evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha basairu lilnnasi wahudan warahmatun liqawmin yooqinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is clear indication for mankind, and a guidance and a mercy for a folk whose faith is sure.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am hasiba allatheena ijtarahoo alssayyiati an najAAalahum kaallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sawaan mahyahum wamamatuhum saa ma yahkumoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or do those who commit ill-deeds suppose that We shall make them as those who believe and do good works, the same in life and death? Bad is their judgment!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakhalaqa Allahu alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi walitujza kullu nafsin bima kasabat wahum la yuthlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah hath created the heavens and the earth with truth, and that every soul may be repaid what it hath earned. And they will not be wronged.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaraayta mani ittakhatha ilahahu hawahu waadallahu Allahu AAala AAilmin wakhatama AAala samAAihi waqalbihi wajaAAala AAala basarihi ghishawatan faman yahdeehi min baAAdi Allahi afala tathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hast thou seen him who maketh his desire his god, and Allah sendeth him astray purposely, and sealeth up his hearing and his heart, and setteth on his sight a covering? Then who will lead him after Allah (hath condemned him)? Will ye not then heed?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo ma hiya illa hayatuna alddunya namootu wanahya wama yuhlikuna illa alddahru wama lahum bithalika min AAilmin in hum illa yathunnoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and naught destroyeth us save time; when they have no knowledge whatsoever of (all) that; they do but guess.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin ma kana hujjatahum illa an qaloo itoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them their only argument is that they say: Bring (back) our fathers. then, if ye are truthful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Quli Allahu yuhyeekum thumma yumeetukum thumma yajmaAAukum ila yawmi alqiyamati la rayba feehi walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Allah giveth life to you, then causeth you to die, then gathereth you unto the Day of Resurrection whereof there is no doubt. But most of mankind know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi wayawma taqoomu alssaAAatu yawmaithin yakhsaru almubtiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and on the day when the Hour riseth, on that day those who follow falsehood will be lost.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watara kulla ommatin jathiyatan kullu ommatin tudAAa ila kitabiha alyawma tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thou wilt see each nation crouching, each nation summoned to its record. (And it will be said unto them): This day ye are requited what ye used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha kitabuna yantiqu AAalaykum bialhaqqi inna kunna nastansikhu ma kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This Our Book pronounceth against you with truth. Lo! We have caused (all) that ye did to be recorded.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faamma allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fayudkhiluhum rabbuhum fee rahmatihi thalika huwa alfawzu almubeenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, as for those who believed and did good works, their Lord will bring them in unto His mercy. That is the evident triumph.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma allatheena kafaroo afalam takun ayatee tutla AAalaykum faistakbartum wakuntum qawman mujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And as for those who disbelieved (it will be said unto them): Were not Our revelations recited unto you? But ye were scornful and became a guilty folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha qeela inna waAAda Allahi haqqun waalssaAAatu la rayba feeha qultum ma nadree ma alssaAAatu in nathunnu illa thannan wama nahnu bimustayqineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when it was said: Lo! Allah's promise is the truth, and there is no doubt of the Hour's coming, ye said: We know not what the Hour is. We deem it naught but a conjecture, and we are by no means convinced.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wabada lahum sayyiatu ma AAamiloo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the evils of what they did will appear unto them, and that which they used to deride will befall them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqeela alyawma nansakum kama naseetum liqaa yawmikum hatha wamawakumu alnnaru wama lakum min nasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And it will be said: This day We forget you, even as ye forgot the meeting of this your day; and your habitation is the Fire, and there is none to help you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalikum biannakumu ittakhathtum ayati Allahi huzuwan wagharratkumu alhayatu alddunya faalyawma la yukhrajoona minha wala hum yustaAAtaboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This, forasmuch as ye made the revelations of Allah a jest, and the life of the world beguiled you. Therefor this day they come not forth from thence, nor can they make amends.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falillahi alhamdu rabbi alssamawati warabbi alardi rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, the Lord of the Worlds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[45][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walahu alkibriyao fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto Him (alone) belongeth Majesty in the heavens and the earth, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Ahqaf (The Sandhills)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hameem}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ha. Mim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi waajalin musamman waallatheena kafaroo AAamma onthiroo muAAridoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and for a term appointed. But those who disbelieve turn away from that whereof they are warned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul araaytum ma tadAAoona min dooni Allahi aroonee matha khalaqoo mina alardi am lahum shirkun fee alssamawati eetoonee bikitabin min qabli hatha aw atharatin min AAilmin in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Have ye thought on all that ye invoke beside Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth. Or have they any portion in the heavens? Bring me a scripture before this (Scripture), or some vestige of knowledge (in support of what ye say), if ye are truthful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman adallu mimman yadAAoo min dooni Allahi man la yastajeebu lahu ila yawmi alqiyamati wahum AAan duAAaihim ghafiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And who is further astray than those who, instead of Allah, pray unto such as hear not their prayer until the Day of Resurrection, and are unconscious of their prayer,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha hushira alnnasu kanoo lahum aAAdaan wakanoo biAAibadatihim kafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when mankind are gathered (to the Judgment) will become enemies for them, and will become deniers of having been worshipped.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena kafaroo lilhaqqi lamma jaahum hatha sihrun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say of the Truth when it reacheth them: This is mere magic.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am yaqooloona iftarahu qul ini iftaraytuhu fala tamlikoona lee mina Allahi shayan huwa aAAlamu bima tufeedoona feehi kafa bihi shaheedan baynee wabaynakum wahuwa alghafooru alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or say they: He hath invented it? Say (O Muhammad): If I have invented it, still ye have no power to support me against Allah. He is Best Aware of what ye say among yourselves concerning it. He sufficeth for a witness between me and you. And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul ma kuntu bidAAan mina alrrusuli wama adree ma yufAAalu bee wala bikum in attabiAAu illa ma yooha ilayya wama ana illa natheerun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: I am no new thing among the messengers (of Allah), nor know I what will be done with me or with you. I do but follow that which is inspired in me, and I am but a plain warner.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul araaytum in kana min AAindi Allahi wakafartum bihi washahida shahidun min banee israeela AAala mithlihi faamana waistakbartum inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Bethink you: If it is from Allah and ye disbelieve therein, and a witness of the Children of Israel hath already testified to the like thereof and hath believed, and ye are too proud (what plight is yours)? Lo! Allah guideth not wrong-doing folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo law kana khayran ma sabaqoona ilayhi waith lam yahtadoo bihi fasayaqooloona hatha ifkun qadeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who disbelieve say of those who believe: If it had been (any) good, they would not have been before us in attaining it. And since they will not be guided by it, they say: This is an ancient lie;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamin qablihi kitabu moosa imaman warahmatan wahatha kitabun musaddiqun lisanan AAarabiyyan liyunthira allatheena thalamoo wabushra lilmuhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When before it there was the Scripture of Moses, an example and a mercy; and this is a confirming Scripture in the Arabic language, that it may warn those who do wrong and bring good tidings for the righteous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena qaloo rabbuna Allahu thumma istaqamoo fala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who say: Our Lord is Allah, and thereafter walk aright, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika ashabu aljannati khalideena feeha jazaan bima kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such are rightful owners of the Garden, immortal therein, as a reward for what they used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wawassayna alinsana biwalidayhi ihsanan hamalathu ommuhu kurhan wawadaAAathu kurhan wahamluhu wafisaluhu thalathoona shahran hatta itha balagha ashuddahu wabalagha arbaAAeena sanatan qala rabbi awziAAnee an ashkura niAAmataka allatee anAAamta AAalayya waAAala walidayya waan aAAmala salihan tardahu waaslih lee fee thurriyyatee innee tubtu ilayka wainnee mina almuslimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We have commended unto man kindness toward parents. His mother beareth him with reluctance, and bringeth him forth with reluctance, and the bearing of him and the weaning of him is thirty months, till, when he attaineth full strength and reacheth forty years, he saith: My Lord! Arouse me that I may give thanks for the favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and that I may do right acceptable unto Thee. And be gracious unto me in the matter of my seed. Lo! I have turned unto Thee repentant, and lo! I am of those who surrender (unto Thee).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika allatheena nataqabbalu AAanhum ahsana ma AAamiloo wanatajawazu AAan sayyiatihim fee ashabi aljannati waAAda alssidqi allathee kanoo yooAAadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those are they from whom We accept the best of what they do, and overlook their evil deeds. (They are) among the owners of the Garden. This is the true promise which they were promised (in the world).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallathee qala liwalidayhi offin lakuma ataAAidaninee an okhraja waqad khalati alquroonu min qablee wahuma yastagheethani Allaha waylaka amin inna waAAda Allahi haqqun fayaqoolu ma hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whoso saith unto his parents: Fie upon you both! Do ye threaten me that I shall be brought forth (again) when generations before me have passed away? And they twain cry unto Allah for help (and say): Woe unto thee! Believe! Lo! the promise of Allah is true. But he saith: This is naught save fables of the men of old:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika allatheena haqqa AAalayhimu alqawlu fee umamin qad khalat min qablihim mina aljinni waalinsi innahum kanoo khasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such are those on whom the Word concerning nations of the jinn and mankind which have passed away before them hath effect. Lo! they are the losers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walikullin darajatun mimma AAamiloo waliyuwaffiyahum aAAmalahum wahum la yuthlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And for all there will be ranks from what they do, that He may pay them for their deeds; and they will not be wronged.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma yuAAradu allatheena kafaroo AAala alnnari athhabtum tayyibatikum fee hayatikumu alddunya waistamtaAAtum biha faalyawma tujzawna AAathaba alhooni bima kuntum tastakbiroona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi wabima kuntum tafsuqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And on the day when those who disbelieve are exposed to the Fire (it will be said): Ye squandered your good things in the life of the world and sought comfort therein. Now this day ye are rewarded with the doom of ignominy because ye were disdainful in the land without a right, and because ye used to transgress.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waothkur akha AAadin ith anthara qawmahu bialahqafi waqad khalati alnnuthuru min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi alla taAAbudoo illa Allaha innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And make mention (O Muhammad) of the brother of A'ad when he warned his folk among the wind-curved sandhills - and verily warners came and went before and after him - saying: Serve none but Allah. Lo! I fear for you the doom of a tremendous Day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ajitana litafikana AAan alihatina fatina bima taAAiduna in kunta mina alssadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Hast come to turn us away from our gods? Then bring upon us that wherewith thou threatenest us, if thou art of the truthful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala innama alAAilmu AAinda Allahi waoballighukum ma orsiltu bihi walakinnee arakum qawman tajhaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: The knowledge is with Allah only. I convey unto you that wherewith I have been sent, but I see you are a folk that know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma raawhu AAaridan mustaqbila awdiyatihim qaloo hatha AAaridun mumtiruna bal huwa ma istaAAjaltum bihi reehun feeha AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, when they beheld it as a dense cloud coming toward their valleys, they said: Here is a cloud bringing us rain. Nay, but it is that which ye did seek to hasten, a wind wherein is painful torment,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tudammiru kulla shayin biamri rabbiha faasbahoo la yura illa masakinuhum kathalika najzee alqawma almujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Destroying all things by commandment of its Lord. And morning found them so that naught could be seen save their dwellings. Thus do We reward the guilty folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad makkannahum feema in makkannakum feehi wajaAAalna lahum samAAan waabsaran waafidatan fama aghna AAanhum samAAuhum wala absaruhum wala afidatuhum min shayin ith kanoo yajhadoona biayati Allahi wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We had empowered them with that wherewith We have not empowered you, and had assigned them ears and eyes and hearts; but their ears and eyes and hearts availed them naught since they denied the revelations of Allah; and what they used to mock befell them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad ahlakna ma hawlakum mina alqura wasarrafna alayati laAAallahum yarjiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We have destroyed townships round about you, and displayed (for them) Our revelation, that haply they might return.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falawla nasarahumu allatheena ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi qurbanan alihatan bal dalloo AAanhum wathalika ifkuhum wama kanoo yaftaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then why did those whom they had chosen for gods as a way of approach (unto Allah) not help them? Nay, but they did fail them utterly. And (all) that was their lie, and what they used to invent.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith sarafna ilayka nafaran mina aljinni yastamiAAoona alqurana falamma hadaroohu qaloo ansitoo falamma qudiya wallaw ila qawmihim munthireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We inclined toward thee (Muhammad) certain of the jinn, who wished to hear the Qur'an and, when they were in its presence, said: Give ear! and, when it was finished, turned back to their people, warning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya qawmana inna samiAAna kitaban onzila min baAAdi moosa musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi yahdee ila alhaqqi waila tareeqin mustaqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: O our people! Lo! we have heard a scripture which hath been revealed after Moses, confirming that which was before it, guiding unto the truth and a right road.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya qawmana ajeeboo daAAiya Allahi waaminoo bihi yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayujirkum min AAathabin aleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O our people! respond to Allah's summoner and believe in Him. He will forgive you some of your sins and guard you from a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman la yujib daAAiya Allahi falaysa bimuAAjizin fee alardi walaysa lahu min doonihi awliyaa olaika fee dalalin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And whoso respondeth not to Allah's summoner he can nowise escape in the earth, and he hath no protecting friends instead of Him. Such are in error manifest.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yaraw anna Allaha allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda walam yaAAya bikhalqihinna biqadirin AAala an yuhyiya almawta bala innahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not seen that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth and was not wearied by their creation, is Able to give life to the dead? Aye, He verily is Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayawma yuAAradu allatheena kafaroo AAala alnnari alaysa hatha bialhaqqi qaloo bala warabbina qala fathooqoo alAAathaba bima kuntum takfuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And on the day when those who disbelieve are exposed to the Fire (they will be asked): Is not this real? They will say: Yea, by our Lord. He will say: Then taste the doom for that ye disbelieved.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[46][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faisbir kama sabara oloo alAAazmi mina alrrusuli wala tastaAAjil lahum kaannahum yawma yarawna ma yooAAadoona lam yalbathoo illa saAAatan min naharin balaghun fahal yuhlaku illa alqawmu alfasiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then have patience (O Muhammad) even as the stout of heart among the messengers (of old) had patience, and seek not to hasten on (the doom) for them. On the day when they see that which they are promised (it will seem to them) as though they had tarried but an hour of daylight. A clear message. Shall any be destroyed save evil-living folk?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Muhammad (Muhammad)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi adalla aAAmalahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who disbelieve and turn (men) from the way of Allah, He rendereth their actions vain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati waamanoo bima nuzzila AAala muhammadin wahuwa alhaqqu min rabbihim kaffara AAanhum sayyiatihim waaslaha balahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who believe and do good works and believe in that which is revealed unto Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He riddeth them of their ill-deeds and improveth their state.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika bianna allatheena kafaroo ittabaAAoo albatila waanna allatheena amanoo ittabaAAoo alhaqqa min rabbihim kathalika yadribu Allahu lilnnasi amthalahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood and because those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus Allah coineth their similitudes for mankind.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha laqeetumu allatheena kafaroo fadarba alrriqabi hatta itha athkhantumoohum fashuddoo alwathaqa faimma mannan baAAdu waimma fidaan hatta tadaAAa alharbu awzaraha thalika walaw yashao Allahu laintasara minhum walakin liyabluwa baAAdakum bibaAAdin waallatheena qutiloo fee sabeeli Allahi falan yudilla aAAmalahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Now when ye meet in battle those who disbelieve, then it is smiting of the necks until, when ye have routed them, then making fast of bonds; and afterward either grace or ransom till the war lay down its burdens. That (is the ordinance). And if Allah willed He could have punished them (without you) but (thus it is ordained) that He may try some of you by means of others. And those who are slain in the way of Allah, He rendereth not their actions vain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sayahdeehim wayuslihu balahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He will guide them and improve their state,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayudkhiluhumu aljannata AAarrafaha lahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And bring them in unto the Garden which He hath made known to them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in tansuroo Allaha yansurkum wayuthabbit aqdamakum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! If ye help Allah, He will help you and will make your foothold firm.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena kafaroo fataAAsan lahum waadalla aAAmalahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who disbelieve, perdition is for them, and He will make their actions vain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika biannahum karihoo ma anzala Allahu faahbata aAAmalahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That is because they are averse to that which Allah hath revealed, therefor maketh He their actions fruitless.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim dammara Allahu AAalayhim walilkafireena amthaluha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not travelled in the land to see the nature of the consequence for those who were before them? Allah wiped them out. And for the disbelievers there will be the like thereof.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika bianna Allaha mawla allatheena amanoo waanna alkafireena la mawla lahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That is because Allah is patron of those who believe, and because the disbelievers have no patron.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha yudkhilu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu waallatheena kafaroo yatamattaAAoona wayakuloona kama takulu alanAAamu waalnnaru mathwan lahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah will cause those who believe and do good works to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow; while those who disbelieve take their comfort in this life and eat even as the cattle eat, and the Fire is their habitation.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakaayyin min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quwwatan min qaryatika allatee akhrajatka ahlaknahum fala nasira lahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And how many a township stronger than thy township (O Muhammad) which hath cast thee out, have We destroyed, and they had no helper!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaman kana AAala bayyinatin min rabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu sooo AAamalihi waittabaAAoo ahwaahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is he who relieth on a clear proof from his Lord like those for whom the evil that they do is beautified while they follow their own lusts?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Mathalu aljannati allatee wuAAida almuttaqoona feeha anharun min main ghayri asinin waanharun min labanin lam yataghayyar taAAmuhu waanharun min khamrin laththatin lilshsharibeena waanharun min AAasalin musaffan walahum feeha min kulli alththamarati wamaghfiratun min rabbihim kaman huwa khalidun fee alnnari wasuqoo maan hameeman faqattaAAa amAAaahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A similitude of the Garden which those who keep their duty (to Allah) are promised: Therein are rivers of water unpolluted, and rivers of milk whereof the flavour changeth not, and rivers of wine delicious to the drinkers, and rivers of clear-run honey; therein for them is every kind of fruit, with pardon from their Lord. (Are those who enjoy all this) like those who are immortal in the Fire and are given boiling water to drink so that it teareth their bowels?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waminhum man yastamiAAu ilayka hatta itha kharajoo min AAindika qaloo lillatheena ootoo alAAilma matha qala anifan olaika allatheena tabaAAa Allahu AAala quloobihim waittabaAAoo ahwaahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Among them are some who give ear unto thee (Muhammad) till, when they go forth from thy presence they say unto those who have been given knowledge: What was that he said just now? Those are they whose hearts Allah hath sealed, and they follow their own lusts.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena ihtadaw zadahum hudan waatahum taqwahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} While as for those who walk aright, He addeth to their guidance, and giveth them their protection (against evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fahal yanthuroona illa alssaAAata an tatiyahum baghtatan faqad jaa ashratuha faanna lahum itha jaathum thikrahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Await they aught save the Hour, that it should come upon them unawares? And the beginnings thereof have already come. But how, when it hath come upon them, can they take their warning?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaiAAlam annahu la ilaha illa Allahu waistaghfir lithanbika walilmumineena waalmuminati waAllahu yaAAlamu mutaqallabakum wamathwakum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So know (O Muhammad) that there is no Allah save Allah, and ask forgiveness for thy sin and for believing men and believing women. Allah knoweth (both) your place of turmoil and your place of rest.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayaqoolu allatheena amanoo lawla nuzzilat sooratun faitha onzilat sooratun muhkamatun wathukira feeha alqitalu raayta allatheena fee quloobihim maradun yanthuroona ilayka nathara almaghshiyyi AAalayhi mina almawti faawla lahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who believe say: If only a surah were revealed! But when a decisive surah is revealed and war is mentioned therein, thou seest those in whose hearts is a disease looking at thee with the look of men fainting unto death. Therefor woe unto them!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{TaAAatun waqawlun maAAroofun faitha AAazama alamru falaw sadaqoo Allaha lakana khayran lahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Obedience and a civil word. Then, when the matter is determined, if they are loyal to Allah it will be well for them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fahal AAasaytum in tawallaytum an tufsidoo fee alardi watuqattiAAoo arhamakum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Would ye then, if ye were given the command, work corruption in the land and sever your ties of kinship?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika allatheena laAAanahumu Allahu faasammahum waaAAma absarahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such are they whom Allah curseth so that He deafeneth them and maketh blind their eyes.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afala yatadabbaroona alqurana am AAala quloobin aqfaluha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Will they then not meditate on the Qur'an, or are there locks on the hearts?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena irtaddoo AAala adbarihim min baAAdi ma tabayyana lahumu alhuda alshshaytanu sawwala lahum waamla lahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who turn back after the guidance hath been manifested unto them, Satan hath seduced them, and He giveth them the rein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika biannahum qaloo lillatheena karihoo ma nazzala Allahu sanuteeAAukum fee baAAdi alamri waAllahu yaAAlamu israrahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That is because they say unto those who hate what Allah hath revealed: We will obey you in some matters; and Allah knoweth their secret talk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakayfa itha tawaffathumu almalaikatu yadriboona wujoohahum waadbarahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then how (will it be with them) when the angels gather them, smiting their faces and their backs!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika biannahumu ittabaAAoo ma askhata Allaha wakarihoo ridwanahu faahbata aAAmalahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That will be because they followed that which angereth Allah, and hated that which pleaseth Him. Therefor He hath made their actions vain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am hasiba allatheena fee quloobihim maradun an lan yukhrija Allahu adghanahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or do those in whose hearts is a disease deem that Allah will not bring to light their (secret) hates?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw nashao laaraynakahum falaAAaraftahum biseemahum walataAArifannahum fee lahni alqawli waAllahu yaAAlamu aAAmalakum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if We would, We could show them unto thee (Muhammad) so that thou shouldst know them surely by their marks. And thou shalt know them by the burden of their talk. And Allah knoweth your deeds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walanabluwannakum hatta naAAlama almujahideena minkum waalssabireena wanabluwa akhbarakum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We shall try you till We know those of you who strive hard (for the cause of Allah) and the steadfast, and till We test your record.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi washaqqoo alrrasoola min baAAdi ma tabayyana lahumu alhuda lan yaduroo Allaha shayan wasayuhbitu aAAmalahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who disbelieve and turn from the way of Allah and oppose the messenger after the guidance hath been manifested unto them, they hurt Allah not a jot, and He will make their actions fruitless.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ateeAAoo Allaha waateeAAoo alrrasoola wala tubtiloo aAAmalakum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Obey Allah and obey the messenger, and render not your actions vain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi thumma matoo wahum kuffarun falan yaghfira Allahu lahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who disbelieve and turn from the way of Allah and then die disbelievers, Allah surely will not pardon them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala tahinoo watadAAoo ila alssalmi waantumu alaAAlawna waAllahu maAAakum walan yatirakum aAAmalakum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So do not falter and cry out for peace when ye (will be) the uppermost, and Allah is with you, and He will not grudge (the reward of) your actions.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][36]
\end{Arabic}}
