\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama alhayatu alddunya laAAibun walahwun wain tuminoo watattaqoo yutikum ojoorakum wala yasalkum amwalakum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The life of the world is but a sport and a pastime. And if ye believe and ward off (evil). He will give you your wages, and will not ask of you your wordly wealth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In yasalkumooha fayuhfikum tabkhaloo wayukhrij adghanakum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If He should ask it of you and importune you, ye would hoard it, and He would bring to light your (secret) hates.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[47][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Haantum haolai tudAAawna litunfiqoo fee sabeeli Allahi faminkum man yabkhalu waman yabkhal fainnama yabkhalu AAan nafsihi waAllahu alghaniyyu waantumu alfuqarao wain tatawallaw yastabdil qawman ghayrakum thumma la yakoonoo amthalakum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! ye are those who are called to spend in the way of Allah, yet among you there are some who hoard. And as for him who hoardeth, he hoardeth only from his soul. And Allah is the Rich, and ye are the poor. And if ye turn away He will exchange you for some other folk, and they will not be the likes of you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Fath (The Victory)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna fatahna laka fathan mubeenan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have given thee (O Muhammad) a signal victory,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyaghfira laka Allahu ma taqaddama min thanbika wama taakhkhara wayutimma niAAmatahu AAalayka wayahdiyaka siratan mustaqeeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That Allah may forgive thee of thy sin that which is past and that which is to come, and may perfect His favour unto thee, and may guide thee on a right path,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayansuraka Allahu nasran AAazeezan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that Allah may help thee with strong help -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa allathee anzala alssakeenata fee quloobi almumineena liyazdadoo eemanan maAAa eemanihim walillahi junoodu alssamawati waalardi wakana Allahu AAaleeman hakeeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who sent down peace of reassurance into the hearts of the believers that they might add faith unto their faith. Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Knower, Wise -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyudkhila almumineena waalmuminati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wayukaffira AAanhum sayyiatihim wakana thalika AAinda Allahi fawzan AAatheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That He may bring the believing men and the believing women into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide, and may remit from them their evil deeds - That, in the sight of Allah, is the supreme triumph -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WayuAAaththiba almunafiqeena waalmunafiqati waalmushrikeena waalmushrikati alththanneena biAllahi thanna alssawi AAalayhim dairatu alssawi waghadiba Allahu AAalayhim walaAAanahum waaAAadda lahum jahannama wasaat maseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And may punish the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women, and the idolatrous men and the idolatrous women, who think an evil thought concerning Allah. For them is the evil turn of fortune, and Allah is wroth against them and hath cursed them, and hath made ready for them hell, a hapless journey's end.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walillahi junoodu alssamawati waalardi wakana Allahu AAazeezan hakeeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Mighty, Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna arsalnaka shahidan wamubashshiran wanatheeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have sent thee (O Muhammad) as a witness and a bearer of good tidings and a warner,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lituminoo biAllahi warasoolihi watuAAazziroohu watuwaqqiroohu watusabbihoohu bukratan waaseelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That ye (mankind) may believe in Allah and His messenger, and may honour Him, and may revere Him, and may glorify Him at early dawn and at the close of day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena yubayiAAoonaka innama yubayiAAoona Allaha yadu Allahi fawqa aydeehim faman nakatha fainnama yankuthu AAala nafsihi waman awfa bima AAahada AAalayhu Allaha fasayuteehi ajran AAatheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who swear allegiance unto thee (Muhammad), swear allegiance only unto Allah. The Hand of Allah is above their hands. So whosoever breaketh his oath, breaketh it only to his soul's hurt; while whosoever keepeth his covenant with Allah, on him will He bestow immense reward.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sayaqoolu laka almukhallafoona mina alaAArabi shaghalatna amwaluna waahloona faistaghfir lana yaqooloona bialsinatihim ma laysa fee quloobihim qul faman yamliku lakum mina Allahi shayan in arada bikum darran aw arada bikum nafAAan bal kana Allahu bima taAAmaloona khabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those of the wandering Arabs who were left behind will tell thee: Our possessions and our households occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us! They speak with their tongues that which is not in their hearts. Say: Who can avail you aught against Allah, if He intend you hurt or intend you profit? Nay, but Allah is ever Aware of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal thanantum an lan yanqaliba alrrasoolu waalmuminoona ila ahleehim abadan wazuyyina thalika fee quloobikum wathanantum thanna alssawi wakuntum qawman booran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but ye deemed that the messenger and the believers would never return to their own folk, and that was made fairseeming in your hearts, and ye did think an evil thought, and ye were worthless folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman lam yumin biAllahi warasoolihi fainna aAAtadna lilkafireena saAAeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And so for him who believeth not in Allah and His messenger - Lo! We have prepared a flame for disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi yaghfiru liman yashao wayuAAaththibu man yashao wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah's is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He forgiveth whom He will, and punisheth whom He will. And Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sayaqoolu almukhallafoona itha intalaqtum ila maghanima litakhuthooha tharoona nattabiAAkum yureedoona an yubaddiloo kalama Allahi qul lan tattabiAAoona kathalikum qala Allahu min qablu fasayaqooloona bal tahsudoonana bal kanoo la yafqahoona illa qaleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who were left behind will say, when ye set forth to capture booty: Let us go with you. They fain would change the verdict of Allah. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye shall not go with us. Thus hath Allah said beforehand. Then they will say: Ye are envious of us. Nay, but they understand not, save a little.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul lilmukhallafeena mina alaAArabi satudAAawna ila qawmin olee basin shadeedin tuqatiloonahum aw yuslimoona fain tuteeAAoo yutikumu Allahu ajran hasanan wain tatawallaw kama tawallaytum min qablu yuAAaththibkum AAathaban aleeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say unto those of the wandering Arabs who were left behind: Ye will be called against a folk of mighty prowess, to fight them until they surrender; and if ye obey, Allah will give you a fair reward; but if ye turn away as ye did turn away before, He will punish you with a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laysa AAala alaAAma harajun wala AAala alaAAraji harajun wala AAala almareedi harajun waman yutiAAi Allaha warasoolahu yudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu waman yatawalla yuAAaththibhu AAathaban aleeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There is no blame for the blind, nor is there blame for the lame, nor is there blame for the sick (that they go not forth to war). And whoso obeyeth Allah and His messenger, He will make him enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow; and whoso turneth back, him will He punish with a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad radiya Allahu AAani almumineena ith yubayiAAoonaka tahta alshshajarati faAAalima ma fee quloobihim faanzala alsakeenata AAalayhim waathabahum fathan qareeban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah was well pleased with the believers when they swore allegiance unto thee beneath the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, and He sent down peace of reassurance on them, and hath rewarded them with a near victory;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamaghanima katheeratan yakhuthoonaha wakana Allahu AAazeezan hakeeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And much booty that they will capture. Allah is ever Mighty, Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAadakumu Allahu maghanima katheeratan takhuthoonaha faAAajjala lakum hathihi wakaffa aydiya alnnasi AAankum walitakoona ayatan lilmumineena wayahdiyakum siratan mustaqeeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah promiseth you much booty that ye will capture, and hath given you this in advance, and hath withheld men's hands from you, that it may be a token for the believers, and that He may guide you on a right path.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waokhra lam taqdiroo AAalayha qad ahata Allahu biha wakana Allahu AAala kulli shayin qadeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And other (gain), which ye have not been able to achieve, Allah will compass it, Allah is Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw qatalakumu allatheena kafaroo lawallawoo aladbara thumma la yajidoona waliyyan wala naseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if those who disbelieve join battle with you they will take to flight, and afterward they will find no protecting friend nor helper.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sunnata Allahi allatee qad khalat min qablu walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is the law of Allah which hath taken course aforetime. Thou wilt not find for the law of Allah aught of power to change.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa allathee kaffa aydiyahum AAankum waaydiyakum AAanhum bibatni makkata min baAAdi an athfarakum AAalayhim wakana Allahu bima taAAmaloona baseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He it is Who hath withheld men's hands from you, and hath withheld your hands from them, in the valley of Mecca, after He had made you victors over them. Allah is Seer of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Humu allatheena kafaroo wasaddookum AAani almasjidi alharami waalhadya maAAkoofan an yablugha mahillahu walawla rijalun muminoona wanisaon muminatun lam taAAlamoohum an tataoohum fatuseebakum minhum maAAarratun bighayri AAilmin liyudkhila Allahu fee rahmatihi man yashao law tazayyaloo laAAaththabna allatheena kafaroo minhum AAathaban aleeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} These it was who disbelieved and debarred you from the Inviolable Place of Worship, and debarred the offering from reaching its goal. And if it had not been for believing men and believing women, whom ye know not - lest ye should tread them under foot and thus incur guilt for them unknowingly; that Allah might bring into His mercy whom He will - If (the believers and the disbelievers) had been clearly separated We verily had punished those of them who disbelieved with painful punishment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith jaAAala allatheena kafaroo fee quloobihimu alhamiyyata hamiyyata aljahiliyyati faanzala Allahu sakeenatahu AAala rasoolihi waAAala almumineena waalzamahum kalimata alttaqwa wakanoo ahaqqa biha waahlaha wakana Allahu bikulli shayin AAaleeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When those who disbelieve had set up in their hearts zealotry, the zealotry of the Age of Ignorance, then Allah sent down His peace of reassurance upon His messenger and upon the believers and imposed on them the word of self-restraint, for they were worthy of it and meet for it. And Allah is Aware of all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad sadaqa Allahu rasoolahu alrruya bialhaqqi latadkhulunna almasjida alharama in shaa Allahu amineena muhalliqeena ruoosakum wamuqassireena la takhafoona faAAalima ma lam taAAlamoo fajaAAala min dooni thalika fathan qareeban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah hath fulfilled the vision for His messenger in very truth. Ye shall indeed enter the Inviolable Place of Worship, if Allah will, secure, (having your hair) shaven and cut, not fearing. But He knoweth that which ye know not, and hath given you a near victory beforehand.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa allathee arsala rasoolahu bialhuda wadeeni alhaqqi liyuthhirahu AAala alddeeni kullihi wakafa biAllahi shaheedan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who hath sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, that He may cause it to prevail over all religion. And Allah sufficeth as a Witness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[48][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Muhammadun rasoolu Allahi waallatheena maAAahu ashiddao AAala alkuffari ruhamao baynahum tarahum rukkaAAan sujjadan yabtaghoona fadlan mina Allahi waridwanan seemahum fee wujoohihim min athari alssujoodi thalika mathaluhum fee alttawrati wamathaluhum fee alinjeeli kazarAAin akhraja shatahu faazarahu faistaghlatha faistawa AAala sooqihi yuAAjibu alzzurraAAa liyagheetha bihimu alkuffara waAAada Allahu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati minhum maghfiratan waajran AAatheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Muhammad is the messenger of Allah. And those with him are hard against the disbelievers and merciful among themselves. Thou (O Muhammad) seest them bowing and falling prostrate (in worship), seeking bounty from Allah and (His) acceptance. The mark of them is on their foreheads from the traces of prostration. Such is their likeness in the Torah and their likeness in the Gospel - like as sown corn that sendeth forth its shoot and strengtheneth it and riseth firm upon its stalk, delighting the sowers - that He may enrage the disbelievers with (the sight of) them. Allah hath promised, unto such of them as believe and do good works, forgiveness and immense reward.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Hujurat (The Apartments)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tuqaddimoo bayna yadayi Allahi warasoolihi waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha sameeAAun AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Be not forward in the presence of Allah and His messenger, and keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tarfaAAoo aswatakum fawqa sawti alnnabiyyi wala tajharoo lahu bialqawli kajahri baAAdikum libaAAdin an tahbata aAAmalukum waantum la tashAAuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Lift not up your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor shout when speaking to him as ye shout one to another, lest your works be rendered vain while ye perceive not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena yaghuddoona aswatahum AAinda rasooli Allahi olaika allatheena imtahana Allahu quloobahum lilttaqwa lahum maghfiratun waajrun AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! they who subdue their voices in the presence of the messenger of Allah, those are they whose hearts Allah hath proven unto righteousness. Theirs will be forgiveness and immense reward.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena yunadoonaka min warai alhujurati aktharuhum la yaAAqiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who call thee from behind the private apartments, most of them have no sense.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw annahum sabaroo hatta takhruja ilayhim lakana khayran lahum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if they had had patience till thou camest forth unto them, it had been better for them. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in jaakum fasiqun binabain fatabayyanoo an tuseeboo qawman bijahalatin fatusbihoo AAala ma faAAaltum nadimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! If an evil-liver bring you tidings, verify it, lest ye smite some folk in ignorance and afterward repent of what ye did.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaiAAlamoo anna feekum rasoola Allahi law yuteeAAukum fee katheerin mina alamri laAAanittum walakinna Allaha habbaba ilaykumu aleemana wazayyanahu fee quloobikum wakarraha ilaykumu alkufra waalfusooqa waalAAisyana olaika humu alrrashidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And know that the messenger of Allah is among you. If he were to obey you in much of the government, ye would surely be in trouble; but Allah hath endeared the faith to you and hath beautified it in your hearts, and hath made disbelief and lewdness and rebellion hateful unto you. Such are they who are the rightly guided.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fadlan mina Allahi waniAAmatan waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (It is) a bounty and a grace from Allah; and Allah is Knower, Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain taifatani mina almumineena iqtataloo faaslihoo baynahuma fain baghat ihdahuma AAala alokhra faqatiloo allatee tabghee hatta tafeea ila amri Allahi fain faat faaslihoo baynahuma bialAAadli waaqsitoo inna Allaha yuhibbu almuqsiteena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if two parties of believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them. And if one party of them doeth wrong to the other, fight ye that which doeth wrong till it return unto the ordinance of Allah; then, if it return, make peace between them justly, and act equitably. Lo! Allah loveth the equitable.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama almuminoona ikhwatun faaslihoo bayna akhawaykum waittaqoo Allaha laAAallakum turhamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The believers are naught else than brothers. Therefore make peace between your brethren and observe your duty to Allah that haply ye may obtain mercy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la yaskhar qawmun min qawmin AAasa an yakoonoo khayran minhum wala nisaon min nisain AAasa an yakunna khayran minhunna wala talmizoo anfusakum wala tanabazoo bialalqabi bisa alismu alfusooqu baAAda aleemani waman lam yatub faolaika humu alththalimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Let not a folk deride a folk who may be better than they (are), not let women (deride) women who may be better than they are; neither defame one another, nor insult one another by nicknames. Bad is the name of lewdness after faith. And whoso turneth not in repentance, such are evil-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ijtaniboo katheeran mina alththanni inna baAAda alththanni ithmun wala tajassasoo wala yaghtab baAAdukum baAAdan ayuhibbu ahadukum an yakula lahma akheehi maytan fakarihtumoohu waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha tawwabun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Shun much suspicion; for lo! some suspicion is a crime. And spy not, neither backbite one another. Would one of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? Ye abhor that (so abhor the other)! And keep your duty (to Allah). Lo! Allah is Relenting, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnasu inna khalaqnakum min thakarin waontha wajaAAalnakum shuAAooban waqabaila litaAAarafoo inna akramakum AAinda Allahi atqakum inna Allaha AAaleemun khabeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O mankind! Lo! We have created you male and female, and have made you nations and tribes that ye may know one another. Lo! the noblest of you, in the sight of Allah, is the best in conduct. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qalati alaAArabu amanna qul lam tuminoo walakin qooloo aslamna walamma yadkhuli aleemanu fee quloobikum wain tuteeAAoo Allaha warasoolahu la yalitkum min aAAmalikum shayan inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The wandering Arabs say: We believe. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye believe not, but rather say "We submit," for the faith hath not yet entered into your hearts. Yet, if ye obey Allah and His messenger, He will not withhold from you aught of (the reward of) your deeds. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama almuminoona allatheena amanoo biAllahi warasoolihi thumma lam yartaboo wajahadoo biamwalihim waanfusihim fee sabeeli Allahi olaika humu alssadiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The (true) believers are those only who believe in Allah and His messenger and afterward doubt not, but strive with their wealth and their lives for the cause of Allah. Such are the sincere.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul atuAAallimoona Allaha bideenikum waAllahu yaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Would ye teach Allah your religion, when Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and Allah is Aware of all things?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yamunnoona AAalayka an aslamoo qul la tamunnoo AAalayya islamakum bali Allahu yamunnu AAalaykum an hadakum lileemani in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They make it a favour unto thee (Muhammad) that they have surrendered (unto Him). Say: Deem not your Surrender a favour unto me; but Allah doth confer a favour on you, inasmuch as He hath led you to the Faith, if ye are earnest.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[49][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha yaAAlamu ghayba alssamawati waalardi waAllahu baseerun bima taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah knoweth the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Qaf (Qaf)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaf waalqurani almajeedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal AAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum faqala alkafiroona hatha shayon AAajeebun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aitha mitna wakunna turaban thalika rajAAun baAAeedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qad AAalimna ma tanqusu alardu minhum waAAindana kitabun hafeethun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal kaththaboo bialhaqqi lamma jaahum fahum fee amrin mareejin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afalam yanthuroo ila alssamai fawqahum kayfa banaynaha wazayyannaha wama laha min furoojin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli zawjin baheejin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tabsiratan wathikra likulli AAabdin muneebin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A vision and a reminder for every penitent slave.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanazzalna mina alssamai maan mubarakan faanbatna bihi jannatin wahabba alhaseedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalnnakhla basiqatin laha talAAun nadeedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rizqan lilAAibadi waahyayna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika alkhurooju}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waashabu alrrassi wathamoodu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAadun wafirAAawnu waikhwanu lootin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waashabu alaykati waqawmu tubbaAAin kullun kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa waAAeedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AfaAAayeena bialkhalqi alawwali bal hum fee labsin min khalqin jadeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad khalaqna alinsana wanaAAlamu ma tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi min habli alwareedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith yatalaqqa almutalaqqiyani AAani alyameeni waAAani alshshimali qaAAeedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma yalfithu min qawlin illa ladayhi raqeebun AAateedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajaat sakratu almawti bialhaqqi thalika ma kunta minhu taheedu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanufikha fee alssoori thalika yawmu alwaAAeedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajaat kullu nafsin maAAaha saiqun washaheedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad kunta fee ghaflatin min hatha fakashafna AAanka ghitaaka fabasaruka alyawma hadeedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala qareenuhu hatha ma ladayya AAateedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alqiya fee jahannama kulla kaffarin AAaneedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{MannaAAin lilkhayri muAAtadin mureebin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee jaAAala maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara faalqiyahu fee alAAathabi alshshadeedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala qareenuhu rabbana ma atghaytuhu walakin kana fee dalalin baAAeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala la takhtasimoo ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bialwaAAeedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma yubaddalu alqawlu ladayya wama ana bithallamin lilAAabeedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma naqoolu lijahannama hali imtalati wataqoolu hal min mazeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waozlifati aljannatu lilmuttaqeena ghayra baAAeedin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha ma tooAAadoona likulli awwabin hafeethin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man khashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi wajaa biqalbin muneebin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Odkhulooha bisalamin thalika yawmu alkhuloodi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahum ma yashaoona feeha waladayna mazeedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fee albiladi hal min maheesin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna fee thalika lathikra liman kana lahu qalbun aw alqa alssamAAa wahuwa shaheedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin wama massana min lughoobin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla alghuroobi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waadbara alssujoodi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaistamiAA yawma yunadi almunadi min makanin qareebin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma yasmaAAoona alssayhata bialhaqqi thalika yawmu alkhurooji}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna nahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wailayna almaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma tashaqqaqu alardu AAanhum siraAAan thalika hashrun AAalayna yaseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[50][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona wama anta AAalayhim bijabbarin fathakkir bialqurani man yakhafu waAAeedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Ad-Dhariyat (The Scatterers)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalththariyati tharwan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By those that winnow with a winnowing}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalhamilati wiqran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those that bear the burden (of the rain)}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faaljariyati yusran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalmuqassimati amran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who distribute (blessings) by command,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama tooAAadoona lasadiqun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna alddeena lawaqiAAun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! the judgment will indeed befall.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalssamai thati alhubuki}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By the heaven full of paths,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innakum lafee qawlin mukhtalifin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yufaku AAanhu man ofika}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qutila alkharrasoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Accursed be the conjecturers}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena hum fee ghamratin sahoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who are careless in an abyss!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yasaloona ayyana yawmu alddeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They ask: When is the Day of Judgment?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma hum AAala alnnari yuftanoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thooqoo fitnatakum hatha allathee kuntum bihi tastaAAjiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Akhitheena ma atahum rabbuhum innahum kanoo qabla thalika muhsineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kanoo qaleelan mina allayli ma yahjaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They used to sleep but little of the night,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wabialashari hum yastaghfiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wafee amwalihim haqqun lilssaili waalmahroomi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wafee alardi ayatun lilmooqineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wafee anfusikum afala tubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wafee alssamai rizqukum wama tooAAadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fawarabbi alssamai waalardi innahu lahaqqun mithla ma annakum tantiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hal ataka hadeethu dayfi ibraheema almukrameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala salamun qawmun munkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faragha ila ahlihi fajaa biAAijlin sameenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqarrabahu ilayhim qala ala takuloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faawjasa minhum kheefatan qaloo la takhaf wabashsharoohu bighulamin AAaleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faaqbalati imraatuhu fee sarratin fasakkat wajhaha waqalat AAajoozun AAaqeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo kathaliki qala rabbuki innahu huwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Linursila AAalayhim hijaratan min teenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That we may send upon them stones of clay,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Musawwamatan AAinda rabbika lilmusrifeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faakhrajna man kana feeha mina almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then we brought forth such believers as were there.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama wajadna feeha ghayra baytin mina almuslimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watarakna feeha ayatan lillatheena yakhafoona alAAathaba alaleema}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wafee moosa ith arsalnahu ila firAAawna bisultanin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatawalla biruknihi waqala sahirun aw majnoonun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faakhathnahu wajunoodahu fanabathnahum fee alyammi wahuwa muleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wafee AAadin ith arsalna AAalayhimu alrreeha alAAaqeema}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma tatharu min shayin atat AAalayhi illa jaAAalathu kaalrrameemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wafee thamooda ith qeela lahum tamattaAAoo hatta heenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaAAataw AAan amri rabbihim faakhathathumu alssaAAiqatu wahum yanthuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama istataAAoo min qiyamin wama kanoo muntasireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalssamaa banaynaha biaydin wainna lamoosiAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalarda farashnaha faniAAma almahidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamin kulli shayin khalaqna zawjayni laAAallakum tathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fafirroo ila Allahi innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tajAAaloo maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kathalika ma ata allatheena min qablihim min rasoolin illa qaloo sahirun aw majnoonun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Atawasaw bihi bal hum qawmun taghoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatawalla AAanhum fama anta bimaloomin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wathakkir fainna alththikra tanfaAAu almumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And warn, for warning profiteth believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama khalaqtu aljinna waalinsa illa liyaAAbudooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma oreedu minhum min rizqin wama oreedu an yutAAimooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna Allaha huwa alrrazzaqu thoo alquwwati almateenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fainna lillatheena thalamoo thanooban mithla thanoobi ashabihim fala yastaAAjiloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[51][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min yawmihimu allathee yooAAadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{At-Tur (The Mountain)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalttoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By the Mount,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakitabin mastoorin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And a Scripture inscribed}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee raqqin manshoorin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On fine parchment unrolled,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalbayti almaAAmoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the House frequented,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalssaqfi almarfooAAi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the roof exalted,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalbahri almasjoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the sea kept filled,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna AAathaba rabbika lawaqiAAun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma lahu min dafiAAin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There is none that can ward it off.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma tamooru alssamao mawran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wataseeru aljibalu sayran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the mountains move away with (awful) movement,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fawaylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then woe that day unto the deniers}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena hum fee khawdin yalAAaboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who play in talk of grave matters;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma yudaAAAAoona ila nari jahannama daAAAAan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hathihi alnnaru allatee kuntum biha tukaththiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afasihrun hatha am antum la tubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is this magic, or do ye not see?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Islawha faisbiroo aw la tasbiroo sawaon AAalaykum innama tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaAAeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakiheena bima atahum rabbuhum wawaqahum rabbuhum AAathaba aljaheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Muttakieena AAala sururin masfoofatin wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena amanoo waittabaAAathum thurriyyatuhum bieemanin alhaqna bihim thurriyyatahum wama alatnahum min AAamalihim min shayin kullu imriin bima kasaba raheenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamdadnahum bifakihatin walahmin mimma yashtahoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YatanazaAAoona feeha kasan la laghwun feeha wala tatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayatoofu AAalayhim ghilmanun lahum kaannahum luluon maknoonun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And some of them draw near unto others, questioning,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo inna kunna qablu fee ahlina mushfiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Famanna Allahu AAalayna wawaqana AAathaba alssamoomi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna kunna min qablu nadAAoohu innahu huwa albarru alrraheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fathakkir fama anta biniAAmati rabbika bikahin wala majnoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am yaqooloona shaAAirun natarabbasu bihi rayba almanooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul tarabbasoo fainnee maAAakum mina almutarabbiseena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am tamuruhum ahlamuhum bihatha am hum qawmun taghoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am yaqooloona taqawwalahu bal la yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falyatoo bihadeethin mithlihi in kanoo sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am khuliqoo min ghayri shayin am humu alkhaliqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am khalaqoo alssamawati waalarda bal la yooqinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am AAindahum khazainu rabbika am humu almusaytiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am lahum sullamun yastamiAAoona feehi falyati mustamiAAuhum bisultanin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am lahu albanatu walakumu albanoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am AAindahumu alghaybu fahum yaktuboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am yureedoona kaydan faallatheena kafaroo humu almakeedoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am lahum ilahun ghayru Allahi subhana Allahi AAamma yushrikoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain yaraw kisfan mina alssamai saqitan yaqooloo sahabun markoomun}}
