\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatharhum hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee feehi yusAAaqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma la yughnee AAanhum kayduhum shayan wala hum yunsaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna lillatheena thalamoo AAathaban doona thalika walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waisbir lihukmi rabbika fainnaka biaAAyunina wasabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoomu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[52][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waidbara alnnujoomi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{An-Najm (The Star)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalnnajmi itha hawa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By the Star when it setteth,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma dalla sahibukum wama ghawa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yantiqu AAani alhawa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In huwa illa wahyun yooha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAallamahu shadeedu alquwa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which one of mighty powers hath taught him,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thoo mirratin faistawa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} One vigorous; and he grew clear to view}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa bialofuqi alaAAla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When he was on the uppermost horizon.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma dana fatadalla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then he drew nigh and came down}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakana qaba qawsayni aw adna}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Till he was (distant) two bows' length or even nearer,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faawha ila AAabdihi ma awha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma kathaba alfuadu ma raa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afatumaroonahu AAala ma yara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad raahu nazlatan okhra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily he saw him yet another time}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAinda sidrati almuntaha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAindaha jannatu almawa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith yaghsha alssidrata ma yaghsha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma zagha albasaru wama tagha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The eye turned not aside nor yet was overbold.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laqad raa min ayati rabbihi alkubra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaraaytumu allata waalAAuzza}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have ye thought upon Al-Lat and Al-'Uzza}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamanata alththalithata alokhra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Manat, the third, the other?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alakumu alththakaru walahu alontha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Are yours the males and His the females?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tilka ithan qismatun deeza}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That indeed were an unfair division!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In hiya illa asmaon sammaytumooha antum waabaokum ma anzala Allahu biha min sultanin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wama tahwa alanfusu walaqad jaahum min rabbihimu alhuda}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am lilinsani ma tamanna}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or shall man have what he coveteth?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falillahi alakhiratu waaloola}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But unto Allah belongeth the after (life), and the former.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakam min malakin fee alssamawati la tughnee shafaAAatuhum shayan illa min baAAdi an yathana Allahu liman yashao wayarda}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati layusammoona almalaikata tasmiyata alontha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama lahum bihi min AAilmin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wainna alththanna la yughnee mina alhaqqi shayan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and lo! a guess can never take the place of the truth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaaAArid AAan man tawalla AAan thikrina walam yurid illa alhayata alddunya}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika mablaghuhum mina alAAilmi inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bimani ihtada}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi liyajziya allatheena asaoo bima AAamiloo wayajziya allatheena ahsanoo bialhusna}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yajtaniboona kabaira alithmi waalfawahisha illa allamama inna rabbaka wasiAAu almaghfirati huwa aAAlamu bikum ith anshaakum mina alardi waith antum ajinnatun fee butooni ommahatikum fala tuzakkoo anfusakum huwa aAAlamu bimani ittaqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaraayta allathee tawalla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaaAAta qaleelan waakda}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And gave a little, then was grudging?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{aAAindahu AAilmu alghaybi fahuwa yara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am lam yunabba bima fee suhufi moosa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or hath he not had news of what is in the books of Moses}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waibraheema allathee waffa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Abraham who paid his debt:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alla taziru waziratun wizra okhra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That no laden one shall bear another's load,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waan laysa lilinsani illa ma saAAa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanna saAAyahu sawfa yura}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that his effort will be seen.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma yujzahu aljazaa alawfa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanna ila rabbika almuntaha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that thy Lord, He is the goal;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waannahu huwa adhaka waabka}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waannahu huwa amata waahya}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that He it is Who giveth death and giveth life;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waannahu khalaqa alzzawjayni alththakara waalontha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Min nutfatin itha tumna}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanna AAalayhi alnnashata alokhra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waannahu huwa aghna waaqna}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that He it is Who enricheth and contenteth;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waannahu huwa rabbu alshshiAAra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waannahu ahlaka AAadan aloola}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) A'ad,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wathamooda fama abqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (the tribe of) Thamud He spared not;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo hum athlama waatgha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the folk of Noah aforetime, Lo! they were more unjust and more rebellious;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalmutafikata ahwa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Al-Mu'tafikah He destroyed}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faghashshaha ma ghashsha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So that there covered them that which did cover.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fabiayyi alai rabbika tatamara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha natheerun mina alnnuthuri aloola}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is a warner of the warners of old.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Azifati alazifatu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The threatened Hour is nigh.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laysa laha min dooni Allahi kashifatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} None beside Allah can disclose it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afamin hatha alhadeethi taAAjaboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Marvel ye then at this statement,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watadhakoona wala tabkoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And laugh and not weep,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waantum samidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} While ye amuse yourselves?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[53][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faosjudoo lillahi waoAAbudoo}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Qamar (The Moon)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Iqtarabati alssaAAatu wainshaqqa alqamaru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain yaraw ayatan yuAAridoo wayaqooloo sihrun mustamirrun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakaththaboo waittabaAAoo ahwaahum wakullu amrin mustaqirrun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad jaahum mina alanbai ma feehi muzdajarun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hikmatun balighatun fama tughnee alnnuthuru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatawalla AAanhum yawma yadAAu alddaAAi ila shayin nukurin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{KhushshaAAan absaruhum yakhrujoona mina alajdathi kaannahum jaradun muntashirun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{MuhtiAAeena ila alddaAAi yaqoolu alkafiroona hatha yawmun AAasirun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin fakaththaboo AAabdana waqaloo majnoonun waizdujira}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FadaAAa rabbahu annee maghloobun faintasir}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fafatahna abwaba alssamai bimain munhamirin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wafajjarna alarda AAuyoonan failtaqa almao AAala amrin qad qudira}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahamalnahu AAala thati alwahin wadusurin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tajree biaAAyunina jazaan liman kana kufira}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad taraknaha ayatan fahal min muddakirin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaththabat AAadun fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna arsalna AAalayhim reehan sarsaran fee yawmi nahsin mustamirrin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{TanziAAu alnnasa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin munqaAAirin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaththabat thamoodu bialnnuthuri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqaloo abasharan minna wahidan nattabiAAuhu inna ithan lafee dalalin wasuAAurin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aolqiya alththikru AAalayhi min baynina bal huwa kaththabun ashirun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{SayaAAlamoona ghadan mani alkaththabu alashiru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna mursiloo alnnaqati fitnatan lahum fairtaqibhum waistabir}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanabbihum anna almaa qismatun baynahum kullu shirbin muhtadarun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fanadaw sahibahum fataAAata faAAaqara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna arsalna AAalayhim sayhatan wahidatan fakanoo kahasheemi almuhtathiri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaththabat qawmu lootin bialnnuthuri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The folk of Lot rejected warnings.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna arsalna AAalayhim hasiban illa ala lootin najjaynahum bisaharin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{NiAAmatan min AAindina kathalika najzee man shakara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad antharahum batshatana fatamaraw bialnnuthuri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad rawadoohu AAan dayfihi fatamasna aAAyunahum fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad sabbahahum bukratan AAathabun mustaqirrun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Now taste My punishment after My warnings!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad jaa ala firAAawna alnnuthuru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaththaboo biayatina kulliha faakhathnahum akhtha AAazeezin muqtadirin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Akuffarukum khayrun min olaikum am lakum baraatun fee alzzuburi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am yaqooloona nahnu jameeAAun muntasirun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or say they: We are a host victorious?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sayuhzamu aljamAAu wayuwalloona alddubura}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bali alssaAAatu mawAAiduhum waalssaAAatu adha waamarru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna almujrimeena fee dalalin wasuAAurin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the guilty are in error and madness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma yushaboona fee alnnari AAala wujoohihim thooqoo massa saqara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna kulla shayin khalaqnahu biqadarin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have created every thing by measure.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama amruna illa wahidatun kalamhin bialbasari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad ahlakna ashyaAAakum fahal min muddakirin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakullu shayin faAAaloohu fee alzzuburi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And every thing they did is in the scriptures,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakullu sagheerin wakabeerin mustatarun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And every small and great thing is recorded.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaharin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[54][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee maqAAadi sidqin AAinda maleekin muqtadirin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Ar-Rahman (The Beneficent)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alrrahmanu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Beneficent}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAallama alqurana}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hath made known the Qur'an.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khalaqa alinsana}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He hath created man.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAallamahu albayana}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He hath taught him utterance.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alshshamsu waalqamaru bihusbanin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The sun and the moon are made punctual.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalnnajmu waalshshajaru yasjudani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The stars and the trees prostrate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalssamaa rafaAAaha wawadaAAa almeezana}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alla tatghaw fee almeezani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That ye exceed not the measure,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaqeemoo alwazna bialqisti wala tukhsiroo almeezana}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalarda wadaAAaha lilanami}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Feeha fakihatun waalnnakhlu thatu alakmami}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalhabbu thoo alAAasfi waalrrayhani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Husked grain and scented herb.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khalaqa alinsana min salsalin kaalfakhkhari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He created man of clay like the potter's,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakhalaqa aljanna min marijin min narin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbu almashriqayni warabbu almaghribayni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Maraja albahrayni yaltaqiyani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He hath loosed the two seas. They meet.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Baynahuma barzakhun la yabghiyani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There is a barrier between them. They encroach not (one upon the other).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yakhruju minhuma alluluo waalmarjanu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There cometh forth from both of them the pearl and coral-stone.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walahu aljawari almunshaatu fee albahri kaalaAAlami}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kullu man AAalayha fanin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Everyone that is thereon will pass away;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayabqa wajhu rabbika thoo aljalali waalikrami}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yasaluhu man fee alssamawati waalardi kulla yawmin huwa fee shanin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sanafrughu lakum ayyuha alththaqalani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[55][33]

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaamthali allului almaknooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Like unto hidden pearls,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Jazaan bima kanoo yaAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Reward for what they used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala tatheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa qeelan salaman salaman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waashabu alyameeni ma ashabu alyameeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee sidrin makhdoodin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Among thornless lote-trees}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watalhin mandoodin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And clustered plantains,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wathillin mamdoodin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And spreading shade,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamain maskoobin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And water gushing,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wafakihatin katheeratin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And fruit in plenty}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La maqtooAAatin wala mamnooAAatin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Neither out of reach nor yet forbidden,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wafurushin marfooAAatin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And raised couches;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna anshanahunna inshaan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have created them a (new) creation}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FajaAAalnahunna abkaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And made them virgins,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAuruban atraban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lovers, friends,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liashabi alyameeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For those on the right hand;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thullatun mina alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A multitude of those of old}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wathullatun mina alakhireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And a multitude of those of later time.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waashabu alshshimali ma ashabu alshshimali}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee samoomin wahameemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In scorching wind and scalding water}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wathillin min yahmoomin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And shadow of black smoke,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La baridin wala kareemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Neither cool nor refreshing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahum kanoo qabla thalika mutrafeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakanoo yusirroona AAala alhinthi alAAatheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And used to persist in the awful sin.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakanoo yaqooloona aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awa abaona alawwaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And also our forefathers?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul inna alawwaleena waalakhireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{LamajmooAAoona ila meeqati yawmin maAAloomin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma innakum ayyuha alddalloona almukaththiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then lo! ye, the erring, the deniers,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laakiloona min shajarin min zaqqoomin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Famalioona minha albutoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And will fill your bellies therewith;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fashariboona AAalayhi mina alhameemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thereon ye will drink of boiling water,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fashariboona shurba alheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Drinking even as the camel drinketh.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha nuzuluhum yawma alddeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][57]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Nahnu khalaqnakum falawla tusaddiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][58]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaraaytum ma tumnoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have ye seen that which ye emit?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][59]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aantum takhluqoonahu am nahnu alkhaliqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Do ye create it or are We the Creator?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][60]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Nahnu qaddarna baynakumu almawta wama nahnu bimasbooqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][61]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAala an nubaddila amthalakum wanunshiakum fee ma la taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][62]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad AAalimtumu alnnashata aloola falawla tathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][63]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaraaytum ma tahruthoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have ye seen that which ye cultivate?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][64]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aantum tazraAAoonahu am nahnu alzzariAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is it ye who foster it, or are We the Fosterer?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][65]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Law nashao lajaAAalnahu hutaman fathaltum tafakkahoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][66]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna lamughramoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! we are laden with debt!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][67]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal nahnu mahroomoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but we are deprived!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][68]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaraaytumu almaa allathee tashraboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have ye observed the water which ye drink?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][69]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aantum anzaltumoohu mina almuzni am nahnu almunziloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][70]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Law nashao jaAAalnahu ojajan falawla tashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][71]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaraaytumu alnnara allatee tooroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have ye observed the fire which ye strike out;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][72]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aantum anshatum shajarataha am nahnu almunshioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][73]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Nahnu jaAAalnaha tathkiratan wamataAAan lilmuqweena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][74]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasabbih biismi rabbika alAAatheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][75]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala oqsimu bimawaqiAAi alnnujoomi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, I swear by the places of the stars -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][76]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnahu laqasamun law taAAlamoona AAatheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! that verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][77]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu laquranun kareemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][78]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee kitabin maknoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In a Book kept hidden}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][79]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yamassuhu illa almutahharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which none toucheth save the purified,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][80]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tanzeelun min rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][81]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afabihatha alhadeethi antum mudhinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is it this Statement that ye scorn,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][82]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WatajAAaloona rizqakum annakum tukaththiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And make denial thereof your livelihood?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][83]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falawla itha balaghati alhulqooma}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][84]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waantum heenaithin tanthuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And ye are at that moment looking}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][85]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi minkum walakin la tubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} - And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][86]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falawla in kuntum ghayra madeeneena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us),}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][87]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{TarjiAAoonaha in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Do ye not force it back, if ye are truthful?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][88]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faamma in kana mina almuqarrabeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus if he is of those brought nigh,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][89]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Farawhun warayhanun wajannatu naAAeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][90]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma in kana min ashabi alyameeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if he is of those on the right hand,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][91]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasalamun laka min ashabi alyameeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][92]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma in kana mina almukaththibeena alddalleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But if he is of the rejecters, the erring,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][93]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fanuzulun min hameemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then the welcome will be boiling water}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][94]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watasliyatu jaheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And roasting at hell-fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][95]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna hatha lahuwa haqqu alyaqeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! this is certain truth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[56][96]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasabbih biismi rabbika alAAatheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Hadid (Iron)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sabbaha lillahi ma fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Allah; and He is the Mighty, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi yuhyee wayumeetu wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; He quickeneth and He giveth death; and He is Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa alawwalu waalakhiru waalththahiru waalbatinu wahuwa bikulli shayin AAaleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He is the First and the Last, and the Outward and the Inward; and He is Knower of all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi yaAAlamu ma yaliju fee alardi wama yakhruju minha wama yanzilu mina alssamai wama yaAAruju feeha wahuwa maAAakum ayna ma kuntum waAllahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi waila Allahi turjaAAu alomooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah (all) things are brought back.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yooliju allayla fee alnnahari wayooliju alnnahara fee allayi wahuwa AAaleemun bithati alssudoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He causeth the night to pass into the day, and He causeth the day to pass into the night, and He is knower of all that is in the breasts.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aminoo biAllahi warasoolihi waanfiqoo mimma jaAAalakum mustakhlafeena feehi faallatheena amanoo minkum waanfaqoo lahum ajrun kabeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Believe in Allah and His messenger, and spend of that whereof He hath made you trustees; and such of you as believe and spend (aright), theirs will be a great reward.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama lakum la tuminoona biAllahi waalrrasoolu yadAAookum lituminoo birabbikum waqad akhatha meethaqakum in kuntum mumineena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} What aileth you that ye believe not in Allah, when the messenger calleth you to believe in your Lord, and He hath already made a covenant with you, if ye are believers?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa allathee yunazzilu AAala AAabdihi ayatin bayyinatin liyukhrijakum mina alththulumati ila alnnoori wainna Allaha bikum laraoofun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who sendeth down clear revelations unto His slave, that He may bring you forth from darkness unto light; and lo! for you, Allah is Full of Pity, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama lakum alla tunfiqoo fee sabeeli Allahi walillahi meerathu alssamawati waalardi la yastawee minkum man anfaqa min qabli alfathi waqatala olaika aAAthamu darajatan mina allatheena anfaqoo min baAAdu waqataloo wakullan waAAada Allahu alhusna waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And what aileth you that ye spend not in the way of Allah when unto Allah belongeth the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent and fought before the victory are not upon a level (with the rest of you). Such are greater in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. Unto each hath Allah promised good. And Allah is Informed of what ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Man tha allathee yuqridu Allaha qardan hasanan fayudaAAifahu lahu walahu ajrun kareemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who is he that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, that He may double it for him and his may be a rich reward?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma tara almumineena waalmuminati yasAAa nooruhum bayna aydeehim wabiaymanihim bushrakumu alyawma jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when thou (Muhammad) wilt see the believers, men and women, their light shining forth before them and on their right hands, (and wilt hear it said unto them): Glad news for you this day: Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein ye are immortal. That is the supreme triumph.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma yaqoolu almunafiqoona waalmunafiqatu lillatheena amanoo onthuroona naqtabis min noorikum qeela irjiAAoo waraakum failtamisoo nooran faduriba baynahum bisoorin lahu babun batinuhu feehi alrrahmatu wathahiruhu min qibalihi alAAathabu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women will say unto those who believe: Look on us that we may borrow from your light! it will be said: Go back and seek for light! Then there will separate them a wall wherein is a gate, the inner side whereof containeth mercy, while the outer side thereof is toward the doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yunadoonahum alam nakun maAAakum qaloo bala walakinnakum fatantum anfusakum watarabbastum wairtabtum wagharratkumu alamaniyyu hatta jaa amru Allahi wagharrakum biAllahi algharooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will cry unto them (saying): Were we not with you? They will say: Yea, verily; but ye tempted one another, and hesitated, and doubted, and vain desires beguiled you till the ordinance of Allah came to pass; and the deceiver deceived you concerning Allah;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalyawma la yukhathu minkum fidyatun wala mina allatheena kafaroo mawakumu alnnaru hiya mawlakum wabisa almaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So this day no ransom can be taken from you nor from those who disbelieved. Your home is the Fire; that is your patron, and a hapless journey's end.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[57][16]
\end{Arabic}}
