\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[65][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allahu allathee khalaqa sabAAa samawatin wamina alardi mithlahunna yatanazzalu alamru baynahunna litaAAlamoo anna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun waanna Allaha qad ahata bikulli shayin AAilman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah it is who hath created seven heavens, and of the earth the like thereof. The commandment cometh down among them slowly, that ye may know that Allah is Able to do all things, and that Allah surroundeth all things in knowledge.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{At-Tahrim (The Prohibition)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[66][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu lima tuharrimu ma ahalla Allahu laka tabtaghee mardata azwajika waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Prophet! Why bannest thou that which Allah hath made lawful for thee, seeking to please thy wives? And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[66][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qad farada Allahu lakum tahillata aymanikum waAllahu mawlakum wahuwa alAAaleemu alhakeemu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah hath made lawful for you (Muslims) absolution from your oaths (of such a kind), and Allah is your Protector. He is the Knower, the Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[66][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waith asarra alnnabiyyu ila baAAdi azwajihi hadeethan falamma nabbaat bihi waathharahu Allahu AAalayhi AAarrafa baAAdahu waaAArada AAan baAAdin falamma nabbaaha bihi qalat man anbaaka hatha qala nabbaaniya alAAaleemu alkhabeeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When the Prophet confided a fact unto one of his wives and when she afterward divulged it and Allah apprised him thereof, he made known (to her) part thereof and passed over part. And when he told it her she said: Who hath told thee? He said: The Knower, the Aware hath told me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[66][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In tatooba ila Allahi faqad saghat quloobukuma wain tathahara AAalayhi fainna Allaha huwa mawlahu wajibreelu wasalihu almumineena waalmalaikatu baAAda thalika thaheerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If ye twain turn unto Allah repentant, (ye have cause to do so) for your hearts desired (the ban); and if ye aid one another against him (Muhammad) then lo! Allah, even He, is his Protecting Friend, and Gabriel and the righteous among the believers; and furthermore the angels are his helpers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[66][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAasa rabbuhu in tallaqakunna an yubdilahu azwajan khayran minkunna muslimatin muminatin qanitatin taibatin AAabidatin saihatin thayyibatin waabkaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It may happen that his Lord, if he divorce you, will give him in your stead wives better than you, submissive (to Allah), believing, pious, penitent, devout, inclined to fasting, widows and maids.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[66][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo qoo anfusakum waahleekum naran waqooduha alnnasu waalhijaratu AAalayha malaikatun ghilathun shidadun la yaAAsoona Allaha ma amarahum wayafAAaloona ma yumaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Ward off from yourselves and your families a Fire whereof the fuel is men and stones, over which are set angels strong, severe, who resist not Allah in that which He commandeth them, but do that which they are commanded.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[66][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena kafaroo la taAAtathiroo alyawma innama tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Then it will be said): O ye who disbelieve! Make no excuses for yourselves this day. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[66][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo tooboo ila Allahi tawbatan nasoohan AAasa rabbukum an yukaffira AAankum sayyiatikum wayudkhilakum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu yawma la yukhzee Allahu alnnabiyya waallatheena amanoo maAAahu nooruhum yasAAa bayna aydeehim wabiaymanihim yaqooloona rabbana atmim lana noorana waighfir lana innaka AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O ye who believe! Turn unto Allah in sincere repentance! It may be that your Lord will remit from you your evil deeds and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, on the day when Allah will not abase the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their light will run before them and on their right hands; they will say: Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[66][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu jahidi alkuffara waalmunafiqeena waoghluth AAalayhim wamawahum jahannamu wabisa almaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O Prophet! Strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be stern with them. Hell will be their home, a hapless journey's end.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[66][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Daraba Allahu mathalan lillatheena kafaroo imraata noohin waimraata lootin kanata tahta AAabdayni min AAibadina salihayni fakhanatahuma falam yughniya AAanhuma mina Allahi shayan waqeela odkhula alnnara maAAa alddakhileena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah citeth an example for those who disbelieve: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot, who were under two of Our righteous slaves yet betrayed them so that they (the husbands) availed them naught against Allah and it was said (unto them): Enter the Fire along with those who enter.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[66][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wadaraba Allahu mathalan lillatheena amanoo imraata firAAawna ith qalat rabbi ibni lee AAindaka baytan fee aljannati wanajjinee min firAAawna waAAamalihi wanajjinee mina alqawmi alththalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah citeth an example for those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh when she said: My Lord! Build for me a home with thee in the Garden, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his work, and deliver me from evil-doing folk;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[66][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamaryama ibnata AAimrana allatee ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna feehi min roohina wasaddaqat bikalimati rabbiha wakutubihi wakanat mina alqaniteena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Mary, daughter of 'Imran, whose body was chaste, therefor We breathed therein something of Our Spirit. And she put faith in the words of her Lord and His scriptures, and was of the obedient.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Mulk (The Kingdom)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tabaraka allathee biyadihi almulku wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Blessed is He in Whose hand is the Sovereignty, and, He is Able to do all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee khalaqa almawta waalhayata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu AAamalan wahuwa alAAazeezu alghafooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who hath created life and death that He may try you which of you is best in conduct; and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee khalaqa sabAAa samawatin tibaqan ma tara fee khalqi alrrahmani min tafawutin fairjiAAi albasara hal tara min futoorin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who hath created seven heavens in harmony. Thou (Muhammad) canst see no fault in the Beneficent One's creation; then look again: Canst thou see any rifts?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma irjiAAi albasara karratayni yanqalib ilayka albasaru khasian wahuwa haseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then look again and yet again, thy sight will return unto thee weakened and made dim.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bimasabeeha wajaAAalnaha rujooman lilshshayateeni waaAAtadna lahum AAathaba alssaAAeeri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily We have beautified the world's heaven with lamps, and We have made them missiles for the devils, and for them We have prepared the doom of flame.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walillatheena kafaroo birabbihim AAathabu jahannama wabisa almaseeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And for those who disbelieve in their Lord there is the doom of hell, a hapless journey's end!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Itha olqoo feeha samiAAoo laha shaheeqan wahiya tafooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When they are flung therein they hear its roaring as it boileth up,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Takadu tamayyazu mina alghaythi kullama olqiya feeha fawjun saalahum khazanatuha alam yatikum natheerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As it would burst with rage. Whenever a (fresh) host is flung therein the wardens thereof ask them: Came there unto you no warner?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo bala qad jaana natheerun fakaththabna waqulna ma nazzala Allahu min shayin in antum illa fee dalalin kabeerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They say: Yea, verily, a warner came unto us; but we denied and said: Allah hath naught revealed; ye are in naught but a great error.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo law kunna nasmaAAu aw naAAqilu ma kunna fee ashabi alssaAAeeri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: Had we been wont to listen or have sense, we had not been among the dwellers in the flames.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaiAAtarafoo bithanbihim fasuhqan liashabi alssaAAeeri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So they acknowledge their sins; but far removed (from mercy) are the dwellers in the flames.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi lahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who fear their Lord in secret, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waasirroo qawlakum awi ijharoo bihi innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And keep your opinion secret or proclaim it, lo! He is Knower of all that is in the breasts (of men).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ala yaAAlamu man khalaqa wahuwa allateefu alkhabeeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Should He not know what He created? And He is the Subtile, the Aware.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Huwa allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda thaloolan faimshoo fee manakibiha wakuloo min rizqihi wailayhi alnnushooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He it is Who hath made the earth subservient unto you, so Walk in the paths thereof and eat of His providence. And unto Him will be the resurrection (of the dead).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aamintum man fee alssamai an yakhsifa bikumu alarda faitha hiya tamooru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not cause the earth to swallow you when lo! it is convulsed?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am amintum man fee alssamai an yursila AAalaykum hasiban fasataAAlamoona kayfa natheeri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not let loose on you a hurricane? But ye shall know the manner of My warning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad kaththaba allatheena min qablihim fakayfa kana nakeeri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And verily those before them denied, then (see) the manner of My wrath (with them)!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awalam yaraw ila alttayri fawqahum saffatin wayaqbidna ma yumsikuhunna illa alrrahmanu innahu bikulli shayin baseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have they not seen the birds above them spreading out their wings and closing them? Naught upholdeth them save the Beneficent. Lo! He is Seer of all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Amman hatha allathee huwa jundun lakum yansurukum min dooni alrrahmani ini alkafiroona illa fee ghuroorin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or who is he that will be an army unto you to help you instead of the Beneficent? The disbelievers are in naught but illusion.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Amman hatha allathee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqahu bal lajjoo fee AAutuwwin wanufoorin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or who is he that will provide for you if He should withhold His providence? Nay, but they are set in pride and frowardness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afaman yamshee mukibban AAala wajhihi ahda amman yamshee sawiyyan AAala siratin mustaqeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is he who goeth groping on his face more rightly guided, or he who walketh upright on a straight road?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul huwa allathee anshaakum wajaAAala lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He it is who gave you being, and hath assigned unto you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul huwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: He it is Who multiplieth you in the earth, and unto Whom ye will be gathered.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul innama alAAilmu AAinda Allahi wainnama ana natheerun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: The knowledge is with Allah only, and I am but a plain warner;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma raawhu zulfatan seeat wujoohu allatheena kafaroo waqeela hatha allathee kuntum bihi taddaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But when they see it nigh, the faces of those who disbelieve will be awry, and it will be said (unto them): This is that for which ye used to call.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul araaytum in ahlakaniya Allahu waman maAAiya aw rahimana faman yujeeru alkafireena min AAathabin aleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad): Have ye thought: Whether Allah causeth me (Muhammad) and those with me to perish or hath mercy on us, still, who will protect the disbelievers from a painful doom?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul huwa alrrahmanu amanna bihi waAAalayhi tawakkalna fasataAAlamoona man huwa fee dalalin mubeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: He is the Beneficent. In Him we believe and in Him we put our trust. And ye will soon know who it is that is in error manifest.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[67][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul araaytum in asbaha maokum ghawran faman yateekum bimain maAAeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Have ye thought: If (all) your water were to disappear into the earth, who then could bring you gushing water?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Qalam (The Pen)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Noon waalqalami wama yasturoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nun. By the pen and that which they write (therewith),}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma anta biniAAmati rabbika bimajnoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna laka laajran ghayra mamnoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! thine verily will be a reward unfailing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnaka laAAala khuluqin AAatheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasatubsiru wayubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thou wilt see and they will see}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Biayyikumu almaftoonu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which of you is the demented.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bialmuhtadeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who walk aright.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala tutiAAi almukaththibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor obey not thou the rejecters}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waddoo law tudhinu fayudhinoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tutiAA kulla hallafin maheenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Neither obey thou each feeble oath-monger,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hammazin mashshain binameemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Detracter, spreader abroad of slanders,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{MannaAAin lilkhayri muAAtadin atheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hinderer of the good, transgressor, malefactor}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAutullin baAAda thalika zaneemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Greedy therewithal, intrusive.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{An kana tha malin wabaneena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is because he is possessed of wealth and children}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sanasimuhu AAala alkhurtoomi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We shall brand him on the nose.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna balawnahum kama balawna ashaba aljannati ith aqsamoo layasrimunnaha musbiheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala yastathnoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And made no exception (for the Will of Allah);}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatafa AAalayha taifun min rabbika wahum naimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faasbahat kaalssareemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in the morning it was as if plucked.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatanadaw musbiheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they cried out one unto another in the morning,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ani ighdoo AAala harthikum in kuntum sarimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faintalaqoo wahum yatakhafatoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So they went off, saying one unto another in low tones:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{An la yadkhulannaha alyawma AAalaykum miskeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} No needy man shall enter it to-day against you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waghadaw AAala hardin qadireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They went betimes, strong in (this) purpose.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falamma raawha qaloo inna ladalloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But when they saw it, they said: Lo! we are in error!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal nahnu mahroomoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but we are desolate!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala awsatuhum alam aqul lakum lawla tusabbihoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo subhana rabbina inna kunna thalimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatalawamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then some of them drew near unto others, self-reproaching.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna tagheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They said: Alas for us! In truth we were outrageous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAasa rabbuna an yubdilana khayran minha inna ila rabbina raghiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we beseech our Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kathalika alAAathabu walaAAathabu alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Such was the punishment. And verily the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they did but know.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna lilmuttaqeena AAinda rabbihim jannati alnnaAAeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AfanajAAalu almuslimeena kaalmujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Shall We then treat those who have surrendered as We treat the guilty?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma lakum kayfa tahkumoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} What aileth you? How foolishly ye judge!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am lakum kitabun feehi tadrusoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or have ye a scripture wherein ye learn}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna lakum feehi lama takhayyaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That ye shall indeed have all that ye choose?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am lakum aymanun AAalayna balighatun ila yawmi alqiyamati inna lakum lama tahkumoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment, that yours shall be all that ye ordain?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Salhum ayyuhum bithalika zaAAeemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ask them (O Muhammad) which of them will vouch for that!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am lahum shurakao falyatoo bishurakaihim in kanoo sadiqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or have they other gods? Then let them bring their other gods if they are truthful}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma yukshafu AAan saqin wayudAAawna ila alssujoodi fala yastateeAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when it befalleth in earnest, and they are ordered to prostrate themselves but are not able,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun waqad kanoo yudAAawna ila alssujoodi wahum salimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} With eyes downcast, abasement stupefying them. And they had been summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet unhurt.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatharnee waman yukaththibu bihatha alhadeethi sanastadrijuhum min haythu la yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Leave Me (to deal) with those who give the lie to this pronouncement. We shall lead them on by steps from whence they know not.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waomlee lahum inna kaydee mateenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or dost thou (Muhammad) ask a fee from them so that they are heavily taxed?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Am AAindahumu alghaybu fahum yaktuboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or is the Unseen theirs that they can write (thereof)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala takun kasahibi alhooti ith nada wahuwa makthoomun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried out in despair.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lawla an tadarakahu niAAmatun min rabbihi lanubitha bialAAarai wahuwa mathmoomun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faijtabahu rabbuhu fajaAAalahu mina alssaliheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wain yakadu allatheena kafaroo layuzliqoonaka biabsarihim lamma samiAAoo alththikra wayaqooloona innahu lamajnoonun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[68][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Haqqah (The Sure Truth)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alhaqqatu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Reality!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma alhaqqatu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} What is the Reality?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama adraka ma alhaqqatu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaththabat thamoodu waAAadun bialqariAAati}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faamma thamoodu faohlikoo bialttaghiyati}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma AAadun faohlikoo bireehin sarsarin AAatiyatin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sakhkharaha AAalayhim sabAAa layalin wathamaniyata ayyamin husooman fatara alqawma feeha sarAAa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin khawiyatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fahal tara lahum min baqiyatin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajaa firAAawnu waman qablahu waalmutafikatu bialkhatiati}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaAAasaw rasoola rabbihim faakhathahum akhthatan rabiyatan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna lamma tagha almao hamalnakum fee aljariyati}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{LinajAAalaha lakum tathkiratan wataAAiyaha othunun waAAiyatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha nufikha fee alssoori nafkhatun wahidatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the trumpet shall sound one blast}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahumilati alardu waaljibalu fadukkata dakkatan wahidatan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fayawmaithin waqaAAati alwaqiAAatu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, on that day will the Event befall.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainshaqqati alssamao fahiya yawmaithin wahiyatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalmalaku AAala arjaiha wayahmilu AAarsha rabbika fawqahum yawmaithin thamaniyatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawmaithin tuAAradoona la takhfa minkum khafiyatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faamma man ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi fayaqoolu haomu iqraoo kitabiyah}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innee thanantu annee mulaqin hisabiyah}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fahuwa fee AAeeshatin radiyatin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then he will be in blissful state}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee jannatin AAaliyatin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In a high garden}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qutoofuha daniyatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whereof the clusters are in easy reach.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima aslaftum fee alayyami alkhaliyati}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma man ootiya kitabahu bishimalihi fayaqoolu ya laytanee lam oota kitabiyah}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walam adri ma hisabiyah}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And knew not what my reckoning!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya laytaha kanati alqadiyatu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Oh, would that it had been death!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma aghna AAannee maliyah}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} My wealth hath not availed me,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Halaka AAannee sultaniyah}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} My power hath gone from me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khuthoohu faghulloohu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (It will be said): Take him and fetter him}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma aljaheema salloohu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And then expose him to hell-fire}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma fee silsilatin tharAAuha sabAAoona thiraAAan faoslukoohu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu kana la yuminu biAllahi alAAatheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala yahuddu AAala taAAami almiskeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And urged not on the feeding of the wretched.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falaysa lahu alyawma hahuna hameemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor hath he no lover here this day,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala taAAamun illa min ghisleenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nor any food save filth}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yakuluhu illa alkhatioona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which none but sinners eat.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala oqsimu bima tubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But nay! I swear by all that ye see}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama la tubsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And all that ye see not}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu laqawlu rasoolin kareemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama huwa biqawli shaAAirin qaleelan ma tuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala biqawli kahinin qaleelan ma tathakkaroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tanzeelun min rabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw taqawwala AAalayna baAAda alaqaweeli}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laakhathna minhu bialyameeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We assuredly had taken him by the right hand}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma laqataAAna minhu alwateena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And then severed his life-artery,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama minkum min ahadin AAanhu hajizeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And not one of you could have held Us off from him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnahu latathkiratun lilmuttaqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna lanaAAlamu anna minkum mukaththibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnahu lahasratun AAala alkafireena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnahu lahaqqu alyaqeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! it is absolute truth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[69][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasabbih biismi rabbika alAAatheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Ma'arij (The Ways of Ascent)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Saala sailun biAAathabin waqiAAin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A questioner questioned concerning the doom about to fall}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lilkafireena laysa lahu dafiAAun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Upon the disbelievers, which none can repel,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Mina Allahi thee almaAAariji}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} From Allah, Lord of the Ascending Stairways}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{TaAAruju almalaikatu waalrroohu ilayhi fee yawmin kana miqdaruhu khamseena alfa sanatin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the span is fifty thousand years.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faisbir sabran jameelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But be patient (O Muhammad) with a patience fair to see.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahum yarawnahu baAAeedan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! they behold it afar off}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanarahu qareeban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} While we behold it nigh:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma takoonu alssamao kaalmuhli}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The day when the sky will become as molten copper,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watakoonu aljibalu kaalAAihni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the hills become as flakes of wool,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala yasalu hameemun hameeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yubassaroonahum yawaddu almujrimu law yaftadee min AAathabi yawmiithin bibaneehi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Though they will be given sight of them. The guilty man will long to be able to ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wasahibatihi waakheehi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And his spouse and his brother}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wafaseelatihi allatee tuweehi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And his kin that harboured him}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waman fee alardi jameeAAan thumma yunjeehi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla innaha latha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But nay! for lo! it is the fire of hell}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{NazzaAAatan lilshshawa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Eager to roast;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{TadAAoo man adbara watawalla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It calleth him who turned and fled (from truth),}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajamaAAa faawAAa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And hoarded (wealth) and withheld it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna alinsana khuliqa halooAAan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! man was created anxious,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Itha massahu alshsharru jazooAAan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Fretful when evil befalleth him}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha massahu alkhayru manooAAan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And, when good befalleth him, grudging;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa almusalleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save worshippers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena hum AAala salatihim daimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who are constant at their worship}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena fee amwalihim haqqun maAAloomun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And in whose wealth there is a right acknowledged}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lilssaili waalmahroomi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For the beggar and the destitute;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena yusaddiqoona biyawmi alddeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who believe in the Day of Judgment,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena hum min AAathabi rabbihim mushfiqoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna AAathaba rabbihim ghayru mamoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena hum lifuroojihim hafithoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who preserve their chastity}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save with their wives and those whom their right hands possess, for thus they are not blameworthy;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But whoso seeketh more than that, those are they who are transgressors;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena hum liamanatihim waAAahdihim raAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who keep their pledges and their covenant,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena hum bishahadatihim qaimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who stand by their testimony}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallatheena hum AAala salatihim yuhafithoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who are attentive at their worship.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika fee jannatin mukramoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} These will dwell in Gardens, honoured.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Famali allatheena kafaroo qibalaka muhtiAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} What aileth those who disbelieve, that they keep staring toward thee (O Muhammad), open-eyed,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAani alyameeni waAAani alshshimali AAizeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the right and on the left, in groups?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AyatmaAAu kullu imriin minhum an yudkhala jannata naAAeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla inna khalaqnahum mimma yaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala oqsimu birabbi almashariqi waalmagharibi inna laqadiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the planets that We verily are Able}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAala an nubaddila khayran minhum wama nahnu bimasbooqeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} To replace them by (others) better than them. And we are not to be outrun.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma yakhrujoona mina alajdathi siraAAan kaannahum ila nusubin yoofidoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[70][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun thalika alyawmu allathee kanoo yooAAadoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} With eyes aghast, abasement stupefying them: Such is the Day which they are promised.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Nuh (Noah)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna arsalna noohan ila qawmihi an anthir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum AAathabun aleemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala ya qawmi innee lakum natheerun mubeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ani oAAbudoo Allaha waittaqoohu waateeAAooni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayuakhkhirkum ila ajalin musamman inna ajala Allahi itha jaa la yuakhkharu law kuntum taAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala rabbi innee daAAawtu qawmee laylan wanaharan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falam yazidhum duAAaee illa firaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainnee kullama daAAawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaAAaloo asabiAAahum fee athanihim waistaghshaw thiyabahum waasarroo waistakbaroo istikbaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma innee daAAawtuhum jiharan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! I have called unto them aloud,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma innee aAAlantu lahum waasrartu lahum israran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqultu istaghfiroo rabbakum innahu kana ghaffaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yursili alssamaa AAalaykum midraran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayumdidkum biamwalin wabaneena wayajAAal lakum jannatin wayajAAal lakum anharan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma lakum la tarjoona lillahi waqaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqad khalaqakum atwaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When He created you by (divers) stages?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam taraw kayfa khalaqa Allahu sabAAa samawatin tibaqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAala alqamara feehinna nooran wajaAAala alshshamsa sirajan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAllahu anbatakum mina alardi nabatan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma yuAAeedukum feeha wayukhrijukum ikhrajan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAllahu jaAAala lakumu alarda bisatan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Litaslukoo minha subulan fijajan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qala noohun rabbi innahum AAasawnee waittabaAAoo man lam yazidhu maluhu wawaladuhu illa khasaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamakaroo makran kubbaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they have plotted a mighty plot,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqaloo la tatharunna alihatakum wala tatharunna waddan wala suwaAAan wala yaghootha wayaAAooqa wanasran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqad adalloo katheeran wala tazidi alththalimeena illa dalalan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in naught save error.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Mimma khateeatihim oghriqoo faodkhiloo naran falam yajidoo lahum min dooni Allahi ansaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqala noohun rabbi la tathar AAala alardi mina alkafireena dayyaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innaka in tatharhum yudilloo AAibadaka wala yalidoo illa fajiran kaffaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[71][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbi ighfir lee waliwalidayya waliman dakhala baytiya muminan walilmumineena waalmuminati wala tazidi alththalimeena illa tabaran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Jinn (The Jinn)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul oohiya ilayya annahu istamaAAa nafarun mina aljinni faqaloo inna samiAAna quranan AAajaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yahdee ila alrrushdi faamanna bihi walan nushrika birabbina ahadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waannahu taAAala jaddu rabbina ma ittakhatha sahibatan wala waladan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waannahu kana yaqoolu safeehuna AAala Allahi shatatan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanna thananna an lan taqoola alinsu waaljinnu AAala Allahi kathiban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waannahu kana rijalun mina alinsi yaAAoothoona birijalin mina aljinni fazadoohum rahaqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah);}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waannahum thannoo kama thanantum an lan yabAAatha Allahu ahadan}}
