\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead) -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanna lamasna alssamaa fawajadnaha muliat harasan shadeedan washuhuban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanna kunna naqAAudu minha maqaAAida lilssamAAi faman yastamiAAi alana yajid lahu shihaban rasadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanna la nadree asharrun oreeda biman fee alardi am arada bihim rabbuhum rashadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanna minna alssalihoona waminna doona thalika kunna taraiqa qidadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanna thananna an lan nuAAjiza Allaha fee alardi walan nuAAjizahu haraban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanna lamma samiAAna alhuda amanna bihi faman yumin birabbihi fala yakhafu bakhsan wala rahaqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanna minna almuslimoona waminna alqasitoona faman aslama faolaika taharraw rashadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waama alqasitoona fakanoo lijahannama hataban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallawi istaqamoo AAala alttareeqati laasqaynahum maan ghadaqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Linaftinahum feehi waman yuAArid AAan thikri rabbihi yaslukhu AAathaban saAAadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanna almasajida lillahi fala tadAAoo maAAa Allahi ahadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waannahu lamma qama AAabdu Allahi yadAAoohu kadoo yakoonoona AAalayhi libadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on him, almost stifling.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul innama adAAoo rabbee wala oshriku bihi ahadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul innee la amliku lakum darran wala rashadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul innee lan yujeeranee mina Allahi ahadun walan ajida min doonihi multahadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa balaghan mina Allahi warisalatihi waman yaAAsi Allaha warasoolahu fainna lahu nara jahannama khalideena feeha abadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell for ever.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona fasayaAAlamoona man adAAafu nasiran waaqallu AAadadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qul in adree aqareebun ma tooAAadoona am yajAAalu lahu rabbee amadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAalimu alghaybi fala yuthhiru AAala ghaybihi ahadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa mani irtada min rasoolin fainnahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi rasadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a guard to go before him and a guard behind him}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[72][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{LiyaAAlama an qad ablaghoo risalati rabbihim waahata bima ladayhim waahsa kulla shayin AAadadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Muzzammil (The One Covering Himself)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha almuzzammilu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O thou wrapped up in thy raiment!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qumi allayla illa qaleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Keep vigil the night long, save a little -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Nisfahu awi onqus minhu qaleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A half thereof, or abate a little thereof}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw zid AAalayhi warattili alqurana tarteelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna sanulqee AAalayka qawlan thaqeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For we shall charge thee with a word of weight.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna nashiata allayli hiya ashaddu watan waaqwamu qeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna laka fee alnnahari sabhan taweelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waothkuri isma rabbika watabattal ilayhi tabteelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi la ilaha illa huwa faittakhithhu wakeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lord of the East and the West; there is no Allah save Him; so choose thou Him alone for thy defender -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waisbir AAala ma yaqooloona waohjurhum hajran jameelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watharnee waalmukaththibeena olee alnnaAAmati wamahhilhum qaleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna ladayna ankalan wajaheeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WataAAaman tha ghussatin waAAathaban aleeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma tarjufu alardu waaljibalu wakanati aljibalu katheeban maheelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna arsalna ilaykum rasoolan shahidan AAalaykum kama arsalna ila firAAawna rasoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaAAasa firAAawnu alrrasoola faakhathnahu akhthan wabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakayfa tattaqoona in kafartum yawman yajAAalu alwildana sheeban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alssamao munfatirun bihi kana waAAduhu mafAAoolan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[73][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna rabbaka yaAAlamu annaka taqoomu adna min thuluthayi allayli wanisfahu wathuluthahu wataifatun mina allatheena maAAaka waAllahu yuqaddiru allayla waalnnahara AAalima an lan tuhsoohu fataba AAalaykum faiqraoo ma tayassara mina alqurani AAalima an sayakoonu minkum marda waakharoona yadriboona fee alardi yabtaghoona min fadli Allahi waakharoona yuqatiloona fee sabeeli Allahi faiqraoo ma tayassara minhu waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waaqridoo Allaha qardan hasanan wama tuqaddimoo lianfusikum min khayrin tajidoohu AAinda Allahi huwa khayran waaAAthama ajran waistaghfiroo Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Muddaththir (The One Wrapping Himself Up)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha almuddaththiru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O thou enveloped in thy cloak,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qum faanthir}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Arise and warn!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Warabbaka fakabbir}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thy Lord magnify,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wathiyabaka fatahhir}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thy raiment purify,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalrrujza faohjur}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Pollution shun!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tamnun tastakthiru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And show not favour, seeking wordly gain!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walirabbika faisbir}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For the sake of thy Lord, be patient!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha nuqira fee alnnaqoori}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For when the trumpet shall sound,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fathalika yawmaithin yawmun AAaseerun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Surely that day will be a day of anguish,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAala alkafireena ghayru yaseerin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Not of ease, for disbelievers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tharnee waman khalaqtu waheedan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Leave Me (to deal) with him whom I created lonely,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAaltu lahu malan mamdoodan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And then bestowed upon him ample means,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wabaneena shuhoodan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And sons abiding in his presence}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamahhadtu lahu tamheedan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And made (life) smooth for him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma yatmaAAu an azeeda}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Yet he desireth that I should give more.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla innahu kana liayatina AAaneedan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Saorhiquhu saAAoodan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On him I shall impose a fearful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu fakkara waqaddara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For lo! he did consider; then he planned -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqutila kayfa qaddara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Self-)destroyed is he, how he planned!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma qutila kayfa qaddara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Again (self-)destroyed is he, how he planned! -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma nathara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then looked he,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma AAabasa wabasara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then frowned he and showed displeasure.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma adbara waistakbara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then turned he away in pride}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqala in hatha illa sihrun yutharu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And said: This is naught else than magic from of old;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In hatha illa qawlu albashari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is naught else than speech of mortal man.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Saosleehi saqara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Him shall I fling unto the burning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama adraka ma saqaru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} - Ah, what will convey unto thee what that burning is! -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La tubqee wala tatharu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It leaveth naught; it spareth naught}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lawwahatun lilbashari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It shrivelleth the man.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAalayha tisAAata AAashara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Above it are nineteen.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama jaAAalna ashaba alnnari illa malaikatan wama jaAAalna AAiddatahum illa fitnatan lillatheena kafaroo liyastayqina allatheena ootoo alkitaba wayazdada allatheena amanoo eemanan wala yartaba allatheena ootoo alkitaba waalmuminoona waliyaqoola allatheena fee quloobihim maradun waalkafiroona matha arada Allahu bihatha mathalan kathalika yudillu Allahu man yashao wayahdee man yashao wama yaAAlamu junooda rabbika illa huwa wama hiya illa thikra lilbashari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla waalqamari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, by the Moon}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallayli ith adbara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the night when it withdraweth}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalssubhi itha asfara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the dawn when it shineth forth,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innaha laihda alkubari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! this is one of the greatest (portents)}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Natheeran lilbashari}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As a warning unto men,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liman shaa minkum an yataqaddama aw yataakhkhara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto him of you who will advance or hang back.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kullu nafsin bima kasabat raheenatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Every soul is a pledge for its own deeds;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa ashaba alyameeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save those who will stand on the right hand.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee jannatin yatasaaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In gardens they will ask one another}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAani almujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Concerning the guilty:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ma salakakum fee saqara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} What hath brought you to this burning?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo lam naku mina almusalleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will answer: We were not of those who prayed}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walam naku nutAAimu almiskeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nor did we feed the wretched.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakunna nakhoodu maAAa alkhaideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We used to wade (in vain dispute) with (all) waders,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakunna nukaththibu biyawmi alddeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatta atana alyaqeenu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Till the Inevitable came unto us.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama tanfaAAuhum shafaAAatu alshshafiAAeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The mediation of no mediators will avail them then.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama lahum AAani alttathkirati muAArideena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Why now turn they away from the Admonishment,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaannahum humurun mustanfiratun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As they were frightened asses}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][51]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Farrat min qaswaratin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Fleeing from a lion?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][52]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal yureedu kullu imriin minhum an yuta suhufan munashsharatan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from Allah).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][53]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla bal la yakhafoona alakhirata}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][54]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla innahu tathkiratun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][55]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faman shaa thakarahu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So whosoever will may heed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[74][56]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yathkuroona illa an yashaa Allahu huwa ahlu alttaqwa waahlu almaghfirati}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they will not heed unless Allah willeth (it). He is the fount of fear. He is the fount of Mercy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Qiyamah (The Resurrection)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La oqsimu biyawmi alqiyamati}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala oqsimu bialnnafsi allawwamati}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ayahsabu alinsanu allan najmaAAa AAithamahu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bala qadireena AAala an nusawwiya bananahu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal yureedu alinsanu liyafjura amamahu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But man would fain deny what is before him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yasalu ayyana yawmu alqiyamati}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha bariqa albasaru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But when sight is confounded}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakhasafa alqamaru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the moon is eclipsed}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajumiAAa alshshamsu waalqamaru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And sun and moon are united,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yaqoolu alinsanu yawmaithin ayna almafarru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On that day man will cry: Whither to flee!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla la wazara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Alas! No refuge!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ila rabbika yawmaithin almustaqarru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yunabbao alinsanu yawmaithin bima qaddama waakhkhara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bali alinsanu AAala nafsihi baseeratun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaw alqa maAAatheerahu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Although he tender his excuses.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La tuharrik bihi lisanaka litaAAjala bihi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna AAalayna jamAAahu waquranahu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha qaranahu faittabiAA quranahu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when We read it, follow thou the reading;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma inna AAalayna bayanahu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla bal tuhibboona alAAajilata}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watatharoona alakhirata}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And neglect the Hereafter.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wujoohun yawmaithin nadiratun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That day will faces be resplendent,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ila rabbiha nathiratun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Looking toward their Lord;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wawujoohun yawmaithin basiratun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And that day will other faces be despondent,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tathunnu an yufAAala biha faqiratun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla itha balaghati alttaraqiya}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqeela man raqin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wathanna annahu alfiraqu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he knoweth that it is the parting;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wailtaffati alssaqu bialssaqi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And agony is heaped on agony;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ila rabbika yawmaithin almasaqu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala saddaqa wala salla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For he neither trusted, nor prayed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walakin kaththaba watawalla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But he denied and flouted.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma thahaba ila ahlihi yatamatta}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then went he to his folk with glee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Awla laka faawla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nearer unto thee and nearer,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma awla laka faawla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ayahsabu alinsanu an yutraka sudan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam yaku nutfatan min manayyin yumna}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma kana AAalaqatan fakhalaqa fasawwa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FajaAAala minhu alzzawjayni alththakara waalontha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And made of him a pair, the male and female.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[75][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alaysa thalika biqadirin AAala an yuhyiya almawta}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Insan (The Man)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hal ata AAala alinsani heenun mina alddahri lam yakun shayan mathkooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna khalaqna alinsana min nutfatin amshajin nabtaleehi fajaAAalnahu sameeAAan baseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna hadaynahu alssabeela imma shakiran waimma kafooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna aAAtadna lilkafireena salasila waaghlalan wasaAAeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna alabrara yashraboona min kasin kana mizajuha kafooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAaynan yashrabu biha AAibadu Allahi yufajjiroonaha tafjeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yoofoona bialnnathri wayakhafoona yawman kana sharruhu mustateeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WayutAAimona alttaAAama AAala hubbihi miskeenan wayateeman waaseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama nutAAimukum liwajhi Allahi la nureedu minkum jazaan wala shukooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna nakhafu min rabbina yawman AAaboosan qamtareeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fawaqahumu Allahu sharra thalika alyawmi walaqqahum nadratan wasurooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajazahum bima sabaroo jannatan wahareeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Muttakieena feeha AAala alaraiki la yarawna feeha shamsan wala zamhareeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wadaniyatan AAalayhim thilaluha wathullilat qutoofuha tathleelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayutafu AAalayhim bianiyatin min fiddatin waakwabin kanat qawareera}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qawareera min fiddatin qaddarooha taqdeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayusqawna feeha kasan kana mizajuha zanjabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAaynan feeha tusamma salsabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona itha raaytahum hasibtahum luluan manthooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha raayta thamma raayta naAAeeman wamulkan kabeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAaliyahum thiyabu sundusin khudrun waistabraqun wahulloo asawira min fiddatin wasaqahum rabbuhum sharaban tahooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna hatha kana lakum jazaan wakana saAAyukum mashkooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna nahnu nazzalna AAalayka alqurana tanzeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala tutiAA minhum athiman aw kafooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waothkuri isma rabbika bukratan waaseelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamina allayli faosjud lahu wasabbihhu laylan taweelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna haolai yuhibboona alAAajilata wayatharoona waraahum yawman thaqeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Nahnu khalaqnahum washadadna asrahum waitha shina baddalna amthalahum tabdeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu inna Allaha kana AAaleeman hakeeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[76][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihi waalththalimeena aAAadda lahum AAathaban aleeman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Mursalat (Those Sent Forth)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalmursalati AAurfan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaalAAasifati AAasfan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By the raging hurricanes,}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalnnashirati nashran}}

\end{Arabic}}

\quranayah[77][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalmulqiyati thikran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By those who bring down the Reminder,}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAuthran aw nuthran}}

\quranayah[77][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama tooAAadoona lawaqiAAun}}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha alnnujoomu tumisat}}

\quranayah[77][9]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha alssamao furijat}}

\quranayah[77][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha aljibalu nusifat}}

\quranayah[77][12]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liayyi yawmin ojjilat}}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyawmi alfasli}}

\quranayah[77][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama adraka ma yawmu alfasli}}

\quranayah[77][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Woe unto the repudiators on that day!}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam nuhliki alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Destroyed We not the former folk,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma nutbiAAuhumu alakhireena}}

\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kathalika nafAAalu bialmujrimeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thus deal We ever with the guilty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Woe unto the repudiators on that day!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam nakhluqkum min main maheenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Did We not create you from a base fluid}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FajaAAalnahu fee qararin makeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which We laid up in a safe abode}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ila qadarin maAAloomin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For a known term?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqadarna faniAAma alqadiroona}}

\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Woe unto the repudiators on that day!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam najAAali alarda kifatan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have We not made the earth a receptacle}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ahyaan waamwatan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Both for the living and the dead,}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalna feeha rawasiya shamikhatin waasqaynakum maan furatan}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Woe unto the repudiators on that day!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][29]

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La thaleelin wala yughnee mina allahabi}}

\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innaha tarmee bishararin kaalqasri}}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaannahu jimalatun sufrun}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Woe unto the repudiators on that day!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha yawmu la yantiqoona}}

\end{Arabic}}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Woe unto the repudiators on that day!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hatha yawmu alfasli jamaAAnakum waalawwaleena}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fain kana lakum kaydun fakeedooni}}

\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Woe unto the repudiators on that day!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][41]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna almuttaqeena fee thilalin waAAuyoonin}}

\quranayah[77][42]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wafawakiha mimma yashtahoona}}

\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum taAAmaloona}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena}}
