\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Woe unto the repudiators on that day!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kuloo watamattaAAoo qaleelan innakum mujrimoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][47]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Woe unto the repudiators on that day!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][48]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha qeela lahumu irkaAAoo la yarkaAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][49]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Woe unto the repudiators on that day!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[77][50]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fabiayyi hadeethin baAAdahu yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In what statement, after this, will they believe?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{An-Naba' (The Announcement)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAamma yatasaaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whereof do they question one another?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAani alnnabai alAAatheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (It is) of the awful tidings,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee hum feehi mukhtalifoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Concerning which they are in disagreement.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla sayaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but they will come to know!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma kalla sayaAAlamoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, again, but they will come to know!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam najAAali alarda mihadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Have We not made the earth an expanse,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaljibala awtadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the high hills bulwarks?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakhalaqnakum azwajan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We have created you in pairs,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalna nawmakum subatan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And have appointed your sleep for repose,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalna allayla libasan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And have appointed the night as a cloak,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalna alnnahara maAAashan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And have appointed the day for livelihood.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wabanayna fawqakum sabAAan shidadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WajaAAalna sirajan wahhajan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And have appointed a dazzling lamp,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waanzalna mina almuAAsirati maan thajjajan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Linukhrija bihi habban wanabatan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thereby to produce grain and plant,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajannatin alfafan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And gardens of thick foliage.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna yawma alfasli kana meeqatan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori fatatoona afwajan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wafutihati alssamao fakanat abwaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wasuyyirati aljibalu fakanat saraban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna jahannama kanat mirsadan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! hell lurketh in ambush,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lilttagheena maaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A home for the rebellious.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Labitheena feeha ahqaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will abide therein for ages.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yathooqoona feeha bardan wala sharaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa hameeman waghassaqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save boiling water and a paralysing cold:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Jazaan wifaqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahum kanoo la yarjoona hisaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakaththaboo biayatina kiththaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They called Our revelations false with strong denial.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakulla shayin ahsaynahu kitaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Everything have We recorded in a Book.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fathooqoo falan nazeedakum illa AAathaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna lilmuttaqeena mafazan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! for the duteous is achievement -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hadaiqa waaAAnaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Gardens enclosed and vineyards,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WakawaAAiba atraban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And voluptuous women of equal age;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakasan dihaqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And a full cup.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala kiththaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Jazaan min rabbika AAataan hisaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alrrahmani la yamlikoona minhu khitaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma yaqoomu alrroohu waalmalaikatu saffan la yatakallamoona illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waqala sawaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thalika alyawmu alhaqqu faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi maaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[78][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna antharnakum AAathaban qareeban yawma yanthuru almaro ma qaddamat yadahu wayaqoolu alkafiru ya laytanee kuntu turaban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{An-Nazi'at (Those Who Yearn)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaalnnaziAAati gharqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By those who drag forth to destruction,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalnnashitati nashtan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By the meteors rushing,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalssabihati sabhan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By the lone stars floating,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalssabiqati sabqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By the angels hastening,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalmudabbirati amran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And those who govern the event,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma tarjufu alrrajifatu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when the first trump resoundeth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{TatbaAAuha alrradifatu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the second followeth it,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Quloobun yawmaithin wajifatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On that day hearts beat painfully}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Absaruha khashiAAatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} While eyes are downcast}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yaqooloona ainna lamardoodoona fee alhafirati}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aitha kunna AAithaman nakhiratan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Even after we are crumbled bones?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qaloo tilka ithan karratun khasiratun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Surely it will need but one shout,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha hum bialssahirati}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! they will be awakened.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hal ataka hadeethu moosa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith nadahu rabbuhu bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ithhab ila firAAawna innahu tagha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqul hal laka ila an tazakka}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waahdiyaka ila rabbika fatakhsha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faarahu alayata alkubra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he showed him the tremendous token.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fakaththaba waAAasa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But he denied and disobeyed,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma adbara yasAAa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then turned he away in haste,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fahashara fanada}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then gathered he and summoned}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faqala ana rabbukumu alaAAla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faakhathahu Allahu nakala alakhirati waaloola}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna fee thalika laAAibratan liman yakhsha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aantum ashaddu khalqan ami alssamao banaha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{RafaAAa samkaha fasawwaha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He raised the height thereof and ordered it;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaghtasha laylaha waakhraja duhaha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.}

\quranayah[79][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalarda baAAda thalika dahaha}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Akhraja minha maaha wamarAAaha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waaljibala arsaha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He made fast the hills,}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{MataAAan lakum walianAAamikum}}

\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha jaati alttammatu alkubra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But when the great disaster cometh,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma yatathakkaru alinsanu ma saAAa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}

\quranayah[79][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waburrizati aljaheemu liman yara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faamma man tagha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then, as for him who rebelled}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waathara alhayata alddunya}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And chose the life of the world,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fainna aljaheema hiya almawa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! hell will be his home.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waama man khafa maqama rabbihi wanaha alnnafsa AAani alhawa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fainna aljannata hiya almawa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the Garden will be his home.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yasaloonaka AAani alssaAAati ayyana mursaha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][43]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Feema anta min thikraha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][44]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ila rabbika muntahaha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][45]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innama anta munthiru man yakhshaha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[79][46]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kaannahum yawma yarawnaha lam yalbathoo illa AAashiyyatan aw duhaha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{'Abasa (He Frowned)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAabasa watawalla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He frowned and turned away}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{An jaahu alaAAma}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Because the blind man came unto him.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yudreeka laAAallahu yazzakka}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw yaththakkaru fatanfaAAahu alththikra}}

\quranayah[80][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Amma mani istaghna}}

\quranayah[80][6]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faanta lahu tasadda}}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma man jaaka yasAAa}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faanta AAanhu talahha}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla innaha tathkiratun}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faman shaa thakarahu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So let whosoever will pay heed to it,}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee suhufin mukarramatin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On honoured leaves}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{MarfooAAatin mutahharatin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Exalted, purified,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Biaydee safaratin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Set down) by scribes}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kiramin bararatin}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][17]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Min ayyi shayin khalaqahu}}

\quranayah[80][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma alssabeela yassarahu}}

\quranayah[80][21]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma amatahu faaqbarahu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then causeth him to die, and burieth him;}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma itha shaa ansharahu}}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla lamma yaqdi ma amarahu}}

\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}

\quranayah[80][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falyanthuri alinsanu ila taAAamihi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Let man consider his food:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Anna sababna almaa sabban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} How We pour water in showers}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma shaqaqna alarda shaqqan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then split the earth in clefts}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faanbatna feeha habban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And cause the grain to grow therein}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAAinaban waqadban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And grapes and green fodder}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wazaytoonan wanakhlan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And olive-trees and palm-trees}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahadaiqa ghulban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And garden-closes of thick foliage}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wafakihatan waabban}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And fruits and grasses:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{MataAAan lakum walianAAamikum}}

\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faitha jaati alssakhkhatu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But when the Shout cometh}

\quranayah[80][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma yafirru almaro min akheehi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when a man fleeth from his brother}

\quranayah[80][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waommihi waabeehi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And his mother and his father}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wasahibatihi wabaneehi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And his wife and his children,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][37]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Likulli imriin minhum yawmaithin shanun yughneehi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][38]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wujoohun yawmaithin musfiratun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On that day faces will be bright as dawn,}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][39]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Dahikatun mustabshiratun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Laughing, rejoicing at good news;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][40]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wawujoohun yawmaithin AAalayha ghabaratun}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][41]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tarhaquha qataratun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Veiled in darkness,}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[80][42]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika humu alkafaratu alfajaratu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{At-Takwir (The Folding Up)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][1]
\end{Arabic}}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha alnnujoomu inkadarat}}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha alwuhooshu hushirat}}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha alssuhufu nushirat}}

\quranayah[81][11]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha alssamao kushitat}}

\quranayah[81][12]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha aljaheemu suAAAAirat}}

\quranayah[81][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha aljannatu ozlifat}}

\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAalimat nafsun ma ahdarat}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala oqsimu bialkhunnasi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Oh, but I call to witness the planets,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aljawari alkunnasi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The stars which rise and set,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallayli itha AAasAAasa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the close of night,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalssubhi itha tanaffasa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the breath of morning}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu laqawlu rasoolin kareemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thee quwwatin AAinda thee alAAarshi makeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{MutaAAin thamma ameenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (One) to be obeyed, and trustworthy;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama sahibukum bimajnoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And your comrade is not mad.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walaqad raahu bialofuqi almubeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama huwa AAala alghaybi bidaneenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And he is not avid of the Unseen.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama huwa biqawli shaytanin rajeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faayna tathhaboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whither then go ye?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liman shaa minkum an yastaqeema}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[81][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu rabbu alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Infitar (The Cleaving)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Itha alssamao infatarat}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When the heaven is cleft asunder,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha alkawakibu intatharat}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When the planets are dispersed,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha albiharu fujjirat}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When the seas are poured forth,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha alqubooru buAAthirat}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the sepulchres are overturned,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAalimat nafsun ma qaddamat waakhkharat}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alinsanu ma gharraka birabbika alkareemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee khalaqaka fasawwaka faAAadalaka}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee ayyi sooratin ma shaa rakkabaka}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla bal tukaththiboona bialddeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but ye deny the Judgment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna AAalaykum lahafitheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! there are above you guardians,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kiraman katibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Generous and recording,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{YaAAlamoona ma tafAAaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who know (all) that ye do.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna alabrara lafee naAAeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna alfujjara lafee jaheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yaslawnaha yawma alddeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama hum AAanha bighaibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And will not be absent thence.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama adraka ma yawmu alddeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma ma adraka ma yawmu alddeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[82][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma la tamliku nafsun linafsin shayan waalamru yawmaithin lillahi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{At-Tatfif (Default in Duty)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waylun lilmutaffifeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Woe unto the defrauders:}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena itha iktaloo AAala alnnasi yastawfoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha kaloohum aw wazanoohum yukhsiroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ala yathunnu olaika annahum mabAAoothoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Liyawmin AAatheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Unto an Awful Day,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma yaqoomu alnnasu lirabbi alAAalameena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla inna kitaba alfujjari lafee sijjeenin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama adraka ma sijjeenun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is! -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kitabun marqoomun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A written record.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Woe unto the repudiators on that day!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena yukaththiboona biyawmi alddeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Those who deny the Day of Judgment}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yukaththibu bihi illa kullu muAAtadin atheemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla bal rana AAala quloobihim ma kanoo yaksiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla innahum AAan rabbihim yawmaithin lamahjooboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma innahum lasaloo aljaheemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma yuqalu hatha allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla inna kitaba alabrari lafee AAilliyyeena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama adraka ma AAilliyyoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is! -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kitabun marqoomun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A written record,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yashhaduhu almuqarraboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna alabrara lafee naAAeemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the righteous verily are in delight,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAala alaraiki yanthuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On couches, gazing,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{TaAArifu fee wujoohihim nadrata alnnaAAeemi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yusqawna min raheeqin makhtoomin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khitamuhu miskun wafee thalika falyatanafasi almutanafisoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss -}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wamizajuhu min tasneemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And mixed with water of Tasnim,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAaynan yashrabu biha almuqarraboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena ajramoo kanoo mina allatheena amanoo yadhakoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][30]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha marroo bihim yataghamazoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And wink one to another when they passed them;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][31]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha inqalaboo ila ahlihimu inqalaboo fakiheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][32]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha raawhum qaloo inna haolai ladalloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][33]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama orsiloo AAalayhim hafitheena}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][34]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faalyawma allatheena amanoo mina alkuffari yadhakoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][35]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAala alaraiki yanthuroona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On high couches, gazing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[83][36]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hal thuwwiba alkuffaru ma kanoo yafAAaloona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Inshiqaq (The Bursting Asunder)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Itha alssamao inshaqqat}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When the heaven is split asunder}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waathinat lirabbiha wahuqqat}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And attentive to her Lord in fear,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha alardu muddat}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And when the earth is spread out}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalqat ma feeha watakhallat}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waathinat lirabbiha wahuqqat}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And attentive to her Lord in fear!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyuha alinsanu innaka kadihun ila rabbika kadhan famulaqeehi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faama man ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then whoso is given his account in his right hand}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasawfa yuhasabu hisaban yaseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He truly will receive an easy reckoning}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayanqalibu ila ahlihi masrooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And will return unto his folk in joy.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma man ootiya kitabahu waraa thahrihi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But whoso is given his account behind his back,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasawfa yadAAoo thubooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He surely will invoke destruction}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayasla saAAeeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And be thrown to scorching fire.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu kana fee ahlihi masrooran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He verily lived joyous with his folk,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu thanna an lan yahoora}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bala inna rabbahu kana bihi baseeran}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fala oqsimu bialshshafaqi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallayli wama wasaqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalqamari itha ittasaqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And by the moon when she is at the full,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Latarkabunna tabaqan AAan tabaqin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama lahum la yuminoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} What aileth them, then, that they believe not}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waitha quria AAalayhimu alquranu la yasjudoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bali allatheena kafaroo yukaththiboona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAllahu aAAlamu bima yooAAoona}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fabashshirhum biAAathabin aleemin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So give them tidings of a painful doom,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[84][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Buruj (The Stars)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalssamai thati alburooji}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalyawmi almawAAoodi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And by the Promised Day.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Washahidin wamashhoodin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qutila ashabu alukhdoodi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alnnari thati alwaqoodi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Of the fuel-fed fire,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ith hum AAalayha quAAoodun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} When they sat by it,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahum AAala ma yafAAaloona bialmumineena shuhoodun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama naqamoo minhum illa an yuminoo biAllahi alAAazeezi alhameedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi waAllahu AAala kulli shayin shaheedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena fatanoo almumineena waalmuminati thumma lam yatooboo falahum AAathabu jahannama walahum AAathabu alhareeqi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu thalika alfawzu alkabeeru}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna batsha rabbika lashadeedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu huwa yubdio wayuAAeedu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahuwa alghafooru alwadoodu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thoo alAAarshi almajeedi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lord of the Throne of Glory,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FaAAAAalun lima yureedu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Doer of what He will.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hal ataka hadeethu aljunoodi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FirAAawna wathamooda}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bali allatheena kafaroo fee taktheebin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaAllahu min waraihim muheetun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal huwa quranun majeedun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[85][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee lawhin mahfoothin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On a guarded tablet.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{At-Tariq (The Comer by Night)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalssamai waalttariqi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By the heaven and the Morning Star}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama adraka ma alttariqu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alnnajmu alththaqibu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} - The piercing Star!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{In kullu nafsin lamma AAalayha hafithun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} No human soul but hath a guardian over it.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Falyanthuri alinsanu mimma khuliqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So let man consider from what he is created.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Khuliqa min main dafiqin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He is created from a gushing fluid}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yakhruju min bayni alssulbi waalttaraibi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} That issued from between the loins and ribs.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu AAala rajAAihi laqadirun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yawma tubla alssarairu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fama lahu min quwwatin wala nasirin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then will he have no might nor any helper.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalssamai thati alrrajAAi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalardi thati alssadAAi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahu laqawlun faslun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama huwa bialhazli}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} It is no pleasantry.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Innahum yakeedoona kaydan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waakeedu kaydan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And I plot a plot (against them).}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[86][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Famahhili alkafireena amhilhum ruwaydan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-A'la (The Most High)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sabbihi isma rabbika alaAAla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee khalaqa fasawwa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who createth, then disposeth;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallathee qaddara fahada}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who measureth, then guideth;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallathee akhraja almarAAa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who bringeth forth the pasturage,}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FajaAAalahu ghuthaan ahwa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Then turneth it to russet stubble.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sanuqrioka fala tansa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
