\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa ma shaa Allahu innahu yaAAlamu aljahra wama yakhfa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanuyassiruka lilyusra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fathakkir in nafaAAati alththikra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Sayaththakkaru man yakhsha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He will heed who feareth,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wayatajannabuha alashqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But the most hapless will flout it,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee yasla alnnara alkubra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He who will be flung to the great Fire}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma la yamootu feeha wala yahya}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Wherein he will neither die nor live.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Qad aflaha man tazakka}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He is successful who groweth,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wathakara isma rabbihi fasalla}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Bal tuthiroona alhayata alddunya}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But ye prefer the life of the world}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalakhiratu khayrun waabqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna hatha lafee alssuhufi aloola}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! This is in the former scrolls.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[87][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Suhufi ibraheema wamoosa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The Books of Abraham and Moses.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Ghashiyah (The Overwhelming Event)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hal ataka hadeethu alghashiyati}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wujoohun yawmaithin khashiAAatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} On that day (many) faces will be downcast,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAamilatun nasibatun}}

\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tasla naran hamiyatan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Scorched by burning fire,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Tusqa min AAaynin aniyatin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Drinking from a boiling spring,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Laysa lahum taAAamun illa min dareeAAin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yusminu wala yughnee min jooAAin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wujoohun yawmaithin naAAimatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In that day other faces will be calm,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{LisaAAyiha radiyatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Glad for their effort past,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fee jannatin AAaliyatin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} In a high Garden}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La tasmaAAu feeha laghiyatan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Where they hear no idle speech,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Feeha AAaynun jariyatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Wherein is a gushing spring,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Feeha sururun marfooAAatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Wherein are couches raised}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waakwabun mawdooAAatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And goblets set at hand}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wanamariqu masfoofatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And cushions ranged}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wazarabiyyu mabthoothatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And silken carpets spread.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Afala yanthuroona ila alibili kayfa khuliqat}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waila alssamai kayfa rufiAAat}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the heaven, how it is raised?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waila aljibali kayfa nusibat}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the hills, how they are set up?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waila alardi kayfa sutihat}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the earth, how it is spread?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fathakkir innama anta muthakkirun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Lasta AAalayhim bimusaytirin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Thou art not at all a warder over them.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa man tawalla wakafara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But whoso is averse and disbelieveth,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{FayuAAaththibuhu Allahu alAAathaba alakbara}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Allah will punish him with direst punishment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna ilayna iyabahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! unto Us is their return}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[88][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma inna AAalayna hisabahum}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And Ours their reckoning.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\chapter{Al-Fajr (The Daybreak)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][1]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waalfajri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} By the Dawn}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walayalin AAashrin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And ten nights,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][3]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WaalshshafAAi waalwatri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the Even and the Odd,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][4]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waallayli itha yasri}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And the night when it departeth,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][5]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Hal fee thalika qasamun lithee hijrin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} There surely is an oath for thinking man.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biAAadin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Irama thati alAAimadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} With many-columned Iram,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatee lam yukhlaq mithluha fee albiladi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} The like of which was not created in the lands;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wathamooda allatheena jaboo alssakhra bialwadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley;}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WafirAAawna thee alawtadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And with Pharaoh, firm of might,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][11]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allatheena taghaw fee albiladi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faaktharoo feeha alfasada}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And multiplied iniquity therein?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][13]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasabba AAalayhim rabbuka sawta AAathabin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna rabbaka labialmirsadi}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faamma alinsanu itha ma ibtalahu rabbuhu faakramahu wanaAAAAamahu fayaqoolu rabbee akramani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waamma itha ma ibtalahu faqadara AAalayhi rizqahu fayaqoolu rabbee ahanani}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla bal la tukrimoona alyateema}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala tahaddoona AAala taAAami almiskeeni}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And urge not on the feeding of the poor.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][19]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watakuloona altturatha aklan lamman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Watuhibboona almala hubban jamman}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And love wealth with abounding love.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Kalla itha dukkati alardu dakkan dakkan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][22]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajaa rabbuka waalmalaku saffan saffan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][23]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wajeea yawmaithin bijahannama yawmaithin yatathakkaru alinsanu waanna lahu alththikra}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)?}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][24]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yaqoolu ya laytanee qaddamtu lihayatee}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][25]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fayawmaithin la yuAAaththibu AAathabahu ahadun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} None punisheth as He will punish on that day!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][26]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala yoothiqu wathaqahu ahadun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} None bindeth as He then will bind.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][27]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Ya ayyatuha alnnafsu almutmainnatu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But ah! thou soul at peace!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][28]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{IrjiAAee ila rabbiki radiyatan mardiyyatan}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[89][29]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faodkhulee fee AAibadee}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Enter thou among My bondmen!}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}

\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wahadaynahu alnnajdayni}}

\end{Arabic}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[90][12]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama adraka ma alAAaqabatu}}

\end{Arabic}}

\quranayah[90][14]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw itAAamun fee yawmin thee masghabatin}}

\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[90][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Yateeman tha maqrabatin}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[90][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Aw miskeenan tha matrabatin}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Or some poor wretch in misery,}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[90][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Thumma kana mina allatheena amanoo watawasaw bialssabri watawasaw bialmarhamati}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[90][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Olaika ashabu almaymanati}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Their place will be on the right hand.}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[90][19]
\end{Arabic}}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[90][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{AAalayhim narun musadatun}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Fire will be an awning over them.}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Waqad khaba man dassaha}}

\quranayah[91][14]

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[91][15]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wala yakhafu AAuqbaha}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} He dreadeth not the sequel (of events).}

\chapter{Al-Lail (The Night)}

\quranayah[92][1]
\end{Arabic}}

\quranayah[92][9]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wakaththaba bialhusna}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[92][10]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Fasanuyassiruhu lilAAusra}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[92][11]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama yughnee AAanhu maluhu itha taradda}}

\quranayah[92][12]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna AAalayna lalhuda}}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wainna lana lalakhirata waaloola}}

\quranayah[92][14]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Faanthartukum naran talaththa}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{La yaslaha illa alashqa}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[92][16]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee kaththaba watawalla}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[92][17]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wasayujannabuha alatqa}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Far removed from it will be the righteous}

\quranayah[92][18]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Allathee yutee malahu yatazakka}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[92][19]

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Wama liahadin AAindahu min niAAmatin tujza}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[92][20]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Illa ibtighaa wajhi rabbihi alaAAla}}

\quranayah[92][21]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Walasawfa yarda}}

\quranayah[93][11]

\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}

\quranayah[94][1]

\quranayah[94][2]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{WawadaAAna AAanka wizraka}}

\quranayah[94][6]

\chapter{Al-Bayyinah (The Clear Evidence)}
\begin{Arabic}
\Huge{\centerline{\basmalah}}\end{Arabic}

\end{Arabic}}

\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} And they are ordered naught else than to serve Allah, keeping religion pure for Him, as men by nature upright, and to establish worship and to pay the poor-due. That is true religion.}
\vspace{2pt}\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.2pt}\vspace{2pt}
\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[98][6]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi waalmushrikeena fee nari jahannama khalideena feeha olaika hum sharru albariyyati}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Lo! those who disbelieve, among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters, will abide in fire of hell. They are the worst of created beings.}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[98][7]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati olaika hum khayru albariyyati}}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[98][8]
\end{Arabic}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Transliteration:} \textit{Jazaohum AAinda rabbihim jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan radiya Allahu AAanhum waradoo AAanhu thalika liman khashiya rabbahu}}
\flushleft{\small\textsc{Translation:} Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord.}

\flushright{\begin{Arabic}
\quranayah[99][8]
\end{Arabic}}
